dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa darig a tibili, ka filim a tarili, ka chɛ ka a tumd a dimnim bɛn nyɛ Filistianim yubu, bɛn nyɛ vi ni gbahi shɛba a biɛriyoli tuma maa zuɣu la.
en: Now I have raised my hand to punish you and to take away your share of my blessing. I have handed you over to the Philistines, who hate you and are disgusted with your immoral actions.

dag: yi ma ni ti di vi pam, ka ŋun daa dɔɣi ya ti nya filiŋ. Nyama, o ni ti be zuliya kam nyaaŋa. O ni ti bemi kaman tiŋgban nɛli din kuui ka kom ka di ni la.
en: But Mother Babylon will be humiliated; the one who bore you will be disgraced. She will become the least of the nations: a wilderness, a desert, and parched land.

dag: Ka kukoli maa lan yɛl o pahi buyi, Naawuni ni lihi binshɛŋa bin suma, nyin miri ka a bol li bin yoya.
en: But the voice said to him again, God has made these things pure. Dont say they are unfit to eat.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna, Sara maligu shee alahichi yɛn ʒila a min a bidibisi ni a yaannim zuliya bɛn be a sani zuɣu; ka maligumaanitali alahichi ʒi a min a bidibisi maa kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: The LORD said to Aaron: You, your sons, and your household will bear the guilt of offenses connected with the sanctuary. You and your sons will bear the guilt of offenses connected with your priesthood.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nanim tiɣisirila tab ʒiina, ka zuɣulaannim laɣindi tɔri jina jɛndiri Yawɛ min o ni pii na so la yɛra.
en: Their kings and leaders join together to fight against the Lord and his chosen king.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ o ni woligi shɛb kaman piɛri la zal o nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ o ni woligi shɛb mi kaman buhi la zal o nuzaa polo.
en: He will place the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.

dag: Di ni simdi ni shɛli be daadam biɛhigu ni nyɛla ʒiɛyimtali, ka nir yi nyɛ faralana di so ʒiŋmara.
en: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni yihi ba yi ni daa zaŋ ba kɔhi luɣ shɛŋa maa ni na. N ni chɛ ka yi tuma maa lab lu yi zuɣu.
en: Now I am going to bring them out of the places to which you have sold them. I will do to you what you have done to them.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ nyɛla Yaakubu mini Reechɛl zuliya. Bɛ zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaanahi.
en: These are Rachels sons who were born to Jacob, a total of persons.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dinzuɣu nyamiya, n je anabi shɛb bɛn zuri n yɛligu bɛ tab sani la.
en: I am against those prophets who take each other's words and proclaim them as my message.

dag: Yawɛ alibarika ni yi Ziɔn na paag a. Naawuni chɛ ka a nya Jɛrusalɛm tɔŋbu a dunia yili bebu ni zaa.
en: May the Lord bless you from Mount Zion. May you enjoy the blessings of Jerusalem all your life.

dag: Ŋunkam ti ninvuɣ biɛɣu yɛlimaŋli mini ŋunkam galim wuntizɔra, di zaa nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani.
en: Judging the righteous wicked and the wicked righteous— the LORD detests both of these.

dag: Bɛ ni ti boli ba, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi, ka nyɛ Yawɛ ni tiligi shɛba. Jɛrusalɛm, bɛ ni ti bol a la, Tiŋ gahindili, ka lan bol a, Tin shɛli din be kasi, ka Naawuni bi zaɣis a.
en: You will be called God's Holy People, The People the Lord Has Saved. Jerusalem will be called The City That God Loves, The City That God Did Not Forsake.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu boli zaɣ viɛlli, ka zaŋ zaɣ viɛlli boli zaɣ biɛɣu, ka zaŋ zibisim leei neesim, ka zaŋ neesim leei zibisim, ka zaŋ bintɔɣu boli binnyaɣisili, ka zaŋ binnyaɣisili boli bintɔɣu.
en: You are headed for trouble! You say wrong is right, darkness is light, and bitter is sweet.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The LORDs word came to me.

dag: ni Nibishan ni Yalim Tiŋ la ni Ɛngɛdi: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara ayɔbu m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Nibshan, Salt City, and Engedi: six cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: Dabisili din daŋ tooni dali yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: On the first day of the festival you are to gather for worship, and no work is to be done.

dag: Naawuni, yiɣisim kari dunianim saria, dama nyini n-su zuliya kam zaa.
en: Get up, God! You be the judge! You be the leader over all the nations!.

dag: Yawɛ, a yi yɛn niŋ ti daalahichi laasabu, ti Duuma, ŋuni n-lee ni tiligi?.
en: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.

dag: Di tambu shee tiŋa zaŋ hal ni di tariga tiŋli ni ti nyɛla mita yini, ka di yɛliŋ ti nyɛ sɛntimita pihinu. Di naŋgbaŋkuɣili kara zaŋ ti paai naŋgbaŋkuɣili bihi ni ti nyɛla mita ayi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihinu.
en: From the ground to the lower ledge, the base measured cubits. It was cubit wide. It measured cubits from the smaller ledge to the larger ledge. It was cubits wide.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti ti nimmira yɛlimaŋli, yi mi di ti zaŋ gaŋbu bee birapu dibu kpɛhi yi bebu ni, dama birapu dibu nyɛla din chɛ ka baŋda nina bi ne, ka chɛ ka bɛn mali yɛlimaŋli kɔŋdi yɛlimaŋli.
en: They are not to be unjust or show partiality in their judgments; and they are not to accept bribes, for gifts blind the eyes even of wise and honest men, and cause them to give wrong decisions.

dag: Ka peentɔriba daa to Naa Jɔsia piɛm ka di gbaag o, ka o daa yɛl o kpambaliba bɛn be o sani, Zaŋmiya ma yi kpaŋa, dama n nya daŋ pam.
en: During the battle an Egyptian soldier shot Josiah with an arrow. Josiah told his servants, Get me out of here! I've been hit.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tim ti boli Pool na ka Tɛɛtulus gbaag o fiɣisibu yɛra: N dan Filiksi, a zuɣu ka ti ʒiya ni alaafee, ka a tumdi tuun suma tiri ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa.
en: So Paul was called in, and Tertullus stated the case against him: Honorable Felix, you have brought our people a long period of peace, and because of your concern our nation is much better off.

dag: Di yi di nyɛla n dimnima n-di maani ma ansarisi, n naan tooi deei li; ka n datahi n-yi di diri dari niŋdi ma, n naan tooi sɔɣi ka bɛ ku nya ma.
en: Its not an enemy that is insulting me— I could handle that. Its not someone who hates me who is exalted over me— I could hide from them.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla kikahi piɛbbu mini tɔbu zambu bubu dabisili din yɛn lu bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa mini bɛn wɔɣila din du pam zuɣu.
en: It will be like a time of war when people hear horns and trumpets in the defense towers and protected cities.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n ti zaŋ ya kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be kaman yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣ shɛli chi mini kawana ni wain ni bindira ni tihi puri ni be.
en: until the emperor resettles you in a country much like your own, where there are vineyards to give wine and there is grain for making bread.

dag: Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa kpahi zaa mini lɔndo din daa gili Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa kpahi zaa daa nyɛla daanya.
en: The pegs for the tent and for the curtain around the tent were made of bronze.

dag: A ni saɣi je suli niŋ ti sahakam? A ni yiɣis a suhu bahi ti zuɣu sahakam? Yi ni yɛli shɛm m-bala, amaa yi tum tuumbiɛ shɛlikam yin ni tooi tum.
en: You also said, God will not always be angry with me. His anger will not continue forever. Judah, you say that, but you do as much evil as you can.

dag: Di chɛ ka n dimnim bɛn nyɛ ʒiŋmariba la nyaŋ ma, ka di dari niŋ ma; a mi di chɛ ka bɛn je ma ka di ka daliri la chani n-kaɣiri bɛ nina lihiri ma.
en: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.

dag: Amaa ka Leeban yɛl o, Chɛ ka n yɛl a, n vihiya nya ka di nyɛla a zuɣu ka Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni;.
en: Laban said to him, Please, let me say something. I know that the Lord has blessed me because of you.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Naawuni zali Vuhim Dabisili dali tila ninsalinima, amaa o bi nam ninsalinim ti Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Then Jesus said to the Pharisees, The Sabbath day was made to help people. People were not made to be ruled by the Sabbath.

dag: ka di daa niŋ niriba maa suhupiɛlli pam, dama bɛ daa zaŋ li ti Yawɛ ni suhu yini ka di nyɛ bɛ suhuyubu. Ka di daa niŋ Naa Dauda gba nyaɣisim pam.
en: David and the people were very happy that so much had been given to the Lord , and they all celebrated.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi tin tariga nti siɣi wain adaka maa puuni nɔra, ka ʒim daa zɔri yiri wain tɔɣiri adaka maa ni na n-zo n-chaŋ hal ti paai kaman kilomita kɔbisita wɔɣilim tariga, ka di zilim mi paai wɔhu nyɔɣu tariga.
en: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about kilometers long and almost deep enough to cover a horse.

dag: Miri ka a ku ninsala.
en: Do not kill.

dag: Kaman kom ni yi zo n-liilii kuɣa, ka kopaliga ʒi tiŋgbani taŋkpaɣu chaŋ shɛm, lala ka a saɣindi daadam tahima.
en: Water flowing over stones wears them down. Floods wash away the soil on the ground. In the same way, God, you destroy the hope people have.

dag: Di saha maa Judanim zaa mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ biliɛri ni bɛ bi kura zaa daa ʒiɛla Yawɛ tooni.
en: All Judah was standing before the LORD, even their little ones, wives, and children.

dag: N yi ti saɣim Ijiptinim nam sulinsi, ka bɛ bara nyubu yiko naai, wuntaŋ ni ni ti zibigi Tɛhafinɛhɛs, ka sagbana ti lim tiŋ maa. Ka bɛ ti gbahi bɛ tiŋkpansi niriba chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: It will be a dark day in Tahpanhes when I break Egypts control. Her proud power will be finished! A cloud will cover Egypt, and her daughters will be taken away as prisoners.

dag: Ka doo maa dii nya alaafee, ka kpuɣ o bindoo chaŋ o chandi. Dindali maa daa nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Right then the man was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking around. The day on which this happened was a Sabbath.

dag: ka zaŋ Kpiɔŋlan Naa leeg a salima min a daanzinfa din viɛli pam.
en: Let God All-Powerful be your silver and gold.

dag: nti zaŋ li kpɛhi bɛ buɣili Dagɔn duu ti zali baɣili buɣili Dagɔn.
en: They brought it into the temple of their god Dagon and put it next to the statue of Dagon, which they worshiped.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Ijipti daanya na, ka chɛ ka Itiɔpianim mi kpuɣi bɛ nuhi duhi zuɣusaa jɛm Naawuni.
en: Messengers from Egypt will come bearing gifts. Ethiopia will offer God their tribute.

dag: Dama a yurilim maŋli zaŋ chaŋ m polo galisiya pam; a yihi n shia kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: because your faithful love toward me is awesome and because youve rescued my life from the lowest part of hell.

dag: Miriya ka yi di ʒiri shɛhira n-jɛndi yi kpee.
en: Do not testify falsely against your neighbor.

dag: Nir yi yiini yila niŋdi ŋun mali suhugarigu, di ŋmanila bɛ ni niŋ bilisitom pa yum ni la. Kaman binneembila ni be situra ni bee nɔyɛla ni be dari ni shɛm, lala ka suhugarigu dimdi daadam suhu ni.
en: Singing happy songs to a sad person is as foolish as taking a coat off on a cold day or mixing soda and vinegar.

dag: Amaa pakoli bee paɣ so ŋun yi dooyili yi po pɔri ni o niŋ shɛli, fashee ka di zani.
en: A widow or a divorced woman might make a special promise. If she does, she must do exactly what she promised.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bipuɣiŋga. Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Bolim o yuli Kunyanambɔzɔbo, dama n ku lan zo Izraɛlnim nambɔɣu, ka chɛ bɛ taali hal biɛla gba.
en: Then Gomer became pregnant again and gave birth to a daughter. The Lord said to Hosea, Name her Lo-Ruhamah, because I will not show mercy to the nation of Israel anymore, nor will I forgive them.

dag: Ka o zaŋ li mihi ninvuɣ so ŋun daa mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa buyopɔin, di nyaaŋa ka o yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni, ka zaŋ noombil nɛɔŋ maa bahi ka o yiɣi.
en: He will sprinkle the person who needs purification from skin disease seven times and declare that they are clean. Then the priest will release the wild bird into the countryside.

dag: Ka suli daa ku bɛnkam zaa be jɛmbu duu maa ni n-wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: When the people in the synagogue heard this, they were filled with anger.

dag: Amaa nyin Naawuni shiri ni tooi be dunia ŋɔ ni? Nyama, zuɣusaa mini di galisim ŋɔ zaa pɔri ni a biɛhigu shee, di ni ti be ka n ni me du shɛli ŋɔ?.
en: There's not enough room in all of heaven for you, Lord God. How could you possibly live on earth in this temple I have built?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Bia maa ku tooi niŋ shɛli omaŋmaŋ yubu ni naɣila o ni nya ka o Ba niŋdi shɛli, dama Ba maa ni niŋdi shɛli, dina ka Bia maa gba niŋda.
en: Jesus told the people: I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ bindira maa zali ŋun daa guli bɛ nɛma sani, ka guui ti kpe tɔb gɔɣu maa ni chaŋ ti puh o biɛyanim maa.
en: David left his things with the man in charge of supplies and ran up to the battle line to ask his brothers if they were well.

dag: Azɛl ba. Azɛl daa malila bidibisi ayɔbu, bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Azirikam mini Bokɛru ni Ishimail ni Shiaria ni Obadia ni Hana. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Azɛl bidibisi maa.
en: Azel had six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.

dag: Dama hal ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun taɣ ma ka m bi niŋ ya zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ zuɣu, a yi di bi kana yomyom ti nya ma, biɛɣuni asiba doo zaɣ yino gba sa naan ku lan guui Nabal yiŋa.
en: As surely as the Lord , the God of Israel, lives, if you hadnt come quickly to meet me, not one man in Nabals family would have lived until tomorrow morning. But the Lord prevented me from hurting you.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa chaŋ ti dɔni miri Chɛrit kulibɔŋ din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: Elijah went and did just what the LORD said. He stayed by the Cherith Brook that faced the Jordan River.

dag: Nabipuɣinsi be a dundɔŋ ni paɣ shɛb bɛn mali jilima la ni, ka a paani ʒe a nudirigu polo n-ye salima din yi Ofiri na.
en: Among the women of your court are daughters of kings, and at the right of your throne stands the queen, wearing ornaments of finest gold.

dag: ka yi ti yɛli yili maa yidana ni yi karimba n-tim ya na ni yi ti bɔh o ni du din ni ka o min nyaandoliba yɛn ʒini m-puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ ka di di bindirigu?.
en: and say to the owner, Our teacher wants to know where he can eat the Passover meal with his disciples.

dag: Di to ni ninvuɣ so saɣi kpi wuntizɔra zuɣu, amaa di pa shɛli so ni saɣi kpi ninvuɣ sun so zuɣu.
en: No one is really willing to die for an honest person, though someone might be willing to die for a truly good person.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa wuɣi lans ayi din nyɛ zaɣ bɔribɔri ka mali zoligo bansi niŋ li n-zaŋ li pili biŋkpila din tam daanya daantalisi maa zuɣu la. Daantaliga kam daa malila di laŋa.
en: He made an intricate network of chains for the capitals on top of the columns, seven for each capital.

dag: O sani ka dɔɣiri yini kam niriba bɛn be alizanda ni mini bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa yu maŋli yina.
en: from whom every family in heaven and on earth receives its true name.

dag: Bɛn diri zalinsi nyɛla bɛn bɔri yɛla tiri bɛ yiŋnima, amaa bɛn je birapu dibu ni be.
en: Those who acquire things unjustly gain trouble for their house, but those who hate bribes will live.

dag: Naawuni, a tɛha nyɛla din viɛli pam n sani, di galisiya.
en: God, your plans are incomprehensible to me! Their total number is countless!.

dag: Lɛvinim zuliya bɛn daa yi Babilɔn n-lab kuli maa kalinli m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛshua mini Kadimiɛl — pisopɔinnaanahi.
en: These are the people from the tribe of Levi: the descendants of Jeshua and Kadmiel through the family of Hodaviah:.

dag: Amaa saha kanna ka bɛ ni ti yihi aŋgo maa bɛ sani, dindali maa ka bɛ ni ti lo noli.
en: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them. Then they will fast.

dag: A ni ti bo a dimnim shee, amaa ka ku nya ba; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tuhir a ni ti bahi yoli.
en: You will look around for those brutal enemies, but you won't find them— they will be gone.

dag: Piligu ni ka Naawuni ni booni so Yɛligu la daa be. Yɛligu maa daa bela Naawuni sani. Yɛligu maa daa nyɛla Naawuni.
en: In the beginning was the one who is called the Word. The Word was with God and was truly God.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ tin shɛŋa din be tooni ŋɔ ha ka n ti yihi waazu nimaani gba; dama di zuɣu ka n kana.
en: He replied, Lets head in the other direction, to the nearby villages, so that I can preach there too. Thats why Ive come.

dag: Wɔribariba niŋdi shili, ka takɔbi chɛri piɣibpiɣib, ka kpana nyaɣisira. Ka bɛ ku niriba pam, n-zaŋ ba sɔŋ duyaduya. Kpiimba maa ka tariga, ka bɛ tuuri kpiimba maa.
en: cavalry attacking, swords and spears flashing; soldiers stumbling over piles of dead bodies.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa zaa m-pahi ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri.
en: They took all the spoils of war and the valuable property, both human and animal.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb zaŋdi anzinfa pari sania zuɣu zahindi li, ka zaŋdi bɛ kola ni salima pahiri tiri machɛlinim ka bɛ maani wuna tiri ba, ka bɛ damdiri tiŋ jɛmdi li!.
en: People open their purses and pour out gold; they weigh out silver on the scales. They hire a goldsmith to make a god; then they bow down and worship it.

dag: chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o bidibis ayopɔin ti ti ka ti zaŋ ba chaŋ Gibiɔn nti ku ba Yawɛ zol la zuɣu ŋun Yawɛ tooni. Ka naa daa yɛli, N ni zaŋ ba tin ya.
en: Give us seven of Sauls sons. Saul was the Lord s chosen king, so we will hang his sons in front of the Lord on Mount Gibeah of Saul. King David said, All right, I will give them to you.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun mali kpiɔŋ, ka kpaŋsir o bɔɣiri n-tumdi kpiɔŋ tuma.
en: and she always works hard.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa yi n-chaŋ ni o ti bo ʒiɛvari na nti nya mɔɣu ni yɔɣili m-pɔhi li buɣi na nti ŋmahiŋmahi li niŋ ʒɛduɣu maa ni, ka bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: One of them went out in the fields to get some herbs. He found a wild vine and picked as many gourds as he could carry. He brought them back and sliced them up into the stew, not knowing what they were.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛ ka n niriba ŋɔ chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ti puhi chuɣu ti ma. .
en: Moses and Aaron went to the king of Egypt and told him, The Lord God says, Let my people go into the desert, so they can honor me with a celebration there. .

dag: Lala n-nyɛ yi gba: Yi yi tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛli so ni bi mi, wula ka so ni tooi baŋ di gbinni? Di yi nyɛ lala, dindina yi tɔɣisiri bahirila pɔhim ni yoli.
en: Its the same way with you: If you dont use language that is easy to understand when you speak in a tongue, then how will anyone understand what is said?.

dag: man Yawɛ daa yi katiŋa n-ka bɛ sanna. N kul yuri ya mi sahakam, dinzuɣu ka n kul gbibi ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ yi sani.
en: the LORD appeared to them from a distance: I have loved you with a love that lasts forever. And so with unfailing love, I have drawn you to myself.

dag: Amaa vi tuma maa nyɛla din di ti yaannim ni daa tum tuma bo binshɛlikam zaa zali ti ti bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ la, dina n-nyɛ bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu mini bɛ niɣi ni bɛ bidibisi ni bɛ bipuɣinsi.
en: From our youth, shame has devoured the fruit of our parents labor— their flocks and herds, as well as their sons and daughters.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛn tɛhi lala baŋ ni ti ni yɛri shɛm ti gbana puuni maa, lala ka ti ni niŋ ti yi ti be yi sani gba.
en: Such a person must understand that there is no difference between what we write in our letters when we are away and what we will do when we are there with you.

dag: Ka o yidan maa bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri ni a chaŋ o sani zuŋɔ? Zuŋɔ pala gol palli dabisili bee Vuhim Dabisili. Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Di bi galim.
en: Her husband said, Why are you going to him today? Its not a new moon or sabbath. She said, Dont worry about it.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ammɔnnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ ni tuhiri ni bɛ deei tiŋgbani palo pahi la zuɣu, bɛ daa kuhi karigi paɣipuhinim puya Giliad.
en: The LORD proclaims: For three crimes of the Ammonites, and for four, I wont hold back the punishment, because they have ripped open pregnant women in Gilead in order to possess more land.

dag: O bi chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri mali nyɛvili, amaa o zaŋdi bɛn diri wahala yɛlimaŋli tiri ba.
en: He will not let evil people live. He brings justice to the poor.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan fa Amalɛknim maa ni daa ŋme n-di binshɛŋa maa zaa, ka lan fa o paɣiba ayi la gba.
en: David got back everything the Amalekites had taken, including his two wives.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Sandihir so n-daa be m-mal o sandaannima ayi; yino daa di o samli ka di paai tumtumda yuma ayi tuma yɔri, ka ŋun la mi di o samli ka di paai tumtumda chira ayi tuma yɔri.
en: A certain lender had two debtors. One owed enough money to pay five hundred people for a days work.The other owed enough money for fifty.

dag: Tɛhimi n ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ yɛla, dama ti Duuma ni chɛ ka a baŋ shɛlikam zaa gbinni.
en: Think about what Im saying; the Lord will give you understanding about everything.

dag: O chɛ ka a dunokparitisi mali kpiɔŋ, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a niriba ni.
en: He keeps your gates strong; he blesses your people.

dag: ka po Naawuni ŋun ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka nyɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni ni dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni ni teeku mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni ŋɔ n-yɛli ni guhibu lan kani.
en: He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, You won't have to wait any longer.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, O ba yi di tuhi nintɔri vie o ninni, vi naan ku gbaag o paai daba ayopɔin? Chɛ ka bɛ yih o kpaŋ daba ayopɔin, di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi zaŋ o labina.
en: The Lord answered, If her father had spit in her face, she would have to bear her disgrace for seven days. So let her be shut out of the camp for a week, and after that she can be brought back in.

dag: Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni daa kari nanim nimaani, o daa chɛ ka sakuɣa lu Zalimɔn Zoli zuɣu na.
en: When the Almighty scattered the kings there, snow fell on Mount Zalmon.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe bɛn guli siliga maa pam, ka bɛ ni sɔhira, ka bɛ be kaman kpiimba la.
en: The guards shook from fear and fell down, as though they were dead.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Izraɛlnim zaa na ti yɛli ba, Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa n ni wuhiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Bɔhimmiya li ka dol li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.

dag: Miri ka a ku ninsala.
en: You must not murder anyone.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o suhudoo pina din nyɛ bɔrɔbɔro kpila din mali dabindi m-pahi o wumpaɣibo sara maligu maa zuɣu na.
en: You must also bring loaves of bread made with yeast to go with your fellowship offering.

dag: Dama Babilɔn naa maa ʒiɛla sochira zuɣu ni o vihi nya o ni yɛn doli so shɛli. O chaɣisi piɛma, ka niŋ buɣa saawara, ka vihi maligu biŋkɔbigu binsabili.
en: The king of Babylon has come to where the two roads separate. He uses magic to learn which way to go: He shakes his arrows, he asks his family idols, and he looks at the liver from an animal he has killed.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa zaŋ o bia Abija ŋun daa nyɛ Maaka bia la n-leei nabi kpɛma, dama o nia daa nyɛla o ti zaŋ o leei naa.
en: so he chose their oldest son Abijah to be the next king.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhiri ya ni yi di chɛ ka yi suhuri miligi n ni diri wahala shɛli yi zuɣu la zuɣu; di nyɛla din yɛn sɔŋ ya kpaŋsi yi suhuri.
en: So then, I ask you not to become discouraged by what Im suffering for you, which is your glory.

dag: Izraɛlnim pin shɛŋa zaa din be kasi puuni bɛ ni zaŋ pin shɛlikam ti maligumaana, di nyɛla o dini.
en: Also every special contribution which the Israelites offer to the Lord belongs to the priest to whom they present it.

dag: N yi ti chɛ ka Ijipti zani dabari, ka chɛ ka binshɛŋa zaa din daa be di ni vuui, n yi ti ku binshɛɣukam din be di ni, di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Egypt will become a barren wasteland, and no living thing will ever survive there. Then you and your people will know that I am the Lord .

dag: ka o niriba ti baŋ tiliginsim ni nyɛ shɛli bɛ taali chɛ m-paŋ puuni.
en: You will make his people understand that they will be saved by having their sins forgiven.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yiɣis o kpim maa sani n-chaŋ ti yɛli Hitinima.
en: Then he left his dead wife and went to talk to the Hittites. He said.

dag: Amaa ka Ashpɛnaz daa lee zɔri naa dabiɛm, ka yɛli Daniɛl, Naa pun wuhi yi ni yɛn diri bindir shɛŋa mini yi ni yɛn nyuri binnyur shɛli, ka yi niŋgbuna yi ti bi pa taba kaman yi tab la dini, o ni ŋma n zuɣu.
en: Ashpenaz, however, was afraid of the king, so he said to Daniel, The king has decided what you are to eat and drink, and if you don't look as fit as the other young men, he may kill me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɔab, Nyama, naa kumdimi ka fabindi Absalom zuɣu.
en: Someone told Joab, The king is crying because Absalom is dead.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, N cham ti liri Filistianim maa? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Dauda, Cham ti liri ba n-tiligi Kɛilanim maa.
en: David asked the Lord , Should I go and fight these Philistines? The Lord answered David, Yes, go attack the Philistines. Save Keilah.

dag: Hal n ni pa so dabili maa zaa yoli, n zaŋ mmaŋ leela sokam zaa dabili din ni chɛ ka n tooi tiligi niriba pahi.
en: I am free. I belong to no other person, but I make myself a slave to everyone. I do this to help save as many people as I can.

dag: Ʒiɛman shɛŋa din gari la ni, o daa chɛ ka zuliya kam doli bɛ suhu yubu.
en: In the past God let all the nations do what they wanted.

dag: n-yɛra, Miriya ka yi nahim n ninvuɣ gahinda maa; ka miriya ka yi niŋ n daanabinim zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Dont touch my anointed ones; dont harm my prophets.

dag: O chɛ ka n noli bemi kaman takɔbi dirili la. O daa zaŋ ma sɔɣila o nuu mahim ka daa chɛ ka m be kaman peen dirili la, ka o zaŋ ma su o lɔɣu ni.
en: He made my words as sharp as a sword. With his own hand he protected me. He made me like an arrow, sharp and ready for use.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ nyaŋ ninvuɣ maŋa pam, chɛliya ka ti chɛ ba ka bɛ be tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni n-gɔri kɔhigu bɛ yubu, dama tiŋgbani ŋɔ galisiya pam; ka chɛ ka ti kpuɣiri bɛ bipuɣinsi; ka ti gba zaŋdi ti bipuɣinsi tiri ba.
en: These men are friendly; let them live in the land with us and travel freely. The land is large enough for them also. Let us marry their daughters and give them ours in marriage.

dag: Di saha ka o daa kuhi pam yɛli, ŋmamiya tia maa luhi; ka ŋmahi di wula bahi; ka wɔbi di vari bahi; ka wɔbi di wala gba bahi. Karimiya biŋkɔbiri la di gbini ka kari noonsi la di wula maa zuɣu.
en: He proclaimed in a loud voice, Cut the tree down and chop off its branches; strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit. Drive the animals from under it and the birds out of its branches.

dag: Musa daa yi zaŋ o nuu duhi zuɣusaa, Izraɛlnim nyarila yaa n-tuhiri nyandi Amalɛknim maa, o mi daa yi ti zaŋ o nuu siɣisi tiŋa, Amalɛknim maa nyarila yaa n-tuhir nyɛndi Izraɛlnim maa.
en: Any time Moses held his hands in the air, the men of Israel would start winning the fight. But when Moses put his hands down, the men of Israel began to lose the fight.

dag: Yilimiya yila niŋ o. Yilimiya yila paɣ o. Yɛlimiya o ni tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa zaa yɛla.
en: Sing praises to the Lord ! Tell about his miracles.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ni n yaa; ŋuna n-nyɛ n tiliginsim.
en: My power and my strength come from the Lord , and he has saved me.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋmi alikama mini chi ni tuya ni sima ni za ni alikama bali shɛli n-niŋ ŋman yini ni m-mali amaŋmaŋ bɔrɔbɔro. Dabisa shɛŋa a ni yɛn do a luɣili zuɣu maa, di nyɛla dabisa kɔbisita ni pihiwɛi, dina ka a ti yɛn ŋubira.
en: Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the days you are lying down.

dag: Dinzuɣu yihimiya dinkam nyɛ daɣiri mini biɛribiɛtali zaa yi bebu ni, ka doliya tarimtali soli n-deei Naawuni ni zaŋ yɛligu shɛli biri yi suhuri ni, ka di nyɛ din ni tooi tiligi ya la.
en: So get rid of every filthy habit and all wicked conduct. Submit to God and accept the word that he plants in your hearts, which is able to save you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim, m mihirila n ninni niŋdi ba, bɛ ni bi dol a zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: I look at those traitors and hate what I see, because they refuse to do what you say.

dag: ni kanaafiri ni binnyoon viɛla balibu kam ni tulaale zim ni tulaale zin shɛŋa bɛ ni booni mɛɛr ni firanki tulaale zim la ni wain ni kpam ni zim balli mini chi ni niɣi mini piɛri ni yuri ni chɛchɛbunsi zaŋ tabili daba mini ninsalinim nyɛviya la.
en: They also sell cinnamon, spice, incense, frankincense, myrrh, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, carriages, and slaves—yes, even human lives. The merchants will cry and say.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Yi yi lɔri noli, yin di zaɣiriya yi ninani kaman bilikɔɣinim ni niŋdi shɛm la, dama bɛ zaɣirila bɛ ninani ni niriba nya ba m-baŋ ni bɛ lɔri noli. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛn pun nya bɛ laara.
en: When you go without eating, don't try to look gloomy as those show-offs do when they go without eating. I can assure you that they already have their reward.

dag: Ka o daa kari doli Abinɛr, o ni daa kariti dol o maa, o daa kul sula o gbini ka bi ŋmaligi kpa o nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo.
en: and he ran straight after Abner, without looking to the right or to the left.

dag: Dama o luhi niriba pam n-ti ba dansi. Ka o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb ka tariga.
en: She has been the ruin of many men and caused the death of too many to count.

dag: Ŋum mali Yawɛ yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika. Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ka ti be ka puhiri ya maa.
en: Welcome to the one who comes in the name of the Lord . The priests answer, We welcome you to the Lord s house!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti zaŋ bindirigu na ti zali nachin kpɛm maa ni o di, ka o yɛli, Di yi pa ni n yɛlila daliri din tahi ma na, n ku di bindirigu maa. Ka Leeban yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: After that, they brought in food. But the servant said, Before I eat, I must tell you why I have come. Go ahead and tell us, Laban answered.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan boli Samuɛl yaha m-pahi buta, ka o lan yiɣisi chaŋ Ɛli sani ti yɛl o, A ni boli ma la, n-nyɛ ma. Di saha ka Ɛli daa baŋ ni Yawɛ m-booni bia maa.
en: The Lord called Samuel a third time; he got up, went to Eli, and said, You called me, and here I am. Then Eli realized that it was the Lord who was calling the boy.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani chaŋ Ɛlim, ka kɔbilisi pinaayi mini abie tihi pisopɔin daa be nimaani, ka bɛ daa dɔni nimaani m-miri kom maa.
en: Next they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees; there they camped by the water.

dag: Chɛ ka n wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm, dama o ni tɔɣisi suhudoo yɛtɔɣa n-ti o niriba bɛn ʒe o yim din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku ŋmaligi labi jɛrilim biɛhigu ni yaha.
en: I am listening to what the Lord God is saying; he promises peace to us, his own people, if we do not go back to our foolish ways.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti zooi m-mali yaa ni baŋsim pam; ka Naawuni daalibarika be o ni.
en: The child grew up and became strong. He was filled with wisdom, and Gods favor was on him.

dag: Kukoli maa ni daa tɔɣisi naai ka bɛ nya ka Yisa kɔŋko n-kpalim. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yɛlli maa shini ka bi yɛli so bɛ ni daa nya shɛli maa yɛla di saha maa.
en: After the voice had spoken, Peter, John, and James saw only Jesus. For some time they kept quiet and did not say anything about what they had seen.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima sara maligu bimbini la kpɛhi Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni nti zaŋ li zali pateesa la tooni.
en: Then Moses put the golden altar in the Meeting Tent, in front of the curtain.

dag: Hal n ni filim mmaŋa n-gari ŋ-ŋɔ gba, ka lihi ʒiɛm mmaŋa, amaa dabipaɣiba shɛb yɛla a ni yɛli ŋɔ bɛn ni ti ma jilima.
en: I may humiliate myself even more, and I may be humbled in my own eyes, but I will be honored by the female servants you are talking about.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa deei gbaŋ maa tuumba maa nuu ni n-karim, ka yiɣisi chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nti teei gbaŋ maa sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni.
en: Hezekiah took the letters from the messengers and read them. Then he went to the temple and spread them out before the LORD.

dag: Di saha maa ka Zakaria zilinjila daa dii lɔrigi, ka o nya noli gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: At that moment, Zechariah was able to speak again, and he began praising God.

dag: Rubin ni daa ti lab bɔɣili maa gbinna nti bi nya Yisifu di ni, o daa darigimi toog o binyɛra.
en: When Reuben returned to the cistern and found that Joseph wasnt in it, he tore his clothes.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya li ti ma na.
en: Jesus said, Bring the bread and the fish to me.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pako faralan ŋɔ tɔhiya gari bɛ zaa.
en: And he said, I tell you that this poor woman has put in more than all the others.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa wum lala maa ka o zo n-chaŋ Midian tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Nimaani ka o daa be hal nti dɔɣi bidibis ayi.
en: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.

dag: Bɛ daa jɛm Chɛdolaoma la yuun pinaayi, amaa yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuun pinaata la ni ka bɛ daa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku lan jɛm o.
en: These kings had served Kedorlaomer for twelve years. But in the th year, they all rebelled against him.

dag: Kpahimmiya Izraɛlnim ni niŋdi shɛm: Bɛn diri sara maligu bindira la nyɛla bɛn mini Naawuni mali dolintabitali sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu tuma ni.
en: Look at the people of Israel. Dont those who eat the sacrifices share from the altar?.

dag: Di kari mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ saria, dama so kani n-nyɛ ŋun ka taali a sani.
en: Please dont bring your servant to judgment, because no living thing is righteous before you.

dag: Ka o daa lan kpuɣi bɔrɔbɔro n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li n-zaŋ ti ba ka yɛli, N niŋgbuŋ m-bala; n niŋgbun shɛli n ni zaŋ pa talima yi zuɣu. Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ n-teemi n yɛla.
en: Then he took some bread and thanked God for it. He broke off some pieces, gave them to the apostles and said, This bread is my body that I am giving for you. Eat this to remember me.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka wuntaŋ mini maligu ni sakuɣa kanna ti kuri yi ni biri binshɛlikam, amaa ka yi na kul bi bɔri ni yi ŋmaligi lab n sanna. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I struck you—everything you do with your hands— with blight and mildew and hail; but you didnt return to me.

dag: Ka bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni.
en: The anointed priest will take some of the bulls blood into the meeting tent.

dag: Di kul simdi ni ti chaŋla tiŋgban nɛli ni daba ata chandi nti mali sara maa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa kaman o ni zali ti shɛm maa.
en: No indeed! The Lord has ordered us to walk three days into the desert before offering sacrifices to him, and that's what we have to do.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim mini wɔɣira zaa nti pahi Naa Dauda bidibisi bɛn daa kpalim la zaa daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni doli Naa Sulemaana.
en: Every official and every soldier, as well as all of David's other sons, were loyal to him.

dag: Di simdi ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa pahi Izraɛl naa zuɣu ka bɛ mali sara maa.
en: Everyone in the country will give to this offering for the ruler of Israel.

dag: Bɛn daa lo o nia biɛɣu maa n-daa nyɛ Zabad Shimiat ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn nir la bia mini Shimrit ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔab nir la bia Jɛhɔzabad.
en: Those who plotted against him were the Ammonite Zabad, Shimeaths son, and the Moabite Jehozabad, Shimriths son.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Mariama sani m-maar o suhu la ni daa nya ka o yiɣisi yomyom yiri maa ka bɛ gba yiɣisi dol o, dama bɛ daa tɛhiya ni o chanila gballi maa gbini ni o ti kum.
en: When the Jews who were comforting Mary in the house saw her get up quickly and leave, they followed her. They assumed she was going to mourn at the tomb.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu nti be nimaani.
en: Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

dag: O daa lan dɔɣi bidibis ayopɔin mini bipuɣins ata.
en: He also had seven sons and three daughters.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa yi Kadɛshi m-mali ti paai Hɔr Zoli gbini.
en: They marched from Kadesh. The entire Israelite community came to Mount Hor.

dag: Laakumnim maa ni daa nyu kom maa naai, ka nachin kpɛm maa zaŋ nyee ni baŋa din nyɛ salima ka di tibisim nyɛ binzahindigu pirigili mini bans ayi din nyɛ salima ka di tibisim nyɛ binzahindigu bupia ti o ni o pir o nuhi ni.
en: As soon as the camels had finished drinking, the man took out a gold ring, weighing a half shekel, and two gold bracelets for her arms, weighing ten shekels.

dag: Uri bia Bɛzalɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Hur yaaŋa, ka nyɛ Juda zuliya ni nir la n-daa mali binshɛɣukam zaa Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o mali maa.
en: Bezalel, the son of Uri and grandson of Hur from the tribe of Judah, made everything that the Lord had commanded.

dag: Niriba ni yɛli a yiko tuma din mali dabiɛm ŋɔ yɛla, ka n gba yɛli a ni galisi shɛm yɛla.
en: People will tell about the amazing things you do, and I will tell everyone how great you are.

dag: Bɛ daa kul karitimi doli ti hal ka ti ti kɔŋ ti soya dolibu. Ti bahigu saha miriya; bɛ pun kali ti dabisa. Ti bahigu saha paaya.
en: The enemy was watching for us; we could not even walk in the streets. Our days were over; the end had come.

dag: N daa yɛlimi, N ni gbaai mmaŋ zaŋ chaŋ n ni niŋdi shɛm polo din ni chɛ ka n zilinli ku tum alahichi. N ni gbib n noli saha shɛlikam ninvuɣ biɛri yi ti be n sani.
en: I told myself, I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.

dag: Yuun pisopɔin maa saha yi ti paai, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka Taai tiŋgbɔŋ maa lan lab di tuun kura ni yaha n-lan zaŋ dimaŋ kɔhi dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa zuɣu kaman pagɔrili la.
en: After years, the Lord will review Tyres case, and he will give her a decision. Tyre will again have trade. She will be like a prostitute for all the nations on earth.

dag: Zuɣusaa, wumma, tiŋgbani, wumma! Yawɛ yɛliya: N ni wumsi bi shɛb zaɣisi ma.
en: Heaven and earth, listen! This is what the Lord says: I raised my children and helped them grow up, but they have turned against me.

dag: Daba ayɔbu ka yi ni zaŋ tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahiri daba ayopɔin nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili titali, ka nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasi dali. Di bi simdi ni yi tum tuma dindali, di nyɛla Yawɛ Vuhim Dabisili yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: You have six days in which to do your work, but remember that the seventh day, the Sabbath, is a day of rest. On that day do not work, but gather for worship. The Sabbath belongs to the Lord , no matter where you live.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔsia daa bo o dahalali piɛbihi pola mini bubihi pola, ka bɛ zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi tuhi pihita ni naɣilahi tusaata n-zaŋ ba ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be nimaani ni bɛ mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara.
en: Josiah donated , sheep and goats, and , bulls from his own flocks and herds for the people to offer as sacrifices.

dag: Wummiya piɛguliba kuhigu, wummiya bɛn guli biŋkɔbbaligu kuhigu, dama Yawɛ saɣindi bɛ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Hear the cry of the shepherds and the sobbing of the masters of the flock, because the LORD is ravaging their pasture.

dag: O yi po pɔri yoli zaŋ chaŋ binshɛli polo; di simdi ka o niŋ di zaa, ka niŋ di pirigibu ʒiibunu zuɣu yim pahi ti ŋun su li, o yi ti baŋ ni o tum taali.
en: or whatever you made a false promise about. You must pay the full price and then add one-fifth of that amount as a fine and give it all to the true owner.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa daa daŋ tooni na la daa nyɛla tayiɣisi ni ŋmɛnditoya, ka piɛri maa daa bi wum ti ba.
en: All others who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.

dag: Ka tin tital la daa bɔɣi ʒii buta, ka zuliya kam tinsi daa lu n-dahim zaa. Ka Naawuni daa teei Babilɔn din nyɛ tin tital la yɛla, ka zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili wain pipia la n-ti Babilɔnnima ni bɛ nyu di zaa.
en: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.

dag: Ka nyɔhi daa yi o nyee ni na; ka buɣim niɛm din diri yi o nol ni na; ka sala buɣim niɛm yi o sanna.
en: Smoke came from his nose. Burning flames came from his mouth. Red-hot coals fell from him.

dag: bɔɣili maa lan ni yo samli. Di simdi ka o yo biŋkɔbigu maa lana, ka zaŋ biŋkɔb kpiŋ maa.
en: You must pay for the dead animal, and it becomes yours.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi yihiri waazu yɛri ni Masia daa neei kum ni, di chaŋ wula ka yi ni shɛb yɛri ni kpiimba kum ni neebu kani?.
en: Now, since our message is that Christ has been raised from death, how can some of you say that the dead will not be raised to life?.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa bɔh o, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ti maa? Di pa shɛli ka yaŋɔnim ni so di zaŋ a paɣ maa dɔni. A naan chɛ ka di taali ʒin ti zuɣu.
en: Abimelech said, You have done a bad thing to us. One of our men might have had sex with your wife. Then he would be guilty of a great sin.

dag: Ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa daa yɛl o, Zaŋmi bia ŋɔ kuli ti wubis o ti ma ka n yo a. Di saha ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ bia maa kuli ti wubis o.
en: The princess told the woman, Take this baby and nurse him for me, and I will pay you. So she took the baby and nursed him.

dag: Chɛ ka wuntizɔriba mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani, ka sɔɣ o sani. Bɛnkam zaa bebu be tibi bɛ suhuri ni tibigim o.
en: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.

dag: ka gbilisiri tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wumdi yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka zaŋ a suhu niŋ baŋsim yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: Listen to wisdom, and do your best to understand.

dag: Naa Hanun mini Ammɔnnim maa ni daa baŋ ni bɛ leei Dauda dimnim maa, ka bɛ daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pihitanaanahi n-chaŋ Siria tinsi din nyɛ Mɛsopoteemia mini Arammaaka ni Zɔba ni bɛ ti da chɛchɛbunsi mini di yuri na.
en: The Ammonites realized they had made David furious. So they paid tons of silver to hire chariot troops from Mesopotamia and from the Syrian kingdoms of Maacah and Zobah.

dag: Ka a zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa ti o, n ni ti be a min o zaa noya ni, ka wuhi ya yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Aaron will speak to the people for you, and you will be like me, telling Aaron what to say. I will be with both of you as you speak, and I will tell each of you what to do.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya n zaligunima, ka miriya ka yi ti doli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pun daŋ be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kaya din chihiri la, ka miriya ka yi ti zaŋ li saɣim yimaŋa: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You must keep my requirement of not doing any of the detestable practices that were done before you arrived so that you dont make yourselves unclean by them; I am the LORD your God.

dag: Di nyɛla yaɣ kɔŋkɔba, amaa ka nyɛ niŋgbun yini.
en: As it is, there are many parts but one body.

dag: ka yi ti bo bɛ bipuɣinsi ti yi bidibisi, ka bɛ bipuɣinsi maa ni ti jɛmdi bɛ buɣa maa, ka yi bidibisi maa gba ti jɛm bɛ buɣa maa.
en: Then you might go and choose their daughters as wives for your sons. And their daughters who prostitute themselves with their gods might lead your sons to prostitute themselves with their gods.

dag: Ti ni daa ti yiɣisi nimaani ti daa dolila so gɔŋ ti paai Rijium n-daa yi biɛɣu ka nudirigu polo pɔhim din daa sɔŋ ti pam yiɣisi ʒiɛra. Di daba ayi dali ka ti daa paai Putioli.
en: From there we sailed to Rhegium. The next day a south wind began to blow, and two days later we arrived in Puteoli.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl.
en: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel;.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔhi bɛ takɔbiri ka guri bɛ tɔbiri ni bɛ nyaŋ faranim mini nandaamba, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi.
en: The wicked draw their swords to kill the poor and the helpless. They aim their arrows to murder all who live right.

dag: A nini yi nya shɛli, nyin di bo yomyom zaŋ li tahi kootu ni, dama a kpee yi ti dih a vi, di nyaaŋa wula ka a yɛn niŋ?.
en: Dont be too quick to tell a judge about something you saw. You will be embarrassed if someone else proves you wrong.

dag: nyini n-daa chɛ ka a dabili ti yab Naa Dauda yaag o noli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni yɛli: Bɔzuɣu ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim jɛri suli tahira, ka zuliya kam tɔri jin yoya?.
en: By means of the Holy Spirit you spoke through our ancestor David, your servant, when he said, Why were the Gentiles furious; why did people make their useless plots?.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu tuuli alikauli la daa naan ku tooi zani, ka pa ni ʒim n-yi.
en: That is why blood was needed to begin the first agreement between God and his people.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa chɛ ka o mini Sool labi, ka Sool ti jɛm Yawɛ.
en: So Samuel went back with Saul, and Saul worshipped the LORD.

dag: Ka di wula daa teei hal ti paai teeku ni, ka di nyaɣa teei hal ni Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni.
en: It sent its branches all the way to the sea; its shoots went all the way to the Euphrates River.

dag: Nyini n-daa ti ma nyɛvili mini yurilim maŋli ka nyɛ ŋun guli n nyɛvili.
en: You, the source of my life, showered me with kindness and watched over me.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ʒiʒiinitab maani ti la ansarisi, ka ti dimnim laɣindi lara.
en: You made us the target of everyones hatred. Our enemies make fun of us.

dag: Buŋ maa ni daa nya Yawɛ malaika maa, ka o teei dɔni Balaam jɔɣu ni, ka Balaam suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o zaŋ o jaaŋgbe bil fiɛbi buŋ maa.
en: The donkey saw the LORDs messenger and lay down underneath Balaam. Balaam became angry and beat the donkey with the rod.

dag: Dabisili din pah anii dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: On the eighth day you will have a holiday. You will not do any job-related work.

dag: Ninsal yɛlli kam ʒila o zuɣu, amaa yɛlli kam malila di soli ni di saha.
en: Life is hard, but there is a time and a place for everything.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka niriba maa zaa daa wurim, ka sokam kul o yiŋa. Ka Dauda daa kul o yiŋa ni o ti suhi alibarika niŋ o yiŋnim ni.
en: After the celebration, all the people left and went home. David also went home to bless his family.

dag: O ni daa chɛ ka o nyu n-naai nyaaŋa, ka o daa lan yɛl o, N ni ŋɔŋ kom ti a laakumnim ŋɔ ka bɛ gba nyu hal ti tiɣi.
en: As soon as she finished giving him something to drink, Rebekah said, I will also pour some water for your camels.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ wain maa ti bɛ ba ka o nyu dindali maa yuŋ, ka bipuɣin kpɛm maa daa kpe ka o min o ba ti dɔni, ka o ba bi mi o ni dɔni o sani saha shɛli ni o ni yiɣisi saha shɛli.
en: That night the two girls went to their father and got him drunk with wine. Then the older daughter went and had sexual relations with him. He did not even know when she came to bed or when she got up.

dag: Yi yi doli n zaligu, yi nyɛla n zɔnima.
en: You are my friends if you do what I command you.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa nya ka Musa birigi kanna ni o ti nya li maa, ka Naawuni daa bol o tutuɣu maa ni, Musa! Musa! Ka o garigi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: When the LORD saw that he was coming to look, God called to him out of the bush, Moses, Moses! Moses said, Im here.

dag: M bi daai Naawuni daalibarika baɣili, dama taali ni yibu Naawuni sani yi yila Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu ni na, dindina Masia kum la ka daliri.
en: I refuse to reject the grace of God. But if a person is put right with God through the Law, it means that Christ died for nothing!.

dag: Ka Ilaija garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun be, ka nyɛ n ni ʒe so tooni ŋɔ zuɣu, n shiri ni zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi Ɛhab zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Elijah answered, I serve the Lord All-Powerful. As surely as he lives, I promise that I will stand before the king today.

dag: ka Yɛhudianim maa daa zaŋ li leei bɛmaŋmaŋ mini bɛ zuliya ni ŋunkam yu ni o zaŋ omaŋ leei Yɛhudia nira kali. Ka di saha daa yi ti paai yuuni kam puuni, bɛ puhirila di chuɣu maa kaman di ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Now every year the Jews set aside these two days for having parties and celebrating, just as they were told to do.

dag: Ka ti Duuma Yisa daa ti baŋ lala ka yi Judia labiri Galili.
en: Jesus left Judea and started for Galilee again.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka Naa Agiripa mini Bɛɛnis ni Gomna Fɛstus ni bɛn zaa daa ʒi bɛ sani yiɣisi yi.
en: Then King Agrippa, Governor Festus, Bernice, and everyone who was with them got up.

dag: Amaa ka o daa lee kpalim dɔɣibu maa ni. O ni daa ti yɛn bahi saha shɛli ka o daa boli bia maa yuli Bɛnɔni, amaa ka o ba mi daa bol o yuli Bɛnjamin.
en: Rachel was at the point of death, and right before dying, she said, I'll name him Benoni. But Jacob called him Benjamin.

dag: daa chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani ti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi. Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o ti o.
en: He went into the presence of Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus. Pilate gave orders for the body to be given to Joseph.

dag: Ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir maa mini Bilidad ŋun daa nyɛ Shua nir la ni Zɔfar ŋun daa nyɛ Naama nir la daa chaŋ ti niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa. Ka Yawɛ daa deei Ayuba suhigu.
en: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar did what the Lord had told them to do, and the Lord answered Job's prayer.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan tim wɔribar so ŋun pah ayi, ka o tuhi ba soli nti yɛli, Naa ni n ti bɔh a nya Alaafee? Ka Jɛhu bɔh o, Alaafee yɛla lee nya a ya? Garim doli n nyaaŋa.
en: The king sent a second driver. He came to them and said, The king asks, Do you come in peace? Jehu said, What do you care about peace? Come around and follow me.

dag: O yi di deeg o shia, ka deeg o vuhim.
en: If he were to decide to do it— to gather his spirit and breath back to himself.

dag: Ka Rubin daa ti chaŋ mɔɣu ni alikama chɛbu saha ti bo ŋmaankpihiga na ti ti o ma Liya. Ka Reechɛl daa yɛli Liya, N suhir a, niŋm a bia ŋmaankpihiga maa shɛli ti ma.
en: During the wheat harvest, Reuben found some erotic herbs in the field and brought them to his mother Leah. Rachel said to Leah, Give me your sons erotic herbs.

dag: Dunianim mini zuɣusaa binnamda, maliya suhupiɛlli; teeku mini binnɛma bɛn be di ni, yomiya vuri;.
en: Be glad, earth and sky! Roar, sea, and every creature in you;.

dag: Lihim pakoya bɛn nyɛ pako maŋa la.
en: Take care of widows who are truly needy.

dag: A mini Damaskusnim daa niŋdi daabiligu a nɛma pam min a daazichi ni daa galisi la zuɣu, dina n-nyɛ: Hɛlibɔn wain mini gumdi.
en: Damascus was a good customer. They traded with you for the many wonderful things you had. They traded wine from Helbon and white wool for those things.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di pala doo ŋɔ daalahichi bee o laamba daalahichi zuɣu, amaa di niŋmi ni Naawuni tumtumsa yi palo o ni.
en: No, it wasn't! Jesus answered. But because of his blindness, you will see God work a miracle for him.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka bɛ be ni alaafee, amaa ka o lee pa nina lihiri bɛ tuma.
en: They make themselves secure; they are at ease. His eyes are on their ways.

dag: Ka wulimpuhili polo tiŋgbani tariga yɛn kpuɣila Teeku Kpiŋ shee zaŋ hal ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli. Ka nuzaa polo tiŋgbani tariga mi piligi Yalim Teeku maa ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli shee.
en: The eastern border was the Dead Sea, all the way up to the inlet where the Jordan empties into it. The northern border began there.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi tihi wali, ka yi puri ni bindira niŋ pam din ni chɛ ka kum ku lan lu yi zuɣu ka yi di vi zuliya shɛb sani.
en: I will make abundant the orchards fruit and the fields produce so that you will never again endure the shame of famine among the nations.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa ku Zɛdɛkia bidibisi mini Juda kpambaliba zaa o ninni Ribila maa.
en: Zedekiah's sons and the officials of Judah were killed while he watched.

dag: ka Zakaria daa nyɛ Iddo daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Mɛshulam so mi daa nyɛ Ginnɛtɔn daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: The leader of Iddos family was Zechariah. The leader of Ginnethons family was Meshullam.

dag: Kush n-daa nyɛ Nimrɔd ba. O daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biiŋa dunia ni.
en: Ethiopia was also the father of Nimrod, the world's first mighty warrior.

dag: Dama ŋun yɛli, Miri ka a niŋ zina la n-nyɛ ŋun lan yɛli, Miri ka a ku ninsal la. Ka a yi bi niŋ zina, amaa ka lee ku ninsala, dindina a leei Naawuni zaligusaɣinda m-bala.
en: The one who said, Dont commit adultery , also said, Dont commit murder . So if you dont commit adultery but do commit murder, you are a lawbreaker.

dag: Ka a zaŋ li ti sɔŋ Yawɛ min o niriba chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni Alikauli Adaka la tooni, n ni kani a sanna luɣ shɛl la.
en: Put these walking sticks in the Meeting Tent in front of the Box of the Agreement. This is the place where I meet with you.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chamiya m biɛhigu shee din be Shilo ka nyɛ luɣ shɛli n ni daa zaŋ leei n jɛmbu shee la nti nya n ni daa niŋ li shɛm n niriba Izraɛlnim tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: Go to Shiloh, the first place where I chose to be worshiped, and see what I did to it because of the sins of my people Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pirig o o zaɣim, ka fa o bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku o. Bɛ daa kar o saria, ka o leei paɣiba ni maani so ansarisi.
en: They stripped her naked, took her sons and daughters, and killed her with the sword. And she became notorious among women for the punishments they enacted against her.

dag: Bɛ ni ti daag a niŋ gballi ni, ka a kpi gadama niŋbu kum teeku bulli maa ni.
en: They will bring you down to the grave. You will be like a sailor who died at sea.

dag: zaŋ tabili tiŋkpan shɛŋa zaa din gil li zaŋ hal ti paai Baalatibeer . Simiɔn zuliya niriba ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini m-bala.
en: Simeon's land also included all the other towns and villages as far south as Baalath-Beer, which is also called Ramah of the South.

dag: Di yɛn nyɛla shihirili ni shɛhira Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ sani Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ yi ti fabili niŋ Yawɛ niriba bɛn nahindi ba la, o ni tim ŋun ni fa ba bahi bɛ sani ka o ti fa ba bahi.
en: These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies.

dag: Biɣivai daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaayi ni pihiyɔbunaayopɔin.
en: of Bigvai .

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ zim sara maligu nti tooi li pal o nuu n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim asiba la zuɣu.
en: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.

dag: Di zɔrimi duri zoya, ka zɔri siɣiri vinvama ni n-chani ti dooni a ni zali ni di dɔni luɣ shɛli.
en: They flowed over the mountains and into the valleys, to the place you had made for them.

dag: Ka bɛn daa di li maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman dɔb tusaanu laasabu m-pahi paɣiba ni bihi.
en: The number of men who ate was about five thousand, not counting the women and children.

dag: Di saha maa tinzun tɔbbihi bɛn zaa kana ti liri tin shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni sara maligu bimbin la mini bɛ bidibbina ni bɛ tɔbutuhiri nɛma ni bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa ni ti yiɣi ka firi kaman zahindi la bee nir ni nya binshɛli ʒii yuŋ shɛm la.
en: then all the armies of the nations attacking the city of God's altar, all their weapons and equipment—everything—will vanish like a dream, like something imagined in the night.

dag: Dinzuɣu di pala ninsal yubu bee o ni niŋ shɛm zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni nambɔzɔbo zuɣu.
en: Everything then depends on God's mercy and not on what people want or do.

dag: Naawuni ni daa zali Jɔshua shɛm zuɣu daa chɛ ka o ŋmaai Juda zuliya la tiŋgbani yaɣ shɛli polo bɛ ni booni Hiburɔn la ti Jɛfune bia Kalɛb. Kiriatariba, di gbinni nyɛla Hiburɔn.
en: As the Lord commanded Joshua, part of the territory of Judah was given to Caleb son of Jephunneh, from the tribe of Judah. He received Hebron, the city belonging to Arba, father of Anak.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ sana zaɣ biɛɣu bee n-niŋ o fitiina, dama yi gba daa nyɛla saamba be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Dont mistreat or oppress an immigrant, because you were once immigrants in the land of Egypt.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali, Firawuna ni chɛ ka bɛ kana ti yih a nti lan zaŋ a labis a tuma ni; ka a ni lan zaŋdi Firawuna pipia maa ni binnyura maa ti tir o kaman a ni daa pun nyɛ o wain tɔɣira shɛm la.
en: In three days the king will release you, pardon you, and restore you to your position. You will give him his cup as you did before when you were his wine steward.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Batishiiba daa chaŋ naa sani o dudoonigu ni. Di saha maa naa daa kurigiya pam, ka Abishag ŋun daa nyɛ Shunɛm paɣ la m-be o sani gbib o.
en: So Bathsheba went to the king in his bedroom. The king was very old, and Abishag from Shunem was serving the king.

dag: Ka Pita mini nyaandol ŋun maa daa yina n-zaŋ kpa siliga maa polo.
en: Then Peter and the other disciple went to the tomb.

dag: N niriba maa kul kpɛrila yɔɣu ka chɛri ma, dinzuɣu ka n zali ba ni bɛ ʒi ʒi tibisa maa, ka so ku tooi yihi li.
en: They insist on turning away from me. They will cry out because of the yoke that is on them, but no one will lift it from them.

dag: Ka Ilaija garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun be, ka nyɛ n ni ʒe so tooni ŋɔ zuɣu, n shiri ni zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi Ɛhab zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Elijah answered, By the living Lord Almighty, whom I serve, I promise that I will present myself to the king today.

dag: Ka o daa ti o niriba subu yiko mini jilima ni kpiɔŋ ni di chɛ ka zuliya kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim tumdi tuma tir o. O yiko kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka o nam mi ku mali tariga.
en: Rule, glory, and kingship were given to him; all peoples, nations, and languages will serve him. His rule is an everlasting one— it will never pass away!— his kingship is indestructible.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla m mini n niriba kɔhi ni bɛ ku ti kpihim ti birili. Di yi di nyɛla bɛ zaŋla ti dɔbba mini paɣiba kɔhi ni ti leei daba, n naan shini ka ku zaŋ di yɛla muɣis a, dama nir ku tooi zaŋ ti ni yɛn di wahala shɛli buɣisi nyin naa ni yɛn kɔŋ shɛli.
en: I ask this because my people and I have been sold to be destroyed—to be killed and wiped out completely. If we had just been sold as slaves, I would have kept quiet, because that would not be enough of a problem to bother the king.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum ni neebu dali, ŋun paɣa n-lee ni ti nyɛ o? Dama bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o mi.
en: But all seven brothers had married her. So at the time when people rise from death, whose wife will she be.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: yi pirigibu buta puuni yim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim bɛn yɛn be tuma ni Vuhim Dabisili dali yɛn nyɛla dunɔguliba.
en: Now, this is what you must do: One-third of you priests and Levites who go on duty on the Sabbath will guard the doors.

dag: A ʒiɛyimtali kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni. Nyini n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka di mi kul ni beni sahakam.
en: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.

dag: ka zaŋ noonsi gba zaɣ lɔri ayopɔin mini zaɣ nyama ayopɔin niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni n-gbib ba ka bɛ birili ku kpihim dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: and from the birds in the sky as well, take seven pairs, male and female, so that their offspring will survive throughout the earth.

dag: Yawɛ, dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, n ni paɣ a zuliya kam sani; ka yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: And so I praise you among the nations; I sing praises to you.

dag: ni o bɔrila a daanzinfa min a salima ni a paɣ viɛla ni a bihi.
en: Ahab, give me your silver and gold, your wives, and your strongest sons.

dag: ka yi ti yɛn bahi ka ŋuhira, ka yi niŋgbuna zaa sheei;.
en: At the end of your life, you will be sad that you ruined your health and lost everything you had.

dag: Ka ti daa ti chani Naawuni suhibu shee n-tuhi bipuɣin so ŋun daa nyɛ dabili ka lan nyɛ kpilikparisilana soli. Bɛn daa su o daa diri kpilikparisi maa baɣitali nyɔri pam.
en: One day we were going to the place for prayer, and a servant girl met us. She had a spirit in her that gave her the power to tell what would happen in the future. By doing this she earned a lot of money for the men who owned her.

dag: Ka o daa mali sara zoli zuɣu n-laɣim o dɔɣiriba ni bɛ kana ka bɛ min o ti laɣim di bindirigu, ka bɛ daa kana ka bɛ min o ti laɣim di bindirigu maa ka kpalim be zoli maa zuɣu yuŋ hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: Then Jacob killed an animal and offered it as a sacrifice on the mountain. And he invited his men to come and share a meal. After they finished eating, they spent the night on the mountain.

dag: Amaa m piila Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ tiri n yuli jilima nimaani ka pii Dauda ni o su n niriba Izraɛlnima. .
en: But now I have chosen Jerusalem as a place for my name, and David as prince over my people Israel.

dag: Asiria naa maa daa timla Rabishake, ka o yi Lakishi n-zaŋ tɔbbihi pam pa omaŋ zuɣu ka Naa Hɛzɛkia sanna Jɛrusalɛm. O daa zanila kɔso titali din be zuɣusaa polo biaŋ solɔɣu din labiri kpaluhi ʒiishee polo la.
en: Then he ordered his chief official to go from Lachish to Jerusalem with a large military force to demand that King Hezekiah surrender. The official occupied the road where the cloth makers work, by the ditch that brings water from the upper pool.

dag: Ka Keen yɛli Yawɛ, N tibidarigibo maa galisiya gari ma.
en: And Cain said to the Lord , This punishment is too hard for me to bear.

dag: N niriba, niŋmiy o o ni daa niŋ ya shɛm labisi, ka yɔny o o tuma samli siɣimsiɣim buyi! Niŋmiy o binnyurigu ka di to n-gari o ni daa niŋ shɛm n-tin ya la!.
en: Treat her as she has treated others. Make her pay double for what she has done. Make her drink twice as much of what she mixed for others.

dag: n yi di di daatam ka bi yo di zuɣu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛn su li kpi.
en: if I have eaten the food that grew there but let the farmers that grew it starve—.

dag: Bɛna n-daa sɔŋ Dauda tuhi ŋmɛnditoya la, dama bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi ka lan nyɛ sapashin kpamba.
en: They helped David fight against bad men who were going around the country and stealing things from people. All these men of Manasseh were brave soldiers. They became leaders in Davids army.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Taɣimiya yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma, ka n chɛ ka yi be kpe.
en: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, says: Improve your conduct and your actions, and I will dwell with you in this place.

dag: Wuntizɔriba je ʒiri, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn tuma nyɛla vidibo mini filiŋ nyabu.
en: Honest people hate lies, but the words of wicked people are shameful and disgraceful.

dag: Zuɣusaa, chɛ ka wuntia luna kaman saa la. Chɛ ka tiŋgbani bɔɣi, ka tiliginsim yina; ka chɛ ka wuntia gba yina; Man Yawɛ n-nam li.
en: May the clouds in the skies above pour goodness on the earth like rain. May the earth open up to let salvation grow. And may goodness grow with that salvation, which I, the Lord , created.

dag: Ka ti daa yi Taai m-be kom maa ni m-mali ti paai Tolɛmais n-daa chaŋ ti puhi ti mabihi bɛn be nimaani, ka gbe bɛ sani dahin yini.
en: Continuing our voyage, we sailed from Tyre and arrived in Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and sisters there and spent a day with them.

dag: Giliad nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim tiŋa, ka ninvuɣ kubo kul pali nimaani.
en: Gilead is a city full of evil people and murderers.

dag: ti yɛl o, Ti dana, ti teeya ni ʒirilan la ni daa be o nyɛvil ni la, o daa yɛliya ni o ni ti neei kum ni daba ata dali.
en: They said, Sir, we remember that while that liar was still alive he said, I will rise from death in three days.

dag: Ti Duuma, a kurimbuni ha yurilim maŋli din nyɛ a ni daa po a ʒiɛyimtali puuni n-yɛli Dauda shɛli yɛla la lee be ya?.
en: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?.

dag: Ka Harumaf bia Jɛdaya daa mali me o yiŋ tooni m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Hashabinɛya bia Hatush mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Next to them Jedaiah, Harumaphs son, made repairs opposite his house, and Hattush, Hashabneiahs son, made repairs next to him.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla ti suhuri piɛli ti wahala dibu puuni, dama ti mi ni wahala dibu tahirila ania niŋbu na.
en: We also boast of our troubles, because we know that trouble produces endurance.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, luɣim a tiba wum ti suhigu ŋɔ, ka ŋmalig a nini n-lihi ti nya ti ni be muɣisigu shɛl ni, ka nya a yuli ni tab tin shɛl la ni diri wahala shɛm. A ni zɔri nambɔɣu la zuɣu ka ti suhir a, ka pa ni ti wuntitali zuɣu.
en: Please show mercy to your chosen city, not because we deserve it, but because of your great kindness.

dag: Amaa Musa daa yi chaŋ Yawɛ sani ni o min o ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, o piligirila sariga maa o ninni, naɣila o ti yina. Ka o daa yi yina ti yɛli Izraɛlnim Naawuni ni yɛl o shɛm.
en: Whenever Moses went into the LORDs presence to speak with him, Moses would take the veil off until he came out again. When Moses came out and told the Israelites what he had been commanded.

dag: Di dunoya zaa mini di takɔriti zaa firimnim daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣiri. Takɔriti maa daa tuhila taba, ka tam tab ʒii buta zuɣu.
en: The doorways and the windows had rectangular frames, and the three rows of windows in each wall faced the opposite rows.

dag: Naa Amazia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the great things that Amaziah did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Bee miri ka a di ʒiri shɛhira jɛndi a kpee.
en: Do not accuse anyone falsely.

dag: Bin biɛri balibu kam ŋɔ zaa yirila ninsal suhu ni na, ka nyɛ din tar o daɣiri.
en: all these evil things come from inside you and make you unclean.

dag: Yi daa lari Izraɛlnima, hal yi ni daa kul bi gbahi ba tayiɣisi ni maa zaa yoli, yi daa yi tɔɣisiri bɛ yɛla yi viinila yi zuɣuri.
en: Moab, remember how you made fun of the people of Israel? You treated them as though they had been caught with a gang of robbers.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni dɔɣiri bidib shɛb mini bipuɣin shɛb kpe mini bɛ manim ni bɛ banim bɛn dɔɣi ba polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what the Lord says about the sons and daughters who are born in the land of Judah and about their mothers and fathers:.

dag: Biŋkɔb so ŋun mali takarifiɛma, ka o takarifiɛma maa wɔrigi, ka o gbuɣiri ŋubira, yin ŋubimiya lala biŋkɔbigu maa.
en: You can eat any animal that has divided hoofs, completely split, and that rechews food.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala n-chɛ ka bɛ zaa ʒini.
en: So the followers did this and everyone sat down.

dag: A ni yiɣisi zo Ziɔn nambɔɣu, dama saha paaya ni a niŋ li nirilim; di saha maa mi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: You will stand up— youll have compassion on Zion because it is time to have mercy on her— the time set for that has now come!.

dag: Ti ni daa be yi sani maa, ti daa bahi ya noli ni ŋun je ni o tum tuma bi simdi ni o di.
en: While we were with you, we used to tell you, Whoever refuses to work is not allowed to eat.

dag: Ka bindir shɛŋa din bili di toli yi puri ni, yin di ti kpuɣiya di daatam, ka yi ni bi wahi yi wain ti shɛŋa wula nyoya ni ka di wali wala, yin di pɔhiya li, di ni ti nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa vuhim yuuni.
en: This is to be a time of complete rest for your fields and vineyards, so don't harvest anything they produce.

dag: Bɛ nini nyabu yim ka ninsal nuchee daa ti puhi yina n-sabiri sabbu shɛli pari nayili maa dukpini zuɣu m-miri firila ni ʒe luɣ shɛli polo ne viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka naa maa daa nya nuchee maa ni sabiri sabbu maa.
en: Suddenly a human hand was seen writing on the plaster wall of the palace. The hand was just behind the lampstand, and the king could see it writing.

dag: Bɛ daa kul karitimi doli ti hal ka ti ti kɔŋ ti soya dolibu. Ti bahigu saha miriya; bɛ pun kali ti dabisa. Ti bahigu saha paaya.
en: Our steps were tracked; we could no longer walk in our streets. Our end had drawn near; our days were done—our end had definitely come.

dag: N daa sabi gbaŋ ti cheechi na; amaa ka Diɔtrifiiz ŋun bɔri ni o nyɛ bɛ toondan la bi lihi ma ni m mali yiko zaŋ chaŋ n ni yɛli shɛm maa polo.
en: I wrote something to the church, but Diotrephes, who likes to put himself first, doesnt welcome us.

dag: Jɔtam yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pinaayɔbu.
en: After he had ruled Judah years, he died at the age of .

dag: dama ti bi ʒi shɛli ka dunia ŋɔ ni na, ka di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni ti shiri ku tooi ʒi shɛli yi dunia ŋɔ ni gba.
en: We didnt bring anything into the world and so we cant take anything out of it.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, N cham ti liri Filistianim maa? A ni zaŋ ba niŋ n nuu ni? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Dauda, Cham ti liri ba, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: David asked the Lord , Shall I attack the Philistines? Will you give me the victory? Yes, attack! the Lord answered. I will give you the victory.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa karim yɛtɔɣ shɛlikam din daa be zaligu kundi la ni. O daa karim alibarika mini noli yɛlibu yɛla kaman di zaa ni daa sabi zaligu kundi maa ni shɛm.
en: Then Joshua read all the words from the law. He read the blessings and the curses. He read everything the way it was written in the Book of the Law .

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhu daa lee bi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ zaligu ni o suhu zaa. O daa bi chɛ Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la soli dolibu.
en: But Jehu did not completely obey the commands of the Lord God of Israel. Instead, he kept doing the sinful things that Jeroboam had caused the Israelites to do.

dag: N lɔri nia ni n chaŋ Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka n yi ti chaŋ nimaani, di nyaaŋa n ni gari ka yi sanna.
en: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you.

dag: ka dabiɛm lan gbaag o pahi zaŋ chaŋ Dauda polo. Dinzuɣu ka Dauda daa kul nyɛ Sool dima di saha maa zaŋ chana.
en: But knowing those things made Saul even more afraid of David, and he was David's enemy for the rest of his life.

dag: Yinim yɛnnim ŋɔ, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ. Yinim baŋdiba ŋɔ, gbilisimiya tibili.
en: You men think you are wise, but just listen to me!.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni booni kɔral bee kirisital la buɣisi li. Yɛm liɣiri gari yɛri liɣiri.
en: The value of wisdom is more Than coral or crystal or rubies.

dag: Ka Nɔba daa chaŋ ti ŋme n-deei Kɛnat mini di tiŋkpansi, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yuli Nɔba boli tinsi maa.
en: Nobah captured the town of Kenath with its villages and renamed it Nobah.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, A yɛl ti ni ti chɛ ka ti bebu doli zaligu shɛŋa a ni daa zaŋ ti a daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim la, amaa ka ti zaɣisi ni ti ku wum ti a.
en: We did not listen to you, O Lord our God, when you told us to live according to the laws which you gave us through your servants the prophets.

dag: M mabihi n yi ka yi sanna ti tɔɣisirila tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa, buchi bɔ ka di yɛn kun ya, ka pa ni n zaŋla yɛla kahigibu bee baŋsim yɛtɔɣa bee anabitali yɛtɔɣa bee wuhibu yɛla tɔɣisi ya.
en: Brothers and sisters, will it help you if I come to you speaking in different languages? No, it will help you only if I bring you a new truth or some knowledge, prophecy, or teaching.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla kuɣ pinaayi, ka a ti zaŋ chiriga chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yinoyino yuli pa kuɣili kam zuɣu. Niŋmi li kaman bɛ ni niŋdi dalinli shɛli bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu shɛm la din ni chɛ ka zuliya pinaayi maa yuya be di ni.
en: and engrave on each of them the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Anabinim bɛn be di puuni naala noli n-lo nia biɛri. Bɛ ŋmanila gbuɣima n-dariti tɔhiri bɛ ni gbahi binshɛŋa ka ŋumda. Bɛ di ninsalinim nyɛviya, ka fa azichi mini binviɛla, ka chɛ ka pakoya galisi.
en: The conspiracy of princes in her is like a roaring lion ripping up prey. Theyve piled up wealth and precious goods and made many widows in her.

dag: N zɔnim maani ma la ansarisi, ka n kuhi ni nintam niŋ Naawuni.
en: My friends scorn me; my eyes pour out tears to God.

dag: Chɛ ka Yawɛ ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa yɛli lala, bɛna n-nyɛ o ni tiligi shɛb muɣisigu ni.
en: Everyone the Lord has rescued from trouble should praise him.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Asha zuliya ni dɔbba, ka daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka lan nyɛ ninvuɣ gahinda. Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni kalinli daa nyɛla dɔbba tuhi pisinaayɔbu.
en: All these were Ashers family, heads of households, select mighty warriors, the heads of the princes. Those ready for battle listed in the records numbered .

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa laɣim o sani na maa pah o zuɣu n-laɣim zani Alikauli Adaka maa tooni n-kɔri piɛri mini naɣilahi pam bɛn ka kalinli m-mali sara.
en: while King Solomon and the entire Israelite assembly that had joined him before the chest sacrificed countless sheep and oxen.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun bɔri ni sokam zaa tiligi ka bɔhim baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: who wants all people to be saved and to come to a knowledge of the truth.

dag: Yuun pinaanahi nyaaŋa ka m mini Baanabas daa yɛn chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm, ka n daa zaŋ Taitus m-pahi ka ti chaŋ.
en: Fourteen years later I went back to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus along with me.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Neesim ni be yi sani yuui biɛla. Ka yi ni mali neesim maa zuɣu, kul chamiya; di yi pa lala zibisim ni ti paai ya. Ŋun chani zibisim ni bi mi o ni kpari shɛli polo.
en: Then Jesus said, The light will be with you for only a short time more. So walk while you have the light. Then the darkness will not catch you. People who walk in the darkness dont know where they are going.

dag: Ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li ti tuma zuɣulaannim bɛn lihiri ka bɛ tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma la, ka bɛ zaŋ li yo tumtumdiba bɛn tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tuma maa.
en: Tell Hilkiah to give it to the men supervising the repairs to the temple. They can use some of the money to pay.

dag: Bɛ di n-tiɣi nyaaŋa, bɛ ni ti be muɣisigu ni. Ka yɛlibiɛɣu kam zaa ni ti ka bɛ zuɣu na.
en: Even while he has plenty, he will be pressed down with trouble. His problems will come down on him!.

dag: Dama saha shɛli n ni daa zaŋ n niriba Izraɛlnim la na hal ni zuŋɔ, n na ʒi m-be yil ni, amaa n daa kul yirila suɣili ni n-lan kpɛri suɣili ni, ka yiri m biɛhigu shee.
en: I didn't live in a temple when I brought my people out of Egypt, and I don't live in one now. A tent has always been my home wherever I have gone with them.

dag: Nyin ŋun suhu yiɣisi ka a dar tɔh amaŋ ŋɔ, a tɛhiya ni bɛ ni chɛ dunia ti a bee n-vuɣi tampiŋ di biɛhigu shee a zuɣu?.
en: You are only hurting yourself with your anger. Will the earth be deserted because you are angry? Will God move mountains to satisfy you?.

dag: Chɛl barinyubo yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka di lan chɛ ka karimbaan yɛtɔɣa yi a nol ni na yaha. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ mi binshɛɣukam, ka mi daadam ni niŋdi shɛlikam.
en: Stop your loud boasting; silence your proud words. For the Lord is a God who knows, and he judges all that people do.

dag: Shutɛla zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛran daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Ɛrannima.
en: The clan of Eran traced its descent from Shuthelah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa ti lan labina pahi buyi nti shih o ka yɛli, Yiɣisim di ka nyu, di yi pa lala a chandi maa ni ti nyaŋ a.
en: Soon the Lord 's angel woke him again and said, Get up and eat, or else you'll get too tired to travel.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ paɣiri bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku kpi. Di simdi ka di nyɛ zaligu sahakam bɛ mini bɛ zuliya sani bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: They must wash their hands and their feet so that they will not die. This will be a law that continues forever for Aaron and his people who will live in the future.

dag: Nir yi bo n-nya azichi yomyom di dii bi nabira, amaa bɛn bɔri nyari li biɛlabiɛla, di nabirimi.
en: Money gained by cheating others will soon be gone. Money earned through hard work will grow and grow.

dag: Yi ni nyari ʒii shɛŋa maa pala ʒiri? Ka yi daanabitali nyɛ ʒiri. Hal n yi bi yɛli shɛli, yi yɛrimi, Yawɛ yɛliya. .
en: They say they're preaching my messages, but they are full of lies—I did not speak to them!.

dag: Bɛ tuumbiɛri maa chɛ ka bɛ ku lan tooi ŋmaligi kpa bɛ Naawuni polo. Dama yolimyolim maa pun kpe bɛ kɔbili ni, ka bɛ bi lan mi Yawɛ.
en: The people of Israel have done many evil things, and these evil things keep them from coming back to their God. They are always thinking of ways to chase after other gods. They dont know the Lord .

dag: Niŋgbun yini mini Shi yino m-beni kaman tahima yini din nyɛ Naawuni ni boli ya shɛli zuɣu ni beni shɛm la.
en: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.

dag: Ka yi yi tum taali ka bɛ fiɛbi ya di zuɣu, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya di zuɣu? Amaa yi yi tum din tuhi ka bɛ niŋ ya wahala di zuɣu ka yi niŋ suɣilo dee li, yi ni nya paɣibu Naawuni sani di zuɣu.
en: For what credit is there if you endure the beatings you deserve for having done wrong? But if you endure suffering even when you have done right, God will bless you for it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa be alizanda ni ka boli Ibrahimma pahi buyi.
en: The Lord 's angel called out from heaven a second time:.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya din niŋ maa yɛli sokam din daa niŋ alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa mini kuruchunim maa.
en: Those who had actually seen what had happened to the demon-possessed man told the others about the pigs.

dag: Ka pako faralaan so daa kana nti tɔhila pihinu diba ayi din nyɛ kɔbo.
en: One poor widow came forward and put in two small copper coins worth a penny.

dag: M puhiri Asinkiritus mini Flɛgɔn ni Hɛrimɛs ni Patirɔbas ni Hɛrimas ni ti mabihi bɛn be bɛ san la.
en: Say hello to Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers and sisters who are with them.

dag: ka lihi di goma, ka kpahindi di birininima din ni chɛ ka yi ti tooi yɛli ʒiɛmani din payana niriba:.
en: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ ninsal bemi kaman ti ni be shɛm, ka mi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu, ka di pa shɛli ka o ti pɔhigi nyɛvili tia la walli di m-be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The Lord God said, Look, the man has become like us—he knows about good and evil. And now the man might take the fruit from the tree of life. If the man eats that fruit, he will live forever.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila teeku kɔgbana din laŋsiri ginda, ka bɛ vi tuma ŋmanila kɔfuɣifuɣi. Bɛ lan ŋmanila saŋmar shɛb bɛn chani ginda. Naawuni pun mali biɛhigu shee zali ba bumbɔn ni.
en: Like the dirty foam on the wild waves in the sea, everyone can see the shameful things they do. They are like stars that wander in the sky. A place in the blackest darkness has been kept for them forever.

dag: Ninvuɣ yoya bɛn daa be bɛ ni daa kpiri kɔre pam; ka Izraɛlnim gba daa lan kum ka yɛli, Ti bi zaɣisi ka ti di nya nimdi ŋubi.
en: The riffraff among them had a strong craving. Even the Israelites cried again and said, Who will give us meat to eat?.

dag: Ka o daa kari alizin birigu maa doo maa zuɣu bahi, ka doo maa lan leei ŋun tɔɣisira; ka di daa niŋ salo maa alahiziba pam ka bɛ yɛra, Ti na ʒi n-nya tuuni ŋɔ tatabo Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: But as soon as the demon was driven out, the man started talking, and everyone was amazed. We have never seen anything like this in Israel! they exclaimed.

dag: N naan wuh o n napɔna yaabu zaa, ka chaŋ o sani kaman naa la.
en: I would tell God everything I have done, and hold my head high in his presence.

dag: Amaa ka Amazia daa zaɣisi wumbu. Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash daa chaŋ ka o mini Juda Naa Amazia ti zaŋ bɛ nyɔri yo taba tɔbu ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: But Amaziah refused to listen. So Jehoash and his troops marched to the town of Beth-Shemesh in Judah to attack Amaziah and his troops.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa ni o kpiɔŋ yɛla zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else Jehu did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Bɛ ni daa labir o kuɣa maa, o daa suhirila ti Duuma yɛra. N Duuma Yisa, deemi n nyɛvili.
en: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, Lord Jesus, please welcome me.
