dag: dama kaman sokam zaa ni kpi Adam ni shɛm, lala ka sokam zaa ni neei kum ni Masia zuɣu.
en: I mean that in Adam all of us die. And in the same way, in Christ all of us will be made alive again.

dag: Amaa ka Firawuna daa lan niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: But even this time the king became stubborn, and again he would not let the people go.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kuri niriba chihiri bɛn ka taali, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu tuhi.
en: A murderer hates everyone who is honest and lives right.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya Amalɛknim naa Agag maa n-ti ma na. Ka Agag daa yi o sanna ni suhupiɛlli ti yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, kum biɛrim vuuya. .
en: Then Samuel shouted, Bring me King Agag of Amalek! Agag came in chains, and he was saying to himself, Surely they won't kill me now.

dag: Di tuhiya a sani ni a niŋ a ni zaŋ a nuhi tum tuun shɛli alaka ka lihi ʒiɛm li, ka lee yurila ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo shɛli?.
en: Does it seem good to you that you oppress me, that you reject the work of your hands and cause the purpose of sinners to shine?.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ka mami m pun yɛli ya ka yi zaɣisi wumbu. Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi lan bɔri ni yi wum yaha? Yi gba bɔrimi ni yi leeg o nyaandoliba yɔɣɔ.
en: He answered, I have already told you that. But you would not listen to me. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to be his followers too.

dag: di saha ka Judanim maa zaa daa yi bɛ ni woliwoli tab be luɣ shɛŋa ni n-labi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni Gɛdalia sani Mizipa nti tɔɣiri wain, ka pɔhiri tiwala pam.
en: When the people of Judah heard this news, they came back to the land of Judah. They came back to Gedaliah at Mizpah from all the countries where they had been scattered. So they came back and gathered a large harvest of wine and summer fruit.

dag: Ka Ɛhab ŋun daa nyɛ Omri bia la daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani n-gari na shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: He sinned against the Lord more than any of his predecessors.

dag: Manaasa yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pihinunaanu Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Hɛfiziba.
en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to rule. He ruled years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Hephzibah.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yɛtɔɣ yoya yiri yi noya ni na naɣila din kpaŋsiri niriba suhuri, ka di ni niŋ bɛnkam zaa wum li anfaani.
en: Do not use harmful words, but only helpful words, the kind that build up and provide what is needed, so that what you say will do good to those who hear you.

dag: Bɛ zaa yinoyino ŋmanila luɣ shɛli nira ni ni zo nti sɔɣi tiligi pɔhim bee sanʒiɛɣu. Bɛ ŋmanila kɔzɔrim din zo n-tiɛli tiŋgban nɛli, ka ŋmani mahim din be tiŋgban nɛl ni tampin titali lɔŋni.
en: Each of them will be like a shelter from the wind and a place to hide from storms. They will be like streams flowing in a desert, like the shadow of a giant rock in a barren land.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, faashee yi ŋub Daadam Bia niŋgbuŋ ka nyu o ʒim, di yi pa lala yi ku mali nyɛvili.
en: Jesus said to them, I assure you, unless you eat the flesh of the Human One and drink his blood, you have no life in you.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka m mi n ni yɛn nya o luɣ shɛli polo, ka n di chaŋ hal ni o biɛhigu shee.
en: I wish I knew where to find him. I wish I knew how to go to where he lives.

dag: N kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma zuɣu ni yi karimmi gbaŋ ŋɔ wuhi ti mabihi la zaa.
en: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.

dag: Ka dim so ŋun biri piriŋkpana biɛlim maa nyɛla Sintani; ka chɛbu saha la nyɛ dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu saha, ka malaikanim mi nyɛ bɛn chɛri li maa.
en: and the one who scattered them is the devil. The harvest is the end of time, and angels are the ones who bring in the harvest.

dag: Di simdi ni yi baŋ ni yi gba daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa teeg o yiko nuu yihi ya nimaani na. Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zali ya ni yi gbibi Vuhim Dabisili maa.
en: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and that I, the Lord your God, rescued you by my great power and strength. That is why I command you to observe the Sabbath.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chaŋ ti paai Ɛshikol vinvamli ni n-nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa, bɛ daa gbarigila Izraɛlnima ni bɛ di chaŋ ti deei Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa.
en: These men went as far as Eshcol Valley. They saw the land, and they discouraged the Israelites. These men made the Israelites not want to go into the land that the Lord had given to them.

dag: Ti Duuma, bɔhim ti ʒiʒiinitab biɛri siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin zuɣu, ansarisi shɛŋa bɛ ni maan a la zuɣu.
en: Punish the nations around us! Pay them back seven times for what they did to us. Punish them for insulting you.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ tumtumdiba maa ni tuumbaŋdiba zaa daa zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli tan tolima pia mali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa; ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ li wuɣi.
en: Then the skilled workers began making the Holy Tent. They made the ten curtains from fine linen and blue, purple, and red yarn. And they sewed pictures of Cherub angels with wings into the curtains.

dag: Dama binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili nyɛla o ʒim maa. Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli Izraɛlnima, Miriya ka yi ŋubi binnɛɔŋ kam ʒim, dama binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili nyɛla o ʒim, ka ŋunkam ŋub li, bɛn yihim o o niriba ni.
en: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.

dag: Pa ninsal ka n fabindi niŋdi maa, ka bɔzuɣu ka n yɛn niŋ suɣilo?.
en: My quarrel is not with mortals; I have good reason to be impatient.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ chɛ tin shɛli din yuli daa du pam ŋɔ bahi? Di nyɛla n suhu ni piɛli tiŋ shɛli zuɣu.
en: Once I was pleased with your famous city. But now I warn you, Escape while you still can.

dag: Dinzuɣu so yi ti bol a ka a chaŋ, nyin ʒinim tariŋ ʒiishee, ka ŋun bol a maa yi ti yina ti yɛl a, Zɔri, yiɣisim chaŋ ti ʒini jilima ʒiishee ŋɔ ha! Di saha maa a ni nya jilima a mini bɛnkam laɣim ʒiya diri maa sani.
en: Instead, when you receive an invitation, go and sit in the least important place. When your host approaches you, he will say, Friend, move up here to a better seat. Then you will be honored in the presence of all your fellow guests.

dag: Yi mi di lihiy o kaman o nyɛla yi dima, amaa lee saɣisimiy o mi kaman yi mabia la.
en: But dont treat them as enemies. Counsel them as fellow believers.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ bɔzuɣu ka ti lan yɛn bo kum ti timaŋa? Dama buɣim titali ŋɔ ni ti di ti. Ti yi lan wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ kukoli pahi, ti ni kpi.
en: But if we hear the Lord our God speak to us again, surely we will die! That terrible fire will destroy us. We dont want to die.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa zɔri Yɛhudianim kpamba la zuɣu ka so daa bi saɣi tɔɣis o yɛla palɔni.
en: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.

dag: Yisa daa ti chaŋ Jɛriko nti tim di tiŋ puuni garita.
en: Jesus was going through the city of Jericho.

dag: ka o ninni biɛhigu daa taɣi, ka di muɣis o pam hal ka o kɔba ni ti dii chɔɣisichɔɣisi, ka o duna ŋmɛri taba.
en: The kings mood changed immediately, and he was deeply disturbed. He felt weak, and his knees were shaking.

dag: Yi tahiri tab ʒiishɛhi, amaa ka yɛlimaŋli ka yi polo. Yi dolila naŋgbankpeeni mini ʒiri soli ni yi di nasara, ka chɛ ka yɛlibiɛri tiɣi pua n-dɔɣi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: You falsely accuse others and tell lies in court; sin and trouble are the names of your children.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn dindali maa yuŋ, Gbaam a ba naɣilaa, ka bo naɣila so ŋun pah ayi ka nyɛ yuma ayopɔin ka daag a ba ni me Baal bimbin shɛl la luhi, ka ŋmaai Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli din ʒe m-baɣ li la luhi;.
en: That night the LORD said to him, Take your fathers bull and a second bull seven years old. Break down your fathers altar to Baal and cut down the Asherah that is beside it.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Amaa wahala dabisa ŋɔ nyaaŋa saha, di ku yuui ka wuntaŋ dii zibigi, ka goli ti ku lan piɛla, ka yiko din gbib zuɣusaa ni ti dam ka saŋmarisi yi zuɣusaa luna.
en: Right after the trouble of those days, this will happen: The sun will become dark, and the moon will not give light. The stars will fall from the sky, and everything in the sky will be changed.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri sara maligu nyɛla din chihira, di ti ku be ka bɛ zaŋ li na ni nia biɛɣu.
en: God hates sacrifices from the wicked, especially when their reason for offering them is evil.

dag: Masia n-nyɛ ti suhudoo. Ŋuna n-daai dimdi goon shɛli din be Yɛhudianim mini zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim la sunsuuni la luhi, ka zaŋ ba naai taba.
en: For Christ himself has brought us peace by making Jews and Gentiles one people. With his own body he broke down the wall that separated them and kept them enemies.

dag: O daa lan tuhi nyaŋ Mɔabnima, ka bɛ leeg o daba, ka yɔri farigu o sani.
en: Then David defeated the country of Moab. The Moabites became Davids servants and brought tribute to him.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tin shɛŋa din nyɛ sɔɣisili shee tinsi la ti Aduna bidibisi. Dina n-daa nyɛ: Hiburɔn mini Libina zaŋ tabili di momaha tiŋgbana ni Jatir ni Ɛshitɛmɔa zaŋ tabili di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: So Aaron's descendants received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Hebron, Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth-Shemesh.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa ʒini nimaani yuui, ka kul tɔɣisiri ti Duuma yɛla ni suhukpeeni, ka ti Duuma daa ʒe bɛ ni tɔɣisiri ŋun Yisa daanfaani yɛl shɛŋa maa nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka bɛ wuhiri shihira ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa.
en: Nevertheless, Paul and Barnabas stayed there for quite some time, confidently speaking about the Lord. And the Lord confirmed the word about his grace by the signs and wonders he enabled them to perform.

dag: Dinzuɣu di pala m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yubu ni bibihi ŋɔ ni yino gba bahi yoli.
en: That's how it is with your Father in heaven. He doesn't want any of these little ones to be lost.

dag: Ka chɛrubi yino daa teeg o nuu chɛrubinim maa sanna n-tim buɣim shɛli din daa be chɛrubinim maa sunsuuni la ni m-mooi di shɛli n-zaŋ li niŋ do so ŋun daa ye binyɛr piɛlli maa nuu ni, ka o zaŋ li yi.
en: One of the Cherub angels reached out his hand and took some of the hot coals from the area between the Cherub angels. He poured the coals into the mans hands, and the man left.

dag: O ni daa nya salo maa, ka bɛ yɛla niŋ o nambɔɣu pam, dama bɛ daa nyɛla bɛn nyari nahiŋgu ka bi nyari sɔŋsim; bɛ daa ŋmanila piɛri bɛn ka gula.
en: Jesus saw the many people and felt sorry for them because they were worried and helpless—like sheep without a shepherd to lead them.

dag: O daa ku Ijipti ninsalinim bikpamba zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri bikpamba.
en: He destroyed the firstborn males of the people in Egypt and their animals.

dag: Ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim mini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim ni daa ti di bɛ liɣiri zaa naai saha shɛli, ka Ijiptinim zaa daa ka Yisifu sanna ti yɛl o, Tim ti bindirigu, bɔzuɣu ka a yɛn lihiri ti ka ti kpi? Dama ti liɣiri zaa naaya.
en: But when everyone had run out of money, the Egyptians came to Joseph and demanded, Give us more grain! If you don't, we'll soon be dead, because our money's all gone.

dag: Dauda yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛsi bia Dauda daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ ni duhi ninvuɣ so, Yaakubu Naawuni ni pii ninvuɣ so ka o ŋma yil nyaɣisa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the last words of David: This message is from David son of Jesse. This message is from the man God made great. He is the king chosen by the God of Jacob, the sweet singer of Israel.

dag: Ka di lan sabi yɛli, Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa.
en: Because of this, a man should leave his father and mother and be joined together with his wife.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ŋmaligi chaŋ naai ka niriba maa yi kɔbiliga maa ni na n-chaŋ ti yɛli Naa Dauda, bɛ daa yɛl o mi, Yiɣisim yomyom gbaai kulibɔŋ ŋɔ du, dama n-nyɛ Ahitɔfɛl ni wuhi yikombiɛlim shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: After they left, Ahimaaz and Jonathan came up out of the well and went and reported to King David. They told him what Ahithophel had planned against him and said, Hurry up and cross the river.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk min o niriba daa yiɣisi yuŋ chaŋ ti piri tab ʒii bunahi zuɣu n-dɔni gili Shɛkɛm.
en: So Abimelech and all his soldiers got up during the night and went to the city. The soldiers separated into four groups. They hid near the city of Shechem.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa da Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa puri zaa n-ti Firawuna; dama Ijiptinim zaa daa zaŋla bɛ puri kɔhi, kum maa ni daa mii ba pam maa zuɣu. Ka puri maa daa leei Firawuna dini.
en: Joseph bought all the land in Egypt for the king. Every Egyptian was forced to sell his land, because the famine was so severe; and all the land became the king's property.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a yuli galisiya dunia ŋɔ zaa ni!.
en: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name throughout the earth!.

dag: O daa lan zali sariakaritiba bɛ ni daa me goondahi gili Juda tiŋgban ni fɔntin shɛŋa la zaa yiniyini ni.
en: He appointed judges in each of the fortified cities of Judah.

dag: Kamiyana pumpɔŋɔ ka ti ku o n-zaŋ o ti bahi bɔɣa ŋɔ zaɣ yin ni, ka yɛli ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbigu n-gbaag o ŋubi, ka ti nya o ni zahim zahin shɛŋa maa ni yɛn bahindi shɛm.
en: We should kill him now while we can. We could throw his body into one of the empty wells and tell our father that a wild animal killed him. Then we will show him that his dreams are useless.

dag: N wuh a yɛm, ka wuh a so shɛŋa din tuhi.
en: I am teaching you about wisdom and guiding you on the right path.

dag: So yi niŋ lala, o yi ti yi daɣiri maa ni, bɛn zalim o daba ayopɔin.
en: After the priest has been made clean, he must wait seven days.

dag: Shɛb daa ʒila zibisim mini bumbɔn ni, ka nyɛ sarikanima, ka bɛ ba ba bandi ʒili ka bɛ diri wahala.
en: Some were living in gloom and darkness, prisoners suffering in chains.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa ŋme ba naŋgbankpeeni ni o chɛ ka gomna maa ku niŋ yɛda.
en: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.

dag: Naawuni noli ni di binshɛɣukam ti ku be tiŋ maa ni. Kulla Naawuni mini Piɛbil maa nam ʒiishee la n-yɛn beni, ka o daba ni jɛmd o.
en: God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zal li saha shɛli yi ti paai, Siria naa maa ni lan labina ti liri Ijiptinim yaha, amaa din yɛla ni ti be di ko.
en: At the set time he will again battle against the south, but the second time will be different from the first.

dag: Dauda min o niriba maa ni daa mali ti paai Mahanaim, ka Nahash bia Shɔbi ŋun daa yi Raba din be Ammɔn tiŋgban ni la na mini Makiri Amiɛl bia ŋun daa yi Lɔdɛba na la ni Barizillai ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nira ka yi Rɔgɛlim na la.
en: When David arrived at Mahanaim, Shobi, Makir, and Barzillai were there. Shobi son of Nahash was from the Ammonite town of Rabbah. Makir son of Ammiel was from Lo Debar. Barzillai was from Rogelim in Gilead.

dag: Bɛ daa yil la buɣilimbuɣilimbila ni pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi ka lan yili buɣilimbuɣilimbila ni pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi m-mali lala hal ti tuui alichɛbba shɛli bɛ ni yɛn yɛri tumdi tuma maa tiŋli kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: with a bell and a pomegranate alternating all around the lower hem of the robe that is used for ministering as a priest, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, yiɣisim zani a naba zuɣu ka n tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa.
en: The Lord said, Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.

dag: Aripakishad ni daa dɔɣi Shɛla maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinahinaata. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: after that, he lived another years and had other children.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, miriya ka yi di binʒim kam yi ni be luɣ shɛli zaa, noonsi ʒim bee biŋkɔbiri ʒim.
en: No matter where the Israelites live, they must never use the blood of birds or animals for food.

dag: Bɛ kul bemi kaman shihi la n-gili n luɣilikam, ka ŋmaligi kpi yomyom kaman buɣim n-di gɔhi la, ka n nyaŋ ba Yawɛ yuli zuɣu!.
en: They surrounded me like a swarm of bees, but they were quickly destroyed like a fast-burning bush. I defeated them with the Lord s power.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi maa naabu dali daa ti paai ka Yawɛ zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi din daa nyɛ alikauli kuɣ parilana maa ti ma.
en: Yes, after those forty days and nights the Lord gave me the two stone tablets on which he had written the covenant.

dag: Di saha maa niriba pam ni ti zaɣisi ma dolibu, ka yi tab nyaansi, ka je taba.
en: At that time many will fall away. They will betray each other and hate each other.

dag: Amaa dalinli maa yi piɛl o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ maa zuɣu, ka bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka kɔbiri din be dalinli maa ni bi paligi, maligumaana maa ŋun zaŋmi dɔro maa lana niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: But if the sore is white and does not appear to be deeper than the skin around it and the hairs have not turned white, the priest shall isolate you for seven days.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Sulemaana Kazala la ni chani ginda.
en: Jesus was walking in Solomon's Porch in the Temple.

dag: A ni tooi yɛli saŋmarisi bɛ ni yɛn yina saha shɛli? Bee a ni tooi wuhi saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim taba ka bɛ booni ba Baa min o bihi la soli?.
en: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti kpihim buɣa yuli tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka so ku lan teei di yɛla yaha. N ni ti lan vuui anab ʒirinim mini buɣijɛmbo tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says: When that time comes, I will get rid of every idol in the country, and they will be forgotten forever. I will also do away with their prophets and those evil spirits that control them.

dag: Yawɛ nina kul bela luɣilikam, ka o yuuni ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma.
en: The LORDs eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on evil and good people.

dag: di yi ti wum kom ʒiɛɣu, di ni puhi n-niŋ wula kaman ti polli la.
en: but at the touch of water, it sprouts once again.

dag: Amaa ka o ma daa bi saɣi ka yɛli ba, Bolimiy o la Jɔn.
en: But his mother replied, No, his name will be John.

dag: Puhimiya tab yurilim puhigu! Naawuni tim yinim bɛn nyɛ Masia ni su shɛb la zaa suhudoo!.
en: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika maa, N suhir a, na di kuli, ka ti gbaai bubil polli kɔrigi niŋ bindirigu ti a.
en: Then Manoah said to the angel of the Lord , We would like for you to stay a while. We want to cook a young goat for you to eat.

dag: Ka Yuria bia Mɛrɛmɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Hakɔz yaaŋa la daa mali me Ɛliashib yiŋ dunoli maa shee hal ti paai o yiŋ maa tariga m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired the next section of wall from the entrance to Eliashibs house to the end of that house.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ni piligi niŋdi shɛli maa leei bɛ kali kaman Mɔdɛkai ni daa sab yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: So the Jews followed Mordecai's instructions, and the celebration became an annual custom.

dag: Yawɛ, n wum a yuli ni du shɛm yɛla. Yawɛ, ka a tuma chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma. Tummi li ti ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni yaha, ka chɛ ka ti baŋ li ti ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni; a suhuyiɣisili saha, teemi nambɔzɔbo yɛla.
en: LORD, I have heard your reputation. I have seen your work. Over time, revive it. Over time, make it known. Though angry, remember compassion.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli, Mbaye! Yawɛ zaŋla ti nanima ata ŋɔ na ni o ti niŋ Mɔabnim nuu ni.
en: Israels king said, This is terrible! Has the LORD brought us three kings together only to hand us over to Moab.

dag: Ɛdom beni, di nanim mini di kpamba kpiɔŋ maa zaa, bɛna n-doya m-pahi bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb la zuɣu maa. Bɛ mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni n-laɣim doya pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun be kpiimba biɛhigu shee la zuɣu maa.
en: The graves of kings and leaders from Edom are there. They were powerful at one time. Now they are buried in the world of the dead with other godless soldiers killed in battle.

dag: Bɛ di n-tiɣi nyaaŋa, bɛ ni ti be muɣisigu ni. Ka yɛlibiɛɣu kam zaa ni ti ka bɛ zuɣu na.
en: Even in their plenty, they are hard-pressed; all sorts of trouble come on them.

dag: Iso paɣ Oholibama bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ nanima n-daa nyɛ: Jɛushi mini Jalam ni Kɔra. Iso paɣ Oholibama Ana bipuɣiŋga la ni daa dɔɣi na shɛba m-bala.
en: The following tribes were descended from Esau by his wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah: Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ kul larila ninvuɣ biɛri maa, dama o mi ni bɛ biɛɣu kanna.
en: But our Lord will laugh at them. He will make sure they get what they deserve.

dag: a nyɛla ŋun saɣisiri niriba viɛnyɛliŋga, ka tumdi tuun kara. A nyari ninsal kam biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka tiri bɛ zaa laara kaman bɛ biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm.
en: You make wise plans and do mighty things; you see everything that people do, and you reward them according to their actions.

dag: Di yi nyɛla n daa birigila soli maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka n suhu ye n nina ni nya binshɛŋa zuɣu, ka daɣ shɛli yi be n nuhi ni.
en: If I ever stepped off the right path, if my eyes led my heart to do evil, or if my hands are dirty with sin.

dag: N daa mi do so ŋun be Masia ni yuun pinaanahi din gari ŋɔ puuni, ka Naawuni daa kpuɣ o du zuɣusaa m-mali ti paai alizanda puuni ha. O yi daa bela o niŋgbuŋ ni bee o yi daa ka o niŋgbuŋ ni, m bi mi; Naawuni m-mi.
en: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago. I dont know whether it was in the body or out of the body. God knows.

dag: Ŋun yɛn fa ba bahi maa nyɛla kpiɔŋlana. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa. Biɛhiŋ kani, o ni lihi bɛ yɛlli maa zuɣu din ni chɛ ka o ti dunianim vuhim, amaa o ku ti Babilɔnnim bɛn vuhim.
en: But God will get them back. His name is the Lord God All-Powerful. He will defend them very strongly. He will argue their case so that he can let their land rest. But there will be no rest for those living in Babylon.

dag: Kalimiya Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yuun pisi zaŋ chana kaman Yawɛ ni zali Musa shɛm. Izraɛlnim bɛn daa yi Ijipti na n-nyɛ:.
en: what the Lord had said about counting the men years and older, just as Moses and their ancestors had done when they left Egypt.

dag: Yi gba kpalimmiya gbe kpe kaman yi tab la ni daa niŋ shɛm la, ka n nya Yawɛ ni yɛn yɛli ma di yɛla shɛm pahi.
en: Now you also must remain the night here so that I may know what else the LORD may say to me.

dag: Ka binyɛra maa zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛli yi lu binshɛli zuɣu di ni leei zaɣ daɣiri, di yi nyɛla bɔrɔbɔro duu bee daaŋa yin wurimmiya li, di leei daɣiri, ka kul ni nyɛla daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: Anything on which a part of these animals dead bodies might fall will be unclean. If it is an oven or stove, it must be destroyed; they are unclean for you and must remain that way.

dag: ni bɛ ni niŋ moonsi mɔhi piɛlahi gban shɛŋa ni teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana ni gɔpiɛliga dari.
en: ram skins dyed red and fine leather; acacia wood;.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ zaligu shɛli Masia ni zali ti. Dina n-nyɛ: Ŋunkam yuri Naawuni, di simdi ni o yur o mabia gba.
en: This commandment we have from him: Those who claim to love God ought to love their brother and sister also.

dag: Musa ni daa kpi saha shɛli maa, o yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pisi. O nina daa na kul nɛmi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka o niŋgbuŋ ni yaa daa bi filim.
en: Moses was years old when he died. He was as strong as ever, and his eyes were still good.

dag: N yi di mmaŋ shɛhira, n shɛhira maa ku nyɛla shɛhira maŋli.
en: If I testify about myself, my testimony isnt true.

dag: Di saha ka Ribɛka daa zaŋ o bituuli Iso binyɛr suma din be o sani yiŋa n-yɛl o bia Yaakubu ŋun nyɛ biasani maa;.
en: Rebekah took her older son Esaus favorite clothes that were in the house with her, and she put them on her younger son Jacob.

dag: Yɛm ni ti gul a, ka yɛla baŋbu gba taɣ a.
en: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim buta m-bɔŋɔ ka m mali shili ni n ka yi sanna; ka m mi ku zaŋ n yɛla doli ya, dama m bi bɔri yi binshɛli, amaa yimaŋmaŋ ka m bɔra. Pa bihi n-dihiri bɛ laamba, amaa bihi laamba n-dihiri ba.
en: Look, Im ready to visit you a third time, and I wont be a burden on you. I dont want your things; I want you. It isnt the childrens responsibility to save up for their parents but parents for children.

dag: Ka nyini Izraɛl na biɛɣu ŋun dabisa pali ŋɔ, a tibidarigibo din bahindi nyaaŋa saha paaya.
en: And you, evil leader of Israel, you will be killed. Your time of punishment has come! The end is here.

dag: ka ti Duuma daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari tiliginsim kul pahiri bɛ ni biɛɣukam.
en: praising God, and enjoying the good will of all the people. And every day the Lord added to their group those who were being saved.

dag: Mbusim be yinim gba zuɣu sokam yi ti paɣiri ya saha shɛli, dama lala ka bɛ yaannim daa pun niŋ anab ʒirinim la.
en: How terrible when all people speak well of you; their ancestors said the very same things about the false prophets.

dag: Pɛka ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the great things that Pekah did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ Jɛrimia bia Jaazania ŋun daa nyɛ Habazinia yaaŋa la min o mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba ni o bidibisi zaa ni Rɛkab daŋ niriba zaa na.
en: So I took the entire Rechabite clan—Jaazaniah and all his brothers and sons—.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ naa maa yoli nti yaɣi, amaa ka o pɔri la mini saamba la zuɣu chɛ ka o bahi noli ni bɛ niŋmi lala.
en: Although the king was upset, because of his solemn pledge and his guests he commanded that they give it to her.

dag: dindali maa ninvuɣ so ŋun ti zo n-tiligi ni ti zo n-ka a sanna nti ti a di lahibali.
en: On that same day, someone will escape from the city and come to tell you what has happened.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋdi dimbɔŋɔ ka gbib li viɛnyɛliŋga ni nya alibarika. Ŋunkam gbibi Vuhim Dabisili viɛnyɛliŋga ka bi saɣim li, ka mi bi tumdi din bie ni nya alibarika.
en: I will bless those who refuse to do wrong and who obey the law about the Sabbath.

dag: Izraɛlnim Naawuni daa pii ti yaannima n-chɛ ka bɛ nab pam hal saha shɛli bɛ ni daa nyɛ tinzunnima m-be Ijipti la. Ka o daa ti yihi ba nimaani o yiko ni.
en: The God of Israel chose our ancestors. And during the time our people lived in Egypt as foreigners, he made them great. Then he brought them out of that country with great power.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, a mali dahin shɛli biɛhigu tahima, ka a tahima maa ni niŋ pali.
en: Then you will truly have hope for the future.

dag: Ka doo maa ba min o ma maa yɛli ba, Ti mi ni ti bia m-bɔŋɔ, ka ti daa dɔɣ o la zoma.
en: His parents answered, We know that this man is our son. And we know that he was born blind.

dag: Ka biɛrisuntal maŋa din nyɛ Masia kɔŋko ni tiri shɛl la kpe m-pali yi bebu ni zaa Naawuni tibigibu min o paɣibu zuɣu.
en: that your life will be full of the many good works that are produced by Jesus Christ to bring glory and praise to God.

dag: Tumtumdiba ni bɔri bindirigu zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ tumdi tuma, ka kum nyɛ din kpaŋsiri ba ka bɛ tumda.
en: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka ti lee yɛn zaŋ Naawuni nam ŋmahindi bee ŋahi dini ka ti lee yɛn ŋahi zaŋ chaŋ di polo?.
en: He continued, Whats a good image for Gods kingdom? What parable can I use to explain it?.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛli ba yaha, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Mani n-nyɛ buzɔŋ dunoli.
en: So Jesus said again, I am telling you the truth: I am the gate for the sheep.

dag: Yɛhudianim mali soya balibu pam din chɛ ka bɛ so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla, Naawuni daa zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa niŋla Yɛhudianim nuu ni.
en: Much, indeed, in every way! In the first place, God trusted his message to the Jews.

dag: Di saha maa ka Jɛhɔram daa zaŋ o chɛchɛbunsi zaa n-yiɣisi yuŋ chaŋ Zairi, ka o min o chɛchɛbunsi sapashinnim ti lu Ɛdomnim bɛn daa teei gil o zuɣu n-niŋ ba buɣim; amaa ka o tɔbbihi daa zo n-kuli.
en: Jehoram along with all his chariots crossed over to Zair. He got up at night to attack the Edomites who had surrounded him and his chariot commanders, but his army fled back home.

dag: Ka bɛ ti yɛra, Tiŋgban shɛli din daa nyɛ tiŋgban nɛl la kpalim ŋmanila Idɛn puu. Ka niriba lan pali fɔntin shɛŋa din daa wurim leei dabari la zaa ni, ka bɛ me gooni gil li.
en: They will say, In the past, this land was ruined, but now it is like the Garden of Eden. The cities were destroyed. They were ruined and empty, but now they are protected, and there are people living in them.

dag: ka lan zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai zo shɛli din doya miri Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli din do Rɛfaim Vinvamli nuzaa polo ni, ka lan zaŋ nimaani hal ni Hinnom Vinvamli din be Jɛbusi nudirigu polo kuŋkuni zuɣu la m-mali lala hal ti sirigi Ɛnrɔgɛl polo ha.
en: Then the border went down to the bottom of the hill near the valley of Ben Hinnom, north of Rephaim Valley. It continued down Hinnom Valley just south of the Jebusite city. Then the border went on to En Rogel.

dag: Ninsal dunia ŋɔ yili biɛhigu zaa puuni, o tuma zaa nyɛla din tir o biɛrim mini suhugarigu, hal ka o bi tooi vuhir o yubu yuŋ gba. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: As long as you live, everything you do brings nothing but worry and heartache. Even at night your mind can't rest. It is all useless.

dag: Ti zaɣisi ni ti ku wum a daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim bɛn daa zaŋ a yuli kana nti tɔɣisi ti nanim mini ti kpambaliba ni ti yaannim zaŋ tabili ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa la yɛligu.
en: We have not listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our rulers, our ancestors, and our whole nation.

dag: Naawuni, zom ma nambɔɣu; dama niriba kul durimi tamdi n zuɣu; n dimnim kul nahindi ma mi dabisili kam puuni.
en: God, have mercy on me because Im being trampled. All day long the enemy oppresses me.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli ba, Yɛlimiya Dauda, Naa bi bɔri paɣibɔr liɣiri a sani n-naɣi pahila Filistianim yokol gbana kɔbiga din ni chɛ ka ŋun naa bɔh o dimnim maa biɛri. Sool daa tɛhiya ni lala ni chɛ ka Filistianim maa ku Dauda.
en: and Saul replied, Tell David this: The king doesnt want any bridal gift, just a hundred Philistine foreskins as vengeance on the kings enemies.

dag: O bela tampima shee, ka zaŋ tampin choya zuɣusaa leeg o yiŋa.
en: It makes its home on the highest rocks and makes the sharp peaks its fortress.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Tiligira ni ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti tiligi Yaakubu zuliya bɛn niŋ tuuba bɛ daalahichi zuɣu.
en: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.

dag: Haa Kum, a nasara dibu be ya? Haa Kum, a dimbu yiko be ya?.
en: O death, where is your victory? Where is your power to hurt? Hosea :.

dag: Ka Ɛkan daa yɛli Jɔshua, Yɛlimaŋli, n tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ sani; N ni tum alahichi shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: It's true, Achan answered. I have sinned against the Lord , Israel's God, and this is what I did.

dag: A zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala. To, ti ni wuhi nyin naa di gbinni.
en: This was the dream. Now we will tell the king its meaning.

dag: Sool ni daa ŋmaligi Samuɛl sani ni o chaŋ, ka Naawuni taɣ o suhu. Ka shihira ŋɔ zaa daa niŋ pali dindali maa.
en: As Saul turned around to leave Samuel, God made Saul feel like a different person. That same day, everything happened just as Samuel had said.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ dunɔdal shɛli din daa kpa wulimpuhili polo la nti du dunɔdura maa m-buɣisi li di dunɔbia zaŋ kpe puuni, ka di nyɛ mita ata.
en: He entered the gate facing east. He went up its steps, and he measured the plaza at the gate. It was ten and a half feet wide: the plaza was ten and a half feet wide.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim ŋɔ, labisim ti na yaha, ka ku a suhuyiɣisili la zaŋ chaŋ ti sani.
en: You, the God who can save us, restore us! Stop being angry with us!.

dag: Tihi din vari kul sabigi sahakam, fabilimiya, dama sida tihi luya; ti suma la zaa bahi yoli! Bashan oki tihi, fabilimiya, dama bɛ ŋma nyɔŋ tihi la zaa luhi!.
en: The cypress trees will cry because the cedar trees have fallen. Those powerful trees will be taken away. Oak trees in Bashan will cry for the forest that was cut down.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yihi Jona bahi teeku maa ni, ka teeku maa daa fo n-dɔni baalim.
en: So the men threw Jonah into the sea. The storm stopped, and the sea became calm.

dag: Ka ŋunkam be Masia ni, o bi tumd alahichi; ka ŋunkam kul tumd alahichi, dindina o na bi nya o bee m-mi o.
en: Every person who remains in relationship to him does not sin. Any person who sins has not seen him or known him.

dag: Di simdi ni a nya tibidarigibo a ni daa tum pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli mini din chihiri shɛl la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You alone must bear your bad reputation and your detestable ways. This is what the LORD says.

dag: Mbusim be ti zuɣu! Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi fa ti buɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ nuu ni bahi? Buɣ shɛŋa din daa zaŋ alɔbo balibu kam luhi Ijiptinim zuɣu n-ku ba mɔɣu ni la m-bala.
en: We are worried. Who can save us from these powerful gods? These gods are the same ones that gave the Egyptians those diseases and terrible sicknesses.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa lan gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu yɛli.
en: Job took up his subject again.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka man Pool nyɛ Yisa Masia dansarika yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zuɣu.
en: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles, pray to God.

dag: Ka ti yab Yaakubu daa ti wum ni bindirigu be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka o daa tuui tim ti yaannim maa ni bɛ chaŋ Ijipti ti da bindirigu na.
en: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣ pihinahi dali, ka Nuhu daa yooi ŋariŋ maa takɔr shɛli o ni daa chib la.
en: Forty days later Noah opened the window he had made in the boat.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti zaŋ kpani maa m-bɔr ni o to Dauda tabili dukpini, amaa ka Dauda daa fɔhi Sool, ka o zaŋ kpani maa to n-nyɔɣila dukpini. Ka Dauda daa guui n-zo n-tiligi yuŋ maa.
en: Saul tried to pin David to the wall with his spear, but David escaped Saul. Saul drove the spear into the wall, but David fled and got away safely. That night.

dag: Binshɛɣukam tariga paabu saha miriya, dinzuɣu gbibiya yimaŋa, ka yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu suhiri Naawuni.
en: The time is near when all things will end. So keep your minds clear, and control yourselves. This will help you in your prayers.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi ti zaŋ anzinfa mali wuni pahi n zuɣu bee n-zaŋ salima mali wuni zali yi sani.
en: Do not make for yourselves gods of silver or gold to be worshiped in addition to me.

dag: Wuntizɔra wuhir o zɔnim din viɛla, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri soli kpɛhirila nir yɔɣu.
en: The righteous person is a guide to his friend, but the path of the wicked leads them astray.

dag: Naawuni, bɔ saha ka a dimnim maa lee yɛn chɛ a labu? Bɛ kul yɛn tarila a yuli daɣiri sahakam?.
en: God, how much longer will the enemy make fun of us? Will you let them insult your name forever?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɛ mabihi m-mali bɛmaŋ be kasi n-kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni nti mal li ka di be kasi kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuhi naa ka o zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm.
en: These men assembled their fellow Levites, and they all made themselves ritually clean. Then, as the king had commanded them to do, they began to make the Temple ritually clean, according to the Law of the Lord .

dag: Ka maligumaana ni mali sara ti ninvuɣ so ŋun chirim maa, o yi bi yuri ka tum alahichi, o ni mali sara ti o Yawɛ sani, ka o nya taali chɛ m-paŋ.
en: The priest will seek reconciliation in the LORDs presence for the person who sinned unintentionally, when the sin is an accident, seeking reconciliation so that person will be forgiven.

dag: Ka Dauda tɔbbihi maa daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnima n-ku ba pam; dindali maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisi ka bɛ daa ku.
en: The army of Israel was defeated there by Davids soldiers. A great slaughter of twenty thousand men took place that day.

dag: Dinzuɣu dimbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla yɛliŋmahima din kpahiri ti zuɣu ni ni ti di yu tuumbiɛri tumbu kaman bɛ ni daa yu li shɛm.
en: These things were examples for us, so we wont crave evil things like they did.

dag: Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas ŋun nyɛ maligumaana Aduna yaaŋa ŋɔ niŋ suhukpeeni Izraɛlnim ni n-zani n zaani mahi n suhu, ka m bi chɛ ka n suhuyiɣisili di Izraɛlnima.
en: In my anger, I would have wiped out the Israelites if Phinehas had not been faithful to me.

dag: Saha yuusim wula ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ lee yɛn fabili? Ka saha yuusim wula ka luɣilikam mɔri yɛn kuui? Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni tuumbiɛri zuɣu chɛ ka biŋkɔbiri mini noombihi zaa kpira; ka din pahi nyɛla, niriba yɛra, O nini bi nyari ti ni niŋdi shɛli.
en: How long will our land be dry, and the grass in every field be withered? Animals and birds are dying because of the wickedness of our people, people who say, God doesn't see what we are doing.

dag: Doliya duno muɣiliŋga kpe, dama so shɛli din kuni bahi yoli shee dolibu be asama ka di dunoli yɛlima, ka niriba pam dol li.
en: Go in through the narrow gate, because the gate to hell is wide and the road that leads to it is easy, and there are many who travel it.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa nya ba lala maa ka kab laɣim taba; ka bɛ ni shɛb daa zo nti sɔɣi vokaba ni, ka shɛb sɔɣi voya ni, ka shɛb sɔɣi tampima lɔna ni, ka shɛb sɔɣi silisi ni, ka shɛb sɔɣi kɔbilisi ni.
en: The Israelites saw that they were in trouble. They felt trapped. They ran away to hide in caves and cracks in the rock. They hid among the rocks, in wells, and in other holes in the ground.

dag: m-pahi Yawɛ vuhim dabisa la mini yi pina ni yi ni po pɔri shɛŋa sara ni yi suhuyubu sara shɛŋa yi ni maani tiri Yawɛ la zaa zuɣu.
en: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.

dag: dama ti bi ʒi shɛli ka dunia ŋɔ ni na, ka di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni ti shiri ku tooi ʒi shɛli yi dunia ŋɔ ni gba.
en: What did we bring into the world? Nothing! What can we take out of the world? Nothing!.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ anabi Shɛmaya mini anabi Iddo yɛlikura litaafinim ni. Di saha maa Rɛhɔbɔam mini Jɛrɔbɔam daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu waawaayili.
en: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king, including a history of his family, is written in the records of the two prophets, Shemaiah and Iddo. During Rehoboam's rule, he and King Jeroboam of Israel were constantly at war.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ so shɛli tiligi Hɛzɛkia mini Jɛrusalɛmnim Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib nuu ni m-bala. O daa lan tiligi Hɛzɛkia o dimnim zaa nuu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ nya nyee vuhi luɣilikam zaa.
en: So the Lord saved Hezekiah and the people in Jerusalem from King Sennacherib of Assyria and from all other people. He cared for Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋla o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛɣu bee bua ni o mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ, ka di nyɛla biŋkɔb lɔɣu bee zaɣ nyaŋ, di simdi ka o zaŋla ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara maa.
en: If a sheep or goat is used as a fellowship offering, it may be male or female, but it must be without any defects.

dag: Sana daa ʒi n-gbe samban ni, n daa kul yoola n dunoya ti sochandiba.
en: I invited travelers into my home and never let them sleep in the streets.

dag: Di moliya di yɛla gili Gaat fɔŋ ni; yi mi di moliya di yɛla doli Ashikɛlɔn solɔri, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Filistia bipuɣinsi yiɣi jam, bee n-chɛ ka bɛn bi gundi ŋɔ bipuɣinsi suhuri paligi.
en: Dont talk about it in Gath; dont bring news of it to Ashkelons streets, or else the Philistines daughters will rejoice; the daughters of the uncircumcised will celebrate.

dag: Ti Duuma, nyini n-su yurilim maŋli. Dama nyini n-tiri sokam zaa o tuma ni simdi shɛm.
en: My Lord, your love is real. You reward all people for what they do.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Labimiya nti yɛli Jɔn yi ni nya ka wum shɛm:.
en: Jesus responded, Go, report to John what you hear and see.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, a tum alahiziba tuma ti ti; a lo ti nia suma pam; ka so mi bi ŋman a. N yi yɛn yɛli di zaa yɛla, di ni galisi pam ka nira ku tooi kal li!.
en: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.

dag: Nuhu ʒiɛman ni, n ni daa lo alikauli ni n ku chɛ ka kom lan di dunia la, lala ka n lo alikauli ni n ku lan chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bah a zuɣu, ka mi ku lan darig a tibili.
en: In the time of Noah I promised never again to flood the earth. Now I promise not to be angry with you again; I will not reprimand or punish you.

dag: Dama n niriba maa nyɛla jɛra; bɛ bi mi ma. Bɛ nyɛla bi jɛra, bɛ bi baŋdi binyɛra gbinni. Bɛ mali yɛm din tumdi tuumbiɛri, amaa ka lee bi mi tuun viɛla tumbu.
en: The Lord said, My people are foolish. They dont know me. They are stupid children. They dont understand. They are skillful at doing evil, but they dont know how to do good.

dag: N yɛr a mi ni a ku tooi yi nimaani faashee a ti yo bɛ ni zal a san shɛli zaa, ka di laɣifu ku guui.
en: I tell you, you wont get out of there until you have paid the very last cent.

dag: Gbibiya Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la. Yi ni ti ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin kaman n ni daa zali ya shɛm ka di doli bɛ ni zal li saha shɛli Abib gol ni, dama Abib goli maa ni ka yi daa yi Ijipti na.
en: Don't fail to observe the Festival of Thin Bread in the month of Abib. Obey me and eat bread without yeast for seven days during Abib, because that is the month you left Egypt.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma pahi.
en: The LORDs word came to me.

dag: Ka Absalom tumtumdiba maa daa shiri niŋ Amnɔn kaman Absalom ni wuhi ba ni bɛ niŋ o shɛm maa. Di saha ka nabihi maa zaa daa dii yiɣisi ba bɛ buntaansi zo.
en: So Absaloms young soldiers did what he said. They killed Amnon. But all of Davids other sons escaped. Each son got on his mule and escaped.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa baŋ ni Yawɛ zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa, ka lan chɛ ka o nam du pam o niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: And so David realized that the Lord had established him as king of Israel and was making his kingdom prosperous for the sake of his people.

dag: Ka n daa ti tim Musa mini Aduna Ijipti maa; ka chɛ ka alɔbo lu Ijiptinim zuɣu m-muɣisi ba pam, di nyaaŋa ka n daa yihi ya nimaani na.
en: Then I sent Moses and Aaron. I plagued Egypt with what I did to them. After that I brought you out.

dag: O ni daa kul wuhi ti di gbinni shɛm, di daa ti shiri niŋla pali; a daa labisi ma n tuma ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ a bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm la mi ti yili tia.
en: and what he said came true. He said I would be free and have my old job back, and it happened. He also said the baker would die, and it happened.

dag: Ka naa daa po pɔri yɛli Shimɛi, A ku kpi.
en: And he said to Shimei, I give you my word that you will not be put to death.

dag: Dabisili din pah ayi dali zaŋmiya naɣilabihi pinaayi mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: For the next six days of the festival, you will sacrifice one less bull than the day before, so that on the seventh day, seven bulls will be sacrificed. The other sacrifices and offerings must remain the same for each of these days.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi lan yɛli yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna yɛla, dama yɛlimuɣisirili maa nyɛla sokam maŋmaŋ yɛligu, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi taɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ka nyɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛligu.
en: But you are no longer to mention the LORDs message, because everyone thinks they have received a message from the LORD. You destroy the very word of the living God, the LORD of heavenly forces, our God.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli, N jilima naaya. N ni daa niŋdi binshɛŋa zaa tahima Yawɛ san la naaya.
en: I do not have much longer to live; my hope in the Lord is gone.

dag: yi ni sɔŋ ma lahibal suŋ la tuma ni di piligu dali hal ti paai pumpɔŋɔ shɛm la zuɣu.
en: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti ye bɛ ni zaŋ piɛkɔbiri mini gali piɛlli gari tab wuɣi situr shɛŋa.
en: Do not wear cloth made by weaving wool and linen together.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Tiŋ kani ka a lee yina? Ŋuni n-lee su a? Ka o garigi yɛli, N nyɛla Ijipti nachimbila, ka nyɛ ŋun tumdi Amalɛk do so tuma. N daa kala alaafee, ka ŋun su ma maa chɛ ma bahi ka chaŋ, di zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then David asked him, Whose slave are you? Where do you come from? Im an Egyptian servant boy, he said, and the slave of an Amalekite. My master abandoned me when I got sick three days ago.

dag: Amaa o yi wum di yɛla ka di niŋ daba yi ha, di nyaaŋa ka o ti yɛn zaɣisi li, dindina paɣ maa taali ni ʒi doo maa zuɣu.
en: If he breaks them after he has heard them, he will assume her guilt.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa pii Lɛvi zuliya niriba zali ni bɛ ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa, ka zaan o tooni tumd o tuma, ka zaŋd o yuli niŋdi alibarika niŋdi niriba ni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: At that time, the LORD selected the tribe of Levi to carry the chest containing the LORDs covenant, to minister before the LORD, to serve him, and to offer blessings in his name. Thats the way things are right now.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa garigi yɛl o, Pa tuun sun shɛli zuɣu ka ti yɛn lab a kuɣa maa, amaa a ni mɔri Naawuni la zuɣu, dama a nyɛla daadam, amaa ka zaŋ amaŋ leei Naawuni.
en: They answered, We are not stoning you because of any good thing you did. We are stoning you because you did a terrible thing. You are just a man, and here you are claiming to be God.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi tɛhi a zaligunim din yi kurimbuni na la yɛla, di kpaŋsirila n suhu.
en: I find true comfort, Lord , because your laws have stood the test of time.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Labimi mɔɣu ni luɣ shɛli din miri Damaskus la. A yi paai nimaani, nyin boom kpam bahi Hazaɛl zuɣu ni ka o leei Siria naa;.
en: The Lord said: Elijah, you can go back to the desert near Damascus. And when you get there, appoint Hazael to be king of Syria.

dag: Di zaa yoli ka Firawuna daa na kul niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku wum bɛ yɛligu maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm la.
en: However, Pharaoh remained stubborn. He wouldnt listen to them, just as the LORD had said.

dag: Pool ni daa nya ʒii maa nyaaŋa ka ti daa dii gbaai nia lɔbu ni ti chaŋ Masidɔnia maa ti ni daa baŋ ni Naawuni n-tim ti ni ti ti yihi Yisa Masia lahibal suŋ waazu ti nimaani nim gba zuɣu.
en: After Paul had seen the vision, we began looking for a way to go to Macedonia. We were sure that God had called us to preach the good news there.

dag: Paɣ ŋuni pul ni ka maasim kpikpikpi lee yina? Ka ŋuni n-lee dɔɣi ko shɛli din kilim yiri alizanda ni na ŋɔ?.
en: Does ice have a mother? Who gives birth to the frost?.

dag: Kul paɣimiya Yawɛ ka duhimiy o yuli, ka molimiy o tuma yɛla zuliya kam ni.
en: Give thanks to the LORD, call on his name; make his deeds known to all people!.

dag: N ni daa lihi binnɛma maa, ka n daa nya ka kalinli zaɣ yiniyini ʒe m-baɣi binnɛma maa. Bɛba anahi maa zaa yino kam daa sula zaɣ yini.
en: As I was looking at the four creatures I saw four wheels touching the ground, one beside each of them.

dag: Lala ka Asiria naa ti yɛn gbahi Ijiptinim leei daba, ka gbahi Itiɔpianim ninkura mini bipola n-zaŋ ba bɛ zaɣim ni bɛ napɔn zaŋa, ka bɛ gbina do palo ni, n-kuli o yiŋa, ka di dihi Ijiptinim vi.
en: The emperor of Assyria will lead away naked the prisoners he captures from those two countries. Young and old, they will walk barefoot and naked, with their buttocks exposed, bringing shame on Egypt.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaɣisi din viɛla, bɛ dimnim ni ti kari doli ba.
en: Israel has turned away from the good; the enemy will pursue him.

dag: Yawɛ, ninvuɣ biɛri yɛn di dari hal ni bɔ saha? Ninvuɣ biɛri yɛn di dari maa hal ni bɔ saha?.
en: How long will the wicked—oh, LORD!— how long will the wicked win?.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ ti liri Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa n-chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi zani Gibia kaman bɛ ni daa pun niŋdi shɛm la.
en: The army of Israel went to fight against the city of Gibeah on the third day. They got ready for battle as they had done before.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti je suli niŋ o, ka zo n-kul o ba yiŋ Bɛtilihɛm Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti niŋ chira anahi nimaani.
en: In an act of unfaithfulness toward him, his secondary wife left him and went back to her fathers household at Bethlehem in Judah. She stayed there four full months.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ. O chɛ ka n naba bemi kaman woliga naba la, ka chɛ ka m be zoya zuɣu chana. Di nyɛla kaman baansi toondana ni zaŋ biŋkumda din mali mihi n-yil li shɛm.
en: The Lord gives me strength. He makes my feet as sure as those of a deer, and he helps me stand on the mountains. To the music director: Use stringed instruments.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sool daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim mini suhudoo sara maligu pina la ti ma na.
en: So Saul ordered, Bring me the entirely burned offering and the well-being sacrifices. Then he offered the entirely burned offering.

dag: Timoti ŋun nyɛ n tumtumdikpee la puhiri ya; ka Lusius mini Jeesɔn ni Sɔsipata bɛn nyɛ n zuliya la gba puhiri ya.
en: Timothy my coworker says hello to you, and Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

dag: O nuhi tuma nyɛla din ʒe yim ka tuhi. O zaligunim zaa mali naani niŋbu.
en: In all he does he is faithful and just; all his commands are dependable.

dag: Izraɛlnim tipawumli ŋmanila naɣisaa tipawumli. Yawɛ ni tooi lan dihi ba kaman piɛbil ni be mɔri pam shee shɛm la?.
en: You are nothing more than a stubborn cow— so stubborn that I, the Lord , cannot feed you like lambs in an open pasture.

dag: Ka o daa teeg o nuu zuɣusaa ha n-tirina gbaai ma n-vooi ma yihi kom pam puuni na.
en: The Lord reached down from above and grabbed me. He pulled me from the deep water.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti sa Ashɛra tia baɣili yi ni ti yɛn me Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sara maligu bimbin shɛl la.
en: When you make an altar for the Lord your God, do not put beside it a wooden symbol of the goddess Asherah.

dag: Yi ni di vi pam, ka pa ni jilima. Yimaŋmaŋ gba nyumiya ka chani ʒiɛhira. Yawɛ nudirigu ni pipia la ni paai ya, ka yi jilima ti leei vi.
en: You in turn will be covered with shame instead of honor. You yourself will drink and stagger. The Lord will make you drink your own cup of punishment, and your honor will be turned to disgrace.

dag: ka o daa chaŋ Ishimail zuliya ni ti kpuɣi Ibrahimma bia Ishimail bipuɣiŋga ŋun yuli daa booni Mahalat ka o tizɔdoo nyɛ Nɛbaiɔt la na ti pah o ni daa pun mali paɣ shɛb maa zuɣu.
en: So he went to Ishmael son of Abraham and married his daughter Mahalath, who was the sister of Nebaioth.

dag: Bɛ ni wum kikaa maa kumsi, ka zaŋ li niŋ bɛ baɣaka zuɣu, bɛ kum zambu ni ʒila bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu. Amaa bɛ yi di deei saɣisigu maa, bɛ naan tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: They heard the trumpet, but they ignored the warning. So they are responsible for their own deaths. If they had paid attention to the warning, they could have saved their own lives.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka o daa bol o nyaandoliba na nti pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ pinaayi m-boli ba tuumba.
en: The next morning he called his followers. He chose twelve of them and called them apostles. These are the ones he chose:.

dag: Ka Piɛbil maa daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ayi, ka n wum ka binnɛɔŋ ŋun pah ayi yɛli, Kamina.
en: Then the Lamb broke open the second seal; and I heard the second living creature say, Come.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa Zin mɔɣu ni zaŋ hal ti paai Rɛhɔb din daa miri Lɛbohamat la.
en: So they went to explore the country. They explored the area from the desert of Zin to Rehob and Lebo Hamath.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, yiɣisima n-chɛ ka a neesim neei; dama a neesim kana. Yawɛ jilima neeg a sani.
en: Jerusalem, get up and shine! Your Light is coming! The Glory of the Lord will shine on you.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa doli yiini yila ka ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnim ni chaɣisanima ni feensi ni dawulɛnim n-wari wahi ni bɛ yaa zaa ni suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni.
en: David and all the Israelites were dancing in front of the Lord and playing all kinds of musical instruments. There were lyres, harps, drums, rattles, instruments made from cypress wood, and cymbals.

dag: hal ka piɛm ti nyɔɣ o gbaag o nyɔri. O ŋmanila noombil so ŋun zɔri chani zana ni ka bi mi ni di nyɛla din yɛn di o nyɛvili.
en: where a hunter waits to shoot an arrow through its heart. The boy was like a bird flying into a net, never seeing the danger he was in.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Darius daa bahi noli, ka bɛ daa vihi luɣ shɛŋa litaafinim ni daa be Babilɔn.
en: Then King Darius made a decree, and they searched the archives where the documents were stored in Babylon.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa yina naŋgban yini. Dan zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zaŋ hal ni Bɛrishiiba zaŋ tabili Giliad. Ka salo maa daa laɣim naŋgban yini Yawɛ tooni Mizipa.
en: Then all the Israelites from Dan to Beer-sheba, as well as from the area of Gilead, marched out, and the group assembled as one body in the LORDs presence at Mizpah.

dag: Wain tihi kuuya; ka fiig tihi vari suui. Ka pumpɔrinchihi tihi mini kpikpal tihi ni apil tihi ni tihi balibu kam zaa kuui. Ka suhupiɛlli din be niriba sani naai.
en: The vines have become dry, and the fig tree is dying. All the trees in the field— the pomegranate, the palm, and the apple—have withered. And happiness among the people has died.

dag: Teemiya Amalɛknim ni daa niŋ ya shɛm yi ni daa yi Ijipti na m-be soli chanila yɛla.
en: Remember, after all, what Amalek did to you on your departure from Egypt.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ piim tinsi bɛ ni deei tiŋgban shɛŋa la ni n-ti Lɛvinim ka bɛ be di ni, ka ti ba biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee tiŋgbana ka di do n-gili tinsi maa.
en: Tell the Israelites that they should give some of the cities in their part of the land to the Levites. The Israelites should give these cities and the pastures around them to the Levites.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii yiɣisi zo yomyom ti nya Mariama mini Yisifu, ka nya biliɛɣu maa ka o do wɔrimɔri piɛɣu ni.
en: They hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and they saw the baby lying on a bed of hay.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Amaa di nyaaŋa n ni ti yɛn lo Izraɛlnim alikauli shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: N ni ti zaŋ n zaligu ti ba, ka sab li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka n ti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ mi nyɛ n niriba.
en: Here is the new agreement that I, the Lord , will make with the people of Israel: I will write my laws on their hearts and minds. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

dag: Di simdi ka o kpuɣila paɣ so ŋun na ʒi doo.
en: He shall marry a virgin.

dag: Naawuni, hal n yi ti kurigi ka n zuɣu paligi, nyin di chɛ ma bahi! Be n sani hal ka n ti zaŋ a yiko min a kpiɔŋ yɛla moli ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna nim zaa sani.
en: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ lɛhu domi gu tihi; dinzuɣu tia kam din bi wandi wal suma, bɛ ni ŋmaa li luhi n-zaŋ nyo buɣim.
en: The ax is now ready to cut down the trees. Every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

dag: O daa zaŋ zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔna ti ba, ka bɛ daa deei niriba maa ni su shɛlikam zaa su.
en: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.

dag: ka yi ti zaŋ li yɛli yi bihi mini yi yaansi n ni daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa tum jɛrilim shɛm, ka n tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I did this because I want you to tell your children and your grandchildren about my miracles and about my harsh treatment of the Egyptians. Then all of you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Naawuni ŋun be o biɛhigu shee din be kasi la nyɛla kpibisi ba, ka nyɛ ŋun gbibi pakoya.
en: God, who lives in his holy palace, is a father to orphans, and he takes care of widows.

dag: Amaa o yidan maa yi bi saɣi li o ni wum li saha shɛli maa, dindina o ni ku o pɔri maa min o noli ni daa faag o ka o yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ni o niŋ shɛl la; ka Yawɛ ni chɛ o taali.
en: But if the husband hears about the promise and refuses to let her keep her promise, the wife does not have to do what she promised. Her husband broke the promise—he did not let her do what she said. So the Lord will forgive her.

dag: O ni gbilisiri tibili wumdi n suhigu zuɣu, n kul ni suhir o hal ni n nyɛvil tariga.
en: Yes, he paid attention to me, so I will always call to him whenever I need help.

dag: Chɛ ka ʒiŋmariba bɛn tɔɣisiri ʒeensi yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ wuntizɔriba polo mini karimbaannim bɛn ʒiɛmdi bɛ taba la fo.
en: Silence those liars— all the proud and arrogant who speak with contempt about the righteous.

dag: Ti Duuma, a kurimbuni ha yurilim maŋli din nyɛ a ni daa po a ʒiɛyimtali puuni n-yɛli Dauda shɛli yɛla la lee be ya?.
en: Lord, where is the love you showed in the past? You promised David that you would be loyal to his family.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, Niriba maa ku tooi du Sinai Zoli ŋɔ na, dama nyin maŋmaŋ daa yɛli ti ni m beemi chɛriga gil li, ka mal li ka di be kasi.
en: Moses said to the LORD, The people arent allowed to come up on Mount Sinai because you warned us and said, Set up a fence around the mountain to keep it holy.

dag: So bi lan teeri bɛ yɛla dunia ni, ka bɛ yuya lan ka solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: They are gone and forgotten.

dag: Ka nanim maa zaa mini bɛ tɔbbihi daa laɣim kana ti dɔni Mɛrom kulibɔŋ ni ni bɛ tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: All these kings met together at the small river of Merom. They joined their armies together into one camp and made plans for the battle against Israel.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yi nimaani zo n-chaŋ Adulam vokabili ni, ka o biɛyanim min o ba yiŋnim zaa daa ti wum o yɛla nimaani ka kahi chaŋ o sani.
en: When David escaped from the town of Gath, he went to Adullam Cave. His brothers and the rest of his family found out where he was, and they followed him there.

dag: ka yi niɣi mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu nabi, ka yi daazinfa mini yi salima nabi, ka yi binshɛɣukam nabi.
en: Your cattle, sheep, and goats will grow large. You will get plenty of gold and silver. You will have plenty of everything.

dag: Ti Duuma zal o zaligu, ka paɣiba pam zaŋ di lahibali moli gili;.
en: The Lord gave the command, and many women carried the news:.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn yi tindul na ni ti tuhi deei Fɔnisia tiŋgbɔŋ n-zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo hal ni Zarɛfat su. Ka Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn nyɛ Jɛrusalɛmnim ka yi tindul na nti be Saadis la mi ti tuhi deei Nɛgɛb tinsi su.
en: People from Israel were forced to leave their homes, but they will take back the land of Canaan, all the way to Zarephath. People from Judah were forced to leave Jerusalem and live in Sepharad. But they will take back the cities of the Negev.

dag: Ka bɛ daa she bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima niŋ binyɛribila maa naŋgbambiya.
en: They made the shoulder pieces for the ephod. They tied these shoulder pieces to the two corners of the ephod.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa ti kpi, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣimna ti kum o kuli, ka sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ yiŋa Rama. Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ Paran mɔɣu ni.
en: Samuel died, and all the Israelites came together and mourned for him. Then they buried him at his home in Ramah. After this, David went to the wilderness of Paran.

dag: Ka Anabi Musa daa bɔhim Ijiptinim maa baŋsim n-leei ninvuɣ titali o yɛtɔɣa min o tuma ni.
en: Moses learned everything Egyptian wisdom had to offer, and he was a man of powerful words and deeds.

dag: Babilɔn wuna bahigu m-bɔŋɔ! Bɛl mini Nɛbo daa nyɛla bɛ ni jɛmdi wun shɛŋa. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ bɛ zaŋ li ʒilila bunsi; ka di nyɛ ʒi shɛŋa din chɛ ka di wum bunsi maa.
en: Bel crouches down; Nebo cowers. Their idols sit on animals, on beasts. The objects you once carried about are now borne as burdens by the weary animals.

dag: Ŋunkam gbi bɔɣili ni lu di ni, ka ŋunkam mi chibi gooni voli, wahu ni dim o.
en: If you dig a pit, you fall in it; if you break through a wall, a snake bites you.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, a tɛhiya ni Yawɛ ʒila n ni kana ni n ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yɛla? Yawɛ n-yɛli ma ni n kamina ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: Whats more, do you think Ive marched against this place to destroy it without the LORDs support? It was the LORD who told me, March against this land and destroy it.

dag: O nam dibu yuma awɛi ni gol so ŋun pahiri pia biɛɣu pia dali, ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ o tɔbbihi zaa kana ti liri Jɛrusalɛmnima. Bɛ daa teemi gil li, ka me bindura gil li ti tuui.
en: In Zedekiah's ninth year as king, on the tenth day of the tenth month, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia led his entire army to attack Jerusalem. The troops set up camp outside the city and built ramps up to the city walls.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahiri daba anii dali, ŋun bom ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi n-chaŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni ti ti maligumaana.
en: Then on the eighth day, she must bring two doves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance of the Meeting Tent.

dag: bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba ni azichilaannim ni faranim zaa, wummiya!.
en: people of every kind, rich and poor alike!.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi lu Ijiptinim zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti ku niriba Ijipti ka va bɛ daazichi chaŋ, ka daai di tanzahi luhi. Biɛrim pam ni ti be Itiɔpia.
en: A sword will come into Egypt, and trembling will overcome Cush, when the slain fall in Egypt, its wealth carried away, and its foundations razed.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka a yɛligu nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, ka a lo a dabili bin suŋ ŋɔ.
en: Lord All-Powerful, you are God. You have promised me some very good things, and you can be trusted to do what you promise.

dag: Ka bi shɛb a ni yɛn dɔɣi ka bɛ doli bɛ nyaaŋa n-yɛn nyɛ a bihi. Bɛ biɛyanim maa yuya ka bɛ ti yɛn zaŋ nya bɛ tarili.
en: Any children you have later will be considered yours, but their inheritance will come from Ephraim and Manasseh.

dag: Di ni chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee? Ti zaa ti yɛn laɣimmi kpi.
en: Hope will not go with me when I go down to the world of the dead.

dag: Ka farigudeeriba gba daa kana ni bɛ ti deei baptaizibu ka bɔh o, Karimba, ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: When tax collectors came to be baptized, they asked John, Teacher, what should we do.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, So bi mi dindali bee di saha, hal malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni mini Naawuni Bia la gba bi mi li; faashee o Ba maa kɔŋko n-naɣ mi li.
en: No one knows when that day or time will be. The Son and the angels in heaven dont know when it will be. Only the Father knows.

dag: Ka Judanim zaa suhuri daa paligi bɛ pɔri maa zuɣu, dama bɛ daa pola pɔri maa ni bɛ suhuri zaa, ka suhi Naawuni bɛ ni bɔr shɛli zaa, ka Naawuni daa deei bɛ suhigu maa, ka ŋun Yawɛ daa ti ba vuhim luɣilikam zaa.
en: All the people of Judah were happy because they had made this covenant with all their heart. They took delight in worshiping the Lord , and he accepted them and gave them peace on every side.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun zɔr a nambɔɣu la yɛliya, Zoya mini kunkuna ni vuui, amaa n yurilim din bi naari la ku vuui ka chɛ a; ka n suhudoo alikauli la gba ku vuug a sani.
en: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla Mɛmfisinim mini Tapanhɛsinim ŋme ŋ-ŋma yi zuɣuŋmana.
en: Yes, the people of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked his skull.

dag: Amaa nyini n tiligi ti ti dimnim nuu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛn je ti la birim.
en: You are the one who saved us from our enemies. You are the one who put our enemies to shame.

dag: N daa yi chaŋ tiŋ puuni dunɔdali gbini nti zaŋ n kuɣ zali laɣiŋgu ni.
en: When I went out to the city gate, took my seat in the square.

dag: Damli dambu zooya n-leei ninvuɣ biɛtali jaaŋgbee. Bɛ ni so ku kpalim, bɛ ninvuɣ gbaliŋ maa zaa mini bɛ daazichi ni bɛ jilima ku kpalim.
en: This violent man is ready to punish the evil people. There are many people in Israel—but he is not one of them. He is not a person in that crowd. He is not some important leader from them.

dag: Di saha ka Reehab daa zaŋ mii tir o yiŋ maa takɔro ni n-chɛ ka tuumba maa dol li yi tiŋ maa ni, dama o yiŋ maa daa me n-tabilila tiŋ maa gooni.
en: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Reehab ŋun daa nyɛ pagɔrili la daa bi pahi tipawumlinim zuɣu bahi yoli, o ni daa deei ninvuɣ puɣisiriba la ni suhupiɛlli la zuɣu.
en: By faith Rahab the prostitute wasnt killed with the disobedient because she welcomed the spies in peace.

dag: Di di bi simdi ni a gba zo a kpee maa nambɔɣu kaman n ni daa zo a nambɔɣu shɛm maa.
en: Don't you think you should show pity to someone else, as I did to you.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna min o bidibisi maa ni Izraɛlnim zaa lala.
en: So Moses told these things to Aaron, Aarons sons, and all the Israelites.

dag: Di saha maa ka Judanim zaa daa zaŋ bɛ bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini din daa nyɛ kawana mini wain palli ni kpa viɛlli na ti niŋdi Naawuni jɛmbu duu nɛma duri maa ni.
en: Then all the people of Israel again started bringing to the Temple storerooms their tithes of grain, wine, and olive oil.

dag: Yi kpalim malila yi buɣ so ŋun yuli booni Molok la suɣili mini yi buɣ so ŋun gba yuli booni Rɛfan, ka o nyɛ saŋmariga kɔtomsi ka nyɛ yi ni daa me shɛŋa n-zali ni yi jɛmdi la. Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ ya ti bahi Babilɔn tooni ha.
en: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.

dag: Yi yi saɣi li, ka deei n noli, yi ni di tiŋgbani ŋɔ bin suma anfaani.
en: If you listen to what I say, you will get the good things from this land.

dag: Yi mi ni yi ni daa nyɛ chɛfirinim saha shɛl la, buɣa din ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa n-daa sun ya ka birigi ya.
en: You know that when you were Gentiles you were often misled by false gods that cant even speak.

dag: ka din pahi pinaanu gbaai Biliga, ka din pahi pinaayɔbu gbaai Imɛr.
en: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer.

dag: So yi zaŋ o yili ti Yawɛ ka di leei zaɣ kasi, maligumaana n-ni zali di daa ni nyɛ shɛm, maligumaana maa ni zali di daa ka di doli di ni viɛl shɛm bee di ni bi viɛl shɛm, ka maligumaana maa ni zali di daa shɛm, lala n-yɛn nyɛ li.
en: If you dedicate your house as holy to the Lord , the priest must decide its price. It doesnt make any difference if the house is good or bad. If the priest decides on a price, that is the price for the house.

dag: Diimas ni yuri dunia ŋɔ la zuɣu, o zoya chaŋ Tɛsalɔnaika ka chɛ ma; Krɛshɛnsi chaŋ Galɛshia, ka Taitus mi chaŋ Dalimatia.
en: Demas loved this world too much. That is why he left me. He went to Thessalonica. Crescens went to Galatia. And Titus went to Dalmatia.

dag: Hadɔram ni Uzal ni Dikila ni.
en: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah.

dag: Wula ka ninvuɣ yino ni tooi kari doli ninvuɣ tuhili ka niriba ayi mi tuhi nyaŋ ninvuɣ tuhi pia, ka pa ni bɛ Tampiŋ n-kɔhi ba? Ka pa ni Yawɛ n-zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ nuu ni?.
en: How could one enemy soldier chase a thousand of Israel's troops? Or how could two of theirs pursue ten thousand of ours? It can only happen if the Lord stops protecting Israel and lets the enemy win.

dag: Di saha ka Zɛbidii paɣa daa zaŋ o bih ayi kana ti gbani Yisa tooni n-suhir o binshɛli.
en: Then the mother of Zebedees sons came to Jesus along with her sons. Bowing before him, she asked a favor of him.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ chamiya ti bom mɔri yi n-ni nya li luɣ shɛli na, amaa yi tuma bi yɛn filim hal biɛla gba. .
en: You must go and get the straw for yourselves. So go and find straw, but you must still make as many bricks as you made before.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ti ni ti yihim waazu ti niriba, ka wuhi ba ni ŋuna ka Naawuni zaŋ leei nyɛvilinim mini kpiimba zaa sariakarita.
en: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that he is the one whom God appointed as judge of the living and the dead.

dag: Ka Javan bidibisi daa nyɛ: Ɛlisha mini Tarishish ni Kitim ni Dɔdanim.
en: Javans sons were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba ni suhupiɛlli m-mali hal ti kpɛhi nayili maa.
en: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.

dag: Naawuni, a zaɣisi ti mi? A bi lan zaŋdi ti tɔbbihi chani tɔbu ni?.
en: But you have rejected us, God, havent you? You, God, no longer accompany our armies.

dag: O nam sagbana niŋ zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka saa luri tiŋgban ni na, ka chɛ ka mɔri zoori zoya zuɣu.
en: God covers the skies with clouds; God makes rain for the earth; God makes the mountains sprout green grass.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Manɔa, N ni daa yɛli paɣ maa shɛlikam zaa la, di simdi ni o dol li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The LORDs messenger answered Manoah, The woman should be careful to do everything that I told her.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa mali kpamba bɛn daa ʒiin o ba Sulemaana tooni o ni daa na be o nyɛvili ni saha shɛl la saawara ka bɔhi ba, Yi lee tɛhiya ni di simdi ni n yɛli niriba ŋɔ wula.
en: There were some older men who had helped Solomon make decisions when he was alive. So King Rehoboam asked these men what he should do. He said, How do you think I should answer the people.

dag: Ka o daa lan bɔhi ba, Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ bihi banim ŋɔ, ŋun bia n-lee ni suh o bɔrɔbɔro ka o zaŋ kuɣili ti o bee n-suh o zahim, ka o gbaai wahu ti o.
en: Would any of you who are fathers give your son a snake when he asks for fish?.

dag: Amaa nyin ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir ŋɔ, gbaam amaŋ ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, ka kpaŋ amaŋa m-malila biɛr kasi mini wuntitali ni yɛda ni yurilim ni ania niŋbu ni biɛribaalimtali.
en: But as for you, man of God, run away from all these things. Instead, pursue righteousness, holy living, faithfulness, love, endurance, and gentleness.

dag: A ni ti zaŋla ninsal bindi mali buɣim n-she chi bɔrɔbɔro maa ŋ-ŋub li bɛ ninni.
en: You must make your bread each day. You must get dry human dung and burn it. Then you must cook the bread over this burning dung. You must eat this bread in front of the people.

dag: Ka bɛn pa Yisa nyaandoliba daa ka suhukpeeni din ni zaŋ bɛmaŋ gari bɛ ni, amaa ka daa lee tiri ba jilima pam.
en: None of the other people dared to stand with the apostles, but everyone was saying wonderful things about them.

dag: N yaannim ni daa ku tiŋ shɛŋa ninvuɣ shɛb zaa la, buɣ dini n-daa lee tooi fa di niriba n nuu ni, ka yinim Naawuni ni ti tooi tiligi ya n nuu ni?.
en: My ancestors destroyed those countries. There is no god that can stop me from destroying his people. So you think your god can save you from me?.

dag: A deeg o nam jaaŋgbee o nuu ni, ka daag o nam luhi.
en: You have taken away his royal scepter and knocked his throne to the ground.

dag: O ŋmanila jɛŋgbini n-doya gu ma, ka ŋmani gbuɣinli ŋun sɔɣi doya gu.
en: He is a bear lurking for me, a lion in hiding.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn zaɣisi ma, ka tam n zoli din be kasi la yɛla, ka puhiri churi ka jɛmdi zuɣusuŋ wuna la.
en: But you people left the Lord , so you will be punished. You forgot about my holy mountain. You began to worship Luck. You held feasts for the false god, Fate.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa kahigi ashili maa gbinni wuhi Daniɛl ʒii nyabu puuni yuŋ. Ka Daniɛl daa paɣi Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yɛli:.
en: Then, in a vision by night, the mystery was revealed to Daniel! Daniel praised the God of heaven.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Keen daa ti yɛl o tizo Ɛbɛl, Ti cham mɔɣu ni. Bɛ ni daa ti be mɔɣu maa ni saha shɛli, ka Keen yiɣisi lu o tizo Ɛbɛl maa zuɣu n-ku o.
en: Cain said to his brother Abel, Let's go for a walk. And when they were out in a field, Cain attacked and killed him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn bɛ suɣa wulimpuhili polo kaman di ni simdi ni bɛ ʒiishee nyɛ luɣ shɛli n-nyɛ: Juda zuliya. Juda niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Aminadab bia Nashɔn.
en: Judah and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the east side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The , troops of the tribe of Judah will be arranged by divisions and led by Nahshon son of Amminadab.

dag: N yura, kamina ka ti yi kpaŋa nti gbɛri tiŋkpansi.
en: Come, my love: Lets go out to the field and rest all night among the flowering henna.

dag: Ɛzɛr bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bilihan mini Zaavan ni Jaakan. Dishan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Uzi mini Aran.
en: Ezer was the father of Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. Dishan was the father of Uz and Aran.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi mali yi yaa nyuri bara? Yinim bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, yi yaa naarimi maa. Yi niŋ yi daazichi naani ka yɛra, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi liri ti.
en: You rebellious Ammonites trust your wealth and ask, Who could attack us? But I warn you not to boast when your strength is fading.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ti bol o ba Ibrahimma, M ba! Ka o garigi yɛli, M bia, n-nyɛ ma. Ka o bɔh o, Buɣim mini dari m-bɔŋɔ, ka piɛ so ti ni ti yɛn zaŋ mali sara maa lee be ya.
en: Isaac spoke up, Father! He answered, Yes, my son? Isaac asked, I see that you have the coals and the wood, but where is the lamb for the sacrifice.

dag: Di ni daa tiɣ o nini ni o kahig o Bia wuhi ma ka di chɛ ka n yih o yɛla waazu ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianim la, n daa bi niŋ so saawara.
en: to reveal his Son to me, so that I might preach about him to the Gentiles. I didnt immediately consult with any human being.

dag: Amaa ti paɣiri Naawuni yinim bɛn daa nyɛ alahichi daba la ni doli wuhibu shɛli yi ni daa deei ni yi suhuri zaa la zuɣu.
en: But thank God that although you used to be slaves of sin, you gave wholehearted obedience to the teaching that was handed down to you, which provides a pattern.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋumdimi kaman gbuɣima la, ka ŋumdi kaman gbuɣimbihi la.
en: The Babylonians all roar like lions and growl like lion cubs.

dag: Ti wuhiri ni nir yiri taali ni Naawuni san la yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka pa ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu.
en: I mean we are made right with God through faith, not through what we have done to follow the law. This is what we believe.

dag: Yi ni shɛb kpɛla yimaŋ duhibu ni, dama yi tɛhimi ni n ku lan ka yi sanna.
en: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa ti wum ni Jɛrɔbɔam kuna, ka bɛ daa laɣim ka tim ti bol o na nti zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa. Dinzuɣu Juda zuliya niriba la kɔŋko n-daa doli Dauda yilinim maa, amaa ka bɛn kpalim la zaa daa zaɣisi ba dolibu.
en: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent for him. They called him to the assembly and crowned him king of all Israel. Nothing was left to the house of David except the tribe of Judah.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi Firawuna sani labira, ka bɛ nya Musa mini Aduna ka bɛ ʒiɛya guhiri ba.
en: After they left the king, they went to see Moses and Aaron, who had been waiting for them.

dag: Musa daa zaŋla o paɣa Zipɔra labisi ka o deemba Jɛtro daa deeg o min o bidibis ayi la ʒili.
en: So he came to Moses, bringing with him Moses' wife Zipporah, who had been left behind.

dag: Ka daa lan zaŋ Giliad hal ni Arinɔn kulibɔŋ ni n-ti Rubin zuliya niriba mini Gaad zuliya niriba, ka kulibɔŋ maa sunsuuni nyɛ bɛ tintariga vulo zaŋ ti du Jabok, kulibɔŋ maa ni n-daa nyɛ Ammɔnnim tintariga.
en: And to the tribe of Reuben and the tribe of Gad, I gave the land that begins at Gilead and goes from the Arnon Valley to the Jabbok River. The middle of the valley is one border. The Jabbok River is the border for the Ammonites.

dag: Ka bipuɣin kpɛm daa ti yɛli biasani, Ti ba kurigiya, ka dɔbba mi ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni n-ni kpuɣi ti kaman bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm dunia ŋɔ zaa ni la.
en: The older daughter said to the younger, Our father is old, and there are no men in the land to sleep with us as is the custom everywhere.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ daanya m-mali binkpila ayi n-zaŋ tam daanya daantalis ayi maa zuɣusaa, ka binkpila maa zaɣ yini dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla.
en: For the top of each column, he also made a bronze cap just over two meters high.

dag: Di saha ka n daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yawɛ, n suhir a, tiligim ma!.
en: Then I called on the Lord s name. I said, Lord , save me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Nyama, M pun piligi zaŋdi Sihɔn min o tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiri ya, piligimiya o tiŋgbɔŋ maa deebu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: The LORD said to me: Look! Right now Im laying Sihon and his land before you. Its time to take possession of his land!.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka Jafɛt tɔŋ! Naawuni chɛ ka o zuliya mini Shɛm zuliya laɣim be; ka chɛ ka Keenan nyɛ o dabili.
en: May God give space to Japheth; he will live in Shems tents, and Canaan will be his servant.

dag: yin doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: you must carefully obey all the laws and rules I give you today.

dag: Ka Pool daa yɛl o, Naawuni ni ŋme nyin dukpin piɛlli ŋɔ! A ʒinimi ni a kari ma saria kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka ti yaɣi zaligu maa zuɣu yɛli ni bɛ ŋmɛm ma.
en: Then Paul said to him, God is about to strike you, you whitewashed wall! You sit and judge me according to the Law, yet disobey the Law by ordering that I be struck.

dag: Di takɔriti mini di zɔntua ni di abie tihi kɔtomsi daa bemi kaman dunɔdali din be wulimpuhili polo la dina ni daa be shɛm. Di daa malila dunɔdura ayopɔin zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali maa gbini, ka di zɔŋ be di puuni.
en: and the windows, the entrance room, and the carvings of palm trees were just like those in the east gate. The entrance room also faced the courtyard of the temple and had seven steps leading up to it.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka yi o daalikauli la nyaaŋa zaŋ tabili Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa zali ba zaligu shɛŋa la zaa zuɣu. Bɛ daa zaɣisi li wumbu, ka zaɣisi li dolibu.
en: All of that happened because the people of Israel had not obeyed the Lord their God. They rejected the solemn agreement he had made with them, and they ignored everything that the Lord 's servant Moses had told them.

dag: Yuria paɣa Batishiiba ni daa wum ni o yidan kpiya, o daa kum o zuɣu.
en: When Bathsheba heard that her husband was dead, she mourned for him.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa nyɛla bɛn tumdi naa tuma m-pah o ni daa zaŋ tɔbbi shɛb ʒil o ni daa me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa Juda tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni la zuɣu.
en: All these soldiers served King Jehoshaphat. The king also had other men in the fortresses in all the country of Judah.

dag: Jɔtam daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Uzia ni daa tum shɛm; ŋun daa lee bi ŋmɛla nyɔɣu kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu. Amaa niriba maa daa na kul tumdila tuumbiɛri.
en: He did what was pleasing to the Lord , just as his father had done; but unlike his father he did not sin by burning incense in the Temple. The people, however, went on sinning.

dag: So ni tooi fa tɔbbihi ni tuhi tɔbu di binshɛŋa bɛ sani bee n-fa daba na biɛɣu nuu ni?.
en: Is it possible to rescue victims from someone strong and cruel?.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli Yisifu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Ifriim mini Manaasa niriba maa, Yi shiri galisiya pam, ka mali kpiɔŋ; ka di simdi ni yi mali tiŋgbani yaɣ bɔbili.
en: Joshua then said to the house of Joseph, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, You are a numerous people and possess great strength. You will have more than a single lot.

dag: Niriba pam bɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be zaashe kara ni, ka ŋun tiri pini nyɛla sokam zo.
en: Many seek favor from rulers; everyone befriends a gift giver.

dag: N kul gbibi n yurilim maŋli zaŋ chaŋ o sani sahakam, ka gbibi m min o daalikauli viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.

dag: A soli daa timla teeku ni gari, ka a sɔbil mi tim ko titaŋa ni gari, amaa ka so daa bi nya ka a napom bɔba doya.
