en: Your way went straight through the sea; your pathways went right through the mighty waters. But your footprints left no trace!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa deeg o mini Bashan naa Ogi bɛn daa nyɛ Amɔrinim nanim ayi bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo maa tiŋgbɔna ʒini.
en: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River.

dag: Ka o daa zaɣisi ka yɛli, N ku di. Amaa ka o tumtumdiba la mini paɣ maa daa kpaŋ bɛmaŋa m-balim o hal ka o ti saɣi, ka daa yiɣisi tiŋa n-ʒini garo zuɣu.
en: But Saul refused. He said, I wont eat. Sauls officers joined the woman and begged him to eat. Finally, Saul listened to them. He got up from the ground and sat on the bed.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ti Sinai, Yi be zoli ŋɔ zuɣu ka di yuui saɣi lala.
en: When we were at Mount Sinai, the Lord our God said to us, You have stayed long enough at this mountain.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti chana, di yuma ayi nyaaŋa gol so ŋun pahir ayi dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni Sinai mɔɣu ni.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses in the Sinai desert in the meeting tent on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they left the land of Egypt.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, N suhir a, di chɛ ti, dama nyini m-mi ti ni yɛn dooni luɣ shɛli mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, leemi ti sowuhira.
en: Then Moses said, Please dont leave us. You know more about the desert than we do. You can be our guide.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa garigi yɛli Adɔnija, Aai, dama ti dan Naa Dauda zaŋ Sulemaana leei naa;.
en: Jonathan answered: No, I don't! David has just announced that Solomon will be king.

dag: Di nyaaŋa, ka a chɛ ka bɛ bo naɣilabila mini sara maligu zim viɛlli shɛli bɛ ni niŋ kpam ŋmiri, ka a mi bo naɣilabil so bɛ ni zaŋdi maani alahichi sanyoo sara la.
en: Then they are to take a young bull and the required grain offering of flour mixed with olive oil; and you are to take another bull for the sin offering.

dag: Hal ka wuhiri li buri ni mini duu kpɛhibu ni ni muɣisigu nyabu duŋtaariba nuu ni ni tuun kpɛma tumbu ni ni gɔgaliga ni ni kumkpibo puuni.
en: We are beaten and thrown into prison. People get upset at us and fight against us. We work hard, and sometimes we get no sleep or food.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ yi ti puhina, bɛ zɔrimi ti kpe bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: But when morning comes, they return to their dens.

dag: ni Buki ni Uzi ni Zɛrahia.
en: his son Bukki, his son Uzzi, his son Zerahiah.

dag: Yiŋbia maa yiŋlan maa yi ti kuna nya o ni lala, o ni nya suhupiɛlli.
en: How happy that servant is if his master finds him doing this when he comes home!.

dag: O nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun wumdi Naawuni yɛtɔɣa, ka mali baŋsim shɛli din yiri Zallakudura Naa sanna. O nyɛla ŋun nyari Kpiɔŋlan Naa ʒii. O luya, amaa ka bi pɔb o nina.
en: I heard this message from God. I learned what God Most High taught me. I saw what God All-Powerful showed me. I humbly tell what I clearly see.

dag: Yinim Yawɛ daba bɛn ʒe o jɛmbu duu yuŋ ŋɔ, paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Praise the Lord , all his servants who serve in the Temple at night.

dag: O ni daa di nam yuun shɛli maa goli so ŋun daŋ tooni puuni ka o daa kparigi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la dunoya n-chɛ ka bɛ malimali di zaa.
en: In the first month of the year after Hezekiah became king, he reopened the gates of the Temple and had them repaired.

dag: N ni daa kul tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa saha shɛli maa, ka Bɛnaaya bia Pɛlatia daa kpi. Di saha ka n daa lu tiŋa n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa, ka kuhi pam yɛli, Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a yɛn bahi naala Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ŋɔ.
en: While I was prophesying, Benaiahs son Pelatiah dropped dead. I fell on my face, and I wailed and said, Oh, LORD God! Are you finishing off even the Israelites who are left.

dag: Ti ni yɛri shɛli maa yɛlikpani m-bɔŋɔ: Ti mali maligumaani titali ŋɔ tatabo ka o ʒi Naawuni Zallakudura Naa nam ʒiishee nudirigu polo alizanda ni.
en: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.

dag: Ka naa yɛli, Pirigimiya bi nɛɔŋ maa buyi n-zaŋ o pirigili ti yino, ka zaŋ o pirigili din la n-ti ŋun la mi.
en: he said, Cut the living child in two and give each woman half of it.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Zaŋmiya yi yɛtɔɣa na, ka zaŋ yi ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni yi yɛli zaŋ chaŋ di polo na.
en: Present your case, says the LORD. Bring forward your evidence, says Jacobs king.

dag: Ka bɛnkam nyɛ Yisa Masia ni su shɛba pun zaŋ bɛ niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu mini di kɔre ni di yubu zaa n-kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o mabia paɣ dɔni, dama o nyɛla o mabia maa paɣa.
en: or sister-in-law.

dag: ni Hɛshibɔn zaŋ hal ti paai Ramatimizipa mini Bɛtɔnim ni zaŋ hal ti paai Mahanaim zaŋ chaŋ Dɛbir tintariga.
en: their land extended from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh and Betonim, from Mahanaim to the border of Lodebar.

dag: Ka Leeban daa yɛli Yaakubu, Bipuɣinsi ŋɔ nyɛla m bipuɣinsi, ka bihi ŋɔ nyɛ m bihi, ka biŋkɔbiri ŋɔ nyɛ m biŋkɔbiri; ka a ni nya binshɛɣukam zaa kpe ŋɔ nyɛla n dini. Amaa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ wula ka n yɛn niŋ m bipuɣinsi ŋɔ mini bɛ ni dɔɣi bi shɛb ŋɔ?.
en: Laban responded and told Jacob, The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, and the flocks are my flocks. Everything you see is mine. But what can I do now about my daughters and about their sons?.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, niŋmiya Yawɛ naani! Ŋuna n-nyɛ yi sɔŋda ni ŋun guli ya.
en: People of Israel, trust in the Lord ! He is your strength and shield.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa nyɛla nachimbil so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ, ka Sulemaana daa kpahim nya o ni nyɛ tumtumdi biiŋa maa, ka zaŋ o leei Yisifu zuliya niriba tuun kpɛma zaa zuɣulana.
en: Jeroboam was a free man. Solomon saw that this young man was a skilled worker, so he made him the supervisor over all the workers from the tribes that descended from Joseph.

dag: Ka naa maa suhu daa paligi ti yaɣi, ka o bahi noli ni bɛ yihim Daniɛl bɔɣili maa ni na. Ka bɛ daa voog o yihi na n-nya ka o bi nya daŋa hal baabiɛla gba, o ni daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda zuɣu.
en: The king was overjoyed and gave orders for Daniel to be pulled up out of the pit. So they pulled him up and saw that he had not been hurt at all, for he trusted God.

dag: Musa daa sabi bɛ ni daa piligiri chandi luɣ shɛŋa maa yiniyini yuya sɔŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm. Bɛ ni daa piligiri chandi luɣ shɛŋa maa yiniyini ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Moses recorded the points of departure for each stage of the march at the LORDs command. These are the stages of their march according to their points of departure.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ, teemiya dimbɔŋɔ; yi nyɛla n-daba. Mani n-nam ya ni yi nyɛ n daba. N ku tam yi yɛla.
en: The Lord says, Israel, remember this; remember that you are my servant. I created you to be my servant, and I will never forget you.

dag: dama yi yi gbihira, o ni ti paana libigi ya.
en: If you are always ready, he will not find you sleeping, even if he comes back earlier than expected.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna ti yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ n tum taali; Yawɛ mali yɛlimaŋli, m mini n niriba ŋɔ galimya.
en: Pharaoh sent for Moses and Aaron and told them, This time I have sinned. The Lord is right, and I and my people are wrong.

dag: Zɛbulɔn tiŋgbani mini Naftali tiŋgbani din be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi teeku polo, ka nyɛ tiŋgban shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Galili chɛfirinim tinsi la.
en: Listen, land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, lands by the road that goes to the sea, the area past the Jordan River— Galilee, where those from other nations live.

dag: Maika bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pitɔn mini Mɛlɛk ni Taria ni Ahaz.
en: Micahs sons were Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

dag: Mɛmiya yiya m-be di ni, ka kɔnya puri n-diri di bindira.
en: Build houses and settle down. Plant gardens and eat what you grow in them.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Ammɔnnim polo tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi ba.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the people of Ammon.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbani daa sɔhigi ka dam; ka zuɣusaa tanzahi daa sɔhigi ka dam o suhuyiɣisili zuɣu.
en: The earth shook and shivered. The foundations of heaven trembled. They shook because he was angry!.

dag: Maligumaaniba n-daa nyɛ: Joyarib bia Jɛdaya mini Jachin.
en: These are the priests who moved into Jerusalem: Jedaiah son of Joiarib, Jakin.

dag: O chɛ ka bɛ mini nanim ʒiina, nanim bɛn nyɛ o niriba nanima.
en: and makes them companions of princes, the princes of his people.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa, Kalimiya niriba maa n-nya ninvuɣ banima n-lee yi ti ni chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa kali ba n-nya ka Jɔnatan min o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa n-kani.
en: Saul said to the army with him, Count the men. I want to know who left camp. They counted the men. Jonathan and his helper were gone.

dag: ka yɛl o kpambaliba, Jɔn Baptaizira la n-ni bala; ŋuna n-lan neei kum ni na maa, dinzuɣu ka o mali yiko n-tumdi tuun kara ŋɔ.
en: He said to his servants, This is John the Baptist. Hes been raised from the dead. This is why these miraculous powers are at work through him.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba daa kpɛhi Juda zuliya niriba maa dabiɛm, ka gbarigi ba zaŋ chaŋ mɛbu maa polo.
en: Then the people who had been living in the land tried to discourage and frighten the Jews and keep them from building.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa bɔh o, Ka ya polo ka ti lee yɛn doli chaŋ ti tuhi ba? Ka Jɛhɔram garigi yɛl o, Ti yɛn dolila Ɛdom yɔɣu polo chaŋ.
en: But which way should we go? We will march through Edom Desert, Joram replied.

dag: Ibram daa zaŋla o paɣ Zarai min o tizo Haran bia Lɔt, ka bɛ daa laɣim bɛ ni mali binshɛlikam zaa zaŋ tabili bɛ ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb Haran tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-yiɣisi kuli Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ ni daa paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Abram took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, all of their possessions, and those who became members of their household in Haran; and they set out for the land of Canaan. When they arrived in Canaan.

dag: Dapaɣili kam daa malila dashɛbira ayi din ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li tuɣi taba. Bɛ daa niŋla Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili dapaɣa maa zaa lala.
en: with two matching projections, so that the frames could be joined together. All the frames had these projections.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yihi fɔntins ayi Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili la tiŋgban ni. Dina n-nyɛ: Taanak mini Gatirimɔn ni di zaa ha biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: From half the tribe of Manasseh: Taanach and its pastures, and Gath-rimmon and its pastures; in total: two cities.

dag: Ka din daa lu gɔhi ni la mi ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu, ka ŋmaligi chaŋ ha ka dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda mini azichi yubo ni kɔre balibu kam chɛ ka di bi dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim.
en: The seeds that fell among the thornbushes are also people who hear the message. But they are so eager for riches and pleasures that they never produce anything.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli wahu, A ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni yɛli noli ti a n-gari yiŋ biŋkɔbiri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa; a ni nyɛritila a puli zuɣu, ka diri taŋkpaɣu hal ni a nyɛvil tariga.
en: Then the Lord God said to the snake, You will be punished for this; you alone of all the animals must bear this curse: From now on you will crawl on your belly, and you will have to eat dust as long as you live.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ timmi laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa mini Baal anabinim kɔbisinahi ni pihinu ni Ashɛra anabinim kɔbisinahi bɛn diri Jɛzibɛl yiŋ la n-zaŋ ba ka n sanna Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu.
en: Now order all the people of Israel to meet me at Mount Carmel. Bring along the prophets of Baal and the prophets of the goddess Asherah who are supported by Queen Jezebel.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti nya a ni tirisi labi nyaaŋa ka chɛ a ka yɛli, Ninive bahi yoli, ŋuni n-lee yɛn fabili di zuɣu? Ya polo ka n lee yɛn nya bɛn ni maag a suhu ti a? .
en: Everyone who sees you will be shocked. They will say, Nineveh is destroyed. Who will cry for her? I know I cannot find anyone to comfort you, Nineveh.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa bela sarika ni, ka wum Yisa Masia tuma yɛla, ka daa tim o nyaandoliba.
en: When John the Baptist heard in prison about the things that Christ was doing, he sent some of his disciples to him.

dag: Di saha Zɛba mini Zalimuna ni bɛ tɔbbihi daa bela Karikɔr. Wulimpuhili polɔnim maa tɔbbihi bɛn daa kpalim kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tuhi pinaanu, dama bɛ daa pun ku bɛ ni ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pisi bɛn daa gbib takɔbiri la.
en: Zebah and Zalmunna and their army were in the city of Karkor. Their army had , soldiers in it. These soldiers were all who were left of the army of the people of the east. , strong soldiers of that army had already been killed.

dag: Tɔbutuhiriba bɛn daa be niriba maa ni zaa ni daa ti kpi n-naai saha shɛli.
en: After they had all died.

dag: N nyari suhupiɛlli a zaligunim maa dolibu ni, dama n yuri li pam.
en: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.

dag: yɛli, Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ niriba ŋɔ? Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ tum alahiziba tuun karili ka Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa nya li, ka ti ku tooi chihi li.
en: They said, What shall we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about the miracle they did as a sign from God. Its too obvious. We cant say it didnt happen.

dag: dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa baɣisi Misia gari chaŋ Troas.
en: So they traveled right on through Mysia and went to Troas.

dag: Jaande chɛ ka n labi n ya ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣi ma baɣili m ba mini m ma gbala. Amaa a dabili Chimham m-bɔŋɔ, chɛ ka o doli nyini n dan naa kuli ka a ti niŋ o a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani.
en: Then let me go back home and die near my parents' grave. Here is my son Chimham, who will serve you; take him with you, Your Majesty, and do for him as you think best.

dag: Yi niŋdi wain paani pipihi n-nyura, ka niŋdi tulaale viɛla n-niŋdi yimaŋa, amaa ka yi baɣa ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli din paai Yisifu zuliya ŋɔ ni.
en: You drink wine by the bowlful and use the finest perfumes, but you do not mourn over the ruin of Israel.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yuli ba ka yɛli ba, Ninsalinim sani ka dimbɔŋɔ ku tooi nani, amaa Naawuni ŋun sani, binshɛɣukam nandimi.
en: Jesus looked straight at them and answered, This is impossible for human beings, but for God everything is possible.

dag: Ka sana yi be yi ni, ka bɔri ni o puhi Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu maa, ŋun doli Yaɣigari chuɣu maa kaya mini di zaligu soli puhi li. Yinim tiŋbihi mini saamba bɛn be yi ni zaa doliya zaligu yini.
en: A foreigner living among you might want to share in the Lord s Passover with you. This is allowed, but that person must follow all the rules about Passover. The same rules are for everyone.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba mini bɛ mabia Simiɔn zuliya niriba daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Keenannim bɛn be Zɛfat la n-ku ba zaa. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli tiŋ maa yuli Hɔrima.
en: Then the Judahites went with the Simeonites, their brothers, and they defeated the Canaanites who lived in Zephath, and they completely destroyed it. So the city was called Hormah.

dag: Bɛ ni laɣindi piriŋkpana nyɔri buɣim shɛm la, lala nti yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu dali.
en: Just as the weeds are gathered up and burned in the fire, so the same thing will happen at the end of the age:.

dag: lala n-nyɛ ti gba: Ti galisiya, amaa ti nyɛla niŋgbun yini Masia ni, ka ti zaa yinoyino nyɛ niŋgbuŋ yini maa yaɣ shɛŋa.
en: In the same way, though there are many of us, we are one body in Christ, and individually we belong to each other.

dag: Dauda daa bi kali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi paai yuun pisi, dama Yawɛ daa lo alikauli ni o ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ.
en: But David didnt count those younger than years of age, because the LORD had promised to make Israel as numerous as the stars in the sky.

dag: dama o bipuɣimbil gaŋa ŋun daa nyɛ kaman yuun pinaayi bia n-daa tarigi n-yɛn kpi. Yisa ni daa chani maa ka niriba pam muɣ o sani n-kabiri dol o.
en: because his twelve-year-old child was dying. She was his only daughter. While Jesus was on his way, people were crowding all around him.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, a mi ni anabinim kul be kpe n-yɛri ba, Tɔbu ku lan ŋmɛn ya, ka kum mi ku lan lu yi zuɣu, amaa n kul yɛn tin ya la suhudoo ni yɛlimaŋli tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. .
en: I replied, LORD God, the prophets are telling them: You wont see war or famine, for I will give you lasting peace in this place.

dag: N daa darigi bɛ tibili ka di dolila bɛ daɣiri mini bɛ biriginsim ni nyɛ shɛm, ka daa ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ba.
en: They sinned and made themselves filthy, so I punished them for the things they did. I turned away from them and refused to help them.

dag: Ka daa gbaai gbarigu maa nudirigu n-yiɣis o zali, ka o naba min o napɔŋkpuɣila dii teei n-kpaŋ zaa.
en: Then he took him by his right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong;.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul karim gbaŋ shɛli din yi Naa Atazɛrikisɛs sanna maa n-wuhi Rɛhum mini Shimshai ni bɛ tab la, bɛ daa dii zola yomyom chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm nti zaŋ kpiɔŋ muɣisi Yɛhudianim maa ka bɛ chɛ mɛbu.
en: So a copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes sent was read to Rehum, Shimshai the secretary, and the people with them. They went very quickly to the Jews in Jerusalem and forced them to stop building.

dag: Amaa ka Firawuna yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Yawɛ, ka n ni wum o yɛligu ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ? M bi mi Yawɛ maa, dinzuɣu n ku chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ.
en: But Pharaoh said, Who is the Lord ? Why should I obey him? Why should I let Israel go? I dont even know who this Lord is, so I refuse to let Israel go.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim sapashin so ŋun su tɔbbihi pihinu fukumsi min o tɔbbihi pihinu maa o sani. Ka o daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Naawuni nira, naa zaligu yɛliya, Siɣim na yomyom! .
en: Ahaziah then sent another commander with fifty soldiers. The commander said to Elijah, Man of God, this is what the king says: Hurry and come down.

dag: M pun yɛl o ni n ni darig o yiŋnim tibili hal ni saha din ka bahigu, tuumbiɛ shɛli yɛla o ni pun mila zuɣu, dama o bihi mɔri man Naawuni ka o bi yihi ba di ni.
en: I told Eli I would punish his family forever. I will do this because Eli knew his sons were saying and doing bad things against God. But he failed to control them.

dag: N shia, Neema! Mɔɣilo mini goonje, neemiya! N ni ŋme biɛɣunaayo.
en: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.

dag: Ka o ni nya ka wum shɛli, dina ka o tɔɣisira; ka so mi bi deer o yɛligu.
en: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.

dag: Amaa bɛ nyina ni daa na gbab nimdi maa ka di na bi lu bɛ puuni saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi niriba maa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka alɔbo titali lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: People began to eat the meat, but the Lord became very angry. While the meat was still in their mouths, before the people could finish eating it, the Lord caused the people to become very sick and die.

dag: Kuɣ shɛŋa din daa nyɛ kuɣ kara ka mali shaara, ka di shɛŋa wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ata ni pirigili, ka shɛŋa mi nyɛ mita anahinahi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ zali duri maa tanzahi.
en: The foundation stones were huge, good stones—some of them four and a half meters long and others three and a half meters long.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyini ka n niŋ naani; n yɛliya, Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: Lord , I trust in you. You are my God.

dag: Labimiya ba kuɣa ku, dama bɛ bɔrimi ni bɛ birigi ya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka yihi ya dabitim ni na la sani.
en: Stone them to death! They tried to lead you away from the Lord your God, who rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves.

dag: Di saha o ni suhi Naawuni ka o deeg o suhigu, ka o ni tooi chaŋ Naawuni tooni ni suhupiɛlli, ka Naawuni ti o wuntia tuma maa laara.
en: They pray to God, and God is pleased with them; they behold Gods presence with a joyful shout. God rewards a persons righteousness.

dag: Naawuni Kundi daa pun daŋ tiri wuhi ni Naawuni ni ti chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka daa daŋ yihi lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu ti Ibrahimma yɛli: A zuɣu ka zuliya kam zaa ni ti nya alibarika.
en: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.

dag: Bɛ suhuri yɛla niriba puri zuɣu, ka bɛ far li, ka ye niriba yinsi zuɣu, ka bɛ far li. Bɛ nahim yililana n-tabil o yiŋnima, ka nahim niriba n-tabili bɛ fali.
en: They covet fields and seize them, houses and take them away. They oppress a householder and those in his house, a man and his estate.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni n-tɛhi ni bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma, hal ka tɛhi ni bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma ti yaɣi.
en: There are people who think they are so good—oh, how good they think they are!.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa yiɣisi niŋ kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa n-zaŋ o yiŋnim kuli Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti be nimaani yuma ayopɔin.
en: So the woman went and did what the man of God asked. She and her household moved away, living in Philistia seven years.

dag: N Duuma, n ni paɣ a niriba balibu kam sani. N ni yili yila paɣ a zuliya balibu kam sani.
en: I will give thanks to you, my Lord, among all the peoples; I will make music to you among the nations.

dag: Ka Ɛsha ninvuɣ zuɣuri shɛb bɛn nyɛ Pool zɔnim gba daa tim ti balim Pool ni o di kpe salo maa laɣiŋgu maa shee.
en: A few of the local officials were friendly to Paul, and they sent someone to warn him not to go.

dag: A yi yi zahira kpahi nir zuɣu ni, di so ashilɔni yurilim.
en: A truly good friend will openly correct you.

dag: Zaŋmiya tiliginsim kaman tɔbutuhir zuɣupila la pili, ka zaŋ Naawuni yɛligu din nyɛ Shia Kasi takɔb la gbibi.
en: Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is Gods word.

dag: ka gbaag o ansarisi malibu yɛra, Ti puhir a Yɛhudianim Naa! Ka ŋmɛr o nutala.
en: They kept coming up to him and saying, Hail to the king of the Jews! And they hit him in the face.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Jona ŋun nyɛ Amitai bia la.
en: One day the Lord spoke to Jonah son of Amittai.

dag: N daa yi Ibrahimma zuɣu, ka yi Yisahaku zuɣu, ka lan yi Yaakubu gba zuɣu n-wuhi ba ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa, amaa n daa bi kahigi n yuli Yawɛ wuhi ba.
en: I appeared to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. They called me God All-Powerful. They did not know my name, the Lord .

dag: Yihim ma bɛ daansarisi mini bɛ ninvuɣ tubo ni, dama n dol a zaligunima.
en: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.

dag: O ni daa paai Nazarɛt, o daa bi yuui, ka yi nimaani gari chaŋ Kapɛrinium din be teeku duli Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali tiŋgbana ni la.
en: But he did not stay in Nazareth. He went to live in Capernaum, a town near Lake Galilee in the area near Zebulun and Naphtali.

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Naa Jɛhoyachin bapira Matania n-leei naa zali ŋun Jɛhoyachin zaani, ka taɣ o yuli Zɛdɛkia.
en: Nebuchadnezzar made Jehoiachin's uncle Mattaniah king of Judah and changed his name to Zedekiah.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ni niŋ di shɛli nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani la shihirili.
en: The priest will remove from the grain offering the token portion and completely burn it on the altar as a food gift of soothing smell to the LORD.

dag: Siria Naa daa pun bahila o sapashinnim pihitanaayi bɛn su o chɛchɛbunsi fukumsi noli yɛli, Di ti tuhiya wɔɣiri so bee tarim so, naɣila Izraɛl naa kɔŋko.
en: Meanwhile, Arams king had commanded his thirty-two chariot officers, Dont bother with anyone big or small. Fight only with Israels king.

dag: Lihimi n nudirigu polo nya, so bi bɔri n zaɣ viɛlli. N ka sɔɣibu shee; so baɣa ka n ni.
en: When I look beside me, I see that there is no one to help me, no one to protect me. No one cares for me.

dag: amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpahiri ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu ni ni mali suhupiɛlli, ka nya alibarika pam.
en: Judges who punish the guilty, however, will be prosperous and enjoy a good reputation.

dag: Sandaantimdiba bɛn biri bimbira ni suhudoo ni ti kpuɣila atam din nyɛ wuntia.
en: And goodness is the harvest that is produced from the seeds the peacemakers plant in peace.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o, Din kariya, n yi di mi ni m ba lo a zaɣ biɛɣu n naan ku yɛl a.
en: Enough! Jonathan replied. If I can determine for certain that my father intends to harm you, of course Ill tell you.

dag: Ka paɣ maa bɔh o, N dana, a ka guuka, ka kɔbiliga ŋɔ mi zilim pam; ka wula ka a lee yɛn niŋ nya nyɛvili kom maa?.
en: The woman said to him, Sir, you dont have a bucket and the well is deep. Where would you get this living water?.

dag: N ni ti mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ mini sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ ka di be kasi, ka lan mali Aduna min o bidibisi la gba ka bɛ be kasi, ka tumdi maligumaaniba tuma tiri ma.
en: I will make the meeting tent and the altar holy. Likewise, I will make Aaron and his sons holy to serve me as priests.

dag: Zuliya shɛli buɣa ni tooi chɛ ka saa mi? Bee zuɣusaa ni tooi chɛ ka sayuɣiyuɣi mi? Pa nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ n-niŋdi li? Ti mali tahima a sani, dama nyini n-nyɛ ŋun niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: Foreign idols dont have the power to bring rain. The sky does not have the power to send down showers of rain. You, the Lord our God, are our only hope. You are the one who made all these things.

dag: Ka Ribɛka daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya Yisahaku, ka sheei laakum zuɣu zani.
en: When Rebecca saw Isaac, she got down from her camel.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa ʒi nimaani m-bɔhiri bɛ suhuri yɛra.
en: Some of the teachers of the law were sitting there. They saw what Jesus did, and they said to themselves.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbibiya n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa, ka tummiya di tuma din ni chɛ ka yi ti be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka barina shɛli kani.
en: Obey all the Lord 's laws and commands, so that you may live in safety in the land.

dag: Ka niriba nya teeku puuni kɔsoya, ka dunia ni tam tanza shɛŋa zuɣu yi zahira Yawɛ tahigu mini pɔhim shɛli din yiri o nyɛvoya ni na vuri zuɣu.
en: The seabeds were exposed; the earths foundations were laid bare at the LORDs rebuke, at the angry blast of air coming from his nostrils.

dag: N yi ti teei n nuu darigi Ijiptinim maa tibili ka yihi Izraɛlnim maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, di saha ka Ijiptinim ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The Egyptians will come to know that I am the LORD, when I act against Egypt and bring the Israelites out from among them.

dag: Yawɛ ni be nyini n dan naa sani shɛm, o kul be Sulemaana gba sani lala ka chɛ ka o nam gari nyini n dan Naa Dauda nam.
en: My lord and king, the Lord has been with you, and now I pray that he will be with Solomon! And I pray that King Solomons kingdom will grow and be even more powerful than yours, my lord and king.

dag: Kɔnyuri gbaai biliɛɣu hal ka o lɔŋni ti kuui zaa. Bihi suhiri bindirigu, amaa ka so bi tiri ba shɛli.
en: Babies are so thirsty that their tongues are stuck to the roof of the mouth. Children go begging for food, but no one gives them any.

dag: N daa fabili niŋ a n wahala dabisili dali, ka a garigi ma.
en: I am praying to you in my time of trouble. I know you will answer me.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bɔhi salo maa, Mani ka yi nyaɣi takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi n-kana ni yi ti gbaai kaman ŋmɛnditoli n-nyɛ ma maa? M mini ya n-yi be Naawuni jɛmbu duu dabisili kam ka n wuhiri ya, ka yi bi gbaai ma.
en: Then Jesus spoke to the crowd, Did you have to come with swords and clubs to capture me, as though I were an outlaw? Every day I sat down and taught in the Temple, and you did not arrest me.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka yi yila yilibu zani tariga, ka so ku lan wum yi mɔɣilɔnim kumsi.
en: So I will stop the sound of your happy songs. People will not hear your harps anymore.

dag: Pool daa ti chaŋ Dɛɛbi mini Listra gba. Yisa nyaandol so daa be nimaani ka o yuli booni Timoti. O ma daa nyɛla Yɛhudia paɣa ka nyɛ Yisa nyaandola, ka o ba mi nyɛ Giriiki doo.
en: Paul reached Derbe, and then Lystra, where there was a disciple named Timothy. He was the son of a believing Jewish woman and a Greek father.

dag: Ka n daa nya biŋkɔb so ka o yiri teeku ni na; o daa malila yila pia, ka mali zuɣur ayopɔin, ka nam zuɣupila pia pili o yila maa, ka Naawuni mɔbu yuya sab pa o zuɣuri maa zuɣu.
en: Then I saw a beast coming up out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads. There was a crown on each of its horns. It had an evil name written on each head.

dag: Ka Musa daa bɔhi Yawɛ, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ lala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ niriba ŋɔ zaa ʒi tibisili ʒili ma ka bi sɔŋ ma?.
en: He prayed: I am your servant, Lord , so why are you doing this to me? What have I done to deserve this? You've made me responsible for all these people.

dag: Di simdi ni yi dɔbba zaa kani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ka nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sanna buta yuuni puuni.
en: All your males should appear three times a year before the LORD God, Israels God.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah anu daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi biŋkɔbigu la nam ʒiishee, ka o nam sulinsi tariga zaa daa zibigi, ka niriba daa dimdi be zilima biɛrim zuɣu.
en: Then the fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast. Darkness fell over the beast's kingdom, and people bit their tongues because of their pain.

dag: Nyin ʒirilana ŋɔ, a yu yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din biɛri niriba tɔɣisibu!.
en: You love to hurt people with your words, you liar!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka zuɣusaa ŋari ka saa bi lan mira, ka binshɛɣukam kɔŋ niŋbu.
en: That's also why the dew doesn't fall and your harvest fails.

dag: Ka ti daa ti nya ti nyaandolitab nimaani, ka bɛ yɛli ti ni ti kpalimmi bɛ sani niŋ daba ayopɔin. Ka ti daa ti yi nimaani chani Rom.
en: We found some believers there who asked us to stay with them a week. And so we came to Rome.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee niŋ o nuu ni ka gahim kuɣ polipoli diba anu n-niŋ o piɛgul koligu ni, ka o kuɣilɔŋ be o nuu ni ka o vu m-miri Filistia doo maa ha.
en: and picked up his shepherd's stick. He went out to a stream and picked up five smooth rocks and put them in his leather bag. Then with his sling in his hand, he went straight toward Goliath.

dag: Yi ni ti yɛn puh o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni tim a suhudoo, ka ti a malibu suhudoo, ka chɛ ka suhudoo be a ni su shɛlikam zaa ni.
en: David gave them this message for Nabal: May you and your family be well and all that you own be well.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Daadam Bia yi ti ʒin o jilima nam ʒiishee dunia palli din kanna ni, yinim bɛn dol o ŋɔ gba ni ti ʒini nam ʒiishɛhi pinaayi ni n-kari Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la saria.
en: Jesus said to them, You can be sure that when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne in the New Age, then you twelve followers of mine will also sit on thrones, to rule the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa, ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyɛra pa di zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ li yili suɣili maa dunoli.
en: For the entrance to the tent, they used a curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ bɔzuɣu ka ti lan yɛn bo kum ti timaŋa? Dama buɣim titali ŋɔ ni ti di ti. Ti yi lan wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ kukoli pahi, ti ni kpi.
en: But why should we die? Surely this massive fire will consume us! If we hear any more of the LORD our Gods voice, we will die.

dag: Mani n-daa guli ya mɔɣu ni tiŋgban kuŋ ni.
en: I knew you in the desert—I knew you in that dry land.

dag: Ka jintɔriba maa daa lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm pahi, ka bahi ba ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛ daa ʒi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm darigi bɛ tibili, dama bɛ daa zɔrila niriba dabiɛm, sokam zaa ni daa paɣiri Naawuni tuun shɛli din tum ka bɛ nini nya maa zuɣu la.
en: The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than years old, and everyone was praising God for what had happened.

dag: Yi vidibo ni yi filiŋ ni ti zani tariga. Yi ni ti be yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka yi daazichi ti nabi; ka yi ti mali suhupiɛlli sahakam.
en: In the past, other people shamed you and said bad things to you. You were shamed much more than any other people. So in your land you will get two times more than other people. You will get the joy that continues forever.

dag: Ka Farisii so ŋun daa boli Yisa na maa daa nya lala ka yɛli o suhu ni, Doo ŋɔ yi di nyɛla anabi, o naan baŋ paɣ ŋun shihir o ŋɔ ni nyɛ so, dama o nyɛla tuumbiɛrilana.
en: The Pharisee who had invited Jesus saw this and said to himself, If this man really were a prophet, he would know what kind of woman is touching him! He would know that she is a sinner.

dag: Yi yi ti nya ka doo bee paɣa ŋun be yi ni tum tuumbiɛɣu ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tin shɛŋa tin ya ŋɔ tin shɛl ni m-birig o daalikauli la.
en: If someone, whether male or female, is found in your community—in one of the cities the LORD your God is giving you—who does evil in the LORD your Gods eyes, by breaking Gods covenant.

dag: Ka Ɛhab ŋun daa nyɛ Omri bia la daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani n-gari na shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: He did what the Lord said was wrong. Ahab was worse than all the kings who were before him.

dag: ni naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɛha bie ka lan nyɛ bɛn bi doli yɛlimaŋli la sanna. Bɛ tɛhiri ni wuntia soli dolibu nyɛla din ni chɛ ka nir nya azichi. Gbaam amaŋa ni niriba ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo.
en: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni yi ku dunia ŋɔ ni kɔr biɛri din be yi ni la. Dina n-nyɛ: Zina niŋbu mini daɣiri tuma ni niŋgbuŋ kɔre ni tɛhi biɛri ni binyara ni kɔre kpɛbu la. Binyara ni kɔre kpɛbu ŋmanila buɣijɛmbo.
en: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.

dag: Naawuni, Wummi n kuhigu; ka deei n suhigu!.
en: God, hear my cry for help. Listen to my prayer.

dag: A ni daa na bi darigi n tibili la, n daa birigiya; amaa pumpɔŋɔ n dol a yɛligu.
en: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.

dag: Chɛ ka a nina kul lihiri tooni, ka a kul lihir a tooni tibi.
en: Focus your eyes straight ahead; keep your gaze on what is in front of you.

dag: N yura, niŋm yomyom, be kaman molifu la bee kparibua ŋun be tulaale tihi zoya zuɣu.
en: Take flight, my love, and be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spice.

dag: Ti yaannim daa tum alahichi, bɛ lan kani, ka ti diri wahala bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: Our ancestors sinned against you, and now they are dead. And we are suffering because of their sins.

dag: Lan gbilisim tibili wum a dabili min a niriba Izraɛlnim fabila; saha shɛli bɛ yi ti ŋmaligi kpa kpe na ka suhir a nyin gbilisim tibili a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni n-wum ti suhigu ka chɛ ti taali.
en: Listen to the request of your servant and your people Israel when they pray concerning this place. Listen from your heavenly dwelling place, and when you hear, forgive!.

dag: Ka n daa kul lihiri nti nya ka yilli maa lo tɔbu n-tuhi wuntizɔriba nyaŋ ba.
en: As I watched, this same horn waged war against the holy ones and defeated them.

dag: Ti ni daa deei Musa noli shɛlikam ni shɛm, lala ka ti yɛn deeg a noli, amaa ti lee suhirimi ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ be a sani kaman o ni daa be Musa sani shɛm la!.
en: We will obey you, just as we always obeyed Moses, and may the Lord your God be with you as he was with Moses!.

dag: ni Igal ŋun daa nyɛ Neetan Zɔba nir la bia ni Bɛni ŋun daa nyɛ Gaad nir la.
en: Igal son of Nathan of Zobah; Bani the Gadite;.

dag: Bɛ yi ti naai bɛ shɛhira tuma maa, biŋkɔb so ŋun yi bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la ni na ni ti tuhi ba tɔbu n-nyaŋ ba ku ba.
en: When they have finished their witnessing, the beast that comes up from the abyss will make war on them, gain victory over them, and kill them.

dag: Chamiya Mirataim tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Chamiya ti liri ba, ka liri Pɛkɔdnima n-ku bɛ zaa. Niŋmiya n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord said: I have told the enemies of Babylonia, Attack the people of Merathaim and Pekod. Kill them all! Destroy their possessions.

dag: n ti a yɛm mini baŋsim. N ni lan ti a buni mini azichi ni jilima, ka di galisi gari na shɛb bɛn daa daŋ a tooni la zaa dini, ka na shɛb bɛn ti yɛn dol a nyaaŋa na mi so dini ti ku paai li.
en: So I will make you wise and intelligent. But I will also make you richer and more famous than any king before or after you.

dag: O ni ti nyu wain ka o nina mɔhi; ka nyu bihim ka o nyina paligi.
en: His eyes are darker than wine, and his teeth whiter than milk.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ bela o jɛmbu duu din be kasi puuni, chɛliya ka dunianim zaa fo o tooni.
en: The Lord is in his holy Temple; let everyone on earth be silent in his presence.

dag: Asina ni Miunim ni Nɛfisim ni.
en: Asnah, Meunim, Nephisim.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ olivi tihi dari m-mali dasara, ka di nyɛ zaɣ mɔɣiri n-zaŋ sa sunsuuni dunol ni.
en: They also made doors for the entrance to the main room. They used olive wood to make a square doorframe.

dag: Yawɛ, saɣisim ma, amaa saɣisim ma kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka pa ni a suhuyiɣisili puuni, di yi pa lala n ni bahi yoli.
en: So correct me, LORD, but with justice, not in your anger, or else you will reduce me to nothing.

dag: A ni je suli niŋ ti sahakam? A yɛn jɛla suli niŋ ʒiɛmani kam nima?.
en: Will you be angry with us forever? Will your anger never cease?.

dag: Ti paɣiri Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka Taitus suhu ye yi sɔŋbu zuɣu kaman ti gba la.
en: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.

dag: So ka pɔhim yiko din ni tooi gooi li, so mi ka kum dabisili yiko. So ku tooi lɔrigi kpara sɔŋ tɔbu tuhibu saha. Lala ka ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma gba ku tooi tiligi ŋun tumdi li.
en: We cannot control the wind or determine the day of our death. There is no escape in time of war, and no one can hide behind evil.

dag: Jɛta ŋun daa nyɛ Shammai mabia la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛtɛrit mini Jɔnatan, Amaa ka Jɛta ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bia ka kpi.
en: Jada, the brother of Shammai, had two sons, Jether and Jonathan, but Jether died without having any sons.

dag: Amaa n ni ti zaŋ zuliya yini n-ti o bia maa, ka di chɛ ka n dabili Dauda zuliya kul diri nam Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni pii tin shɛli leei n jɛmbu shee la.
en: but Solomon's son will still rule one tribe. This way, my servant David will always have a descendant ruling in Jerusalem, the city where I have chosen to be worshiped.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Dahin shɛli kanna, ka bɛ ti ku lan bol li Tɔfɛt bee Hinnom Vinvamli, amaa bɛ ni ti booni li la Ninvuɣ kubo Vinvamli. Dama bɛ ni ti sɔɣi ba Tɔfɛt hal ka palo ti lan kani.
en: So now the time is coming, declares the LORD, when people will no longer speak of Topheth or the Ben-hinnom Valley, but the Carnage Valley. They will bury in Topheth until no space is left.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini Amɔrinim tiŋgbani maa ni hal ni di tintariga Arinɔn Mɔɣili noli shee la zaŋ hal ti paai Jabok n-yi di yɔɣu maa ni m-mali hal ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni.
en: The Israelites got all the land of the Amorites from the Arnon River to the Jabbok River. The land also went from the desert to the Jordan River.

dag: Amaa ka di daa mali ti paai Naa Jɔash nam dibu yuun pisinaata saha ka maligumaaniba maa na bi mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa luɣ shɛli.
en: But the priests never started repairing the temple. So in the twenty-third year of his rule.

dag: Hal nanim ni laɣindi ʒiini lɔri nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ m polo la zaa yoli, mani a dabili ŋɔ kul ni bɔhind a zaligunima.
en: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord , even if rulers plot against me.

dag: O kum maa saha, o kul yɛn ŋmɛlimmi, ka o kɔba ni kpam kul maha.
en: with a body that was well fed and bones that were still strong.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa ka o sanna nti bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka bɔh o, Di luhiya ni nir yih o paɣa.
en: Some Pharisees came and, trying to test him, they asked, Does the Law allow a man to divorce his wife.

dag: Dama a bi bɔri sara; ka n yi mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, a nini ku tiɣi li.
en: You dont really want sacrifices, or I would give them to you.

dag: Yi tiŋ daa lumi dahim leei dabari, amaa di pɔri pam pumpɔŋɔ, ka bɛn kanna ni bɛ ti be di ni ni muɣi li. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wurim li maa ni zo n-chaŋ katiŋ ka chɛn ya.
en: Your country was ruined and desolate— but now it will be too small for those who are coming to live there. And those who left you in ruins will be far removed from you.

dag: Sɛgub daa nyɛla Jair ba, ka Jair daa nyɛ ŋun su tinsi pisinaata fukumsi Giliad tiŋgban ni.
en: and Segub had a son named Jair. Jair ruled twenty-three cities in the territory of Gilead.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn bahila yoli zama laɣiŋgu ni.
en: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.

dag: amaa saha kanna, hal di paaya gba, ka Naawuni jɛmdi maŋa ni ti jɛm ti Ba Naawuni ni bɛ shihi zaa ni yɛlimaŋli, dama bɛ tatabo ka ti Ba Naawuni bɔri ni bɛ jɛmd o.
en: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.

dag: ni Ahilud bia Baana ŋun daa su Taanak mini Mɛgido ni bɔb shɛli zaa din zaŋ ti miri Bɛtishɛan din baɣi Zarɛtan ka be Jɛziriil tooni n-yi Bɛtishɛan n-zaŋ ti paai Ɛbɛlimɛhola n-zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Jokimiam yaɣili polo la.
en: Baana son of Ahilud: the cities of Taanach, Megiddo, and all the region near Beth Shan, near the town of Zarethan, south of the town of Jezreel, as far as the city of Abel Meholah and the city of Jokmeam.

dag: Ŋuni mini tuumbiɛtumdiba n-lee laɣim be, ka o mini ninvuɣ biɛri doli?.
en: He likes the company of evil people and goes around with sinners.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ti yi nimaani n-chani Bɛtɛl. O ni daa yi soli n-chani ha, ka bidibbihi nya o m-maani o ansarisi yɛra, Zuɣupalo ŋɔ lana, chama! Zuɣupalo ŋɔ lana, chama.
en: Elisha left and headed toward Bethel. Along the way some boys started making fun of him by shouting, Go away, baldy! Get out of here.

dag: ka bɛ yi yɛli ti zilima, ti zaŋdila zilim balli yɛtɔɣa labisi ba. Ti kul bemi kaman dunia ŋɔ bin chɔɣima la, hal ti ŋmanila saɣiri dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: when we are insulted, we answer back with kind words. We are no more than this world's garbage; we are the scum of the earth to this very moment!.

dag: N di ba shɛhira ni bɛ suhuri ye Naawuni zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ Naawuni bɔbu milinsi maa lee bi doli soli.
en: I can assure you that they are deeply devoted to God; but their devotion is not based on true knowledge.

dag: Dama o daa lab mɛla o ba Hɛzɛkia ni daa wurim buɣa jɛmbu shee luɣ shɛŋa la zaa, ka me maligu bimbina zali Baalnima, ka lan lab me Ashɛranim ŋmahima zali, ka daa gbaani tiŋ jɛmdi saŋmarisi zaa.
en: He rebuilt the pagan places of worship that his father Hezekiah had destroyed. He built altars for the worship of Baal, made images of the goddess Asherah, and worshiped the stars.

dag: Ka ninkurigu maa daa yɛl o, Naawuni chɛ ka yi suhuri doya. N ni tin ya yi ni bɔri shɛlikam, amaa lee di gbɛnya palo ŋɔ ni.
en: The old man said, You are welcome to spend the night in my home and to be my guest, but don't stay out here.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa niŋ naɣitɔroko palli ni n-yi Abinadab yiŋ chana, ka Yuza mini Ahio daa vɔri li chana.
en: The sacred chest was still at Abinadab's house, and when David and the crowd arrived there, they brought the chest outside and placed it on a new ox cart. Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio guided the cart.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti laɣim kpe n-tɔɣisi, ka tɛhi ni di luhiya ni ti pii ti ni shɛba n-chɛ ka bɛ doli ti mabiyurisi Baanabas mini Pool.
en: We have all agreed to choose some men and send them to you. They will be with our dear friends, Barnabas and Paul.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa yɛl o, N-hii, pumpɔŋɔ a yipa kahigiri yɛri ti, ka di pa ŋaha puuni yaha!.
en: His disciples said, See! Now you speak plainly; you arent using figures of speech.

dag: Ka o daa suhi Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ wuh o ti shɛli wulli ka o daa zaŋ li na ti lɔhi kom maa ni, ka di niŋ nyaɣisim. Nimaani ka Yawɛ daa zali ba zaligu, ka zahim ba.
en: Moses asked the Lord for help, and the Lord told him to throw a certain piece of wood into the water. Moses did so, and the water became fit to drink. At Marah the Lord tested his people and also gave them some laws and teachings.

dag: Di saha ka Judanim maa daa bu tɔb zambu. Bɛ ni daa bu tɔb zambu maa, ka Naawuni daa nyaŋ Jɛrɔbɔam mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be Abija mini Judanim tooni maa.
en: Then the men in Abijahs army shouted. When the men of Judah shouted, God defeated Jeroboams army. Jeroboams whole army from Israel was defeated by Abijahs army from Judah.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim ʒiɛmannim ŋɔ bɔrila shihirili nyabu, amaa bɛ ku nya shihir shɛli m-pahila Anabi Jona shihirili la. Ka o daa ŋmaligi chaŋ ka chɛ ba.
en: It is the evil and sinful people who want to see a miracle as a sign from God. But no miracle will be done to prove anything to them. The only sign will be the miracle that happened to Jonah. Then Jesus went away from there.

dag: Yi yi ti kpe fɔntiŋ ni bee tiŋkpaŋa, yin bɔhimiya n-nya ninvuɣ chirichi n-kpe o yiŋa m-be nimaani hal nti yi tiŋ maa ni.
en: When you come to a town or village, go in and look for someone who is willing to welcome you, and stay with him until you leave that place.

dag: Yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa o daa kul bela gbala maa shee mini zoya zuɣu kuhiri ka mali kuɣa jɛr omaŋa.
en: Night and day in the tombs and the hills, he would howl and cut himself with stones.

dag: ka mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ gɔhi nyolɔrigu maa naŋgbambiya.
en: Make two gold rings and put them on two corners of the judgment pouch.

dag: Luɣ dini ka n lee yɛn zo n-chaŋ ka chɛ a Shia? Bee ya ka n lee yɛn zo n-kuli n-yi a sani?.
en: Where could I go to escape from you? Where could I get away from your presence?.

dag: Ka di ni yi ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi dɔni bindoo kam zuɣu di ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni, ka o ni ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: Anything that he rests on or sits on is also unclean.

dag: Ninvuɣ tuhili ni ti lu n-do a luɣili polo, ka tuhi pia lu n-do a nudirigu polo, amaa di ti ku miri nyin na.
en: A thousand may fall dead beside you, ten thousand all around you, but you will not be harmed.

dag: N yi yɛli ni n ku lan bol a bee n-zaŋ a yuli tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, di saha a yɛligu maa ŋmanila buɣim be n kɔba ni dira, ka di gbibbu ti wum ma, ka n ku lan tooi gbib li.
en: But when I say, I will forget the Lord and no longer speak in his name, then your message is like a fire burning deep within me. I try my best to hold it in, but can no longer keep it back.

dag: N Naawuni, nyini ka n niŋ naani. Di chɛ ka n di vi; a mi di chɛ ka n dimnim di nasara ka chɛ ma.
en: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.

dag: Yisa daa yɛli salo maa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa la ŋaha puuni, hal o daa bi wuhiri ba shɛli ka pa ni yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni.
en: Jesus said all these things to the crowds in parables, and he spoke to them only in parables.

dag: Dama o yurilim maŋli la galisiya pam zaŋ chaŋ ti sani, ka o ʒiɛyimtali kul ni beni sahakam. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: His love for us is strong, and his faithfulness is eternal. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi ni yi chɛl yɛlli ŋɔ ka gbaaya yimaŋ ni Yisa tuumba maa, dama bɛ wuhibu ŋɔ mini bɛ tuma ŋɔ yi nyɛla salinim dini, di ni zan tariga;.
en: And so in this case, I tell you, do not take any action against these men. Leave them alone! If what they have planned and done is of human origin, it will disappear.

dag: So ni tooi baŋ saa ni kuri shɛm bee saa tahigu din yiri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili ni na?.
en: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?.

dag: Ka o tizɔpaɣiba maa daa tim ti yɛli Yisa, Ti Duuma, a ni yuri so pam la biɛra.
en: The sisters sent a message to the Lord and told him that his good friend Lazarus was sick.

dag: N ni tɔɣis a dunia ŋɔ ni yɛtɔɣa ka a bi niŋ li yɛda ŋɔ, ka n yi tɔɣis a alizanda ni yɛtɔɣa, wula ka a ni tooi niŋ li yɛda?.
en: If I have told you about earthly things and you dont believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?.

dag: Amaa yi yi mali nyuli zabbu din yiri putɔɣu ni na mini diribarilim tɛha yi suhuri ni, yin miriya ka yi nyuri bara, ka leei bɛn chihiri din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: But if in your heart you are jealous, bitter, and selfish, don't sin against the truth by boasting of your wisdom.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti booni Jɛrusalɛm la Yawɛ nam ʒiishee, ka zuliya kam zaa ti laɣim ka Yawɛ tooni na Jɛrusalɛm maa, ka bɛ ti ku lan niŋ tipawumli n-doli bɛ maŋmaŋ suhuyubu din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu la.
en: At that time the city of Jerusalem will be called the Lord s Throne. All nations will come together in the city of Jerusalem to give honor to the name of the Lord . They will not follow their stubborn, evil hearts anymore.

dag: Bɛ zuya daa ŋmanila nɔnsi zuya, ka bɛ dimdi kaman nɔnsi la, ka bɛ dimbu lɔɣu din yɛn nahim niriba chira anu la do bɛ zuya maa ni.
en: They also have tails with stingers, just like scorpions; and in their tails is their power to hurt people for five months.

dag: Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim wuna la lee be ya? Bɛ daa tooi fa Samaria n nuu ni bahi?.
en: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Did they rescue Samaria from my power?.

dag: Jilima mini nam yiko n-gil o; kpiɔŋ mini viɛlim be o biɛhigu shee.
en: Glory and majesty surround him; power and beauty fill his Temple.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yihimiya Gibia ninvuɣ galima bɛn tum lala maa na ka ti ku ba, ka lala tuuni maa vuui ka chɛ Izraɛlnima. Amaa ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum bɛ mabihi Izraɛlnim maa ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: We can't allow such a terrible crime to go unpunished in Israel! Hand the men over to us, and we will put them to death. But the people of Benjamin refused to listen to the other Israelites.

dag: Ka Lamɛk daa yɛl o paɣiba, Ada mini Zilla, wummiya: Yinim Lamɛk paɣiba, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ: N kula do so ŋun ti ma daŋa. N kula nachimbil so ŋun ŋme ma.
en: Lamech said to his wives, Adah and Zillah, listen to me: I have killed a young man because he struck me.

dag: Lɔɣimi li, di doli li, ŋmaligim chaŋ ka chɛ li.
en: Avoid it! Dont turn onto it; stay off of it and keep going!.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ li kuli Babilɔn, ka di ti kpalim be nimaani hal ti paai dabisi shɛli n ni lan yɛn zaŋ n zaŋsim labisi di polo. Di saha ka n ti lan yɛn zaŋ li nimaani na ti zali kpe yaha. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: All those things will also be taken to Babylon. They will be brought to Babylon until the day comes when I go to get them, says the Lord . Then I will bring those things back. I will put them back in this place.

dag: Nyama, Yawɛ dabisili dali kanna ka bɛ ni ti pirigi bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa ti taba yi ninni.
en: The Lord will have his day. And when it comes, everything that was ever taken from Jerusalem will be returned and divided among its people.

dag: Nyam biŋkɔbiri ni bamdi shɛm. Niɣi kul chanimi gindi mɔri ni kani ka bɛ ni ŋubi zuɣu; ka piɛri mini buhi gba kul diri wahala.
en: How the animals groan! Herds of cattle are in distress because there is no pasture for them; even the flocks of sheep pant.

dag: ka zaŋ bula yino mal alahichi sanyoo sara, ka di kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: There will be one male goat for a purification offering to seek reconciliation for yourselves.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka yi ni ti yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Kuhimiya bol o yuli ka o sɔŋ ya! Yɛlimiya zuliya kam zaa o ni tum tuun shɛŋa! Yɛlimiya ba ni o galisiya pam!.
en: At that time you will say, Praise the Lord and call out his name! Tell everyone what he has done and how wonderful he is.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaisha daa je suli niŋ o, ka yɛli, Di di simdi ni a zaŋ li fiɛbila siɣimsiɣim bunu bee buyɔbu; dindina a naan ŋme Sirianim hal ti kpimsi bɛ birili, amaa a ni bi niŋ lala maa zuɣu, a ni ŋme n-nyaŋ ba la siɣimsiɣim buta kɔŋko.
en: This made Elisha angry, and he said to the king, You should have struck five or six times, and then you would have won complete victory over the Syrians; but now you will defeat them only three times.

dag: Ka wula ka n lee ni tooi yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi Naawuni ni bi yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu? Bee wula ka n lee ni tooi yɛli ni Naawuni ni wuhi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bi simdi tibidarigibo simdi ni bɛ nya tibidarigibo?.
en: How can I curse whom God hasnt cursed? How can I denounce whom God hasnt denounced?.

dag: N daa lari niŋdi ba saha shɛli bɛ daa yi ti lan ka yɛda, ka n suhupiɛlli lihigu kpaŋsiri bɛ suhuri.
en: I smiled on them; they couldnt believe it. They never showed me disfavor.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔhira, Wula ka Naawuni lee yɛn niŋ baŋ? Zallakudura Naa malila baŋsim.
en: Those evil people say, God does not know what we are doing! God Most High does not know.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n ni bo binshɛŋa zaa ni bɛ me du kasi maa, n lan mali mmaŋmaŋ daazichi din nyɛ salima mini anzinfa, ka n ni zaŋ n zaŋsim zaa niŋ n Naawuni duu ŋɔ mɛbu ni maa zuɣu, n zaŋ li ti ni bɛ tum n Naawuni duu maa tuma.
en: I am making a special gift of gold and silver things for my Gods Temple. I am doing this because I really want the Temple of my God to be built. I am giving all these things to build this holy Temple.

dag: Ka o daa va Naawuni jɛmbu duu duɣuri mini lahi, zaɣ kara mini zaɣ bihi zaa ni Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni azichi mini nayili azichi ni kpambaliba yinsi azichi zaa kuli Babilɔn.
en: Nebuchadnezzar carried off everything that was left in the temple; he robbed the treasury and the personal storerooms of the king and his officials. He took everything back to Babylon.

dag: Ɛlam ŋun pahi la niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinunaanahi.
en: from the other town of Elam:.

dag: Firawuna kpambaliba ni daa nya o, bɛ daa paɣ o pam Firawuna sani. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tahi Firawuna yiŋa.
en: The king's officials told him about her, and she was taken to his house.

dag: Naawuni gbaɣisi n tɔbu ka filim ma, lala zuɣu ka bɛ liri ma ka binshɛli bi gu ba soli.
en: Because he loosened my bowstring and afflicted me, they throw off restraint in my presence.

dag: Ka so yi mal o suhu n-yi din nyɛ daɣiri ni ka be kasi, dindina o ni leei la shɛli din mali jilima, ka mali shili ni di tum tuun suŋ kam, ka yil yidana ni woligi li n-zali di ko ni o zaŋ li tumd o tuma.
en: The Lord wants to use you for special purposes, so make yourself clean from all evil. Then you will be holy, and the Master can use you. You will be ready for any good work.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, Yawɛ suhu daa na kul bi maai. O suhu daa yiɣisiya pam bahi Judanim zuɣu Manaasa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam la zuɣu.
en: Even so, the LORD didnt turn away from the great rage that burned against Judah on account of all that Manasseh had done to make him angry.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yiɣisi zani Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini gbini Izraɛlnim zaa ninni n-kpuɣ o nuhi zuɣusaa.
en: Then Solomon stood in front of whole assembly of Israel and faced the Lord s altar. Solomon spread his hands and looked toward heaven.

dag: N ni daa nya li yuŋ maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pɔhim n-daa kul ʒiɛri kpari luɣ shɛlikam teeku kom zuɣu.
en: I am Daniel. In the vision I had during the night I saw the four winds of heaven churning the great sea.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyama, n yɛn zaŋla n jaaŋgbee din be n nuu ni ŋɔ fiɛbi ko shɛli din be Nail Mɔɣili ŋɔ ni ŋɔ ka di leei ʒim, ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: This is what the LORD says: By this you will know that I am the LORD. Im now going to hit the water of the Nile River with this rod in my hand, and it will turn into blood.

dag: Ka niriba chɛ solɔri dolibu, ka sochandiba chɛ so kara dolibu. Ka zɔtali saɣim, ka alikaulinim saɣim, ka so baɣa ka di yɛla ni.
en: No one travels anymore; every road is empty. Treaties are broken, and no respect is shown to any who keep promises.

dag: Di saha maa ka gadama daa piligi Ɛfɛsus Yisa soli dolibu zuɣu.
en: At that time there was serious trouble because of the Lord's Way.

dag: O yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ buŋ yɛno kɔbili maa bahi. Ka bɛ daa bol o ni zaŋ li bahi luɣ shɛli maa yuli Ramatilɛhi.
en: After that, he threw the jawbone away. The place where this happened was named Ramath Lehi.

dag: Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun mɔŋ ma yɛlimaŋli ka chɛ ka m biɛhigu niŋ tom ŋɔ.
en: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives.

dag: Di saha maa, n shiri ni ti zaŋ n shia n-niŋ yi dab bidibisi mini yi dab bipuɣinsi ni.
en: At that time I will pour out my Spirit even on servants, both men and women.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Bom yuma ata naɣilaa mini yuma ata bunyaŋ ni yuma ata piɛlaa ni ŋmanʒee ni yiŋ ŋmani ti ma.
en: He said, Bring me a three-year-old female calf, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a dove, and a young pigeon.

dag: Pa omaŋmaŋa n-yɛli ma ni o nyɛla o tizɔpaɣa? Ka paɣ maa maŋmaŋ gba yɛli ma ni o nyɛla o tizɔdoo. M bi tum taali n tɛha ni, ka mi bi zaŋ n nuhi tum taal shɛli.
en: Didnt he say to me, Shes my sister, and didnt she—even she—say, Hes my brother? My intentions were pure, and I acted innocently when I did this.

dag: Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni suhupiɛlli! Yilimiya yila ka o sanna!.
en: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord !.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa piligi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu Jɛrusalɛm Mɔria Zoli zuɣu Aruna ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛbusi nir la kabɔɣili la ni. O ba Dauda ni daa wuhi ni bɛ mɛm li luɣ shɛli din nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa yi ŋun Naa Dauda zuɣu la.
en: Solomon began building the Lord s Temple at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the Lord appeared to David, Solomons father. This was the place David had prepared for the Temple. It had been the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni ti chɛ o niriba bahi hal ka paɣ so ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi maa ti dɔɣi. Di saha Izraɛlnim bɛn na kpalim be dabitim ni la ni ti labi bɛ mabihi sanna.
en: So the Lord will abandon his people to their enemies until the woman who is to give birth has her son. Then those Israelites who are in exile will be reunited with their own people.

dag: Ɛlam din pahi la — tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinunaanahi.
en: from the other town named Elam:.

dag: O yiɣisiri faranim taŋkpaɣu ni, ka yiɣisiri nandaamba tampiligim ni.
en: He raises the poor from the dust; he lifts the needy from their misery.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, ka bɛ kpamba zaa daa bo jaaŋgbɛhi na ti ti o. Kpɛm kam jaaŋgbe yiniyini, ka di kalinli daa yiɣisi jaaŋgbɛhi pinaayi kaman bɛ dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Ka Aduna jaaŋgbee daa be bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi maa ni.
en: So Moses spoke to the Israelites, and each of their leaders gave him a stick, one for each tribe, twelve in all, and Aaron's stick was put with them.

dag: Dama di yi niŋ daba ayi n ni doli soli chaŋ ka ku lan labina.
en: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.

dag: Ka Ribɛka dɔɣibu dali daa ti paai, ka jahi m-be o pul ni.
en: The time came for her to give birth, and she had twin sons.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi maa bahi, ka di yi n nuh ayi maa ni lu tiŋ ŋ-ŋma yi ninni.
en: I grabbed the two tablets and threw them down with my own hands, shattering them while you watched.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka ti lee yɛn zaŋ Naawuni nam ŋmahindi bee ŋahi dini ka ti lee yɛn ŋahi zaŋ chaŋ di polo?.
en: Then Jesus said, What can I use to show you what Gods kingdom is like? What story can I use to explain it?.

dag: Di bi wuhiri ni m pun nya dimbɔŋɔnima bee ni n nyɛla ŋun be tibi, amaa n na kul kpaŋdila mmaŋ chani tooni ni n nya Masia ni gbaai ma kpɛhi nuu ni ni n nya shɛl la.
en: I do not claim that I have already succeeded or have already become perfect. I keep striving to win the prize for which Christ Jesus has already won me to himself.

dag: N daa lan lo ba alikauli ni n ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ti ba, bɛ ni daa nyɛ saamba be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni la.
en: I also set up my covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan where they lived as immigrants.

dag: Jɔash yuma daa nyɛla yuma ayopɔin o ni daa di nam saha shɛli maa.
en: Joash was only seven years old when this happened.

dag: Dinzuɣu kahigimiya yi daalahichi wuhimi taba, ka suhimiya Naawuni tiri taba, ka di chɛ ka yi nya alaafee. Wuntizɔra nimmoo wunsuhigu mali yiko pam di tuma puuni.
en: So always tell each other the wrong things you have done. Then pray for each other. Do this so that God can heal you. Anyone who lives the way God wants can pray, and great things will happen.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku be kaman bɛ yaannim bɛn daa nyɛ tipawumlinim mini duŋtaariba ʒiɛmani niriba la. Bɛ daa nyɛla ʒiɛman shɛli niriba bɛn bi ʒe yim bɛ suhuri ni. Bɛ daa lan nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim.
en: They would not be like their ancestors, who were stubborn and refused to obey. Their hearts were not devoted to God, and they were not faithful to him.

dag: Zaligu shɛŋa yi ni yɛn doli viɛnyɛliŋga Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ni yi ʒini di ni saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be dunia yili m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Here are the laws that you are to obey as long as you live in the land that the Lord , the God of your ancestors, is giving you. Listen to them!.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa puuni niriba ata bee ayi tɔɣisi; ka chɛ ka bɛn kpalim buɣisi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Two or three persons may prophesy, and everyone else must listen carefully.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa boli, Samuɛl! Samuɛl! Ka Samuɛl saɣi, N-nyɛ ma.
en: The LORD called to Samuel. Im here, he said.

dag: Ka shɛb gba daa ʒi barinim mini alizin biɛri ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu n-yi Jɛrusalɛm tiŋkpaŋ kɔɣilikɔɣili kana, ka bɛ zaa daa ti nya alaafee.
en: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed.

dag: Suhusaɣiŋgu yi ti paai ya kaman sanʒiɛɣu la, ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ya kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga la, ka biɛrim mini nandahima yi ti paai ya;.
en: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.

dag: ka yɛra, Naawuni chɛ o bahi; doliy o ti gbaag o, dama so kani n-ni fa o bahi.
en: They say, God has abandoned him; let's go after him and catch him; there is no one to rescue him.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn yɛri noya tiri niriba, amaa nyin niŋdila alibarika niŋdi niriba ni. Naawuni, chɛ ka bɛn nahindi ma maa di vi, amaa ka chɛ ka a dabili mali suhupiɛlli.
en: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.

dag: Ka n ti wum lahibali ni Yɛhudianim dɔni n-gu o soli, dinzuɣu ka n chɛ ka bɛ tah o a sanna yomyom maa; ka yɛli bɛn fiɣisir o maa ni bɛ kam a sanna nti yɛl a bɛ ni fiɣisir o shɛli zuɣu maa.
en: When I was informed of a conspiracy against his life, I sent him to you at once and ordered his accusers to bring their case against him before you.

dag: Jilima mini nam yiko n-gil o; kpiɔŋ mini viɛlim be o biɛhigu shee.
en: Greatness and grandeur are in front of him; strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

dag: Dinzuɣu daadam, ŋuhima; ŋuhimi ni suhusaɣiŋgu mini biɛrim pam bɛ ninni.
en: You, human one, groan in their sight; groan bitterly with trembling knees.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa kana ti nya shigbaŋ maa, shikpam daa kul tɔɣirimi, amaa so daa bi niŋ li kpar o nol ni; dama niriba maa daa zɔrila pɔri la.
en: The woods were full of honey, but no one ate any of it because they were all afraid of Saul's curse.

dag: Ka Filip daa bɔ n-nya Nataniɛl yɛl o, Ti nya Anabi Musa ni daa sab so yɛla o zaligu kundinim ni min anabinim gba ni daa sab so yɛla la. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa Yisifu bia ŋun yi Nazarɛt na la.
en: Philip found Nathanael and told him, We have found the one whom Moses wrote about in the book of the Law and whom the prophets also wrote about. He is Jesus son of Joseph, from Nazareth.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi di nasara, niriba zɔrimi sɔɣira, amaa bɛ yi ti lan kani, wuntizɔriba zoorimi pahi.
en: When the wicked rise up, people hide, but when they are destroyed, the righteous multiply.

dag: Dama a yurilim maŋli zaŋ chaŋ m polo galisiya pam; a yihi n shia kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: How great is your constant love for me! You have saved me from the grave itself.

dag: Dama Daadam Bia min o malaikanim yi ti labina o Ba Naawuni jilima ni, o ni ti ti sokam bɛ tuma laara.
en: The Son of Man will soon come in the glory of his Father and with his angels to reward all people for what they have done.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, N di pun bi yɛl a ni o bi yɛn yɛli zaɣ viɛlli zaŋ chaŋ m polo naɣila zaɣ biɛɣu kɔŋko.
en: Then Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, See, I told you! This prophet never says anything good about me. He always says something bad.

dag: Zatu daŋ ni: Ɛliɔnai mini Ɛliashib so ni Matania so mi ni Jɛrɛmɔt so gba ni Zabad ni Aziza.
en: From the descendants of Zattu, these men: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

dag: Dinzuɣu malimiya shili zani. Zaŋmiya yɛlimaŋli leei shɛlɔriti lo yi shɛhi ni, ka zaŋ wuntitali leei yi nyɔtaɣirisi;.
en: So stand strong with the belt of truth tied around your waist, and on your chest wear the protection of right living.

dag: Amaa tinim nyɛla alizanda tiŋbihi, ka ti suhuri kul yɛla tiligir so ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia m-be alizanda ni la labbuna zuɣu.
en: We, however, are citizens of heaven, and we eagerly wait for our Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ, to come from heaven.

dag: Dimiya li, di nyɛla din be kasi. Dɔbba kɔŋko n-ni tooi di li. Di nyɛla din be kasi yi sani.
en: Eat these things only in a very holy place. Every male in your family may eat them, but you must remember that these offerings are holy.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli, bɛ daa zu ma la Hiburu tiŋgbɔŋ ni na; ka kpe gba, m bi tum taal shɛli ka di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ ma kpɛhi sarika.
en: After all, I was kidnapped from the land of the Hebrews, and even here in Egypt I didn't do anything to deserve being put in prison.

dag: Goonje mini mɔɣilo, neemiya! N ni ŋme biɛɣunaayo.
en: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ kpamba maa mini niriba maa zaa nyaɣisim pam, ka bɛ daa kanna ti yɔri bɛ farigu liɣiri maa niŋdi adaka maa ni hal ti naai dindali maa.
en: This pleased the people and their leaders, and they brought their tax money and filled the box with it.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu kpuɣ o pakoli maa, ka gba bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bia ka kpi; ka ŋun pah ata gba lala;.
en: So the second brother married the woman. But he also died and had no children. The same thing happened with the third brother.

dag: Dabisili maa ni ti bie pam! Dama Yawɛ dabisili la dali miriya. Di ni ti kana kaman zaɣ biɛɣu din yi Kpiɔŋlan Naa sanna.
en: Be sad because the Lord s special day is near. At that time punishment will come like an attack from God All-Powerful.

dag: hal ka deei gbana maligumaaniba kpamba sani n-ka kpe na ni o ti gbahi bɛnkam dol a.
en: Hes here with authority from the chief priests to arrest everyone who calls on your name.

dag: Ka m bo o nuzaa polo, ka o sɔɣi, ka n ku tooi nya o, ka n ŋmaligi nudirigu polo, amaa ka bi tooi nya o.
en: God has been at work in the North and the South, but still I have not seen him.

dag: Ti yi di chɛ nyin ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu ka ŋmaligi jɛmdila buɣa.
en: Did we forget the name of our God? Did we pray to foreign gods?.

dag: O daa yɛlila lala ni o zahim o, dama omaŋmaŋ daa mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Jesus said this to test him, for he already knew what he was going to do.

dag: Kɛnaz ni Tɛman ni Mibizar.
en: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar.

dag: Naa Sulemaana ni daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu du shɛli maa puuni wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pisinaayopɔin; ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili.
en: The inside of the Lord 's temple was meters long, meters wide, and . meters high.

dag: Bɛn daa be o nuzaa polo n-daa nyɛ bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Mɛrari bidibisi la, Ɛtan daa nyɛla Kish bia, ka Kish nyɛ Abidi bia, ka Abidi nyɛ Maluk bia.
en: Ethan of the clan of Merari was the leader of the third choir. His family line went back to Levi as follows: Ethan, Kishi, Abdi, Malluch.

dag: N ni yɛli m mabi dɔbba ni paɣiba a yɛla; N ni paɣ a a jɛmbu laɣiŋgu ni;.
en: I will tell my people about you. I will praise you in the great assembly.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the LORD said to me.

dag: Daadam Bia kandina ni ti ŋmanila do so ŋun daa yɛn go n-chaŋ tinshee katiŋa, ka zaŋ o yili niŋ o yiŋbihi nuu ni ka ti sokam o tuma, ka yɛl o yiligula ni o gul o yili maa la.
en: Its like a man who goes on a trip and leaves his house in the care of his servants. He gives each one a special job to do. He tells the servant guarding the door to always be ready. And this is what I am telling you now.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi kambɔna mini yi tuma zaa ni; o ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni ŋun Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: The Lord your God will bless your work and fill your barns with grain. He will bless you in the land that he is giving you.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi lahibali maa na garigi yɛl o, Izraɛlnim vaami guui ka chɛ Filistianima; bɛ ku niriba pam, hal bɛ ku a bih ayi la Hofini mini Finɛhas, ka fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la chaŋ.
en: The messenger answered, Israel has fled from the Philistines. The army has suffered a massive defeat. Also, your own two sons Hophni and Phinehas have died, and Gods chest has been taken.

dag: N daa bi di bindir nyaɣisili bee ŋ-ŋub nimdi bee n-chɛ ka wain to n noli, m mi daa bi niŋ kpam ʒe n ni hal ka bakɔi muna ata maa ti gari.
en: During those three weeks, I didnt eat any fancy food; I didnt eat any meat or drink any wine. I didnt put any oil on my head. I didnt do any of these things for three weeks.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun be o ko nyɛla ŋun kul niŋd o ni bɔri shɛli, ka o nini bi tiɣiri shɛb ni tumdi din tuhi ka di viɛli shɛm.
en: Unfriendly people look out for themselves; they bicker with sensible people.

dag: Wuntizɔriba alibarika duhirila tiŋa, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri noli ni yɛtɔɣa wurindila tiŋa.
en: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.

dag: Bɛ yi di nyɛla n saawaranima, dindina bɛ naan moli n yɛligu maa n niriba sani; bɛ naan yihi ba bɛ biɛriyoli ni, ka yihi ba bɛ ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ni.
en: If they had stood in my council, they would have proclaimed my words to my people; they would have turned them from their evil ways and deeds.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni niriba pam bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni ti yi wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo na, ka bɛ mini Ibrahimma ni Yisahaku ni Yaakubu ti laɣim ʒini alizanda nam ni ni suhupiɛlli;.
en: I say to you that there are many who will come from east and west and sit down to eat with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka m biɛhigu di be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm la, kaman saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa yuuni ma la;.
en: Oh, that life was like it used to be, like days when God watched over me.

dag: N ni su ninvuɣ shɛb maa ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋun be mɔɣu ni n sani. Bɛ ŋumdimi bahiri n zuɣu, dinzuɣu ka n je ba.
en: My chosen people have turned against me; like a lion in the forest they have roared at me, and so I hate them.

dag: N ni ti yihi ya di puuni na nti zaŋ ya niŋ tinzunnim nuu ni, ka bɛ kari ya saria.
en: He also said, I will take you out of this city and give you to strangers. I will punish you.

dag: Saha shɛli Mɔdɛkai ni daa ʒe n-guli nayili dunoli, ka Bigitan mini Tɛrɛsh bɛn daa nyɛ namɔɣilis ayi n-ʒe n-guli naa zɔntua dunoli daa ti je suli niŋ Naa Ahasivɛrɔs ka lo ni bɛ sɔɣi ku o.
en: At that time, as Mordecai continued to work at the Kings Gate, two royal eunuchs, Bigthan and Teresh, became angry with King Ahasuerus. They were among the guards protecting the doorway to the king, but they secretly planned to kill him.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Izraɛl tin yini ninvuɣ tuhili yi chaŋ tɔbu ni, bɛ puuni ninvuɣ kɔbiga n-ni ti labina. Ka tin shɛli nim mi ninvuɣ kɔbiga yi chaŋ tɔbu ni, ninvuɣ pia n-ni ti labina.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: Officers leaving the city with men will return with only men. Officers leaving the city with men will return with only ten men.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, Bɛ mal li kunila Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni bɛ ti me di duu zali nimaani. Bɛ yi ti me di duu maa naai, bɛ ni zaŋ piɛɣu maa zali di ni.
en: The angel told me, They are going to build a house for it in Babylonia. After they build that house, they will put the bucket there.

dag: Daadam tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Izraɛl piɛguliba. Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Piɛguliba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Izraɛl piɛguliba bɛn kul dihirila bɛmaŋ ŋɔ, pa piɛguliba n-dihiri piɛri?.
en: Human one, prophesy against Israels shepherds. Prophesy and say to them, The LORD God proclaims to the shepherds: Doom to Israels shepherds who tended themselves! Shouldnt shepherds tend the flock?.

dag: Hal maligumaaniba zuɣulana mini ya ŋɔ jintɔriba zaa ni tooi di ma shɛhira, dama bɛ sani ka n daa deei gbana n-chani ni n ti ti bɛ mabihi bɛn be Damaskus la, ka gbahi bɛn doli soli ŋɔ n-lo ba mihi tahi Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ na ka bɛ ti darigi bɛ tiba.
en: The high priest and the whole Jerusalem Council can testify about me. I received letters from them, addressed to our associates in Damascus, then went there to bring those who were arrested to Jerusalem so they could be punished.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ n-su tiŋgbani, ka bɛ ni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb jilima be di ni.
en: although you were rich, respected, and powerful.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa guhirila tin shɛli Naawuni maŋmaŋ ni zali di tanzaa ka lan nyɛ ŋun me li, ka di ku vuui.
en: He was looking forward to a city that has foundations, whose architect and builder is God.

dag: Ka Yisa yuli ba ka yɛli ba, Ninsalinim sani ka dimbɔŋɔ ku tooi nani, amaa pa ni Naawuni sani; dama Naawuni ŋun sani binshɛɣukam nandimi.
en: Jesus looked at them and said, That is something people cannot do, but God can. He can do anything.

dag: Ka Hiram daa chɛ ka o kpambaliba zaŋ ŋarima mini tumtumdiba bɛn mili teeku nti ti o, ka bɛ mini Sulemaana tumtumdiba daa chaŋ Ofiri nti ʒi salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pinaanu na ti ti Naa Sulemaana.
en: Hiram sent ships to Solomon. Hirams own men sailed the ships. They were skilled at sailing on the sea. His men went with Solomons servants to Ophir and brought back tons of gold to King Solomon.

dag: Ka Yisifu zuliya niriba gba daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Bɛtɛlnima, ka Yawɛ daa sɔŋ ba.
en: The Ephraim and Manasseh tribes were getting ready to attack Bethel, which at that time was called Luz. And the Lord helped them when they sent spies to find out as much as they could about Bethel.

dag: bee n-di m bindirigu n kɔŋko, ka kpibiga bi di li.
en: I have never been selfish with my food. I shared what I had with orphans.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ni, bɛn daa nyɛ Sool dɔɣiriba la kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaata, ka bɛ niriba pam mi daa na kul ʒe Sool nyaaŋa.
en: From the tribe of Benjamin there were men. They were Sauls relatives. Most of them stayed faithful to Sauls family until that time.

dag: Ka o paɣ Jɛzibɛl bɔh o, Pa nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛl Naa? Yiɣisim di ni suhupiɛlli. N ni zaŋ Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir maa wain tihi puu maa ti a.
en: Aren't you the king of Israel? Jezebel asked. Get out of bed and eat something! Don't worry, I'll get Naboth's vineyard for you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋdila yi zuɣu; ka Naawuni daalibarika yi paari niriba pam n-kul pahira, di ni chɛ ka bɛ wumpaɣibo din tibigiri Naawuni gba kul pahira.
en: All these things are for you. And so the grace of God is being given to more and more people. This will bring more and more thanks to God for his glory.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa piligi n-gbahiri cheechi ni ninvuɣ shɛba n-niŋdi ba alaka;.
en: About this time King Herod began to persecute some members of the church.

dag: Dama o ni tilig a bɛn bariti zana nuu ni mini alɔbo din kuri niriba ni.
en: God will save you from the hunters trap and from deadly sickness.

dag: ni sabisigu ni yuɣu ni baandɔɣu ni bankalansilli ni gumachuɣu.
en: the gecko, the spotted lizard, the lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.

dag: Bɔ ka a su kpe? Ŋuni ka a lee mi kpe hal ka ti gbir amaŋmaŋ gballi kpe n-chibiri daboli zuɣu tampiŋ ni?.
en: and say this: What are you doing here? None of your relatives are buried here, are they? Then what right do you have to prepare a tomb for yourself in this high place? Why are you cutting a tomb out of this rock?.

dag: Di ni ʒiɛya lala sahakam, ni di chɛ ka niriba doli zaligunim maa ni ʒiɛyimtali mini din tuhi tumbu ni.
en: they are established always and forever: they are fulfilled with truth and right doing.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli, N tum taali, amaa di zaa yoli, tim ma jilima n kpamba ŋɔ mini Izraɛlnim zaa tooni, ka chɛ ka m min a labi ka n ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Duuma Naawuni maa.
en: Saul said, I did sin, but please honor me in front of the leaders of the army and the people of Israel. Come back with me, so I can worship the Lord your God.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa shɛb wum lala ka yɛli, Nyamiya, o boonila Anabi Ilaija.
en: After hearing him, some standing there said, Look! Hes calling Elijah.

dag: yɛra, Saha paaya, ka Naawuni nam gba mirina; dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba ka niŋ lahibal suŋ ŋɔ yɛda.
en: He said, The right time is now here. Gods kingdom is very near. Change your hearts and lives, and believe the Good News.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli ka bi chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The Lord made Pharaoh stubborn again, so he refused to let them go.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi nyolɔrigu maa puuni naŋgbanbiya, ka di miri binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa.
en: They made two rings of gold and attached them to the lower corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.

dag: hal ka piɛm ti nyɔɣ o gbaag o nyɔri. O ŋmanila noombil so ŋun zɔri chani zana ni ka bi mi ni di nyɛla din yɛn di o nyɛvili.
en: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.

dag: Chɛ ka ti kpe a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni gari. Ti ku tim yi puri ni bee yi wain tihi ni gari bee n-nyu yi kɔbilisi kom. Ti yɛn dolila solɔɣu gari. Ti ku ŋmaligi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo hal ti yi a tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Please let us cross through your land. We wont pass through any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will walk on the Kings Highway and not turn to the right or to the left until we have crossed your border.

dag: Din daa lu sol zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu maa, ka Sintani kana nti yihi li bɛ suhuri ni ka bɛ ku niŋ li yɛda n-tiligi.
en: The seeds that fell along the path stand for those who hear; but the Devil comes and takes the message away from their hearts in order to keep them from believing and being saved.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Musa ni zali ni bɛ zaŋ binshɛŋa maa zaa na nti sɔŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka niriba maa zaa daa vu m-miri ti zani Yawɛ tooni.
en: They brought what Moses had commanded to the front of the meeting tent. Then the whole community came forward and stood before the LORD.

dag: Ka n daa kul lihiri hal ka biŋkɔb so ti tɔhi zanina. O daa ŋmanila jɛŋgbini, amaa ka kpiŋkpama anahi din ŋmani nooŋa kpiŋkpama lee sa o yaaŋa zuɣu, ka o mali zuɣur anahi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yiko ti o.
en: I kept watching, and suddenly there was another beast, this one like a leopard. On its back it had four wings like bird wings. This beast had four heads. Authority was given to it.

dag: Hagab ni Shamlai ni Hanan ni.
en: Hagab, Shamlai, Hanan.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun tuhiri tɔbu. O yuli n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The Lord is a warrior; the Lord is his name.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa boli, Samuɛl! Samuɛl! Ka Samuɛl saɣi, N-nyɛ ma.
