en: when the Lord called out Samuel's name. Here I am! Samuel answered.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyama, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka alɔbo titali lu a niriba min a paɣiba ni a bihi ni a ni su shɛlikam zaa zuɣu;.
en: the LORD will now strike your family, your children, your wives, and all your possessions with a heavy blow.

dag: Ka yi daa garigi yɛli ma, A ni lo shɛm maa viɛla.
en: You answered, That's a good idea.

dag: Ka a niriba yi bɔhi, Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ lee niŋ ti dimbɔŋɔnim zaa? Nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi ni daa zaɣisi ma, ka jɛmdi tinzun wuna yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, lala ka yi yɛn jɛm saamba tiŋgbɔn shɛli din pa yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni. .
en: And when they ask, Why has the LORD our God done all these things to us? you must reply, Just as you have abandoned me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve strangers in a land not your own.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka do so daa ti yi Baalishalisha n-ʒi bindir pala din nyɛ kapala bɔrɔbɔro kpil pisi mini kawaan maha o kpalaŋ ni na nti ti Naawuni nir maa. Ka Ilaisha daa yɛl o sɔŋda, Zaŋm li ti niriba maa ka bɛ ŋubi.
en: A man from Baal Shalishah came and brought bread from the first harvest to the man of God. This man brought loaves of barley bread and fresh grain in his sack. Then Elisha said, Give this food to the people, so that they can eat.

dag: O ʒila Salɛm, ka o biɛhigu shee nyɛ Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu.
en: His dwelling place became Salem; his habitation was Zion.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ yi mini yi ni pii yi na so ka o sun ya maa n-tahi yi mini yi yaannim ni daa bi mi zuliya shɛb sani, ka yi ti jɛmdi buɣa din nyɛ dari mini kuɣa.
en: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.

dag: Salima beni ka kuɣ viɛla pam din mali shaara beni, amaa noli din tɔɣisiri baŋsim yɛtɔɣa n-nyɛ binshɛli din viɛl gari di zaa.
en: Sensible words are better than gold or jewels.

dag: Nachimbili ni kpuɣiri paɣipiɛliga shɛm la, lala ka bɛn me a zali yɛn kpuɣ a. Aŋgo suhu ni piɛl o daamiliya zuɣu shɛm, lala ka a Naawuni suhu yɛn piɛl a zuɣu.
en: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.

dag: N ni zaŋ wumpaɣibo sara ti Yawɛ, ka jɛm o.
en: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.

dag: A ni wuhi Yaakubu ʒiɛyimtali, ka wuhi Ibrahimma ʒiɛyimtali din bi taɣira kaman a ni daa po pɔri yɛli ti yaannim shɛm kurimbuni ha la.
en: You will show your faithfulness and constant love to your people, the descendants of Abraham and of Jacob, as you promised our ancestors long ago.

dag: O yuri ni o yɛli noli din bie ti niriba. Chɛ ka noli di o. O je alibarika, dinzuɣu di chɛ ka alibarika mir o.
en: He loved to curse—may he be cursed! He hated to give blessings—may no one bless him!.

dag: Yawɛ, ŋmaligim na tiligi ma; fam ma bahi a yurilim din galisi la zuɣu.
en: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord .

dag: n-yiini Naawuni dabili Musa mini Piɛbil la yilli n-yɛra, Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, Zallakudura Naa, a tuma nyɛla tuun kara ni alahiziba tuma! Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, ŋun nyɛ ʒiɛmani kam Naa ŋɔ, a soya nyɛla din tuhi, ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋli!.
en: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.

dag: Bɛ daa lihiya, amaa ka so daa kani ŋun ni tiligi ba. Bɛ daa fabili niŋ Yawɛ, amaa ka o daa bi garigi ba.
en: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Zuliya ayi m-be a pul maa ni. Niriba ayi ka a ti yɛn dɔɣi, ka bɛ ni ti woligi. Yino ni ti mali kpiɔŋ gari yino; ka kpɛm ni ti ŋmaligi jɛm biasani.
en: And the LORD said to her, Two nations are in your womb; two different peoples will emerge from your body. One people will be stronger than the other; the older will serve the younger.

dag: Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka bɛ niŋ tipawumli, ka lo tɔbu kana ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima ni di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ku bɛ zaa n-kpihim bɛ birili, ka ku zo ba nambɔɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm la.
en: Their stubborn resistance came from the LORD and led them to wage war against Israel. Israel was then able to wipe them out as something reserved for God, without showing them any mercy. This was exactly what the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Kul teemiya bɛn be sarika ni yɛla ka di be kaman yi mini ba ka bɛ laɣim kpɛhi sarika maa la. Teemiya bɛn diri wahala yɛla ka di be kaman yi mini ba n-laɣim diri wahala maa la.
en: Dont forget those who are in prison. Remember them as though you were in prison with them. And dont forget those who are suffering. Remember them as though you were suffering with them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi Izraɛlnim maa tooni guui kpa mɔɣu polo, amaa bɛ daa bi tooi zo n-tiligi. Bɛn daa yi tiŋ maa puuni na la daa taɣi ba niŋ sunsuuni n-ku bɛ zaa.
en: The men of Benjamin headed down the road toward the desert, trying to escape from the Israelites. But the Israelites stayed right behind them, keeping up their attack. Men even came out of the nearby towns to help kill the men of Benjamin.

dag: Ninsal niŋgbuŋ ni nyɛ zaɣ yini, amaa ka mali yaɣ bɔbili ka di zaa tuma bi nyɛ yim la.
en: We have many parts in one body, but the parts dont all have the same function.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka kpuɣi paɣ so tum zina o ni yihi paɣ so maa sani.
en: He said to them, Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.

dag: Di ni chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka m bɔhi biɛri. N chɛ o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa ʒim pa tampiŋ maa zuɣu din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku niŋ taŋkpaɣu pi li.
en: But I have seen that blood, and it cries out for me to take revenge.

dag: Amaa di ni shɛba ni ti gali, bɛ ni ti yihi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi ka bɛ ka n sanna, ka a yi ti nya bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ tuma, a suhu ni maai zaŋ chaŋ n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa zaa lu Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu maa polo.
en: And those who survive will be taken from their country and led here to Babylonia. Ezekiel, when you see how sinful they are, you will know why I did all these things to Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ kpirila ninvuɣ kaha, ka bɛ nyɛviya bahigu nyɛla vi bahigu.
en: So they die young in shameful disgrace.

dag: Samla ni daa ti kpi, Shaul ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛhɔbɔt, tin shɛli din be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili polo nir la n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: after Samlah's death, Shaul from the town of Rehoboth on the Euphrates River became king;.

dag: Gban shɛli Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ni daa sabi ti Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana ni gbansabira ni baŋda so ŋun daa mi Yawɛ zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka nyɛ o ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti Izraɛlnim la viɛnyɛliŋga m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Emperor Artaxerxes gave the following document to Ezra, the priest and scholar, who had a thorough knowledge of the laws and commands which the Lord had given to Israel:.

dag: Yi pun zaɣisi ma, ka chɛ ma jɛmbu ka di waɣa, ka yɛra, Ti ku jɛm a. Yi daa jɛm buɣa daboli kam din du zuɣu mini ti mahali kam gbini.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, Israel, long ago you rejected my authority; you refused to obey me and worship me. On every high hill and under every green tree you worshiped fertility gods.

dag: Yi mini Masia ni mali simdi la zuɣu, yi nya binshɛɣukam pam o zuɣu hal zaŋ tabili yɛtɔɣa mini baŋsim zaa.
en: In him you have been blessed in every way. You have been blessed in all your speaking and all your knowledge.

dag: Di ni daa tiɣ o nini ni o kahig o Bia wuhi ma ka di chɛ ka n yih o yɛla waazu ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianim la, n daa bi niŋ so saawara.
en: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.

dag: Chɛ ka o paɣa leei pakoli, ka o bihi leei kpibisi.
en: Let his children become orphans and his wife a widow.

dag: Musa ni daa wum li, o daa teemi dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa.
en: When Moses heard this, he fell on his face.

dag: Yinim Jɛshurunnima, so kani ŋ-ŋmani yi Naawuni ŋun yi zuɣusaa na ni o ti sɔŋ ya ka nyɛ ŋun yi sagbana ni na ni jilima ŋɔ. Naawuni so ŋun ka bahigu ŋɔ n-nyɛ yi sɔɣisili shee.
en: Israel, no other god is like ours— the clouds are his chariot as he rides across the skies to come and help us.

dag: Dama di pala ŋun paɣ omaŋa n-nyari paɣibu, amaa ti Duuma ni paɣ so n-nyari paɣibu.
en: It isnt the person who promotes himself or herself who is approved but the person whom the Lord commends.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Na so ŋun mali jilima maa? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ Na so ŋun mali jilima maa.
en: Who is this glorious king? The LORD of heavenly forces— he is the glorious king! Selah.

dag: N nyaya ka sokam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa dolila nachimbil so ŋun di nam zani naa zaani.
en: I thought about all the people who live in this world, and I realized that somewhere among them there is a young man who will take the king's place.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka niriba maa daŋ yiɣisibu me bimbini zali nimaani, ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara.
en: Early the next day, the Israelites built an altar. They put burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to God on that altar.

dag: Duhimaŋtali lihigu mini karimbaani suhu nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri firila, ka nyɛ alahichi.
en: Prideful eyes, an arrogant heart, and the lamp of the wicked are all sinful.

dag: Dama mani n-yihi bɛ ni zaŋ bimbihili shɛli gahigahi la mini bɛ ni zaŋ nudirigu gbali shɛli mali Izraɛlnim suhudoo sara la Izraɛlnim sani n-zaŋ li ti Aduna min o bidibisi maa, ka di leei bɛ ni su shɛli ʒiɛman kam ni.
en: The breast of the animal is a special gift, and the right hind leg is a special contribution that the Lord has taken from the people of Israel and given to the priests. This is what the people of Israel must give to the priests for all time to come.

dag: Ka wula ka nir yɛn niŋ? Dama bɛ ni wum ni a kana.
en: What about this? Without a doubt, they will hear that you have arrived.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala naai ka o ŋmaligi yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Ti zo Lazarɔs gbihirimi, amaa n chanimi ni n ti neeg o o gom maa ni.
en: Jesus said this and then added, Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I will go and wake him up.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mali m biɛhigu shee dundɔŋ ka zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesanim din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinahinaanahi n-yil li zaŋ labi nudirigu polo.
en: For the Tent of my presence make an enclosure out of fine linen curtains. On the south side the curtains are to be yards long.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be sagban ni n-siɣina ti zani suɣili maa dunol ni, ka boli Aduna mini Miriam, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa kana ti zani.
en: The Lord came down in the tall cloud and stood at the entrance to the Tent. He called out, Aaron and Miriam! They went to him.

dag: N yi bili kpiŋkpama yiɣi kpa wulimpuhili polo n-chaŋ ti be teeku tariga.
en: If I go east where the sun rises or go to live in the west beyond the sea.

dag: Miri ka a tam ka bi paɣi Naawuni o tuma zuɣu, dama niriba pun yiinila wumpaɣibo yila zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.

dag: A yɛligu baŋbu nyɛla din tiri neesim. Di chɛmi ka tarim nyari baŋsim.
en: As people understand your word, it brings light to their lives. Your word makes even simple people wise.

dag: dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka soya niŋ Mɔab luɣili zuɣu tintariga tinsi din nyɛ Bɛtijɛshimɔt mini Baalimiɔn ni Kiriataim din nyɛ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa jilima tinsi la ni.
en: So I will let Moab's fortress towns along its border be attacked, including Beth-Jeshimoth, Baal-Meon, and Kiriathaim.

dag: Ka o daa ti kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya Farisiinim dabindi mini Naa Hɛrɔd dabindi la.
en: Take care, Jesus warned them, and be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ ŋun taɣi Gihɔn zuɣusaa polo kulibɔŋ la kom zali ka ŋmaligi li ka di zɔri chani Dauda tiŋ la wulinluhili polo. Hɛzɛkia daa di nasara o tuuni kam puuni.
en: It was Hezekiah who stopped up the upper source of the waters of the Gihon Spring in Jerusalem and made the waters flow straight down on the west side of the City of David. And he was successful in everything he did.

dag: Yaa n Duuma, Izraɛlnim yi ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ka ti dimnim nya ti kpaya, wula ka n lee lan yɛn yɛli?.
en: I promise by my life, Lord! There is nothing I can say now. Israel has surrendered to the enemy.

dag: Kaman man ni nya shɛm, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔri zaɣ biɛɣu puu, ka biriti yɛlimuɣisira, dina ka bɛ ti yɛn chɛra.
en: As Ive observed, those who plow sin and sow trouble will harvest it.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ binnyɔɣ shɛli a ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa maa mini maligumaaniba leebu piɛlaa maa gbalipuɣ shɛli a ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa maa ti Aduna min o bidibisi maa.
en: When a priest is ordained, the breast and the thigh of the ram being used for the ordination are to be dedicated to me as a special gift and set aside for the priests.

dag: Taai Naa Hiram n-daa bo sida mini sipirɛs dari ni salim shɛli Naa Sulemaana ni daa bɔri ni o zaŋ tum o tuma maa ti o. Ka Sulemaana mi daa zaŋ Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni fɔntinsi pisi ti Naa Hiram.
en: Hiram supplied Solomon with all the cedar, pine and gold that he wanted, so Solomon gave him cities in Galilee.

dag: Bi so ŋun buɣisi ni o yɛli noli ti o ba bee o ma o firila ni kpi bumbɔn ni.
en: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.

dag: Manaasa yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihinunaanu.
en: Manasseh was years old when he became king, and he ruled for fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ yɛrigi pil li, ka zaŋ chinchin sabilitim yirigi pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: Then they must cover all of this with covering made from fine leather. Then they must spread the solid blue cloth over the leather and put the poles in the rings on the Holy Box.

dag: M mabihi, yi yi nya ka so tum alahichi, di niŋ kamaata ni yinim bɛn mali Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu ŋɔ zaŋ tarimtali biɛhigu yiɣis o zali. Ka lihimiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga, dama di pa shɛli ka yi gba ti nya zahimbu.
en: My friends, if someone is caught in any kind of wrongdoing, those of you who are spiritual should set him right; but you must do it in a gentle way. And keep an eye on yourselves, so that you will not be tempted, too.

dag: Ka salo maa daa nya Yisa ni chaŋ ti kpe Zakius yiŋ maa ka ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni yɛra, O chaŋ ti kpe alahichilan la yiŋa.
en: Everyone who saw this started grumbling, This man Zacchaeus is a sinner! And Jesus is going home to eat with him.

dag: O ni yɛn doli so shɛli kana, dina ka o ti lan yɛn ŋmaligi dol labi ka ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ ni na. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: He will go back by the same road he came, without entering this city. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka ti daa kuhi niŋ Yawɛ, ka o wum ti kuhigu maa ka daa tim o malaika na ka o ti yihi ti Ijipti maa na, ka ti kana ti be Kadɛshi tin shɛli din miri a tintariga la.
en: and we cried out to the LORD. He heard our voice, sent a messenger, and brought us out of Egypt. Now here we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of your border.

dag: A yi ti chɛ ka bɛ piɛbi kika biɛɣu, bɛn suɣa be wulimpuhili polo la bɛn yiɣisim gbaai chandi.
en: When you blow a series of short blasts, the camp on the east side will march.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ ti Duuma tɛha bee ŋuni n-lee nyɛ o saawaralana?.
en: As the scripture says, Who knows the mind of the Lord? Who is able to give him advice?.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa baŋ ni Yawɛ n-zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka duh o nam maa ŋun Naawuni niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: Then David knew that the LORD had established him as king over Israel, and that his kingship was held in great honor for the sake of his people Israel.

dag: ka lan me n-gili Bɛtizur mini Soko ni Adulam.
en: Beth-Zur, Soco, Adullam.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Dama Daadam Bia n-su Vuhim Dabisili dali gba. .
en: The Human One is Lord of the Sabbath.

dag: Ka Lamɛk daa yɛl o paɣiba, Ada mini Zilla, wummiya: Yinim Lamɛk paɣiba, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ: N kula do so ŋun ti ma daŋa. N kula nachimbil so ŋun ŋme ma.
en: One day, Lamech said to his two wives, A young man wounded me, and I killed him.

dag: A nuu ni ka n zaŋ n shia niŋ; Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim ŋɔ, nyini n-daa tiligi ma.
en: I place myself in your care. You will save me, Lord ; you are a faithful God.

dag: a yi yɛli, Nyama, ti di bi mi dimbɔŋɔ. Ŋun mi din be ninsal suhu ni la nya li. Ŋun gul a bi mi li? O ku yo nira o tuma samli?.
en: You may say that it is none of your business, but God knows and judges your motives. He keeps watch on you; he knows. And he will reward you according to what you do.

dag: Bɛ guurimi kaman tɔbutuhiriba la; ka duri goma kaman tɔbbihi la. Bɛ zaa mi kul dolila bɛ soya, ka bɛ taɣiri bɔba.
en: The soldiers run fast. They climb over the walls. Each soldier marches straight ahead. They dont move from their path.

dag: Amaa yi yi nyɛla bɛn dimdi taba, ka vandi taba, yin miriya ka yi ti bahi tab yoli zaa.
en: But if you bite and devour each other, be careful that you dont get eaten up by each other!.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa lab kulina maa mini bɛnkam zaa daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ bali bɛ ni, ka woligi bɛmaŋ ka chɛ zuliya shɛb bɛn daa be nimaani daɣiri tuma ni bɛ jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni la zaa daa laɣim di li.
en: The Israelites who had returned from exile, together with all those who had joined them by separating themselves from the pollutions of the nations of the land to worship the LORD, the God of Israel, ate the Passover meal.

dag: Bɛ daa shɛla biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa yin ni ka lan she biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa din la gba ni. Biŋgolinsi maa daa domi tuhi taba.
en: There were loops on the end curtain in one group and loops on the end curtain in the other group. The loops were opposite each other.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti kpi, ka bɛ niŋ tim ʒe o niŋgbuŋ n-zaŋ o niŋ kum adaka ni Ijipti. O daa niŋ dunia yil la yuun kɔbiga ni pia.
en: So Joseph died in Egypt at the age of a hundred and ten. They embalmed his body and put it in a coffin.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kpe pam pali dunia hal ka zoya din du pam zaa ti lim.
en: The water rose so much that even the highest mountains were covered by the water.

dag: ni Yirɔn ni Migidalɛl ni Hɔrɛm ni Bɛtanat ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pisiyinika m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh. In all, there were towns and all the fields around them.

dag: Dindali maa di simdi ka yi moli molo, ka laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka di tumiya tuma, di nyɛla zaligu ʒiɛmani kam ni yi biɛhigu shee zaa.
en: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi bi kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma ku tooi niŋ n nyaandola.
en: Whoever will not carry the cross that is given to them when they follow me cannot be my follower.

dag: Ka Dauda daa me omaŋmaŋ ya o tiŋ maa ni, ka daa mali luɣ shɛli n-ti suɣili nimaani zali Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la.
en: David had several buildings built in Jerusalem, and he had a tent set up where the sacred chest would be kept.

dag: Ka o ni daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa maa, ka shia daa kpe n ni n-yiɣisi ma zali n naba zuɣu, ka n daa wum ka o yɛri ma;.
en: After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋla tiŋgbana ŋɔ zaa ti Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun nyɛ n dabili ŋɔ, ka zaŋ mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ti o ni bɛ jɛmd o.
en: Now I hand over all these countries to my servant King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon. I even give him the wild animals as subjects.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa yɛli Aizaia, Yawɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛli a ni yɛli maa viɛla. Dama o daa yɛlila o suhu ni, Suhudoo mini alaafee yi ni be n ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, di viɛla.
en: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, The LORDs word that youve spoken is good, because he thought: There will be peace and security in my lifetime.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, Amaŋmaŋ mi n ni tum shɛm ti a, ka lan mi n zuɣu ni chɛ ka a niɣi yɛligi shɛm.
en: Jacob answered: You've seen how hard I've worked for you, and you know how your flocks and herds have grown under my care.

dag: Amaa yinim Judanim zaa bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm. Yawɛ yɛliya, M po n yuli din galisi ŋɔ, Juda ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Ijipti ŋɔ so ku lan boli n yuli yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: But listen to the LORDs word, all you Judeans who live in the land of Egypt. I swear by my great name, says the LORD, that no one from Judah living in Egypt will utter my name again, even in the solemn pledge: As surely as the LORD God lives.

dag: Ka niriba yi mi ni nahu maa pun ʒiɛrila o taba ka o lan maa bi lɔr o zaana, dindina o ni bo nahu yo nahu maa zuɣu, ka zaŋ naɣ kpiŋ maa.
en: But if it was known that the bull had been in the habit of attacking and its owner did not keep it penned up, he must make good the loss by giving the other man a live bull, but he may keep the dead animal.

dag: A mi kparibuhi ni dɔɣiri saha shɛli? A na mi n-nya saŋkpaliŋ ni dɔɣiri shɛm?.
en: Do you know when the mountain goats are born? Do you watch when the mother deer gives birth?.

dag: Lala ka o daa niŋ ti Iso zuliya bɛn be Ɛdom la, o daa kula Hɔrinima ka chɛ ka bɛ deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒini n-zani bɛ zaani hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Lord had done the same thing for the Edomites, the descendants of Esau, who live in the hill country of Edom. He destroyed the Horites, so that the Edomites took over their land and settled there, where they still live.

dag: Ka Mikaya garigi yɛl o, Nyama, dahin shɛli a ni ti yɛn zo nti sɔɣ a dudoonigu ni, ka a ni baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Micaiah answered, You will find out on the day you try to hide in an inner room.

dag: Ammɔnnim ni daa lo tɔb na ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim saha shɛli maa, ka Giliad kpamba daa chaŋ Tɔb tiŋgban ni ni bɛ ti zaŋ Jɛfita na.
en: And when the Ammonites attacked Israel, Gileads elders went to bring Jephthah back from the land of Tob.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Lɛvi zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Isaka zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi.
en: , from Simeon, , from Levi, , from Issachar.

dag: Ka Abijam daa ti leei ŋun kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Asa daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Abijam lay down with his ancestors; he was buried in Davids City. His son Asa succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka sapashin kpeen so ŋun daa ʒe nimaani nya Yisa ni daa kuhi lala ka bahi maa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia.
en: The army officer who was standing there in front of the cross saw what happened when Jesus died. The officer said, This man really was the Son of God.

dag: ka lan fari pakoya yinsi, ka suhiri Naawuni yuuri ni niriba tɛhi ni bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma la. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim ni ti nya tibidarigibo pam.
en: But they cheat widows out of their homes and then pray long prayers just to show off. These teachers will be punished most of all.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naaman kɔŋ maa ni lu a min a bihi zuɣu n-kul maliya sahakam! Ka Gɛhaazi daa ŋmalig o sani n-yi ni kɔŋa; ka o niŋgbuna dii paligi laɣilaɣi kaman gumbɔrigu la.
en: Naamans skin disease will now cling to you and to your descendants forever! And Gehazi left Elishas presence, flaky like snow with skin disease.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni Judanim ni ti tiligi, ka Jɛrusalɛmnim mi ti be ni alaafee. Ka bɛ ni ti yɛn booni li yu shɛli n-nyɛ: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti wuntia.
en: The people of Judah and of Jerusalem will be rescued and will live in safety. The city will be called The Lord Our Salvation.

dag: Ka sokam daa chaŋ ti zaŋ o suhu ni kul yu ni o zaŋ shɛli na ti ti Yawɛ, ka bɛ zaŋ tum Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tuma mini neen shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ tumdi tuma di puuni ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛŋa she binyɛr kasi la.
en: Then those who wanted to bring gifts to the Lord , brought them to be used for the sacred tent, the worship services, and the priestly clothes.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa mini ʒii ŋɔ yɛla zaa kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Nathan reported all of these words and this entire vision to David.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛli, Nyamiya o ni yuri Lazarɔs shɛm.
en: And the Jews said, Look! He loved Lazarus very much.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋunkam yɛn nyu bara, ŋun nyum li la ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: But as the scripture says, Whoever wants to boast must boast about what the Lord has done.

dag: ka yi nini daa nya zahimbu kara mini shihir kara ni alahiziba tuun kara la.
en: You saw the great troubles he gave them. You saw the miracles and amazing things he did.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim yi ni tum n ni zali ba ni bɛ tum shɛm, ka gbibi n ni daa zaŋ n zaligu shɛŋa zaa ti Musa ni o ti ba la, dindina n ku lan chɛ ka bɛ vuui bɛ napɔŋ yi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti bɛ yaannim la ni.
en: I will never again remove Israel from the fertile land I gave to your ancestors, provided they carefully do everything I have commanded them—keeping all the Instruction, the regulations, and the case laws given through Moses.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi mini niriba lala tatabo be.
en: So you shouldnt have anything to do with them.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim noya lan woli.
en: There was another division among the Jews because of Jesus words.

dag: Ibrahimma daa kurigiya pam, ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: Abraham lived to be a very old man. The Lord blessed him and everything he did.

dag: Zibisim titali n-nyɛ bɛ daazichi n-doya guli ba, ka buɣim din pa so ni mali shɛli ni ti di ba. Ka binshɛlikam din ti kpalim bɛ yinsi ni ti di buɣim.
en: Everything they have saved is destroyed; a fire not lit by human hands burns them and all their family.

dag: ka lan zaŋ jɛsint mini agɛt ni amɛtisit la m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir ata.
en: in the third row, a turquoise, an agate, and an amethyst;.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni di leei yi fali shɛli yi ni yɛn su la ni, ka yi deei li su n-ʒini di ni.
en: The Lord is giving you the land, and soon you will conquer it, settle down.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun daa zaŋ pina ti ninsalinim la. O pii shɛb leela tuumba, ka pii shɛb leeg anabinima, ka pii shɛb leei Masia lahibal suŋ molomooniba, ka pii shɛb leei pastanima, ka pii shɛb mi leei karimbanima.
en: Christ chose some of us to be apostles, prophets, missionaries, pastors, and teachers.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ paɣa n-tin ya, amaa ka do so zaŋ o dɔni, yi ni ti me yi yili ka bi kpe di ni. Yi ni ti sa yi wain tihi, ka ku di di wala.
en: You will be engaged to a woman, but another man will have sexual relations with her. You will build a house, but you will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard, but you will not gather anything from it.

dag: Ŋuni ka m mal alizanda ni pah a zuɣu? Ka binshɛli mi ka dunia ŋɔ ni ka m bɔri li pah a zuɣu.
en: Do I have anyone else in heaven? Theres nothing on earth I desire except you.

dag: A yi lo alikauli ka bi pal li, dindina a yi bi lo li, di so.
en: Better not to make a promise than to make a promise without fulfilling it.

dag: Yuŋ zahima yɛla tɛhibu puuni, saha shɛli niriba ni gbihi maai la.
en: Like a bad dream in the night, it ruined my sleep.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim daa pirigila buyi; bɛ pirigili daa bɔri ni bɛ zaŋla Ginat bia Tibini leei naa, ka pirigili mi bɔri ni bɛ zaŋla Omri leei naa.
en: After Zimri died, some of the Israelites wanted Tibni son of Ginath to be king, but others wanted Omri.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim nyɛla tarimba, bɛ ka yɛm, dama bɛ bi mi Yawɛ soli din nyɛ bɛ Naawuni zaligu la.
en: But I said to myself, It must be only the poor who are so foolish. They have not learned the way of the Lord . They dont know the teachings of their God.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Tiŋ kani ka a lee yina? Ŋuni n-lee su a? Ka o garigi yɛli, N nyɛla Ijipti nachimbila, ka nyɛ ŋun tumdi Amalɛk do so tuma. N daa kala alaafee, ka ŋun su ma maa chɛ ma bahi ka chaŋ, di zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ.
en: David asked the Egyptian, Who is your master? Where do you come from? The Egyptian answered, I am an Egyptian, the slave of an Amalekite. Three days ago I got sick, and my master left me behind.

dag: O daa bi wuhiri ba shɛli ka pa ni yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni, amaa di daa yi ti kpalim o min o nyaandoliba maa ko, o kahigirila binshɛɣukam gbinni wuhiri ba.
en: He did not tell them anything without using stories. But when he was alone with his disciples, he explained everything to them.

dag: Chamiya Saipurus teeku noli ti nya, ka timiya Kɛdar ka bɛ ti lihi viɛnyɛliŋga n-nya lala na mi n-niŋ.
en: of a crime that no nation has ever committed before. Just ask anyone, anywhere, from the eastern deserts to the islands in the west.

dag: Bɛ daa kul karitimi doli ti hal ka ti ti kɔŋ ti soya dolibu. Ti bahigu saha miriya; bɛ pun kali ti dabisa. Ti bahigu saha paaya.
en: Our enemies hunted us all the time. We could not even go out into the streets. Our end came near. Our time was up. Our end came!.

dag: Ka zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mali tahima o yuli zuɣu.
en: All nations will place their hope in him.

dag: Lala ka yi yaannim daa niŋ ka Naawuni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ti mini tiŋ ŋɔ la. Amaa ka yi lan tari Vuhim Dabisili maa daɣiri ni yi chɛ ka Naawuni suhu lan yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: This is exactly why God punished your ancestors when he brought destruction on this city. And yet you insist on bringing more of God's anger down on Israel by profaning the Sabbath.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri pun birigi ka na bela bɛ manim puya ni. Bɛ dɔɣibu saha ka bɛ pun birigi; ka nyɛ ʒiŋmariba.
en: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka paɣ maa daa nya ka o bia maa viɛli pam, ka o daa zaŋ o sɔɣiri hal ni chira ata.
en: and she later had a baby boy. He was a beautiful child, and she kept him inside for three months.

dag: Yi yi ti chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi tinsheenima, yin tɔɣisimiya ba suhumahili yɛtɔɣa.
en: When you go to attack a city, you must first offer peace to the people there.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Galimi dini ka yi yaannim daa lee nya n sani, ka zo n-chaŋ katiŋ ti jɛmdi binyoya ka chɛ ma, ka bɛ gba maŋmaŋ daa leei ninvuɣ yoya la?.
en: This is what the Lord says: Do you think that I was not fair to your ancestors? Is that why they turned away from me? Your ancestors worshiped worthless idols, and they became worthless themselves.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubi yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi.
en: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Malimiya shili, ka nyo yi firilanim zali ka di dira;.
en: Be ready! Be fully dressed and have your lights shining.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa guli Naa Sool Gibia din be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni la daa lihi nya ka Filistianim maa pam yiɣisi zɔri yiriŋ.
en: Saul's men on watch at Gibeah in the territory of Benjamin saw the Philistines running in confusion.

dag: Ŋun mali tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini, o bi mal li tɔɣisirila ninsalinima, amaa o mal li tɔɣisirila Naawuni, dama o tɔɣisirila yɛlisɔɣira Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, ka so bi mi o ni tɔɣisiri yɛl shɛŋa maa gbinni.
en: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.

dag: Chɛ ka maligumaaniba ayopɔin gbib piɛla yila kikah ayopɔin m-be Alikauli Adaka la tooni. Ka dabisi shɛli din ti pahir ayopɔin dali, nyin chɛ ka maligumaaniba maa zaŋ kikahi m-piɛbira, ka yi chaŋ gili Jɛriko maa napɔŋ buyopɔin.
en: Have seven priests carry seven trumpets made from rams horns in front of the chest. On the seventh day, circle the city seven times, with the priests blowing the trumpets.

dag: Ka Jɛtro daa wum Yawɛ ni niŋ zaɣ viɛl shɛli ti Izraɛlnim maa min o ni daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm maa, ka o suhu daa paligi pam.
en: Jethro was happy when he heard all the good things the Lord had done for Israel. He was glad that the Lord had freed the Israelites from the Egyptians.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa tim tuumba ka bɛ zo n-chaŋ o suɣili maa ni nti shiri nya ka di pi tiŋa ka anzinfa maa be di gbinni.
en: So Joshua sent some men to the tent. They ran to the tent and found the things hidden there. The silver was under the coat.

dag: Di lan sabi Naawuni Kundi ni yaha, Kum yi wum a dima, nyin dihim o; ka kɔnyuri yi wum o, nyin nyuhim o; dimbɔŋɔ niŋbu ni chɛ ka vi gbaag o.
en: Instead, If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him a drink. By doing this, you will pile burning coals of fire upon his head .

dag: Ka Pita lan chihi yaha; ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: Again Peter said No—and at once a rooster crowed.

dag: Ka di yi di nyɛla n niŋ o la zaɣ biɛɣu ka binshɛli mi bi sɔɣiri naa sani, di saha a ku zani n nyaaŋa.
en: If I had killed Absalom, the king himself would find out, and you would punish me. .

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm; chamiya ti yɛli m mabihi maa ni bɛ cham Galili; nimaani ka bɛ ni ti nya ma.
en: Do not be afraid, Jesus said to them. Go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee, and there they will see me.

dag: Kamiyana nti dinya nanim mini sapashinnim ni kpiɔŋlaannim ni yuri mini bɛn bari ba zaŋ tabili daadam kam bɛn nyɛ bilichinnim mini daba ni wɔɣira mini tarimba nimdi.
en: Come and eat the flesh of kings, generals, and soldiers, the flesh of horses and their riders, the flesh of all people, slave and free, great and small.

dag: Ka sokam zaa daa dii kab dol o m-piɛbiri yuhi, ka mali suhupiɛlli pam, ka tiŋgbani sɔhigi bɛ vuri yɔbu zuɣu.
en: Then all the people followed Solomon back into the city. They were very happy and excited. They were playing flutes and making so much noise that the ground shook.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga kam ŋun mali tarili Izraɛlnim daŋ shɛli puuni, di simdi ni o kulila o yaannim daŋ ni doo, ka lala chɛ ka Izraɛl nir kam kul su o yaannim fali tarili ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: Every daughter who inherits land from an Israelite tribe must marry into one of the clans of her fathers tribe. In this way each Israelite will own the land of his ancestors.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tuhi ba lala hal ti yaɣi Bɛtavɛn. Ka Yawɛ daa fa Izraɛlnim bahi dindali maa.
en: So the Lord saved the Israelites that day. The battle moved on past Beth Aven. The whole army was with Saul—he now had about , men. The battle spread to every city in the hill country of Ephraim.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi ni niŋ n dan maa din tuhi ni din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, yin yɛlim ma, ka yi yi ku niŋ o, yin lan yɛlim ma. Ka n zaŋ kpa n nudirigu polo bee n nuzaa polo.
en: Now, tell me, will you be kind and loyal to my master and give him your daughter? Or will you refuse to give her to him? Tell me so that I will know what I should do.

dag: Ka Ribɛka min o dab bipuɣinsi daa yiɣisi m-ba laakumnima n-doli nachin kpɛm maa ka o zaŋ o lu yiŋ soli.
en: Then Rebecca and her young women got ready and mounted the camels to go with Abraham's servant, and they all started out.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka o nina neei, ka o nya ka kɔbiliga doya, ka o daa chaŋ di ni nti tooi kom pal o kom koligu maa na nti booi li ti bia maa ka o nyu.
en: Then God let her see a well. So she went to the well and filled the skin with water, then gave some to her son.

dag: Ka o yɛli doo maa, Yihim li, ka o zaŋ o nuu tim ha yihi li.
en: Now get it, Elisha told him. And the prophet reached in and grabbed it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Pool tahi bɛ jintɔriba laɣiŋgu shee din yuli daa booni Ariɔpagus la ti yɛl o, Ti bɔri ni a wuhi ti wuhiri pal shɛli a ni wuhiri ŋɔ ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: So they took Paul, brought him before the city council, the Areopagus, and said, We would like to know what this new teaching is that you are talking about.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan labi pahi buyi ti suhiri Naawuni yɛra, M Ba, pipia ŋɔ yi ku miligi n zuɣu ka pa ni n nyu li mi, nyin chɛ ka a yubu n-niŋ.
en: Then Jesus went away a second time and prayed, My Father, if I must do this and it is not possible for me to escape it, then I pray that what you want will be done.

dag: Amɔn yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuma ayi Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Mɛshulɛmɛt. O daa nyɛla Haruzi ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔtiba nir la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for two years. His mother was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz from the town of Jotbah.

dag: Ka Mikaya daa yɛli ba o ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa saha shɛli Baruk ni daa karindi gbaŋ maa ka niriba maa wumdi maa.
en: Micaiah told them all the words he heard Baruch read from the scroll before the people.

dag: hal ka na bi dɔɣi ba, ka bihi maa mi na bi tum zaɣ suŋ bee zaɣ biɛɣu la, Naawuni daa yɛl o ni bikpɛm ni ti jɛm biasani. Naawuni daa niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka o ni piir o ninvuɣ gahinda shɛm zani, ka di nyɛla o bolibu zuɣu, ka pa ni bɛ tuma zuɣu.
en: When they hadnt been born yet and when they hadnt yet done anything good or bad, it was shown that Gods purpose would continue because it was based on his choice.

dag: Yi yi ni deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka dol o fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: but only if you carefully obey the LORD your Gods voice, by carefully doing every bit of this commandment that Im giving you right now.

dag: Ka Kɛnania ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya maa biŋkumdiŋmɛriba zuɣulan la daa nyɛ ŋun yɛn wuhiri bɛ ni yɛn ŋmɛri biŋkumda maa shɛm, dama ŋuna n-daa mi di ŋmɛbu.
en: Chenaniah was leader of the Levites who provided transportation, because he was skilled at it.

dag: Mɛlikizɛdɛk daa nyɛla Salɛm Naa mini Naawuni Zallakudura Naa maligumaana. Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa chaŋ ti tuhi nanim tɔbu n-nyaŋ ba ka labirina la, Mɛlikizɛdɛk ŋɔ n-daa tuh o soli niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: This Melchizedek, who was king of Salem and priest of the Most High God, met Abraham as he returned from the defeat of the kings, and Melchizedek blessed him.

dag: Amaa bomiya baaŋa ti ma na pumpɔŋɔ. Baaŋa maa ni daa ti yiini yila saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ yiko siɣi Ilaisha zuɣu na.
en: But now bring me someone who plays the harp. When the person played the harp, the Lord s power came on Elisha.

dag: To, ka yi yi ti nya ka Daadam Bia labiri o ni daa pun be luɣ shɛl la, wula ka di lee ni ti ben ya?.
en: Suppose, then, that you should see the Son of Man go back up to the place where he was before?.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa malila yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi duri tusaanahi. O daa malila yuri tuhi pinaayi, ka daa piripiri ba niŋ chɛchɛbunsi ni be tin shɛŋa ni, ka chɛ ka shɛb mi be ŋun naa sani Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Solomon also had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, together with twelve thousand horsemen that he kept in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.

dag: N niŋ yɛda ni n ni be hal ti nya Yawɛ ni yɛn niŋ alibarika niŋ o niriba ni shɛm.
en: I know that I will live to see the Lord 's goodness in this present life.

dag: dama alɔbo ni tooi yi bɛ sanna n-libig a, ka ŋuni n-lee mi bɛ ni yɛn tahi saɣiŋgu shɛl na?.
en: because people like that can quickly be destroyed. You have no idea how much trouble God and the king can make for their enemies.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A yuli? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N yuli m-booni Bɔbigu, dama ti galisiya.
en: Jesus asked, What is your name? The man answered, My name is Lots, because I have lots of evil spirits.

dag: Ka Mɔab kpamba maa daa yiɣisi labi Balak sani ti yɛl o, Balaam zaɣisiya ni o ku dol ti kana.
en: The officials left and told Balak that Balaam refused to come.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim daa nya zama maa, ka di niŋ ba nyuli ka bɛ ŋmɛri Pool ni tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa naŋgbankpeeni, ka tur o.
en: When the Jews there saw all these people, they became very jealous. Shouting insults, they argued against everything Paul said.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti nya o ka bɛ jɛm o; amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb biɛhim o.
en: They saw him and worshiped him, but some of them doubted.

dag: N ni daa kul ŋmaligi bɛ sani, di daa bi yuui ka n nya n suhu ni yuri so pam maa. Ka n daa gbaag o mali, ka bi saɣi bah o ka o chaŋ. Ka n daa zaŋ o kuli m ma yiŋa nti zaŋ o kpe ŋun daa zali m pua duu.
en: As soon as I left them, I found him. I held him and wouldn't let him go until I took him to my mother's house, to the room where I was born.

dag: O tihi nyɔŋ maa ni tihi din kpalim ni nyɛla biɛla, hal ka bia ni tooi kal li.
en: There will be so few trees left that even a child will be able to count them.

dag: Ka a chɛ ka a min a bidibisi maa kpe yi duu ka yo yimaŋ niŋ di puuni, ka zaŋ kpam maa m-boori niŋdi ŋmana maa ni; ŋman yini yi ti pali, ka yi vuui li zali kpaŋa.
en: go home and shut the door behind you and your sons. Then begin filling the jars with oil and set each one aside as you fill it.

dag: dama tiŋgbani kuumi tahi la, saa ni bi lan miri maa zuɣu, ka di niŋ pukpariba alahiziba, ka bɛ zaŋ bini pili bɛ zuɣuri.
en: There has been no rain, and farmers feel sick as they watch cracks appear in the dry ground.

dag: Bɛ daa nyuri binnyura maa dolila zaligu ni wuhi shɛm. Bɛ daa bi muɣisi so ni o nyu li; dama naa maa daa pun yɛl o yiŋbihi ni bɛ tim sokam wain maa kaman bɛ ni bɔri li shɛm tariga.
en: The king had given a command to his servants. He told them that each guest must be given as much wine as he wanted, and the wine server obeyed the king.

dag: Bɛ ni ti leeni taŋkpaɣu kaman wahu la bee kaman tiŋgban ni biŋgbamda la. Bɛ ni ti yi bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa na ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ ti ŋmaligi ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sanna ni dabiɛm pam. Bɛ ni ti zɔr a dabiɛm.
en: They will crawl in the dust like a snake. They will shake with fear. They will be like insects crawling from their holes in the ground and coming to the Lord our God. God, they will fear and respect you!.

dag: Daabihi ni saɣi di o daa? Bɛ ni saɣi pirig o ti kɔhigɔriba?.
en: Will merchants sell him; will they divide him among traders?.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a nya alibarika, dama bɛ ku tooi niŋ a lala labisi. Amaa ka a lee ti nya laara wuntizɔriba kum ni neebu dali.
en: and you will be blessed, because they are not able to pay you back. God will repay you on the day the good people rise from death.

dag: Di veeni ni nir kul maag o ni baalim guhiri Yawɛ tiliginsim.
en: Its good to wait in silence for the LORDs deliverance.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni yili a yurilim maŋli la yila sahakam, n ni moli a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla molo ʒiɛmani kam zaa niriba sani.
en: O Lord , I will always sing of your constant love; I will proclaim your faithfulness forever.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi nimaani kul o ya, ka o nyaandoliba daa dol o.
en: Jesus left and returned to his hometown with his disciples.

dag: Ka bɛn daa mali Pool tahiri maa daa zaŋ o hal ti paai Atɛnsi, ka Pool yɛli ba ni bɛ yi lab kuli bɛn yɛlimi Silas mini Timoti ni bɛ yi nya soli bɛn paam o na yomyom. Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lab kuli.
en: Some men went with Paul as far as Athens, and then returned with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible.

dag: Dama o shiri timla Babilɔn na ti yɛli ti, Di ni yuui pam. Mɛmiya yiya m-be di ni, ka kɔnya puri n-diri di bindira. .
en: Jeremiah has sent this message to us in Babylon: You people in Babylon will be there for a long time, so build houses and settle down. Plant gardens and eat what you grow.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: Grace and peace to all of you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Ti dunia ŋɔ ni banim daa saɣisi ti saha biɛla puuni kaman bɛ ni tɛhi ni di tuhiya shɛm zuɣu; amaa Naawuni niŋdi lala la ti zaɣ viɛlli nyabu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti min o laɣim mal o biɛrikasitali.
en: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.

dag: ka yɛl o suhu ni, Iso yi kana ti ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tooni ŋɔ, bɛn doli nyaaŋa la ni zo n-tiligi.
en: He thought, If Esau meets the first camp and attacks it, at least one camp will be left to escape.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti miri tiŋkpan shɛli bɛ ni kuni maa, ka o ŋmani ŋun bɔri ni o garila tooni.
en: When the two of them came near the village where they were going, Jesus seemed to be going farther.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam ti niŋ suhukpeeni hal ni wahala ŋɔ bahigu ni ti tiligi.
en: But whoever holds out to the end will be saved.

dag: To, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisifu kuli Ijipti, ka tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa guli Firawuna la sapashin kpɛm ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti nir ka o yuli booni Pɔtifa la daa da o Ishimail zuliya bɛn daa ʒi o kuli nimaani maa sani.
en: The Ishmaelites took Joseph to Egypt and sold him to Potiphar, the king's official in charge of the palace guard.

dag: Ka Nabal daa garigi bɔhi Dauda tuumba maa, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Dauda? Ka ŋuni mi n-lee nyɛ Jɛsi bia? Pumpɔŋɔ daba pam kul zɔrimi ka chɛri bɛ laamba.
en: This is what he said: Who does this David think he is? That son of Jesse is just one more slave on the run from his master, and there are too many of them these days.

dag: Ka Juda daa ti nya Keenan do so ŋun yuli daa booni Shua la bipuɣiŋga n-kpuɣ o; ka daa zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Judah met a Canaanite girl there and married her. The girls father was named Shua.

dag: Daniɛl daa lo o suhu ni ni o ku di nayili bindirigu maa bee n-nyu wain shɛli naa ni daa nyurila n-saɣim omaŋa; dinzuɣu ka o daa suhi namɔɣilisi kpɛm maa n-yɛl o ni o bi lo ni o saɣim omaŋa nayili bindirigu maa dibu ni, lala zuɣu ni o sɔŋm o.
en: Daniel decided that he wouldnt pollute himself with the kings rations or the royal wine, and he appealed to the chief official in hopes that he wouldnt have to do so.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka tɔbbihi maa chɛ Pool ti wɔribariba la ni bɛ zaŋ o tahi, ka bɛn daa ŋmaligi lab bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: The following day they let the horsemen continue on with Paul while they returned to the military headquarters in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Aduna bidibisi la na nti zaŋ zabbanim yɛli ba, ka zaŋ shɛlɔriti lo bɛ shɛhi ni, ka zaŋ zuɣupila pil ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Then Moses brought Aarons sons forward. He put their woven shirts on them, tied belts around them, and put cloth caps on their heads. He did everything just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Ka kikaa maa kumsi vuri daa maan pahi, ka Musa daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka Naawuni garig o satahiŋga puuni.
en: The blasts of the horn grew louder and louder. Moses would speak, and God would answer him with thunder.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, So ʒi n-nyo firila zaŋ lɔɣu pil li bee n-zaŋ li sɔɣi, amaa o naɣ ni zaŋ li mi tam binshɛl zuɣu ni bɛnkam kpɛri yili maa ni na nyari li.
en: No one takes a light and puts it under a bowl or hides it. Instead, they put it on a lampstand so that the people who come in can see.

dag: Izar bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Kɔra mini Nɛfɛg ni Zikiri.
en: Izhar had three sons: Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.

dag: Bɛ chanila bɛ zaɣim, ka ka situra, ka ʒiri kabɔba, ka kum mali ba.
en: They have no clothes, so they work naked. They carry piles of grain for others, but they go hungry.

dag: Nir ni tooi dɔɣi bihi kɔbiga, ka beni n-yuui pam, hal o yi yuui ti yaɣi gba, amaa ka bi di dunia ŋɔ binyara nyaɣisim, ka ti bi nya sɔɣiri viɛlli, dindina man ni yɛli shɛm nyɛla, Zaŋbahi so o.
en: We may have a hundred children and live a long time, but no matter how long we live, if we do not get our share of happiness and do not receive a decent burial, then I say that a baby born dead is better off.

dag: Amaa n niriba dimnim yi bɔri ni n tiligi ba, dindina bɛn niŋmi sandaani niŋ ma, Iin, bɛn niŋmi sandaani niŋ ma.
en: Or let them cling to me for refuge; let them make peace with me; let them make peace with me.

dag: Hal m bi lan simdi ni a boli ma a bia gba; amaa lihim ma kaman a padiriba ŋɔ ni yino.
en: I am no longer fit to be called your son; treat me as one of your hired workers.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka tiligira so lan kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: I, I am the LORD, and there is no savior besides me.

dag: Di saha kopaliga din mali kpiɔŋ daa naan du ti gari.
en: Those proud people would have been like water rising up to our mouth and drowning us.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa kari doli ba nti fa bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi, ka ku Sirianim maa pam.
en: King Ahab led the army and attacked all the horses and chariots. So King Ahab made the Arameans suffer a great defeat.

dag: Jafilɛt bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pasak mini Bimhal ni Ashivat. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Jafilɛt bidibisi.
en: Japhlets family: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. This is Japhlets family.

dag: Amalɛknim mini Keenannim ni gunya soli n-zaŋ takɔbiri kun ya; yi ni chɛ Yawɛ dolibu maa zuɣu, Yawɛ ku be yi sani.
en: The Amalekites and the Canaanites will be there in front of you and you will fall by the sword because you turned away from the LORD, and the LORD is no longer with you.

dag: Ka Musa daa kɔrig o n-zaŋ o ʒim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Moses slaughtered it, then tossed the blood against all sides of the altar.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa chaŋ bɛ wain puri ni ti pihi wain wala na nti kahim di kom niŋ wain n-zaŋ li chaŋ bɛ wuni jɛmbu duu ti puhi chuɣu nimaani, ka diri ka nyura, ka turi Abimilɛk.
en: They went out into the field, cut off clusters from their vineyards, trampled them out, and had a celebration. They entered their gods temple and ate, drank, and made fun of Abimelech.

dag: amaa ti shɛli din chɛri ka nir baŋdi zaɣ suŋ mini zaɣ biɛɣu la, miri ka a di li, dama a yi ti di li dahin shɛli, a ni kpi.
en: but dont eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, because on the day you eat from it, you will die.

dag: Bɛ leela ninvuɣ diɣilima bɛn bi zɔri vi. Bɛ tumdila kɔr biɛri tuma, ka bɛ suhuri kul yɛla daɣiri tuma balibu kam tumbu zuɣu.
en: They have lost their feeling of shame and use their lives to do what is morally wrong. More and more they want to do all kinds of evil.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ pia puuni ninvuɣ yino yi kpalim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, bɛ ni ku o gba. O ni bemi kaman oki ti shɛli bɛ ni ŋma n-luhi ka chɛ di tigbirigu. Tigbirigu maa nyɛla bimbirili din be kasi din ni lan zooi yaha.
en: If only a tenth of the people are left, even they will be destroyed. But just as stumps remain after trees have been cut down, some of my chosen ones will be left.

dag: amaa milinsi din pali la yi ti kana, milinsi din bi pali zaa ŋɔ ni vuui.
en: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Juda paɣ ŋun daa nyɛ Shua bipuɣiŋga la daa kpi. O ni daa mal o kuli naai nyaaŋa ka o min o zo Hira ŋun daa nyɛ Adulam nir la chaŋ Timna ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chɛr o piɛri kɔbiri la sani.
en: After a long time, Judahs wife the daughter of Shua died. Then, after a period of mourning, he and his neighbor Hirah the Adullamite went up to Timnah, to those who were shearing his sheep.

dag: nti zaŋ tulaale zim maa niŋ buɣim maa ni Yawɛ tooni, ka chɛ ka di nyɔhi tuɣi kpe bimpindigu din pili Alikauli Adaka la, di yi pa lala o ni kpi.
en: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Naa Jɛhoyakim ŋun nyɛ Juda naa Jɔsia bia la polo m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ti ku fabili o zuɣu yɛli, Mbaye, m mabia! Mbaye, m mabia! Bɛ mi ti ku fabili o zuɣu n-yɛli, Mbaye, n dana! Mbaye, n naa.
en: Jehoiakim, no one will mourn at your funeral. They won't turn to each other and ask, Why did our great king have to die.

dag: Ka bɔ n-daa lee niŋ ka a bi zaŋ n liɣiri maa ti sɔŋ banki ni? N ni di kuli ŋɔ na, n naan ku nya nyɔri pahi n laɣidaya maa zuɣu.
en: Why then didnt you put my money in the bank? Then when I arrived, at least I could have gotten it back with interest.

dag: Pɛka ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Pekah did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: O ni lo a alikauli ni a zaŋm o leeg a tumtumda sahakam?.
en: Will it surrender as a slave for life?.

dag: Dama nir yi kpi, o ku lan teeg a yɛla; ka ŋuni n-ni tooi paɣ a gballi ni?.
en: In the world of the dead you are not remembered; no one can praise you there.

dag: Bɛ daa chɛ ka o zabi nyuli tinzun wuna zuɣu, ka daa lan niŋ binshɛŋa din chihira n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi.
en: They made God jealous with strange gods, aggravated him with detestable things.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim la daa kul tahiri bindira na ti tiri Naa Sulemaana mini bɛnkam zaa dir o yiŋa, bɛ zaa yinoyino ni o ni su gol shɛli, bɛ mi daa bi chɛri ka binshɛli poor o.
en: The officials provided King Solomon and all who joined him at the royal table with monthly food rations. They left out nothing.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata naabu saha, ka di daa ti niŋ daliri ka Shimɛi daba niriba ayi yi o sani n-zo n-chaŋ Maaka bia Akishi ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat naa la sani. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Shimɛi, Nyama, a daba la be Gaat.
en: About three years later, two of Shimei's servants ran off to King Achish in Gath. When Shimei found out where they were.

dag: Amaa ka n daa kul timdi n daba bɛn zaa nyɛ anabinim la yi sanna ti yɛri ya, Jaande, miriya ka yi tum din chihiri shɛli n ni je.
en: I sent my servants, the prophets, to those people again and again. They spoke my message and said to the people, Dont do this terrible thing. I hate for you to worship idols.

dag: n-zaŋ bunsi maa na nti zaŋ bɛ binyɛra pa bɛ yaansi zuɣu, ka Yisa ba.
en: they brought the donkey and the colt, threw their cloaks over them, and Jesus got on.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn ka yɛm hal ti kpi, ka shɛb di bɛ nɛma fali.
en: The ropes of their tent are pulled up, and they die before gaining wisdom.

dag: Ŋunkam chɛ ka o mini biŋkɔbigu dɔni, yin kum o.
en: Anyone who has sexual relations with an animal should be put to death.

dag: Ka mmaŋmaŋ ti zaŋ o ʒili tiŋgbani maa ni. Ka Kunyanambɔzɔbo ni ti nya nambɔzɔbo n sani, ka n ni ti yɛli Panniriba, Yi nyɛla n niriba; ka bɛ mi ni ti yɛli, Nyini n-nyɛ ti Naawuni. .
en: I will scatter the seeds and show mercy to Lo-Ruhamah. I will say to Lo-Ammi, You are my people, and they will answer, You are our God.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi doli Yawɛ yɛligu maa? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zo yomyom chaŋ ti di nɛma, ka tum din bi tiɣi Yawɛ nini.
en: So why didnt you listen to the Lord ? You did what the Lord said is wrong because you wanted to keep what you took in battle.

dag: Reechɛl ni daa kpi maa, bɛ daa sɔɣ o la so shɛli din daa kuni Ɛfirat la sokpaŋa, nimaani ka bɛ booni Bɛtilihɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: When Rachel died, she was buried beside the road to Ephrath, now known as Bethlehem.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm ka ti mali yɛri ya maa. Dina n-nyɛ ni ti ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn mali nyɛviya hal ti paai ti Duuma labbuna saha ti ku daŋ bɛn pun gbihiri kum ni la tooni.
en: What we tell you now is the Lords own message. Those of us who are still living when the Lord comes again will join him, but not before those who have already died.

dag: mini nɛma balibu kam ni pali yiya shɛŋa, ka di pala yinima n-zaŋ li niŋ di ni ni kɔbil shɛŋa din gbi n-doya, ka di pala yinima n-gbi li ni wain tihi mini olivi tihi puri, ka di pala yinima n-sa li, ka yi yi ti di n-tiɣi.
en: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi dimnim nyaŋ ya. Yi ni ti doli so yini chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi ba, amaa ka ni ti ŋmaligi bɛ sani n-zo n-doli soya ayopɔin. Yi ni ti leei dunia nanim zaa ni je shɛba.
en: The LORD will hand you over defeated to your enemies. You will go out against them by one direction, but you will run for your life away from them in seven different directions. All the earths kingdoms will be horrified by you.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, yilimi yila pampam. Izraɛlnima, tahimiya! Jɛrusalɛm bipuɣiŋga, mali suhupiɛlli, ka diri dari ni a suhu zaa!.
en: Sing and shout for joy, people of Israel! Rejoice with all your heart, Jerusalem!.

dag: Anabi maa n-nyɛ ŋun guli Ifriimnim bɛn nyɛ n Naawuni niriba ŋɔ, amaa ka bɛ bari noongbahiri zana bɛ soya zuɣu, ka dimdi be bɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: The prophet is Gods watchman looking over Ephraim, yet a hunters trap is set, covering all his ways, and rejection is in his Gods house.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ yihim niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb mini mari ni yiri shɛb niŋgbuna ni ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn shihi kpima, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ leei bɛn bi be nyam bɛ sunsuuni.
en: Command the Israelites to send out from the camp anyone with a skin disease, an oozing discharge, or who has become unclean from contact with a corpse.

dag: Ka biasan la gba daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Bɛnammi. O yaansi n-nyɛ Ammɔnnim bɛn na kul beni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The younger daughter also gave birth to a son and named him Ben-ammi. He is the ancestor of todays Ammonites.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa yɛli Samuɛl, Tim ti naa ka o su ti maa, di daa bi palig o suhu; ka o daa suhi Yawɛ.
en: It seemed very bad to Samuel when they said, Give us a king to judge us, so he prayed to the LORD.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ma alahiziba n ni daa bi nya ninvuɣ so ŋun ni sɔŋ ma maa; amaa ka n suhuyiɣisili maa daa ti ma kpiɔŋ ka n di nasara n toli.
en: I was amazed when I looked and saw that there was no one to help me. But my anger made me strong, and I won the victory myself.

dag: Ka a ti niŋ salima alali pa di zuɣu, ka niŋ li pa di zuɣusaa mini di luɣa ni ni di binyila maa zaa zuɣu, ka mali salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka a nini nya a yaansi. Naawuni tim Izraɛlnim suhudoo!.
en: And may you live to see your grandchildren. Let Israel always enjoy peace!.

dag: Doo maa yi di pala Naawuni nira, o naan ku tooi niŋ shɛli.
en: Jesus could not do anything unless he came from God.

dag: Niŋmiya shɛlikam zaa ni yurilim!.
en: Show love in everything you do.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu tahirila Naawuni suhuyiɣisili na, dama zaligu yi kani di chihibu gba ku beni.
en: because the law can only bring Gods anger on those who disobey it. But if there is no law, then there is nothing to disobey.

dag: Ka di mahim chaŋ ti luri zoya zuɣu; ka di wula mi zooi lim sida ti kara la.
en: It covered the hills with its shade; its branches overshadowed the giant cedars.

dag: Dama Yɛhudianim bɔri ni bɛ nyala shihira, ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mi bɔri yɛm.
en: Jews want miracles for proof, and Greeks look for wisdom.

dag: O gba daa zaŋ o puu kɔhi n-zaŋ di liɣiri ti sɔŋ Yisa tuumba maa tooni.
en: He owned a field, sold it, brought the money, and placed it in the care and under the authority of the apostles.

dag: N yɛri ya mi o ni kari saria yomyom ti ba nasara. Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Daadam Bia yi lab dunia ŋɔ ni na, o ni nya bɛn mali yɛda.
en: I tell you, he will give them justice quickly. But when the Human Onecomes, will he find faithfulness on earth.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa yɛl o malaika tab bɛn ʒe o tooni, Yeemiya doo maa ni ye binyɛr daɣ shɛŋa maa. Di saha maa ka o daa yɛli Jɔshua, N yihila a daalahichi, ka yɛn zaŋ binyɛr suma yɛl a.
en: The angel said to his heavenly attendants, Take away the filthy clothes this man is wearing. Then he said to Joshua, I have taken away your sin and will give you new clothes to wear.

dag: Anabi Habakuk wunsuhigu. Di dolila Shigiɔnɔt ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth.

dag: Bipolitali ni daa kul pali bɛ niŋgbuŋ shɛŋa ni maa; bɛ mini li ni ti dɔni taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: Vigor filled their bones and now sleeps with them in the dust.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛmnim mini Bɛtimilɔnim zaa daa laɣim chaŋ Shɛkɛm oki tia din nyɛ bɛ tiŋgban la gbini nti leei Abimilɛk nam.
en: The leaders of Shechem, including the priests and the military officers, met at the tree next to the sacred rock in Shechem to crown Abimelech king.

dag: O daa lan yɛli yaha: N ti ku lan teei bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ biriginsim tuma yɛla hal abada.
en: And then he says, I will not remember their sins and evil deeds any longer.

dag: Di ni daa tiɣ o nini ni o kahig o Bia wuhi ma ka di chɛ ka n yih o yɛla waazu ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianim la, n daa bi niŋ so saawara.
en: It pleased him to let me see and know his Son so that I could tell the Good News about him to the non-Jewish people. I immediately prepared to do this work without asking for advice or help from anyone.

dag: Ti yom li bee ti di yo? Amaa ka Yisa baŋ bɛ bilikɔɣintali maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ niŋ ka yi zahindi ma? Zaŋmiya laɣifu na ka n nya.
en: But Jesus saw through their trick and answered, Why are you trying to trap me? Bring a silver coin, and let me see it.

dag: Jakim mini Zikiri ni Zabidi.
en: Shimei's descendants included Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi.

dag: N zaŋla n nina kpa a jɛmbu duu la, ka gbani paɣ a yuli a yurilim maŋli la min a ʒiɛyimtali la zuɣu, dama a duh a yuli min a yɛligu gari shɛlikam.
en: I face your holy Temple, bow down, and praise your name because of your constant love and faithfulness, because you have shown that your name and your commands are supreme.

dag: amaa ka Pool ŋun daa bi tɛhi ni di luhiya ni bɛ lan ʒi ninvuɣ so ŋun daa zani Pamfilia ŋ-ŋmaligi lab ka chɛ ba ka bi doli ba paai bɛ tuma tariga la.
en: Paul insisted that they shouldnt take him along, since he had deserted them in Pamphylia and hadnt continued with them in their work.

dag: Yi galim ma yimyim bupia zuɣu, yi ni miligi n suhu shɛm maa vi bi mali ya?.
en: Time after time you insult me and show no shame for the way you abuse me.

dag: Ka niriba daa pili buri; ka shɛb du n-tam duri zuɣusaa, ka shɛb mi ʒe tiŋ puuni laɣiŋgu shee kumdi ka fabinda.
en: Everywhere in Moab, on the housetops and in the streets, people are wearing sackcloth. Everyone is crying.

dag: Bimbɔ ka tumtumdiba lee nyari bɛ tuma puuni?.
en: What do we gain by all our hard work?.

dag: Bɛ yuri takarifiɛma ni ti no n-gili yi solɔri zaa, ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku yi niriba, ka daai yi daantali kara la luhi tiŋa.
en: His horses hooves will trample all your courtyards; he will cut down your people with the sword, and the monuments to your strength he will bring down to the ground.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, M pun mi ni yi ni ŋahi ma ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Timlana, tibim amaŋa! Ka ni lan yɛli ma, Niŋmi ti ni daa wum ni a niŋ shɛm Kapɛrinium la amaŋmaŋ ya ŋɔ! .
en: Jesus said to them, I know you will tell me the old saying: Doctor, heal yourself. You want to say, We heard about the things you did in Capernaum. Do those same things here in your own hometown.

dag: Nyini ka n kul lihira, nyini ŋun nam ʒiishee be zuɣusaa ŋɔ!.
en: Lord, I look up and pray to you. You sit as King in heaven.

dag: Di daba ayi nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chaŋ Galili;.
en: Two days later Jesus left and went to Galilee.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila Naa Nɛbukadnɛza, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili!.
en: They said, Your Majesty, we hope you live forever!.

dag: Ka buɣim daa doli tiŋgbani dambu maa nyaaŋa na, amaa ka Yawɛ daa ka buɣim maa gba ni. Ka kukol balli zaɣ bilifu daa ti doli buɣim maa dibu nyaaŋa na.
en: Then there was a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. Finally, there was a gentle breeze.

dag: Ka doo maa yɛli, A ni zaŋ paɣ so ti ma ni o be n san la, ŋuna n-zaŋ tia maa walli maa ti ma ka n di.
en: The man answered, The woman you put here with me gave me the fruit, and I ate it.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa ti lan lo tɔbu ni bɛ tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka Dauda daa pah o tɔbbihi zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ, ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti tuhi hal ka di ti gbarigi Dauda.
en: One time David got very tired when he and his soldiers were fighting the Philistines.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn yi tindul na ni ti tuhi deei Fɔnisia tiŋgbɔŋ n-zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo hal ni Zarɛfat su. Ka Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn nyɛ Jɛrusalɛmnim ka yi tindul na nti be Saadis la mi ti tuhi deei Nɛgɛb tinsi su.
en: Those who return from captivity will control Phoenicia as far as Zarephath. Captives from Jerusalem who were taken to Sepharad will capture the towns of the Southern Desert.

dag: Ka o yi ti ʒin o nam ʒiishee, ŋun chɛ ka bɛ yaai zaligu ŋɔ niŋ litaafi ni Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la ninni ti o.
en: The official copy of God's laws will be kept by the priests of the Levi tribe. So, as soon as anyone becomes king, he must go to the priests and write out a copy of these laws while they watch.

dag: Niŋmiya bɛ ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam: Ŋun simdi ni a yo lampoo zuɣu o sani, nyin yom o; ka ŋun deerila farigu, nyin tim o; ka ŋun simdi ni a lu o sizuura, nyin lum o sizuura; ka ŋun mi simdi ni a ti o jilima, nyin tim o jilima.
en: So pay everyone what you owe them. Pay the taxes you owe, pay the duties you are charged, give respect to those you should respect, and honor those you should honor.

dag: Bɛn daa nyɛ jɛra maa daa zaŋla bɛ firilanima, ka lee bi ʒi kpam pahi ni bɛ ti gu bɛmaŋa;.
en: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any extra oil with them.

dag: Ka bɛ lan bɔh o yaha, Wula ka o daa lee niŋ a? Wula ka o daa lee niŋ neeg a nina maa.
en: They asked, What did he do to you? How did he heal your eyes.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli ti ni daa kul chɛ alizanda ni paɣa ŋun nyɛ naa maa malibu, ka bi lan boori kom bahir o, ti daa lan ka binshɛli, ka tɔbu mini kum kuri ti.
en: But then we stopped making sacrifices to the Queen of Heaven, and we stopped pouring out drink offerings to her. And we have had problems ever since we stopped worshiping her. Our people have been killed by war and hunger.

dag: Ka Zua bia Nɛtanɛl nyɛ Isaka zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Nethanel, Zuars son, commanded the military of the tribe of Issachar.

dag: Ŋun kur niriba yiɣisirila zaawuni n-chana ni o ku nandaamba mini faranima. Yuŋ yi paai, o ŋmanila tayiɣa.
en: A murderer gets up at dawn and kills poor, helpless people. And at night he becomes a thief.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Zuliya kam zuɣulaannim kuuni bɛ nam, ka wuhiri tarimba bɛ kpiɔŋ ni nyɛ shɛm; ka niriba booni ba tarimba sɔŋdiba.
en: But Jesus said to them, The kings of the Gentiles rule over their subjects, and those in authority over them are called friends of the people.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ʒiŋmariba, hal bɛ yi po pɔri, bɛ ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: They are all liars, even when they swear to tell the truth.

dag: Dama bidibiga lihi ʒiɛm o ba, ka bipuɣiŋga yiɣisi lu o ma zuɣu. Ka paɣa yiɣisi lu o yidan ma zuɣu. Ka nir dimnim ni nyɛla omaŋmaŋ yiŋnima.
en: Your enemies will be the people in your own house. A son will not honor his father. A daughter will turn against her mother. A daughter-in-law will turn against her mother-in-law.

dag: Ibram paɣa Zarai daa bi dɔɣi bihi. Zarai daa mali Ijipti dab bipuɣiŋga ka o yuli booni Haga.
en: Sarai, Abrams wife, had not been able to have children. Since she had an Egyptian servant named Hagar.

dag: Firilanim pam daa be jirambisa du shɛl ni ti ni daa laɣim maa.
en: Many lamps were burning in the upstairs room where we were meeting.

dag: N ni zaŋ sara maligu shɛŋa ti ni mali nyɔri buɣim la n-ka a jɛmbu duu na; n ni zaŋ binshɛŋa n ni po pɔri ni n zaŋ ti a la ti a;.
en: So Ill enter your house with entirely burned offerings. Ill keep the promises I made to you.

dag: N ni zaŋ li ti tinzunnima, ka bɛ zaŋ li ti dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ biɛri, ka di leei bɛ ni ŋme n-di shɛli. Bɛ ni ti ta li daɣiri.
en: I will let strangers take them. Those strangers will make fun of them. They will kill some of the people and take others away as prisoners.

dag: Yi tibidarigibo dali, wula ka yi lee ti yɛn niŋ, ka zaɣ biɛɣu ni ti yɛn yi katiŋ na ti paai ya dahin shɛli, wula ka yi lee ti yɛn niŋ? Ŋun sani ka yi lee ti yɛn zo n-chaŋ ti bo sɔŋsim bee luɣ dini ka yi lee ti yɛn zaŋ yi daazichi sɔŋ?.
en: Lawmakers, you will have to explain what you have done. What will you do then? Your destruction is coming from a faraway country. Where will you run for help? Your money and your riches will not help you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-wuhiri yurilim ni nyɛ shɛli: Di pala tinima n-daa yuri Naawuni, amaa ŋuna n-daa yuri ti ka tim o Bia na ni o ti leei sara maligu din kpihindi ti daalahichi.
en: This is love: it is not that we loved God but that he loved us and sent his Son as the sacrifice that deals with our sins.

dag: A chɛ ka mɔri zoori ka biŋkɔbiri ŋubira, ka chɛ bindira bimbilima ti ninsalinim ni bɛ kɔri li ka di yihiri bindirigu tiŋgban ni na.
en: You make grass grow for cattle; you make plants for human farming in order to get food from the ground.

dag: Ka o daa pii bɛ niriba ayi n-tim ba ti Duuma Yisa sani ni bɛ ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn kana la bee ti na yulim dilan soli.
en: and sent them to the Lord. They were to ask him, Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for someone else.

dag: Amaa ka n yɛli, N tum tuma pam, amaa ka di ka nyɔri. N yihi n yaa tum, amaa ka shɛli bi yi di ni na. Amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nyaanzaana, ka n laara be n Naawuni sani.
en: I said, I worked hard for nothing. I wore myself out, but I did nothing useful. I used all my power, but I did not really do anything. So the Lord must decide what to do with me. He must decide my reward.

dag: Nyin naa ni bɔri ni ti wuh a shɛli ŋɔ to pam, ka so ku tooi wuh a li naɣila wuna din mini ninsalinim bi laɣim bela n-ni tooi niŋ lala.
en: It can't be done, except by the gods, and they don't live here on earth.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n ni suui bɛ ni zaŋ ʒi tibisa shɛŋa ʒili ya la, ka kabi bɛ ni ban ya bandi shɛŋa la.
en: Now I will set you free from the power of Assyria. I will take the yoke off your neck and tear away the chains holding you.

dag: So ka tɛha bee baŋsim din ni chɛ ka o baŋ ka yɛli: N zaŋla dari maa pirigili mali buɣim n-zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini nimdi she di buɣimsala ni ŋubi, ka ŋmaligi zaŋ din kpalim mali binshɛli din bi tu ni m mali n-damdi di tooni jɛm li.
en: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood.

dag: Mushi daa dɔɣi la bidibisi ata, Mahili mini Ɛda ni Jɛrimɔt.
en: Mushi the second son of Merari, was the father of Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.

dag: Amaa ka Shafan bia Ahikam daa zaŋ o zaŋsim niŋ Jɛrimia ni, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ bi zaŋ o ti niriba ni bɛ ku o.
en: There was an important man named Ahikam son of Shaphan who supported Jeremiah. He kept Jeremiah from being killed by the priests and prophets.

dag: Gol tuuli biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni nyɛla yi ni yɛn zaŋdi Yaɣigari chuɣu pina tiri Yawɛ saha shɛli.
en: The LORDs Passover is on the fourteenth day of the first month at twilight.

dag: Dama n shee kul tulimi ka biɛra, ka alaafee ka n niŋgbuna ni.
en: I am burning with fever and I am near death.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni darigi bɛ tibili; bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ nachimba, ka kum ku bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi.
en: Therefore, the LORD of heavenly forces proclaims, Im going to punish them. Their young men will die in war, and their sons and daughters will die by famine.

dag: ka Saimɔn Pita daa buɣisi yɛl o ni o wuhim ba Yisa ni yɛri bɛ ni so maa ni nyɛ so.
en: Simon Peter motioned to him and said, Ask him whom he is talking about.

dag: Zomiya yi zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni, ka tummila din viɛla, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi kul be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni sahakam.
en: Stop doing anything evil and do good, and you will always have a place to live.

dag: Yinima n niriba Izraɛlnima, n ni lan zaŋ ya labisi yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ka yi ti be di ni n-su li yaha. Ka yi bihi ku lan kpi di ni.
en: I will let people walk through you, my people Israel! They will lay claim to you, you will be their inheritance, and you will no longer deprive them of anything.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa neei, ka Pashihur chɛ ka bɛ baai Jɛrimia bandi maa, ka Jɛrimia yɛl o, Yawɛ daa bi bol a yuli Pashihur, amaa o daa bol a yuli la Dabiɛm be luɣilikam zaa .
en: The next day Pashhur took Jeremiah out from between the blocks of wood. Then Jeremiah said to him, The Lord s name for you is not Pashhur. Now his name for you is Surrounded by Terror.

dag: Yi tarili ni yɛn nyɛ shɛli sara maligu binshɛŋa din be kasi ka bɛ bi zaŋ li nyo buɣim m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ sara maligu kam din be kasi ka bɛ zaŋ li ti ma, din nyɛ chi sara bee alahichi sara bee taali tumbu sara kam di nyɛla a min a bidibisi dini.
en: Of the most sacred offerings not burned on the altar, the following belong to you: the grain offerings, the sin offerings, and the repayment offerings. Everything that is presented to me as a sacred offering belongs to you and your sons.

dag: O saria dibu dolila yɛlimaŋli soli ni din tuhi. O kari pagɔr biɛɣu ŋun zaŋ o zina niŋbu n-saɣim dunia la saria, ka bɔh o biɛri ti o ni daa yihi ŋun Naawuni dab shɛb ʒim la.
en: His judgments are true and right. Our God has punished the prostitute. She is the one who ruined the earth with her sexual sin. God has punished the prostitute to pay her back for the death of his servants.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi ni tuhi yi dimnim ka di azichi nɛma pam din nyɛ niɣi mini anzinfa ni salima ni daanya ni kuriti ni situra pam ŋɔ kuli yi tiŋgban ni nti pii ti yi mabihi.
en: He said to them, Return home with great wealth and many cattle, with silver, gold, bronze, and iron, and with much clothing. Divide the spoil taken from your enemies among your own people.

dag: Ninsalinim ni tumdi shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ puuni, bɔ ka bɛ lee nyari di ni?.
en: Do people really gain anything from all the hard work they do in this life ?.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa zaŋla bɛmaŋ bali niriba maa ni n-niŋdi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: They mixed with the other people and did what those people were doing.

dag: Ka goli maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali mi nyɛla Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu Yawɛ sani. Ka yi ni ti ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin.
en: The Festival of Thin Bread begins on the fifteenth day of that same month; it lasts seven days, and during this time you must honor me by eating bread made without yeast.

dag: Wuhim ma ka n niŋ a yubu, dama nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni. Chɛ ka a Shi suŋ maa wuhi ma soli din tuhi.
en: Teach me to do what pleases you, because you are my God. Guide me by your good spirit into good land.

dag: Ti yom li bee ti di yo? Amaa ka Yisa baŋ bɛ bilikɔɣintali maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ niŋ ka yi zahindi ma? Zaŋmiya laɣifu na ka n nya.
en: Since Jesus recognized their deceit, he said to them, Why are you testing me? Bring me a coin. Show it to me.

dag: N ni daa kul tɛhiri ʒii maa yɛla saha shɛli, ka n daa nya malaika ka o yi zuɣusaa siɣina. O daa nyɛla ŋun niŋ shili gu viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: While I was thinking about the vision, I saw coming down from heaven an angel, alert and watchful.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa lan niŋ kaman Musa ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm la; bɛ daa suhi Ijiptinim maa anzinfa mini salima yɛri ni situra.
en: The Israelites had already done what Moses had told them to do. They had gone to their Egyptian neighbors and asked for gold and silver and for clothes.

dag: Zaŋmiya naɣilabih ayi mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi m-mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: You will bring a food gift, an entirely burned offering to the LORD: two bulls from the herd, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old. They will be flawless.

dag: N nuu ka n daa zaŋ nam dunia ŋɔ, ka zaŋ n nudirigu teei sagbana pa zuɣusaa. N yi yɛli ni di niŋ shɛli, di tiɣisirimi zani niŋ li.
en: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Di zɔri dabiɛm, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N nyala so shia ka di yiri tiŋgban ni na.
en: Don't be afraid, Saul replied. Just tell me what you see. She answered, I see a spirit rising up out of the ground.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ bɛ sani nti chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa woli taba, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku lan tooi wum tab yɛtɔɣa.
en: Come, lets go down and mix up their language there so they wont understand each others language.

dag: Amaa n zaŋsim daa be n yuli din be kasi ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni daa saɣim shɛli bɛ ni daa be zuliya shɛb ni la.
en: That made me concerned for my holy name, since the Israelites brought disgrace on it everywhere they went.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ni Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya: N niriba bɛn be Ziɔn, di zɔriya Asirianim dabiɛm saha shɛli bɛ yi ti zaŋ fiɛbisi fiɛbiri ya, ka kpuɣi jaaŋgbɛbihi fiɛbiri ya kaman Ijiptinim ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: The Lord GOD All-Powerful says, My people living in Zion, dont be afraid of Assyria! Yes, he will beat you, and it will be just as the time when Egypt beat you with a stick.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wuɣiri situr piɛla ni ti yihi tahima, ka bɛn ʒi kpalu dari ni ninni biɛhigu ti taɣi.
en: Those who make linen cloth will be in despair;.

dag: Ka Ham ŋun daa nyɛ Keenan ba la daa nya o ba ni do o zaɣim maa, ka yi samban ni nti yɛl o mabih ayi la.
en: Ham entered the tent and saw him naked, then went back outside and told his brothers.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa mali buni ka lan mali jilima pam, ka o daa ti bɔri paɣa Ɛhab sani ni o ti o daŋ ni so.
en: Even though Jehoshaphat already had great wealth and honor, he allied himself with Ahab through marriage.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Hazaɛl daa yi Ilaisha sani n-lab o dan maa sani, ka o ti bɔh o, Ka wula ka Ilaisha lee yɛl a? Ka o garigi yɛl o, O yɛli ma ni a ni kpaŋ.
en: Then Hazael left Elisha and went to his king. Ben-Hadad said to Hazael, What did Elisha say to you? He answered, Elisha told me that you will live.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛn bɔrigi maa sani, di nyɛla nyom din tahiri kum na; amaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛn tiligi la sani, di nyɛla nyom din tahiri nyɛvili na. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi su tuuni ŋɔ tatabo fukumsi?.
en: For those who are being lost, it is a deadly stench that kills; but for those who are being saved, it is a fragrance that brings life. Who, then, is capable for such a task?.

dag: Yawɛ, ti dolila a yubu ni nyɛ shɛli, ka niŋ a ni doli so shɛŋa kariti saria naani. A kɔŋko ka ti kul bɔra.
en: In the path of your justice, LORD, we wait for you; with all our being, we long for your name and your acclaim.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ mini goli ni zibigi ka saŋmarisi gba ni zaɣisi peebu.
en: The sun and the moon will become dark. The stars will stop shining.

dag: A ku ŋmaligi a nini bahi kpaŋ biɛla, ka chɛ ma hal ka n ti vali n nintɔri?.
en: Won't you look away just long enough for me to swallow?.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Sool daa tim tuumba Jɛsi sani ti yɛl o, Zaŋm a dapala Dauda ŋun guli piɛri la ti ma na.
en: So Saul sent messengers to Jesse. They told Jesse, You have a son named David. He takes care of your sheep. Send him to me.

dag: Juda bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛr mini Onan ni Shɛla, o Keenan paɣ ŋun yuli daa booni Batishua la ni daa dɔɣi bidibisi ata shɛba m-bala. Juda bikpɛm sani ŋun yuli daa booni Ɛr maa daa nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛɣu Yawɛ sani, ka o daa chɛ ka o kpi.
en: Judah and his Canaanite wife Bathshua had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord had Er put to death, because he disobeyed and did what the Lord hated.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim Ijipti naa Firawuna min o niriba zaa: A galisim lee ŋmanila ŋuni?.
en: Son of man, say this to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and to his people: You are so great! Who can I compare you to?.

dag: Man Yawɛ je ŋmɛndintoli tuma mini alahichi, amaa m bɔrila yɛlimaŋli soli. N ʒiɛyimtali puuni, n ni tin ya laara, ka lɔn ya alikauli din ku zani tariga.
en: The Lord says, I love justice and I hate oppression and crime. I will faithfully reward my people And make an eternal covenant with them.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Firawuna suhu kpɛm pam; o zaɣisiya ni o ku chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Pharaoh is stubborn. He still refuses to let the people go.

dag: N ni woligi n niriba ka chɛ a niriba. Biɛɣuni ka alahiziba tuuni ŋɔ sa yɛn tum. .
en: Ill put a barrier between my people and your people. This sign will happen tomorrow.

dag: Gbib ma ka n tiligi, ka kul dol a zaligunim sahakam.
en: Help me and I will be saved. And I will always give attention to your laws.
