dag: Ŋunkam zu o ba bee o ma binshɛli ka yɛli ni di pala zaɣ biɛɣu, dilan nyɛla ŋun pahi ninvuɣ kuriba ni.
en: Those who steal from their father and mother, and say, Its not a crime, are friends of vandals.

dag: Amaa man ni yɛlimi, Yawɛ, n tum alahichi a sani, zom ma nambɔɣu ka tib ma.
en: I said, I have sinned against you, Lord ; be merciful to me and heal me.

dag: Ti mini Yisa Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini zuɣu ka Naawuni daa neei ti min o kum ni ni ti min o laɣim ʒin o nam ʒiishee alizanda ni.
en: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka ti ti wumdi ka bɛ tɔɣisirila ti zaa yinoyino ya yɛligu.
en: How is it, then, that all of us hear them speaking in our own native languages?.

dag: Ka o nyamma daa yɛligi ka o leei bundana.
en: and Isaac was so successful that he became very rich.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, N yi bi ŋma Shafat bia Ilaisha la zuɣu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma din gari lala.
en: The king said, May God punish me if the head of Elisha son of Shaphat is still on his body at the end of this day.

dag: Manaasa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa suhi Naawuni shɛm ni anab shɛb bɛn daa zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni yuli tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa la zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Manasseh did while he was king, including his prayer to the Lord God and the warnings from his prophets, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: ka su kom luɣ kasi shee maa, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ binyɛra ye n-yina ti mal o sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini niriba sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la n-yo omaŋmaŋ daalahichi mini niriba maa daalahichi samli.
en: He will bathe his body in water in a holy place and dress in his priestly clothing. Then he will go out and perform the entirely burned offerings for himself and for the people. In this way, he will make reconciliation for himself and for the people.

dag: Ka o daa dii gbaai nachimbil maa m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ka lih o ninni ka bi zɔri vi ka yɛl o.
en: She grabs him and kisses him. Her face is brazen as she speaks to him.

dag: N yɛn chɛmi ka zuliya shɛb yi katiŋ kana ti liri yinim Izraɛlnima. Bɛ nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa. Bɛ zuliya maa nyɛla zuliya kurili. Yi bi mi zuliya maa yɛtɔɣa bee yi ti tooi baŋ bɛ ni yɛri shɛm gbinni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People of Israel, the Lord is bringing a nation from far away to attack you. It is a strong and ancient nation, a nation whose language you do not know.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ŋun kariti saria luhiri so ka yiɣisiri so la sani ka di yirina.
en: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Naa Jɛhoyachin bapira Matania n-leei naa zali ŋun Jɛhoyachin zaani, ka taɣ o yuli Zɛdɛkia.
en: Then the Babylonian king made Mattaniah, Jehoiachins uncle, succeed Jehoiachin as king. Nebuchadnezzar changed Mattaniahs name to Zedekiah.

dag: M mabihi, di bi simdi ni yi ni niriba pam bɔri ni yi niŋ karimbanima, dama yi mi ni tinim bɛn nyɛ karimbanim ni ti nya saria karibu gari sokam.
en: My brothers and sisters, not many of you should be teachers. I say this because, as you know, we who teach will be judged more strictly than others.

dag: ka Matɛnai daa nyɛ Joyarib daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma, ka Uzi daa nyɛ Jɛdaya daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi.

dag: Ka Mariama daa yɛli, N tibigiri n Duuma n suhu ni.
en: Then Mary said, I praise the Lord with all my heart.

dag: amaa di simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun niŋdi saani ni ŋun yuri zaɣ suŋ ni ŋun su omaŋa ni ŋun bebu tuhi ni ŋun bebu be kasi ni ŋun gbib omaŋa.
en: Instead, they should show hospitality, love what is good, and be reasonable, ethical, godly, and self-controlled.

dag: Dindali maa mi yi ti ku bɔhi binshɛli yɛla n sani. Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam m Ba sani, o ni tin ya li.
en: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.

dag: ni Lɛbaɔt ni Shilihim ni Ain ni Rimɔn: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pihitayinika m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. In all, there were towns and all their fields.

dag: Alɔbo maa ni daa chɛ, ka Aduna labi Musa sani Yawɛ min o niriba chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: When the plague had stopped, Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance of the Tent.

dag: Di saha ka malaika bɔbili daa dii yi alizanda ni na nti pahi malaika yino maa zuɣu, ka bɛ yiini yila paɣiri Naawuni yɛra:.
en: Then a huge army of angels from heaven joined the first angel, and they were all praising God, saying.

dag: Diribarilimlan nyɛla ŋun bɔri zabili, amaa ŋunkam niŋ Yawɛ naani ni tɔŋ.
en: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord .

dag: Miriya ka yi pɔhi yi puri ni tiwala zaa bee n-gahim yi wain wal shɛŋa din lu tiŋa. Chɛliya li ti nandaamba mini saamba. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Do not go back through your vineyard to gather the grapes that were missed or to pick up the grapes that have fallen; leave them for poor people and foreigners. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya maa daa chaŋ ti ŋme o luhi n-ku o, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o ti sɔɣ omaŋmaŋ yiŋ din daa be mɔɣu ni la.
en: So Benaiah, Jehoiadas son, went and attacked Joab and killed him. Joab was buried at his home in the wilderness.

dag: Di bi simdi ka jɛrigu mali buni pam, di mi bi simdi ni dabili su nabihi.
en: Luxury isnt fitting for a fool; even less so for a servant to rule over princes.

dag: lala zuɣu ka man daa zo a dabiɛm, ka zaŋ a pɔŋ tuhili maa ti pi tiŋgban ni; dinzuɣu n-nyɛ a bini.
en: I was afraid, so I went off and hid your money in the ground. Look! Here is what belongs to you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛl o, Zaŋm nimdi maa mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi maa pa tampiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu, ka kpaai ʒiɛri maa pol li. Ka Gidiɔn daa niŋ lala.
en: God's angel said, Gideon, put the meat and the bread on this rock, and pour the broth over them. Gideon did as he was told.

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni ti zaŋ bɛ ni daa ku wuntizɔr shɛba dunia ŋɔ ni, Ɛbɛl ŋun daa bi tum taal shɛl la kubu saha zaŋ ti paai Anabi Zakaria Bɛrakia bi so yi ni daa ku Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini sara malibu bimbini sunsuuni la taali ʒili ya.
en: That's why you will be held guilty for the murder of every good person, beginning with the good man Abel. This also includes Barachiah's son Zechariah, the man you murdered between the temple and the altar.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi, ka tumdi din tuhi, ka tɔɣisiri yɛlimaŋli ka di yiri bɛ suhuri ni na.
en: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth.

dag: Biɣivai daŋ — tusaayi ni pihinunaayɔbu.
en: the descendants of Bigvai:.

dag: kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ti Duuma yɛliya, N ni be ŋɔ zuɣu, sokam ni ti gbani n tooni, ka sokam ti yaag o noli m-paɣi man Naawuni.
en: For the scripture says, As surely as I am the living God, says the Lord, everyone will kneel before me, and everyone will confess that I am God.

dag: N yura yɛli ma, N ni yuri so pam, ŋun viɛli pam n sani, Yiɣisim ka n sanna.
en: My lover speaks to me, Get up, my darling, my beautiful one. Lets go away!.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Jotham did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Bɛ zuliya maa ni daŋ kam ni dɔbba bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔb ni kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisi ni kɔbisiyi.
en: Their family history shows who the family leaders were. And it also shows they had , soldiers.

dag: Amɔz bia Aizaia ni daa nya ʒii shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛm polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Isaiah son of Amoz received this message about Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ sapashin kpamba mini ninvuɣ zuɣuri ni gomnanima ni tiŋgbani maa ni niriba zaa ka bɛ chaŋ ti zaŋ naa maa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni yi n-doli zuɣusaa polo dunol la n-kuni nayili. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ naa maa ʒili nayili nam ʒiishee.
en: The army officers, the leading citizens, the officials, and all the rest of the people joined Jehoiada in a procession that brought the king from the Temple to the palace. They entered by the main gate, and the king took his place on the throne.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, a ni ti bela tiŋgbani puuni ha tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, ka a yɛtɔɣa yiri tiŋgban ni na. A kukoli ni ti ŋmanila kpim kukoli n-yiri tiŋgban ni na. A ti yɛn sɔɣirimi yɛri ka di yiri tiŋgban ni na.
en: Jerusalem will be like a ghost struggling to speak from under the ground, a muffled voice coming from the dust.

dag: Ka Hɛnadad bia Binnui daa mali me yaɣ shɛli m-pan o zuɣu. O daa kpuɣi li la Azaria yiŋ hal ti paai gooni maa gɔŋbu shee.
en: Binnui son of Henadad rebuilt the section of the wall from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall.

dag: Gbahim ŋɔri mini bɛ bihi bɛn saɣindi ti wain tihi puri la. Dama ti wain tihi maa daari pum.
en: Our vineyards are in blossom; we must catch the little foxes that destroy the vineyards.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa kul shini, hal o daa bi garigi bɛ ni fiɣis o yɛl shɛŋa zuɣu maa zaɣ yini gba. Ka di daa gari Gomna Pailɛt pam.
en: But Jesus did not say anything, and this really surprised the governor.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni daa yiɣisi Seir zoya zuɣu, a ni daa yi Ɛdom tiŋgban ni chana, tiŋgbani daa dammi, ka saa luna. Iin, ka sagbana daa chɛ ka saa luna.
en: Lord , in the past you came from Seir. You marched from the land of Edom. You marched and the earth shook. The skies rained. The clouds dropped water.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah anu.
en: There was evening and there was morning: the fifth day.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka chɛchɛbuŋ maa zani; ka o mini Filip zaa yi n-chaŋ ti siɣi kom maa ni, ka Filip baptaiz o.
en: Then the official ordered the chariot to stop. Both Philip and the official went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.

dag: Ka sana yi be yi sani ka bɔri ni o puhiri Yaɣigari chuɣu ŋɔ tiri Yawɛ jilima, yin chɛliya ka o gun o yiŋ bidibisi zaa, di saha o ni leei Izraɛl tiŋbia, ka ni tooi puhiri Yaɣigari chuɣu maa. Amaa di bi simdi ka ŋun bi guni di li.
en: If a foreigner living among you wants to share in the Lord s Passover, he must be circumcised. Then he can share in the meal like any other citizen of Israel. But a man who is not circumcised cannot eat the Passover meal.

dag: Ka Hamat Naa Tɔi daa wum ni Dauda tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa maa min o tɔbbihi zaa.
en: Tou was king of the city of Hamath. Hadadezer was the king of Zobah. Tou heard that David had defeated all of Hadadezers army.

dag: Baŋmiya ni mani n-su nyɛviya zaa. Mani n-su bihi laamba nyɛviya, mani n-lan su bia nyɛvili. Ninvuɣ so ŋun tum alahichi kɔŋko n-ni kpi.
en: The life of every person belongs to me, the life of the parent as well as that of the child. The person who sins is the one who will die.

dag: ka zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli she bantabiga mini zuɣupila, ka lan zaŋ tan piɛli viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli she jɛŋjɛŋŋmahi.
en: And the workers made a turban from fine linen. They also used fine linen to make cloth caps and underclothes.

dag: N suhir a, ni a di chaŋ, ka m bo pin na ti ti a. Ka o yɛl o, N ni guh a hal ka a ti labina.
en: Dont leave here until I return, bring out my offering, and set it in front of you. The Lord replied, Ill stay until you return.

dag: M pun pirigi n situra, n lan zaŋm li so yaha? M pun paɣi n naba, n lan niŋmi n-chɛ ka di daɣi?.
en: But I had already undressed and bathed my feet. Should I dress again and get my feet dirty?.

dag: Saha shɛli Yisifu ni daa neei gom ni ka o niŋ kaman ti Duuma malaika ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa n-chɛ ka bɛ kulis o na.
en: So when Joseph woke up, he married Mary, as the angel of the Lord had told him to.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, n zaŋ n ni daa zaŋ n takɔb mini n tɔbu tuhi Amɔrinim ka fa bɛ tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ Shɛkɛm la ti a, ka a mabihi la nuu ka di ni.
en: I have given you one portion more than I gave to your brothers. I gave you the land that I won from the Amorites. I used my sword and bow to take that land.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o lɛb o nyaaŋa biri ba, ka chɛla Juda zuliya kɔŋko.
en: So the LORD was very angry at Israel. He removed them from his presence. Only the tribe of Judah was spared.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, bɛ ni leeg o daba din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ man Naawuni jɛmbu mini tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa nanim jɛmbu ni pa yim shɛm.
en: but Shishak will conquer them, and they will learn the difference between serving me and serving earthly rulers.

dag: Amaa bɛ bi mi Yawɛ tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛ bi mi o ni lo nia shɛli, bɛ mi bi mi ni o laɣim ba mi kaman kabɔba ka bɛ lo n-sɔŋ kabɔɣili ni la.
en: But these nations do not know what is in the Lord 's mind. They do not realize that they have been gathered together to be punished in the same way that grain is brought in to be threshed.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa bela sarika ni, ka wum Yisa Masia tuma yɛla, ka daa tim o nyaandoliba.
en: When John was in prison, he heard about the things that were happening—things the Messiah would do. So he sent some of his followers to Jesus.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa suhuri daa paligi ka bɛ yiini yila yɛri taba, Sool kula tuhilituhili, ka Dauda mi ku tuhi piapia.
en: In their celebration the women sang, Saul has killed thousands, but David tens of thousands.

dag: ka o tiligi ti, ka di daa pala ti ni tum wuntia tuun shɛŋa zuɣu, amaa o nambɔzɔbo zuɣu ka o paɣ ti ka ti yi, ka ti ti nyɛvil palli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa chɛ ka ti nya biɛr palli saha shɛl la.
en: he saved us. It was not because of any good deeds that we ourselves had done, but because of his own mercy that he saved us, through the Holy Spirit, who gives us new birth and new life by washing us.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee be yi ni n-zɔri Yawɛ, ka deeg o dabili noli? Ŋun be zibisim ni ka neesim ka o sani, o niŋmi Yawɛ naani, ka zaŋ omaŋ dalim o Naawuni.
en: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam hal ka o ti kari ba o sani. Zɛdɛkia daa nyɛla ŋun zaɣisi Babilɔn naa noli.
en: The Lord became so angry with the people of Jerusalem and Judah that he banished them from his sight. Zedekiah rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia.

dag: ka zaŋ bula yino mal alahichi sanyoo sara, ka di kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, and in this way perform the ritual of purification for the people.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kpuɣi Filistia doo maa zuɣu maa n-kuli Jɛrusalɛm, amaa ka daa lee zaŋ o tɔbutuhiri nɛma ti niŋ ŋun Dauda maŋmaŋ suɣili ni.
en: David got Goliath's head and took it to Jerusalem, but he kept Goliath's weapons in his own tent.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi nyɛla yi ni zaŋ yimaŋ ti so n-deer o noli daba? Di yi nyɛla alahichi tumbu din tahiri nir kum ni bee Naawuni noli deebu din zaŋdi nir zaani wuntia zaani, lala n-nyɛ li.
en: Don't you know that you are slaves of anyone you obey? You can be slaves of sin and die, or you can be obedient slaves of God and be acceptable to him.

dag: Yawɛ bemi kaman tɔbbia la, o ŋmanila tɔbutuhira ŋun suhu ye tuhibu zuɣu. O kuhirimi yɛri pampam, ka wuhiri ni o mali yaa gar o dimnima.
en: The Lord is marching out like an angry soldier, shouting with all his might while attacking his enemies.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa daa yi n-chaŋ tiŋ maa dunol ni maa daa saɣi Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm ni yɛli shɛm maa; ka dɔbba bɛn zaa daa yi n-chaŋ bɛ tiŋ maa dunol ni maa daa guni.
en: Everyone at the city gate agreed with Hamor and his son Shechem, so every able-bodied male in the city was circumcised.

dag: O daa piila o dabili Dauda, o daa yih o la piɛgulibo ni.
en: He chose his servant David; he took him from the pastures.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni n-kul niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim tiri daadamnim sahakam.
en: God gives each of us chance after chance.

dag: Ka Hɛnadad bia Binnui daa mali me yaɣ shɛli m-pan o zuɣu. O daa kpuɣi li la Azaria yiŋ hal ti paai gooni maa gɔŋbu shee.
en: Binnui son of Henadad repaired the section of wall from Azariahs house to the bend in the wall and then to the corner.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pa liɣiri ka bɛ daa zaŋ dan ya leei daba maa. Dinzuɣu pa liɣiri ka n yɛn zaŋ yo yi zuɣu n-yihi ya dabitim maa ni.
en: The Lord says, You were not sold for money. So I will not use money to set you free.

dag: Di saha ka o daa mali chɛchɛbunsi shili, ka zaŋ o tɔbbihi pa omaŋ zuɣu.
en: So Pharaoh prepared his chariot and took his men with him.

dag: Yi bihi yuli ni ti du pam zuliya kam sani. Ka ŋunkam zaa ti nya ba ni baŋ ni bɛ nyɛla Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni.
en: Their descendants will be known throughout the earth, and everyone will know their children. Whoever sees them will know that the Lord has blessed them.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛligu bi lan yɛn yuui. Amaa n yi kul tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛli, di ni niŋ pali. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: So you must tell them this: The Lord GOD says, I will not delay any longer. If I say something will happen, it will happen! This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Dama di pala ŋun paɣ omaŋa n-nyari paɣibu, amaa ti Duuma ni paɣ so n-nyari paɣibu.
en: What people say about themselves means nothing. What counts is whether the Lord says they have done well.

dag: Ka Nan bia Jɔshua maa daa boli maligumaaniba na nti yɛli ba, Kpuɣimiya Alikauli Adaka la, ka chɛ ka maligumaaniba ayopɔin gbibi piɛla yila kikah ayopɔin be Alikauli Adaka maa tooni.
en: Joshua called the priests together and said, Take the chest and tell seven priests to carry trumpets and march ahead of it.

dag: N yuli zuɣu ka n chɛ ka n suhu bi yiɣisi. M paɣibu zuɣu ka n gbaai mmaŋa ni di chɛ ka n ku kun ya.
en: For the sake of my reputation I control my anger; for your sake I restrain my powerful radiance so as to not destroy you.

dag: Di saha ka Lɛvinim bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la daa yiɣisi zani suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ niriba maa ni, ka Naawuni daa be alizanda ni o biɛhigu shee din nyɛ kasi la ka deei bɛ suhigu maa.
en: The priests and the Levites asked the Lord 's blessing on the people. In his home in heaven God heard their prayers and accepted them.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ma chaŋ duno shɛli din kpɛri dundɔŋ maa puuni, ka n daa lihi nya ka voli be gooni ni.
en: He took me to the entrance of the outer courtyard and showed me a hole in the wall.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ibram, M bɔri ni a baŋ ka biɛhiŋ kani, ni a zuliya ni ti chaŋ ti be tiŋgbɔn shɛli din pa bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-nyɛ daba nimaani, ka bɛ ni ti nahim ba yuun kɔbisinahi.
en: The Lord said to him, Your descendants will be strangers in a foreign land; they will be slaves there and will be treated cruelly for four hundred years.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi ni mali dahima shɛli n-tummi di ni simdi ni yi tum shɛm ni nimmoo, dama ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nyɛla ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu.
en: These are evil times, so make every minute count.

dag: Ka biɛɣ daa neei asiba ka Dauda sabi gbaŋ ti o ni o zaŋ mali chaŋ ti ti Jɔab.
en: The next morning David wrote a letter to Joab and made Uriah carry the letter.

dag: Ninsalinim ni yɛn niŋ shɛm tooi baŋ Naawuni yɛla zaa dola palɔni bɛ sani, dama Naawuni maŋmaŋa m-pun kahigi li wuhi ba.
en: This makes God angry because they have been shown what he is like. Yes, God has made it clear to them.

dag: Izraɛlnim maa ni daa nya li, ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔ n-lee bala? Dama bɛ daa bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli. Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni zaŋ bindir shɛli tin ya ni yi di m-bala.
en: When the Israelites saw it, they didn't know what it was and asked each other, What is it? Moses said to them, This is the food that the Lord has given you to eat.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam chani yuŋ tuurimi, ka di nyɛla neesim ni kani zuɣu.
en: But whoever walks at night will stumble because there is no light.

dag: Naawuni bi bela zuɣusaa ha? Nyam saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ ha ni be zuɣusaa ha shɛm!.
en: Isnt God in the heights of heaven; see how high the topmost stars are?.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya li, ka tɛhi di yɛla, ka lan lihi li, ka deei wuhibu di ni.
en: I looked at this, thought about it, and learned a lesson from it:.

dag: Ka Hɛshibɔnnim mini Ɛlialɛnim daa kuhi pam, ka Jahaznim wum bɛ kuhigu maa, hal ka bɛ tɔbbihi ni sɔhira.
en: From Heshbon and Elealeh, weeping is heard in Jahaz; Moab's warriors scream while trembling with fear.

dag: Pɛdaya bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɛrubabɛl mini Shimɛi. Zɛrubabɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mɛshulam mini Hanania, bɛ tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Shɛlomit.
en: Pedaiahs sons were Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabels sons were Meshullam and Hananiah. Shelomith was their sister.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ piɛlahi gbana din niŋ moonsi pili suɣili maa, ka zaŋ teeku ni biŋkɔbbal shɛb gbana pili pa di zuɣu.
en: They made two more coverings, one of rams' skin dyed red and the other of fine leather, to serve as an outer cover.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma yaha, Di pun niŋ! N nyɛla Alfa mini Omega . Di gbinni nyɛla, Piligu ni Bahigu. Kɔnyuri ni wum ninvuɣ shɛb la, n ni ti ba nyɛvili kom din nyɛ kɔbilisirim la yoli.
en: The one on the throne said to me, It is finished! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give free water from the spring of the water of life to anyone who is thirsty.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal di saha n ti ku kpihim yi birili zaa.
en: The Lord says, Yet even in those days I will not completely destroy my people.

dag: Di saha ka o nyaandoliba ayi maa daa ŋmaligi kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: So the two of them went back to the other disciples.

dag: Ka niriba maa ti labi ba kuɣa, ka zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba. Bɛ ni ti ku bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi, ka nyo bɛ yiya buɣim.
en: Let the mob stone them and attack them with swords, kill their children, and burn down their houses.

dag: Kom be kulibɔŋ maa ni ka a ni nyura, ka n zali kahiŋkɔri ni bɛ tahiri bindirigu na ti tir a.
en: The brook will supply you with water to drink, and I have commanded ravens to bring you food there.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa yɛlila Musa, Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa, Yi nyɛla tipawumlinima, n yi lan doli ya biɛla pahi n ni ti kun ya. Dinzuɣu yihimiya salima nɛma din be yi ni, ka m baŋ n ni yɛn niŋ ya shɛm. .
en: This was because the Lord said to Moses, Tell the Israelites, You are a stubborn people. I might destroy you even if I travel with you only a short time. So take off all your jewelry while I decide what to do with you.

dag: Ka Rubin daa bɔhi ba, N daa bi yɛli ya ni yi di niŋ bia maa shɛli? Amaa ka yi daa zaɣisi wumbu. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, o kubu maa biɛri m-bɔhiri ti maa.
en: Reuben said, I told you not to harm the boy, but you wouldn't listen. And now we are being paid back for his death.

dag: M mi ni yi niŋ ania n-saɣi nahiŋgu n yuli zuɣu, ka na bi tiri gbini.
en: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi yi zuɣu. N ni kari ya saria kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka darigi yi tibili yi ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve.

dag: N-daa lan yi biɛɣu ka Jɔn min o nyaandoliba ayi ʒiɛya;.
en: The next day John was standing there again with two of his disciples.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ŋun kariti saria luhiri so ka yiɣisiri so la sani ka di yirina.
en: God is the judge. He decides who will be important. He lifts one person up and brings another down.

dag: Ka Naawuni gba daa di o shɛhira yiko shihira wuhibu ni mini alahiziba tumtumsa ni ni alahiziba tuma balibu pam ni min o ni daa zaŋ o Shia Kasi pina ti niriba kaman o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm la puuni.
en: God also vouched for their message with signs, amazing things, various miracles, and gifts from the Holy Spirit, which were handed out the way he wanted.

dag: Di ni daa ti kpalim daba ayɔbu ni bɛ puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu, ka Yisa daa chaŋla Bɛtani din nyɛ o ni daa neei Lazarɔs so la ni daa be tin shɛl la.
en: Six days before Passover Jesus went back to Bethany, where he had raised Lazarus from death.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ɛlikana daa lab kul o ya Rama, ka bia maa daa be Ɛli ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa sani n-tumdi Yawɛ tuma.
en: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah, but the boy served the LORD under Eli the priest.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim maa daa mali bɛmaŋ yi alahichi ni, ka paɣi bɛ binyɛra, ka Aduna daa zaŋ ba kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi gahiri zuɣusaa la zali Yawɛ tooni, ka mali sara ti ba bɛ daalahichi zuɣu m-mali ba kasi.
en: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes. Aaron presented them as an uplifted offering in the LORDs presence, and he sought reconciliation for them in order to cleanse them.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aizaia.
en: Then the Lord sent me.

dag: Din beni nyɛla: Zaligu kurili la leela din daai baɣili kpaŋa di gbariginsim mini di ni ka buchi zuɣu.
en: The old rule, then, is set aside, because it was weak and useless.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bipuɣiŋga. Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Bolim o yuli Kunyanambɔzɔbo, dama n ku lan zo Izraɛlnim nambɔɣu, ka chɛ bɛ taali hal biɛla gba.
en: Gomer became pregnant again and gave birth to a daughter. Then the LORD said to Hosea, Name her No Compassion, because I will no longer have compassion on the house of Israel or forgive them.

dag: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs nam dibu yuun pisi saha gol so bɛ ni booni Nisan la puuni, Naa wain nyubu saha ni daa ti paai, ka n daa zaŋ li ti ti o. N daa na ʒi m-mali suhugarigu o tooni.
en: In the month of Nisan in the th year of King Artaxerxes, some wine was brought to the king. I took the wine and gave it to the king. I had never before been sad when I was with him, but now I was sad.

dag: Ka Judanim ti sɔŋ zabi Jɛrusalɛm zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti ŋme n-di zuliya kam bɛn gili ba nɛma din nyɛ salima mini anzinfa ni situra pam.
en: The men of Judah will fight to defend Jerusalem. They will take as loot the wealth of all the nations—gold, silver, and clothing in great abundance.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi jintɔriba maa sani n-yi ni suhupiɛlli Naawuni ni kali ba pahi bɛn simdi ni bɛ di vi Yisa yuli zuɣu kalinli ni maa zuɣu.
en: The apostles left the council meeting. They were happy because they were given the honor of suffering dishonor for Jesus.

dag: Dama ŋuni n-lee be sagbana ni ŋ-ŋmani nyin Yawɛ? Ŋuni n-leei be alizanda ni ŋ-ŋmani nyin Yawɛ?.
en: No one in heaven is like you, Lord ; none of the heavenly beings is your equal.

dag: Ka tinzunnim bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili Yawɛ ni bɛ tumd o tuma, ka yur o, ka nyɛ o daba bɛn zaa gbibi Vuhim Dabisili ka bi saɣindi di zaligunima, ka gbibi n daalikauli viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.

dag: Ka biisim ti kpe li ka di nyɛligi. Tulim yi ti kana, a ku lan nya li di biɛhigu maa shee.
en: then suddenly disappear in the summer heat.

dag: Ka n tɛhi ni a yihi ma la a sani bahi, ka n ku lan nya a jɛmbu du kasi la.
en: I thought I had been banished from your presence and would never see your holy Temple again.

dag: Tampiligim n kul nyɛ m bindirigu, ka n nintam kul tɔɣiri luri m binnyura ni.
en: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink.

dag: Lala ka Jɛhu daa niŋ kpihim Baal birili zaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: This is how Jehu eliminated Baal from Israel.

dag: Dama o soli nyɛla din kuni kum shee, ka o soya kuni kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.

dag: ka wurim nam ʒiishɛhi ka chɛ ka di yiko zan tariga. N ni lɛb chɛchɛbunsi mini bɛn mal li chani pili; ka daai wɔribariba mini bɛ yuri luhi; ka bɛ ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku taba.
en: and wipe out kings and their kingdoms. I will overturn war chariots, and then cavalry troops will start slaughtering each other.

dag: Di daa bi lan kpa ni so wuh o ninsal biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, dama omaŋmaŋ pun mi din be ninsalinim suhuri ni.
en: He didnt need anyone to tell him about human nature, for he knew what human nature was.

dag: Chɛ ka so ku niŋ o nirilim. So di zo o kpibisi maa nambɔɣu.
en: Let no one be kind to him. Let no one show mercy to his children.

dag: N yi yɛn kal li, di galisi gari bihigu. N yi gbihi nti neei, n kul bela a sani.
en: If I tried to count them—they outnumber grains of sand! If I came to the very end—Id still be with you.

dag: Mbusim be yinim zaligubaŋdib zuɣu! Dama yi ŋooi baŋsim bɔhimbu dunoli saafɛbia; yimaŋmaŋ bi kpɛri di ni, ka mi guri bɛn bɔri ni bɛ kpe di ni soli.
en: It will be bad for you, you experts in the law! You have taken away the key to learning about God. You yourselves would not learn, and you stopped others from learning too.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim din zaa kpalim min anabinim yɛligu zaa tamla zaligunima ayi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The whole Law of Moses and the teachings of the prophets depend on these two commandments.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa yɛli Yisa, Ti Duuma, pahim ti yɛda.
en: The apostles said to the Lord, Give us more faith.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu yubu mini Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu yubu nyɛla din tuhiri tab tɔbu; dama di nyɛla din chihi taba ka guri ya soli n-chɛ ka yi bi niŋdi yi ni bɔri ni yi niŋ shɛm.
en: For what our human nature wants is opposed to what the Spirit wants, and what the Spirit wants is opposed to what our human nature wants. These two are enemies, and this means that you cannot do what you want to do.

dag: N ni wuhi ya Naawuni yiko ni nyɛ shɛm; n ku sɔɣi ya din be Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani.
en: I will teach you about Gods power. I will not hide anything about God All-Powerful.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Di simdi ni ti yili wumpaɣibo yilli paɣi ti Naawuni; dama o nyɛla ŋun niŋdi nirilim, ka di simdi ni ti yili yilli paɣ o.
en: Praise the Lord ! It is good to sing praise to our God; it is pleasant and right to praise him.

dag: Ka amiliya yilinim maa wain daa ti pooi ba, ka Yisa ma yɛl o, Bɛ lan ka wain din nyura.
en: When the wine ran out, Jesus mother said to him, They dont have any wine.

dag: Ka Aduna daa yɛli Musa, Nyama, zuŋɔ ka bɛ mali bɛ daalahichi sanyoo sara mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, amaa di zaa yoli ka yɛla ŋ-ŋɔ ti paai ma! N yi di di alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋɔ zuŋɔ Yawɛ naan saɣi lala.
en: Aaron answered, If I had eaten the sin offering today, would the Lord have approved? The people presented their sin offering to the Lord today, and they brought their burnt offering, but still these terrible things have happened to me.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛn fiɣisiri ma maa nya filiŋ, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ vi ye kaman binyɛrigu la.
en: May my enemies be covered with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu maa saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ yɛligu daa ka anabi kurili ŋun bol anab ŋuni maa labisina maa sanna.
en: While they were sitting at the table, the Lord spoke to the old prophet.

dag: ni Alikauli Adaka la mini di dapuhi ni di yɔrigu ni di pateesa la.
en: the Covenant Box, its poles, its lid, and the curtain to screen it off;.

dag: So yi sɔɣi gbaai o Izraɛl kpee n-zaŋ o leei dabili bee n-zaŋ o kɔhi, dindina ŋun gbaag o maa simdi kubu, ka lala chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.
en: Someone might kidnap another Israelite—one of their own people. And that kidnapper might sell that person as a slave. If that happens, that kidnapper must be killed. You must remove this evil from your group.

dag: Bɛ gbinni nyaɣa kuuya, ka bɛ zuɣusaa wula kpi.
en: Their roots dry out below; their branches wither above.

dag: Amaa malimiya bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la tiri Yawɛ hal ni daba ayopɔin, dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin n-nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasi dali, Miriya ka yi tum tuma dindali.
en: For seven days, you will bring sacrifices offered as gifts to the Lord . Then there will be another special meeting on the seventh day. You must not do any work on that day.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ni ŋɔri bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli ka na bi niŋ dabindi niŋ di ni n-niŋ bɛ bɔrɔbɔro shɛr lahi ni n-guri adiikunim ni n-zaŋ pa bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu.
en: So the people filled their baking pans with unleavened dough, wrapped them in clothing, and carried them on their shoulders.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu Anabi Musa ni daa ti bi doo, o daa zaɣisiya ni o pala Firawuna bipuɣiŋga bia.
en: It was faith that made Moses, when he had grown up, refuse to be called the son of the king's daughter.

dag: Ka o daa lɔrigi malaikanim anahi shɛb bɛn daa pun mali shili gu di saha maa ni di dabisili maa ni di goli maa ni di yuuni maa ni bɛ ku daadamnim pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim la.
en: Then the four angels who had been made ready for that hour, day, month, and year were released to kill a third of humankind.

dag: Ka Gaiɔs ŋun nyɛ m mini cheechi zaa yilikpɛrilan la puhiri ya. Ka Ɛrastus ŋun nyɛ tiŋ puuni laɣigul la mini ti mabia Kuatus gba puhiri ya. .
en: Gaius welcomes me and the whole church into his home, and he sends his greetings. Erastus, the city treasurer, and our dear friend Quartus send their greetings too.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli, N tum taali, amaa di zaa yoli, tim ma jilima n kpamba ŋɔ mini Izraɛlnim zaa tooni, ka chɛ ka m min a labi ka n ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Duuma Naawuni maa.
en: Saul answered, All right, I sinned! But please come back with me. Show me some respect in front of the leaders and the Israelites. Come back with me so that I may worship the Lord your God.

dag: ka bɛ ti yihi tuuba niŋbu mini alahichi chɛ m-paŋ waazu ŋun Masia yul ni n-ti zuliya kam zaa, ka di piligu shee mi yɛn nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm zaŋ nti kpa luɣilikam.
en: They also say that all people of every nation must be told in my name to turn to God, in order to be forgiven. So beginning in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Naa Agiripa mini Bɛɛnis ka Siizaria na ni bɛ ti puhi Gomna Fɛstus.
en: Some time later King Agrippa and Bernice came to Caesarea to pay a visit of welcome to Festus.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa chaŋ Farisiinim kpeen so yiŋa ni o min o ti laɣim di bindirigu, ka Farisiinim maa daa kul kpahind o.
en: One Sabbath Jesus went to eat a meal at the home of one of the leading Pharisees; and people were watching Jesus closely.

dag: N suhu dammi, ka bi lan doya; ka wahala dabisa kul paari ma.
en: My insides, churning, are never quiet; days of affliction confront me.

dag: A bilim ni ha mi ka a pun mi Naawuni Sabbu Kasi din ni tooi wuh a tiliginsim soli Yisa Masia yɛda niŋbu zuɣu la.
en: Since childhood you have known the holy scriptures that help you to be wise in a way that leads to salvation through faith that is in Christ Jesus.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ yi gba: Yi yi tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛli so ni bi mi, wula ka so ni tooi baŋ di gbinni? Di yi nyɛ lala, dindina yi tɔɣisiri bahirila pɔhim ni yoli.
en: It is the same with you. If you dont speak clearly in a language people know, they cannot understand what you are saying. You will be talking to the air!.

dag: n ni ti lan labisi Ijipti zali di zaashee, ka zaŋ ba labisi Patrɔs din nyɛ bɛ virili shee la. Ka bɛ nam ti ku mali yaa nimaani.
en: I will bring back the Egyptian captives. I will bring back the Egyptians to the land of Pathros, to the land where they were born. But their kingdom will not be important.

dag: Ka o yɛli, A mi ni mani n-daa su nam ŋɔ, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa yu ni mani n-di li, amaa ka nam maa ti ŋmaligi leela n tizo dini, dama Yawɛ n-zaŋ li ti o.
en: He answered, You know that I should have become king and that everyone in Israel expected it. But it happened differently, and my brother became king because it was the Lord 's will.

dag: Daadam, Izraɛlnim leela saɣiri n sani. Bɛ zaa bɛn nyɛ anzinfa mini daanya ni samafuu ni kurugu ni dalima ŋɔ, bɛ nyɛligibu shee ka bɛ daa leei saɣiri.
en: Human one, the house of Israel has become a waste product for me. They are all copper, tin, iron, and lead. In the furnace, theyve become the waste product of silver.

dag: Amaa n ni tɔɣisila Kpiɔŋlan Naa yɛtɔɣa, n yuya ni n yɛtɔɣa maa tɔɣisila Naawuni sani.
en: But I want to speak to the Almighty; I would gladly present my case to God.

dag: O zaŋ bin suma dihi ma n ni yɛn be saha shɛli puuni, ka di chɛ ka m bipolitali kpiɔŋ labina kaman tɔrili kpiɔŋ la.
en: and satisfies you with plenty of good things so that your youth is made fresh like an eagles.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbani daa dam ka sɔhigi; ka zoya gbina ni gba sɔhigi ka dam, o suhu ni daa yiɣisi pam zuɣu.
en: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry.

dag: M biyurisi, pa zaligu palli ka n sabiri tiri ya, amaa di nyɛla zaligu kur shɛli yi ni daa pun mali piligu ni ha la. Zaligu kurili maa nyɛla yi ni daa pun wum yɛligu shɛl la yɛla.
en: Dear friends, Im not writing a new commandment to you, but an old commandment that you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the message you heard.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka bɛ nab pam, ka bi chɛ ka bɛ biŋkɔbiri filim.
en: He blessed his people, and they had many children; he kept their herds of cattle from decreasing.

dag: Amaa nyini n-daa yihi ma m ma pul ni na; nyini n-daa chɛ ka m mɔɣi m ma bihim baai.
en: It was you who brought me safely through birth, and when I was a baby, you kept me safe.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka yi neesim maa ne sokam zaa sani, ka bɛ nyari yi tuun suma ka tiri yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ jilima.
en: In the same way, you should be a light for other people. Live so that they will see the good things you do and praise your Father in heaven.

dag: Ka anab so ŋun daa goog o labisina maa daa wum li, ka yɛli, Anab so ŋun zaɣisi Yawɛ nol la m-bala. Lala zuɣu n-chɛ ka Yawɛ zaŋ o niŋ gbuɣinli maa nuu ni ka o gbaag o ku kaman ŋun Naawuni ni daa pun yɛl o shɛm.
en: When the old prophet heard about it, he said, That is the prophet who disobeyed the Lord 's command! And so the Lord sent the lion to attack and kill him, just as the Lord said he would.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ taɣimiya yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma, ka deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛligu, ka ŋun Yawɛ ni taɣ o tɛha zaŋ chaŋ o ni yɛn chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli paai ya maa polo.
en: You must change the way you are living and the things you are doing, and must obey the Lord your God. If you do, he will change his mind about the destruction that he said he would bring on you.

dag: Izraɛlnima, yɛlimiya, O yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Let the people of Israel say, His love is eternal.

dag: Naawuni mi n-ti ninvuɣ shɛb azichi mini nɛma ni jilima, ka bɛ ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa shɛli bi poori ba, amaa ka o bi chɛ ka bɛ tooi diri di nyaɣisim, ka naɣ chɛ ka ninvuɣ zino n-diri di nyaɣisim maa. Dimbɔŋɔ ka buchi, ka nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu pam.
en: God will give us wealth, honor, and property, yes, everything we want, but then will not let us enjoy it. Some stranger will enjoy it instead. It is useless, and it just isn't right.

dag: Di saha maa zaŋ chana, ka ŋun daa su bɛ fukumsi maa kul tiri ba la tarim bindirigu maa ka chɛ Naa ni daa wuhi ni bɛ tim ba bindir shɛŋa mini binnyur shɛl la.
en: So the guard kept taking away their rations and the wine they were supposed to drink and gave them vegetables instead.

dag: dindina n ni teei n ni daa lo Yaakubu mini Yisahaku ni Ibrahimma alikauli shɛŋa la yɛla, ka lan teei tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yɛla.
en: I will remember my covenant with Jacob and with Isaac and with Abraham, and I will renew my promise to give my people the land.

dag: Izraɛlnim chandi maa zaa puuni, sagbani maa daa yi ti vuui ka chɛ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, bɛ yiɣisirimi chaŋ.
en: The Israelites moved their camp to another place only when the cloud lifted from the Tent.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa tim tuumba Dauda sani Hiburɔn ni bɛ ti yɛl o, Ŋuni n-lee lan su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ? Chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli, ka n sɔŋ a n-zaŋ Izraɛlnim zaa na ti ti a.
en: Abner sent messengers to David, who at that time was at Hebron, to say, Who is going to rule this land? Make an agreement with me, and I will help you win all Israel over to your side.

dag: Ka a yi ti kanna, nyin zaŋmi m binyɛr tibisi shɛli n ni daa chɛ n-sɔŋ Kaapus sani Troas la m-mali ma na; ka zaŋ litaafinim la gba pahi na, di bahi bamdi gbandi la.
en: When you come, bring my coat that I left in Troas with Carpus; bring the books too, and especially the ones made of parchment.

dag: O ni ti wuhi zuliya kam shihirili ni o lan laɣindi Izraɛlnim mini Judanim bɛn daa wurim be dunia ŋɔ yaɣa anahi ŋɔ ni la.
en: He will gather the people of Israel and Judah who were forced to leave their country. They were scattered to all the faraway places on earth. But he will raise the flag as a sign for the other nations, and he will gather his people together again.

dag: Amaa dunia ŋɔ ni ti leei tiŋgban nɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni tuumbiɛri tumbu zuɣu.
en: The land was ruined by the people who lived there and by what they did.

dag: Yi mi ti ni daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm mini ti ni daa tim zuliya gbaliŋ ni garina shɛm.
en: You remember what life was like in Egypt and what it was like to travel through the territory of other nations.

dag: Baŋsim ŋɔ tatabo mali ma alahiziba pam. Di galisiya yaɣi ka n ku tooi baŋ li.
en: I am amazed at what you know; it is too much for me to understand.

dag: Uziɛl bidibisi ni, Aminadab n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbiga ni pinaayi pah o zuɣu.
en: Amminadab, the leader of the Uzziel clan, with of his relatives.

dag: Ka Sool daa po Yawɛ yɛli, Hal ka Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, a ku nya tibidarigibo shɛli dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu.
en: But Saul promised to her by the LORD, As surely as the LORD lives, you wont get into trouble for this.

dag: ka yi ŋme n-nyaŋ bɛ ni me birininim gili bɛ tin shɛŋa la nim mini tiŋ gahinda la, ka ŋma bɛ ti suŋ kam zaa luhi; ka ŋari bɛ kɔbil nina zaa, ka kahi kuɣa sɔŋ luɣ shɛŋa din tam vuhiri shee zaa n-saɣim li.
en: You will then attack every fort and every grand city, cutting down all the good trees, stopping up all the springs, and ruining the good fields with stones.

dag: Di chɛliya ka sam shɛli doli ya n-naɣ pahila tab yubu samli, dama ŋunkam yur o ʒiʒiinikpee nyɛla ŋun pali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Be under obligation to no one—the only obligation you have is to love one another. Whoever does this has obeyed the Law.

dag: Wulinluhili polɔnim ni lu Yawɛ yuli sizuura, ka wulimpuhili polɔnim mi lu o sizuura o jilima zuɣu; dama dimnim maa yi ti kana kaman kokpɛɣu mini sanʒiɛɣu la, Yawɛ Shia ni ti yiɣisi tuhi ba.
en: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.

dag: Ka n daa bɔri ni m baŋ bɛ ni gbaag o shɛli zuɣu, ka zaŋ o tahi bɛ jintɔriba sani.
en: I wanted to know why they were accusing him. So I brought him before their council meeting.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yaa ni ŋmanila gumdi, ka bɛ tuma be kaman chɛbili la. Buɣim ni di bɛ mini bɛ tuma zaa, ka so ku kpihi li.
en: Your strongest leaders will be like dry wood set on fire by their idols. No one will be able to help, as they all go up in flames.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibiga Ɛliɛza daa kpuɣi Putiɛl bipuɣinsi ni yino n-daa zaŋ o dɔɣi Finɛhas. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya maa ni kpamba kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Aarons son, Eleazar, married a daughter of Putiel. She gave birth to Phinehas. All these people were from Israels son, Levi.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be Yisifu sani ka chɛ ka o diri nasara o tuma ni. O daa bela o dana ŋun nyɛ Ijipti nir maa yiŋa.
en: The Lord helped Joseph become a successful man. Joseph lived in the house of his master, Potiphar the Egyptian.

dag: Di ti tumiya tuma, di nyɛla zaligu yi ʒiɛmani kam ni sahakam yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: This regulation applies to all your descendants, no matter where they live.

dag: Nyin Ayuba, wummi dimbɔŋɔ, zanimi tɛhi Naawuni daalahiziba tuma yɛla.
en: Pause a moment, Job, and listen; consider the wonderful things God does.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa zali shɛm maa daa tiɣi naa mini niriba maa zaa nini.
en: The agreement satisfied King Hezekiah and all the assembly.

dag: Naawuni daa bi ku Izraɛl ninvuɣ zuɣuri maa, ka bɛ daa nya o, ka di ka nyu.
en: God did not harm these leading men of Israel; they saw God, and then they ate and drank together.

dag: Ka sapashin maa ni daa tim ninvuɣ shɛb maa daa lab yiŋa nti nya ka sapashini maa dabili maa shiri kpaŋmi zaa.
en: The messengers went back to the officer's house and found his servant well.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli yaha, Goli palli kam chuɣu dali mini Vuhim Dabisili dali kam di simdi ni zuliya kam zaa kana ti jɛm ma.
en: On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Doo yi na yoli niŋ amiliya, di bi simdi ni yi chɛ ka o doli tɔbbihi chaŋ tɔb ni bee n-chɛ ka o tum tuma lala tatabo, amaa di simdi ni bɛ chɛ o ka o be yiŋ yuun yini, ka o min o ni kpuɣi paɣ so maa laɣim mali suhupiɛlli.
en: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife.

dag: ka yɛl o, N ni zaŋ nama ŋɔ sulinsi mini di jilima zaa ti a, dama mani n-su li ka ni tooi zaŋ li ti n ni bɔri so.
en: The devil said, I will give you this whole domain and the glory of all these kingdoms. Its been entrusted to me and I can give it to anyone I want.

dag: Piligu ni, zuliya yɛtɔɣ yini n-daa be dunia ŋɔ zaa ni, ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa daa nyɛ yɛtɔɣ yinsi.
en: At first everyone spoke the same language.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ n-yili yilli paɣi Yawɛ dahin shɛli Yawɛ ni daa fa o o dimnim zaa nuu ni bahi, ka lan fa o Sool gba nuu ni bahi la nyaaŋa.
en: David sang a song to the Lord after the Lord had rescued him from his enemies, especially Saul. These are the words to David's song:.

dag: Di bɔhiya so biɛri bee n-tu so labisi, amaa lee niŋmiyala alibarika niŋmi bɛn niŋdi ya zaɣ biɛɣu ni, dama dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni daa boli ya ni di chɛ ka yi tooi nya o daalibarika.
en: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say.

dag: N lee bɔrila paɣibu ninsalinim sani bee Naawuni sani? Bee n kpaŋdi mmaŋ ni n tiɣila ninsalinim nini? N yi na kul tiɣiri ninsalinim nini, dindina n ku tooi nyɛ Masia dabili.
en: Am I trying to win over human beings or God? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I wouldnt be Christs slave.

dag: ka puu maa nyɛ dunia ŋɔ; ka alikama biɛlin suma maa nyɛ Naawuni nam ni bihi; ka piriŋkpana biɛlim la mi nyɛ Sintani bihi.
en: the field is the world; the good seed is the people who belong to the Kingdom; the weeds are the people who belong to the Evil One;.

dag: Bɛ ni daa du duli maa ha, ka Ilaija yɛli Ilaisha, Yɛlim ma a ni bɔri ni n niŋ shɛli ti a pɔi ka bɛ naanyi kpuɣ ma chaŋ ka chɛ a. Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, N suhir a, chɛ ka a shia ŋun be a ni ŋɔ ʒiibuyi zuɣu be n ni.
en: After they crossed the river, Elijah said to Elisha, What do you want me to do for you before God takes me away from you? Elisha said, I ask you for a double share of your spirit on me.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim maa bɛn daa siɣi tiŋgban kuŋ ni du, ka kom maa daa kul pirigi ʒiɛya kaman goma la bɛ nudirigu mini bɛ nuzaa polo.
en: But the sea had made a wall of water on each side of the Israelites, so they walked through on dry land.

dag: Yi vihiri Naawuni Kundi, dama yi tɛhiya ni di ni ka yi ni nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu; ka Naawuni Kundi maa maŋmaŋ gba diri ma shɛhira.
en: Examine the scriptures, since you think that in them you have eternal life. They also testify about me.

dag: Zoya ni fɔntinsi ni mini Shɛfɛla fɔntinsi ni ni Nɛgɛb fɔntinsi ni ni Bɛnjamin zuliya fɔntinsi ni ni luɣ shɛŋa din gili Jɛrusalɛm la ni Juda fɔntinsi ni piɛguliba ni ti lan kaani bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Shepherds will count their sheep as the sheep walk in front of them. They will be counting their sheep all around the country—in the hill country, in the western foothills, in the Negev, and in all the other towns of Judah.

dag: ni di chɛ ka niŋgbuŋ yaɣa maa zaa ku gaŋdi taba, amaa ka di baɣa lee ni bela tab ni.
en: God did this so that our body would not be divided. God wanted the different parts to care the same for each other.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ni tooi. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli, yi ni ti nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia maa ni, ka ti deei baptaizibu shɛli bɛ ni ti yɛn baptaizi ma maa;.
en: We can, they answered. Jesus said to them, You will indeed drink the cup I must drink and be baptized in the way I must be baptized.

dag: Baŋmiya ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni. Ŋuna n-nam ti, ka ti nyɛ o ni su shɛba. Ti nyɛla o niriba, ka nyɛ o ni gul shɛba kaman piɛri la.
en: Know that the LORD is God— he made us; we belong to him. We are his people, the sheep of his own pasture.

dag: Ka Samsin yɛl o, Bɛ yi zaŋ mi pal shɛŋa bɛ ni na bi zaŋ lo binshɛli lo ma, n ni gbarigi, ka be kaman sokam ni be shɛm.
en: He replied to her, If someone ties me up with new ropes that havent been used for work, Ill become weak. Ill be like any other person.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu chihila Naawuni daalikaulinima? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Dama Naawuni yi daa zali fukumsi zaligu shɛli ni di tooi tahi nyɛvili na, dindina taali ni yibu Naawuni sani naan shiri yi fukumsi zaligu maa dolibu ni na.
en: Does this mean that the law works against Gods promises? Of course not. The law was never Gods way of giving new life to people. If it were, then we could be made right with God by following the law.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi n-naɣ wuhiri ma tiŋ kam ni ni sarika kpɛbu mini wahala n-guli ma nimaani.
en: In every city I visit, I am told by the Holy Spirit that I will be put in jail and will be in trouble in Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ guurimi kaman tɔbutuhiriba la; ka duri goma kaman tɔbbihi la. Bɛ zaa mi kul dolila bɛ soya, ka bɛ taɣiri bɔba.
en: They climb over walls like warriors; they march in columns and never turn aside.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ bia maa min o ma labiri Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So Joseph took the child and the mother and went to Israel.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha, ka Ahija bia Baasha daa leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa n-ʒi Tiriza. O daa niŋla nam maa ni yuun pisinaanahi.
en: Ahijahs son Baasha became king of Israel during the third year that Asa ruled over Judah. Baasha ruled in Tirzah for years.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ n ni yiɣisi wuhi ni m mali yiko; bɛ ni tibigi ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: But the Lord says, Now I will do something and be greatly praised.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋm a mɔgɔr nɛma min a tɔbu ni a lɔɣu chaŋ mɔɣu ni ti ku mɔɣu ni valiga na.
en: So take your bow and arrows and go hunting. Kill an animal for me to eat.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn kul ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni ka galindi niriba. Bɛ dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔr biɛri soli, ka nyuri bara zaŋ chaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ biɛhigu polo, ka zaŋ naŋgban malisim yɛtɔɣa ni be di niriba zuɣu nyɔri.
en: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want.

dag: N ku guhi, n ni niŋ yomyom dol a zaligunim maa.
en: As soon as you command, I do what you say.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi yipa niŋ yɛda pumpɔŋɔ?.
en: Jesus answered them, Do you believe now?.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun galisi ka be zuɣusaa. O chɛ ka yɛlimaŋli mini wuntitali be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: How great the Lord is! He rules over everything. He will fill Jerusalem with justice and integrity.

dag: Nyama, timbil din ʒiɛya ŋɔ nyɛla din mirina ka nir ni zo nti kpe di ni. Chɛliya ka n zo nti kpe di ni tiligi. Yi nya di ni nyɛ timbil shɛm, ka m mi ni tooi zo nti kpe di ni tiligi.
en: Look, there is a very small town near here. Let me run to that town. I can run there and be safe.

dag: Noombihi zaa daa tɛrila bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu; ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri daa dɔɣiri bɛ bihi di mahim, ka zuliya pam ʒiini di mahim.
en: All the birds in the sky made nests in its branches; all the beasts of the field gave birth under its boughs, and in its shade, every great nation lived.

dag: Bɛ ni ti vɔn ya tahi gooni ŋmabu shee nti daai ya bahi Hamɔn. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will be dragged to the nearest break in the wall and thrown out.

dag: Nachimbil maa ni daa wum yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ ka o kuli ni suhugarigu, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he was very rich.

dag: M mabihi, n ni daa ka yi sanna la, pa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din to ni baŋbu bee yɛm yɛtɔɣa din yi bɔhimbu pam puuni na ka n daa zaŋ Naawuni daashili yɛlimaŋli yɛla la kahigiri wuhiri ya.
en: Dear brothers and sisters, when I came to you, I told you the secret truth of God. But I did not use fancy words or great wisdom.

dag: Dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti nyɛ yi Naawuni, dinzuɣu di simdi ni yi be kasi, dama n nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: I am the Lord who brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. You must be holy, because I am holy.

dag: Bɛn daa lo o nia biɛɣu maa n-daa nyɛ Zabad Shimiat ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn nir la bia mini Shimrit ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔab nir la bia Jɛhɔzabad.
en: These are the servants who made plans against Joash: Zabad and Jehozabad. Zabads mother was Shimeath, a woman from Ammon. And Jehozabads mother was Shimrith from Moab.

dag: Ka biɛɣ daa neei asiba ka Dauda sabi gbaŋ ti o ni o zaŋ mali chaŋ ti ti Jɔab.
en: Early the next morning, David wrote a letter and told Uriah to deliver it to Joab.

dag: Hal di yi niŋ lala ŋun di laɣim yuri pam lo bee n-chɛ ka niriba maa labi Ijipti ni bɛ ti laɣim yuri pam na ti pahi; dama Yawɛ daa yɛliya, Di lan labiya nimaani yaha.
en: That granted, the king must not acquire too many horses, and he must not return the people to Egypt in order to acquire more horses, because the LORD told you: You will never go back by that road again.

dag: Musa daa lan zaŋ tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Gaad zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ su li.
en: This is the land Moses gave to the tribe of Gad. He gave this land to each tribe:.

dag: Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba la ti miri binshɛŋa din nyɛ kasi la, ka ku kpi m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna min o bidibisi la kpɛm ti wuhi bɛ zaa yinoyino o tuma bee o ʒili ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: You must do these things so that the Kohathite men can go near the most holy things and not die. Aaron and his sons must go in and show each Kohathite man what to do and what to carry.

dag: bɛ muɣisigu zaa ni. Pa malaika ka o daa tim na, amaa ŋun Yawɛ maŋmaŋa n-daa tiligi ba. O nambɔzɔbo min o yurilim zuɣu ka o daa tiligi ba. Ŋuna n-daa pun gbib ba piligu ni ha.
en: from all their suffering. It was not an angel, but the Lord himself who saved them. In his love and compassion he rescued them. He had always taken care of them in the past.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun galisi ka be zuɣusaa. O chɛ ka yɛlimaŋli mini wuntitali be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: You, Lord , are above all others, and you live in the heavens. You have brought justice and fairness to Jerusalem;.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yiɣisi chaŋ vinvamli maa ni, ka Yawɛ jilima ʒe nimaani ŋ-ŋmani n ni daa pun nya jilima shɛli Kɛba Mɔɣili dul la. Ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa.
en: So I got up and went out to the valley. Suddenly, the LORDs glory stood there, like the glory that I had seen at the Chebar River, and I fell on my face.

dag: Ka nachimbihi maa ni yino garigi yɛli, Nyama, n daa nya Jɛsi ŋun nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la dapala, ka o mi mɔɣilo ŋmɛbu pam, ka nyɛ do so ŋun mali suhukpeeni, ka ni tooi tuhi tɔbu; o tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga, ka lan nyɛ ŋun viɛla, ka Yawɛ be o sani.
en: One of his attendants said, Jesse of the town of Bethlehem has a son who is a good musician. He is also a brave and handsome man, a good soldier, and an able speaker. The Lord is with him.

dag: Ka Ahimaaz daa ti paana yɛli naa, Bɛ zaa mal alaafee, Ka silim o zuɣu n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa ka yɛli, Naa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋun zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je nyini n dan naa niŋ ti nuu ni ŋɔ simdi paɣibu.
en: Ahimaaz called out a greeting to the king, threw himself down to the ground before him, and said, Praise the Lord your God, who has given you victory over the men who rebelled against Your Majesty.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ pini bɛ zuɣuri sunsuuni bee n-kɔrisi taɣi bɛ teensi bee n-chihi chiha bɛ niŋgbuna ni.
en: No priest shall shave any part of his head or trim his beard or cut gashes on his body to show that he is in mourning.

dag: Di nyɛla Naawuni Shia Kasi maŋmaŋa n-diri ti shɛhira ti suhuri ni ni ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi.
en: And the Spirit himself speaks to our spirits and makes us sure that we are Gods children.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa nya Izraɛlnim ni nyari nahiŋgu shɛm, ka so daa kani n-nyɛ dabili bee bilichina ka bi nya nahiŋgu ŋɔ; ka so mi daa kani din ni sɔŋ Izraɛlnima.
en: The LORD saw how brutally Israel suffered, whether slave or free, with no one to help Israel.

dag: Ka Juda daa bɔh o, N dana, wula ka ti lee lan yɛn yɛl a? Ti ka ti ni yɛn yɛli shɛm. Bee wula ka ti yɛn tooi niŋ tɔɣisi yi? Naawuni nya tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ taali ni nyɛ shɛli; ti mini bɛ ni nya pipia ŋɔ so sani maa zaa leela nyini n dan daba.
en: What can we say to you, sir? Judah answered. How can we argue? How can we clear ourselves? God has uncovered our guilt. All of us are now your slaves and not just the one with whom the cup was found.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ nachimbil maa kuli ni alaafee, ka bɛ suhuri daa maai pam.
en: They took the young man away alive, and they were greatly comforted.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti tim ti yɛli Jɛsi, Chɛ ka Dauda kpalim n yili ŋɔ n-tumdi n tuma; dama n suhu yu o pam.
en: Saul sent a message to Jesse: Please allow David to remain in my service because I am pleased with him.

dag: ka o yidan maa wum li ka bi yɛl o shɛli, ka mi bi galim li, dindina o pɔri maa min o ni lo alikauli shɛŋa zaa ni o ni niŋ shɛli maa ni zani.
en: If her husband hears about the promise and says nothing, she must do what she said.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ kpamba maa mini niriba maa zaa nyaɣisim pam, ka bɛ daa kanna ti yɔri bɛ farigu liɣiri maa niŋdi adaka maa ni hal ti naai dindali maa.
en: All the leaders and the people were happy. They brought their money and put it in the box. They continued giving until the box was full.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pa shihir shɛŋa yi ni sa nya la zuɣu ka yi bɔri n shee maa, amaa yi ni sa ŋub bɔrɔbɔro la tiɣ la zuɣu.
en: Jesus replied, I assure you that you are looking for me not because you saw miraculous signs but because you ate all the food you wanted.

dag: Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la bia Ɛliɛza n-daa nyɛ Lɛvinim kpamba maa zuɣulana; ŋuna n-daa lihiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn su luɣ kasi shee la.
en: Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Yiɣisima, garim niriba maa tooni leei bɛ zuɣulana ka yi lan gbaai soli, ka bɛ chaŋ ti ʒini n ni daa po pɔri bɛ yaannim sani ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni.
en: Then the LORD told me: Get going. Lead the people so they can enter and take possession of the land that I promised Id give to their ancestors.

dag: Lihimiy o ka mali suhupiɛlli; ka vi ku be yi ninni.
en: Keep your eyes on the Lord ! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti mali wuni ŋ-ŋmahindi binshɛli din be zuɣusaa bee binshɛli din be tiŋgbani puuni bee binshɛli din be kom ni tiŋgbani puuni.
en: Do not make for yourselves images of anything in heaven or on earth or in the water under the earth.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Naawuni min o Ba ŋɔ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Ba ŋun nyɛ nambɔzɔra mini suhumaabo zaa Naawuni.
en: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛm kul bɔhindila baŋsim pahira, ka yɛnnim tiba kul bɔri ni di wumdi baŋsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: An understanding mind gains knowledge; the ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

dag: Amaa Jɔnatan ŋun daa bi wum o ba ni po pɔri yɛli niriba maa shɛm maa, dinzuɣu ka o daa zaŋ jaaŋgbee din be o nuu ni tu shigbaŋ maa n-zaŋ o nuu nyɛhi li ti kpar o nol ni, ka o nini neei zaa.
en: Jonathan did not know about Saul's warning to the soldiers. So he dipped the end of his walking stick in the honey and ate some with his fingers. He felt stronger and more alert.

dag: nti kaŋka bɛ daalahichi ka o naanyi baptaizi ba Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili maa ni.
en: They told how sorry they were for their sins, and he baptized them in the river.

dag: Anabi Jɛrimia daa talimla Nɛria bia Sɛraya ŋun daa nyɛ Masɛya yaaŋa la ni o zaŋ lahibal shɛli chaŋ Babilɔn saha shɛl o ni daa doli Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia kuli Babilɔn o nam dibu yuma anahi ni la. Sɛraya daa nyɛla naa zo.
en: This is what the prophet Jeremiah instructed the staff officer Seraiah, Neriahs son and Mahseiahs grandson, when Seraiah went to Babylon with Judahs King Zedekiah in the fourth year of his rule.

dag: ka ashili yuli sab pa o gbɛɣu zuɣu. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Babilɔn titali, pagɔra mini dunia chihi biɛri ma.
en: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.

dag: M be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je suhudoo sani n-yuui pam.
en: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti kpihim buɣa yuli tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka so ku lan teei di yɛla yaha. N ni ti lan vuui anab ʒirinim mini buɣijɛmbo tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: At that time I will remove the names of the idols from the land, and no one will remember them any more. I will get rid of anyone who claims to be a prophet and will take away the desire to worship idols.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ifriim zuliya niriba daa kana ti bɔhi Gidiɔn, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa yɛn chaŋ ti tuhi Midiannim ka bi bol ti? Bɔzuɣu ka a niŋ ti lala? Ka bɛ daa galim o pam di zuɣu.
en: Then the people of Ephraim said to Gideon, Why didn't you call us when you went to fight the Midianites? Why did you treat us like this? They complained bitterly about it.

dag: Dama saha shɛli n ni daa zaŋ n niriba Izraɛlnim la na hal ni zuŋɔ, n na ʒi m-be yil ni, amaa n daa kul yirila suɣili ni n-lan kpɛri suɣili ni, ka yiri m biɛhigu shee.
en: From the time I rescued the people of Israel from Egypt until now I have never lived in a temple; I have always lived in tents and moved from place to place.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla leeŋa, ka nyɛ mahim din taɣiri ba tulim wuntaŋ ni ni sɔɣibu shee ni leeŋa din taɣiri ba pɔhim mini saa.
en: It will be a shelter to protect the people from the heat of the sun and from all kinds of storms and rain.

dag: O lan tim ma mi na ni n ti moli ni o ni yɛn tilig o niriba saha shɛl la paaya, ka moli ni o ni yɛn bɔhi biɛri saha shɛl la paaya; o lan tim ma mi na yaha ni n ti maai bɛn fabindi la suhuri.
en: He sent me to announce that the time has come for the Lord to show his kindness, when our God will also punish evil people. He has sent me to comfort those who are sad.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Yisa Nazarɛt nir la ka ti bɔra. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Mani m-bɔŋɔ. Ka Judas ŋun yi o nyaaŋa maa ʒiɛya m-pahi niriba maa zuɣu.
en: They answered, Jesus the Nazarene. He said to them, I Am.

dag: Lɛvinim maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari.
en: Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, had become the heads of their own clans.

dag: Yi daa bɔrigimi kaman piɛr la, amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa ŋmaligi labila yi Piɛgula ŋun nyɛ ŋun gbibi ya la sanna.
en: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn daa kul ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yim la zaa n-na be yi nyɛviya ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: but all of you who stayed true to the LORD your God are alive today.

dag: Ti bi nyu dam kuli kaman yi ni tɛhiri shɛm maa, dama yi mi ni pumpɔŋɔ na kul nyɛla asiba kurig awɛi.
en: These people arent drunk, as you suspect; after all, its only nine oclock in the morning!.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa laɣim ʒiya kumdi ka fabindi la ni Yisa neei kum ni.
en: She left and told his friends, who were crying and mourning.

dag: kumiya bɛ zaa, Hitinim mini Amɔrinim ni Keenannim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinima kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya shɛm.
en: You must completely destroy all the people—the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites. The Lord your God has commanded you to do this.

dag: Nyamiya, n yɛn lola yi mini yi zuliya.
en: I am now setting up my covenant with you, with your descendants.

dag: Aduna bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛliɛza mini Finɛhas ni Abishua.
en: This was Aarons family: his son Eleazar, his son Phinehas, his son Abishua.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ ni zo Rɛzin mini Pɛka dabiɛm ka zaɣisi Shilɔa kulibɔŋ kom din doya baalim la zuɣu.
en: He said, Because these people have rejected the quiet waters of Shiloah Brook and tremble before King Rezin and King Pekah.

dag: kpiimba biɛhigu shee mini paɣiŋoo ni tiŋgbani din bi nyuri kom tiɣira ni buɣim din na ʒi n-yɛli, Di saɣiya.
en: the world of the dead, a woman without children, dry ground that needs rain, and a fire burning out of control.

dag: N ku lan tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa pam, dama dunia ŋɔ naa kanna, amaa o ka n yiko.
en: I will not talk with you much longer. The ruler of this world is coming. He has no power over me.

dag: Yuun pisi ka Sulemaana daa zaŋ me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa min o nam yil la.
en: It took Solomon twenty years to build the Temple and his palace.

dag: Ka o daa yuuni salo maa gindi ni o nya ŋun niŋ lala maa.
en: But Jesus looked around carefully to see who had done it.

dag: dindina yin ŋmaam paɣa maa nuu, di zɔny o nambɔɣu.
en: If she does that, cut off her hand. Dont feel sorry for her.

dag: ka nyin Ayuba yaag a noli tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ka buchi ŋɔ, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ka bi mi di gbinni maa.
en: Everything you have said adds up to nonsense.

dag: Di biɛrisuŋ mini di viɛlim ti ku mali kpee! Di kawana ni ti chɛ ka nachimbihi mali kpiɔŋ, ka di wain mi chɛ ka paɣisara ni nyeena.
en: What is his goodness, and what is his beauty? Grain will make his young men flourish; so too wine his young women.

dag: Mbusim be tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba ŋɔ zuɣu, yɔhiŋgu mini faɣiri dibu kul palila di ni, ka nɛma ʒiɛbu ku naai.
en: Doomed is the lying, murderous city, full of wealth to be looted and plundered!.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka bɛ niŋ o yɛda shɛm maa ka o yɛli bara maa, M bia, n chɛ a daalahichi paŋ a.
en: When Jesus saw how much faith they had, he said to the man, My friend, your sins are forgiven.

dag: Ka n yi pirigi n ni mali shɛlikam zaa zaŋ tari, hal ka zaŋ n niŋgbuŋ ti ni bɛ nyo li buɣim, ka ka yurilim, dindina di ku ku ma buchi.
en: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.

dag: Bɛ kpuɣiri li tamdila bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu chana. Bɛ yi ti zaŋ li zali luɣ shɛli, di kul kpalim ʒiɛla nimaani; di ku tooi vuui chaŋ shɛli. Ka so yi suhi li, di ku tooi yɛli shɛli bee n-yihi dilana o muɣisigu ni.
en: They lift it to their shoulders and carry it; they put it in place, and there it stands, unable to move from where it is. If any pray to it, it cannot answer or save them from disaster.

dag: Abishur paɣ yuli n-daa booni Abiheel, ŋuna n-daa dɔɣi Ahiban mini Molid.
en: Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid.

dag: Di saha o ni ti bɔhi, Bɛ wuna la lee be ya? Bɛ ni daa sɔɣi tampiŋ shɛli ni la lee be ya?.
en: The Lord will ask, Where are their gods— the rocks they trusted in.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di wumdi ya anabi shɛb bɛn be yi sani ŋɔ yɛligu. Bɛ ŋmari ya la ʒiri; bɛ suhuyubu yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ tɔɣisiri maa. Di pala Yawɛ noli ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful says: Dont pay attention to what those prophets are saying to you. They are trying to fool you. They talk about visions, but they did not get their visions from me. Their visions come from their own minds.

dag: Dama zaɣ biɛɣu bi yirila taŋkpaɣu ni na, ka yɛlimuɣisira gba bi puhiri yiri tiŋgban ni na.
en: Bad times dont come up from the dirt. Trouble does not grow from the ground.

dag: ka so yi ti be puu ni, ŋun di lan kuli yiŋa ni o ti zaŋ o binyɛrigu.
en: If they are in the field, they must not go back to get a coat.

dag: Lala ka maligumaana maa yɛn niŋ m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara o zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zaɣ yini kam polo, ka o nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ. Ka din kpalim nyɛ maligumaaniba dini kaman chi bee kawana sara yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices.

dag: M mabihi, di benya kaman bihi la yi tɛha ni, amaa benyami kaman bihi la zaŋ chaŋ din nyɛ biɛr biɛɣu polo, ka lee bi dɔbba yi tɛha ni.
en: Brothers and sisters, dont be like children in the way you think. Well, be babies when it comes to evil, but be adults in your thinking.

dag: N ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka chɛ ka yi dɔɣi bihi n-nabi pahi, ka n kul gbibi n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la.
en: I will bless you and give you many children; I will keep my part of the covenant that I made with you.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli maligumaaniba maa, Yimiya Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni na.
en: So Joshua commanded the priests, Come up from the Jordan.

dag: Rubin ni daa ti lab bɔɣili maa gbinna nti bi nya Yisifu di ni, o daa darigimi toog o binyɛra.
en: When Reuben came back to the well and found that Joseph was not there, he tore his clothes in sorrow.

dag: Naawuni, m paɣir a. Di shini ma!.
en: God, I praise you! Hear my prayer and do something!.

dag: Aai Dama di yi nyɛ lala, wula ka Naawuni ni tooi kari dunianim saria?.
en: But the answer is, No. Otherwise, how could God judge the world?.

dag: Jɔab ni daa chɛ ka bɛ teei gili tiŋ maa, ka o zaŋ Yuria zali o ni mi ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi be shɛli polo.
en: So as Joab was attacking the city, he put Uriah in the place where he knew there were strong warriors.

dag: Amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn suhuri ni paligi ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni sani. Bɛ suhuri shiri ni paligi ka bɛ wa waa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: But let the righteous be glad and celebrate before God. Let them rejoice with gladness!.

dag: Ka di yɛla daa moli gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: The news about this spread all over that part of the country.

dag: ninvuɣ so ŋun daa kana ti yɛli ma, Nyama, Sool kpiya, ka daa tɛhi ni o ʒila lahiba suŋ na ti ti ma la, n daa gbaag o mi n-ku o Zikilag, ka di leeg o yɔri o ni ti ma lahiba shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: When a man came to Ziklag and told me that Saul was dead, he thought he deserved a reward for bringing good news. But I grabbed him and killed him.

dag: A ni nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa zaa, n ni zaŋ li ti a zuliya ka bɛ su li sahakam.
en: All this land that you see I will give to you and your people who live after you. This will be your land forever.

dag: A yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, nyaɣisim bɔ ka di lee tiri Kpiɔŋlan Naa? Bee a yi nyɛla ŋun ka galimi, nyo bɔ ka o yɛn nya di zuɣu?.
en: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.

dag: Yim ka Babilɔn dii lu n-wurim. Kummiya di zuɣu. Zaŋmiya kpam na ti bɔbili di daŋ maa, di pa shɛli di ni tibi kpaŋ.
en: But suddenly Babylon fell and shattered into pieces. Wail for her! Bring medicine for her pain; perhaps she will recover.

dag: Jɔab min o mabia Abishai ni daa ku Abinɛr shɛm m-bala. O ni daa ku bɛ mabia Asahɛl Gibiɔn tɔb la ni zuɣu.
en: So that is how Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner, because he killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Ti mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni Yawɛ be a sani, dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti min a laɣim lo tab alikauli.
en: They answered, Now we know that the Lord is with you. We think that we should make an agreement. We want you to make a promise to us.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum maa ni;.
en: But God raised him from the dead!.

dag: Kulibɔn shɛŋa din kom nyuui mini tiŋgbani voya ni ni tampima voya ni n-nyɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: so they live in scary ravines, holes in the ground and rocks.

dag: Teeku bula mini biŋkɔb kara bɛn be di ni, paɣimiya Yawɛ dunia ni.
en: Praise the Lord from the earth, sea monsters and all ocean depths;.

dag: Daŋ kam ni niriba daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya bɛ ni yɛn guli duno shɛŋa, bihi mini ninkura zaa.
en: They cast lots for each gate in the same way, whether their household was small or large.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o kpiɔŋ yɛla ni o ni daa tuhi tɔb shɛm min o ni daa deei Damaskus mini Hamat din nyɛ Judanim ni su shɛl la shɛm, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the great things that Jeroboam did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel . This includes the story about Jeroboam winning back Damascus and Hamath for Israel.

dag: ka o yɛli ba, N sa zahimla zahindi ka di yɛla muɣisi ma pam ka m bɔri ni m baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then the king said to them, I had a dream that bothers me. I want to know what it means.

dag: Sɔdom nanima, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu! Gomɔranima, wummiya Naawuni ni wuhiri ya shɛli.
en: Jerusalem, your rulers and your people are like those of Sodom and Gomorrah. Listen to what the Lord is saying to you. Pay attention to what our God is teaching you.

dag: Ka ti daa ŋme n-deeg o fɔntinsi zaa di saha maa, ka ku dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi fɔntiŋ kam ni. Bɛ ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi tiligi.
en: At that time, we captured all of Sihons cities, and we placed every town—men, women, and children—under the ban. We left no survivors.

dag: Ka Keenan paɣ so ŋun daa be di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni daa ka Yisa sanna ti kuhiri yɛra, N Duuma ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu! Alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi m bipuɣiŋga zuɣu m-muɣisir o pam.
en: A Canaanite woman from that area came out and began shouting, Lord, Son of David, please help me! My daughter has a demon inside her, and she is suffering very much.

dag: Niriba pam bɔri ni naa yuri ba, amaa Yawɛ sani ka nir nyari din niŋ kamaata.
en: Many seek access to the ruler, but justice comes from the LORD.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nya bimburiginli a mabia ninni, ka daantaliga lee sa amaŋmaŋ ninni ka a bi nya li?.
en: Why do you notice the small piece of dust that is in your friends eye, but you dont notice the big piece of wood that is in your own?.

dag: Ka saa daa miri sakuɣ kara ka nyaɣisira, ka lala tatabo daa na ʒi n-niŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha shɛli di ni daa leei di dahalali tiŋa.
en: The hail was falling, and lightning was flashing all through it. It was the worst hailstorm that had ever hit Egypt since it had become a nation.

dag: Ka n ni zaŋ dimdi niŋ a mini paɣ sunsuuni ni a zuliya min o zuliya sunsuuni, ka paɣ zuliya maa ni ti ŋme m-bɔr a zuɣu, ka a mi zuliya ti dim o zuliya napɔŋkpaa.
en: You and this woman will hate each other; your descendants and hers will always be enemies. One of hers will strike you on the head, and you will strike him on the heel.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ dɔɣ ma mi ni tuumbiɛri, bɛ ni daa zali m pua saha shɛli ka m pun nyɛ alahichilana.
en: I was born to do wrong, a sinner before I left my mothers womb.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa laɣim niriba maa zaa chaŋ Raba ti tuhi deei li.
en: So David gathered his forces, went to Rabbah, attacked it, and conquered it.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa, ka ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa n-nya Yisa ka o ʒiɛya, amaa ka o lee bi baŋ ni Yisa m-bala.
en: Then she turned around and saw Jesus standing there; but she did not know that it was Jesus.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ anabi Shɛmaya mini anabi Iddo yɛlikura litaafinim ni. Di saha maa Rɛhɔbɔam mini Jɛrɔbɔam daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu waawaayili.
en: Rehoboam's acts from beginning to end and his family records are found in The History of Shemaiah the Prophet and The History of Iddo the Prophet . Rehoboam and Jeroboam were constantly at war with each other.

dag: O paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Hushim la gba daa dɔɣi bidibisi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Abitub mini Ɛlipaal.
en: He also had children with Hushim: Abitub and Elpaal.

dag: bɔhim dunia ni tihi ka di wuh a; ka teeku ni zahim ni yɛl a.
en: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. Or let the fish in the sea tell you their wisdom.

dag: Bɛ ni ti deei Ɛdomnim tiŋgbɔŋ su. Siɛrinim dimnim ni ti deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ su.
en: Israel will grow strong! He will get the land of Edom. He will get the land of Seir, his enemy.

dag: O ni chɛ ka a wuntitali ne kaman wuntaŋ la, ka chɛ ka a yɛlimaŋli be kaman wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha neesim ni be shɛm la.
en: he will make your righteousness shine like the noonday sun.

dag: Yilimiya yil palli paɣi Yawɛ; dunianim zaa, yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ.
en: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth!.

dag: Jɔab ni daa chɛ ka bɛ teei gili tiŋ maa, ka o zaŋ Yuria zali o ni mi ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi be shɛli polo.
en: Joab watched the city and saw where the bravest Ammonites were. He chose Uriah to go to that place.

dag: Ka niriba yi mi ni nahu maa pun ʒiɛrila o taba ka o lan maa bi lɔr o zaana, dindina o ni bo nahu yo nahu maa zuɣu, ka zaŋ naɣ kpiŋ maa.
en: If you refuse to fence in a bull that is known to attack others, you must replace any animal it kills, but the dead animal will belong to you.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Ɛdom zoli zani dabari bahi yoli. Ka n chɛ ka bɛn zaa daa yi kanna ka chana ku lan kana.
en: I will make Mount Seir an empty ruin. I will kill everyone who enters or leaves that city.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm wun shɛŋa pahi n zuɣu.
en: You must have no other gods before me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-kahigiri wuhiri Naawuni bihi ni nyɛ shɛba, ka lan wuhiri Sintani gba bihi ni nyɛ shɛba: Ŋunkam bi tumdi din tuhi bee n-yur o mabia pala Naawuni bia.
en: So we can see who Gods children are and who the devils children are. These are the ones who are not Gods children: those who dont do what is right and those who do not love their brothers and sisters in Gods family.

dag: Ŋunkam tumdi tuumbiɛri, ŋun na kul be tuumbiɛri maa tumbu ni; ka ŋunkam mali tabizahim, ŋun na kul be o tabizahim tuma maa ni; ka ŋunkam nyɛ wuntizɔra, ŋun na kul be din tuhi tumbu ni; ka ŋunkam mi be kasi, ŋun na kul kpalimmi be kasi.
en: Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka yɛli ba, Nam yini puuni niriba yi ŋmaligi tuhiri taba, bɛ nam maa ni wurim; ka yil yin nim yi ŋmaligi zabira, bɛ yili maa mi wurindimi.
en: But he knew what they were thinking. So he said to them, Every kingdom that fights against itself will be destroyed. And a family that fights against itself will break apart.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ba yina ti bɔhi ba, N duumanima, ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ tiligi.
en: Then he led them out and asked, Sirs, what must I do to be saved.

dag: N firila baɣiri ni, ka n naba ni yɛn tam binshɛli zuɣu kani, m paala kɔbulli ni, ka kɔgbana ŋmɛri ma garita.
en: I am sinking in deep mud, and there is no solid ground; I am out in deep water, and the waves are about to drown me.

dag: Ti zaa daa ŋmanila piɛri bɛn bɔrigi, ka sokam dol o suhuyubu soli. Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ti zaa daalahichi ʒil o.
en: Like sheep we had all wandered away, each going its own way, but the LORD let fall on him all our crimes.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa nya malaikanima anahi, ka bɛ ʒe dunia luɣa anahi ŋɔ n-gu pɔhim soli ni di di ʒe n-kpe dunia ni bee teeku ni bee n-ʒe tihi.
en: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds so that no wind should blow on the earth or the sea or against any tree.

dag: O tuumba pinaayi maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la min o tizo Anduru ni Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi min o tizo Jɔn ni.
en: The first of the twelve apostles was Simon, better known as Peter. His brother Andrew was an apostle, and so were James and John, the two sons of Zebedee.
