dag: dama Naawuni pala ŋun tumdi chirachira, amaa o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun tumdi din doli soli. Zaŋ chaŋ di ni be Yisa nyaandoliba cheechinim zaa ni shɛm la polo.
en: because God does not want us to be in disorder but in harmony and peace. As in all the churches of God's people.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli Dauda, A ni bɔri ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa, n ni niŋ li ti a.
en: Then Jonathan said, Tell me what to do, and I'll do it.

dag: ni Alikauli Adaka la mini di dapuhi ni di yɔrigu ni di pateesa la.
en: the Holy Box, its poles, the mercy-cover, and the curtain that covers the area where the Box stays;.

dag: ka chɛ ka di ku pali mɔchɛriba nukura bee n-saɣi mɔbɔbilɔriba mɔbɔɣu.
en: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.

dag: Aduna mini Musa zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛba saha shɛli Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Sinai Zoli zuɣu la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the descendants of Aaron and Moses at the time when the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ salima alali mali zoligɔnima ŋ-ŋmɛl li kaman gabisi la n-zaŋ li niŋ nyolɔrigu maa;.
en: For the breastpiece make chains of pure gold, twisted like cords.

dag: Yɛlli ŋɔ lahibali ni daa ti nti to Hazɔr Naa Jabin saha shɛli, ka o daa tim ti yɛli Madɔn Naa Jɔbab mini Shimrɔn naa ni Akishaf naa.
en: King Jabin of Hazor heard about this. So he sent word to Madons King Jobab, to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph.

dag: Zuliya pam niriba ni ka yi neesim maa ni na, ka nanim ka yi biɛkaali neesim ni na.
en: Nations will come to your light and kings to your dawning radiance.

dag: ka duhi bɛ yee yɛli, Ti dan Yisa, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: they raised their voices and said, Jesus, Master, show us mercy.

dag: O ni daa yɛri ma yɛla maa, ka n daa lu n-dɔni tiŋ tarigi. Amaa ka o daa gbaai ma n-yiɣisi ma zali n naba zuɣu.
en: As soon as he said this to me, I fell into a trance. My face was still on the ground. Then Gabriel touched me and set me up on my feet.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yaai n noli, ka o zaŋ gbaŋ maa ti ma ni n ŋubi.
en: He handed me the scroll and said, Eat this and fill up on it. So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.

dag: Ka nachin kpɛm maa daa chaŋ ti kpe yili maa ni, ka Leeban daa paai laakumnim maa ʒiya, ka niŋ taɣitaɣi mini mɔri ti o ni o ti laakumnim maa. Di nyaaŋa ka Leeban daa tooi kom na ti ti o mini bɛn daa be o sani ni bɛ paɣi bɛ naba.
en: So the man entered the house. Then Laban unbridled the camels, provided straw and feed for them and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men with him.

dag: Ka o yɛli Yisa, N dana, wuhim ma o ni nyɛ so, ka n niŋ o yɛda.
en: He answered, Who is he, sir? I want to believe in him.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, So yi lan yɛl a shɛli, nyin tahim o n sanna, ka o ku lan tooi niŋ a shɛli yaha.
en: King David said, If anyone is saying bad things to you, bring them to me. They will not bother you again.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam mali biɛhiŋ zaŋ chaŋ o ni diri shɛli polo ka diri li mali taali o ni niŋdi shɛli maa ni bi yi yɛda niŋbu ni na zuɣu, dama binshɛɣukam din bi yi yɛda niŋbu ni na nyɛla alahichi.
en: But anyone who eats something without being sure it is right is doing wrong. That is because they did not believe it was right. And if you do anything that you believe is not right, it is sin.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ o ti ba ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus was taken away.

dag: Saɣimmiya yi ni yɛn kari ninvuɣ shɛb ka deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa buɣa jɛmbu shee zaa, din be zoya zuɣu mini daboya zuɣu ni ti maha gbina ni zaa.
en: In the land that you are taking, destroy all the places where the people worship their gods on high mountains, on hills, and under green trees.

dag: ka daa boli bia maa yuli Yisifu ka yɛli, Yawɛ tim ma bidib so pahi.
en: I'll name the boy Joseph, and I'll pray that the Lord will give me another son.

dag: Ka bɛ daa be Ijipti n-tumdi pagɔrisigu tuma. Bɛ bilim ni ka bɛ daa kul tumdi pagɔrisigu tuma maa. Nimaani ka bɛ daa tabisi bɛ biha, ka zaŋ ba saɣim.
en: When they were young, living in Egypt, they lost their virginity and became prostitutes.

dag: Din pahi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim mini bɛn daa zo n-tiligi ti kpi.
en: The LORD your God will send terror on them until even the survivors and those hiding from you are destroyed.

dag: ka yɛra, Timiya ma yiko ŋɔ, ka n gba zaŋdi n nuhi pari niriba zuɣu ka bɛ deeri Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: and said to Peter and John, Let me have this power too! Then anyone I place my hands on will also be given the Holy Spirit.

dag: Gbib ma ka n tiligi, ka kul dol a zaligunim sahakam.
en: Hold me, and I will be safe, and I will always pay attention to your commands.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka yɛlimaŋli naɣ beni kaman kulibɔŋ kom din zɔri la, ka chɛ ka wuntia mi be kaman mɔɣili kom din zɔri la.
en: But let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.

dag: Ka o daa ti kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya Farisiinim dabindi mini Naa Hɛrɔd dabindi la.
en: Jesus warned them, Watch out! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and of Herod.

dag: Ka a zaŋ di zaa tuɣi taba ka di leei da yini n-nyɛ zaɣ yini a nuu ni.
en: Hold these two sticks end to end, so they look like one stick.

dag: A ni bɔr a ba yiŋ la zuɣu ka a yiɣisi zɔri maa, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a zu n-kpuɣi n wuna.
en: Youve rushed off now because you missed your fathers household so much, but why did you steal my gods.

dag: N suui ʒitibisi shɛŋa din yi tam yi bɔɣusapima zuɣu la; ka yihi ya piɛri ʒiya la ʒibu ni.
en: I took the burdens off your backs; I let you put down your loads of bricks.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Chɛliya ka niriba pam ka bɛ sanna nti kpɛhi ba dabiɛm ka ʒe bɛ nɛma.
en: This is what the Lord GOD said: Gather the people together to punish and terrorize Oholah and Oholibah.

dag: Bɛna n-yɛn be tinsi maa ni ka su li, ka bɛ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee la nyɛ bɛ niɣi mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri zaa dini.
en: These cities will belong to the Levites, and they will live there. The pasture land will be for their cattle and all their other animals.

dag: Ka so yi je o kpee ka daag o luhi bee n-zaŋ bini lab o bee n-sɔɣi dɔni gu o ku o.
en: If in hatred someone hits another or throws something at him with premeditation, he will be put to death.

dag: Ka doo maa daa zo n-kuli Hitinim tiŋgban ni n-daa ti me omaŋmaŋ tiŋa m-boli di yuli Luz; ka di yuli n-na kul bala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: He went to the land where the Hittites lived and built a city. He named it Luz, and that city is still called Luz today.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Teem a nuu tiri teeku maa n-chɛ ka kom maa nahi tab yaha n-lim Ijiptinim maa n-tabili bɛ chɛchɛbunsi mini bɛ chɛchɛbunduhiriba maa zaa.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Stretch out your hand over the sea so that the water comes back and covers the Egyptians, their chariots, and their cavalry.

dag: Ʒii shɛli gbinni bɛ ni daa kahigi wuh a zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni min asiba sara maligu shɛŋa yɛla polo la nyɛla din ni niŋ yɛlimaŋli. Amaa lee gbib li ashilɔni, dama di ni yɛn niŋ pali saha shɛli maa na wɔɣ pam.
en: What I said and the vision about those times are true. But seal up the vision, because those things will not happen for a long, long time.

dag: N yi di yu alahichi n suhu ni, n Duuma naan ku deei n suhigu.
en: If I had ignored my sins, the Lord would not have listened to me.

dag: Ilaisha ni daa nya lala maa, ka o kuhi yɛli, M ba, m ba! Izraɛl chɛchɛbunsi mini di wɔribariba. Ka o daa bi lan nya Ilaija yaha. Di saha ka o daa gbaag omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu darigi tooi li buyi.
en: Elisha was watching, and he cried out, Oh, my father, my father! Israels chariots and its riders! When he could no longer see him, Elisha took hold of his clothes and ripped them in two.

dag: Hɔrinim nanima n-daa nyɛ: Lɔtan mini Shɔbal ni Zibiɔn ni Ana.
en: These are the names of the leaders of the Horite families: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah.

dag: Zaɣ biɛ shɛli ka n nya dunia ŋɔ ni, chirimbu titali maa mi yirila zuɣulaannim sanna.
en: Here is something else that I have seen in this life that isnt fair. It is the kind of mistake that rulers make.

dag: Ka Bɛnaaya ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔiada bia la daa mali suhukpeeni pam Kabiziil niriba ni. O daa tum tuun kara pam. Ŋuna n-daa ku Mɔabnim tɔbutuhiri biinsi ayi la, ŋuna n-daa lan siɣi bɔɣili ni ti ku gbuɣinli dahin shɛli sakuɣa ni daa lu la.
en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada from Kabzeel was a famous soldier; he did many brave deeds, including killing two great Moabite warriors. He once went down into a pit on a snowy day and killed a lion.

dag: Binnɛma anahi maa daa yi ti tibigiri ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa ni ka tir o jilima, ka paɣiri ŋuna ŋun ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu maa saha shɛli.
en: Whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the one seated on the throne, who lives forever and always.

dag: O noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka Ribɛka ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtuɛl bipuɣiŋga la paana, ka koyuli tam o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu. Bɛtuɛl mi daa nyɛla Ibrahimma tizo Nahɔr min o paɣ Milika bidibiga.
en: Before he had finished praying, Rebecca arrived with a water jar on her shoulder. She was the daughter of Bethuel, who was the son of Abraham's brother Nahor and his wife Milcah.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa yɛli Naawuni, N suhir a, dolimi Ishimail nyɛvili.
en: Then he asked God, Why not let Ishmael inherit what you have promised me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa piri Aduna bidibisi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Aaron's descendants were then divided into work groups. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: Ti Duuma kpaŋsim a suhu! Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.

dag: A niŋ yɛda ni o ni ʒi a puu atam labina ti sɔŋ a kabɔɣili ni?.
en: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place?.

dag: Di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɔhim ya yɛli, Yawɛ ni tiligi ti. Zuliya shɛb wuna na mi n-fa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ Asiria naa nuu ni?.
en: Dont believe Hezekiah when he tells you, The Lord will save us. He is wrong. Did any of the gods of other nations save their land from the king of Assyria?.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka di simdi ni paɣ zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu malaikanim zuɣu, ka di wuhi ni so su o fukumsi.
en: So that is why a woman should have her head covered with something that shows she is under authority. Also, she should do this because of the angels.

dag: A dimnim yi lu, nyin di chɛ ka di niŋ a nyaɣisim, bɛ yi tuui, nyin di chɛ ka a suhu piɛla.
en: When your enemies fall, dont rejoice. When they stumble, dont let your heart be glad.

dag: Bɛraya bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɛbɛr mini Malikiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Birizait ba la.
en: Beriahs family: Heber and Malchiel, who was Birzaiths father.

dag: Naawuni, a soli nyɛla din be kasi; wun ŋuni n-lee galisi paai ti Naawuni ŋɔ?.
en: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa daa zaŋ o mabia Ɛliakim leei Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm naa, ka taɣ o yuli m-bol o Jɛhoyakim; amaa ka daa zaŋ Jɛhoyakim mabia Jɛhɔahaz kuli Ijipti.
en: Neco chose Jehoahazs brother Eliakim to be the new king of Judah and Jerusalem. Neco gave Eliakim a new name. He named him Jehoiakim. But Neco took Jehoahaz to Egypt.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya paɣ so ŋun nyɛ yidaampaɣ maŋli? O gari salima.
en: How hard it is to find the perfect wife. She is worth far more than jewels.

dag: A niŋ ti mi kaman a ni daa pun yɛli ni a ni niŋ ti mini ti kpamba shɛm. A darigi Jɛrusalɛm tibili pam gari tiŋ kam dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: You did what you said you would do to us and our rulers. You punished Jerusalem more severely than any other city on earth.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli pal shɛli o ni lo n ʒim ni. Dina n-nyɛ n ʒi shɛli din ti yɛn yi n niŋgbuŋ ni niriba pam zuɣu.
en: He said to them, This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.

dag: O daa niŋ yɛda ni o yi nya turi Masia zuɣu, di so Ijipti azichi, dama o daa lihirila o ni ti yɛn nya laara shɛli dahin shɛl ha la.
en: He reckoned that to suffer scorn for the Messiah was worth far more than all the treasures of Egypt, for he kept his eyes on the future reward.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, ŋunkam daa kpe yili maa ni saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kpar li zali la nyɛla ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anyone who goes into that house will be unclean until evening.

dag: Ka bɛn daa yi Hɛman daŋ ni na daa nyɛ: Jɛhuɛl mini Shimɛi. Ka bɛn mi daa yi Jɛdutun daŋ ni na daa nyɛ Shɛmaya mini Uziɛl.
en: from the descendants of Heman: Jehuel and Shimei; and from the descendants of Jeduthun: Shemaiah and Uzziel.

dag: Di simdi ka o zaŋ kawana lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili pahi naɣilaa kam zuɣu, ka lan zaŋ kawana lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili pahi piɛlaa kam zuɣu m-mali sara din nyɛ o chi min o kawana sara, ka bo kpam lita ata pahi kawaan tahili kam zuɣu.
en: He will also provide nine kilograms of grain and three liters of olive oil to be offered with each bull and each ram.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Bɔhimi nya ŋun bia bala.
en: Then find out whose son that young man is, the king replied.

dag: Amaa ka sapashin la daa bɔri ni o tiligi Pool ka gɔŋ ba ni bɛ di niŋ lala, ka naɣ yɛli ba mi ni bɛn mi kɔduɣili, bɛn lum kom maa ni n-daŋ duɣi du.
en: But Captain Julius wanted to save Paul's life, and he did not let the soldiers do what they had planned. Instead, he ordered everyone who could swim to jump into the water and head for shore.

dag: Musa mini Aduna ni daa gari tooni zaŋ Izraɛlnima ka bɛ yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni chani kaman tɔbbihi la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These were the stages by which the Israelites marched when they left the land of Egypt, according to their military units under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.

dag: Ka di simdi ni cheechi buɣisi ba pɔi, ka bɛ biɛhigu yi wuhi ni bɛ ka galimi, ka cheechi naanyi chɛ ka bɛ tum cheechi sɔŋdiba tuma.
en: They should also be tested and then serve if they are without fault.

dag: O labisi n yaa ti ma. O wuhi ma soya din tuhi o yuli zuɣu.
en: He restores my strength. He leads me on right paths to show that he is good.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a soli, ka n dol a yɛlimaŋli la; tim ma suhuyini, ka n tibigir a yuli.
en: Teach me your way, LORD, so that I can walk in your truth. Make my heart focused only on honoring your name.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ, bɛ ni daa teei gili ma kaman tin shɛli bɛ ni liri, ka o tum ma o yurilim maŋli tuun shɛli din mali alahiziba la zuɣu.
en: I will praise you, Lord , for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.

dag: Hal bɛ daa timla tuumba katinsi ni bɛ ti boli dɔbba ti ba, ka bɛ daa shiri kana. Bɛ zuɣu ka a su kom, ka bali chilo, ka zaŋ yɛ viɛla ye.
en: They even sent for men who came from a great distance. No sooner than a messenger was sent, they arrived! For these men you bathed, you painted your eyes, and you put on your jewelry.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛl o niriba maa, Mani n-daa wurim ya bahi ka yi chaŋ ti be luɣ shɛlikam, dinzuɣu yinim bɛn be tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa, Zomiya yi Babilɔn n-lab Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: The Lord says to his people, Run! Escape from the land in the north, where I scattered you to the four winds.

dag: Malaika yi di be bɛ sani, ŋun nyɛ sandaantimda, ka nyɛ malaikanim tuhili ni yino, n-wuhi ni daadam nyɛla ŋun bebu tuhi.
en: Perhaps an angel may come to their aid— one of God's thousands of angels, who remind us of our duty.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, nyini ka n zaŋ n nina lihira. A sani ka n sɔɣi. Di chɛ ma ka m bahi yoli!.
en: But my eyes are on you, my LORD God. I take refuge in you; dont let me die!.

dag: O ni daa nam zuɣusaa, n daa beni, o ni daa booi booli gili teeku zuɣu, n daa beni.
en: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.

dag: Yi niriba ŋmanila zana ni gbahi kparibu shɛba. Bɛ kul gbarigimi do sochira kam zuɣu. Bɛ nyula Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili mini Naawuni tibidarigibo buɣi.
en: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.

dag: lala ka daadamnim doya ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha, hal ka sagbana ti lan kani, bɛ ku lan yiɣisi, bee n-neei bɛ gom maa ni.
en: so people lose their lives, never to live again. The skies will all pass away before they rise from death. The skies will all disappear before anyone wakes up from that sleep!.

dag: Ka dansarika gul maa daa bi lan lihir o ni zaŋ binshɛlikam niŋ Yisifu nuu ni maa, dama Yawɛ daa be Yisifu sani, ka o daa yi niŋ shɛlikam, Yawɛ chɛrimi ka di tɔŋ.
en: The jailer did not have to look after anything for which Joseph was responsible, because the Lord was with Joseph and made him succeed in everything he did.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zani dubil yini nyaaŋa m-buɣisi dunɔdali zaŋ ti paai dubil din la nyaaŋa, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili zaŋ goon yini hal ti paai goon dini la.
en: The man measured the distance from the back wall of one of these rooms to the same spot in the room directly across the passageway, and it was twelve and a half meters.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka noli di dunia, ka niriba bɛn be di ni di wahala bɛ taali zuɣu; ka di chɛ ka daadamnim kul filinda hal ka niriba biɛla nti kpalim.
en: The people living in this land are guilty of doing wrong, so God promised to destroy the land. The people will be punished, and only a few of them will survive.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ Ofiri salima bee kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni booni oniɣisi la bee safaya buɣisi li.
en: You cannot buy it with gold from Ophir or with precious onyx or sapphires.

dag: Dauda tɔbutuhiri biinsi maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Jashɔbiam ŋun daa nyɛ Hachimɔn nira, ka daa nyɛ wɔɣiri kɔba ata la kpɛma. Ŋuna n-daa ti zaŋ o kpani lu niriba kɔbisita zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa saha yin la.
en: This is the list of Davids warriors: Jashobeam, a Hacmonite, was commander of the Thirty. He raised his spear against eight hundred, killing them on a single occasion.

dag: Amaa ka Iso daa guuina ti tuh o soli m-bɔb gbaag o n-zaŋ o zuɣu ti pa o nyingol zuɣu m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ka bɛ zaa dii kuhira.
en: When Esau saw Jacob, he ran to meet him. He put his arms around Jacob, hugged his neck, and kissed him. Then they both cried.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Gibiɔnnim maa, Bɔ ka n lee yɛn niŋ tin ya? Bee bɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ yɔn ya ti ni daa tum ya taal shɛli maa samli, ka yi suhi alibarika niŋ Yawɛ ni su shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: So David summoned the people of Gibeon and said to them, What can I do for you? I want to make up for the wrong that was done to you, so that you will bless the Lord 's people.

dag: Nir yi chaŋ kumsi ni be yil shɛli, di so ni o chaŋ dimma ni nyubu ni be yil shɛli. Dinzuɣu di simdi ni bɛn be bɛ nyɛviya ni baŋ ni kum nyɛla din yɛn paai sokam zaa.
en: It is better to go to a funeral than to a party, because everyone must die, and the living need to remember this.

dag: Ka Pita daa gbaai yɛla maa yiniyini n-kahigiri wuhiri ba yɛra:.
en: Step-by-step, Peter explained what had happened.

dag: O daa zaŋ ma zali pal tital ni. O daa tiligi ma, dama o nini daa tiɣi ma.
en: He was pleased with me, so he rescued me. He took me to a safe place.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ zaa tɔɣisi ti ni daa ka yi sanna ka yi deei ti viɛnyɛliŋga shɛm la yɛla: Yi daa ŋmaligi chaŋ Naawuni sani ka chɛ buɣa ni yi jɛm Naawuni maŋli ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililana ŋɔ.
en: People everywhere are already telling the story about the good way you accepted us when we were there with you. They tell about how you stopped worshiping idols and changed to serve the living and true God.

dag: O yi niŋ ya kaman o daba n-nyɛn ya la bee n-saɣim yi bini bee n-din ya zalinsi bee n-ʒiɛm ya bee ŋ-ŋmɛn ya tapaɣa, yi dir o suɣilo.
en: You tolerate anyone who orders you around or takes advantage of you or traps you or looks down on you or slaps you in the face.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani ka yiko. Dabiɛm kpe ba, ka di niŋ ba alahiziba. Bɛ ŋmanila mɔri din be mɔɣu ni bee mɔ shɛŋa din bili mɔpilli zuɣu ka na bi zooi ka wuntaŋ ŋme n-ku li.
en: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or like tender young grass growing on a flat roof or like a field of grain before it matures.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi yɛli bɛ ni zaŋ liɣiri maa n-niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb nuu ni ni bɛ yo tumtumdiba maa ni bɛ malim bɛ ni di liɣiri maa shɛm laasabu wuhi ba, dama bɛ daa doli yɛlimaŋli soli bɛ tuma ni.
en: The men in charge of the work were thoroughly honest, so there was no need to require them to account for the funds.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti yiɣisi yimaŋmaŋ gba ni n-tɔɣisi ya chirimbu yɛtɔɣa ni bɛ lɛbigi nyaandoliba maa suhuri n-zu ba chaŋ.
en: The time will come when some men from your own group will tell lies to lead the believers away after them.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka ti birigi ka chɛ a soli? Bee bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka ti niŋ tipawumli n-zo a sani? Labimi ti sanna, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ a daba la mini zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ a niriba la zuɣu.
en: Lord , why are you pushing us away from you? Why are you making it hard for us to follow you? Come back to us! We are your servants. Come to us and help us! Our tribes belong to you.

dag: Ka so di ti bɔhi ni o nyɛla ŋun viɛl bee ŋun bi viɛla, ka so mi di ti zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o, ka so yi ti zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o, dindina o min o ni zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o maa zaa ni leei din be kasi, ka so ku lan tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o.
en: You may not arrange the animals so that the poor animals are chosen, and you may not make any substitutions. If you do substitute one animal for another, then both animals will belong to the Lord and may not be bought back.

dag: Ka a ti niŋ salima alali pa di zuɣu, ka niŋ li pa di zuɣusaa mini di luɣa ni ni di binyila maa zaa zuɣu, ka mali salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Cover the altar with pure gold, including its top, all its sides, and its horns. You should also make a gold molding all around it.

dag: Bɛ pun chɛ n ni daa zali ba ni bɛ doli so shɛl la, ka malila naɣibila n-jɛmdi li, ka maani maligu tiri li, ka yɛli, Izraɛlnima, yi buɣili ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la m-bɔŋɔ. .
en: They have already stopped obeying me and have made themselves an idol in the shape of a young bull. They have bowed down to it, offered sacrifices, and said that it is the god who brought them out of Egypt.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣ asibaasi ka Ashidɔdnim daŋ yiɣisibu n-nya ka buɣili Dagɔn lu m-pilila o puli zuɣu Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni. Ka bɛ daa kpuɣi buɣili Dagɔn n-lan zal o zaashee.
en: When the people of Ashdod got up early the next morning, they found the statue lying facedown on the floor in front of the sacred chest. They put the statue back where it belonged.

dag: Ka dɔbba bɛn zaa daa be o yiŋ puuni, ka nyɛ bɛ ni dɔɣi bidib shɛb mini bɛ ni daa zaŋ bɛ liɣiri da shɛb tinzunnim sani zaa gba daa guni.
en: All the men of his household, those born in his household and those purchased with silver from foreigners, were circumcised with him.

dag: Dama jɛrigu tɔɣisirila jɛrilim yɛtɔɣa, ka tɛhiri zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu yɛla. O ni tumdi shɛm min o ni yɛri shɛm nyɛla biriginsim zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani. O mi na ʒi n-ti kum ni mali shɛb bindirigu bee n-niŋ kom ti kɔnyuri ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Fools say foolish things, and in their minds they plan evil things to do. They want to do what is wrong. They say bad things about the Lord . They dont let hungry people eat their food. They dont let thirsty people drink the water.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Abirɔna maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Ɛziɔngɛba.
en: They marched from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ tumdi tuma sɔŋdi ya, ka tumdi bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛli zaa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni; amaa bɛ di miri sara maligu shee lahi la bee sara maligu bimbini maa, bɛ yi niŋ lala, yi mini ba ni kpi.
en: They will perform their duties for you and the service for the entire tent. But they will not approach the holy equipment of the sanctuary or the altar, lest both they and you die.

dag: Di pɔ dunia ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla Naawuni napɔntamdigu; ka di pɔ Jɛrusalɛm gba, dama di nyɛla Natitamlan tiŋa;.
en: You must not pledge by the earth, because its Gods footstool. You must not pledge by Jerusalem, because its the city of the great king.

dag: Bɛ yi ti biɛra, Yawɛ ni sɔŋ ba, ka tib bɛ dɔriti zaa.
en: The LORD will strengthen them when they are lying in bed, sick. You will completely transform the place where they lie ill.

dag: di saha maa n daa bela o luɣili zuɣu kaman tumtumdiba kpɛm la. O suhu daa piɛli n zuɣu dabisili kam, ka n kul mali suhupiɛlli o sani sahakam.
en: I was beside him like an architect, I was his daily source of joy, always happy in his presence—.

dag: Chɛ ka a baɣa be a daalikauli la ni, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri duŋ taabu kul palila tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛŋa din nyɛ zibisim shee.
en: Remember the agreement you gave us, because violence fills every dark place in this land.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam zaa tumdi din tuhi chanila neesim ni ni sokam ti nya o tuma ka baŋ ni o zɔri Naawuni.
en: Whoever does the truth comes to the light so that it can be seen that their actions were done in God.

dag: ni di chɛ ka sokam zaa ti Bia maa jilima kaman bɛ ni tir o Ba maa jilima shɛm. Ŋunkam bi tiri Bia maa jilima bi tirila o Ba ŋun tim o maa na jilima.
en: God did this so that all people will respect the Son the same as they respect the Father. Anyone who does not respect the Son does not respect the Father. He is the one who sent the Son.

dag: Doo daa bi lan kpalim Ai bee Bɛtɛl. Bɛ daa yimi kari doli Izraɛlnima, ka chɛ bɛ tiŋ maa dunoli yali.
en: No one who hadnt gone out after Israel was left in either Ai or Bethel. They left the city wide open and chased after Israel.

dag: Chɛliya ka Masia yɛligu ba jila yi suhuri ni pam. Wuhimiya taba ka kpammiya tab jaande yɛm zaa puuni, ka zaŋmiya adiini yila mini Naawuni paɣibu yila ni Yila litaafi ni yila n-yiini paɣiri Naawuni yi suhuri ni.
en: Let the teaching of Christ live inside you richly. Use all wisdom to teach and counsel each other. Sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with thankfulness in your hearts to God.

dag: ni nabihi bɛn mali salima, ka zaŋ anzinfa pali bɛ yinsi la n-di vuhira.
en: and with rulers once rich with silver and gold.

dag: Ka Yuria bia Mɛrɛmɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Hakɔz yaaŋa la daa mali me Ɛliashib yiŋ dunoli maa shee hal ti paai o yiŋ maa tariga m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Meremoth, the son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built the next section, up to the far end of Eliashib's house.

dag: Di daa bi simdi ni yi mali yi mabihi ansarisi bɛ nandahima dabisili dali. Di daa bi simdi ni yi mali suhupiɛlli Judanim zuɣu bɛ kpimsibu dabisili dali. Di daa bi simdi ni yi nyu bara n-niŋ ba bɛ wahala dibu dabisili dali.
en: You should not have gloated over the misfortune of your relatives in Judah. You should not have been glad on the day of their ruin. You should not have laughed at them in their distress.

dag: Man ŋuna, Naawuni ka n yɛn jɛmda, ka zaŋ n yɛla niŋ Naawuni nuu ni.
en: Job, if I were you, I would ask God for help.

dag: Yi ni ti teerila dabiɛm din daa yi mali ya la yɛla ka bɔhira, Ka ŋun kaani liɣiri la lee be ya? Ka ŋun zahindi farigu binyara tibisim la lee be ya? Ka ŋun kaani pihi la lee be ya.
en: Your old fears of foreign tax collectors and spies will be only a memory.

dag: Ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim daa laɣim zani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔn palli la ni, ka Jɛhɔshafat daa kana ti zani bɛ sani.
en: After everyone from Judah and Jerusalem had come together at the Lord 's temple, Jehoshaphat stood in front of the new courtyard.

dag: A ni daa tim ma dunia ŋɔ ni na shɛm, lala ka n gba tim ba.
en: As you sent me into the world, so I have sent them into the world.

dag: Ka bɛnkam ʒe yim hal ti paai biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisita ni pihitanaanu la tariga mal alibarika!.
en: God will bless everyone who patiently waits until , days have gone by.

dag: Naawuni mi n-ti ninvuɣ shɛb azichi mini nɛma ni jilima, ka bɛ ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa shɛli bi poori ba, amaa ka o bi chɛ ka bɛ tooi diri di nyaɣisim, ka naɣ chɛ ka ninvuɣ zino n-diri di nyaɣisim maa. Dimbɔŋɔ ka buchi, ka nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu pam.
en: God may give you everything you want—money, property, and wealth. Then God doesn't let you enjoy it, and someone you don't even know gets it all. That's senseless and terribly unfair!.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbibiya n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa zaa, ka tummiya di tuma, dina n-ni chɛ ka n ni zaŋdi ya kuni tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa ti ku gbuɣi ya bahi.
en: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.

dag: n ni mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani. N ni mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiligira ŋɔ sani.
en: But I will still be glad in the Lord and rejoice in God my Savior.

dag: Doli naa zaligu, a ni po pɔri din nyɛ kasi la zuɣu.
en: If you promised God that you would be loyal to the king, I advise you to keep that promise.

dag: Amaa o yi yɛli ma, N nini bi lan tiɣ a. Nyama, mani m-bɔŋɔ, O niŋmi ma kaman o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: But if he says he isn't pleased with me, then let him do what he knows is best.

dag: Jɔn daa di o shɛhira kuhi yɛli, Ŋumbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ n ni daa yɛli so yɛla ni ŋun be n nyaaŋa kanna gari ma la, dama o daa be saha shɛli n ni daa na kani.
en: John testified about him, crying out, This is the one of whom I said, He who comes after me is greater than me because he existed before me.

dag: Hal bɛ nyɛla bɛn kul kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ chɛ ka ti ku yihi waazu din tahiri tiliginsim na la n-ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alahichi shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa ni bɛ tum zan tariga; amaa Naawuni suhuyiɣisili la pun paai ba.
en: when they try to stop us from speaking to the Gentiles so they can be saved. Their sins are constantly pushing the limit. Gods wrath has caught up with them in the end.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o chaŋ Zɔfim mɔɣu ni Pisiga Zoli zuɣu nti me sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali, ka kɔrigi naɣila yinoyino mini piɛla yinoyino m-mali sara pa di zaɣ yini kam zuɣu.
en: He took him to the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah. He built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa kali Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm.
en: Moses obeyed, and registered all the first-born males.

dag: Ka o daa lan pii Daniɛl mini niriba ayi shɛba m-pahi ni bɛ lihiri kpambaliba maa ka bɛ tumdi ŋun naa maa tuma ka di mali nyɔri.
en: He chose three men to rule over the satraps. Daniel was one of the three supervisors. The king put these men in this position to keep anyone from cheating him.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, A ku tooi nya n ninni, dama ninsal ku tooi nya n ninni ka lan be.
en: I will not let you see my face, because no one can see me and stay alive.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa tahi luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Goligɔta la. Di gbinni nyɛla Zuɣuŋmaŋ Shee.
en: They brought Jesus to the place called Golgotha, which means Skull Place.

dag: Nyamiya, Yawɛ dabisili maa dali shiri kanna. Di ti yɛn nyɛla o sujee min o suhuyiɣisili ni o putɔɣu niŋbu dali. O ni ti chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ kpalimla tiŋgban nɛli, ka ku alahichinim bɛn be di ni zaa.
en: Look, the day of the LORD is coming with cruel rage and burning anger, making the earth a ruin, and wiping out its sinners.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Nuhu, N lo nia ni n kpihim ninsalinim zaa birili, dama bɛna n-chɛ ka tuumbiɛri pali dunia ŋɔ ni. Nyama, n ni kpihim bɛ birili dunia ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: So he told Noah: Cruelty and violence have spread everywhere. Now I'm going to destroy the whole earth and all its people.

dag: O luɣi bɛ tiba, ka wuhi ba, ka zali ba ni bɛ zom yi alahichi ni labi o sanna.
en: then he warns them to turn back to him.

dag: Aduna ŋɔ mini Musa ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Yihimiya Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni gbilligbilli la.
en: Aaron and Moses were from this tribe. And they are the men the Lord spoke to and said, Lead my people out of Egypt in groups. .

dag: Di saha ka n daa moli molo Ahava Mɔɣili duli ni ti siɣisi timaŋ ti Naawuni sani, ka suh o ni o tim ti mini ti bihi ni ti ni su shɛlikam zaa napɔŋ suŋ ti chandi ni.
en: Then I called for a fast there at the Ahava River so that we might submit before our God and ask of him a safe journey for ourselves, our children, and all our possessions.

dag: Ŋunkam yuri zabili nyɛla ŋun yuri alahichi. Ŋun me dunɔbia din du pam nyɛla ŋun bɔri kɔb kaba.
en: Those who love an offense love a quarrel; those who build a high doorway invite a collapse.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ biɛr ayi maa daa kana ti ʒin tuh o, ka fiɣisi Nabɔt yɛli, Nabɔt turila Naawuni mini naa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o yi tiŋ maa tariga nti lab o kuɣa ku.
en: The two liars came in and sat across from Naboth. Then they accused him of cursing God and the king, so the people dragged Naboth outside and stoned him to death.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Huramabi ŋun nyɛ tuumbaŋda, ka mali yɛm pam la ka a sanna.
en: Im sending you a skilled and experienced craftsman, Huram-abi.

dag: Ka a ti lan yɛli ba yaha ni Izraɛl ninvuɣ so bee saan shɛb bɛn be bɛ sani ninvuɣ so yi yɛn mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bee sara maligu.
en: Tell the people: Any citizen of Israel, traveler, or foreigner living among you might want to offer a burnt offering or some other sacrifice.

dag: Chɛ ka ti yɛli ni yi mabia ŋun nyɛ doo bee paɣa beni n-nyɛla ŋun chani gbinfini ka ka bindirigu din ni di.
en: Imagine a brother or sister who is naked and never has enough food to eat.

dag: A bɔri ni yɛlimaŋli be nir suhu ni; dinzuɣu wuhim ma yɛm n suhu ni.
en: But you want complete honesty, so teach me true wisdom.

dag: Ka Nashɔn daa nyɛ Aminadab bia, ka Aminadab nyɛ Adimin bia, ka Adimin nyɛ Arini bia, ka Arini nyɛ Hɛzirɔn bia, ka Hɛzirɔn nyɛ Pɛrɛz bia, ka Pɛrɛz mi nyɛ Juda so bia.
en: Amminadab, Admin, Arni, Hezron, Perez, Judah.

dag: dama yi na kul dolila daadam biɛhigu. Nyuli zabbu mini naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu yi be yi sunsuuni, pa daadam biɛhigu ka yi doli ka niŋdi kaman dunianim ni niŋdi shɛm?.
en: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.

dag: Galimi yɛtɔɣ shɛli yi n nol ni na? N ku tooi baŋla nia biɛɣu ni nyɛ shɛli?.
en: I know right from wrong, and I am not telling lies.

dag: Ka Tɛra daa zaŋ o bia Ibram min o yaaŋa Lɔt ni Ibram paɣa Zarai m-pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka bɛ yi Ur din be Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Haran n-kpalim ʒini nimaani.
en: Terah decided to move from Ur to the land of Canaan. He took along Abram and Sarai and his grandson Lot, the son of Haran. But when they came to the city of Haran, they settled there instead.

dag: Ka pɔhim maa ʒiɛri ba, ka bi chɛra, ka bɛ zo yomyom ni bɛ yi pɔhim kpiɔŋ maa ni.
en: without showing mercy, as they try to escape.

dag: Ka kɔnyuri daa gbaai Samsin pam, ka o suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Nyini n-chɛ ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ di nasara ŋɔ, ka kɔnyuri ti yɛn ku ma, ka n lu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi gundi ŋɔ nuu ni.
en: Samson was very thirsty. So he cried to the Lord . He said, I am your servant. You gave me this great victory. Please dont let me die from thirst now. Please dont let me be captured by men who are not even circumcised.

dag: A ni daa nya ti shɛli maa daa wɔɣ pam ka mali kpiɔŋ, ka di zuɣusaa mali hal ti tɔri sagbana, ka ŋunkam be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣili kam tooi nyari li.
en: You saw a tree that grew so big and strong that it reached up to heaven and could be seen from anywhere on earth.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa nya yaa pam, ka me goondahi gili fɔntinsi, ka lan me nɛma sɔŋbu shee tinsi zali Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: So Jehoshaphat continued to grow more and more powerful. Throughout Judah he built fortifications and cities.

dag: Amaa nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ma, Zaŋmi liɣiri da puu maa ka bo shɛhiranima hal bɛ ni kul zaŋ tiŋ maa niŋ Kalidianim nuu ni maa zaa yoli.
en: Yet, Sovereign Lord , you are the one who ordered me to buy the field in the presence of witnesses, even though the city is about to be captured by the Babylonians.

dag: O daa lan kpuɣi Absalom bipuɣiŋga Maaka ka o daa dɔɣi Abija mini Atai ni Ziza ni Shɛlomit.
en: Later he married Maacah, Absaloms daughter, who bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

dag: dama Jɔn daa yɛl o ni di chihiri ni o fa o tizo Filip paɣa.
en: John the Baptist kept telling Herod, It isn't right for you to marry your brother's wife.

dag: Dama zaɣ biɛɣu bi yirila taŋkpaɣu ni na, ka yɛlimuɣisira gba bi puhiri yiri tiŋgban ni na.
en: Evil does not grow in the soil, nor does trouble grow out of the ground.

dag: Nyamiya, maligumaaniba ni ʒi dunia zaa Duuma Daalikauli Adaka maa n-gari yi tooni chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du.
en: Look! The covenant chest of the ruler of the entire earth is going to cross over in front of you in the Jordan.

dag: Yawɛ yɛli Babilɔn bipuɣiŋga, Fom baalim ʒini zibisim ni, bɛ ku lan bol a zuliya kam paɣiba naa.
en: So Babylon, sit down and shut up. Daughter of the Chaldeans, go into the dark prison. You will no longer be The Queen of the Kingdoms.

dag: Yɛm ka Ayuba ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa ni, o yɛtɔɣa maa ka gbinni.
en: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.

dag: Ka daa yɛli ŋmaŋkɔhiriba la mi, Zaŋmiya yi binyara yi! Di zaŋya m Ba duu leei daa.
en: and he ordered those who sold the pigeons, Take them out of here! Stop making my Father's house a marketplace.

dag: Dama ti Duuma yɛla yɛtɔɣa daa bi yi yi sani m-paala Masidɔnia mini Akaia kɔŋko, amaa yi ni niŋ Naawuni yɛda shɛm yɛla pun gili luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Dinzuɣu di bi lan simdi ni ti yɛli shɛli pahi.
en: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan bɔhi Yawɛ, ka o daa yɛl o, Di yi kpe chaŋ ti liri ba, amaa gilim bɛ nyaaŋa chaŋ ti liri ba tulaale tihi la tooni polo.
en: When David asked the LORD, God replied, Dont attack them directly. Circle around behind them and come at them from in front of the balsam trees.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla gali sabilifaa n-she biŋgolinsi niŋ tuuli pateesa la naŋgbambili, ka lan niŋ pateesa shɛli din pah ayi gba lala.
en: They made loops of blue cloth on the edge of the outside piece in each set.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ti tum tuma dindali maa, n ni yihi dilan maa niriba sunsuuni.
en: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa kahigi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa wuhi anabi Habakuk m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is the message that the Lord revealed to the prophet Habakkuk.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bari ma la zana, amaa m bi birigi a zaligunim maa.
en: The wicked try to trap me, but I have not disobeyed your instructions.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ ni, n lan nya shɛli zaŋ chaŋ yɛm polo, ka di nyɛ yɛlikpeeni n sani.
en: I also observed the following example of wisdom under the sun—it impressed me greatly.

dag: Yawɛ wurindi karimbaandan yili, amaa ka guli pakoli tiŋgbani tarisi.
en: The Lord destroys a proud mans house but protects a widows property.

dag: dama binshɛɣukam din nyɛ zaɣ suŋ mini din tuhi ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋli yirila neesim ni na.
en: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Dimiya li zuŋɔ, dama zuŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ Vuhim Dabisili, yi ku nya li tiŋgban ni zuŋɔ.
en: You may eat the food, Moses said. Today is the Sabbath in honor of the Lord , and there won't be any of this food on the ground today.

dag: ninvuɣ biɛri suhupiɛlli daa bi yaɣi lala? A bi mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi zɔri Naawuni kul dirila nyaɣisim saha biɛla kɔŋko?.
en: that the rejoicing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless, brief?.

dag: Ŋun pa Yisa yɛdaniŋda yi boli ya ni yi ka o yiŋ na nti di bindirigu ka yi yu ni yi chaŋ, bɛ yi ti kul zaŋ shɛlikam zaa zali yi tooni, yin dimiya li ka di bɔhiya, ka di chɛ ka yi suhuri ni tɛha muɣisi ya di zuɣu.
en: Someone who is not a believer might invite you to eat with them. If you want to go, then eat anything that is put before you. Dont ask questions to see if it is something you think is wrong to eat.

dag: N ni darigi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa tibili, ka kpihim Baal tuma din kpalim mini buɣa maligumaaniba yuya kpe.
en: I will reach out to punish Judah and Jerusalem— nothing will remain of the god Baal; nothing will be remembered of his pagan priests.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni maa Bia la zom ti nambɔɣu, ka niŋ anfaani niŋ ti ni, ka ti ti suhudoo, ka chɛ ka di leei ti dini yɛlimaŋli mini yurilim puuni.
en: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be ours who live in truth and love.

dag: Anabi Aizaia ni daa nya Yisa jilima zuɣu ka o daa yɛl o yɛla lala maa.
en: Isaiah said this because he saw Jesus' glory and spoke about him.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka Yɛhudianim shɛb lo nia ni bɛ ku Pool, ka daa laɣim po pɔri ni shee bɛ ku Pool ni di yi pa lala bɛ ku di bee n-nyu.
en: The next morning some Jewish leaders formulated a plot and solemnly promised that they wouldnt eat or drink until they had killed Paul.

dag: Di saha ka Filip daa zaŋ litaafi maa ni luɣ shɛli o ni karim maa n-gbaag o Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu.
en: Starting with that passage, Philip proclaimed the good news about Jesus to him.

dag: Tuuni kam tumbu mali nyɔri, amaa yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu kɔŋko nyɛla din tahiri fara na.
en: Work and you will earn a living; if you sit around talking you will be poor.

dag: Wumpaɣibo yila ni ti yiri di puuni na, ka bɛn puhiri chuɣu ni ti yɔri vuri di puuni. N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ nabi, ka ku lan pɔra. N ni chɛ ka bɛ nya jilima, ka so ku lan mali ba ansarisi.
en: Other nations will respect and honor you. Your homes will be filled with children, and you will celebrate, singing praises to me.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya sanʒiɛɣu ni yi nuzaa polo kanna, ka sagban titali daa beni, ka neesim gil li, ka buɣim daa kul nyaɣisira, ka binshɛli daa be buɣim maa sunsuuni kaman daanya din nyaɣisiri la.
en: I looked up and saw a windstorm coming from the north. Lightning was flashing from a huge cloud, and the sky around it was glowing. Where the lightning was flashing, something shone like bronze.

dag: Saha shɛli Mɔdɛkai ni daa ʒe n-guli nayili dunoli, ka Bigitan mini Tɛrɛsh bɛn daa nyɛ namɔɣilis ayi n-ʒe n-guli naa zɔntua dunoli daa ti je suli niŋ Naa Ahasivɛrɔs ka lo ni bɛ sɔɣi ku o.
en: Bigthana and Teresh were the two men who guarded King Xerxes' rooms, but they got angry with the king and decided to kill him.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu! Dama yi ŋmanila gbal shɛŋa niriba ni nɔri gariti ka bi mi ni gbala m-bala.
en: How terrible for you! You are like unmarked graves, and people walk on them without recognizing it.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o ba paɣ dɔni, dilan nyɛla ŋun nya o ba zaɣim, ka di simdi ka bɛ ku bɛ niriba ayi maa, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.
en: A man who has intercourse with one of his father's wives disgraces his father, and both he and the woman shall be put to death. They are responsible for their own death.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ tiliginsim liɣiri maa ti Aduna min o bidibisi kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ka zal o shɛm.
en: Moses gave the money for those rescued to Aaron and his sons according to the LORDs word, as the LORD commanded Moses.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk, ka tiŋ maa nim nya ka sɔɣ li ka bi ku o.
en: Maybe the common people will ignore them. Maybe they will not kill those who gave their children to Molech.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa be dunia ŋɔ ni, bɛ yi ti kpuɣi binshɛli din nyɛ shihirili bin la zuɣusaa zoya zuɣu, yin lihimiya! Bɛ yi ti piɛb kikaa, yin gbilisimiya tibili wum.
en: Like a flag on a hill, everyone on earth will see what happens. Like a trumpet call, everyone in the country will hear it.

dag: ka yi ni niŋ di mini di naa kaman yi ni daa niŋ Jɛriko mini di naa shɛm la. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ ni dina, dimiya tiŋ maa nɛma zaŋ tabili di biŋkɔbiri. Chamiya ti sɔɣi dɔni tiŋ maa gulinyaaŋa polo.
en: Do to Ai and its king what you did to Jericho and its king. But you may take its booty and cattle as plunder. Set your ambush behind the city.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒiɛm wuhibu ni bo bahiyoli ti bɛmaŋa, amaa bɛn tiri zaligu jilima ni nya laara.
en: Those who reject a command hurt themselves; those who respect a command will be rewarded.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti ka o tooni na ni wumpaɣibo; ka chɛ ka ti yɔnya suhupiɛlli vuri yili yila paɣ o!.
en: Let us come before him with thanksgiving and sing joyful songs of praise.

dag: Amazia daa lan ku Ɛdom tɔbbihi tuhi pia Yalim Vinvamli ni, ka tuhi fa Sɛla m-boli di yuli Joktiɛl, ka di yuli n-na kul bala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Amaziah killed , Edomites in the Valley of Salt. In war, Amaziah took Sela and called it Joktheel. It is still called Joktheel today.

dag: Yɛlim a mabia ŋun nyɛ doo la, N niriba. Ka yɛl a tizɔpaɣa, O nya nambɔzɔbo.
en: So call your fellow Israelites God's People and Loved-by-the-Lord.

dag: Jɛra maanila alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ansarisi, amaa Naawuni niŋdi wuntizɔriba nirilim.
en: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.

dag: ka zaŋ naɣilaa mini piɛlaa ni zim shɛli bɛ ni niŋ kpam ŋmiri m-mali suhudoo sara Yawɛ tooni, dama zuŋɔ Yawɛ ni yi zahira yi sani.
en: and a bull and a ram for a fellowship offering. They are to sacrifice them to the Lord with the grain offering mixed with oil. They must do this because the Lord will appear to them today.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Kiburɔtihataava, bɛ ni daa sɔɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpiri kɔre pam nimaani la zuɣu.
en: That place was named Kibroth Hattaavah , because there they buried the people who had craved meat.

dag: Di yi pa lala Yawɛ ni nya li, ka di bi niŋ o nyaɣisim, ka o ku lan yiɣisi o suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them.

dag: Chɛ ka o niŋgbuŋ leei zaɣ palli kaman bipolli niŋgbuŋ la; ka chɛ ka o lan mali yaa kaman o ni daa nyɛ bipolli la.
en: That persons flesh is renewed like a childs; they regain their youth.

dag: Hal sagbani maa daa yi kpalim ʒe Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa zuɣusaa dabisi gbaliŋ gba, Izraɛlnim maa kul dolila Yawɛ zaligu maa ka ku yiɣisi chaŋ.
en: Sometimes the cloud would stay over the Holy Tent for a long time. The Israelites obeyed the Lord and did not move.

dag: Chɛ ka n wum suhupiɛlli yɛtɔɣa; ka chɛ ka a ni daa kabisi n kɔb shɛŋa la mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Let me hear sounds of joy and happiness again. Let the bones you crushed be happy again.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli, Bolim o na. Ka o daa boli paɣ maa, ka o kana ti zani dunol ni.
en: Then Elisha said, Call her. So Gehazi called the woman. She came and stood at his door.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ti yi nimaani n-chani Bɛtɛl. O ni daa yi soli n-chani ha, ka bidibbihi nya o m-maani o ansarisi yɛra, Zuɣupalo ŋɔ lana, chama! Zuɣupalo ŋɔ lana, chama.
en: Elisha went up from there to Bethel. As he was going up the road, some young people came out of the city. They mocked him: Get going, Baldy! Get going, Baldy.

dag: ni Ɛliab ni Jɛrɔham ni Ɛlikana.
en: his son Eliab, his son Jeroham, and his son Elkanah.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ suhuyini n-gbib ba, ka daa doli yɛm soli wuhi ba din tuhi.
en: David took care of them with unselfish devotion and led them with skill.

dag: Ka o daa lan mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi n-zaŋ li pie tab kulis ayi n-gili lansi maa zaɣ yini n-zaŋ li pili biŋkpilli din tam daanya daantalisi la zaɣ yini zuɣu; ka daa lan niŋ din la gba lala.
en: Then he made two rows of bronze pomegranates. He put the bronze pomegranates on the nets of each column to cover the capitals at the top of the columns.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n wumya. A nini shiri ku lan nya ma.
en: Have it your way, Moses answered. You won't see me again.

dag: Ɛhab bia Jɔram ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun piniyini saha ka Ahazia daa di Juda nam.
en: Ahaziah had become king over Judah during Jorams eleventh year as king of Israel.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli pam ti Duuma zuɣu, dama di ni yuui pam la nyaaŋa yi lan wuhi ni yi baɣa be n ni. M bi yɛlimi ni yi chɛ ma la lihibu, amaa yi yi bi nyala soli din ni doli niŋ li.
en: In my life in union with the Lord it is a great joy to me that after so long a time you once more had the chance of showing that you care for me. I don't mean that you had stopped caring for me—you just had no chance to show it.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ nyɛviya zan tariga kaman nir ni yi vuhi pɔhim bahi la; ka chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ba bɛ ni be yuun shɛŋa ni.
en: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.

dag: Wuntizɔra ŋɔ daa bela niriba ŋɔ ni, ka o ni daa nyari shɛli ka wumdi shɛli dabisili kam daa nyɛla niriba maa tuumbiɛ shɛŋa din kul chihir o suhu.
en: This good man lived with those evil people every day, and his good heart was hurt by the evil things he saw and heard.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di shihi ma; dama n na bi chaŋ m Ba sani. Amaa cham m mabihi la sani nti yɛli ba ni n chanila m Ba ŋun nyɛ yi gba Ba la ni n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yi gba Naawuni la sani.
en: Jesus said to her, You dont need to hold on to me! I have not yet gone back up to the Father. But go to my followers and tell them this: I am going back to my Father and your Father. I am going back to my God and your God.

dag: O ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa maa m-bɔŋɔ: Daanya daantalis ayi mini zuɣuri ayi din daa tam daantalis ayi maa zuɣu la mini zoligɔnim din daa lo biŋkpila maa la.
en: two columns; two circular capitals on top of the columns; two networks adorning the two circular capitals on top of the columns.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n fabindi Mɔabnim mini Kirihɛrɛsinim zuɣu kaman kalambua ka bɛ piɛbiri la, dama bɛ ni daa nya bun shɛli zaa la naaya.
en: So my heart mourns for Moab and for the people of Kir Heres, like someone playing a funeral song on a flute, because everything they owned is gone.

dag: O ni daa leei ŋun be tibi maa zuɣu, ka o leei bɛnkam zaa deer o noli tiliginsim din ka bahigu ni yiri so sanna.
en: This made him the perfect high priest, who provides the way for everyone who obeys him to be saved forever.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini anabinim ni niriba zaa daa wum Jɛrimia ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni maa.
en: The priests, the prophets, and all the people heard Jeremiah say all these words at the Lord s Temple.

dag: Cham Rɛkabinim sani nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa, ka zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na nti zaŋ ba kpɛhi dubihi la yini puuni, ka niŋ wain ti ba ka bɛ nyu.
en: Go to the Recabite family and invite them to come to one of the side rooms of the Lord s Temple. Offer them wine to drink.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa neeg asiba ka dam maa yi o ninni, ka o paɣ maa yɛl o binshɛɣukam zaa, ka o suhu kabi, ka o be kaman kuɣili la.
en: In the morning, when Nabal was sober, his wife told him everything. Nabals heart failed inside him, and he became like a stone.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-ni chɛ ka yi tooi baŋ shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna: Ŋunkam yɛli ni Yisa Masia daa leei ninsala n-ka dunia ŋɔ ni na n-nyɛ ŋum mali Shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna;.
en: This is how you know if a spirit comes from God: every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come as a human is from God.

dag: O zaŋla noli yɛlibu ye kaman binyɛrigu la. Chɛ ka di tabil o niŋgbuna kaman kom la, ka chɛ ka di be kaman kpam la n-nyɛligi kpe o kɔba ni.
en: Cursing was a daily part of his life, like the clothes he wears. Cursing others became a part of him, like the water he drinks and the oil he puts on his body.

dag: Di simdi ka yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka lumiy o kɔŋko sizuura, ka dol o zaligunima, ka deeg o noli, ka jɛmiy o, ka ʒe o yim.
en: You must be completely faithful to the Lord . Worship and obey only the Lord and do this with fear and trembling.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Ashaara niŋbu din doli taba, nyama, dina n-kanna ŋɔ.
en: This is what the Lord GOD said: There will be one disaster after another!.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Samuɛl, Nyama, n yɛn tumla tuun shɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka ŋunkam ti wum li tiba puuni ni chahira.
en: The Lord said to Samuel, I will soon do things in Israel that will shock anyone who hears about them.

dag: Ŋuna n-fuɣiri maligumaaniba situra ka mali ba chana, ka luhiri wɔɣira.
en: God removes priests and others who have great power—.

dag: O ni ti wuhi ya jirambisa du kar shɛli bɛ ni pun malimali binshɛɣukam zali, ka yi mali chuɣu maa shili nimaani gul ti.
en: The owner will take you upstairs and show you a large room ready for you to use. Prepare the meal there.

dag: Ka Judianim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa kabi chaŋ o sani nti kaŋka bɛ daalahichi ka o naanyi baptaizi ba Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ni.
en: Everyone in Judea and all the people of Jerusalem went out to the Jordan River and were being baptized by John as they confessed their sins.

dag: Nyamiya, pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋ zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi wuhi ya ni yi ti dol li yi ni chani ni yi ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ma shɛm.
en: I taught you the laws and rules that the Lord my God commanded me. I did this so you could obey them in the land you are ready to enter and take for your own.

dag: n-zaŋ o nudirigu nubil tim kpa shɛli din be o nuzaa ni maa n-zaŋ o nubil ni kpam maa mihi Yawɛ tooni ʒiibuyopɔin.
en: The priest will then dip his right finger into the oil and sprinkle some of it with his finger seven times before the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ ni yiɣisi tuhi kaman o ni daa niŋ shɛm Pɛrazim Zoli zuɣu mini Gibiɔn vinvamli ni la din ni chɛ ka o tum o ni lo ni o tum shɛm. O ni yɛn tum shɛli maa yi kul nyɛ yɛl saani kabo, o ni bahi tum o tuma din nyɛ alahiziba tuma maa naai.
en: The Lord will fight as he did at Mount Perazim. He will be angry as he was in Gibeon Valley. He will do what he must do. It will be what some stranger should do, but he will finish his work. Yes, this is a strangers job.

dag: Nyam tumo ŋun mali lahiba suŋ mini suhudoo yɛtɔɣa n-zɔri duri zoya kanna ŋɔ naba ni viɛli pam shɛm! O moonila tiliginsim molo yɛri Ziɔnnima, Yi Naawuni nyɛla naa.
en: How wonderful it is to see a messenger coming across the mountains, bringing good news, the news of peace! He announces victory and says to Zion, Your God is king.

dag: bɛ kul durila tab dari maa gbini, ka biŋkɔbiri maa daa ti dɔɣi bi shɛb bɛn mali bomaboma mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn mali sabilimsabilim.
en: in front of the branches, and their young were spotted and speckled.

dag: ka o ni yihi bɛ ni zaŋdi binshɛli nyɔri buɣim maani sara tiri Yawɛ la n-gbib li omaŋmaŋ nuu ni na. O ti zaŋm biŋkpam mini bimbihili na, ka bɛ ti zaŋ bimbihili maa gahigahi ka di leei gahibu sara maligu Yawɛ tooni.
en: bringing it with your own hands as a food offering. You shall bring the fat of the animal with its breast and present it as a special gift to the Lord .

dag: Maliya suhupiɛlli sahakam n ni nam shɛli zuɣu. Suhupiɛlli ni be n ni nam Jɛrusalɛm shɛli maa ni, ka di niriba mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Be glad and rejoice forever in what I create. The new Jerusalem I make will be full of joy, and her people will be happy.

dag: O zuɣu ka ti nya yolisim din nyɛ ti daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ la.
en: by whom we are set free, that is, our sins are forgiven.

dag: Dama n niriba ŋɔ tibidarigibo maa galisi gari Sɔdomnim tibidarigibo la, din daa wurim nini pɔbbu ni neebu ka so nuu daa bi shihi li la.
en: My nation was punished worse than the people of Sodom, whose city was destroyed in a flash without the help of human hands.

dag: A zal a zaligunima ni niriba dol li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Lord, you gave us your instructions and told us to always obey them.

dag: Ka Aduna yi ti kana ni o ti malimali firilanim maa asiba kam, ŋun tuɣilim tulaale zim din nyom viɛl sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Every morning when Aaron comes to take care of the lamps, he is to burn sweet-smelling incense on it.

dag: Ka o ya kpamba maa mini ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn min o daa laɣim be tin yini maa ni daa niŋ kaman Jɛzibɛl ni daa sab gbana wuhi ba shɛm maa.
en: The elders and the officials who lived in Naboths town did exactly as Jezebel specified in the letters that she had sent.

dag: Lɛvinim bɛn daa be tin kasi maa ni zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihiniinaanahi.
en: All the Levites in the holy city totaled .

dag: Ka Naawuni yiko tuuni ŋɔ daa niŋ niriba maa zaa alahiziba pam. Niriba maa ni daa na kul tɛhiri Yisa ni tumd alahiziba tuun shɛlikam zaa yɛla maa ka o daa yɛl o nyaandoliba.
en: Everyone was overwhelmed by Gods greatness. While everyone was marveling at everything he was doing, Jesus said to his disciples.

dag: Jɔnatan min o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa ni daa tuui ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisi, kaman nakpaa pirigili palo puuni.
en: In that first slaughter Jonathan and the young man killed about twenty men in an area of about half an acre.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣisi zaɣ chɛhi din guui m-pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: Everyone ate until they were full, and they filled twelve baskets with the leftovers.

dag: Dama ti yaannim daa bi ʒe yim, ka tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani. Bɛ daa zaɣis o, ka ŋmaligi bɛ nini ka chɛ o biɛhigu shee, ka lɛb bɛ nyaaŋa biri ka chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ.
en: Our ancestors were unfaithful to the Lord our God and did what was displeasing to him. They abandoned him and turned their backs on the place where he dwells.

dag: Ʒirilana nyɛla ŋun sɔɣiri jɛlinsi. Ka ŋunkam zuri niriba nyaaŋa nyɛ jɛrigu.
en: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.

dag: O daa kul niŋd o la lala yuuni kam. Bɛn dee daa yi kul chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni, o ni bahi miligi Hanna suhu ka o kum hal ti bi di bindirigu.
en: This happened every year when their family went to the Lord s house at Shiloh. Peninnah would upset Hannah so much that she would begin to cry and would not eat anything. One year when this happened.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam pihi di wala ni di li ka paɣi Yawɛ, ka bɛnkam pihi wain tiwala laɣim sɔŋ ni nyu di wain n jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni.
en: Whoever gathers the food will eat it and praise the Lord . Whoever gathers the grape will drink the wine in the courtyards of my Temple.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa biri ti shɛli bɛ ni booni tamarisik tia la Bɛrishiiba, ka jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ saha din ka bahigu Naawuni ŋɔ nimaani.
en: Then Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba and worshiped the Lord , the Everlasting God.

dag: Ʒiɛmani ŋɔ zuɣulaannim ni so daa ʒi yɛm ŋɔ yɛla, dama bɛ yi di daa mi li, bɛ daa naan ku kpahi ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ jilimalan la tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: None of the rulers of this world knew this wisdom. If they had known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

dag: Biŋkɔbigu kam ŋun mali takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, ka nyɛ ŋun gbuɣiri ŋubira, yin ŋubimiy o.
en: You may eat any animal that has hooves divided into two parts and that chews the cud.

dag: Pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ka n kana, amaa alahichinim tuuba niŋbu zuɣu ka n kana.
en: I have not come to ask good people to change. I have come to ask sinners to change the way they live.

dag: M puhiri Apɛlees ŋun wuh o ʒiɛyimtali Masia ni ni nyɛ shɛm la. M puhiri Aristɔbulus yiŋnim zaa.
en: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gbahi zahim maa shɛm maa zuɣu ka di daa niŋ Saimɔn mini bɛnkam zaa be o sani maa alahiziba pam.
en: He and the others with him were all amazed at the large number of fish they had caught.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai Yisa sani nti nya alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa, ka o leela ninvuɣ maŋli ye situra ʒiya; ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba pam.
en: They came to Jesus and saw the man who used to be demon-possessed. They saw the very man who had been filled with many demons sitting there fully dressed and completely sane, and they were filled with awe.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli Sisɛra ni Barak Abinɔam bia la be Tabo Zoli zuɣu.
en: When Sisera learned that Barak had led an army to Mount Tabor.

dag: Ya polo ka ti lee chana? Ti mabihi maa ni labina ti yɛli shɛm maa chɛ ka ti suhuri fuŋ. Bɛ yɛliya, Niriba maa mali yaa ka lan wɔɣiwɔɣ gari ti, ka bɛ fɔntinsi maa galisi, ka bɛ me goma gil li hal ti taɣi sagbana. Hal ti nyala Anakinim nimaani. .
en: Why should we go there? We are afraid. The men we sent tell us that the people there are stronger and taller than we are, and that they live in cities with walls that reach the sky. They saw giants there.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Ʒe a sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ŋɔ gbini; ka n chaŋ Yawɛ sani kpe ha.
en: Wait here beside your offerings, Balaam said. The Lord will appear to me over there.

dag: Yi yi ti chaŋ ti dɔni ni yi tuhi yi dimnima, yin gbaamiya yimaŋa ni zaɣ biɛɣu kam zaa.
en: When you men go off to fight your enemies, make sure your camp is acceptable to the Lord .

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ li zali sara maligu bimbini naŋgbaŋkuɣila la lɔŋni, ka di du m-paai sara maligu bimbini maa pirigili tariga zaŋ siɣi tiŋ polo.
en: Put the grating under the rim of the altar, so that it reaches halfway up the altar.

dag: Yi daa lan nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni gbibi ya shɛm tiŋgban nɛl la ni kaman nira ni buɣiri bia shɛm la, ka yi chaŋ na hal ti paai kpe.
en: You saw what happened in the desert. You saw how the Lord your God carried you like a man carries his child. He brought you safely all the way to this place.

dag: Nyamiya, biŋkura la zaa gariya; pumpɔŋɔ bimpala yɛla ka n yɛra. N yɛn daŋmi yɛli ya di yɛla pɔi, ka di naanyi kana.
en: In the past, I told you what would happen, and it happened! Now I am telling you something new, and I am telling you now, before it happens.

dag: M mabihi, n daa naan ku tooi tɔɣisi ya kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla, amaa n daa tɔɣisiri ya mi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dolila daadam biɛhigu bee kaman bɛn na nyɛ biliɛri Masia dolibu ni.
en: Brothers and sisters, when I was there, I could not talk to you the way I talk to people who are led by the Spirit. I had to talk to you like ordinary people of the world. You were like babies in Christ.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a? A nyɛla Anabi Ilaija? Ka o yɛli ba, M pa o. Ka bɛ lan bɔh o, Bɛ ni daa yɛli anab so yɛla la n-nyɛ a? Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Aai.
en: Then when they asked him if he were Elijah, he said, No, I am not! And when they asked if he were the Prophet, he also said No.

dag: Bɛ tim a anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi, ka ti a alikama din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pia, ka ti a wain lita tusaayi, ka ti a kpam lita tusaayi, ka ti a yalim pam kaman di ni simdi shɛm.
en: up to a limit of , pounds of silver, bushels of wheat, gallons of wine, gallons of olive oil, and as much salt as needed.

dag: Nyamiya, yi jɛmbu duu yipa leela dabɔɣu.
en: Now your house will be left completely empty.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tarimba ŋɔ, bomiya yɛm. Yinim bɛn ka fahim ŋɔ, bomiya li.
en: You who are ignorant, learn to be wise. You who are foolish, get some common sense.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋdi binyɛra paŋdi ya, amaa yinim ti ku zaŋ shɛli paŋ ba. Bɛna nti yɛn nyɛ zuɣu, ka yi nyɛ zuli.
en: They will lend to you, but you will have nothing to lend to them. They will be the head of things; you will be the tail.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Jɔshua ti zali maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini salo maa zaa tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm maa.
en: Moses followed the Lord 's instructions and took Joshua to Eleazar and the people.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din be tintan zuɣu nya saria karibu. Dina n-nyɛ: Holɔn mini Jaaza ni Mɛfaat.
en: Judgment has come to the towns of the plateau— to Holon, Jahzah, and Mephaath.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali firilatamdigu. O daa zaŋla matarika n-kuri firilatamdigu maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu mini di mundili. Ka di mini di pipihi ni di bintira kɔtomsi la ni di tipuma kɔtomsi la zaa daa nyɛ zaɣ yini.
en: He also made the lampstand of pure, hammered gold. The lampstands base, branches, cups, flowers, and petals were all attached to it.

dag: Di saha maa n daa yɛliya, N kɔŋko ku tooi gbib ya.
en: At that time I told you, I cant take care of you by myself.

dag: Kum yi mali so, ŋun dim yiŋ pɔi ka di chɛ ka yi ku nya tibidarigibo yi laɣiŋgu ni. Zaŋ chaŋ yɛl shɛŋa din kpalim polo, n yi ti kana, n ni wuhi ya di gba yɛla.
en: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.

dag: Miriya ka yi yi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni, di yi pa lala yi ni kpi, dama bɛ ni boori Yawɛ kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la be yi ni. Ka bɛ daa niŋ kaman Musa ni yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: But you are the Lord 's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.

dag: M bia, di chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔnim faai ka chɛ a. Kul gbibi yɛm maŋli mini tɛhi wɔɣila.
en: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.

dag: So yi kpi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni, di mi zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋunkam be suɣili maa ni mini ŋunkam kpe di ni na ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: In the case of a person who dies in a tent, anyone who is in the tent at the time of death or who enters it becomes ritually unclean for seven days.

dag: Kpɛm sani yuli n-daa booni Ohola, ka o tizo maa mi yuli booni Oholiba. Ka n daa kpuɣi ba leei m paɣiba, ka bɛ dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi. Bɛ yuya maa ni wuhi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ohola nyɛla Samaria, ka Oholiba mi nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The older sister was named Oholah, and the younger sister was named Oholibah. They became mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. Now Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.

dag: A ŋmaag o bipolitali saha dabisa jia, ka chɛ ka o di vi.
en: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia daa yɛl o niriba zaa, Puhimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ Yaɣigari chuɣu kaman di ni sab shɛm alikauli kundi ni la.
en: Then King Josiah gave a command to all the people. He said, Celebrate the Passover for the Lord your God. Do this just as it is written in the Book of the Agreement .

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ ʒim maa mihi niriba maa ka yɛli, Nyamiya, Yawɛ ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la ʒim, di nyɛla din doli o ni yɛli ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: Then Moses took the blood in the bowls and threw it on the people. He said, This is the blood that seals the covenant which the Lord made with you when he gave all these commands.

dag: So beni n-nyɛ zoma n-lan paai n dabili bee n-nyɛ tikpiralana n-lan paai n tumo so n ni tim? Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ zoma m-paai n ni pii so, bee n-nyɛ zoma paai Yawɛ dabili?.
en: In all the world, no one is more blind than my servant. No one is more deaf than my messenger. No one is more blind than my chosen people, the servant of the Lord .

dag: Amaa biha maa mini nudirigu gbalipuɣa dina Aduna daa zaŋ li mi gahigahi Yawɛ tooni ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi kaman Musa ni daa zali shɛm.
en: He lifted the breasts and the gift of the right thigh to show he was offering them before the Lord , just as Moses had commanded.

dag: Ka o daa nya ka ŋariŋ maa duhibu muɣisiri ba, dama bɛ daa tuhila pɔhim. Ka di daa ti niŋ kaman nolɔɣu kukol saha ka Yisa tam kom zuɣu chani bɛ sani nti niŋ ka o yɛn garila bɛ zuɣu la.
en: He could see that the disciples were struggling hard, because they were rowing against the wind. Not long before morning, Jesus came toward them. He was walking on the water and was about to pass the boat.

dag: O yi mali bidibiga ka o nyɛ biyariga, ka kuri niriba.
en: But suppose one of them has a violent child who sheds blood or does any one of these things.

dag: Ka Jɔash kpambaliba ayi daa ti yi o nyaaŋa n-ku o Millo yil shɛli din daa ʒe Silla soli zuɣu la puuni.
en: Jehoashs officials plotted a conspiracy and killed him at Beth-millo on the road that goes down to Silla.

dag: Ka Anakinim maa ni so daa lan ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, naɣila Gaza mini Gaat ni Ashidɔd ka bɛ ni shɛb daa be.
en: None of the Anakim were left in the land of Israel; a few, however, were left in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.

dag: Yi ni yɛn bɔhiri anabinim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Wula ka Yawɛ lee garigi yɛli ya? bee Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka Yawɛ lee yɛli.
en: If you want to learn about Gods message, ask a prophet, What answer did the Lord give you? or What did the Lord say.

dag: Ka Maika maa daa ti yɛl o ma, A daanzinfa kpila tuhili ni kɔbiga shɛli bɛ ni daa zu ka a yɛli noli ti ŋun zu li, ka yɛli ma di yɛla la, nyama, di be n sani, mani n-daa kpuɣ li. Ka o ma yɛli, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ m bia ŋɔ ni.
en: He told his mother, When someone stole those eleven hundred pieces of silver from you, you put a curse on the robber. I heard you do it. Look, I have the money. I am the one who took it. His mother said, May the Lord bless you, my son.

dag: O yi daa kala o zaɣ zaŋli na, di simdi ka o lan chaŋ o zaɣ zaŋli. Ka di yi nyɛla o min o paɣa n-daa kana, dindina di simdi ka o min o paɣa maa zaa lan chaŋ.
en: If he was single at the time you bought him, he alone must be set free. But if he was married at the time, both he and his wife must be given their freedom.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ŋmaligi zaŋ din buɣisiri maa m-buɣisi nuzaa polo, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu.
en: Then he measured the north side, the south side, and the west side of the wall, and they were each meters long.

dag: Naawuni n-chɛ ka n suhu ŋooi; Kpiɔŋlan Naa n-chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma.
en: The fear of God has made me lose my courage. God All-Powerful makes me afraid.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa lan yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun daa pii Musa mini Aduna ka bɛ yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na lan di ma shɛhira.
en: Samuel continued, The Lord is the one who chose Moses and Aaron and who brought your ancestors out of Egypt.

dag: O zaŋ bandi ba n naba, ka kul zaŋ o nina kpa n soya zaa.
en: He put chains on my feet and watches everything I do.

dag: O naan zaŋ o yiko din galisi ŋɔ zab ma? Aai, amaa o naan gbilisi tibili wum n yɛligu.
en: Would he contend with me through brute force? No, he would surely listen to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, niŋmi alibarika niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ zuliya ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ kul be a sani sahakam. Dama nyini Yawɛ yi niŋ alibarika niŋ binshɛli ni, alibarika maa kul ni kpalim be di ni sahakam.
en: I ask you to bless my descendants so that they will continue to enjoy your favor. You, Lord , have blessed them, and your blessing will rest on them forever.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o suhu ni, Pumpɔŋɔ Sool ni ti bahi ku ma dahin shɛli. N lan ka n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm pahila n zo n-kuli Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni din ni chɛ ka Sool yihi n shee bɔbu tahima Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka n yi o nuu ni.
en: but he thought to himself, One of these days, Saul is going to kill me. The only way to escape from him is to go to Philistia. Then I'll be outside of Israel, and Saul will give up trying to catch me.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya ka nuu teei tiri ma na, ka bɛ ni sabi gbaŋ shɛli kpabikpabi be di ni.
en: Then I looked, and there in a hand stretched out to me was a scroll.

dag: Bɛ ni me birini gili tin shɛl la lumi dahim zaa, ka bɛ chɛ li bahi kaman tiŋgban nɛl la. Di leela biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ni bɛ ni dooni luɣ shɛli vuhira.
en: Fortress cities are left like a desert where no one lives. Cattle walk through the ruins, stripping the trees bare.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, n gba ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛli noli ti a, n gba ni yɛli noli ti ba. Ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni ti nya alibarika a zuɣu.
en: I will bless those who bless you, But I will curse those who curse you. And through you I will bless all the nations.

dag: ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti leei yi Naawuni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and I brought you out of Egypt to become your God. I am the Lord .

dag: dama buni bi beni sahakam, ka nam zuɣupiligu mi kul ku beni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: for no treasure lasts forever, nor a crown generation after generation.

dag: Sahimiya piɛma pali lɔɣiri. Yawɛ piɛlila Miidia nanim bahina, dama o nia nyɛla o wurim Babilɔn. Dama Yawɛ n-yɛn bɔhi biɛri o jɛmbu duu la zuɣu.
en: The Lord has stirred up the kings of Media, because he intends to destroy Babylonia. That is how he will take revenge for the destruction of his Temple. The attacking officers command, Sharpen your arrows! Get your shields ready!.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa kuhiri yɛra, Naawuni kukoli m-bɔŋɔ, pa ninsal dini.
en: The people shouted, This is the voice of a god, not a man.

dag: O mi ni o daguya mali nyɔri, o firila bi kpiri yuŋ.
en: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.

dag: A daa yɛli ma, Wumma, ka n yɛl a yɛtɔɣa; n ni bɔh a bɔhigu, ka a garigi ma.
en: You said to me, Listen, and I will speak. I will ask you questions, and you will answer me.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka sapashin kpamba mini sapashim bihi bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili ni tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi daa ka Musa sanna.
en: The army commanders went to Moses.

dag: Yi ʒiɛri kpam, ka niŋdi tulaale pam niŋdi yimaŋ chani ti jɛmdi Molɛk. Buɣa jɛmbu zuɣu, yi timdi tuumba katinsi hal ka timdi ba kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: You put on your perfumes and ointments and go to worship the god Molech. To find gods to worship, you send messengers far and wide, even to the world of the dead.

dag: Di saha ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti yi kpaŋa chaŋ luɣ shɛli ti vuhi biɛla. Dama niriba daa kul kanila o sanna ka chana, hal ka o min o nyaandoliba ti kɔŋ dahima diri bindirigu.
en: Jesus and his followers were in a very busy place. There were so many people that he and his followers did not even have time to eat. He said to them, Come with me. We will go to a quiet place to be alone. There we will get some rest.

dag: O yɛla ka Anabi Aizaia daa sabi yɛl la. O daa yɛlimi: Ninvuɣ so ni ti be mɔɣu ni mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma kandina soli gu o, ka mal o soya ka di tuhi. .
en: John was the one the prophet Isaiah was talking about, when he said, In the desert someone is shouting, Get the road ready for the Lord! Make a straight path for him. .

dag: Di simdi ka o ti zaŋ firilanim maa tamtam salima firilatamdigu maa zuɣu ka di doli soli Yawɛ tooni sahakam.
en: Aaron must always keep the lamps burning on the lampstand of pure gold before the Lord .

dag: Ka o zaŋ li mihi ninvuɣ so ŋun daa mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa buyopɔin, di nyaaŋa ka o yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni, ka zaŋ noombil nɛɔŋ maa bahi ka o yiɣi.
en: He shall sprinkle the blood seven times on the one of you who is to be purified from your skin disease, and then he shall pronounce you clean. He shall let the live bird fly away over the open fields.

dag: Ka so di ti bɔhi ni o nyɛla ŋun viɛl bee ŋun bi viɛla, ka so mi di ti zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o, ka so yi ti zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o, dindina o min o ni zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o maa zaa ni leei din be kasi, ka so ku lan tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o.
en: The one bringing the tenth-part gift must not pick out the good from the bad, and cannot substitute any animal. But if one should substitute an animal, both it and the substitute will be holy and cannot be bought back.

dag: Dɛhi nɔri li mi sɔŋdi tiŋa, ka binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun gɔri mɔɣu ni diri li.
en: Wild pigs come and ruin it. Wild animals eat the leaves.

dag: Dindali maa ka Nuhu min o paɣa ni o bidibisi bɛn yuya daa booni Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt ni o bidibisi maa paɣiba ata la daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: On that same day Noah and his wife went into the boat with their three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and their wives.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa saai kpani maa ka kpuɣi ko gaɣili maa Sool zuɣusaa ka bɛ chaŋ. So daa bi nya ba bee m-baŋ di yɛla bee so ti neei, bɛ zaa daa gbihirimi, dama Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka go titali gbahi ba.
en: So David took the spear and the water jar from right beside Saul's head, and he and Abishai left. No one saw it or knew what had happened or even woke up—they were all sound asleep, because the Lord had sent a heavy sleep on them all.

dag: Yinima ninvuɣ shɛb o ni ti kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, yinima ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa ʒe o yim ŋɔ, yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn mir o ŋɔ, paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: God raised the strength of his people, the praise of all his faithful ones— thats the Israelites, the people who are close to him. Praise the LORD!.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋumdimi kaman gbuɣima la, ka ŋumdi kaman gbuɣimbihi la.
en: The Babylonians roar and growl like young lions.

dag: Yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛm tariga m-bala. Dabiɛm daa kpe man Daniɛl pam, ka n ninni biɛhigu taɣi, amaa ka n daa lee zaŋ yɛla maa niŋ n suhu ni.
en: This is the end of the account. I was so frightened that I turned pale, and I kept everything to myself.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o suhu ni, Di simdi ni n zaŋ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛli sɔɣi Ibrahimma?.
en: The Lord said to himself, I should tell Abraham what I am going to do.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli Dauda, Yuria bi kul o yiŋa. Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yuria, Pa gɔrim yɔɣu ka a yina maa? Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi kuli yiŋa.
en: David was told, Uriah didnt go down to his own house, so David asked Uriah, Havent you just returned from a journey? Why didnt you go home.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kumdi olivi tihi puri ni, dama n ni ka yi sanna. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: In all the vineyards there will be bitter crying because I will pass through your midst, says the LORD.

dag: di chaŋ wula ka yi yɛli ni m Ba ni pii man ninvuɣ so n-tim dunia ŋɔ ni na maa mɔri Naawuni, n ni yɛli ni n nyɛla Naawuni Bia la zuɣu?.
en: So how can you say that the one whom the Father has made holy and sent into the world insults God because he said, I am Gods Son?.

dag: ŋ-ŋme n-deei li; ka daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku binshɛɣukam mini ninsalinim zaa ni di naa ni di fɔndi ni niriba zaa. Bɛ daa bi chɛ ka ninvuɣ yino gba kpalim. Bɛ ni daa niŋ Ɛgilɔnnim shɛm la, lala ka bɛ daa saɣim Hiburɔn, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be di ni.
en: and captured it. They killed the king and everyone else in the city as well as in the nearby towns. Joshua condemned the city to total destruction, just as he had done to Eglon. No one in it was left alive.

dag: Bɛ pala tuum maŋa; bɛ nyɛla tumtumdiba bɛn yɔhindi niriba, ka lɛbigi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ be kaman Masia tuumba n-nyɛ ba la.
en: Such people are false apostles and dishonest workers who disguise themselves as apostles of Christ.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni tiligi Ziɔn, ka lan me Juda tinsi zali, ka o daba ti be nimaani su li.
en: God will most certainly save Zion and will rebuild Judahs cities so that Gods servants can live there and possess it.

dag: Ka din chɛ ka saria karibu beni maa nyɛla, neesim ni ka dunia ŋɔ ni na ka salinim ni yu tuumbiɛri tumbu zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ bɔrila zibisim gari neesim maa la.
en: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.

dag: Yi ni kul ŋubiri kparibuhi mini wolisi shɛm, lala ka yi ni ti ŋub ba, bɛn ka kasi mini bɛn be kasi zaa ni tooi ŋub li.
en: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa ʒii nyabu ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ bini dihi litaafi shɛli noli tabili puuni yɛtɔɣa, ka so yi zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi karimbu ka yɛli ba, Karimmiya litaafi ŋɔ, bɛ ni yɛli, Ti ku tooi karim li, bini ka bɛ zaŋ dihi di noli tabili.
en: This entire vision has become for you like the words of a sealed scroll. When they give it to one who can read, saying, Read this, that one will say, I cant, because its sealed.

dag: Dinzuɣu, m bia, wummi n ni yɛn wuh a shɛm ŋɔ, yiɣisim zo n-kuli n tizɔdoo Leeban sani Haran.
en: Now listen carefully and do what I say. Go to the home of my brother Laban in Haran.

dag: Giliad zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Iiza daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Iizanima, ka Hɛlɛki daŋ niriba nyɛ Hɛlɛkinima.
en: These are Gileads descendants: from Iezer, the Iezerite clan; from Helek, the Helekite clan.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ daanya mali gaɣa kɔtomsi n-tuɣituɣi taba n-zaŋ li kaai vili kɔniŋdi bini maa nyingol ni ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita anu.
en: There was a rim around the outer edge of the tank. Under this rim there were two rows of bronze gourds all around the tank. The bronze gourds were made in one piece as part of the tank.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Dibɔngaad maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Alimɔndibilataim.
en: They left Dibon Gad and camped at Almon Diblathaim.
