dag: N niŋ ti Duuma naani ni yi ku doli din be di ko ka chɛ n ni doli so shɛl la. Ka ŋun chirindi ya yi kul nyɛ sokam, o ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: But I still feel confident about you. Our life in union with the Lord makes me confident that you will not take a different view and that whoever is upsetting you will be punished by God.

dag: Ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa yɛli Jɛrimia, N zɔrila Yɛhudianim bɛn zo nti pahi Babilɔnnim maa zuɣu la, bɛ ti zaŋ ma niŋ bɛ nuu ni ka bɛ niŋ ma alaka zuɣu.
en: King Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, Im afraid that I will fall into the hands of the Judeans who have defected to the Babylonians, and they will torture me.

dag: Sool ba n-daa nyɛ Kish, ka Abinɛr ba Nɛr mi daa nyɛ Abiɛl bia.
en: Kish, Sauls father, and Ner, Abners father, were Abiels sons.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lihi nya, ka wum malaika bɔbili bɛn nyɛ tusatusa paai shɛm kukoya. Bɛ daa ʒe n-gilila nam ʒiishee maa ni binnɛma anahi la ni kpamba la.
en: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them.

dag: dama bɛn zaa piila bɛ bun ni na ti tɔhi, amaa pakoli ŋɔ ŋun zaŋla o duu ni o yiŋ zaa na ti tɔhi.
en: All of them are giving out of their spare change. But she from her hopeless poverty has given everything she had, even what she needed to live on.

dag: ka daa tim ba ni bɛ chaŋ ti yihi Naawuni nam waazu, ka chɛ ka barinim kpaŋda.
en: He sent them to tell about Gods kingdom and to heal the sick.

dag: Yi yi kali ninvuɣ so ka o yuma paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana, di simdi ka o yo man Yawɛ ni zali farigu shɛli maa.
en: Every one who is counted, from years old and above, should present a gift offering to the LORD.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛtali yɛla n-kul yiri bɛ suhuri ni na, ka nia biɛri lɔbu yɛla kul be bɛ tɛha ni.
en: If they see something they like, they go and take it. They do whatever they want.

dag: Ka yi niŋ salima alali niŋ di puuni mini di nyaaŋa zaa, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Cover it with pure gold, inside and out, and make a gold molding all around it.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Abirɔna maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Ɛziɔngɛba.
en: They left Abronah and camped at Ezion Geber.

dag: A daa labisi ti taŋkpaɣu ni; ka yɛli, Yinim daadamnima, labimiya taŋkpaɣu ni yaha.
en: You bring people into this world, and you change them into dust again.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa dii chaŋ naa sani nti suh o ni o tim o saha pahi ka o wuh o zahindi maa gbinni.
en: Daniel rushed off and said to the king, If you will just give me some time, I'll explain your dream.

dag: Ka bɛ ni zaŋ kawana bee chi zim mali binshɛli bɔrɔbɔro duu puuni mini bɛ ni chim shɛli zaa tahilaa bee mahilaa puuni, maligumaana ŋun mali di sara maa n-su li.
en: just as he may eat the bread from a sacrifice to give thanks to me.

dag: Ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa yih o ni mali binshɛɣukam pia puuni zaɣ yiniyini ti o. O yuli Mɛlikizɛdɛk gbinni nyɛla Wuntia Naa. O lan nyɛla Salɛm Naa, ka di mi gbinni nyɛla Suhudoo Naa.
en: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The name Melchizedek, king of Salem, has two meanings. First, Melchizedek means king of justice. And king of Salem means king of peace.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti zaŋ omaŋ wuhi Ibrahimma Mamri oki tihi la gbini, o ni daa ʒi o tanti suɣili dunol ni wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha la.
en: Later, the Lord again appeared to Abraham near the oak trees of Mamre. It was the hottest part of the day, and Abraham was sitting at the door of his tent.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun daa yihi ya Ijiptinim mini Firawuna nuu ni maa.
en: that he shouted, Praise the Lord ! He rescued you and the Israelites from the Egyptians and their king.

dag: Naawuni ʒiinim maa puuni ka o daa zaŋ ma chaŋ nimaani nti tam zoli din du pam zuɣu, ka binshɛli daa ʒe zoli maa zuɣu nudirigu polo m-be kaman fɔntiŋ la.
en: In Gods visions, he brought me to the land of Israel and set me down on a very high mountain, where there was a city structure to the south.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka o ba min o ma maa daa yɛli ni o gba lan pala bia, dinzuɣu ni bɛ bɔhim o maa.
en: That is why his parents said, He is old enough. Ask him.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋd o nyɛvili n zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: All who want to save their lives will lose them. But all who lose their lives because of me will find them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi ni chaŋ Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli ha yaha; ka salo pam daa laɣim o sanna ka o ti gbaai ba wuhibu kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm.
en: Then Jesus left there and went into the area of Judea and across the Jordan River. Again, many people came to him, and Jesus taught them as he always did.

dag: Ka Zɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Itiɔpia nir la tɔbbihi tuhi tuhili mini chɛchɛbunsi kɔbisita kana ti liri ba Marɛsha.
en: Then Zerah from Ethiopia came out against Asas army. He had . men and chariots in his army. His army went as far as the town of Mareshah.

dag: Saha shɛli kanna, ka Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ ni ti ba nyaɣa kaman tia la. Bɛ ni ti pum puma, ka wali wala. Ka bɛ zuliya ti be dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam.
en: In the future, Jacob will take root firmly on his soil. Then Israel will sprout and bloom, and the world will be filled with his fruit.

dag: Amɔs daa yɛliya, Bɛ wum Yawɛ damli Ziɔn zoli zuɣu; ka o kukoli tahigu yi Jɛrusalɛm na. Biŋkɔbiri mɔŋubira kuuya, ka Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu kuui.
en: Amos said, The Lord roars from Mount Zion; his voice thunders from Jerusalem. The pastures dry up, and the grass on Mount Carmel turns brown.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti shihi ba ka yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya! Di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: But Jesus came and touched them. Get up, he said. Dont be afraid.

dag: dama yimaŋmaŋ mi viɛnyɛliŋga ni ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la ni ti kana kaman tayiɣa ni kanna yuŋ shɛm la.
en: You know very well that the day of the Lord is going to come like a thief in the night.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla nyin daadam, a niriba bɛn ʒe goma gbini mini bɛn ʒe dunoya ni yɛri taba, ka sokam yɛri o ʒiʒiinikpee, Kamiyana ti wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din yi Yawɛ sanna ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: As for you, human one, your people talk about you beside the walls and in their doorways. One by one, they say to each other, Lets go hear what sort of message has come from the LORD.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii kpamba cheechi kam puuni ti ba, ka daa lo noli n-suhi ti Duuma ka zaŋ ba niŋ Naawuni so bɛ ni niŋ yɛda maa nuu ni.
en: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.

dag: Di ni yɛli ni o daa zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu zuɣu la daa bi sabi zalila ti yab Ibrahimma kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: But the scripture that says it was credited to him wasnt written only for Abrahams sake.

dag: Dinzuɣu teemiya ka doli n zaligunim maa zaa, ka be kasi yi Naawuni sani.
en: In this way youll remember to do all my commands. Then you will be holy to your God.

dag: Yawɛ ni be nyini n dan naa sani shɛm, o kul be Sulemaana gba sani lala ka chɛ ka o nam gari nyini n dan Naa Dauda nam.
en: Just as the LORD was with my master the king, so may he be with Solomon. May his throne be even greater than the throne of my master King David.

dag: Amaa Abimilɛk daa na bi zaŋ Zara dɔni, dinzuɣu ka o daa bɔhi, N Duuma, a ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali?.
en: Now Abimelech hadnt gone near her, and he said, Lord, will you really put an innocent nation to death?.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ be yi sani yi sansani maa ni chana ni o tiligi ya, ka zaŋ yi dimnim niŋ yi nuu ni. Dinzuɣu di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yi sansani maa ni be kasi din ni chɛ ka o ku nya binshɛli din nyɛ daɣiri bini yi sani ka zo ka chɛn ya.
en: This is because the Lord your God is there with you in your camp to save you and to help you defeat your enemies. So the camp must be holy. Then he will not see something disgusting and leave you.

dag: Ka a boli tuumbaŋdiba bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb n ni zaŋ baŋsim ti na nti chɛ ka bɛ she binyɛra ti Aduna ka o leei m maligumaana.
en: Aaron is to be dedicated as my high priest, and his clothes must be made only by persons who possess skills that I have given them.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti nya li, di daa gari ba mi ka dabiɛm gbaai ba ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: but when they saw it, they were amazed. They all panicked and ran away.

dag: ka mali naŋgbaŋkuɣila ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ milimita pisopɔinnaanu niŋ li, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Make a rim inches wide around it and a gold border around the rim.

dag: Yaa n Duuma, a daa zo n kuŋa. A daa tiligi n nyɛvili.
en: You rescued me and saved my life.

dag: Ka nam ʒiishɛhi pisinaanahi gili nam ʒiishee maa, ka kpamba pisinaanahi ye binyɛr piɛla, ka pil salima zuɣupila n-ʒi nam ʒiishɛhi maa ni.
en: In a circle around the throne were twenty-four other thrones, on which were seated twenty-four elders dressed in white and wearing crowns of gold.

dag: Wummi bɛ ni bɔhiri ma shɛm, Yawɛ yɛligu maa lee be ya? Chɛ ka ti wum li.
en: The people of Judah say to me, Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us what the Lord has said. So why hasn't it come true.

dag: Ka o daa deei salima maa n-zaŋ li nyɛligi mali salima naɣilabila. Ka niriba maa daa yɛli, Izraɛlnima, yi buɣili ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: He took the gold from the people and used it to make an idol. Using a special tool, he shaped the gold into a statue of a calf. Then the people said, Israel, here are your gods! These are the gods that brought you out of the land of Egypt.

dag: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni yi baŋ ni ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre soli ni ti beni. Bɛ ni ti nyɛla ansarisimaaniba bɛn maani yi ni niŋ shɛli yɛda la ansarisi.
en: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you.

dag: Bɛn pa Yɛhudianim la ni daa wum lala maa ka di paligi bɛ suhuri pam ka bɛ paɣi ti Duuma yɛligu maa; ka Naawuni ni daa zali shɛb ni bɛ nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu la niŋ yɛda.
en: When the non-Jewish people heard Paul say this, they were happy. They gave honor to the message of the Lord, and many of them believed it. These were the ones chosen to have eternal life.

dag: ka daa ti lan yi Bamɔt mi chaŋ vinvamli shɛli din daa do Mɔab tintariga Pisiga zolɔŋni zaŋ lab tiŋgban nɛli polo la.
en: They traveled from Bamoth to the Valley of Moab. In this place the top of the Pisgah Mountain looks over the desert.

dag: Amaa mɔɣu ni buŋ yi ni dɔɣi ninsala, jɛrigu ni niŋ yɛm.
en: but it's easier to tame a wild donkey than to make a fool wise.

dag: Amaa leemiyala bɛn tumdi yɛligu maa ni wuhi shɛm, ka pa ni bɛn yɔhim bɛmaŋ wumdila di ni yɛli shɛm kɔŋko.
en: Obey God's message! Don't fool yourselves by just listening to it.

dag: N shini ka di yuui, N kul gbaala mmaŋ ka fo. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni kuhi pam kaman paɣ ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi. N ni vuhi parim.
en: Ive kept still for a very long time. Ive been silent and restrained myself. Like a woman in labor I will moan; I will pant, I will gasp.

dag: Amaa pa sokam zaa m-mali dimbɔŋɔ baŋsim, dama yɛdaniŋdib bɛn pun mili buɣa yi di bindirigu ŋɔ tatabo, bɛ tɛhirimi ni di nyɛla bɛ ni shiri zaŋ shɛli mali buɣili, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha ni ka kpiɔŋ zuɣu chɛ ka di nyɛ daɣiri bɛ sani.
en: But not everyone knows this truth. Some people have been so used to idols that to this day when they eat such food they still think of it as food that belongs to an idol; their conscience is weak, and they feel they are defiled by the food.

dag: N daa nya n suhu ni kul bɔri shɛlikam. N daa bi zaɣisi n suhu ni kul bɔri nyaɣisim shɛlikam. N daa nyu bara n ni tum nya shɛli zuɣu. N tuma laara zaa ni daa nyɛ shɛli m-bala.
en: Anything I wanted, I got. I did not deny myself any pleasure. I was proud of everything I had worked for, and all this was my reward.

dag: Ka Juda Naa Jɛhoyachin min o ma ni o kpambaliba ni o bidibisi ni o naazɔnim daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti Babilɔn naa. Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa gbaai Naa Jɛhoyachin ŋun Babilɔn naa maa nam dibu yuma anii saha kuli Babilɔn.
en: King Jehoiachin of Judah went out to meet the king of Babylon. His mother, his officers, leaders, and officials also went with him. Then the king of Babylon captured Jehoiachin. This was during the eighth year of Nebuchadnezzars rule.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ nyo Ai buɣim, ka di di n-kab lu n-duhiduhi doya; ka na kul doya lala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Then Joshua burned Ai. He made it a permanently deserted mound. That is still the case today.

dag: Ŋmaligim lab ti yɛli Hɛzɛkia ŋun nyɛ n niriba naa maa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a yab Dauda Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, N wum a suhigu maa, ka nya a nintam maa. Nyama, n ni chɛ ka a kpaŋ, ka zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali, a ni chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: to go back to Hezekiah, ruler of the Lord 's people, and say to him, I, the Lord , the God of your ancestor David, have heard your prayer and seen your tears. I will heal you, and in three days you will go to the Temple.

dag: Yi zaa nya li yimaŋmaŋa, ka wula ka yi zaa leei bɛn ka buchi.
en: But no, after all, you have seen for yourselves; so why do you talk such nonsense?.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi suhuri kul yɛla binshɛŋa din be nimaani zuɣu, ka pa ni binshɛŋa din be dunia ŋɔ ni zuɣu.
en: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.

dag: Bɛ kabɔɣa mini bɛ wain tɔɣiri bɔɣa ku dihi ba, ka bɛ ku nya wain palli.
en: Threshing floor and wine vat wont feed them; the new wine will fail them.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka n nya wɔr piɛli. Ŋun daa ʒi o zuɣu yuli daa boonila Ʒiɛyim mini Yɛlimaŋli. Ka o daa mali wuntitali n-kariti saria ka tuhiri tɔbu.
en: I looked and saw heaven was open, and a white horse was there. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he is always fair when he judges or goes to war.

dag: Yi ŋmanila firila dunia ŋɔ ni. Tin shɛli din me n-tam zoli zuɣu mi bi sɔɣira.
en: You are the light for the whole world. A city built on top of a hill cannot be hidden.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ saɣim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n-daa darigi di tibili, ka di gbuɣi di niriba maa bahi maa.
en: Their actions made the land unclean, and so the Lord is punishing the land and making it reject the people who lived there.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ binnɛma balibu kam zaɣ lɔɣu ni zaɣ nyaŋ niŋ a sani ŋariŋ maa ni, ka lala niŋbu chɛ ka bɛ tiligi.
en: Take into the boat with you a male and a female of every kind of animal and bird, as well as a male and a female of every reptile. I don't want them to be destroyed.

dag: Nyamiya Yawɛ sanʒiɛɣu, suhuyiɣisili titali. Di ŋmanila pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga, di ni lu ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu.
en: Now the punishment from the Lord will come like a storm. His anger will be like a tornado. It will come crashing down on the heads of those wicked people.

dag: Ka salo maa ni yino daa kuhi yɛl o, Karimba, n suhir a mi ni a lihi m bia ŋɔ ti ma, dama o kɔŋko n-kul nyɛ m bia.
en: A man in the group shouted to him, Teacher, please come and look at my son. He is the only child I have.

dag: Ka sana yi be yi sani ka bɔri ni o puhiri Yaɣigari chuɣu ŋɔ tiri Yawɛ jilima, yin chɛliya ka o gun o yiŋ bidibisi zaa, di saha o ni leei Izraɛl tiŋbia, ka ni tooi puhiri Yaɣigari chuɣu maa. Amaa di bi simdi ka ŋun bi guni di li.
en: If an immigrant who lives with you wants to observe the Passover to the LORD, then he and all his males should be circumcised. Then he may join in observing it. He should be regarded as a native of the land. But no uncircumcised person may eat it.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal o yi ku yiɣisi zaŋ li ti o o min o simdi maa zuɣu, amaa o nimmoo suhigu maa zuɣu o ni yiɣisi zaŋ o ni bɔri shɛli maa ti o.
en: Well, what then? I tell you that even if he will not get up and give you the bread because you are his friend, yet he will get up and give you everything you need because you are not ashamed to keep on asking.

dag: Ka n yi mal anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini, ka tooi baŋdi yɛlisɔɣira, ka mali baŋsim zaa, hal n yi mali yɛda din ni chɛ ka n tooi vuui zoya di dooshɛhi, ka ka yurilim, dindina m pala shɛli.
en: I may have the gift of inspired preaching; I may have all knowledge and understand all secrets; I may have all the faith needed to move mountains—but if I have no love, I am nothing.

dag: Di saha ka paɣiba maa daa lan kum pam. Ka Opa ŋun daa chɛbisi Naomi ka ŋmaligi kuli, amaa ka Rut ŋun zaɣisi ka kul doli Naomi.
en: Again they started crying. Then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law good-bye and went back home, but Ruth held on to her.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali biɛɣu daa ti neerina ka bɛ daŋ yibu ti chaŋ gili tiŋ maa kaman bɛ ni daa yi pun gindi li shɛm la napɔŋ buyopɔin. Kulla dindali maa kɔŋko ka bɛ daa gil li napɔŋ buyopɔin maa.
en: On the seventh day, the army got up at daybreak. They marched slowly around Jericho the same as they had done for the past six days, except on this day they went around seven times.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Wummiya, ka kpahi Yaakubu zuliya zuɣu ni yɛli.
en: This is what the Lord GOD All-Powerful says: Warn the family of Jacob about these things.

dag: nti zaŋ a kparibu yɛl o, ka zaŋ shɛlɔrigu lo o; ka zaŋ a yiko niŋ o nuu ni, ka o leei Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim ba.
en: I will put your official robe and belt on him and give him all the authority you have had. He will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and Judah.

dag: Zɛdɛkia daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum shɛm.
en: He did evil in the LORDs eyes just as Jehoiachin had done.

dag: Mɔri shiri kuura, ka tipum kpahiri lura, amaa ti Naawuni maa ŋun yɛligu kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change.

dag: Ka naa daa po pɔri yɛli Shimɛi, A ku kpi.
en: Then David promised Shimei that he would not be killed.

dag: Dama o suhu bi yu ni o nahim ti bee n-ti ti ni so suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: The Lord doesn't enjoy sending grief or pain.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛzra daa yiɣisi zani ka chɛ ka maligumaaniba zuɣulaannim mini Lɛvinim ni Izraɛlnim zaa po pɔri n-wuhi ni bɛ ni niŋ bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa shiri po.
en: So Ezra began by making the leaders of the priests, of the Levites, and of the rest of the people take an oath that they would do what Shecaniah had proposed.

dag: Di simdi ka yi piɛbil nyɛla ŋun ka daŋa, ka nyɛ yuun yini piɛbila. Yi ni tooi zaŋ bulaa ŋun be lala gba.
en: You may choose either a sheep or a goat, but it must be a one-year-old male without any defects.

dag: Yawɛ ni tuhi ba tin ya, kul ʒiɛnya baalim.
en: The Lord will fight for you, and you won't have to do a thing.

dag: Di saha ka ti daa deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dul la Amɔrinim nanim maa nuu ni, zaŋ Arinɔn kulibɔŋ ni hal ti paai Hɛrimɔn Zoli gbini.
en: So at that time, we took the land that had belonged to the two Amorite kings beyond the Jordan, all the way from the Arnon Ravine to Mount Hermon .

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni ti zaŋ bɛ ni daa ku wuntizɔr shɛba dunia ŋɔ ni, Ɛbɛl ŋun daa bi tum taal shɛl la kubu saha zaŋ ti paai Anabi Zakaria Bɛrakia bi so yi ni daa ku Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini sara malibu bimbini sunsuuni la taali ʒili ya.
en: Therefore, upon you will come all the righteous blood that has been poured out on the earth, from the blood of that righteous man Abel to the blood of Zechariah the son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the temple and the altar.

dag: Ka bɛn daa gariti nimaani gba yɛri Yisa zilima, ka gbaɣisiri bɛ zuɣuri niŋd o ka yɛra, Nyin ŋun wurindi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka lan mɛri li daba ata sunsuuni ŋɔ.
en: People passing by shook their heads and hurled insults at Jesus: Aha! You were going to tear down the Temple and build it back up in three days!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala n-zaŋ talim Baanabas mini Sool ni bɛ ti ti cheechi kpamba.
en: So they appointed Barnabas and Saul to take their gifts to the church leaders in Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛn daa ŋubi bɛ sara maligu biŋkɔbiri kpam ka nyu bɛ sara maligu wain la lee be ya? Chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi zani sɔŋ ya, chɛ ka bɛ guli ya.
en: who ate up the fat of their sacrifices, who drank their sacred wine? They should stand up and help you! They should protect you now!.

dag: Daadam bahirila yoli kaman bin pɔŋ la, ka ŋmani lɛla ni yi ŋubi chahi situra shɛli.
en: Surely a person wastes away like refuse, like clothing that a moth eats.

dag: Yawɛ ni tiligi ma, ka ti zaŋ goonjɛnim ŋme m-paɣ o. Ti kul ni paɣir o o jɛmbu duu hal ni ti nyɛviya tariga.
en: So I say, The Lord saved me. So we will sing and play songs in the Lord s Temple all our lives.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim nyɛla Naawuni sariakaribo din tuhi shihira, ka di wuhiri ni Naawuni chɛ ka yi leei bɛn simdi ŋun Naawuni nam shɛli zuɣu yi ni diri wahala ŋɔ ni kpɛbu.
en: This is proof that God is right in his judgment. He wants you to be worthy of his kingdom. Your suffering is for that kingdom.

dag: Ka Yisifu yɛl o, N lihiri bɔrila m biɛyanima, ka yɛli, N suhir a, wuhim ma bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔbiri maa be luɣ shɛli polo ka bɛ ŋubiri mɔri maa.
en: Joseph answered, I am looking for my brothers. Can you tell me where they are with their sheep.

dag: Bɛ daa bi gbibi Naawuni ni lo ba alikauli shɛl la, ka daa zaɣis o zaligu dolibu.
en: They didnt keep Gods covenant; they refused to walk in his Instruction.

dag: N ni mali suhupiɛlli Jɛrusalɛm mini n niriba zuɣu, ka so ku lan kum bee n-fabili di ni.
en: I will celebrate with Jerusalem and all its people; there will be no more crying or sorrow in that city.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Chamiya ti bo n-nya paɣ so ŋun nyɛ jinwara ni be luɣ shɛli, ka n chaŋ o sani ti kari saria. Ka o tumtumdiba maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, jinwara be Ɛndo.
en: So Saul said to his servants, Find me a woman who communicates with ghosts! Ill then go to her and ask by using her techniques. There is such a medium in En-dor, his servants replied.

dag: Ka Pita chihi yɛli, Paɣa, man bi mi a ni yɛri so maa.
en: But Peter said this was not true. He said, Lady, I dont know him.

dag: Di pa ni ti kuunimi ni tinim su yi ni niŋ yɛda shɛm fukumsi, dama yi ʒiɛla dɛde yi ni niŋ yɛda shɛm puuni, amaa tinim lee pahila yi zuɣu n-tumdi yi suhupiɛlli nyabu zuɣu.
en: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.

dag: Jɛriko — kɔbisita ni pihinahinaanu.
en: from the town of Jericho:.

dag: A nam dariza din galisi pam ŋɔ puuni ka a ŋme m-paag a dimnima. Nyini n-daa chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili di ba zaa kaman mɔ kuma ka bɛ chɛ n-sɔŋ ka buɣim di li la.
en: In majestic triumph you overthrow your foes; your anger blazes out and burns them up like straw.

dag: Ka paɣa maa yi ti tuui dɔɣi bidibiga, bɛn zaŋm o mabi so ŋun kpi maa yuli boli bia maa din ni chɛ ka o yuli maa ku kpihim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Then the first son she has will be considered the dead mans son in order to keep the dead mans name alive in Israel.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim daa chɛ ka tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri mini paɣ shɛb bɛn mali jilima ka doli Yɛhudianim daadiini sol la taai duŋ n-daa niŋ Pool mini Baanabas alaka, ka kari ba bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: But the Jews there caused some of the important religious women and the leaders of the city to be angry and turn against Paul and Barnabas and throw them out of town.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, nyini Ayuba, wummi n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka gbilisi tibili wum n yɛtɔɣa maa zaa.
en: But now, listen to me, Job; pay attention to all my words.

dag: A ni yɛligi kpa nudirigu mini nuzaa polo, ka a niriba ni su zuliya shɛba, ka yi ti ʒini tin shɛŋa din daa nyɛ dabari la ni.
en: because you will grow in all directions. Your children will take over many nations and live in the cities that were destroyed.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ daanya mali gaɣa kɔtomsi n-tuɣituɣi taba n-zaŋ li kaai vili kɔniŋdi bini maa nyingol ni ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita anu.
en: Under the rim were two rows of gourds completely encircling it, ten every eighteen inches, each cast in its mold.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ma nyintaa bipuɣiŋga ŋun nyɛ o ba dapala dɔni, dama o nyɛla o tizɔpaɣa.
en: If your father and his wife have a daughter, she is your sister. You must not have sexual relations with her.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔahaz bia la daa lab deei tin shɛŋa Naa Bɛnhadad Hazaɛl bia ni daa tuh o ba Jɛhɔahaz ka fa la. Siɣimsiɣim buta ka Jɛhɔash daa tuhi nyaŋ Bɛnhadad ka fa Izraɛlnim tinsi o sani.
en: Then King Jehoash of Israel defeated Benhadad three times and recaptured the cities that had been taken by Benhadad during the reign of Jehoahaz, the father of Jehoash.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paɣi Naawuni o nambɔzɔbo zuɣu kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Dinzuɣu n ni paɣ nyin Naawuni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sunsuuni ka yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: and so that the Gentiles could glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, Because of this I will confess you among the Gentiles, and I will sing praises to your name .

dag: Ŋmaligim m polo na n-zo ma nambɔɣu; zaŋm a kpiɔŋ ti a dabili ŋɔ, tiligim a dab bipuɣiŋga bia ŋɔ.
en: Come back to me! Have mercy on me! Give your servant your strength; save this child of your servant!.

dag: Ka a daa kul lihir o hal ka kuɣili din pa ninsal nuu ni ŋme ŋ-ŋmaai shɛli bahi na daa ti kana ti lu binnani maa napɔnvari din daa nyɛ kuriti mini yaɣiri la zuɣu n-wurisiwurisi li buɣibuɣi.
en: While you were looking at the statue, you saw a rock that was cut loose, but not by human hands. Then the rock hit the statue on its feet of iron and clay and smashed them.

dag: Yi ti bi yɛn niŋdi kaman ti ni niŋdi shɛm kpe zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Ti zaa kul niŋdila ti suhuri ni yu shɛm.
en: When that time comes, you must not do as you have been doing. Until now you have all been worshiping as you please.

dag: Ka naa Sulemaana daa zaŋ aligum dari maa mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu min o yiŋ dunɔdura. O daa lan zaŋ li mali mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima n-ti baansi, ka so daa na ʒi n-nya di tatabo Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The king made steps for the LORDs temple and for the royal palace with the algum wood, as well as lyres and harps for the musicians. Never before had anything like them been seen in the land of Judah.

dag: Judanim daa tum din bie Naawuni sani. Bɛ daa tum alahichi gari bɛ yaannim ni daa tum shɛm n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: The people of Judah did things that the Lord considered evil. They made him angry with all their sins—more than any of their ancestors had done.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi tɛha be kaman tɛhi shɛli din be Masia ni la:.
en: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:.

dag: ka n ti labiri kuni yiŋ na, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ti kul yi n yiŋa n-daŋ ma soli tuhibu na, dilana ni leei nyin Yawɛ dini, ka n zaŋ o mali sara n-nyo o buɣim ti a.
en: I will give you the first thing that comes out of my house when I come back from the victory. I will give it to the Lord as a burnt offering.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dimbɔŋɔ gari ma pam! Yi bi mi doo maa ni yi shɛl na, amaa o neegi n nina.
en: How strange! the man replied. He healed my eyes, and yet you don't know where he comes from.

dag: N lan yɛri ya mi ni laakum shɛriga nyee ni kpɛbu mal asama gari bundan Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.

dag: Jɛrigu n-zaɣisir o ba ni wuh o shɛli, amaa ŋunkam deeri saɣisigu nyɛla ŋun mali yɛm.
en: It is foolish to ignore what your parents taught you; it is wise to accept their correction.

dag: ni nuzaa polo nanim zaa bɛn be katinsi ni yoma zaa ti nyu li ka ti taba. Ka dunia ŋɔ ni nanim zaa bɛn be bɛ nyɛviya ni ti nyu li. Babilɔn naa nti yɛn bahindi bɛ zaa nyaaŋa nyu li.
en: all the kings of the north, those nearby and those faraway, one after another, all the empires on the earth will drink from this cup. And after them the king of Sheshach will drink from it.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa kpe nti ʒini Yawɛ tooni ka yɛli, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, m mi lee nyɛ ŋuni, ka n daŋ lee nyɛ dini, ka a ti zaŋ ma zali zaashee ŋɔ tatabo ni?.
en: David went into the tent he had set up for the sacred chest. Then he sat there and prayed: Lord All-Powerful, my family and I don't deserve what you have already done for us.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Alɔbo ni yi nuzaa polo na ti lu tiŋgbani maa ni niriba zaa zuɣu.
en: The LORD said to me, Trouble will erupt from the north against the people of this land.

dag: Azaria daa nyɛla Amaria ba, ka Amaria nyɛ Ahitub ba.
en: Azariah was Amariahs father. Amariah was Ahitubs father.

dag: Saha shɛli Rom naa ni daa zaŋ Gallio leei Akaianim gomna la, ka Yɛhudianim daa niŋ naŋgban yini n-chaŋ ti gbaai Pool n-vo o tahi saria karibu shee.
en: Now when Gallio was the governor of the province of Achaia, the Jews united in their opposition against Paul and brought him before the court.

dag: Ka bɛ daa puhi ti ni ti paabuna ka niŋ ti nirilim pam, dama bɛ daa malila buɣim ti ti saa ni daa miri ka wari beni zuɣu.
en: The islanders showed us extraordinary kindness. Because it was rainy and cold, they built a fire and welcomed all of us.

dag: Lala ka o daa niŋ ti Iso zuliya bɛn be Ɛdom la, o daa kula Hɔrinima ka chɛ ka bɛ deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒini n-zani bɛ zaani hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: God did the same thing for Esaus people. In the past the Horites lived in Seir. But Esaus people destroyed the Horites, and Esaus descendants still live there today.

dag: O ni gbilisiri tibili wumdi n suhigu zuɣu, n kul ni suhir o hal ni n nyɛvil tariga.
en: He listens to me every time I call to him.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ ti shihi kum din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpe daɣiri ni, amaa di yi nyɛla bɛ ba bee bɛ ma bee bɛ bidibiga bee bɛ bipuɣiŋga bee bɛ mabia ŋun nyɛ doo bee bɛ tizɔpaɣa ŋun bi kuli doo, bɛ ni tooi kpe daɣiri ni.
en: A priest is not to become ritually unclean by touching a corpse, unless it is one of his parents, one of his children or a brother or an unmarried sister.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ o niŋ o mamanim bɛn nyɛ Asirianim shɛb o ni daa niŋ kɔre maa nuu ni.
en: So I handed her over to her Assyrian lovers whom she wanted so much.

dag: Ka Pool daa ti nya Masidɔnia do so ʒii yuŋ ka o ʒiɛya m-balindi ŋun Pool yɛra, Kam Masidɔnia na ti sɔŋ ti.
en: That night Paul saw a vision. In it, a man from Macedonia came to Paul. The man stood there and begged, Come across to Macedonia and help us.

dag: N wum anab shɛb bɛn mali n yuli ŋmari ʒiri yɛra, N zahimla zahindi, n zahimla zahindi.
en: I have heard the prophets prophesying lies in my name. They claim, Ive had a dream; Ive had a dream.

dag: Hashum daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihitaayika.
en: of Hashum.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni a nuu n-tum lala maa.
en: Make my enemies know that you are the one who saves me.

dag: O ni daa duh omaŋa o tuumbiɛri zuɣu la zuɣu, niŋmiy o nahiŋgu ka o fabili lala! Dama o yɛli o suhu ni: N dila nam ʒiya! M pala pakoli! Lala zuɣu n ku nya suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: To the extent that she glorified herself and indulged her loose and extravagant ways, give her pain and grief. In her heart she says, I sit like a queen! Im not a widow. Ill never see grief.

dag: Di yih a ʒiɛyimtali maa n daŋ ni. Ka Yawɛ yi ti kpihim nyin Dauda dimnim zaa birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: show the same kind of loyalty to my family forever. And when the Lord has completely destroyed all your enemies.

dag: Ka Ribɛka min o dab bipuɣinsi daa yiɣisi m-ba laakumnima n-doli nachin kpɛm maa ka o zaŋ o lu yiŋ soli.
en: Rebekah and her young women got up, mounted the camels, and followed the man. So the servant took Rebekah and left.

dag: Nir yi niŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ʒe yim naani a muɣisigu saha, di ŋmanila nyinvɔɣu bee napɔŋ din ka alaafee.
en: A friend you can't trust in times of trouble is like having a toothache or a sore foot.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, zanimiya baalim nya Yawɛ ni yɛn tum tiliginsim tuun shɛli tin ya zuŋɔ; dama yi ni nya Ijipti ninvuɣ shɛb zuŋɔ ŋɔ, yi nini ku lan nya ba yaha.
en: Moses answered, Don't be afraid! Stand your ground, and you will see what the Lord will do to save you today; you will never see these Egyptians again.

dag: Malaika maa kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila saa ni yi nyaɣisi la, ka o binyɛrigu piɛli kaman gol la.
en: The angel looked as bright as lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.

dag: A nuu ni ka n zaŋ n shia niŋ; Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim ŋɔ, nyini n-daa tiligi ma.
en: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.

dag: N ni daa yihi ba zuliya shɛb ni, ka yihi ba bɛ dimnim tiŋgbana ni na nti chɛ ka n kasitali yi palo bɛ zuɣu ka zuliya kam nya li la.
en: I will bring my people back from other countries. I will gather them from the lands of their enemies. Then many nations will see how holy I am.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ maa ka paɣ so be salo maa ni kuhi yɛli, A ni daa yi pu shɛl ni na min a ni daa mɔɣ bihi shɛŋa mal alibarika.
en: While Jesus was saying these things, a certain woman in the crowd spoke up: Happy is the mother who gave birth to you and who nursed you.

dag: Ka o daa kana ti paai piɛri biɛhigu shee ka tampiŋ voli daa be nimaani so naŋgbanyee; ka Sool daa kpe di puuni ni o ti damdi yɔɣu ni ka Dauda min o niriba gba daa be voli maa puuni ha.
en: There were some sheep pens along the side of the road, and one of them was built around the entrance to a cave. Saul went into the cave to relieve himself. David and his men were hiding at the back of the cave.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla bɛn nyɛ daɣiri bina yi sani binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋgbani ni maa puuni, ka ŋunkam shihi bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Whoever touches them or their dead bodies will be unclean until evening.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa ti kurigi ka o nina niŋ liti, ka o bi lan tooi nyari viɛnyɛliŋga saha shɛli, ka o daa bol o bituuli Iso na ti yɛl o, M bia. Ka o saɣi yɛli, N nyɛ ma.
en: Isaac was old and almost blind, when he called in his first-born son Esau, who asked him, Father, what can I do for you.

dag: Ka paɣitali dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so yuun pinaayi, ka o daa saɣim o ni mali shɛlikam timanim sani ka sokam tib o je la.
en: A woman was there who had been bleeding for twelve years. She had spent her entire livelihood on doctors, but no one could heal her.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa, ka bi ʒe a kɔsoya maa nyaaŋa, n ni chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa bahi yoli n-leei dabari, zaŋ Migidol hal ni Sine n-zaŋ hal ti paai Itiɔpia tintariga.
en: So I am against you. I am against the many branches of your Nile River. I will destroy Egypt completely. The cities will be empty from Migdol to Aswan and as far as the border of Ethiopia.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni daa pun yɛli o Kundi ni ni o ni tim anabinim mini tuumba na, ka bɛ ti ku bɛ shɛba, ka niŋ bɛ shɛb mi alaka;.
en: Therefore, Gods wisdom has said, I will send prophets and apostles to them and they will harass and kill some of them.

dag: Ka Nagai daa nyɛ Maat bia, ka Maat nyɛ Matatias so bia, ka Matatias maa nyɛ Sɛmɛin bia ka Sɛmɛin nyɛ Josɛk bia, ka Josɛk mi nyɛ Jɔda bia.
en: Maath, Mattathias, Semein, Josech, Joda;.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb daa tahiri yɛra, ŋ-ŋɔ nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ; ka bɛn la mi yɛra, ŋ-ŋɔ nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ; dama salo daa kul tahirila yiriŋ, hal bɛ shɛb daa bi mi din chɛ ka bɛ laɣimna.
en: Meanwhile, the assembly was in a state of confusion. Some shouted one thing, others shouted something else, and most of the crowd didnt know why they had gathered.

dag: ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku Jɔn mabia Jeemsi.
en: He ordered James, the brother of John, to be killed with a sword.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tuhi Midiannim maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm n-ku dɔbba zaa.
en: They battled against Midian as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they killed every male.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Izraɛlnim maa, Ijiptinim mini Amɔrinim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim.
en: The Lord answered: In the past when you came crying to me for help, I rescued you. At one time or another I've rescued you from the Egyptians, the Amorites, the Ammonites, the Philistines, the Sidonians, the Amalekites, and the Maonites.

dag: Naawuni daa nya Sɔdom mini Gomɔra tinsi la nim taali, ka daa zaŋ buɣim bahi ba yoli wuliwuli, ka di wuhi din ti yɛn niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura.
en: God condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to total destruction, reducing them to ashes as a warning to ungodly people.

dag: ka doli Naawuni ni daa kari zuliya shɛb ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-ti bɛn Izraɛlnim la kaya mini Izraɛl nanim ni daa zaŋ ka shɛŋa wuhi ba la.
en: followed the customs of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel, and were just as sinful as the Israelite kings.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani bɔh o, Naawuni maligumaaniba zuɣulana ka a tu lala maa.
en: The men standing beside Paul asked, Don't you know you are insulting God's high priest.

dag: Dama o zuliya ni ti galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ, ka dunia ŋɔ niriba zaa ni ti nya alibarika la o zuɣu.
en: His descendants will become a great and mighty nation, and through him I will bless all the nations.

dag: Wuntizɔriba solɔɣu nyɛla din lɔɣiri zaɣ biɛɣu. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi bɛmaŋ bɛ soli ni nyɛla bɛn tiligiri bɛ nyɛviya.
en: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila ala m-be yi sani? Chamiya ti nya. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti lihi ka labina ti yɛl o, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi ko m-beni.
en: He said to them, How much bread do you have? Take a look. After checking, they said, Five loaves of bread and two fish.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa boli maligumaaniba Zadok mini Abiata m-pahi Lɛvi zuliya ni niriba bɛn nyɛ: Uriɛl mini Asaaya ni Joɛl ni Shɛmaya ni Ɛliɛl ni Aminadab na.
en: David called for the priests Zadok and Abiathar, and the Levites Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.

dag: Ba maa yur o Bia maa, ka wuhir o omaŋmaŋ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa, ka ni lan wuh o tuun kara gari dimbɔŋɔnima din ni chɛ ka di niŋ ya alahiziba.
en: The Father loves the Son and shows him everything he does. This man was healed. But the Father will show the Son greater things than this to do. Then you will all be amazed.

dag: O daa lan bɔri ni o kahigila o jilima din galisi n-wuhi o ni daa zaŋ li niŋ tinim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nya o nambɔzɔbo la ni, ka mali ti zali ni ti ti nya o jilima.
en: What if he did this to make the wealth of his glory known toward pots made for mercy, which he prepared in advance for glory?.

dag: So yi lab a tapaɣa, nyin lɛbigim din la gba pah o; ka so yi fa a binyɛrigu, nyin di mɔŋ o a chinchini gba.
en: If someone slaps you on the cheek, offer the other one as well. If someone takes your coat, dont withhold your shirt either.

dag: Bɛ ni ti chɛ bɛ tɔbbihi bɛn kpi sɔŋ palo ni, ka zoya zuɣu noonsi mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri di ba, ka ŋub ba. Noonsi ni ti di ba shɛɣu ni, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mi ŋub ba kikaa saha.
en: Ethiopians will be food for mountain vultures during the summer and for wild animals during the winter.

dag: Maliya suhupiɛlli yi tahima niŋbu puuni; ka maliya suɣilo yi muɣisigu nyabu ni; ka kul suhimiya Naawuni.
en: Be happy in your hope, stand your ground when youre in trouble, and devote yourselves to prayer.

dag: Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa sab gbaŋ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa niŋ di ni n-ti zuliya kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ zaa ni yɛli, Naawuni timiya suhudoo!.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar sent the following message to the people of all nations, races, and languages in the world: Greetings!.

dag: Amaa n ni ti chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi yi yɛligu maa wumbu, hal n ni ti yɛn tum alahiziba shɛŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa zaa yoli.
en: But I will make the king so stubborn that he won't listen to you. He won't listen even when I do many terrible things to him and his nation. Then I will bring a final punishment on Egypt, and the king will let Israel's families and tribes go.

dag: N daa bi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ashilɔni bee bumbɔn ni. N daa bi yɛli Izraɛlnim ni bɛ bom ma luɣ shɛli din ka nyam shee. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, n tɔɣisirila yɛlimaŋli, ka wuhiri din tuhi.
en: I have not spoken in secret or kept my purpose hidden. I did not require the people of Israel to look for me in a desolate waste. I am the Lord , and I speak the truth; I make known what is right.

dag: Binyara ŋɔ bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa kaman ninsalinim ni tɔɣisiri shɛm. So mi bi wumdi di kukoya.
en: No speech or words are used, no sound is heard;.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim daa kul kpaŋsiri Izraɛlnim maa ni bɛ yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yomyom, dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Di yi pa lala tinim gba kul kpimi maa.
en: The Egyptians urged the people to hurry and leave the country; they said, We will all be dead if you don't leave.

dag: Ka di daa muɣis o pam asibaasi, ka o tim ti boli Ijipti timanim mini baŋdiba zaa na, ka ŋun Firawuna daa yɛli ba o zahima maa, amaa ka so daa kani n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi wuhi Firawuna o zahima maa gbinni.
en: In the morning he was worried, so he sent for all the magicians and wise men of Egypt. He told them his dreams, but no one could explain them to him.

dag: Yi ni daa labina ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, Yawɛ daa bi wum yi kuhigu maa bee n-chɛ ka o baɣa be yi ni.
en: Then you came back to the place of worship at Kadesh-Barnea and wept, but the Lord would not listen to your prayers.

dag: Ka Yaakubu bihi maa daa niŋ lala, ka Yisifu daa zaŋ tɔrokɔnim maa ti ba kaman Firawuna ni daa zali shɛm, ka bo bɛ sol ni bindira ti ba.
en: Jacob's sons agreed to do what the king had said. And Joseph gave them wagons and food for their trip home, just as the king had ordered.

dag: Bɛ zaa ni ti yaai bɛ noli yɛl a, A gba gbarigimi kaman ti ni gbarigi shɛm. Ti min a zaa niŋla yim.
en: All of them speak and say to you: Even youve become weak like we are! You are the same as us.

dag: Ka di tiri mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri kom, ka mɔɣu ni bunsi nyuri li kuri kɔnyuri.
en: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.

dag: Paɣisarili mi daa yi yɛn yi paɣiba yili maa ni kpe nayili maa, o ni yɛli ni o bɔri shɛlikam, dina ka bɛ tir o ka o zaŋdi mali kpɛra.
en: So this is how the young woman would go to the king: They gave her anything that she asked to take with her from the womens house to the palace.

dag: N naan zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa maa sɔŋ o tooni ka ti tɔɣisi di yɛla.
en: I would lay out my case before him, fill my mouth with arguments.

dag: N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi tinzunnim bɛn yi su n niriba maa zuɣu. N ni darigi bɛ tibili. Judanim nyɛla n niriba, ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni gbib ba. Bɛna n-yɛn nyɛ n tɔbutuhiri yuri bɛn mali yiko pam.
en: My anger burns hot against the shepherds; I will punish the goats. The LORD of heavenly forces will take care of his splendor, the house of Judah. He will make them like his majestic horse in battle.

dag: Ka yi niŋ salima alali niŋ di puuni mini di nyaaŋa zaa, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Cover it with pure gold inside and out and put a gold border all around it.

dag: Ka Musa deemba Jɛtro daa zaŋ Musa paɣ min o bidibis ayi maa n-ka o sanna tiŋgban nɛli maa ni bɛ ni daa ti bɛ suɣa be Naawuni zoli maa gbini luɣ shɛli maa.
en: While Israel was camped in the desert near Mount Sinai, Jethro sent Moses this message: I am coming to visit you, and I am bringing your wife and two sons.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi leei yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ bihi, dama ŋuna n-chɛ ka wuntaŋ neeri ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma zaa zuɣu, ka lan chɛ ka saa miri ninvuɣ suma mini ninvuɣ biɛri tinsi ni.
en: so that you may become the children of your Father in heaven. For he makes his sun to shine on bad and good people alike, and gives rain to those who do good and to those who do evil.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni daa nyɛla bɛ lihiri binshɛŋa din be kasi pam la.
en: Their service involves the most holy things.

dag: Ka daa yi nti kum pam.
en: Then Peter went out and cried bitterly.

dag: Ka Timoti ni daa yi yi sani labina, o daa yɛli ti yi yɛda niŋbu mini yi yurilim yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm. O yɛli ti ni yi kul tɛhirila ti yɛla ka bɔri ni yi nya ti kaman ti gba suhuri ni ye yi nyabu zuɣu shɛm.
en: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa tumtumdiba bɛn daa ʒe o yiŋ dunol ni daa bɔhi Mɔdɛkai, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaɣisi naa zaligu dolibu.
en: So the royal workers at the Kings Gate said to Mordecai, Why dont you obey the kings order.

dag: nti nya Izraɛlnim Naawuni maa, ka o naba tiŋli daa ŋmanila bɛ zaŋla bɛ ni booni kuɣ shɛŋa safaya la mal li. Di daa kul nɛmi kaman sagbana ni yi kani ka zuɣusaa ne shɛm la.
en: and they saw Israels God. Under Gods feet there was what looked like a floor of lapis-lazuli tiles, dazzlingly pure like the sky.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti puhi zani Zakaria sani n-ʒe tulaale zim maa tuɣilibu shee nudirigu polo.
en: An angel from the Lord appeared to him, standing to the right of the altar of incense.

dag: Chamiya ti tum tuma maa, dama bɛ bi lan yɛn tin ya mɔri, amaa yi mi kul yɛn ŋmarila bilichiisi maa kaman yi ni yi pun ŋmari li shɛm tariga la.
en: Get back to work! You won't be given straw, but you must still make the same number of bricks.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋme n-wurim bɛ ni daa me binwɔɣila shɛŋa zal la, ka chɛ n-kabi buɣili Ashɛrim binnani luhi; ka zaŋ ninsalinim kɔba niŋ di zaashɛhi maa bɔɣa ni.
en: He tore down the stone images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred pole used in the worship of Asherah. Then he had the whole area covered with human bones.

dag: Naawuni pun tin ya dahima ni yi doli Masia, ka di pala ni yi niŋ o yɛda kɔŋko, amaa ni yi di wahala gba o zuɣu.
en: God has generously granted you the privilege, not only of believing in Christ but also of suffering for Christs sake.

dag: Wuntaŋ mini goli, paɣimiy o! Saŋmarisi bɛn nyaɣisiri zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, shining stars.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa ka bɔhi ba, Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zahindi ma?.
en: But Jesus knew that these men were trying to trick him. So he said, You hypocrites! Why are you trying to catch me saying something wrong?.

dag: Dama n niriba maa nyɛla jɛra; bɛ bi mi ma. Bɛ nyɛla bi jɛra, bɛ bi baŋdi binyɛra gbinni. Bɛ mali yɛm din tumdi tuumbiɛri, amaa ka lee bi mi tuun viɛla tumbu.
en: My people are foolish. They dont even know me! They are thoughtless children without understanding; they are skilled at doing wrong, inept at doing right.

dag: N nyee nyɔni m biɛhigu; n ku beni hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Miligim ka chɛ ma, dama n dabisa kul nyɛla vuhim.
en: Leave me alone and let me die; my life has no meaning.

dag: Bɛ daa shɛla biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa yin ni ka lan she biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa din la gba ni. Biŋgolinsi maa daa domi tuhi taba.
en: They made fifty loops on the one curtain and fifty loops on the outer curtain that was in the second set. The loops were opposite each other.

dag: Naawuni ŋun tiri binshɛɣukam nyɛvili ŋɔ mini Yisa Masia ŋun daa zani Gomna Pɔntius Pailɛt tooni n-niŋ shɛhira suŋ la zuɣu, n zal a.
en: Before God, who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus, who firmly professed his faith before Pontius Pilate, I command you.

dag: Zaliguzaɣisibutali pun be di tuma tumbu ni, amaa din yɛn niŋ maa na ku niŋ faashee Naawuni ti vuui ŋun taɣi di niŋbu zali maa.
en: The Mysterious Wickedness is already at work, but what is going to happen will not happen until the one who holds it back is taken out of the way.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ yɛda ka mali tahima saha shɛli di ni daa to ni o niŋ tahima ni o ni leei zuliya pam yaba kaman Naawuni ni daa lo o alikauli yɛli, A zuliya ni ti galisi pam la.
en: When it was beyond hope, he had faith in the hope that he would become the father of many nations, in keeping with the promise God spoke to him: Thats how many descendants you will have. .

dag: Dinzuɣu gbibiya n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa, ka tummiya di tuma din ni chɛ ka yi ti be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka barina shɛli kani.
en: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.

dag: Ka bɛn daa dari piɛri ŋ-ŋmaligiri kɔhiri bu ma paa, ka n leei piɛ shɛb bɛ ni daa yɛn ku gula. Ka n daa bo jaaŋgbɛh ayi m-boli zaɣ yini yuli anfaani, ka boli din pah ayi mi yuli naŋgban yini. Ka n daa leei piɛri maa gula.
en: So I took care of the sheep that had been raised to be killed—those poor sheep. I found two sticks. I called one stick Favor, and I called the other stick Union. Then I began caring for the sheep.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti zooi, ka bɛ ŋmaag o bihili, ka Ibrahimma daa puhi chuɣu dahin shɛli Yisahaku ni daa ŋmaai bihili maa.
en: The time came when Sarah no longer had to nurse Isaac, and on that day Abraham gave a big feast.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti bɔhi Sool zuɣu, ka zaŋ Dauda so o ni daa di shɛhira suŋ la leei bɛ naa. Naawuni daa yɛliya, N nya Jɛsi bia Dauda ka o nyɛla n nin ni tiɣ so, ka lan nyɛ ŋun ni tum n yubu zaa.
en: After God took Saul away, God made David their king. This is what God said about David: David, the son of Jesse, is the kind of person who does what pleases me. He will do everything I want him to do.

dag: Yi ni bo biŋkɔb shɛb mali sara kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm, yin bomiya binyɛra maa pahi biŋkɔbigu kam zuɣu.
en: However many you offer, you will do the same for each one.

dag: di saha ŋun ti zaŋ sara maa na ni o ti ti Yawɛ, ŋun bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini n-zaŋ kpam lita yini ŋmiri li.
en: At the time someone brings their offering, they must also give a grain offering to the Lord . The grain offering will be cups of fine flour mixed with quart of olive oil.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Biligimiya kuɣili maa bahi! Ka Maata ŋun tizɔdoo daa kpi maa yɛl o, N Duuma, ŋ-ŋɔ o pooya, dama o ni kpi maa daba anahi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then he told the people to roll the stone away. But Martha said, Lord, you know that Lazarus has been dead four days, and there will be a bad smell.

dag: N sa ni doli m ba kana nti zani baɣil o a ni sɔɣi luɣ shɛli maa ka yɛl o a yɛla, ka o yi sa yɛli shɛlikam, n ni yɛl a.
en: Ill go out and stand by my father in the field where youll be. Ill talk to my father about you, and Ill tell you whatever I find out.

dag: dinzuɣu niŋmiya bɛ ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam, amaa ka di niŋdiya bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm, dama bɛ wuhiri din tuhi, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ lee bi dol li.
en: So you must obey and follow everything they tell you to do; do not, however, imitate their actions, because they don't practice what they preach.

dag: ka o ni nyɛhi bɛ nintam zaa bahi, ka kum ku lan beni bee fabila bee kumsi, ka biɛrim gba ku lan beni yaha, dama bin kura la zaa vuuya.
en: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more. There will be no mourning, crying, or pain anymore, for the former things have passed away.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni, niŋm ti nirilim ka chɛ ka ti nuhi tuma tɔŋ. Iin, chɛ ka ti nuhi tuma tɔŋ!.
en: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa naai ŋahili ŋɔ ka yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu di gbihiriya, dama yi bi mi dindali bee di saha.
en: And Jesus concluded, Watch out, then, because you do not know the day or the hour.

dag: ka bɛ zaŋ Anabi Aizaia litaafi ti o, ka o kpabigi li bo n-nya luɣ shɛli din daa sab yɛli.
en: The book of Isaiah the prophet was given to him. He opened the book and found the place where this is written:.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri duŋtaabo ni ʒi ba chaŋ, bɛ ni zaɣisi ni bɛ ku tum din tuhi zuɣu.
en: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.

dag: O doli zaligu soli kariti saria tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nahiŋgu ni, ka tiri kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba bindirigu. Yawɛ yoori bɛn be sarika ni bahira.
en: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free.

dag: Lihim pakoya bɛn nyɛ pako maŋa la.
en: Take care of any widow who is really in need.

dag: Hal Naa Dauda kpambaliba zaa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni daa be o nudirigu min o nuzaa polo maa zaa yoli, doo maa daa pihila kuɣa labiri Dauda mini ba zaa.
en: Shimei started throwing stones at David and his officials, even though David was surrounded by his men and his bodyguards.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nya ka Anabi Ilaija mini Anabi Musa puhi zan o sani, ka bɛ min o tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: Elijah and Moses appeared and were talking with Jesus.

dag: Ka Samsin daa ti yɛli ninvuɣ so ŋun gbib o nuu vɔr o, Chɛ ka m bɔbili gbaai duu ŋɔ ni tam daantal shɛŋa zuɣu n-zaŋ mmaŋ dalim li.
en: Samson said to the young man who led him by the hand, Put me where I can feel the pillars that hold up the temple, so I can lean on them.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka a niŋ Yawɛ naani. N chɛ ka a baŋ li zuŋɔ, iin, n chɛ ka a baŋ li.
en: So that your trust will be in the LORD, Im teaching you today—yes, you.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, A yi niŋ niriba maa nirilim, ka niŋdi din tiɣiri bɛ nini, ka zaŋ zilimballi yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi ba, bɛ ni jɛmd a sahakam.
en: They answered, If you do what is good for the people, you will please them. If you speak kindly to them, they will always work for you.

dag: ka boli Lɔt m-bɔh o, Saamba bɛn kpe a yil ŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ la lee be ya? Zaŋm ba na ka ti goli ba.
en: They called out to Lot and asked, Where are the men who came to stay with you tonight? Bring them out to us! The men of Sodom wanted to have sex with them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama bɛ daa bi deei Yawɛ noli. Ka bɛ daa mali hal ti paai Tapanhɛs.
en: The people disobeyed the Lord and went to Egypt. The group had settled in Tahpanhes.

dag: Yi yi ti nya ka doo bee paɣa ŋun be yi ni tum tuumbiɛɣu ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tin shɛŋa tin ya ŋɔ tin shɛl ni m-birig o daalikauli la.
en: Suppose you hear that in one of your towns some men or women have sinned against the Lord and broken his covenant.

dag: Kɛdar peentɔriba bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiriba la ni ti kpalimla biɛla. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: there will be few Kedarite archers remaining. The LORD God of Israel has spoken.

dag: O tizo Oholiba daa nya dimbɔŋɔ, amaa ka o pagɔrisigu tumbu min o kɔre daa bie n-gar o biɛli maa dini.
en: Oholibah saw all this, but she was more sinful and wanted sex more than her sister Oholah ever did.

dag: Saimɔn Pita pun wuhi ti Naawuni ni daa tuui pii bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni bɛ leeg o niriba shɛm yɛla.
en: Simon reported how, in his kindness, God came to the Gentiles in the first place, to raise up from them a people of God.

dag: ka yɛl o, Aai! Ti ni dol a kul a niriba sani.
en: But they replied to her, No, instead we will return with you, to your people.

dag: ka baŋ ni ŋuna n-yi nyɛ gbarigu n-ʒiini Naawuni jɛmbu duu duno shɛli din yuli booni Duno Viɛlli la shee maani bara la. Ka din daa niŋ o maa niŋ ba alahiziba ka gari ba pam.
en: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man.

dag: Bɛ daai nandaamba baɣili palli kpaŋa, ka nandaamba zaa zo n-sɔɣi.
en: They prevent the poor from getting their rights and force the needy to run and hide.

dag: Ka kpamba pisinaanahi la mini binnɛma anahi la gbani n-jɛmdi Naawuni ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee la ka yɛra, Ami! Haliluya.
en: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God, who was seated on the throne. They said, Amen! Praise God.

dag: O daa zaŋla o bipalitab la ni daa yɛl o shɛm la yɛli ba. O daa yɛli ba mi, M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisili, amaa man maan yɛn pahi li la tibisim. M ba daa malila barazim fiɛbiri ya, amaa nɔnsi ka man yɛn zaŋ fiɛb ya.
en: as the younger men had advised. He said, My father placed heavy burdens on you; I will make them even heavier. He beat you with whips; I'll flog you with bullwhips.

dag: Simiɔn mini Lɛvi nyɛla nir ni o mabia. Bɛ malila bɛ bidibbina tumdi barina.
en: Simeon and Levi are brothers, weapons of violence their stock in trade.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi daa zaŋ gɔhi n-wuɣi zuɣupiligu zaŋ pili Yisa, ka zaŋ kpar ʒiɛɣu yɛl o.
en: The soldiers made a crown from thorny branches and put it on his head. Then they put a purple robe around him.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Naawuni ŋ-ŋman a, ka nyɛ ŋun chɛr o niriba bɛn kpalim taali, ka bi lan doli bɛ biriginsim tuma? A suhu yi yiɣisi, di lan maara; dama a yuri nambɔzɔbo.
en: Our God, no one is like you. We are all that is left of your chosen people, and you freely forgive our sin and guilt. You don't stay angry forever; you're glad to have pity.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Malimiya yimaŋa, dama biɛɣuni Yawɛ sa ni tum alahiziba tuma yi sani.
en: Joshua said to the people, Make yourselves holy! Tomorrow the LORD will do wonderful things among you.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinima, yi Naawuni sɔŋsim zuɣu, labimiya o sani. Gbibiya yurilim mini yɛlimaŋli, ka kul guhimiya yi Naawuni maa sahakam.
en: So return to your God. Patiently trust him, and show love and justice.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa maa di na kul bela n suhu ni, ka Ribɛka paana, ka o koyuli tam o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu, ka o gari siɣi kɔbiliga maa ni ti ŋɔŋ kom na. Ka n yɛl o, N suhir a, tim ma kom ka n nyu.
en: Before I finished saying this to myself, Rebekah came out with her water jar on her shoulder and went down to the spring to draw water. And I said to her, Please give me something to drink.

dag: ka sab bɛ puhigu gbaŋ ti ba. Bɛ ni daa sab yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Yisa tuumba mini cheechi kpamba puhiri yinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ mabihi bɛn pa Yɛhudianima m-be Antiɔk mini Siria ni Kilikia zaa ha.
en: They were to carry this letter: The apostles and the elders, to the Gentile brothers and sisters in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia. Greetings!.

dag: Yi ni chani bɔri mamanim maa, yi niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga! Lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi wuhi paɣ yoya yi soya.
en: You certainly know how to chase after lovers. Even the worst of women can learn from you.

dag: Di kpalim biɛla ka yuŋ gari, ka di ku yuui ka biɛɣu neei. Chɛliya ka ti chɛ zibisim tuma, ka zaŋ bidibbina n-tuhi tɔbu neesim ni.
en: The night is almost finished. The day is almost here. So we should stop doing whatever belongs to darkness. We should prepare ourselves to fight evil with the weapons that belong to the light.

dag: Dama m mini Silvanus ni Timoti ni daa yihi Naawuni Bia ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia yɛla waazu shɛli yi sani la daa pala Iin mini Aai yɛla, amaa o ni, di kul nyɛla Iin.
en: Gods Son, Jesus Christ, is the one who was preached among you by us—through me, Silvanus, and Timothy—he wasnt yes and no. In him it is always yes.

dag: ka Ram dɔɣi Aminadab.
en: Hezron the father of Ram, Ram the father of Amminadab.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba ata maa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina nti paala salo pam.
en: The next day Jesus and his three disciples came down from the mountain and were met by a large crowd.

dag: ni Hazɔr ni Rama ni Giteem.
en: in Hazor, Ramah, and Gittaim.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn piri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya ka yi su li yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini Nan bia Jɔshua.
en: These are the names of the men who will assign the inheritance of the land: Eleazar the priest and Joshua, Nuns son.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana soli zuɣu kul zibigila gɔhi, amaa ŋun tumdi din tuhi soli nyɛla solɔɣu.
en: The path of the lazy is like a hedge of thorns, but the way of those who do right is a clear road.

dag: Dama Yawɛ kul mi wuntizɔriba soli ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ni bahi yoli.
en: The LORD is intimately acquainted with the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked is destroyed.

dag: N ni baŋ ya saha shɛli zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, yi nyɛla bɛn kul zaɣisiri Yawɛ.
en: Ever since I have known you, you have rebelled against the Lord .

dag: Yinim zoomba ŋɔ, bina ayi maa ni dini n-lee gari di kpee: Sara maa bee bimbini din chɛ ka sara maa be kasi maa?.
en: You are blind! Cant you see that the altar is greater than any gift on it? Its the altar that makes the gift holy!.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Zuf, ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumda so ŋun daa be o sani maa, Kamina ka ti lab kuli, di yi pa lala m ba ni chɛ bunsi ŋɔ yɛla tɛhibu ka kpalim tɛhirila ti yɛla.
en: When they came to the territory of Zuph, Saul said to the boy who was with him, Lets go back before my father stops worrying about the donkeys and starts worrying about us.

dag: Dama di yi niŋ daba ayi n ni doli soli chaŋ ka ku lan labina.
en: In only a few years I will go to that place of no return.

dag: Ɛhud ni daa zaŋ bɛ farigu binyara maa yo n-naai, o daa chɛmi ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi li tahi na kuli.
en: When he had finished delivering the tribute payment, Ehud sent on their way the people who had carried it.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna na yomyom ti yɛli ba, N tum taali Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa sani ni yi gba sani.
en: Pharaoh quickly called for Moses and Aaron. Pharaoh said, I have sinned against the Lord your God and against you.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka so birigi ya;.
en: Jesus answered: Don't let anyone fool you.

dag: O daa bi tum alahichi, ka yɛmbimbiɛri yɛtɔɣa mi daa ka o nol ni.
en: He committed no sin, nor did he ever speak in ways meant to deceive.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋaha ŋɔ yɛli, So na ʒi n-tooi binyɛr palli tani n-liɣi binyɛr kurili; dama o yi niŋ lala o cheei binyɛr palli maa, ka tam palli din liɣi binyɛr kurili maa mi ku ŋman li.
en: Then he told them a parable. No one tears a patch from a new garment to patch an old garment. Otherwise, the new garment would be ruined, and the new patch wouldnt match the old garment.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Alɔbo zaɣ yini n-kpalim ka n yɛn chɛ ka di lu Firawuna mini Ijiptinim zuɣu, di nyaaŋa o ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ, o ni kari ya o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: Then the Lord told Moses, I have one more disaster to bring against Pharaoh and Egypt. After this, he will ask you to leave Egypt. In fact, he will force you to leave this country.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba ka yi tinzun tinsi balibu kam ni na la daa laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: There were Jews living in Jerusalem, religious people who had come from every country in the world.

dag: Ka zuliya pam ti tim ya ŋɔ tiŋ puuni garita ka bɔhiri taba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka Yawɛ ti darigi tin titali ŋɔ nim tibili lala? .
en: People from many nations will pass by this city. They will ask one another, Why has the Lord done such a terrible thing to Jerusalem? Jerusalem was such a great city.

dag: Dinzuɣu n nyaya ka ninsalitali biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm zuɣu chɛ ka n yi kul bɔri ni n tum din tuhi, zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu n-nyɛ din miriti ma.
en: So I find that this law is at work: when I want to do what is good, what is evil is the only choice I have.

dag: Ka o daa yi bɛ sani chaŋ o chandi.
en: So Paul left the council meeting.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni ka Jɛziriil mini Chɛsulɔt ni Shunɛm.
en: Their border ran toward Jezreel. They also owned Chesulloth, Shunem.

dag: Chɛ ka ti yɛli ni yi mabia ŋun nyɛ doo bee paɣa beni n-nyɛla ŋun chani gbinfini ka ka bindirigu din ni di.
en: Suppose there are brothers or sisters who need clothes and don't have enough to eat.

dag: N ni ti ba nyɛvil wɔɣinli; ka wuhi ba n tiliginsim.
en: I will reward them with long life; I will save them.

dag: Izraɛlnim karimbaani yi zahira, ka bɛ nini nya li. Izraɛlnim ni ti tuui lu bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ni. Ka Judanim gba ni ti tuui lu m-pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: The arrogance of the people of Israel cries out against them. Their sins make them stumble and fall, and the people of Judah fall with them.

dag: Amaa yinim yiɣisimi lu n niriba zuɣu kaman yi dimnim la. Yi darigi fuɣi suhudoolan binyɛrigu, ka darigi fuɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn garita ka bi lan tɛhiri tɔbu tuhibu yɛla binyɛra.
en: The Lord replies, You attack my people like enemies. Men return from battle, thinking they are safe at home, but there you are, waiting to steal the coats off their backs.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa lan kpuɣi daanya pam Bɛta mini Bɛrɔtai din daa nyɛ Hadadɛza ni su fɔntin shɛŋa la ni.
en: He also took a lot of bronze from the cities of Betah and Berothai, which had belonged to Hadadezer.

dag: Di saha maa Naa Dauda daa niŋ yuun bɔbili ka kurigi pam; ka bɛ daa kul mali chinchin tibisa m-pind o, amaa di zaa yoli, di daa bi kur o wari.
en: King David was now a very old man, and although his servants covered him with blankets, he could not keep warm.

dag: Ka o daa kpabigi li n tooni, di daa sabila di tooni mini di nyaaŋa zaa. Ka sabbu din daa be di ni daa nyɛla fabila mini kuyila ni mbusim.
en: The hand unrolled the scroll, and I saw that there was writing on both sides—cries of grief were written there, and wails and groans.

dag: Dabisili din pah ayi dali zaŋmiya naɣilabihi pinaayi mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the second day of this festival, you must offer bulls, rams, and lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: Di saha ka Asiria naa maa daa chaŋ ti liri Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa m-mali ti paai Samaria n-daa teei gil li hal ka di ti paai yuma ata.
en: Then Shalmaneser invaded Israel and besieged Samaria. In the third year of the siege.

dag: Ka nir yi zaŋ kpaa din be o nuu ni ka nyɛ din ni ku nir ŋme so ka o kpi, o nyɛla ninvuɣ kura; bɛn kum o.
en: Or if someone strikes with a wood object in hand that could cause death, he is a murderer. The murderer must definitely be put to death.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan mabia n-nyɛ bukaata saɣinda.
en: Someone who does careless work is as bad as someone who destroys things.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ nyɔtaɣirisi mini kpana n-niŋ tinsi maa zaa ni n-chɛ ka di niŋ yaa pam. O ni daa su Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliyanim shɛm m-bala.
en: as well as with shields and spears. He used these fortified cities to keep control of Judah and Benjamin.

dag: Ka n ni zaŋ kuɣili ŋɔ sa luɣ shɛli ŋɔ ni leei nyin Naawuni yiŋa, ka a yi ti ma binshɛlikam zaa, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni yihi di bini pia kam ni zaɣ yini ti a.
en: This stone that Ive set up as a sacred pillar will be Gods house, and of everything you give me I will give a tenth back to you.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya filiŋ pam Midiannim maa zuɣu, ka daa naɣ ti kummi niŋ Yawɛ ni o sɔŋ ba.
en: The Midianites took almost everything that belonged to the Israelites, and the Israelites begged the Lord for help.

dag: M mabia Failimɔn, n yi ti suhiri Naawuni tir a, n kul paɣir o mi sahakam.
en: I remember you in my prayers. And I always thank my God for you.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, A daa ŋmanila paɣiŋoo, amaa pumpɔŋɔ, yilimi yila pampam ni suhupiɛlli. Nyini ŋun na ʒi n-wolisi ŋɔ! Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ, a ni mali bihi gari paɣ so ŋun mali yidana.
en: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.

dag: Di dunoli yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita anu, ka goma din barilim nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili daa be di luɣa zuɣu. Ka o daa buɣisi du titali maa puuni wɔɣilim, ka di nyɛ mita pisi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pia.
en: five meters long, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was two and a half meters. The main room itself was meters by meters.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Anabi Aizaia ni daa pun yɛli yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ yɛla shɛm la shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli kaman di ni daa sab shɛm ni Naawuni yɛliya: Niriba ŋɔ tiri ma la jilima bɛ nyina zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee be katiŋ ni mani.
en: Jesus answered, You are all hypocrites. Isaiah was right when he wrote these words from God about you: These people honor me with their words, but I am not really important to them.

dag: ka daa lab kuli ti bo tulaale mini kpaʒiɛrim zali. Ka bɛ daa vuhi Vuhim Dabisili dali maa kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Then they left to prepare some sweet-smelling spices to put on the body. On the Sabbath day they rested, as commanded in the Law of Moses.

dag: Yuma ayi nyaaŋa ka Firawuna daa ti zahim zahindi n-nya ka o ʒiɛla Nail Mɔɣili duli.
en: Two years later the king of Egypt dreamed he was standing beside the Nile River.

dag: Judanim ni ti niŋ ayɛi, niriba maa ni daa bi tooi sɔŋ ba la zuɣu. Bɛ ni chɛ ka Judanim maa di vi.
en: the people of Judah will regret that they ever trusted that unreliable nation, a nation that fails them when they expect help.

dag: Chɛ ka Speen mini teeku ni tiŋgban bihi nanim kana ti jɛm o, ka chɛ ka Shiiba nanima mini Siiba nanim ʒi pina na ti ti o.
en: Let the kings of Tarshish and the islands bring tribute; let the kings of Sheba and Seba present gifts.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka so lan paana ti yɛli, Kalidianim laɣimla tab ʒiibuta zuɣu n-kana ti lu laakumnim la zuɣu n-zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛn guli ba maa, ka taɣi ba chaŋ, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun zo n-tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: Before he had finished speaking, another servant came and said, Three bands of Chaldean raiders attacked us, took away the camels, and killed all your servants except me. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.

dag: Dama n daa doli Yawɛ zaligunima, ka daa bi tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma ŋ-ŋmaligi ka chɛ ŋuna ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni maa.
en: The Lord did this because I have obeyed him. I have not turned against my God.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ yɛda n-nyɛ Ibrahimma yaansi.
en: So you should know that the true children of Abraham are those who have faith.

dag: Amaa bɛ zuɣu n ni teei n ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛl la yɛla, n ni daa yihi shɛb Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na zuliya pam ninni nti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni la. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: But for their sake I will remember the covenant with the first generation, the ones I brought out of Egypts land in the sight of all the nations, in order to be their God; I am the LORD.

dag: N ŋmanila sana n dɔɣiriba sani; ka ŋmani tinzun nira m ma puuni bihi sani.
en: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.

dag: Daniɛl ni daa baŋ ni naa dih o nuu zaligu gbɔŋ maa zuɣu maa, ka o daa kul o yiŋa. O yiŋ zuɣusaa duu takɔro daa yoori bahila Jɛrusalɛm polo. Ka o daa gbaani suhir o Naawuni, ka paɣir o siɣimsiɣim buta dahin yini puuni kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm.
en: When Daniel learned that the document had been signed, he went to his house. Now his upper room had open windows that faced Jerusalem. Daniel knelt down, prayed, and praised his God three times that day, just like he always did.

dag: ka yɛli di tiŋgbɔŋ maa, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N je a yɛlli, n ni ŋooi n takɔbi di tɔɣu ni n-ku wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa bɛn be a ni.
en: that I am about to punish them. I will pull out my sword and have it ready to kill everyone, whether good or evil.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord said to him.

dag: A bi nya ka di nyɛla o yɛda niŋbu min o tuma tumbu n-daa laɣim tum lala maa? Ka o yɛda niŋbu daa niŋ dɛde la o tuma tumbu puuni.
en: Can't you see? His faith and his actions worked together; his faith was made perfect through his actions.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti nyɛla Masia tuumba bɛn ʒe o zaani, ka Naawuni be ti ni n-kul booni niriba. Lala zuɣu ka ti kul ʒe Masia zaani n-suhiri ya yɛra, Zaŋmiya yimaŋa n-naai Naawuni.
en: Here we are, then, speaking for Christ, as though God himself were making his appeal through us. We plead on Christ's behalf: let God change you from enemies into his friends!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm maa daa yɛl o, Pirigim a namda ŋɔ, dama a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla luɣ kasi shee. Ka Jɔshua daa niŋ lala.
en: Take off your sandals, the commander answered. This is a holy place. So Joshua took off his sandals.

dag: Amaa saha ni daa ti paai, Naawuni daa tim o Bia na n-chɛ ka paɣ dɔɣ o fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni.
en: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law.

dag: Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni!.
en: May God's grace be with you all.

dag: Zaŋmi bɛ zaa laɣim sɔɣi tiŋgban ni, ka lo ba niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Hide them together in the dust; bind their faces in a hidden place.

dag: Di saha ka Hagai ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ tumo maa daa zaŋ Yawɛ yɛligu n-yɛli niriba maa. Yawɛ daa yɛliya, N ni be yi sani.
en: Haggai then told them that the Lord had promised to be with them.

dag: Ka yi mi nini nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ zuliya shɛba shɛlikam zaa yi zuɣu la; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun daa tuhi ba tin ya.
en: You have seen everything that the Lord your God has done to all these nations because of you. The Lord your God has been fighting for you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka buchi, ka so bi mi bɛ yɛla, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛ ni daa fiɛbi ninvuɣ shɛb yihi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: They are a bunch of worthless people without names, who were forced to leave their country.

dag: Di bi tu ni bɛ zali ŋun ka taali samli bee ka bɛ fiɛbi kpambaliba bɛ biɛrisuŋ zuɣu.
en: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ n ni boli shɛb la, wummiya! Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni; Mani n-nyɛ piligu. Mani n-nyɛ naabu.
en: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord , the first and the last.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ti ma laara n wuntitali mini m biɛrisuntali zaŋ chaŋ o sani zuɣu.
en: So the Lord rewarded me for doing what is right. He could see that I am innocent.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri jiɣindi shɛli zuɣu, amaa yi suhigu zaa puuni, yɛlimiya Naawuni yi ni bɔri shɛli, ka kul balimmiya Naawuni ni wumpaɣibo din yiri yi suhuri ni na.
en: Dont be anxious about anything; rather, bring up all of your requests to God in your prayers and petitions, along with giving thanks.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, A ni saɣi tahi ma ŋmɛnditoya maa sani? Ka o garigi yɛli Dauda, Pom Naawuni ni a ku ku ma bee n-zaŋ ma niŋ n dan maa nuu ni pɔi, ka n naanyi zaŋ a tahi bɛ sani.
en: Can you guide me to this raiding party? David asked him. Make a pledge to me by God that you wont kill me or hand me over to my master, the boy said, and I will guide you to the raiding party.

dag: Bɛn zɔr o, bɛna ka o mi zɔri nambɔɣu ʒiɛmani zaŋ ti kpa ʒiɛmani.
en: He always shows mercy to everyone who worships him.

dag: ka ŋun chaŋ ti bela kpiimba biɛhigu shee nyari azaaba, ka daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya ti yab Ibrahimma katiŋ ha, ka Lazarɔs be o sani.
en: He went to hell and was suffering terribly. When he looked up and saw Abraham far off and Lazarus at his side.

dag: Ka o suhu daa gbaai Daina Yaakubu bipuɣiŋga maa pam, ka o daa tɔɣis o yurilim mini suhumahili yɛtɔɣa.
en: He was drawn to Dinah, Jacobs daughter. He loved the young woman and tried to win her heart.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Yawɛ zaka ni nyɛ shɛli maa ti maligumaana Ɛliɛza kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Moses gave the tribute, a gift offering for the LORD, to Eleazar the priest as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaisha daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Neem o nina ka o nya. Ka Yawɛ daa neei nachimbil maa nina ka o lihi nya ka yuri mini buɣim chɛchɛbunsi n-kul pali zoli zuɣu n-teei gili Ilaisha.
en: Then Elisha prayed and said, Lord , I ask you, open my servants eyes so that he can see. The Lord opened the eyes of the young man, and the servant saw the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire. They were all around Elisha.

dag: Yawɛ, a kul yɛn lihiri yɛlli maa la hal ni bɔ saha? Fam ma ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma maa nuu ni bahi. Fam n nyɛvili gbuɣima maa nuu ni bahi!.
en: How long, my Lord, will you watch this happen? Rescue me from their attacks; rescue my precious life from these predatory lions!.

dag: suhimiya Naawuni sahakam.
en: Pray continually.

dag: Wummiya, yinim Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim dɔɣirikpamba mini bɛ nanim bɛn zaɣisi zaligu, ka tiri nimmira yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ.
en: So listen to my message, you rulers of Israel! You hate justice and twist the truth.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa pii Kɛdɛshi din be Galili Naftali zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoli zuɣu la mini Shɛkɛm din daa be Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoli zuɣu la ni Kiriatariba din be Juda zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoli zuɣu la.
en: So, on the west side of the Jordan they set aside Kedesh in Galilee, in the hill country of Naphtali; Shechem, in the hill country of Ephraim; and Hebron, in the hill country of Judah.

dag: O daa yɛliya, N ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbani tin ya ka di leei yi tarili.
en: when he said, I'll give you the land of Canaan.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a, nyin ninsala, ni a ŋme Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni? Duɣu ni tooi bɔhi yaɣimɛra, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a me ma lala.
en: You are only a human being. Who do you think you are to talk back to God? Does the clay say to the potter, Why did you make me like this? .

dag: O daa yihi ma na ti zali pal tital ni. O daa fa ma bahi, o nini ni daa tiɣ ma la zuɣu.
en: He brought me out to wide-open spaces; he pulled me out safe because he is pleased with me.

dag: Bɛ daa paaya nti nya ka kuɣili din daa yo siliga maa nol la biligimi ka chɛ di noli maa.
en: They saw that the heavy stone that covered the entrance had been rolled away.

dag: Bɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba zaa ni ti kpi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka so ti ku sɔɣi ba, ka so mi ti ku fabili bɛ zuɣu. So ti ku zaŋ bini ŋmaag omaŋ bee m-pini o zuɣu bɛ zuɣu.
en: From the least to the greatest, all will die in this land, and there will be no funerals or time of mourning. No one will gash themselves in grief or shave their heads in sorrow.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka yi mi lee yɛli ni n nyɛla ŋuni? Ka Pita garigi yɛl o, A nyɛla Masia.
en: What about you? he asked them. Who do you say I am? Peter answered, You are the Messiah.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ti yi mabihi maa vuhim kaman o ni daa pun lo ba alikauli shɛm la, dinzuɣu labimiya kuli yi biɛhigu shee din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli polo, ka nyɛ Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa pun zaŋ luɣ shɛli tin ya la.
en: The Lord promised to give peace to your relatives, and that's what he has done. Now it's time for you to go back to your own homes in the land that Moses gave you east of the Jordan River.

dag: N tɔɣisiri ya mi kaman bɛn mali fahim; yimaŋmaŋ buɣisimiya n ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: You are intelligent people. Judge for yourselves the truth of what I say now.

dag: Mɛshɛlɛmia bia Zakaria la n-daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔgula.
en: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also a guard at the entrance to the Tent of the Lord 's presence.

dag: Ŋuna n-fari ninkura yɛm ka mali ba chana; ka chɛ ka sariakaritiba leeri jɛra.
en: He leads advisors away barefoot; makes madmen of judges.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yɛri taba, Yɛlimaŋli, ti ni daa niŋ ti mabia la shɛm la samli n-yɔri ti ŋɔ, o ni daa balim ti ka ti daa nya o suhusaɣiŋgu ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa ka zaɣisi wumbu la; dinzuɣu ka suhusaɣiŋgu ŋɔ ti paai ti gba maa.
en: The brothers said to each other, We are clearly guilty for what we did to our brother when we saw his life in danger and when he begged us for mercy, but we didnt listen. Thats why were in this danger now.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa ti tim boli tindaannim mini laasabuniŋdiba na ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ Izraɛlnim Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ? Ka ti yi yɛn zaŋ li labisi di biɛhigu shee, bɔ ka ti lee yɛn zaŋ pahi di zuɣu labisi.
en: the Philistines called in their priests and fortunetellers, and asked, What should we do with this sacred chest? Tell us how to send it back where it belongs.

dag: Amaa yi zaa yi tɔɣisirila anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka ŋun bi niŋ yɛda bee ŋun ka yi kalinli ni kpɛna, yi zaa ni yɛri shɛm maa ni chih o suhu, ka yi zaa ni yɛri shɛm maa ni lan vih o.
en: But if everyone is proclaiming God's message when some unbelievers or ordinary people come in, they will be convinced of their sin by what they hear. They will be judged by all they hear.

dag: Amaa dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Neetan.
en: But that night the word of God came to Nathan.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pahi pinaayi n-su chir pinaayi ni mi n-daa nyɛ Hɛlidai ŋun daa yi Nɛtɔfa na ka nyɛ Otiniɛl daŋ ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: in the twelfth month, Heldai from Netophah, who was a descendant of Othniel.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Nyamiya, n tim ya mi kaman piɛri ni be kunduna sunsuuni shɛm la; dinzuɣu maliya yɛm kaman tinvura, ka benya baalim kaman ŋmana la.
en: I am sending you like lambs into a pack of wolves. So be as wise as snakes and as innocent as doves.
