dag: Ka doo maa daa yɛl o, Biɛɣu neera, chɛ ka n chaŋ. Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N ku chɛ ka a chaŋ, faashee ka a niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: They kept on wrestling until the man said, Let go of me! It's almost daylight. You can't go until you bless me, Jacob replied.

dag: Naawuni ŋun zaŋ o Shia Kasi tin ya ka tumd alahiziba tuma yi san la, Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu bee lahibal suŋ yɛla wumbu mini yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o niŋdi lala maa?.
en: Does God give you the Spirit and work miracles among you because you do what the Law requires or because you hear the gospel and believe it?.

dag: Ka Musa daa wum o deemba yɛligu maa, ka niŋ o ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa zaa.
en: Moses listened to his father-in-laws suggestions and did everything that he had said.

dag: ka yi Sintani ŋun gbahi ba n-chɛ ka bɛ dol o nol la zana ni.
en: The devil has trapped them and now makes them do what he wants. But maybe they can wake up to see what is happening and free themselves from the devils trap.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa lo tɔb na ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima. Bɛ daa malila chɛchɛbunsi tuhi pihita, ka mali wɔribariba tusaayɔbu, ka bɛ tɔbbihi daa kul tɛli ʒiizaa kaman mɔɣibihigu la. Ka bɛ daa kana nti ti bɛ suɣa dɔni Mikimash Bɛtavɛn wulimpuhili polo.
en: The Philistines called their army together to fight Israel. They had , chariots, , cavalry, and as many foot soldiers as there are grains of sand on the beach. They went to Michmash and set up camp there east of Beth-Aven.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbibiya n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa zaa, ka tummiya di tuma, dina n-ni chɛ ka n ni zaŋdi ya kuni tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa ti ku gbuɣi ya bahi.
en: You must remember all my laws and rules. And you must obey them. I am leading you to your land. You will live in that country. If you obey my laws and rules, that land will not vomit you out.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Neetan, N tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Ka Neetan garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ chɛ a taali maa, a ku lan kpi.
en: I have sinned against the Lord , David said. Nathan replied, The Lord forgives you; you will not die.

dag: Kum yuma maa daa ti yɛn kana, ka Yisifu pun zaŋ Asɛnat ŋun daa nyɛ Pɔtifɛra ŋun nyɛ Hɛliopolis tindan bipuɣiŋga la dɔɣila bidibis ayi.
en: Before the years of famine arrived, Asenath the daughter of Potiphera, priest of Heliopolis, gave birth to two sons for Joseph.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka puu maa lan yɛl o nachin kpɛma, Cham ti boli tumtumdiba maa na ti yo ba. Daŋmi bɛn yoli kana la yɔbu pɔi, ka naanyi yo bɛn di daŋna la.
en: That evening the owner of the vineyard told the man in charge of the workers to call them in and give them their money. He also told the man to begin with the ones who were hired last.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa chaŋ Sool sani, ka Sool ti yɛl o, Yawɛ niŋmi alibarika niŋ a ni, n niŋ Yawɛ ni zali ma ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa la.
en: When Samuel came near to Saul, Saul greeted him and said, The Lord bless you! I have obeyed the Lord s commands.

dag: dama m bipolitali saha ka n daa wums o kaman o ba la, ka kul sɔŋdi pakoli sahakam.
en: for from my youth I raised the orphan as a father, and from my mothers womb I led the widow.

dag: Di nyaaŋa, ka a chɛ ka bɛ bo naɣilabila mini sara maligu zim viɛlli shɛli bɛ ni niŋ kpam ŋmiri, ka a mi bo naɣilabil so bɛ ni zaŋdi maani alahichi sanyoo sara la.
en: They must take a young bull and the grain offering that must be offered with it. This grain offering will be flour mixed with oil. Then take another young bull for a sin offering.

dag: Ka Amasa daa yi n-chaŋ ni o ti boli Judanim maa na, amaa ka o daa yuui hal ka bɛ ni daa zal o dabisi shɛli maa ti gari.
en: So Amasa went to call Judah together, but he took longer than the allotted time.

dag: Ka Gɛra biŋkɔbiguliba daa kana ti niŋ Yisahaku biŋkɔbiguliba maa naŋgbankpeeni yɛli, Ti kom m-bala. Dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli Ɛsɛk, bɛ ni daa niŋ o naŋgbankpeeni maa zuɣu.
en: But the men who herded sheep in the Valley of Gerar argued with Isaacs servants. They said, This water is ours. So Isaac named that well Esek. He gave it that name because it was the place where they had argued with him.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka yi ni ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni; mani n-nyɛ ŋun tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here.

dag: Jokitan bihi n-daa nyɛ: Alimɔdad mini Shɛlɛf ni Hazarimavɛt ni Jɛra.
en: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah.

dag: A chɛ ka tiŋgbani sɔhigi, ka chɛ ka di tahi bɔɣi; liɣimi di tahibu maa, dama di kul sɔhirimi.
en: You have made the land tremble, and you have cut it open; now heal its wounds, because it is falling apart.

dag: Ka alizin biɛɣu ʒi o zuɣu kul yiɣisir o, ka o yi bembe o ti kuhirimi; ka alizin biɛɣu maa darigir o hal ka nintɔfuɣifuɣi ŋariti o noli, ka o kul nahind o ka bi bɔr o bahibu.
en: A demon often attacks him and makes him scream. It shakes him until he foams at the mouth, and it won't leave him until it has completely worn the boy out.

dag: Bɛn pa Yɛhudianim la ni daa wum lala maa ka di paligi bɛ suhuri pam ka bɛ paɣi ti Duuma yɛligu maa; ka Naawuni ni daa zali shɛb ni bɛ nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu la niŋ yɛda.
en: When the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and praised the Lord's message; and those who had been chosen for eternal life became believers.

dag: Ka Yawɛ nuu daa pa n zuɣu nimaani ka o yɛli ma, Yiɣisim zani n-chaŋ vinvamli ni ka n ti tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: I felt the powerful presence of the Lord and heard him say to me, Get up and go out into the valley. I will talk to you there.

dag: Ka Pool daa bɔri ni o zaŋ o pah omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ; dinzuɣu ka o daa guni Timoti, Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be tinsi maa ni la zuɣu, dama bɛ zaa daa mi ni Timoti ba nyɛla Giriiki doo.
en: Paul wanted to take Timothy with him, so he circumcised him. This was because of the Jews who lived in those areas, for they all knew Timothys father was Greek.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa. O daa deei zoya zuɣu tinsi mini Nɛgɛb polo tinsi zaa ni Goshɛn tiŋgbani zaa ni tintan ni tinsi ni Araba ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zoya zuɣu tinsi la.
en: So Joshua took this whole land: the highlands, the whole arid southern plain, the whole land of Goshen, the lowlands, the desert plain, and both the highlands and the lowlands of Israel.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa nya ka o tam kom zuɣu chani maa, ka bɛ tɛhi ni alizini m-bala ka kuhi pam.
en: When the disciples saw Jesus walking on the water, they thought he was a ghost, and they started screaming.

dag: Kulla niriba biɛla n-daa yi Asha zuliya mini Manaasa zuliya ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni n-siɣisi bɛmaŋa n-ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Still, there were some from the tribes of Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun who were willing to come to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka n suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka n kahi Tɔbaya nɛma m-bahi samban ni.
en: I was very angry about what Eliashib had done, so I threw all of Tobiahs things out of the room.

dag: N suhir a yɛra, Di chɛ ka n dimnim di suhupiɛlli dari niŋ ma, a mi di chɛ ka bɛ di dari niŋ ma n napɔŋ sarigibu zuɣu.
en: Thats why I prayed, Dont let my enemies smile at my pain. Full of pride, they will laugh if I stumble and fall.

dag: N daa nyɛla nachimbila, ka pumpɔŋɔ n kurigiya, amaa n na ʒi n-nya ka Yawɛ chɛ wuntizɔriba bahi bee n-nya ka bɛ bihi chani maani bara bɔri bindirigu.
en: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.

dag: Ka n daa ti yiɣis asiba ni o mɔɣi, ka nya ka o kpimi. Amaa ka n daa lih o viɛnyɛliŋga asiba maa n-nya ka o pala m bi so n ni daa dɔɣi maa.
en: In the morning I woke up and was about to feed the baby when I saw he was dead. When I looked at him more closely, I saw that he was not my baby.

dag: Ka Gɛra biŋkɔbiguliba daa kana ti niŋ Yisahaku biŋkɔbiguliba maa naŋgbankpeeni yɛli, Ti kom m-bala. Dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli Ɛsɛk, bɛ ni daa niŋ o naŋgbankpeeni maa zuɣu.
en: The shepherds of Gerar quarreled with Isaac's shepherds and said, This water belongs to us. So Isaac named the well Quarrel.

dag: Ka zuliya gari la zaa mini Uzi tiŋgbɔŋ ni nanim zaa ni Filistia nanim zaa bɛn be Ashikɛlɔn mini Gaza ni Ɛkurɔn ni Ashidɔd bɛn kpalim la.
en: including the foreigners living there; all the kings of the land of Uz; all the kings of the land of the Philistines—Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and whats left of Ashdod.

dag: Kumsi saha beni, ka lari saha beni. Fabila saha beni, ka waa wabu saha beni.
en: for crying and laughing, weeping and dancing.

dag: Teemiya Vuhim Dabisili yɛla, ka chɛ ka di nyɛ dabisili kasi.
en: You must remember to keep the Sabbath a special day.

dag: ka Naomi yɛli ba, Labimiya kuli yi manim sani. Yawɛ ŋɔ niŋmi ya nirilim kaman yi ni niŋ m mini yi yidaannim bɛn kpi la nirilim shɛm la.
en: Naomi said to them, Don't you want to go back home to your own mothers? You were kind to my husband and sons, and you've always been kind to me. I pray that the Lord will be just as kind to you.

dag: Ka zoya ni saa buri ba, ka bɛ ka bɛ ni yɛn kpe shɛli yi saa bubu ni, ka baɣila tampima.
en: wet from mountain rains, with no refuge, huddled against a rock.

dag: Ka a chɛ ka bɛ laɣim yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa din kanna ŋɔ ni bindira din yɛn niŋ pam maa zaa zali, ka di nyɛ a ni zaŋ bindir shɛli niŋ fukumsi fɔntinsi ni ka bɛ gbib li.
en: In this way these men will collect all the food during the seven good years and store it in the cities until it is needed. Pharaoh, this food will be under your control.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o suhupiɛlli min o churi puhibu ni o goli paliga churi puhibu ni o vuhim dabisa ni o ni zali chu shɛŋa zaa la zani tariga.
en: I will end all her religious celebrations, her festivals, her new moons, her Sabbath days, and all her sacred seasons.

dag: Man mɛla du shɛli din mali jilima ti a ni di nyɛ a ni yɛn be luɣ shɛli sahakam.
en: but I have indeed built you a lofty temple as a place where you can live forever.

dag: ka yi ti zaŋ bɛ ʒim paɣi yi naba, ka yi bahi mi lɛli yi dimnim maa ʒim.
en: So you will march through pools of their blood, and there will be plenty left for your dogs.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti ku zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa lo nia ni bɛ liri Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: On that day I intend to destroy all the nations who come against Jerusalem.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mali Naawuni Shia Kasi vihiri binshɛɣukam zaa baŋdi di gbinni, amaa ka so ku tooi vihi baŋ ŋun yɛla gbinni.
en: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.

dag: dama Jɔn daa yɛlila Naa Hɛrɔd ni di chihiri ni o fa o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Thats because John told Herod, Its against the law for you to marry her.

dag: Maliya yaa ni suhukpeeni. Di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhiri Asiria naa min o tɔbbihi bɛn be o sani ŋɔ zuɣu. Dama ŋun be ti sani yiko gari ŋun be o sani yiko.
en: Be determined and confident, and don't be afraid of the Assyrian emperor or of the army he is leading. We have more power on our side than he has on his.

dag: ni zoli kam zuɣu mɔɣu ni la yɛla. N ni chɛ ka bɛ ŋme n-di yi buni mini yi daazichi yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ zaa ni n-yo yi daalahichi maa samli.
en: So I'll take everything you own, including your altars, and give it all to your enemies.

dag: Kumsi saha beni, ka lari saha beni. Fabila saha beni, ka waa wabu saha beni.
en: He sets the time for sorrow and the time for joy, the time for mourning and the time for dancing.

dag: N nyaɣa daa chaŋmi ti gbaai kom, ka maligim kul luri n wula zuɣu yuŋ zaa.
en: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water.

dag: Ka Lazarɔs ŋun daa kpi maa shiri yina. Ka kahiŋga pɔb o n-lo o nuhi min o naba, ka bantabiga vil o zuɣu tabil o ninni. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yihimiya kahiŋga maa, ka viligi bantabiga maa, ka chɛ ka o chaŋ.
en: The dead man came out. His hands and feet were wrapped with pieces of cloth. He had a handkerchief covering his face. Jesus said to the people, Take off the cloth and let him go.

dag: Di saha ka Balak daa bɔhi Balaam, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ma ŋɔ? N zaŋ a mi na ni a ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi n dimnim zuɣu, nyama, ka a ti bi niŋ ba shɛli, ka naɣ niŋla alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Balak said, What are you doing? I asked you to come and place a curse on my enemies. But you have blessed them instead.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Naawuni yi ti yihi ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, yin ʒimiya n kɔba mali kuli; ka daa chɛ ka bɛ po di pɔri.
en: Then Joseph asked his people to make a promise. Joseph said, Promise me that you will carry my bones with you when God leads you out of Egypt.

dag: Yinim bɛn be ʒilinsi ni ŋɔ, kpɛmiya kpe na. Ka yɛri bɛn ka yɛm mi;.
en: Whoever is naive, come in here, she says to those who lack sense.

dag: Ka ti ni mali maligumaani titali ŋun su Naawuni jɛmbu duu fukumsi la zuɣu.
en: And we have a great priest who rules the house of God.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi Yawɛ ni pun tum tuun kar shɛŋa tariga? Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi puh o ka di saɣi?.
en: No one can describe how great the Lord really is. No one can praise him enough.

dag: Bɛ jɛmdi ma la yoli, dama bɛ malila salinim zaligunim wuhiri niriba kaman Naawuni zaligunima n-nyɛ li la. .
en: It is useless for you to worship me, when you teach rules made up by humans.

dag: saha shɛli n ni daa pii zuɣulaannim ka bɛ su n niriba Izraɛlnim la. N ni nyaŋ a dimnim zaa. Din pahi nyɛla, n daa pun kahigi wuh a ni man Yawɛ ni chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi.
en: when I appointed judges over my people Israel. Ill subdue all your enemies and make you great. As for a dynasty, the LORD will build one for you!.

dag: Niŋmiya binshɛɣukam ka kparima ni ŋumbu bee naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu kani.
en: Do everything without complaining or arguing.

dag: Hal tɔbbihi yi teei gili ma, n ku zo dabiɛm; ka hal bɛ ni kul lo tɔbu na ti liri ma maa zaa yoli, n kul ni niŋ naani.
en: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.

dag: O daa lan mali binzahi pia, ka mali taha pia tamtam di zuɣu.
en: ten stands with ten basins on them.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi maa daa ti zaŋ Simiɔn chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu. Dindali maa ka Yisifu mini Mariama gba daa zaŋ Yisa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni ni bɛ ti niŋ kaman Anabi Musa zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛm la.
en: Led by the Spirit, Simeon went into the Temple. When the parents brought the child Jesus into the Temple to do for him what the Law required.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋme n-ku nira, bɛn kum o gba.
en: Anyone who hits and kills someone should be put to death.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Babilɔn leei yuɣimpina biɛhigu shee ni ko dooshee, ka zaŋ sɔɣu din ni saɣim li n-kol li bahi. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will change Babylon. It will be a place for animals, not people. It will be a swamp. I will use the broom of destruction to sweep Babylon away. The Lord All-Powerful said this.

dag: Ka a yi ti chɛ ka a niriba ŋɔ doli so shɛlikam n-lo tɔbu chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi bɛ dimnima, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tin shɛli a ni pii ŋɔ mini n ni me a jɛmbu du shɛli ŋɔ polo na ka suh a.
en: When you command your people to go into battle against their enemies and they pray to you, wherever they are, facing this city which you have chosen and this Temple which I have built for you.

dag: Ka niriba daa paɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gba daa saɣi zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima ni bɛ ni chaŋ ti be Jɛrusalɛm maa.
en: The people blessed those who agreed to live in Jerusalem.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin ka n paɣir a dahin yini, a wuntia zaligunim la zuɣu.
en: Seven times each day I thank you for your righteous judgments.

dag: O kari doli ba chani ni alaafee, ka di bi ŋman o naba shihiri tiŋa.
en: He chases armies and is never hurt. He goes places he has never been before.

dag: Bɛ bi tɔɣisiri suhudoo yɛtɔɣa; amaa bɛ nyɛla ʒiŋmariba bɛn tɔɣisiri ʒiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din bi niŋ kamaata zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be baalim be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni polo.
en: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.

dag: Ka din pah ata gbaai Zakur min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Third, there were men chosen from Zaccurs sons and relatives.

dag: nti nya zaɣ yini din mali shaara pam, ka chaŋ nti zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam kɔhi n-lab ti da li.
en: and when he finds one that is unusually fine, he goes and sells everything he has, and buys that pearl.

dag: Ka n jilima yi ti garita, n ni zaŋ a niŋ tampiŋ maa lɔŋni, ka zaŋ n nuu pɔb a hal ti gari naai.
en: I will put you in a large crack in that rock. Then I will cover you with my hand, and my Glory will pass by.

dag: ka Annas mini Kaiafas mi daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulaannima. Di saha maa ka Naawuni zilinli daa ti paai Zakaria bia Jɔn ŋun daa be mɔɣu ni la.
en: and Annas and Caiaphas were High Priests. At that time the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the desert.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ka bɛ daa taai duŋ niŋ o tiŋgban nɛl la ni, ka daa saɣim o suhu pam!.
en: How often they rebelled against him in the desert; how many times they made him sad!.

dag: Ka shihir karili daa puhi zani alizanda ni. Paɣ so n-daa ye wuntaŋa kaman chinchini la, ka goli be o naba tiŋli, ka nam zuɣupiligu din mali saŋmarisi pinaayi pil o zuɣu.
en: And then a great wonder appeared in heaven: There was a woman who was clothed with the sun, and the moon was under her feet. She had a crown of twelve stars on her head.

dag: Paɣ bi simdi ni o ye doo situra, ka doo gba bi simdi ka o ye paɣ situra, dama ŋunkam niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima, di nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: A woman must not wear mens clothes, and a man must not wear womens clothes. That is disgusting to the Lord your God.

dag: N ni mali Naawuni ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛl la tahima zuɣu ka n ʒe kpe ŋɔ saria karibu shee pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: And now I stand here to be tried because of the hope I have in the promise that God made to our ancestors—.

dag: Ka a zaŋ bantabiga vil o, ka zaŋ zuɣupil shɛli din be kasi pil o pa bantabiga maa zuɣu.
en: Set the turban on his head and place the holy crown on the turban.

dag: Biŋkɔbiri maa tab dubu saha ka n daa ti zahim zahindi nya ka bulahi bɛn duri buhi maa nyɛla zaɣ bomaboma mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn nyɛ zaɣ bɔribɔri.
en: I had a dream during the time when the animals were mating. I saw that the only male goats that were mating were the ones with stripes and spots.

dag: O daa yɛl o tumtumdiba kpɛma, M biɛli Iso yi ti tuhi ya soli bɔhi ya, Ŋuni n-lee sun ya? Ka ya polo ka yi lee chana? Ka ŋuni n-lee su biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be yi tooni ŋɔ.
en: Then he said to the servant in charge of the first herd, When Esau meets you, he will ask whose servant you are. He will want to know where you are going and who owns those animals in front of you.

dag: M bɔri ni dɔbba bɛn be luɣ shɛlikam zaa kpuɣiri bɛ nuhi din be kasi zuɣusaa n-suhiri Naawuni, ka sujee bee naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu ka di puuni.
en: I want the men everywhere to pray. Men who lift their hands in prayer must be devoted to God and pleasing to him. They must be men who keep themselves from getting angry and having arguments.

dag: Ka yi tɛhiya ni tibidarigibo bɔ n-lee simdi ninvuɣ so ŋun no n-taai Naawuni Bia, ka lihi ʒiɛm alikauli ʒi shɛli din daa mal o ka o be kasi, ka niŋdi din dihiri Naawuni daalibarika Shia la vi la?.
en: What, then, of those who despise the Son of God? who treat as a cheap thing the blood of God's covenant which purified them from sin? who insult the Spirit of grace? Just think how much worse is the punishment they will deserve!.

dag: Maligumaaniba zuɣulan kam yirila o tab sunsuuni na ni o ʒe bɛ zaani n-zaŋdi pina mini sara maani maligu niriba daalahichi zuɣu Naawuni sani.
en: Every Jewish high priest is chosen from among men. That priest is given the work of helping people with the things they must do for God. He must offer to God gifts and sacrifices for sins.

dag: Yi nini ni lan nya na so ŋun diri mali jilima su tiŋgbɔn shɛli din galisi pam.
en: When you gaze upon a king in his glamour and look at the surrounding land.

dag: Timiy o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ jilima, ka chɛ ka bɛnkam jɛmdi Yawɛ suhuri paligi.
en: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.

dag: Bɛ ŋme Ifriimnima, ka bɛ nyaɣa zaa kuui, bɛ ku lan dɔɣi bihi. Hal bɛ yi kul dɔɣi bihi gba, n ni ku bɛ biyurisi zaa.
en: The people of Israel are like a plant whose roots have dried up and which bears no fruit. They will have no children, but even if they did, I would kill the children so dear to them.

dag: Ka yi mini yi yiŋnim zaa ni tooi di li luɣ shɛlikam zaa; dama yi ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni la yɔri m-bala.
en: You and your families may eat the rest anywhere, because it is your wages for your service in the Tent.

dag: Di daa nyɛla Yaɣigari Chuɣu dazɔhigu dali kaman agbaa saha, ka o yɛli Yɛhudianim maa, N-nyɛ yi Naa maa.
en: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, Look at your king.

dag: Ka dɔr biɛɣu yi mali ninvuɣ so, dilan ŋun yɛm binchɛra, ka chɛ ka o zabiri yirimyirim, ka o pɔb o zuɣusaa naŋgbampibili ka kuhiri yɛra, Daɣiri! Daɣiri.
en: People with leprosy must warn other people. They must shout, Unclean, unclean! They must tear their clothes at the seams. They must let their hair grow wild, and they must cover their mouth.

dag: Ka ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa paɣ o nɛma, ka pin o zabiri zaa, ka su kom yi daɣiri ni. Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi labi yi biɛhigu shee maa na, amaa o ni ti bela o suɣili samban ni daba ayopɔin.
en: You shall wash your clothes, shave off all your hair, and take a bath; you will then be ritually clean. You may enter the camp, but you must live outside your tent for seven days.

dag: N daa bu n-nuɣisi ba kaman taŋkpa zim la. N daa burisi ba ka no n-taai ba kaman soli zuɣu batibati la.
en: I crushed them like dust on the ground; I stomped on them, trampled them like mud dumped in the streets.

dag: Dama tɔbbihi bɛn kana namdanim zaa mini bɛ binyɛra din ŋam ʒim zaa, bɛ ni zaŋ li nyo buɣim.
en: Every boot that marched in battle and every uniform stained with blood will be destroyed and thrown into the fire.

dag: dama niriba pam suhuri ni tɛha ni ti yi palo o zuɣu. Ka suhusaɣiŋgu ti ŋma amaŋmaŋ gba suhu kaman takɔb la.
en: so that the inner thoughts of many will be revealed. And a sword will pierce your innermost being too.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ti ni daa wum yi yɛla hal ni pɔŋɔ, ti kul suhirila Naawuni tiri ya sahakam. Ti suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka yi baŋ o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm zaa, ka pahi ya yɛm mini baŋsim zaa din nyɛ Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri ya shɛl la.
en: Because of this, since the day we heard about you, we havent stopped praying for you and asking for you to be filled with the knowledge of Gods will, with all wisdom and spiritual understanding.

dag: Tuuli binnɛɔŋ daa ŋmanila gbuɣinli, ka ŋun pah ayi ŋmani naɣilaa, ka ŋun pah ata ninni mi ŋmani ninsal ninni, ka ŋun pah anahi mi ŋmani tɔrili ŋun yiɣira.
en: The first living creature was like a lion. The second living creature was like an ox. The third living creature had a face like a human being. And the fourth living creature was like an eagle in flight.

dag: Ti yi doli Naawuni zaligunima dina n-nyɛ din wuhiri ni ti yuri ŋun Naawuni. Ka o zaligunim maa mi pala yɛlimuɣisira.
en: For our love for God means that we obey his commands. And his commands are not too hard for us.

dag: Ka n ni ti saɣim yi jɛmbu shɛhi zaa, ka wurim yi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbina, ka ti zaŋ ya zaɣ kpima pa yi buɣ kpima zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ya ni n suhu zaa.
en: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka a zaŋ naɣilaa maa ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa samban ni na nti chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Present the bull at the front of the meeting tent. Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on the bulls head.

dag: Musa ni daa sabi zaligu ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa niŋ kundi ni naai zaa.
en: Moses wrote God's Law in a book, taking care not to leave out anything.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N loya ni n chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu, ka n kpihim Judanim zaa birili.
en: So this is what the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, says: I have decided to make terrible things happen to you. I will destroy the whole family of Judah.

dag: Di dubihi mini di pilanim ni di zɔŋ mini dina la zaa daa nyɛla yim, ka takɔriti be di puuni zaa gili ni di zɔntua ni. Di ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: Its rooms, side walls, and porch also measured the same as the other gates. There were windows all around the gateway and its porch. The gateway was cubits long and cubits wide.

dag: Naa daa malila ŋariŋ shɛŋa din yi Tarishish na m-pahi Hiram ŋarima zuɣu ka di be teeku ni, ka nyɛ din zɔri pam. Ka ŋarima din daa yi Tarishish na maa daa yi ʒirila salima mini anzinfa ni wɔbinyina ni kpara ni noon shɛb bɛn ŋmani tɔrotɔronim na.
en: He had a fleet of ocean-going ships sailing with Hiram's fleet. Every three years his fleet would return, bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and monkeys.

dag: N ni yuri so yi tum ma tuumbiɛɣu, o mali soli ni o lan be n yiŋa? Pɔri pɔbu bee biŋkɔbiri sara maligu ni tooi vuui mbusim maa? O ni tooi mali suhupiɛlli?.
en: Judah is the one I love, but why is she in my temple? She has done too many evil things. Judah, do you think vows and sacrifices will keep you from being destroyed? Will I then allow you to enjoy your evil ways.

dag: Ti ni so bi be omaŋmaŋ zuɣu, ka ti ni so mi bi kpiri omaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: We do not live for ourselves only, and we do not die for ourselves only.

dag: Ka so kani ŋun mali suhukpeeni din ni tooi niŋ o ka o suhu yiɣisi. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zan o tooni?.
en: No one is brave enough to wake him up and make him angry. Well, no one can challenge me either!.

dag: ka wuh a din tuhi mini yɛlimaŋli din ni chɛ ka a garigi bɛn tim a na yɛlimaŋli garigibu?.
en: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti ku yi yuri, ka saɣim yi chɛchɛbunsi.
en: The Lord says, At that time I will take away your horses and destroy your chariots.

dag: O tiri kɔnyuri ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb kom, ka tiri kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb bindir suma.
en: because God satisfied the one who was parched with thirst, and he filled up the hungry with good things!.

dag: Di saha ka Leeban daa bɔhi Yaakubu, A ni nyɛ n dɔɣira maa zuɣu, a yɛn tumla tuma ti ma yoli? Yɛlim ma a ni bɔri ni n yo a shɛm.
en: Laban said to him, You shouldn't have to work without pay, just because you are a relative of mine. What do you want me to give you.

dag: Bɛ pirigim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒii buyopɔin. Juda zuliya niriba la kul ni be o tiŋgbani din be nudirigu polo la ni, ka Yisifu zuliya niriba mi kul be o tiŋgbani din be nuzaa polo la ni.
en: The land will be divided among them in seven parts; Judah will stay in its territory in the south, and Joseph in its territory in the north.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ daa jɛmdi Yawɛ, amaa ka lan jɛmdi bɛmaŋmaŋ buɣa kaman bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba yi tin shɛŋa na maa niriba ni daa niŋdi shɛm.
en: They respected the Lord but also served their own gods, just as they did in their own countries.

dag: Naawuni kul bela alizanda ni, ka lihiri ninsalinim dunia ŋɔ ni na ni o nya bɛ ni shɛb mali yɛm, ka nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi ŋun Naawuni.
en: God looks down from heaven on humans to see if anyone is wise, to see if anyone seeks God.

dag: Ka kahiŋkɔri maa daa shiri tahiri bindirigu mini nimdi na nti tir o asiba ni zaawuni; ka o daa nyuri kulibɔŋ maa ni kom.
en: The ravens brought bread and meat in the mornings and evenings. He drank from the Cherith Brook.

dag: Dabiɛm ni kpe ba kaman kokpɛɣu la, ka pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ti ʒe ba chaŋ yuŋ.
en: Terrible fears will come over them like a flood, like a storm in the night that blows everything away.

dag: Ɛhud ni daa yina kuli naai, ka naazɔnim daa kpe nti nya ka dufahirili zuɣusaa zɔntua maa dunoya yomi kpari, ka bɛ tɛhi ni naa maa kpɛla zɔntua maa ni du bil ni ni o ti wɔɣis omaŋa.
en: and left. When the king's officials came back and saw that the doors were locked, they said, The king is probably inside relieving himself.

dag: ka Maikil bia Sɛtur daa yi Asha zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur, Michaels son.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya kɔniŋdi bini ka di nyɛ zaɣ kpilli, ka di naŋgbanyɛra zaŋ ti tuui tab nyɛ mita pinaata ni biɛla, ka di dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita anahi ni biɛla.
en: Then he made a tank of cast metal called the Sea. It was circular in shape, fifteen feet from rim to rim, seven and a half feet high, and forty-five feet in circumference.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Yisa, ti teemi n yɛla a nam ni.
en: Then he said, Jesus, remember me when you begin ruling as king.

dag: Bɛ kul tɔŋdimi bɛ soya ni sahakam. Bɛ ku tooi baŋ a ni kariti saria shɛm. Bɛ kul maanila bɛ dimnim ansarisi.
en: They succeed in everything they do. They dont understand how you can judge them. They make fun of all their enemies.

dag: Bɛ yihi yɛli ni bɛ mi Naawuni, amaa ka bɛ tuma lee bi wuhi ni bɛ mi o. Bɛ nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim mini tipawumlinima ka ka buchi zaŋ chaŋ tuun suŋ kam tumbu polo.
en: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kumdi olivi tihi puri ni, dama n ni ka yi sanna. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: There will be wailing in all the vineyards. All this will take place because I am coming to punish you. The Lord has spoken.

dag: Ka chɛrubinim maa kpiŋkpama ti yirigi zuɣusaa, ka di mahim luri yɔrigu maa zuɣu, ka bɛ nina kpa taba. Yɔrigu maa polo ka bɛ nina ti yɛn kpa.
en: The heavenly creatures should have their wings spread out above, shielding the cover with their wings. The winged heavenly creatures should face each other toward the covers center.

dag: Bɛ daa dari chɛchɛbunsi Ijipti la anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisiyɔbu; ka dari yuri mi anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbiga ni pihinu. Ka naa kɔhigɔriba maa mi daa mali yuri maa n-tomdi kɔhiri Hitinim mini Siria nanim zaa zuɣu.
en: They would import a chariot from Egypt for six hundred pieces of silver and a horse for one hundred fifty, and then export them to all the Hittite and Aramean kings.

dag: Yi mi di ŋmariya tab ʒiri, dama yi pun yihi biɛr kurili la mini di miligu yɛla bahi.
en: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka niriba maa galisi kaman ʒii bukɔbiga zuɣu pahi, ka chɛ ka n dan naa nini nya li, ka bɔzuɣu ka nyin n dan naa lan bɔr ni a niŋ dimbɔŋɔ yaha.
en: Joab answered, I hope the Lord your God will give you times more soldiers than you already have. I hope you will live to see that day! But why do you want to do a thing like this.

dag: Nyama, niriba maa yiɣisirimi kaman gbuɣin nyaŋ la, ka bɛ ni nyamdi kaman gbuɣindaa la. O bi doona ka pa ni o ŋubila o ni gbaai binshɛɣu, ka nyu o ni ku binshɛɣu maa ʒim.
en: A people now rises like a lioness, like a lion it stands up. It doesnt lie down until it eats the prey and drinks the blood of the slain.

dag: Dinzuɣu sum kom n-niŋ tulaale niŋ a ni, ka zaŋ a situr suma so n-chaŋ o ni be luɣ shɛli yeeni o chi maa. Amaa di chɛ ka o baŋ ni a be nimaani hal ka o ti di ka nyu n-naai.
en: Go wash yourself and get dressed. Put on a nice dress, and go down to the threshing floor. But dont let Boaz see you until he has finished eating his dinner.

dag: Di yi nyɛla piɛlaa sara, yin bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram ayi n-zaŋ kpam lita yini ni pirigili ŋmir li;.
en: If you are giving a ram, you must also prepare a grain offering. This grain offering should be cups of fine flour mixed with / quarts of olive oil.

dag: Ka Rut lan yɛli Naomi, Ka din gari dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla, o yɛli ma ni n kul dol o kachɛriba yihimi kayiha maa hal ka bɛ ti chɛ n-naai.
en: Ruth the Moabite replied, Furthermore, he said to me, Stay with my workers until theyve finished all of my harvest.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa ti yɛli Yisifu, A biɛyanim zaŋ biŋkɔbiri chaŋ Shɛkɛm ni bɛ ti ŋub mɔri. Kamina ka n tim a bɛ sani. Ka o yɛli, To.
en: his father Jacob said to him, I want you to go to your brothers. They are with the sheep near Shechem. Yes, sir, Joseph answered.

dag: Chɛl barinyubo yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka di lan chɛ ka karimbaan yɛtɔɣa yi a nol ni na yaha. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ mi binshɛɣukam, ka mi daadam ni niŋdi shɛlikam.
en: Dont continue bragging. Dont speak proud words, because the Lord God knows everything. He leads and judges people.

dag: O daa wurim bɛ ni zaani luɣ shɛŋa tuhiri tɔbu ka wurim bɛ fɔntinsi. O daa yi ŋum, dabiɛm gbaarila sokam zaa bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: He attacked the palaces and destroyed the cities. Everyone in that country was too afraid to speak when hearing his growl.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi gba chamiya m puu ŋɔ ni ha ti tum tuma, ka n ti yɔn ya din niŋ kamaata.
en: He promised to pay them what was fair, if they would work in his vineyard.

dag: Amaa malimiya bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la tiri Yawɛ hal ni daba ayopɔin, dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin n-nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasi dali, Miriya ka yi tum tuma dindali.
en: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship.

dag: Ka Dauda daa je suli Yawɛ ni daa yiɣis o suhu bahi Yuza zuɣu shɛm maa zuɣu; ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Pɛrɛzuza hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: and so that place has been called Perez Uzzah ever since. David was furious because the Lord had punished Uzzah in anger.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma kpa nudirigu polo, ka dunɔdali daa be nudirigu polo maa, ka o daa buɣisi di pilanima mini di zɔntua, ka di mini dunɔda dina la zaa nyɛ yim.
en: Then the man led me to the south wall. I saw a gate in the south wall. He measured its side walls and its porch. They measured the same as the other gates.

dag: Amaa ŋun tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa mal li tɔɣisirila ninsalinima bɛ kpaŋsibu mini bɛ saɣisibu ni bɛ suhumaabo zuɣu.
en: But those who prophesy are speaking to people. They help people grow stronger in faith, and they give encouragement and comfort.

dag: n-yɛra, Miriya ka yi nahim n ninvuɣ gahinda maa; ka miriya ka yi niŋ n daanabinim zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: and telling them, Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets.

dag: Di kul nyɛla zaɣ palli asiba kam. A ʒiɛyimtali galisiya.
en: Every morning he shows it in new ways! You are so very true and loyal!.

dag: Ka Hiram ŋun daa nyɛ Taai naa la daa tim tuumba ka bɛ ʒi sida tihi dari na ti ti Dauda, ka daa lan tim kapintanim mini tammɛriba na ni bɛ ti me Naa Dauda yili ti o.
en: Tyres King Hiram sent messengers to David with cedar logs, bricklayers, and carpenters to build David a palace.

dag: Tinzunnim deei bɛ yaa zaa, ka bɛ bi baŋ lala. Bɛ bi mi ni bɛ kum saha bi lan waɣa.
en: Strangers destroy Ephraims strength, but Ephraim does not know it. Gray hairs are also sprinkled on Ephraim, but Ephraim does not know it.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi lir o ka tiligi? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi niŋ lala dunia zaa ni?.
en: Who opposes me that I must repay? Everything under heaven is mine.

dag: Zuɣu ni kpahibu ka a mali darigiri ninsalinim tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu, ka saɣindi bɛ ni yuri binshɛŋa zaa kaman binneembihi n-nyɛ li la. Yɛlimaŋli, ninsal biɛhigu shiri ŋmanila vuhim.
en: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.

dag: O daa wurim bɛ ni zaani luɣ shɛŋa tuhiri tɔbu ka wurim bɛ fɔntinsi. O daa yi ŋum, dabiɛm gbaarila sokam zaa bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: He wrecked forts, he ruined towns. The people of the land were terrified every time he roared.

dag: Ka a niriba maa yi ti chaŋ tɔbu ni bɛ ti tuhi bɛ dimnima, ka a chɛ ka bɛ be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka zaŋ bɛ nina kpa a ni pii tiŋ shɛli ka m me a duu zali ti a yuli jilima ŋɔ polo na n-suh a.
en: Sometimes you will command your people to go and fight against their enemies. Then your people will turn toward this city that you have chosen and the Temple that I built in your honor, and they will pray to you.

dag: Ka o daa tim ŋmaai shikpam maa niŋ o nuu ni diri chana; ka daa zaŋ di shɛli nti ti o ba min o ma, ka bɛ di. Amaa ka Samsin daa bi yɛli ba ni gbuɣin kpiɔŋ ni ka o yihi shiri maa na.
en: He scooped the honey into his hands, eating it as he continued along. When he got to his father and mother, he gave some to them, and they ate it too. But he didnt tell them that he had scooped the honey from the lions skeleton.

dag: Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku wɔribara min o wɔhu. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-wurim chɛchɛbuŋa, ka ku chɛchɛbunduhira.
en: With you I will crush horse and rider. With you I will crush chariot and driver.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli, Zomiya ka chɛ ma ka n kum pam m pubiɛ niriba kum zuɣu. Di bɔriya ni yi maai n suhu.
en: Therefore, I said, Dont look at me; let me weep bitterly. Dont try to comfort me about the destruction of my dearly loved people.

dag: Naawuni yi Ziɔn din nyɛ tin suŋ la ni n-kanna ka kul nyɛlisira.
en: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.

dag: Silas mini Timoti ni daa yi Masidɔnia paai Pool sani, o nini daa kul moola waazu yihibu zuɣu, ka o yɛri Yɛhudianim ni Yisa n-shiri nyɛ Masia.
en: But after Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, he spent all his time preaching to the Jews about Jesus the Messiah.

dag: Di saha yi neesim ni neei kaman biɛkaali neesim la, ka yi nya alaafee yomyom, ka ŋun yɛn zabi yi zuɣu ni be yi tooni; ka Yawɛ jilima ni nyɛ yi gula m-be yi nyaaŋa polo.
en: Then your light will break out like the dawn, and you will be healed quickly. Your own righteousness will walk before you, and the LORDs glory will be your rear guard.

dag: Ka wula ka yi ni tooi zaŋ binshɛŋa din ka buchi ŋɔ maai n suhu? Yi lan ka yi ni yɛn garigi ma shɛm naɣila ʒiri kɔŋko.
en: How empty is your comfort to me; only deceit remains in your responses.

dag: Dama nyama, ninvuɣ biɛri guri bɛ tɔbiri n-zaŋ bɛ piɛma pa tɔbimii zuɣu n-kpuɣi tiri ni bɛ to ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu tuhi zibisim ni.
en: because the wicked have already bent their bows; theyve already strung their arrows; they are ready to secretly shoot those whose heart is right?.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri chɛ ka saa nyaɣisira.
en: The LORDs voice unleashes fiery flames.

dag: Yawɛ Yɛliya, Tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni ti kpalim dabari, amaa n ti ku saɣim di zaa.
en: The Lord has said that the whole earth will become a wasteland, but that he will not completely destroy it.

dag: Ka ŋunkam lu kuɣili maa zuɣu ni chɛrisichɛrisi, amaa kuɣili maa mi yi lu sokam zuɣu, di ni niɛm o buɣibuɣi kaman zim la. .
en: Whoever falls on this stone will be broken. And it will crush anyone it falls on.

dag: yin miriya ka yi ti gbani bɛ buɣa la tooni bee n-jɛm ba bee n-tum kaman bɛ ni tumdi shɛm, amaa ti daamiya bɛ buɣa maa zaa luhi, ka wurim bɛ ni me buɣa maa binwɔɣil shɛŋa zaa zali.
en: dont bow down to their gods, worship them, or do what they do. Instead, you should completely destroy them and smash their sacred stone pillars to bits.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ, kamiyana ka ti tɔɣisi mali ti yɛla maa. Hal yi daalahichi ni kul be kaman mulifu maa, di ni paligi kaman sakuɣa la; hal di ni kul be kaman zom maa, di ni paligi kaman piɛ piɛlli kɔbiri la.
en: The Lord says, Now, let's settle the matter. You are stained red with sin, but I will wash you as clean as snow. Although your stains are deep red, you will be as white as wool.

dag: Ka do so yi nyɛla faralana ka ku tooi yo yi ni zali da shɛli maa, dindina yin zaŋmi dilan chaŋ maligumaana sani, ka o ti zal o daa, maligumaana ni zal o daa maa ka di dolila ŋun po pɔri maa dahima ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But if financial difficulty prevents the promise maker from giving the full value, they must set the person before the priest. The priest will assign the person a value according to what the promise maker can afford.

dag: Yisa daa yiɣisi bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni yi n-chaŋ ti kpɛla Saimɔn yiŋa; ka Saimɔn deempaɣa niŋgbuŋ daa bii pam, ka bɛ balim Yisa ni o chɛ ka o kpaŋ.
en: Jesus left the synagogue and went to Simon's home. Simon's mother-in-law was sick with a high fever, and they spoke to Jesus about her.

dag: Di simdi ni yi bo kulagaa niŋ yi nɛma ni, ka yi yi ti yi kpaŋa ni yi ti damdi yɔɣuni, ka yi zaŋ li gbi bɔɣili pi yi bindi maa.
en: And make sure that you have a small shovel in your equipment. When you go out to the toilet area, use the shovel to dig a hole. Then, after you relieve yourself, bury the waste in the hole.

dag: Ka kul doliya n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka nyɛ n ni daa sab shɛŋa tin ya la. Kul doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga. Miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa.
en: You must carefully keep the regulations and case laws, the Instruction, and the commandment that he wrote for you. Dont worship other gods.

dag: Ka o daa kab dari pa bimbin maa zuɣu, ka ŋmahiŋmahi naɣilaa maa nimdi pa dari maa zuɣu, ka yɛli ba, Niŋmiya kom pali koyuya anahi n-kpaai li tɛli sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ŋɔ mini dari maa.
en: He placed the wood on the altar, then they cut the bull into pieces and laid the meat on the wood. He told the people, Fill four large jars with water and pour it over the meat and the wood. After they did this.

dag: Saha shɛli yi yi ti lo tɔbu yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni yi tuhi yi dimnim bɛn muɣisiri ya, di saha yin piɛbimiya kika biɛɣu, ka lala chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ teei yi yɛla, ka tiligi ya yi dimnim maa nuu ni.
en: If you are fighting an enemy in your own land, blow loudly on the trumpets before you go to fight them. The Lord your God will hear you, and he will save you from your enemies.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi niŋgbuna nyɛla Masia niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛli polo? Ka di simdi ni n zaŋ Masia niŋgbuna yaɣ shɛli leei pagɔrili dini? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: Dont you know that your bodies are parts of Christ? So then, should I take parts of Christ and make them a part of someone who is sleeping around? No way!.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla Mɛmfisinim mini Tapanhɛsinim ŋme ŋ-ŋma yi zuɣuŋmana.
en: Soldiers from the Egyptian towns of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skulls.

dag: Ka fara yi gbaag a mabia ŋun ʒi m-baɣ a, ka o zaŋ omaŋ pa talima a sani, nyin di chɛ ka o tumdi tuma kaman dabili la.
en: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.

dag: Ti Duuma, nyam bɛ ni kpɛhi ti dabiɛm shɛm. Chɛ ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ na kul tɔɣisim a yɛligu ni suhukpeeni.
en: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Haman, To, zaŋm kpariti maa mini wɔhu maa yomyom chaŋ ti niŋ Mɔdɛkai ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nira ka ʒi nayili dunol ni la lala. Niŋm o a ni kul wuhi shɛm maa zaa, ka di chɛ ka shɛli pooi.
en: The king replied, Hurry and do just what you have said! Don't forget a thing. Get the robe and the horse for Mordecai the Jew, who serves as one of the king's officials.

dag: Ka Ahishar nyɛ ŋun su nayili fukumsi. Ka Abida bia Adɔniram mi nyɛ bɛn tumdi tuun kpɛma zuɣulana.
en: Ahishar was responsible for everything in the kings palace; Adoniram son of Abda was in charge of the slaves.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ŋun mali binyɛra ayi, ŋun piimi zaɣ yini ti o kpe so ŋun ka; ka ŋun mi malila bindirigu, ŋun niŋmi lala.
en: He answered, If you have two shirts, share with someone who does not have one. If you have food, share that too.

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Nyamiya, n yoola dunoli n-tin ya, ka so ku tooi daa li yo. M mi ni yi yiko bi yaɣ lala, amaa di zaa yoli yi kul gbibi n yɛligu ka bi chihi n yuli.
en: I know what you do; I know that you have a little power; you have followed my teaching and have been faithful to me. I have opened a door in front of you, which no one can close.

dag: Faranim mini nandaamba yi ti bɔri kom ka bi nya, ka kɔnyuri chɛ ka bɛ lɔna kuui, man Yawɛ ni deei bɛ suhigu. Mani ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ku bahi ba.
en: The poor and needy look for water, but they cannot find any. Their tongues are dry with thirst. I, the Lord , will answer their prayers. I, the God of Israel, will not leave them to die.

dag: Naa, a nyɛla na titali gari nanim zaa. Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ n-ti a nam maa; ka lan ti a yiko mini kpiɔŋ ni jilima.
en: Your Majesty, you are the greatest of kings, and God has highly honored you with power.

dag: Dinzuɣu Daadam Bia n-su Vuhim Dabisili dali gba.
en: So the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.

dag: Amaa Yisa maligumaanitali tuma nyɛla din gari bɛ maligumaanitali tuma kaman o ni mali alikauli shɛli Naawuni mini ninsalinim sunsuuni ni so alikauli kurili la shɛm, dama di tam la alikaulinim din so zuɣu.
en: But now, Jesus has been given priestly work which is superior to theirs, just as the covenant which he arranged between God and his people is a better one, because it is based on promises of better things.

dag: Ŋuna m-booi booli pa teeku kom zuɣu luɣ shɛli neesim mini zibisim ni chirigi taba.
en: traced a circle on the waters surface, at the limit of light and darkness.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di lan booni ya ma Naomi, amaa bolimiya ma la Mara, dama Kpiɔŋlan Naa chɛ ka n nya naŋgbantom.
en: Don't call me Naomi, she answered; call me Marah, because Almighty God has made my life bitter.

dag: Ka Yisa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa laɣim ʒiya diri bindirigu maa ni yino wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka yɛl o, Dindina ŋun ti yɛn ʒini Naawuni nam ni di bindirigu ni ti nya alibarika.
en: After Jesus had finished speaking, one of the guests said, The greatest blessing of all is to be at the banquet in God's kingdom.

dag: Ŋuna n-deeri dunia ŋɔ zuɣulaannim yɛm ka chɛ ka bɛ dari gindi mɔɣu.
en: God strikes their rulers senseless, then leaves them to roam through barren deserts.

dag: Ka o yi bi tooi deeg omaŋ soya ŋɔ zaa puuni, dindina bɛn bahim o min o bihi nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni.
en: Those who sold themselves will become free, even if no one buys them back. At the year of Jubilee, they and their children will become free.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ʒi luɣ shɛŋa kaman bɛ ni daa ŋmahi tiŋgbani maa tari ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba la n-daa daŋ tiŋgbani deebu.
en: Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in.

dag: Di saha ka bɛnkam zaa daa wum Izraɛl Naawuni yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ ni sɔhiri la daa laɣim gili ma zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa lab kulina maa yɛda kalinsi maa zuɣu. N daa kul ʒimi ka kɔŋ suhukpeeni hal ti paai zaawuni sara maligu saha.
en: until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners.

dag: Ninsal soya zaa ni tooi nyɛla din viɛl o sani, amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun zahindi ninsal suhu.
en: People think that whatever they do is right, but the Lord judges their reason for doing it.

dag: ni Maarat ni Bɛtanɔt ni Ɛlitɛkɔn: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara ayɔbu m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon. In all, there were six towns and all the fields around them.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Du shɛli din dunoli kpa nudirigu polo ŋɔ nyɛla maligumaana ŋun su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa fukumsi duu.
en: The man told me that the room which faced south was for the priests who served in the Temple.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ kpahi din wɔɣilim nyɛ milimita pisopɔinnaanu n-kpahi gili di puuni zaa. Teebuya maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛn zaŋdi sara maligu nimdi para.
en: There were meat hooks three inches long on all the walls in this area. The meat of the offerings was put on the tables.

dag: nyama, pumpɔŋɔ n ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa. Nyama, n ti a yɛm mini baŋsim tɛha, ka di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daŋ a tooni puuni so ku ŋman a, ka so mi ti ku yiɣis a kalinsi nyaaŋa ŋ-ŋman a.
en: So I will give you what you asked for. I will make you wise and intelligent. I will make you wiser than anyone who ever lived or ever will live.

dag: Dama yi mini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-yɛn chaŋ ti tuhi yi dimnim maa, ka o chɛ ka yi di nasara.
en: The Lord your God is going with you, and he will give you victory.

dag: Ka Judanim maa ninvuɣ tusaata daa chaŋ Ɛtam tampiŋ lɔŋ maa ni ti bɔhi Samsin, A bi mi ni Filistianima n-su ti? Ka tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ti ŋɔ? Ka Samsin garigi yɛli ba, N niŋ ba la bɛ ni niŋ ma shɛm labisi.
en: Then men from the tribe of Judah went to the cave near the Rock of Etam and said to Samson, What have you done to us? Dont you know that the Philistines rule over us? Samson answered, I only punished them for what they did to me.

dag: Ti mini nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa yi Siizaria na n-daa doli taba chaŋ, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti tahi tuuli cheechi nyaandol so ŋun daa nyɛ Saipurus tiŋbia, ka o yuli booni Mneesin la yiŋa ni ti ti gbe nimaani.
en: Some of the disciples from Caesarea accompanied us and led us to Mnasons home, where we were guests. He was from Cyprus and had been a disciple a long time.

dag: Ka Sool daa tɛh o suhu ni, N ni zaŋ o ti Dauda ka o leei tɔŋ gbaag o, ka Filistianim ku o. Dinzuɣu ka Sool daa lan yɛli Dauda pahi buyi, Pumpɔŋɔ a yi pa ni leei n deemba.
en: Ill give her to him, Saul thought; shell cause him problems, and the Philistines will be against him. So Saul said to David a second time, Become my son-in-law now.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ma, Daadam, kɔba ŋɔ ni tooi lan niŋ nyɛvili? Ka n garigi yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, nyini m-mi.
en: Then the Lord said to me, Son of man, can these bones come to life? I answered, Lord GOD, only you know the answer to that question.

dag: ka o tim puɣisiriba ka bɛ chaŋ ti nya ka Sool shiri be ni.
en: he sent some spies to find out if it was true.

dag: M-pahi Ogi ka diri Ashitarɔt mini Ɛdirɛi nam ni daa su luɣ shɛli zaa Bashan la. Bɛna ka Musa daa tuhi nyaŋ ka kari ba bahi la.
en: It included the kingdom of Og, the last of the Rephaim, who had ruled at Ashtaroth and Edrei. Moses had defeated these people and driven them out.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛl ti shɛlikam maa zaa, ka ni chaŋ a ni kul yɛl ti ni ti cham luɣ shɛlikam.
en: They answered Joshua, We will obey everything you have commanded us and go anywhere you send us.

dag: N dol a zaligunima, dama n yuri li pam.
en: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.

dag: Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba daa mali niɣi pam. Bɛ ni daa nya ka Jaza mini Giliad tiŋgbana simdi niɣi biɛhigu shee.
en: The tribes of Reuben and Gad had a lot of livestock. When they saw how suitable the land of Jazer and Gilead was for cattle.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yuli bɛ zaa ti tuui taba ka yɛli doo maa, Teem a nuu maa. Ka o teei li, ka di dii kpaŋ zaa.
en: After he had looked around at everyone, he told the man, Stretch out your hand. He did, and his bad hand became completely well.

dag: A yi nyɛ tarima m-be nandaamba sani, di so ni a mini karimbaannim pirigiri bɛ ni ŋmɛri diri neen shɛŋa.
en: It is better to be humble and stay poor than to be one of the arrogant and get a share of their loot.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Na so ŋun mali jilima maa? Yawɛ ŋun mali kpiɔŋ mini yaa maa. Yawɛ ŋun mali yaa tɔbu ni maa.
en: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord , a strong and mighty warrior.

dag: Ka Judanim shɛb bɛn kpalim ni lan zooi m-be kaman ti shɛli din nyaɣa ba tiŋa nti wali wala la;.
en: The survivors of the house of Judah who have escaped will take root below and bear fruit above.

dag: Shia Kasi yino m-beni, amaa ka o pina lee nyɛ balibubalibu.
en: There are different spiritual gifts but the same Spirit.

dag: Daba ayopɔin maa dali, di simdi ka maligumaana maa lan kana ti nya, dɔro maa yi yɛligi yili maa dukpina maa zuɣu.
en: On the seventh day, the priest will return. If he finds that the infection has spread over the walls of the house.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daanya mali gaɣa kɔtomsi m-pie taba ʒiibuyi zuɣu n-zaŋ li zali kɔniŋdi bini maa lɔŋni, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili, ka di daa tuɣituɣi taba.
en: All around the outer edge of the rim of the tank were two rows of decorations, one above the other. The decorations were in the shape of bulls, which had been cast all in one piece with the rest of the tank.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Sokam zaŋm o takɔbi nyaɣ o luɣili zuɣu n-chaŋ gili sansani ŋɔ ni zaa n-kpe suɣili kam puuni, ka sokam ti ku o mabia ni o mini ŋun doli ni o ʒiʒiinikpee. .
en: Moses said to them, This is what the LORD, Israels God, says: Each of you, strap on your sword! Go back and forth from one end of the camp to the other. Each of you, kill your brother, your friend, and your neighbor.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ piɛma to o tɔbbihi zuɣulana, bɛn daa kana kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ni bɛ ti wurim ti, ka bɛ pulaantali be kaman bɛn mali shili ni bɛ ku tarimba bɛn sɔɣi la.
en: His troops had come like a storm, hoping to scatter us and glad to gobble us up. To them we were refugees in hiding— but you smashed their heads with their own weapons.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n nyee nyɔni biɛhigu, dama binshɛlikam din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni nyɛla din tiri ma suhugarigu, dinzuɣu di zaa nyɛla din ka buchi, ka ŋmani nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: This made me hate life. It was depressing to think that everything in this life is useless, like trying to catch the wind.

dag: Amaa ka n daa bi saɣi ti Balaam, ka o daa naɣ niŋla alibarika niŋ yi ni; ka n daa tiligi ya Balak nuu ni.
en: But I wouldn't listen to Balaam, and I rescued you by making him bless you instead of curse you.

dag: Izraɛlnim mini Judanim Naawuni, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ bi zaɣisi ba, hal alahichi ni kul pali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ sani maa zaa yoli.
en: The Lord All-Powerful did not leave Israel and Judah alone, like a widow. No, they are guilty of leaving the Holy One of Israel. Their God did not leave them. They left him!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun nyɛ yɛndana ni shini tuumbiɛri ŋɔ saha; dama tuumbiɛri saha n-shiri bala!.
en: Times are so evil that anyone with good sense will keep quiet.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa zali ti ni ti doli zaligunim ŋɔ zaa; ka zom ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ti zaɣ viɛlli nyabu zuɣu sahakam din ni chɛ ka ti be kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: The Lord commanded us to follow all these teachings. We must respect the Lord our God. Then he will always keep us alive and doing well, as we are today.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa yi kpaŋ ti yɛli ba, Nyamiya, ti chanila Jɛrusalɛm; ka anabinim ni daa sab shɛlikam zaŋ chaŋ Daadam Bia polo la ni ti niŋ pali.
en: Jesus took the twelve disciples aside and said to them, Listen! We are going to Jerusalem where everything the prophets wrote about the Son of Man will come true.

dag: Amaa n ni ti chɛ ka bɛ niriba biɛla tiligi takɔbi maa mini fifali ni ni alɔbo ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ yɛli bɛ ni yɛn chaŋ zuliya shɛb sani maa, bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa, di saha ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: But I will preserve a few of their number from the sword, famine, and plague, so that they may confess all their detestable practices among the nations where they go. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa yi tɔɣisi viɛnyɛliŋga, di ŋmanila salima zaɣ kpil shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ kpɛh anzinfa binyara ni.
en: An idea well-expressed is like a design of gold, set in silver.

dag: Dama Naawuni Shia Kasi zaligu din tahi nyɛvili din be Yisa Masia ni na nti ti ti la yihi ma alahichi mini kum zaligu taali ni.
en: For the law of the Spirit, which brings us life in union with Christ Jesus, has set me free from the law of sin and death.

dag: Di ti maliya buɣim yi biɛhigu shee zaa Vuhim Dabisili maa dali.
en: On the Sabbath you should not even light a fire in any of the places where you live.

dag: dama dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli pal shɛli o ni lo n ʒim ni. Dina n-nyɛ n ʒi shɛli din ti yɛn yi n niŋgbuŋ ni niriba pam daalahichi kpihimbu zuɣu.
en: This is my blood, and with it God makes his agreement with you. It will be poured out, so that many people will have their sins forgiven.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa nya ka Yaakubu je Liya maa, ka o ti Liya nama, ka chɛ ka Reechɛl nyɛ paɣiŋoo.
en: When the Lord saw that Leah was loved less than Rachel, he made it possible for her to have children, but Rachel remained childless.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Ɛhab yuli sab gbana, ka zaŋ o dalinli dihi tabili li n-zaŋ li ti ti Jɛziriil kpamba mini ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn mini Nabɔt daa laɣim be tin yin ni la.
en: Then Jezebel wrote some letters. She signed Ahabs name to them and used his seal to seal the letters. Then she sent them to the elders and important men who lived in the same town as Naboth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa neeg o yɛl o, Ti Duuma, ti Duuma, kom yɛn di ti! Ka o neei n-tahi sanʒiɛɣu maa mini kɔgbana maa zuɣu, ka di zaa dii fo baalim.
en: The followers went to Jesus and woke him. They said, Master! Master! We will drown! Jesus got up. He gave a command to the wind and the waves. The wind stopped, and the lake became calm.

dag: Maazia ni Biligai ni Shɛmaya; maligumaaniba m-bala.
en: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah; these are the priests.

dag: Amaa naŋgbammalisim ka bɛ daa kul niŋd o, bɛ daa ŋmar o la ʒiri.
en: But they tried to fool him with their words; they told him lies.

dag: Bɛ dim maa zaŋla ziŋgoo gbahi bɛ zaa, ka zaŋ o laŋa n-vo ba na ti niŋ o daasau ni, ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim ka o suhu paligi.
en: The Babylonians catch people with hooks, as though they were fish. They drag them off in nets and shout for joy over their catch!.

dag: ni di chɛ ka bɛ nam maa siɣisi dimaŋa, ka ku duhi dimaŋa. Ka di yi gbibi alikauli maa, dina n-ni chɛ ka di zani.
en: So Judah became a weak kingdom that could not turn against King Nebuchadnezzar. The people were forced to keep the agreement Nebuchadnezzar made with the new king of Judah.

dag: N yɛn zaŋla ziŋgoo kuhi a yɛno, ka chɛ ka a kɔsoya ni zahim kpe n-shɛbis a salichɛhi ni, ka n voog a yih a kɔsoya maa ni na n-tabil a kɔsoya maa ni zahim shɛb zaa bɛn be a salichɛhi maa ni zaa du duli.
en: I am going to put a hook through your jaw and make the fish in your river stick fast to you. Then I will pull you up out of the Nile, with all the fish sticking to you.

dag: Din chɛ ka bɛ ni bu so paa zɔri maa nyɛla o ni guli ba la liɣiri zuɣu maa n-chɛ ka o baɣa dii ka bɛ ni.
en: The hired man runs away because he is only a hired man and does not care about the sheep.

dag: Ka kikaa maa kumsi vuri daa maan pahi, ka Musa daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka Naawuni garig o satahiŋga puuni.
en: The sound of the trumpet became louder and louder. Moses spoke, and God answered him with thunder.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom nyɛla tɛhi zilimalana, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu yiɣisiri yomyom kpaŋsirila jɛrilim.
en: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Paɣa, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kumda? Ŋuni ka a bɔra? Mariama daa tɛhiya ni puu maa lana m-bala ka yɛl o, N dana, nyini n-yi yih o, nyin wuhim ma a ni zaŋ o ti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli, ka n chaŋ ti zaŋ o.
en: He asked her, Woman, why are you crying? Who are you looking for? She thought he was the man in charge of the garden. So she said to him, Did you take him away, sir? Tell me where you put him. I will go and get him.

dag: Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba daa mali niɣi pam. Bɛ ni daa nya ka Jaza mini Giliad tiŋgbana simdi niɣi biɛhigu shee.
en: The livestock owned by the Reubenites and the Gadites were unusually vast and numerous. They saw that the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead were exactly the place for livestock.

dag: N ni zaŋ a min a kɔsoya ni zahim maa labi tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka a ti lu palɔni, ka bɛ ti ku nya a sɔɣi. N ni ti zaŋ a ti mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini juri ka bɛ di.
en: I'll throw you and the fish into the desert, and your body will fall on the hard ground. You will be left unburied, and wild animals and birds will eat your flesh.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Naawuni, N tum alahichi pam n ni tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, chɛl mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ taali, dama n tum jɛrilim pam.
en: David prayed, I am your servant. But what I did was stupid and terribly wrong. Please forgive me.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o yiɣisi Galili n-chaŋ Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli ha;.
en: When Jesus finished saying these things, he left Galilee and went to the territory of Judea on the other side of the Jordan River.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi ti ninvuɣ shɛba yi ninni, ka yi yuli ba soli ka yi nina ti fulim dindali maa zaa, ka yi ti ku mali yiko din ni tooi niŋ shɛli.
en: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation while you watch; you will long for them constantly, but you wont have the power to do anything about it.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ gol so ŋun pahir ayi biɛɣ pisinaayopɔin dali, ka tiŋgbani daa kuui zaa.
en: By the th day of the second month, the ground was completely dry.

dag: Dinzuɣu kaman alahichi ni nyaŋ sokam kum puuni shɛm, lala ka Naawuni daalibarika gba nyaŋ di nasara wuntia puuni, ka tahi nyɛvili din ka bahigu na ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu. Bɛn niŋ Yisa yɛda kpimi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo.
en: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.

dag: Ka sagban daantaliga din daa be niriba maa tooni wuntaŋ ni la mini buɣim daantaliga din daa be bɛ tooni yuŋ la daa na ʒi n-zo bɛ sani.
en: The pillar of cloud was always in front of the people during the day, and the pillar of fire at night.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn simdi ni bɛ ti neei kum ni n-kpe nyɛvili din ka bahigu shee ti ku kpuɣiri paɣiba bee n-zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba.
en: But in the future world no one who is worthy to rise from death will either marry.

dag: Ka yi daa gbi kɔbɔɣili sɔŋ goma ayi sunsuuni ni beeŋ kurili la ni kom zɔrina ti luri di ni. Amaa ka bi lihi nya ŋun daa pun niŋ li bee n-chɛ ka yi baɣa be ŋun daa pun lo di nia zali ka di waɣ la ni.
en: you built a reservoir inside the city to hold the water flowing down from the old pool. But you paid no attention to God, who planned all this long ago and who caused it to happen.

dag: O daa bi saɣi ka so dol o pahila Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jeemsi tizo Jɔn.
en: Jesus did not let anyone go with him except Peter and the two brothers, James and John.

dag: ka lan laɣim nyu binnyur yini; dama Naawuni ni daa ti ba kuɣ shɛli ka di doli ba la kom ka bɛ daa nyura. Masia mi n-daa nyɛ kuɣili maa.
en: and all drank the same spiritual drink. They drank from a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

dag: Di saha ka bundan maa lan yɛli, N yaba, n suhir a mi ni a tim Lazarɔs m ba yiŋa dunia ni.
en: The rich man said, Then I beg you, Father, send Lazarus to my fathers house.

dag: Ti ni daa puhi ba naai ka Pool kahigi Naawuni ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa yiniyini o waazu yihibu ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani yɛli ba.
en: Paul greeted them and told how God had used him to help the Gentiles.

dag: Ka di ni nyɛ bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini zuɣu, tinim bɛn galisi ŋɔ gba nyɛla niŋgbun yini, dama ti zaa laɣindi ŋubirila bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini maa.
en: There is one loaf of bread, so we who are many are one body, because we all share in that one loaf.

dag: Ka Jɛsi lan chɛ ka Shamma kana ti gari, ka o lan yɛli, Yawɛ bi pii ŋumbɔŋɔ gba.
en: Then Jesse told Shammah to walk by Samuel. But Samuel said, No, the Lord did not choose this man, either.

dag: ka chɛ ka sokam baŋ Naawuni daashili nia shɛli o ni daa lo la ni yɛn pali shɛm. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ binshɛɣukam zaa namda daa sɔɣ o daashili maa ʒiɛmana din gari la zaa puuni.
en: And God gave me the work of telling all people about the plan for his secret truth. That secret truth has been hidden in him since the beginning of time. He is the one who created everything.

dag: Bɛ ni daa piri Aduna bidibisi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: These were the groups of Aarons sons: Aarons sons were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: A mi ni bɛnkam be Ɛsha daa zoya ka chɛ ma, bɛ ni shɛba n-nyɛ Faijɛlus mini Hɛrimɔjɛneez.
en: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.

dag: Amaa ka doo maa daa chaŋ ti mol o kpaŋbu maa yɛla gili luɣilikam, dina n-daa chɛ ka Yisa ku lan tooi yi palɔni kpe tiŋ kam ni yaha, amaa ka kul bela mɔɣu ni, ka niriba yiri luɣ shɛlikam chan o sani.
en: Instead, he went out and started talking freely and spreading the news so that Jesus wasnt able to enter a town openly. He remained outside in deserted places, but people came to him from everywhere.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhɔshafat daa silim o zuɣu n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa, ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa lu tiŋa Yawɛ tooni jɛm o.
en: Jehoshaphat bowed with his face to the ground. And all the people of Judah and Jerusalem bowed down before the Lord and worshiped him.

dag: Sulemaana bihi ni daa nyɛ shɛba m-bɔŋɔ: Rɛhɔbɔam mini Abija daa nyɛla o bihi, ka Asa nyɛ o bia, ka Jɛhɔshafat nyɛ o bia.
en: Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool ni Dauda zo n-kuli Gaat, ka o daa chɛ o shee bɔbu.
en: When Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, he didnt pursue him anymore.

dag: Daba ayɔbu dali bɛ daa yi pihirila ʒii buyi zuɣu. Bɛ daa pihirila lita anahi ninvuɣ yino kam zuɣu, ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa kana ti yɛli Musa di yɛla.
en: However, on the sixth day of the week, everyone gathered enough to have four liters, instead of two. When the leaders reported this to Moses.

dag: Lala n-yɛn niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛmaŋ naani mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ daazichi naani.
en: See what happens to those who trust in themselves, the fate of those who are satisfied with their wealth—.

dag: Ka o mini ba daa ti di daa, ka bɛ saɣi ni o yom ba tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri; ka o chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ o puu maa ni.
en: After he agreed with the workers to pay them a denarion, he sent them into his vineyard.

dag: Ka Balak daa yɛli Balaam, Kamina pumpɔŋɔ, ka n zaŋ a chaŋ luɣ shɛli polo, di pa shɛli ka Naawuni ti chɛ ka a yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu nimaani ti ma.
en: Balak said to Balaam, Please come and Ill take you to another place. Perhaps God will prefer it, so that you could curse him for me from there.

dag: Nyama, ka paɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ dunɔgula ʒiya maani alikama, ka gom ti gbaag o ka o gbihi, di saha ka Rɛkab min o mabia Baana daa sɔɣ kpe.
en: They went straight into his house, as if getting wheat, and they stabbed him in the stomach. Then Rechab and his brother Baanah escaped.

dag: N daa dolila Vinvamli Dunɔdal la yi yuŋ chaŋ ti gari Wɔɣ Kurili kɔbilinini la shee n-chaŋ Saɣiri Dunɔdal la ni. N daa chanimi n-kaari ni n nya Jɛrusalɛm goma maa ni lunlu shɛm mini buɣim ni daa di n-saɣimsaɣim di dunɔdaya la shɛm.
en: It was still night as I left the city through the Valley Gate on the west and went south past Dragon's Fountain to the Rubbish Gate. As I went, I inspected the broken walls of the city and the gates that had been destroyed by fire.

dag: Soli din kuni neesim biɛhigu shee lee be ya, bee zibisim ni be luɣ shɛli lee be ya.
en: Do you know where the light comes from or what the source of darkness is?.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli, Bilimmiya kuɣ kara ti ŋari voli maa noli, ka bo niriba zali di gbini ka bɛ gul li.
en: Joshua said, Roll large stones over the mouth of the cave. Station some men by it to guard them.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Midiannima, ka bɛ ku lan tooi niŋ ba shɛli yaha. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinahi Gidiɔn ʒiɛman ni.
en: The Midianites were forced to be under the rule of the Israelites. The Midianites did not cause trouble anymore. And the land was at peace for years, as long as Gideon was alive.

dag: Di simdi ni tan tolinli kam wɔɣilim ti nyɛ mita pinaata, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ayi. Di simdi ka tan tolima maa zaa buɣisibu ti nyɛ yim.
en: Make them all the same size, yards long and yards wide.

dag: Niriba pam daa ti yi tinsi gari shɛm ni laɣim Yisa sanna, ka o daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli.
en: When a great crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from one city after another, he spoke to them in a parable.

dag: Dinzuɣu hal tiŋgbani yi damda, ka zoya vuuri ti luri teeku kɔbulli ni;.
en: Thats why we wont be afraid when the world falls apart, when the mountains crumble into the center of the sea.

dag: Di saha ka Mɔdɛkai daa yɛli ba ni bɛ labimi ti yɛli Ɛsta: Di tɛhiri ni a ni be nayili maa wuhiya ni a ni yi kum ni gari Yɛhudia nir kam.
en: he sent back this reply, Don't think that you will escape being killed with the rest of the Jews, just because you live in the king's palace.

dag: Bɛ daa kpala tanti, ka booni di puuni luɣ shɛli din daŋ tooni Luɣ Kasi Shee. Firilatamdigu mini teebuli shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro shɛli bɛ ni mali maani sara Naawuni sani m-pari di zuɣu la n-daa be nimaani.
en: A tent was put up, the outer one, which was called the Holy Place. In it were the lampstand and the table with the bread offered to God.

dag: ka a daa wum n ni fabindi niŋd a maa. Di ŋar a tiba ka bi wum n ni kuhiri niŋd a ni a sɔŋ ma ŋɔ.
en: I begged you to listen. Help! I shouted. Save me! You answered my prayer.

dag: Jokitan daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ: Alimɔdad mini Shɛlɛf ni Hazarimavɛt ni Jɛra ni.
en: Joktan fathered Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah.

dag: Ka nachimbil so ŋun daa yɛl o li maa yɛli, Di daa niŋla daliri ka n chaŋ Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu nti chirigi Sool ka o zaŋ omaŋ dalim o kpani, ka chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba daa kabiri kani o sanna.
en: The young man replied: I was on Mount Gilboa and saw King Saul leaning on his spear. The enemy's war chariots and cavalry were closing in on him.

dag: Yawɛ n-nam tibili din wumda mini nini din nyari ŋɔ zaa.
en: The Lord has given us eyes to see with and ears to listen with.

dag: Dama dabisi shɛŋa din daa daŋ di saha maa tooni puuni, so daa naan ku tooi bu ninsal paa bee n-zaŋ biŋkɔbigu tum tuun shɛli; ka so daa yi yɛn yi bee n-yɛn lab kpe na, bɛ mini bɛ dimnim kul varimi. Mani n-daa tuɣindi ba maa.
en: Before that time, neither people nor animals were rewarded for their work, and no one was safe anywhere, because I had turned them against each other.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mmaŋmaŋ ni vihi bo m piɛri, n shiri ni bo bɛ shee.
en: The Lord GOD says, I myself will be their Shepherd. I will search for my sheep and take care of them.

dag: O wuhiya ni n chɛ ka bɛn fabindi Ziɔn ka mali nandahima la mali suhupiɛlli. Ka bɛn mali suhugarigu la yili wumpaɣibo yila. Bɛ ni ŋmanila Yawɛ ni sa oki ti shɛŋa. Bɛ zaa ni tum din tuhi, ka Yawɛ nya paɣibu bɛ ni tum shɛm zuɣu.
en: especially in Jerusalem. He sent me to give them flowers in place of their sorrow, olive oil in place of tears, and joyous praise in place of broken hearts. They will be called Trees of Justice, planted by the Lord to honor his name.

dag: Yi mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi yɛn nyɛla yim.
en: There will be one set of instructions and one legal norm for the immigrant and for you.

dag: Ka Napaɣiba kpɛm Ɛsta daa lan chaŋ ti teei dɔni naa naba ni n-kuhiri ka suhir o ni o yiɣisim Haman ŋun yi Agag zuliya ni na ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim polo la.
en: Once again Esther went to speak to the king. This time she fell down at his feet, crying and begging, Please stop Haman's evil plan to have the Jews killed.

dag: Chamiya gili Ziɔn zaa, ka kaliya di pihi la.
en: Walk around Jerusalem, and count its towers.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi doli Yawɛ yɛligu maa? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zo yomyom chaŋ ti di nɛma, ka tum din bi tiɣi Yawɛ nini.
en: Why didnt you obey the LORD? You did evil in the LORDs eyes when you tore into the plunder.

dag: Ka bɛnkam ti lan gariti du shɛli din yuli du pam ŋɔ gbini, di ni gari ba, ka bɛ bɔhira, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka Yawɛ niŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ mini jɛmbu duu ŋɔ lala.
en: Everyone who sees it will be amazed. They will ask, Why did the Lord do this terrible thing to this land and to this temple.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka bɛnkam nya sɔɣibu shee a sani mali suhupiɛlli; chɛ ka bɛ kul yiini suhupiɛlli yila sahakam. Guli ba, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a yuli nya suhupiɛlli a sani.
en: But all who find safety in you will rejoice; they can always sing for joy. Protect those who love you; because of you they are truly happy.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun ka buchi kul chanimi gindi ŋmari ʒiri.
en: Worthless people and guilty people go around with crooked talk.

dag: A yi zaŋ yɛtɔɣa talim jɛrigu, di ŋmanila a zaŋla sua ŋmaag a napɔŋ bahi ka bɔri yɛla.
en: Sending messages with a fool is like cutting off ones feet or drinking down violence.

dag: Sokam zaa kul lihir a mi, ka a tiri ba bindirigu bɛ ni bɔri li saha shɛli.
en: All eyes look to you, hoping, and you give them their food right on time.

dag: Suhu m-mi biɛrim shɛli din be di ni, ka di mini zino ku tooi laɣim mali di suhupiɛlli.
en: When you are sad, no one else feels the pain; and when you are happy, no one else can really feel the joy.

dag: Ka o daa lan yihi Ashɛra binnani din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la na nti zaŋ li yi Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ tariga n-chaŋ Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ ni nti nyo li buɣim Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ maa ni, ka ŋmɛnŋme m-burisi li n-va li ti bahi tiŋ maa gbala ni.
en: Josiah removed the Asherah pole from the Lord s Temple. He took the Asherah pole outside the city to the Kidron Valley and burned it there. Then he beat the burned pieces into dust and scattered the dust over the graves of the common people.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni lan chɛ ka Izraɛlnim suhi ma ka n niŋ dimbɔŋɔ ti ba, dina n-nyɛ n chɛ ka bɛ daadambiɛligu nabi kaman biŋkɔbbaligu la.
en: I will once again answer your prayers, and I will let your nation grow until you are like a large flock of sheep.

dag: chɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa bɔri nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ni bɛ suhu zaa ŋɔ taali, hal bɛ yi bi doli Naawuni jɛmbu duu kasitali zaligu la.
en: everyone who has decided to seek the true God, the LORD, the God of their ancestors, even though they arent ceremonially clean by sanctuary standards.

dag: Yawɛ, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi be a jɛmbu duu puuni? Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi be Ziɔn a daboli din be kasi la zuɣu?.
en: Who can live in your tent, LORD? Who can dwell on your holy mountain?.

dag: Yawɛ yɛla daa gbahi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din daa gili Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa nanim zaa dabiɛm, ka bɛ daa bi buɣisi ni bɛ lo tɔbu n-tuhi Jɛhɔshafat.
en: All the kingdoms surrounding Judah were afraid of the LORD and didnt wage war against Jehoshaphat.

dag: Bɛ daa wuh o shihira bɛ sani, ka tum alahiziba tumtumsa Ham tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: He used Moses and Aaron to do many miracles in Hams country.

dag: Ka di yi yɛligi o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla dɔr biɛɣu.
en: If it continues to spread over the skin, the priest will declare the person unclean; it is an infection.

dag: Jɛta ŋun daa nyɛ Shammai mabia la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛtɛrit mini Jɔnatan, Amaa ka Jɛta ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bia ka kpi.
en: Jada was Shammais brother. Jadas sons were Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without having children.

dag: Di daba ata dali, niriba maa gunibu maa yuma ni daa na biɛri saha shɛli maa, ka Yaakubu bidibis ayi, Simiɔn mini Lɛvi bɛn daa nyɛ Daina tizɔdɔbba la daa zaŋ takɔbiri chaŋ ti liri tiŋ maa nima n-libigi ba ku bɛ dɔbba zaa.
en: Three days later the men who had been circumcised were still weak from pain. So Simeon and Levi, two of Dinah's brothers, attacked with their swords and killed every man in the town.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla a zaligunim zuɣu. A wuntitali puuni, tim ma nyɛvili.
en: I want to obey your commands; give me new life, for you are righteous.

dag: Ka a yi bahi a dabili ni o chaŋ, nyin di chɛ ka o chaŋ ni nu zaŋa.
en: Furthermore, when you set them free from your service, you must not let them go empty-handed.

dag: Ka Mɛfibɔshɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Sool yaaŋa la daa yina ni o ti tuhi naa soli. Naa ni daa kul yi Jɛrusalɛm dahin shɛli maa Mɛfibɔshɛt daa bi lan paɣ o naba bee m-mal o teeŋa bee m-paɣ o situra hal ka o ti labina ni alaafee maa.
en: Mephibosheth, Sauls grandson, also came down to meet the king. He hadnt taken care of his feet, trimmed his beard, or washed his clothes from the day the king left until the day he returned safely.

dag: ka daadam kam ti nya Naawuni tiliginsim. .
en: Then everyone will see the saving power of God. .

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, di pala dimbɔŋɔnim kɔŋko, n shiri lihi binshɛɣukam zaa la yoli binshɛli din mali buchi pam la zuɣu; dina n-nyɛ n Duuma Yisa Masia baŋbu. O zuɣu ka n chɛ binshɛɣukam zaa bahi; n lihi di zaa ha la saɣiri ni di chɛ ka m mali Masia.
en: But even beyond that, I consider everything a loss in comparison with the superior value of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have lost everything for him, but what I lost I think of as sewer trash, so that I might gain Christ.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o tɔbbihi bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni bɛ lom bɛ niriba ata maa mihi n-zaŋ ba ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ni.
en: Next, he commanded some of his strongest soldiers to tie up the men and throw them into the flaming furnace.

dag: N ni fa a mini tiŋ ŋɔ Asiria naa nuu ni bahi, ka guli tiŋ ŋɔ.
en: while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Alizin birigu maa kul luhir o la waawaayili; ka o luri buɣim ni, shɛlini mi kom ni ni o di o nyɛvili. Ka a yi ni tooi sɔŋ ti, nyin zom ti nambɔɣu sɔŋ ti.
en: The spirit often throws him into a fire or into water to kill him. If you can do anything, please have pity on us and help us.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka salo maa zaa daa pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ tuhi pinaayi bɛn mali suhukpeeni n-tim ba ka yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya takɔbiri chaŋ ti ku Jabɛshigiliadnima, hal kumiya paɣiba mini bihi gba.
en: So they sent , warriors with these orders: Attack Jabesh in Gilead and kill everyone, except the women who have never been married.

dag: Ninvuɣ so beni n-diri binshɛɣukam, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛda bi kpɛm mi kul dirila bindir gahinda.
en: Some people's faith allows them to eat anything, but the person who is weak in the faith eats only vegetables.

dag: Yawɛ, mɔɣa zuɣu ka a suhu daa yiɣisi bahi la bee kulibɔna zuɣu ka a suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bee teeku zuɣu ka a suhu daa yiɣisi bahi saha shɛli a ni daa kpe a nasara dibu chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu ni ka yuri vɔri li la?.
en: Our Lord , were you angry with the monsters of the deep? You attacked in your chariot and wiped them out.

dag: Ka a boli tuumbaŋdiba bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb n ni zaŋ baŋsim ti na nti chɛ ka bɛ she binyɛra ti Aduna ka o leei m maligumaana.
en: I have given special wisdom to some of the skilled men. Tell them to make the clothes for Aaron. These clothes will show that he serves me in a special way. Then he can serve me as a priest.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, daboya mini zoya zuɣu buɣa jɛmbu nyɛla yɔhiŋ. Yɛlimaŋli, Izraɛlnim tiliginsim bela Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: It was foolish to worship idols on the hills. All the loud parties on the mountains were wrong. Surely the salvation of Israel comes from the Lord our God.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa chibi tiŋ maa gooni voli, ka tɔbbihi zaa daa doli voli maa yi goma ayi sunsuuni yuŋ naa puu la polo hal Babilɔnnim ni daa teei gili tiŋ maa zaa la yoli. Bɛ daa zaŋ kpala Araba polo.
en: the Babylonian troops broke through the city wall. That same night, Zedekiah and his soldiers tried to escape through the gate near the royal garden, even though they knew the enemy had the city surrounded. They headed toward the Jordan River valley.

dag: Di yi pa lala ŋuni n-lee ni wuhi ni n nyɛla ʒirilana, ka wuhi ni n ni yɛli shɛm maa kani.
en: If this isnt so, who can prove me a liar and make my words disappear?.

dag: M puhiri Traifɛna mini Traifɔsa bɛn nyɛ ti Duuma tumtumdiba la. M puhiri Pɛrisis n ni yuri so ka o nyɛ ŋun tum tuma pam ti Duuma ni la.
