en: Say hello to Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who are workers for the Lord. Say hello to my dear friend Persis, who has worked hard in the Lord.

dag: Ka paɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa mi gumdi mibu daa mi gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni gali piɛl viɛlli.
en: All the skilled women spun cloth with their hands, and brought what they had spun in blue and purple and deep red yarns and fine linen.

dag: Ka Hasɛnaa bidibisi daa mali me Zahim Dunɔdal la ka zaŋ dunɔpaɣiri dari sa, ka mali pununim kpɛhi di dunoya, ka niŋ dunokparita mini kurimulima niŋ li.
en: The family of Hassenaah built Fish Gate. They put the beams in place and hung the doors, then they added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.

dag: Ka Gaal daa ti ŋmaligi guui, ka Abimilɛk kari dol o. Ka niriba pam daa nya dansi zaŋ lala hal ti paai tiŋ maa gooni dunoli shee.
en: Abimelech and his men chased Gaal and his men. Gaals men ran back toward the gate of the city of Shechem, but many were killed before they could get back to the gate.

dag: Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahir ayɔbu dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu n-ti Anabi Hagai ni o ti Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Juda gomna la mini Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Maligumaaniba Zuɣulaan la.
en: The LORDs word came through Haggai the prophet in the second year of King Darius, in the sixth month on the first day of the month, to Judahs governor Zerubbabel, Shealtiels son, and to the high priest Joshua, Jehozadaks son.

dag: Ram ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛramiil bituuli san la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Maaz mini Jamin ni Ɛkɛr.
en: The family of Ram, Jerahmeels oldest son: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa yi nti bɔh o ma, Bɔ ka n lee yɛn suhi Naa? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Yɛlim o ni a bɔrila Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu.
en: So the girl went out and asked her mother, What shall I ask for? The head of John the Baptist, she answered.

dag: Di saha paɣisara ni ti wari waa ni suhupiɛlli, ka nachimba mini ninkura ti mali suhupiɛlli. N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ kumsi leei suhupiɛlli. N ni ti maai bɛ suhuri, ka chɛ ka bɛ suhugarigu leei suhupiɛlli.
en: Then the young women of Israel will be happy and dance. And the men, young and old, will join in the dancing. I will change their sadness into happiness. I will comfort my people, making them happy instead of sad.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka anzinfa mini salima galisi Jɛrusalɛm kaman kuɣa la, ka chɛ ka sida dari gba galisi kaman sinsabisi dari ni galisi shɛm Shɛfɛla la.
en: In Jerusalem Solomon gathered so much gold and silver that it was as common as rocks. He gathered so much cedar wood that it was as common as sycamore trees in the western hill country.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari mali sara maligu bimbini, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di dubu nyɛ mita yini ni biɛla. Malimiya li zaɣ mɔɣu.
en: Make an acacia-wood altar. The altar should be square, seven and a half feet long and seven and a half feet wide. It should be four and a half feet high.

dag: Bɛrɔtnim maa daa zo n-chaŋla Giteem nti ʒini nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: But all the people in Beeroth ran away to Gittaim, and they are still living there today.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa yɛli, N daa ŋma Jɔn zuɣu; ka ŋuni mi yɛla ka n lee lan wumdi ŋɔ? Ka daa lo nia ni o nya Yisa.
en: Herod said, I cut off Johns head. So who is this man I hear these things about? Herod continued trying to see Jesus.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka yɛli ba, Nam yini puuni niriba yi ŋmaligi tuhiri taba, bɛ nam maa ni wurim; ka tin yin nim bee yil yin nim yi ŋmaligi zabira, bɛ tiŋ maa bee bɛ yili maa mi wurindimi.
en: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he said to them: Any kingdom where people fight each other will end up ruined. And a town or family that fights will soon destroy itself.

dag: Yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam zaa, n ni niŋ li tin ya.
en: When you ask me for anything in my name, I will do it.

dag: Zuɣusaa kahigi Naawuni wuntitali wuhi, dama Naawuni maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ sariakarita.
en: The heavens announce, God is the judge, and he is always honest.

dag: Di nabihi daa be kasi gari sakuɣa, ka piɛli gari bihim. Bɛ niŋgbuna daa mali alaafee. Bɛ zabiri viɛlim daa ŋmanila safaya kuɣa viɛlim.
en: The leaders of Jerusalem were purer than snow and whiter than milk; their bodies were healthy and glowed like jewels.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka bɛnkam maani maligu buɣa jɛmbu shee, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim tiri bɛ wuna Mɔab la chɛ li niŋbu.
en: Ill put an end to Moab, declares the LORD, for making offerings on the shrines, and worshipping their gods.

dag: Niriba pam ni nyuri bara dunia ŋɔ binyara zuɣu shɛm, n gba ni nyu bara lala.
en: But since there are so many who boast for merely human reasons, I will do the same.

dag: O ni ti zaɣisi binshɛɣukam ninsalinim ni jɛmdi mini ninsalinim ni lihi so Naawuni la; o ni ti duh omaŋ gari dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha; hal o ni ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ti ʒini, ka yɛri ni o nyɛla Naawuni.
en: He will stand against and put himself above everything that people worship or think is worthy of worship. He will even go into Gods Temple and sit there, claiming that he is God.

dag: Yɛlim ba yaha, Yi yi ti yihi zaɣ viɛla maa zaka di ni, yinim Lɛvinim yin zaŋmiya din kpalim kaman kabɔɣili ni chi bee wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni wain zaka la.
en: Moses, tell this to the Levites: When you give the best part of what you receive to the Lord, it will be the same as grain from your own threshing floor and wine from your own winepress.

dag: Ɛdom naa ni daa zaɣisi ni Izraɛlnim di tim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gari maa, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa taɣi doli shɛli polo gari.
en: to keep Israel from passing through its territory. So the Israelites had to go in another direction.

dag: Di ni tilig a zaɣ biɛɣu ni, ka tilig a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri nuu ni.
en: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars.

dag: ka yɛra, Yawɛ bi nya; Yaakubu Naawuni maa ku baŋ.
en: They say, The Lord does not see us; the God of Israel does not notice.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sabimi n ni yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa niŋ litaafi ni.
en: said to me, Write down in a book everything that I have told you.

dag: A nya ninvuɣ so ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa yomyom? Jɛrigu mali tahima gari dilana.
en: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi maa, ka kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa ka niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro maa ti o nyaandoliba ni bɛ tari niriba maa; di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi ŋmahi zahim ayi la mi pahi zaŋ tari bɛ zaa.
en: Jesus took the five loaves and two fish. He looked up to the sky and thanked God for the food. Then he broke the bread into pieces, which he gave to his followers to distribute to the people. Then he divided the two fish among everyone there.

dag: ka ni deei ti ni suhi shɛlikam o sani, ti ni dol o zaligunim ka tumdi din tiɣir o nini la zuɣu.
en: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yinima ninvuɣ shɛb zaa n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Jɛrusalɛm n-kuli Babilɔn la wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: All of you whom I sent into exile in Babylonia, listen to what I, the Lord , say.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita mabia Anduru ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni yino la yɛli Yisa.
en: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peters brother, said.

dag: O no n-gur o tɔbu kaman o nyɛla ti dima, ka zaŋ o nudirigu tiri ti kaman ti dim la. O ku ti ni daa mali ninvuɣ shɛb zaa nyuri bara Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga tanti suɣili puuni la. O chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili yina kaman buɣim la.
en: He bent his bow as an enemy would; his strong hand was poised like an adversary. He killed every precious thing in sight; he poured out his wrath like fire on Daughter Zions tent.

dag: Di saɣi n-wum niriba ni fiɣisi toondana n-yɛli shɛm naɣila niriba ata bee ayi n-di li shɛhira.
en: Do not listen to an accusation against an elder unless it is brought by two or more witnesses.

dag: Miriya ka yi mini ba ti kpuɣiri taba, di zaŋya yi bipuɣinsi ti bɛ bidibisi bee n-kpuɣi bɛ bipuɣinsi ti yi bidibisi.
en: Dont intermarry with them. Dont give your daughter to one of their sons to marry, and dont take one of their daughters to marry your son.

dag: Biŋkɔbigu kam ŋun mali takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, ka nyɛ ŋun gbuɣiri ŋubira, yin ŋubimiy o.
en: any animals that have divided hoofs and that also chew the cud.

dag: Nyin paɣa, wula ka a ni tooi baŋ ni a zuɣu ku tilig a yidana? Ka nyin doo mi, wula ka a ni tooi baŋ ni a zuɣu ku tilig a paɣa?.
en: How do you know as a wife if you will save your husband? Or how do you know as a husband if you will save your wife?.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa gɔri gindi ka nyɛ bɛn gba kariti alizin biɛri daa zaŋ ti Duuma Yisa yuli n-yɛri alizin biɛri bɛn ʒi niriba zuɣu, Pool ni yihiri Yisa so waazu la yuli zuɣu, wariya ka chɛ ba.
en: Some Jewish men started going around trying to force out evil spirits by using the name of the Lord Jesus. They said to the spirits, Come out in the name of that same Jesus that Paul preaches about.

dag: Ka neesim maa kul neeri zibisim ni, ka zibisim maa bi tooi nyaŋ li.
en: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has never put it out.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sabi Lɛvi bihi yuya n-doli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: bɛ daa sabi li dolila bɛ yaannim dunoya mini bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni bɛ ninvuɣ yinoyino bɛn daa paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana, ka ni tooi tum tuma Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: These were the members of Levis family according to their households. The household heads were registered, along with a listing of the names of each person years old and above who carried out assigned tasks in the LORDs temple.

dag: bɛna n-ni tiligi. Bɛ biɛhigu shee ni ti nyɛla zoya din du pam zuɣu, ka bɛ sɔɣibu shee ti nyɛ kuɣa birininim puuni, ka bɛ ti tiri ba bindirigu mini kom.
en: They will live in a fortress high on a rocky cliff, where they will have food and plenty of water.

dag: Ka Judanim mini Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Dan tiŋgban ni zaŋ hal ti paai Bɛrishiiba tiŋgban ni nim zaa kul be ni alaafee, ka sokam ʒin omaŋmaŋ yiŋ wain tihi mini fiig tihi gbina ni Sulemaana ʒiɛmani maa ni.
en: Everyone living in Israel, from the town of Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south, was safe as long as Solomon lived. Each family sat undisturbed beneath its own grape vines and fig trees.

dag: Ka di pala Adam ka Sintani daa yɔhim, amaa Awa ka o daa yɔhim ka o leei ŋun saɣim Naawuni zaligu.
en: And it was not Adam who was deceived; it was the woman who was deceived and broke God's law.

dag: ka nir yiŋnim ni nyɛla o dimnima.
en: your worst enemies will be the members of your own family.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi, Bimbɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ ŋmahindi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba? Bɛ lee ŋmanila bɔ?.
en: To what will I compare the people of this generation? Jesus asked. What are they like?.

dag: Amaa o daa lee bi wurimla luɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa la; ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani nti maani maligu, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim. Jɔtam n-nyɛ ŋun daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa polo dunol la.
en: But he did not destroy the high places. The people still made sacrifices and burned incense at those places of worship. Jotham built the upper gate of the Lord s Temple.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi nyɛla din tuhi ni jilima ka yi ti Gidiɔn min o malibu maa, yin maliya suhupiɛlli zaŋ chaŋ Abimilɛk sani, ka o gba mali suhupiɛlli zaŋ chaŋ yi sani.
en: So, you leaders of Shechem, if you treated Gideon and his family the way you should have, then I hope you and Abimelech will make each other very happy.

dag: Chi ni ti pali kaburi bɔɣa ni; ka wain mini kpam ti pali di tɔɣibu bɔɣa ni hal ti puuri bahira.
en: The threshing floors will be full of grain; the vats will overflow with new wine and fresh oil.

dag: Ka buɣim daa taai bɛ salo maa sunsuuni n-di ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: Fire blazed throughout that whole group; flames burned up the wicked.

dag: Ti yi zahim timaŋa ni yɛlimaŋli, dindina ti ku lan nya saria karibu.
en: But if we judged ourselves in the right way, then God would not judge us.

dag: Amaa nyin ŋuna, di simdi ni a mali suhukpeeni, di chɛ ka a kɔba ni chɔɣisi, dama a nya a ni tum tuun shɛli maa laara.
en: So you must be brave. Don't give up! God will honor you for obeying him.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaata ni kɔbisinahi.
en: There are , men in this division.

dag: Amaa m bihi, yi nyɛla Naawuni niriba ka pun nyaŋ anab ʒirinim maa, dama Shi so ŋun be yi ni maa mali yiko gari shi so ŋun be dunianim ni.
en: You are from God, little children, and you have defeated these people because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.

dag: Ka o yi zaŋ o puu ti Yawɛ yi nɛma labisi ti yuuni puuni yi ni zal li da shɛli, di daa n-kul yɛn bala.
en: If you give your field to God during the year of Jubilee, then its value will be whatever the priest decides.

dag: Yi daa zɔrila takɔbi, n ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi lu yi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You fear the sword, so I will bring the sword against you. This is what the LORD God says!.

dag: Ti zaa yinoyino deerila pin gahinda kaman Masia ni buɣisiri li shɛm tiri ti.
en: Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha n ni zaŋ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa kpuɣi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la shɛŋa zaa kpe n-kuli Babilɔn la labisi kpe na.
en: Before two years are over, I will bring back all the things that King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon took from the Lord s Temple. Nebuchadnezzar has carried those things to Babylon. But I will bring them back here to Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn chɛmi ka a yi dunia ni. A ni kpi yuuni ŋɔ puuni a ni tɔɣisi duŋtaabo yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Yawɛ maa zuɣu. .
en: So this is what the Lord says: Soon I will take you from this world, Hananiah. You will die this year, because you taught the people to turn against the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa saɣi, ka piligi bɔri so shɛli o ni yɛn doli yi Yisa nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ sɔɣi gbaag o salo ni ka o sani saha shɛli.
en: He agreed and began looking for an opportunity to hand Jesus over to them—a time when the crowds would be absent.

dag: Ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa di din kpalim maa; bɛ ti dim li luɣ kasi shee, ka di niŋ dabindi niŋ di ni, Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la dundɔŋ ni ka bɛ ni ti ŋub li.
en: Aaron and his sons will eat the rest of it. It must be eaten as unleavened bread in a holy place; the priests must eat it in the meeting tents courtyard.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋm ti ni yɛn wuh a shɛm ŋɔ. Ti mali niriba anahi bɛn po pɔri.
en: Please do what we ask, because four of our men have made special promises to God.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee niŋ ti ni yɛli shɛm yɛda? Ka ŋuni ka Yawɛ lee kahig o yiko wuhi?.
en: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?.

dag: Asa tuun shɛŋa din pahi min o kpiɔŋ ni o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa ni o ni daa me tin shɛŋa zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi ni. Amaa o ni daa ti kurigi, naba polo dɔro n-daa gbaag o.
en: Everything else that King Asa did, his brave deeds and the towns he fortified, are all recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah . But in his old age he was crippled by a foot disease.

dag: N ni niŋ n daalibarika niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun shɛli din pahir ayɔbu maa ni din ni chɛ ka di niŋ yuma ata bindira.
en: I will send my blessing on you in the sixth year so that it will make enough produce for three years.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ o sani palli naŋgbanyee ti yɛl o, Kamina ti chɛ ka m min a dɔni. Dama o daa bi mi ni o bia pakoli maa m-bala. Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka a yɛn ti ma ka chɛ ka m min a dɔni.
en: So he went to her and said, Let me have sex with you. She said, How much will you give me.

dag: Di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ; dama m bela nandahima ni, deemi n suhigu yomyom.
en: Dont turn away from your servant. I am in trouble, so hurry and help me!.

dag: N ni yili yila yɛli ʒiɛyimtali mini zaligu soli yɛla. N ni yili yila paɣi Yawɛ.
en: I will sing to you, Lord ! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa garigi yɛli Adɔnija, Aai, dama ti dan Naa Dauda zaŋ Sulemaana leei naa;.
en: I'm afraid not, Jonathan answered. His Majesty King David has made Solomon king.

dag: Saha shɛli Yaakubu ni daa nya o ŋahiba Leeban bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl mini ŋun Leeban piɛri maa, o daa chaŋmi ti paai kuɣili maa kɔbiliga maa noli ka ŋɔŋ kom ti o ŋahiba Leeban piɛri maa ka bɛ nyu.
en: When Jacob saw her and his uncle's sheep, he rolled the rock away and watered the sheep.

dag: O doli zaligu soli n-zabiri kpibisi mini pakoya zuɣu, ka yuri saamba, ka tiri ba bindirigu mini situra.
en: He defends widows and orphans. He loves even the strangers living among us. He gives them food and clothes.

dag: Amaa ka a niriba maa yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Ka di mi nyɛla bɛ ni tumdi shɛm n-lee bi doli zaligu soli.
en: Yet your people say, My Lords way doesnt measure up. Isnt it their ways that dont measure up?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum lala maa ka yɛli ba, Bɛn mal alaafee bi bɔri dɔɣite naɣila bɛn biɛra; pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ka n kana, amaa alahichinim tuuba niŋbu zuɣu ka n kana.
en: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, Healthy people dont need a doctor, but sick people do. I didnt come to call righteous people, but sinners.

dag: N ni labisi Izraɛlnim ʒili bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ ti di bindir shɛli din be Kamɛl mini Bashan, ka di Ifriim zoya ni bindira ni Giliad bindira tiɣi.
en: I will bring Israel back to his own fields. He will eat food that grows on Mount Carmel and in the land of Bashan. He will eat and be full. He will eat on the hills in the lands of Ephraim and Gilead.

dag: Ka Amɔrinim maa daa kul kpalim be Harihɛrɛs mini Aijalɔn ni Shaalibim, amaa ka Yisifu zuliya niriba daa muɣisi ba hal ka bɛ ti tumdi tuma tiri ba.
en: The Amorites continued to live at Aijalon, Shaalbim, and Mount Heres, but the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh kept them under their rule and forced them to work for them.

dag: Ka so yi do m-baɣ o ka ti kpi n-libig o, ka di chɛ ka o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa bi lan be kasi, dindina ŋun pinim o zuɣu maa o ni ti yɛn yi daɣiri ni dahin shɛli. O pinim li daba ayopɔin dali.
en: If your consecrated hair is defiled because you are right beside someone who suddenly dies, you must wait seven days and then shave your head; and so you become ritually clean.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni yi di yimaŋ shɛhira ni yi nyɛla bɛn daa ku anabinim maa yaansi.
en: But you prove you really are the relatives of the ones who killed the prophets.

dag: dama niriba pam suhuri ni tɛha ni ti yi palo o zuɣu. Ka suhusaɣiŋgu ti ŋma amaŋmaŋ gba suhu kaman takɔb la.
en: and so reveal their secret thoughts. And sorrow, like a sharp sword, will break your own heart.

dag: Zoya daa nya a ka sɔhigi. Kopaliga daa ŋme n-gari, ka teeku bulli duhi di kukoli. Wuntaŋ duhi di nuhi zuɣusaa.
en: The mountains see you and writhe. A flood of water rushes through. The deep utters its voice; it raises its hands aloft.

dag: Bɛtani mini Jɛrusalɛm bi wɔɣa ni taba; di nyɛla kaman mail ayi laasabu.
en: Bethany was a little less than two miles from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim ni bɛnkam zaa kpalim ka nyɛ bɛn daa yi Babilɔn labina maa daa yooi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Then the Israelites, the priests and the Levites, and the rest of the returned exiles joyfully celebrated the dedication of this house of God.

dag: Wuhim ma n ni bi nyari shɛli, di yi nyɛla n tumla tuumbiɛri, n ku lan tum lala yaha?.
en: You teach me what I cant see; if Ive sinned, I wont do it again.

dag: Bɛla ni daa ti kpi, Jɔbab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛra bia, ka o ya nyɛ Bɔzira la n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah became the new king. Jobab came from Bozrah.

dag: Miriya ka yi damdi binyɛra maa tooni bee n-jɛm binyɛra maa, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun zabiri nyuli, ka darigiri bihi tibili bɛ banim mini bɛ manim bɛn je ma taali zuɣu hal zaŋ tabili bɛ yaantibichɛhi gba.
en: Do not bow down to any idol or worship it, because I am the Lord your God and I tolerate no rivals. I bring punishment on those who hate me and on their descendants down to the third and fourth generation.

dag: ka chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman ti Duuma ni bɔri ni yi be shɛm, ka kul tumdi din tiɣir o nini. Ka lan chɛ ka yi bebu ni tooi mali wala kaman tia la tuun suŋ balibu kam ni, ka yi kul ni zoori pahiri Naawuni baŋbu puuni.
en: that this will help you live in a way that brings honor to the Lord and pleases him in every way; that your life will produce good works of every kind and that you will grow in your knowledge of God ;.

dag: Paɣ bi simdi ni o ye doo situra, ka doo gba bi simdi ka o ye paɣ situra, dama ŋunkam niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima, di nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Women are not to wear men's clothing, and men are not to wear women's clothing; the Lord your God hates people who do such things.

dag: O daa chɛ ka o kukoli yi zuɣusaa na ka yi wum li ni di chɛ ka o wuhi ya. O daa wuhi ya o buɣim titali dunia ŋɔ ni, ka yi daa wum o kukoli buɣim sunsuuni.
en: From heaven he made you hear his voice in order to discipline you. On earth he showed you his great fire. You heard his words from that very fire.

dag: Tuumbiɛrinim maa zaa so ʒimi? Bɛ zaŋ n niriba leei bindirigu dira, ka bi jɛmdi ma.
en: Don't they know? God asks. Are these evildoers ignorant? They live by robbing my people, and they never pray to me.

dag: Doo daa bi lan kpalim Ai bee Bɛtɛl. Bɛ daa yimi kari doli Izraɛlnima, ka chɛ bɛ tiŋ maa dunoli yali.
en: All the men of Ai and Bethel chased the army of Israel. The city was left open—no one stayed to protect the city.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrikɔnim daa kana ti yɛli Ilaisha, Ti dana, yiya ŋɔ ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ viɛli pam kaman a gba ni nya li shɛm, amaa di kom nyɛla ko biɛɣu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka paɣiba zaŋdi bahira.
en: The men of the city said to Elisha, Sir, you can see this city is in a nice place, but the water is bad. That is why the land cannot grow crops.

dag: Yuŋ ti ku lan beni; bɛ mi ti ku bɔri firila bee wuntaŋ neesim, dama ti Duuma Naawuni maŋmaŋa nti yɛn nyɛ bɛ neesim, ka bɛ ni ti di nam hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: There will never be night again. People will not need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun. The Lord God will give them light. And they will rule like kings forever and ever.

dag: Dama Naa mi yɛla ŋɔ zaa, di zuɣu ka n tɔɣisiri li bahiri mmaŋa o sani maa; yɛla ŋɔ zaa shɛli bi sɔɣi o sani, dama di daa bi niŋla ashilɔni.
en: None of these things happened off in a corner somewhere. I am sure that King Agrippa knows what I am talking about. That's why I can speak so plainly to him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali buɣim sɔŋ dundɔŋ sunsuuni ʒiya wuɣisira, ka Pita daa chaŋ ti ʒini pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: The soldiers started a fire in the middle of the yard and sat together. Peter sat with them.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n daa po pɔri yɛli ba tiŋgban nɛli maa ni ni n ku lan zaŋ ba tahi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam, ka lan nyɛ tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali jilima gari tiŋgbɔna zaa la ni.
en: I made another promise to those people in the desert. I promised that I would not bring them into the land I was giving them. That was a good land filled with many good things. It was the most beautiful of all countries!.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa ti kani, ka o bia Manaasa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Hezekiah lay down with his ancestors. His son Manasseh succeeded him as king.

dag: Yawɛ mi ti tɛha, ka di nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: The Lord knows what we think; he knows how senseless our reasoning is.

dag: Taainim mɛla birini gili bɛmaŋa, ka va anzinfa mini salima puli kaman taŋkpaɣu la!.
en: Tyre has built a fortress and piled up silver and gold, as though they were dust or mud from the streets.

dag: Ka yi ni bɛn ti kpalim ni ti bahi yoli yi dimnim tiŋgbɔna ni bɛ mini bɛ yaannim daalahichi zuɣu, bɛ ni ti bahi yoli kaman bɛ yaannim maa.
en: So the survivors will rot away in their sin in their enemies countries. They will rot away in their sins just as their ancestors did.

dag: O lan yɛli ni a lɔri nia ni a chɛ ka anabinim moli gili Jɛrusalɛm puuni zaŋ chaŋ a polo n-yɛri ni a nyɛla Juda naa. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛli Pɛriʒia naa. Di zuɣu n-chɛ ka n yɛli ni a chirigim ma ka ti tɔɣisi di yɛla maa.
en: You even have prophets in Jerusalem, claiming you are now the king of Judah. You know the Persian king will hear about this, so let's get together and talk it over.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la.
en: The entire priestly vest was made of fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool. Thin sheets of gold were hammered out and cut into threads that were skillfully woven into the vest.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, nyini ŋun yuri niriba ŋɔ, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi zaa daa bela a nuu ni, bɛ daa dolila a naba, ka deer a noli.
en: Yes, the Lord loves his people. All his holy people are in his hand. They sit at his feet and learn his teachings!.

dag: Ka o dɔro maa daa dii naai, ka o baŋ o niŋgbuŋ ni ni o nya alaafee.
en: As soon as she touched his coat, her bleeding stopped. She felt that her body was healed from all the suffering.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa daa ti bɛ suɣa zalila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa nudirigu polo.
en: This clan was to camp on the south side of the Tent.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba ni dinzuɣu bɛ chɛ ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ zuɣuri dol o chaŋ ti wuhi doo maa taali ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: and your leaders can go with me. If this man has really done anything wrong, they can accuse him there.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ bini ŋmahiŋmahi yimaŋa kpiimba zuɣu bee n-chihi yimaŋ chiha. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Do not cut your bodies for the dead or put marks on yourselves; I am the LORD.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa suhi naa ka o zaŋ Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo zali Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni tuma zaashɛhi ni. Amaa ka Daniɛl ŋun daa kul kpalim be nayili.
en: At Daniels urging, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to administer the province of Babylon, but Daniel himself remained at the royal court.

dag: Di ni simdi ni o niŋ naɣilaa maa shɛm m-bala, kaman o ni yɛn niŋ alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa la shɛm, di simdi ka o niŋ naɣilaa ŋɔ gba lala, ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li yo bɛ daalahichi maa samli, ka bɛ daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: He must offer these parts, just as he offered the bull of the sin offering. In this way the priest will make the people pure, and God will forgive them.

dag: Juda kpambaliba mini Jɛrusalɛm kpambaliba ni namɔɣilisi ni maligumaaniba ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn daa tim naɣisaa maa pirigibu maa sunsuuni gari la.
en: The officials of Judah and Jerusalem, the eunuchs and priests, and all the people who passed through the pieces of the calf.

dag: Dama Yawɛ nyɛla wuntialana ka yuri wuntia tuma. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi n-nyɛ bɛn ni tooi nya o ni bɛ nini.
en: The Lord is righteous and loves good deeds; those who do them will live in his presence.

dag: Goli maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali nyɛla chuɣu, yi yɛn ŋubirila bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: The following day will begin the Festival of Thin Bread, which will last for a week. During this time you must honor me by eating bread made without yeast.

dag: Dinzuɣu zomiya Yawɛ, ka gbaamiya yimaŋ yi tuma ni; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ bi bɔri ŋaribu bee gaŋbu bee yi bɔri ni niriba tiri ya birapu.
en: You must fear the Lord . Protect justice and do what is right because the Lord our God is fair. He does not treat some people as if they are more important than others, and he does not accept bribes to change his judgments.

dag: N suhu ni yɛla yi ti galisi pam, a suhukpaŋsibo nyɛla din tiri ma suhupiɛlli.
en: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa laɣisi pam dini daa bi guura; ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa laɣisi biɛla dini mi daa bi poor o.
en: As the scripture says, The one who gathered much did not have too much, and the one who gathered little did not have too little.

dag: O daa zaŋ zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔna ti ba, ka bɛ daa deei niriba maa ni su shɛlikam zaa su.
en: He gave them the lands of other peoples and let them take over their fields.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa siɣi niriba maa sani nti zaŋ li yɛli ba.
en: Moses then went down to the people and told them what the Lord had said.

dag: Inok ni daa dɔɣi Mɛtusɛla maa nyaaŋa, o daa jɛmdi Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga hal ti paai yuun kɔbisita. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Enoch walked with God. After Methuselahs birth, Enoch lived years; and he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Lɔtan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɔri mini Hɛman. Lɔtan tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Timna.
en: Lotan's sons were Hori and Heman; his sister was Timna.

dag: Yɛnnim yɛm n-chɛ ka bɛ mi bɛ ni chani luɣ shɛli, amaa jɛra bɛn jɛrilim kpɛhiri ba la yɔɣu.
en: Why is a clever person wise? Because he knows what to do. Why is a stupid person foolish? Because he only thinks he knows.

dag: nti nya ka o nyaandol shɛb bi doli bɛ kali soli paɣiri bɛ nuhi ka diri bindirigu.
en: They saw some of his disciples eating food with unclean hands. They were eating without first ritually purifying their hands through washing.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti ŋub li, ti kpaamiya li bahi tiŋa kaman kom la.
en: Do not use the blood for food; instead, pour it out on the ground like water.

dag: ni Kɛila ni Akizib ni Marɛsha ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara awɛi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Keilah, Aczib, and Mareshah. In all, there were nine towns and all the fields around them.

dag: Di saha, Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya la ti ku lan zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalim zuliya shɛb bɛn bahiri ba yol la, amaa bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalimla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ka biɛhiŋ kani.
en: A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka ninsalinim tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa? Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka bɛ nyɛ biriti bee tikpiranima bee n-nyara bee n-nyɛ zoomba? Pa man Yawɛ?.
en: Then the LORD said to him, Who gives people the ability to speak? Whos responsible for making them unable to speak or hard of hearing, sighted or blind? Isnt it I, the LORD?.

dag: Ka kum daa ti lu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Ka Ibram daa yiɣisi chaŋ Ijipti ni o ti ʒini nimaani n-niŋ daba ayi, dama kum maa daa miiya pam bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: During this time there was not enough food in the land, so Abram went down to Egypt to live.

dag: Ka maligumaana zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa n-zaŋ li vie binyila din be bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la, ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim bahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara maligu nyɔri buɣim sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu la naba zaashee.
en: The priest will take some of its blood and, using his finger, will put it on the horns of the altar of entirely burned offerings. But he will pour all the rest of the blood out at the base of the altar.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita bɔh o, N Duuma, ŋun sani ka ti yɛn chaŋ? Nyini m-mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu yɛtɔɣa.
en: Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words that give eternal life.

dag: Dinzuɣu n kul ni yiini yila paɣir a yuli, n yi ti zaŋ n ni lo alikauli ni n zaŋ binshɛli n-tir a dabisili kam la na ti ti a.
en: Then I will sing praises to your name forever, and I will do what I promised every single day.

dag: Luk kɔŋko n-kul kpalim be n sani. Zaŋm Maak m-pah amaŋ zuɣu kana, dama o nyɛla ŋun tooi sɔŋdi ma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he can help me in the work.

dag: Tɔbutuhiriba ŋɔ zaa daa malila shili doli taba kaman bɛ ni chani tɔb tuhibu shɛm n-ka Hiburɔn na ni suhuyini, ka bɛ nia daa nyɛla bɛ zaŋ Dauda leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa; lala ka Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri daa yu ni bɛ zaŋ Dauda leei bɛ naa.
en: All of these soldiers voluntarily came to Hebron because they wanted David to become king of Israel. In fact, everyone in Israel wanted the same thing.

dag: ka zaŋ bubihi pola maa gbandi pɔb o nuchɛhi min o nyiŋgoli;.
en: On his arms and smooth neck she put the hide of young goats.

dag: Ɛlishama ni Ɛliada ni Ɛlifɛlɛt.
en: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

dag: N yi tɛh a soya yɛla, ŋ-ŋmaligirimi dol a zaligunim maa.
en: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka yɛli ba, Nam yini puuni niriba yi ŋmaligi tuhiri taba, bɛ nam maa ni wurim; ka tin yin nim bee yil yin nim yi ŋmaligi zabira, bɛ tiŋ maa bee bɛ yili maa mi wurindimi.
en: Because Jesus knew what they were thinking, he replied, Every kingdom involved in civil war becomes a wasteland. Every city or house torn apart by divisions will collapse.

dag: Kaman salima baŋa ni be kuruchu nyee ni shɛm, lala n-nyɛ paɣ viɛlli ŋun ka yɛm.
en: Like a gold ring in a pigs nose is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

dag: Bɛ mi bi zɔri Naawuni.
en: They don't even fear God.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa miri ba daa wum bɛ kuhigu ka guui; dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Tiŋgbani ni vali ti gba.
en: The rest of the Israelites heard their screams, so they ran off, shouting, We don't want that to happen to us.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa lan yɛli Haga, N ni chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam hal ka so ti ku tooi kali ba.
en: The angel of the Lord also said, From you will come many people—too many people to count.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Ɛfɛsus, ka Pool chɛ Akuila mini Prisila ka chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu ni o mini ba ti tɔɣisi Naawuni yɛla.
en: After they arrived in Ephesus, he left Priscilla and Aquila and entered the synagogue and interacted with the Jews.

dag: N ni darigi Bɛl din be Babilɔn ŋɔ tibili, ka chɛ ka o gbuɣ o ni daa vali binshɛŋa la bahi. Zuliya kam ku lan jɛm o. Babilɔn goma luya.
en: I will punish the false god Bel in Babylon. I will make him vomit out the people he swallowed. The wall around Babylon will fall, and other nations will stop coming to Babylon.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla shia, ka di niŋ kamaata ni bɛn jɛmd o, jɛmd o ni bɛ shihi ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: God is spirit. So the people who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.

dag: Ti yi nya wahala, di nyɛla yi suhumaabo mini yi tiliginsim nyabu zuɣu; ka ti yi nya suhumaabo, di nyɛla yi suhumaabo shɛli yi ni nyari yi ni niŋdi suɣilo n-diri wahala shɛŋa ti gba ni diri la zuɣu.
en: If we have troubles, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is so that we can comfort you. And this helps you patiently accept the same sufferings we have.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia garigi yɛl o, Di bi to ni mahim chaŋ tooni polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia, dinzuɣu chɛ ka di labila nyaaŋa polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia.
en: It's normal for the sun to go forward, Hezekiah answered. But how can it go back.

dag: o naan zo dilan nambɔɣu ka yɛli, Famiy o bahi, ka o ku siɣi gballi ni; dama n nya soli ni n fa o bahi.
en: The angel shows kindness, commanding death to release us, because the price was paid.

dag: Dabiɛm mini suhuchihibo n-daa lu bɛ zuɣu. A nuu din galisi ŋɔ zuɣu, bɛ kul fomi doya chichi kaman kuɣili la hal ka nyin Yawɛ niriba ti gari; hal ka a ni daa tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb la ti gari.
en: Terror and dread fall upon them. They see your strength, O Lord , and stand helpless with fear until your people have marched past— the people you set free from slavery.

dag: Dunia zaa ni kul be ŋun nyɛ Tuumbiɛrilan la sulinsi ni la zaa yoli, tinim mi ni ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi.
en: We know that we belong to God, but the Evil One controls the whole world.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, A ni suhila yɛm ka bi suhi nyɛvil wɔɣinli bee azichi bee a dimnim nyaŋbu, amaa ka suhila yɛm din ni chɛ ka a baŋ din tuhi la zuɣu.
en: God said to him, Because you have asked for this instead of requesting long life, wealth, or victory over your enemies—asking for discernment so as to acquire good judgment.

dag: Ka do so daa be nimaani n-garigi bɔhi ba, Ka anabinim maa ba lee nyɛ ŋuni? Dinzuɣu lala yɛtɔɣili maa daa leei yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ka bɛ mal li yɛra, Sool gba nyɛla anabi.
en: A man who lived there asked, How about these other prophets—who do you think their fathers are? This is how the saying originated, Has even Saul become a prophet.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa be Yisa sani saha shɛl o ni daa neei Lazarɔs kum ni gballi ni la daa di o shɛhira.
en: The crowd who had been with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead were testifying about him.

dag: Kaman bɛ ni yi dooi samafuu pa yaɣiri duɣu zuɣu shɛm la, lala n-nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ viɛla o noli ni, ka zaɣ biɛɣu be o suhu ni.
en: Good words that hide an evil heart are like silver paint over a cheap, clay pot.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, yiɣisim zani a naba zuɣu ka n tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa.
en: saying, Mortal man, stand up. I want to talk to you.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu Naa Hɛrɔd dɔɣim dabisili dali, ka Hɛrɔdias bipuɣiŋga yi salo ni na nti wa waa ka di niŋ Naa Hɔrɔd nyaɣisim pam.
en: On Herod's birthday the daughter of Herodias danced in front of the whole group. Herod was so pleased.

dag: Kuriinius n-daa nyɛ Siria Gomna niriba yuya tuui sab maa saha.
en: When this first census took place, Quirinius was the governor of Syria.

dag: N wum Izraɛlnim ni ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni shɛm maa. Yɛlim ba ni yi yɛn ŋubirila nimdi yuŋ, ka diri bindirigu mi tiɣiri asiba, ka baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Ive heard the complaints of the Israelites. Tell them, At twilight you will eat meat. And in the morning you will have your fill of bread. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dali asibaasi, di ni daa na bi neei zaa saha shɛli ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la daa chaŋ siliga maa gbini nti nya ka kuɣili din daa yo siliga maa nol la biligimi doya.
en: Early on Sunday morning, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb. She saw that the large stone was moved away from the entrance.

dag: n yɛri ya la zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi zaa ni ti kpi, yi ti ku yuui yi ni yɛn du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ti kpe tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni nti dee li su maa ni.
en: you will be destroyed. I am warning you today, if you turn away from God, you will not live long in that land across the Jordan River that you are ready to enter and take for your own.

dag: A ni ti zaŋ n yɛligu yɛli ba, bɛ yi ni wum li bee bɛ yi ni zaɣisi li wumbu, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: You will tell them whatever I tell you to say, whether they listen or not. Remember what rebels they are.

dag: bɛ daŋ niriba maa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tusaata ni kɔbisiyi.
en: their enrollment by their clans was .

dag: Ka di ni yiri so tooni na maa yi tuhi nintɔri ka di shihi ninvuɣ so ŋun ka daɣiri, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If he spits on you, you must wash your clothes and bathe in water. You will be unclean until evening.

dag: O daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Ɛdom, ka Ɛdomnim zaa daa leei Dauda ni su shɛba. Dauda daa yi chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa Yawɛ chɛ ka o dirila nasara.
en: He stationed soldiers in Edom, and all the Edomites became Davids slaves. The LORD gave David victory wherever he went.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa zaŋ Naawuni daalikauli zaligunim zaa yɛla yɛli niriba zaa la nyaaŋa, o daa zaŋla naɣibihi mini buhi ʒim ni kom n-zaŋ taaŋkɔro vari mini piɛkɔb ʒɛhi tim di ni n-zaŋ li mihi Naawuni Zaligu Kundi la mini niriba maa zaa.
en: First, Moses proclaimed to the people all the commandments as set forth in the Law. Then he took the blood of bulls and goats, mixed it with water, and sprinkled it on the book of the Law and all the people, using a sprig of hyssop and some red wool.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋm a niriba yi yuŋ chaŋ mɔɣu ni nti sɔɣ dɔni gu ba.
en: This is what I think you should do. Lead your army here during the night and hide in the fields.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di simdi ni dunɔdali ŋɔ kul yo n-ʒiɛya, di bi simdi ni di yooi, ka so mi di doli li kpe. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ daa doli li kpe, dinzuɣu di simdi ni di kul yomi ʒiɛya.
en: The Lord said to me, This gate will stay shut. It will not be opened. No one will enter through it, because the Lord of Israel has entered through it. So it must stay shut.

dag: Di saha Chɛmɔshi yɛla ni ti gbaai Mɔabnim vi kaman Izraɛlnim ni daa niŋ Bɛtɛl naani ka di yɛla ti gbahi ba vi shɛm la.
en: Then the Moabites will be disillusioned with their god Chemosh, just as the Israelites were disillusioned with Bethel, a god in whom they trusted.

dag: Amaa ka o kpee la daa tah o zuɣu ka bɔh o, A bi zɔri Naawuni? A bi nya ka bɛ bahi noli ni bɛ kum ti min o zaa?.
en: Responding, the other criminal spoke harshly to him, Dont you fear God, seeing that youve also been sentenced to die?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa dol o la daa naanyi di ka nyu, ka gbe nimaani. Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka o yiɣisi ka yɛli ba, N suhiri soli ni n labi n dan sani.
en: Abraham's servant and the men with him ate and drank, then spent the night there. The next morning they got up, and the servant told Rebekah's mother and brother, I would like to go back to my master now.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla a jɛmbu duu maa ni benibu zuɣu hal ti yɛli ni bo m-bala. N niŋgbuŋ yaɣa pinaayi kul yiinila yila ni suhupiɛlli paɣiri nyin Naawuni ŋun kul be ŋɔ.
en: How I want to be there! I long to be in the Lord 's Temple. With my whole being I sing for joy to the living God.

dag: Yɛnnim chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa viɛla; ka bɛ zaŋdi balima yɛtɔɣa niŋdi bɛ noya ni pahira.
en: Intelligent people think before they speak; what they say is then more persuasive.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa wum niriba maa yɛligu maa, ka o gba daa lan zaŋ li yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Samuel listened to everything the people said and repeated it directly to the LORD.

dag: Vuhim Dabisili dali kam, Aduna ni zaŋdi li zaani ka di doli soli Yawɛ tooni kaman lzraɛlnim ʒiɛyimtali, ka di leei alikauli sahakam.
en: Every Sabbath, for all time to come, the bread must be placed in the presence of the Lord . This is Israel's duty forever.

dag: Ka Omri daa ti tum alahichi Yawɛ sani n-gari na shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: Omri did evil in the LORDs eyes, more evil than anyone who preceded him.

dag: Ka Pɛkahia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the great things Pekahiah did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ku lo kpara pahi yi zuɣu du, yi mini ba zaa tarili ni bela Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: If, however, they dont cross with you, equipped for war, they will take possession of property with you in the land of Canaan.

dag: Ka Aduna bia Ɛliɛza gba daa kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Gibia fɔntin shɛli din be Ifriim zoya tiŋgban ni, ka o daa zaŋ li ti o bia Finɛhas la.
en: Eleazar son of Aaron died and was buried at Gibeah, the town in the hill country of Ephraim which had been given to his son Phinehas.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Yisa ni kahig omaŋa wuhi o nyaandoliba m-pahi siɣim buta o kum ni neebu la nyaaŋa.
en: This, then, was the third time Jesus appeared to the disciples after he was raised from death.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, m mi n ni lɔn ya nia shɛŋa. Di nyɛla nia shɛŋa n ni lo zaŋ chaŋ yi zaɣ viɛlli polo ka pa ni yi zaɣ biɛɣu polo. N ni chɛ ka yi kul mali dahin shɛli biɛhigu tahima.
en: I will bless you with a future filled with hope—a future of success, not of suffering.

dag: N ni daa be Damaskus, Naa Arɛtas ni daa zali so ka o su Damaskus fukumsi la daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi chaŋ ti zan la tiŋ maa gooni dunoya ni ni bɛ gu soli gbaai ma.
en: When I was in Damascus, the governor under King Aretas wanted to arrest me, so he put guards around the city.

dag: Amaa ka pii din mali kpiɔŋ daa be tiŋ maa ni, ka dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa ni tiŋ maa ni nanim zaa daa zo nti kpe di ni, ka yo di dunoli n-kpari bɛmaŋ niŋ di ni. Ka du pii maa kpaakpaanyom ni ha ti beni.
en: But there was a strong tower inside the city. All the men and women and all the citys leaders had fled there, shut themselves inside, and climbed to the towers roof.

dag: Ŋunkam yɛli ninvuɣ biɛɣu ni o ka taali, dilan nyɛla niriba ni yɛn turi so, ka zuliya kam zaɣis o;.
en: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.

dag: A ku lan ti ti kpiɔŋ, ka a niriba ŋɔ lan nya suhupiɛlli a sani yaha?.
en: Wont you bring us back to life again so that your people can rejoice in you?.

dag: Buɣisim nya Yawɛ ni viɛli shɛm; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zo nti sɔɣ o sani mali alibarika.
en: Find out for yourself how good the Lord is. Happy are those who find safety with him.

dag: O daa nyɛla yɛndana n-gari yɛnnim zaa. Hal o daa nyɛla yɛndana n-gari Ɛtan ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛzra nir la mini Hɛman ni Kalikol ni Darida bɛn daa nyɛ Mahol bihi la. Ka o yuli daa du pam zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ba zaa ni.
en: He was wiser than anyone, more wise than Ethan the Ezrahite or Mahols sons: Heman, Calcol, and Darda. His reputation was known throughout the region.

dag: Di daa malila dunɔdura ayopɔin, ka di zɔntua be di puuni. Bɛ daa ŋmɛla abie tihi pa di pilanim maa zaa zuɣu. Yaɣili kam daa malila zaɣ yiniyini.
en: Seven steps led up to it, and its entrance room was also at the end facing the courtyard. There were palm trees carved on the inner walls that faced the passageway.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋubi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni vamahili kam, ka saɣim bɛ puri atam.
en: They devoured all the plants in their land; they devoured the fruit of their soil.

dag: Yawɛ, teem a dimnim maa ni maani a ansarisi shɛm la yɛla; ka jɛra gba ʒiɛm a yuli.
en: So remember this, LORD: how enemies have insulted you, how unbelieving fools have abused your name.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa yɛl o nachimba maa, Ʒiɛnya buŋ ŋɔ sani, ka m mini bia ŋɔ chaŋ kpe ha ti jɛm Naawuni ka labina.
en: He told his servants, Stay here with the donkey, while my son and I go over there to worship. We will come back.

dag: Yi gba yumiya saamba, dama yi daa nyɛla saamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: And you should also care for them, because you were foreigners in Egypt.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli salo maa zaa ni bɛ laɣimmi ʒini momaha zuɣu. Ka o daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi maa, ka kpuɣ o zuɣu n-lihi zuɣusaa ka niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba, ka bɛ zaŋ li tari salo maa.
en: He ordered the crowds to sit down on the grass. He took the five loaves of bread and the two fish, looked up to heaven, blessed them and broke the loaves apart and gave them to his disciples. Then the disciples gave them to the crowds.

dag: Dunianim ku tooi zaɣisi ya, amaa bɛ ni zaɣisi mani, n ni yɛri ni bɛ tuma bie la zuɣu.
en: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbibiya n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa zaa, ka tummiya di tuma, dina n-ni chɛ ka n ni zaŋdi ya kuni tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa ti ku gbuɣi ya bahi.
en: You must keep all my rules and all my regulations, and do them so that the land I am bringing you to, where you will live, wont vomit you out.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn lo nia biɛri bɛ suhuri ni, ka kul bɔrila zabili.
en: who plot evil things in their hearts, who pick fights every single day!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ n-yɛra, ka booni dunianim zaa bɛn be wulimpuhili polo mini wulinluhili polo.
en: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya suhukpeeni, dama n niŋ Naawuni yɛda ni o ni chɛ ka o malaika maa yɛli ma shɛm maa shiri ni niŋ pali.
en: Cheer up! I am sure that God will do exactly what he promised.

dag: Bɛ yi ti nya so, bɛ ni zaŋ bini kuh o ka di pili yi, ka bɛ mi yi ti gbaai so, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔb ku o.
en: Those men who are captured will be killed by a sword.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o, N yi yu ni o kul kpalim beni hal ka n ti labina, di lee nya a ya? Nyin dee doli ma.
en: Jesus answered, Maybe I want him to live until I come. That should not matter to you. You follow me.

dag: Ka naŋgbankpeeni daa ti kpe Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba mini Yɛhudia ninvuɣ so sunsuuni bɛ ni paɣibu kali dolibu zuɣu.
en: Some of John's disciples began arguing with a Jew about the matter of ritual washing.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim nyɛla Naawuni sariakaribo din tuhi shihira, ka di wuhiri ni Naawuni chɛ ka yi leei bɛn simdi ŋun Naawuni nam shɛli zuɣu yi ni diri wahala ŋɔ ni kpɛbu.
en: All of this proves that God's judgment is just and as a result you will become worthy of his Kingdom, for which you are suffering.

dag: O daa yɛliya, N ni lɛbi n nyaaŋa biri ba. N ni nya bɛ bahigu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, dama bɛ nyɛla ʒiɛman golimanima. Bɛ nyɛla bi shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim.
en: and said, You are unfaithful and can't be trusted. So I won't answer your prayers; I'll just watch and see what happens to you.

dag: ka yi ti kari yi dimnim bɛn zaa be di ni kaman Yawɛ ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛm.
en: and so the LORD will drive out all your enemies from before you, just as he promised.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, jɛra kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa. So bi mi din yɛn niŋ, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛl o kpee din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha?.
en: Fools talk too much! No one knows what will happen; no one can say what will happen in the future.

dag: Di niŋ ma yoli n ni daa zaŋ Sool leei naa maa zuɣu, dama o chɛ ma dolibu ka bi lan doli n zaligunima. Ka Samuɛl suhu daa yiɣisi, ka o kuhi niŋ Yawɛ dindali maa yuŋ zaa.
en: Saul has stopped following me, so I am sorry that I made him king. He is not doing what I tell him. Samuel became angry and cried to the Lord all night.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha, ka kulibɔŋ maa kom maa nyuui, saa ni daa bi lan miri bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni la zuɣu.
en: But after a while, it dried up because there was no rain.

dag: ka daa zaŋ fɔŋ maa puri mini di tiŋkpansi zaa ti Kalɛb ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛfune bia la.
en: But the citys fields and its settlements they gave to Caleb, Jephunnehs son.

dag: Bɛ ni daa piripiri dunɔgulibo tuma maa Kɔra daŋ niriba mini Mɛrari daŋ niriba maa sunsuuni shɛm m-bala.
en: This is the assignment of guard duty to the clan of Korah and the clan of Merari.

dag: Ka Biliha ŋun daa nyɛ Reechɛl dabipaɣ la bidibisi daa nyɛ Dan mini Naftali.
en: The sons of Rachel's slave Bilhah were Dan and Naphtali.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa yɛli Filip, Guumi paai chɛchɛbuŋ ŋɔ lana.
en: The Spirit told Philip to catch up with the chariot.

dag: Daadam, sabimi zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yuli sɔŋ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Babilɔn naa teei gilila Jɛrusalɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Human one, write down todays date, because today the king of Babylon has set up camp at Jerusalem—today!.

dag: Bɛn mali kpiɔŋ tɔbiri kabisiya, ka ninvuɣ gbarima nya yaa.
en: The bows of strong soldiers are broken, but the weak grow strong.

dag: Musa daa zalila Lɛvinim bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la zaligu yɛli.
en: he gave a command to the Levites. Moses said.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka a ni lihiri ti ka ti mini ti puri maa zaa kpi? Zaŋm bindirigu taɣi ti mini ti puri maa, ka ti mini ti puri maa zaa leei Firawuna daba; ka ti ti bimbira din ni chɛ ka ti gali ka ku kpi, ka ti puri maa gba ku kpalim doya yoli.
en: Don't let us starve and our land be ruined. If you'll give us grain to eat and seed to plant, we'll sell ourselves and our land to the king. We'll become his slaves.

dag: Ka bɛ lar o, bɛ ni daa mi ni o kpiya zuɣu.
en: The people laughed at him, because they knew that the girl was dead.

dag: Ninsalinim ni tooi mali bɛ wuna? Binyara lala pala Naawuni.
en: Can people make their own gods? No, if they did, those would not really be gods.

dag: Di saha ka malaika ŋun pah ayɔbu daa piɛb o kikaa, ka n wum ka kukol shɛli yi salima bimbin shɛli din do Naawuni tooni la yila anahi ni na.
en: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim mini Judanim bɛn daa be Juda tiŋgbani maa ni fɔntinsi ni daa zaŋ bɛ naɣ pia kam puuni naɣ yino na mini piɛri pia kam puuni piɛ yino m-pahi bɛ ni daa zaŋ pin kasi shɛŋa zaa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni la na nti zaŋ li sɔŋsɔŋ gbilligbilli.
en: All the people who lived in the cities of Judah brought tithes of their cattle and sheep, and they also brought large quantities of gifts which they dedicated to the Lord their God.

dag: Di saha ka Zɛbul bɔh o, Ka a noli buɣibuɣi la lee be ya pumpɔŋɔ? Pa nyini n-daa yɛli ni Abimilɛk mi lee nyɛ ŋuni ka ti jɛmd o la? Pa bɛna ka a daa ʒiɛm la? To, pumpɔŋɔ cham ka a mini ba ti tuhi.
en: Zebul said to Gaal, Why arent you bragging now? You said, Who is Abimelech? Why should we obey him? You made fun of these men. Now go out and fight them.

dag: Ka du shɛli din daa ʒe Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee duu maa tooni wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita pisaayika.
en: The temple's main room was meters long, and it was in front of the most holy place.

dag: ka yuri puhigu dahi ni, ka lan yuri ni niriba booni ba bɛ karimbanima.
en: they love to be greeted with respect in the marketplaces and to have people call them Teacher.

dag: O daa zali Judanim ni bɛ jɛmmila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la kɔŋko, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi.
en: and urged Judah to seek the LORD, the God of their ancestors, by doing what the Instruction and the commandments required.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ saria karibu saha; ka Naawuni ni yihi dunia ŋɔ naa bahi.
en: Now is the time for the world to be judged. Now the ruler of this world will be thrown out.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ʒini Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-nyɛ sana n-yuui pam.
en: And Abraham lived as a stranger for a long time in the country of the Philistines.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi ti lura, nyin zaŋmi li labisi ti ti o, ka o zaŋ o chinchini maa pili gbihi ka paɣ a, ka di ti a laara Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Instead, give it back before sunset, so the owner can keep warm and sleep and ask the Lord to bless you. Then the Lord your God will notice that you have done the right thing.

dag: Nyin Asiria naa, a piɛguliba gbihiya. A ninvuɣ zuɣuri ʒeei gom. A niriba wurimya be zoya zuɣu, ka so kani ŋun ni laɣim ba.
en: Emperor of Assyria, your governors are dead, and your noblemen are asleep forever! Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to bring them home again.

dag: O ti zaŋm ba na ti ti maligumaana, ka o ti daŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maa malibu. O ti ŋmɛlimi kabi ŋmani maa nyiŋgoli, amaa o di ti ŋmɛli ŋmaag o zuɣu.
en: Take them to the priest. First, the priest will offer one bird for the sin offering. The priest will pull the birds head from its neck but he will not pull it off completely.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋme n-ku nira, bɛn kum o gba.
en: Whoever hits and kills someone must be killed too.

dag: Di saha maa Dauda daa ʒila tiŋ maa dunoya ayi sunsuuni, ka tiŋgula daa ti du n-tam dunɔdali dufahirili zuɣusaa n-lihi ha nya do so ni zɔrina o kɔŋko.
en: David was sitting between the two gates of the city. The watchman went up to the roof over the gate walls and saw a man running alone.

dag: Dama a yi bi dol ti chaŋ, wula ka bɛ ni ti baŋ ni a nini tiɣi m min a niriba ŋɔ? Ka bɔ n-leei yɛn woligi m min a niriba ŋɔ biɛhigu ka chɛ dunia ŋɔ niriba zaa biɛhigu.
en: How will anyone know that you are pleased with your people and with me if you do not go with us? Your presence with us will distinguish us from any other people on earth.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka tɔbbihi maa chɛ Pool ti wɔribariba la ni bɛ zaŋ o tahi, ka bɛn daa ŋmaligi lab bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: The next day the soldiers on horses went with Paul to Caesarea, but the other soldiers and the spearmen went back to the army building in Jerusalem.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛ kum kuyila bahi ti zuɣu yomyom, ka nintam yi ti nina ni na, ka nintam ti tɛli ti niŋkari zaa.
en: Hurry! Let them weep for us so that our eyes fill up with tears and water streams down.

dag: Dama niriba maa kaya nyɛla ʒiri kaya. Bɛ ŋmaala mɔɣu ni tia, ka ŋun kpɛri binyara zaŋ lɛbil kpe li.
en: The rituals of the nations are hollow: a tree from the forest is chopped down and shaped by the craftsmans tools.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka naa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o bahi noli ni bɛ kum baŋdiba zaa bɛn be Babilɔn.
en: When the king heard that, he became very angry. So he gave an order for all the wise men of Babylon to be killed.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ kali tinzunnim bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kaman o ba Dauda ni daa chɛ ka bɛ kali ba shɛm la. Ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi niriba tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinunaata ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were living in Israel, just as his father David had done when he was king, and the total was .

dag: Nyin ŋun nyari niriba galimi ŋɔ ni tooi mo Kpiɔŋlan Naa? Ŋunkam ŋmɛri Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni ŋun garigima.
en: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.

dag: O tiri bɛn zɔr o bindirigu; o bi tamd o daalikauli yɛla.
en: He provides food for those who honor him; he never forgets his covenant.

dag: M biɛhigu ni be kaman Masia biɛhigu la zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi gba biɛhigu be kaman m biɛhigu.
en: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ.

dag: Yɛlim naa min o ma, Ʒinimiya tariŋ ʒiishee, dama yi nam zuɣupila din viɛl la yi yi zuɣu ni lu tiŋa.
en: Tell the king and the queen mother: Come down from your lofty place, because your glorious crowns will soon be removed from your heads.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa wum di yɛla, ka bɔri ni o ku Musa. Amaa ka Musa daa zo Firawuna sani n-kuli Midian tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dahin shɛli ka o daa ti ʒi kɔbiliga gbini.
en: Pharaoh heard about what Moses did, so he decided to kill him. But Moses ran away from Pharaoh and went to the land of Midian. Moses stopped near a well in Midian.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ Jɛrusalɛm gbibbu fukumsi niŋ n tizo Hanani mini Hanania ŋun daa nyɛ birini guliba kpɛm la nuu ni, dama Hanania daa nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim ni ŋun zɔri Naawuni n-gari niriba pam.
en: I put my brother Hanani in charge of Jerusalem, along with Hananiah, the commander of the fortress, because Hananiah could be trusted, and he respected God more than most people did.

dag: m-pah o ni daa deeri salima shɛli daabihi mini kɔhigɔriba ni Areebia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nanim zaa ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni gomnanim san la zuɣu.
en: In addition to the gold brought in by the traveling merchants and traders, all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the land also brought gold and silver to Solomon.

dag: N dabisa chani yomyom gari kpalua gombo, ka m paari di tariga, ka tahima kani.
en: My days are swifter than a weavers shuttle; they reach their end without hope.

dag: hal ka n ti chɛ ka a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: and I will put your enemies under your power. Psalm :.

dag: Kahigim a daalikauli din nyɛ bɛn lur a sizuura dini la wuhi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ, ka n lu a sizuura.
en: Keep your promise to me, your servant— the promise you make to those who obey you.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n kul kuhiri boona, di chɛ ka n di vi. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri di vi; chɛ ka bɛ fo baalim n-chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: LORD, dont let me be put to shame because I have cried out to you. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them be silenced in deaths domain!.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim ti boli Izraɛl kpamba mini daŋ kam ni toondaannim zaa ni bɛ laɣim o sanna Jɛrusalɛm nti kpuɣi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la Ziɔn, din daa nyɛ Dauda tiŋ la ni na.
en: Then King Solomon summoned all the leaders of the tribes and clans of Israel to come to him in Jerusalem in order to take the Lord 's Covenant Box from Zion, David's City, to the Temple.

dag: Naawuni, Fam ma ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi. Fam ma ninkuunsinim mini bɛn bi doli zaligu la nuu ni bahi.
en: My God, save me from wicked people. Save me from cruel, evil people.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Pumpɔŋɔ a ni nya n ni yɛn niŋ Firawuna shɛm: N yi niŋ o firimiinsi o ni chɛ ka bɛ yi, yɛlimaŋli, n ni niŋ o firimiinsi, ka o kari ba yih o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh. I will use my great power against him, and he will let my people go. He will be so ready for them to leave that he will force them to go.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa duhi bɛ yee n-garigi yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, ti ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: The whole assembly shouted in reply, Yes. We must do as you have said.

dag: dama ŋunkam mali ni lan nya m-pahi mali pam, ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: For to every person who has something, even more will be given, and he will have more than enough; but the person who has nothing, even the little that he has will be taken away from him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ayuba.
en: The LORD continued to respond to Job.

dag: Dama Naawuni yɛliya: N daa wum yi suhigu n daalibarika saha, ka daa sɔŋ ya yi tiliginsim dabisili dali. Nyamiya! Pumpɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alibarika deebu saha. Nyamiya! Zuŋɔ n-nyɛ tiliginsim nyabu dabisili.
en: In the Scriptures God says, When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you. That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.

dag: Dinzuɣu a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, yihim nanim pihitanaayi la zaa nam ni, ka zaŋ sapashin kpamba zali bɛ zaashɛhi maa.
en: This is what you need to do: Remove the kings from their military posts and appoint officials in their place.

dag: Puhimiya Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.

dag: O ni daa mali bia maa chani Yisa sani ka alizin biɛɣu maa yiɣis o n-darig o. Ka Yisa tahi alizin biɛɣu maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bia maa kpaŋ, ka o zaŋ o labisi ti o ba maa.
en: While the boy was being brought, the demon attacked him and made him shake all over. Jesus ordered the demon to stop. Then he healed the boy and gave him back to his father.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa di nam ʒila Pɛriʒianim tinzuɣu din yuli daa booni Susa la. O daa di nam maa n-sula tiŋgbana kɔbiga ni pisinaayopɔin. Ŋuna n-daa su India tiŋgbɔŋ zaŋ hal ni Itiɔpia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: From his royal throne in Persia's capital city of Susa, King Xerxes ruled provinces, all the way from India to Ethiopia.

dag: Yi yi kariti ma saria bee dunianim yi kariti ma saria m baɣa kani; hal n gba kariti mmaŋ saria.
en: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.

dag: Wumma! N suhu n-yɛli ma ni n garig a, dama di muɣisi ma pam n suhu ni.
en: Your words are disturbing; now I must speak.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ tiŋgbani kɔhi ti so ka o su li sahakam, dama tiŋgbani maa nyɛla n dini, yi nyɛla tinzunnim mini saamba n sani.
en: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din bindila gɔhi mini mɔri din ka buchi, dindina Naawuni ni yɛli noli ti li, ka buɣim di li.
en: But if it grows thorns and weeds, it is worth nothing; it is in danger of being cursed by God and will be destroyed by fire.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim daa ŋme n-wurim daanya daantalisi mini tɔrokɔnim daanya ni daanya kɔniŋdi bin titali din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la, ka kpuɣi daanya maa kuli Babilɔn.
en: The Chaldeans shattered the bronze columns, the stands, and the bronze Sea that were in the LORDs temple. They carried the bronze off to Babylon.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Kpahimmiya fiig tia; Yi yi ti kul nya ka di wula puhiri va mama, di saha yi baŋya ni siɣili miriya.
en: Learn this parable from the fig tree. After its branch becomes tender and it sprouts new leaves, you know that summer is near.

dag: Mbusim din daŋ tooni pun gari; amaa ka mbusim diba ayi na doli di nyaaŋa na.
en: The first horror is over; after this there are still two more horrors to come.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Abib goli ŋɔ ni ka yi yɛn yi.
en: Today, in the month of Abib, you are going to leave.

dag: Ka Ɛli bɔh o, Wula ka o sa lee yɛl a? Di sɔɣ ma shɛli, a yi sɔɣ ma yɛtɔɣ shɛli o ni yɛl a shɛlikam maa zaa puuni, Naawuni ŋun zaŋm o ni di yɛn niŋ ma shɛm maa niŋ a, hal ŋun niŋm a gari lala gba.
en: What did the Lord tell you? Eli asked. Don't keep anything from me. God will punish you severely if you don't tell me everything he said.

dag: Ka ti daa yiɣisi Troas kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Samɔtirɛsi n-yi biɛɣu n-naanyi paai Niapolis.
en: We sailed from Troas straight for Samothrace and came to Neapolis the following day.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka Naa min o saawaranim ni o tuma zuɣulaannim bɛn mali yiko pam la niŋ ma nirilim. N daa niŋ suhukpeeni, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ nuu daa pa n zuɣu, ka n daa laɣim Izraɛl zuɣulaannima ni m mini ba lab kuli.
en: By God's grace I have won the favor of the emperor, of his counselors, and of all his powerful officials; the Lord my God has given me courage, and I have been able to persuade many of the heads of the clans of Israel to return with me.

dag: Ka Ananias yɛli, N Duuma, m pun wum doo maa yɛla niriba pam sani zaŋ chaŋ o ni niŋdi a nyaandoliba bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm alaka shɛm polo.
en: Ananias countered, Lord, I have heard many reports about this man. People say he has done horrible things to your holy people in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka salo bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa wum lala ka yɛli ni saa n-tahira. Ka shɛb mi yɛli ni malaika n-tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa shɛm maa.
en: When the crowd heard the voice, some of them thought it was thunder. Others thought an angel had spoken to Jesus.

dag: Hal n yi kuhi, Famiya ma! so bi garigiri ma. N daa duhi n yee pam, amaa ka so daa bi ti ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: I shout, He hurt me! but get no answer. No one hears my cry for fairness.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yina dabisili din pah ayi maa dali ti lu Izraɛlnim maa zuɣu n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisaayika; ka bɛ zaa nyɛla takɔbichɛriba.
en: And for the second time the Benjaminites came out of Gibeah, and this time they killed eighteen thousand trained Israelite soldiers.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mali sania maŋa ni zahimbu maŋa ni tahi maŋa ni kuruwa maŋa: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: Use honest scales, honest weights, and honest measures. I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt.

dag: Ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa n Naawuni, n suhir a, chɛ ka o nya alaafee.
en: Moses prayed, Lord God, please heal her.

dag: Amaa di daa bi yuui ka bɛ tam a tuma maa yɛla, ka daa bi guhi n-deeg a wuhibu.
en: But they quickly forgot what he had done and acted without waiting for his advice.

dag: Ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti lan tuhiri tɔbu, ka Ɛlhanan ŋun daa nyɛ Jair bia la daa ku Lahimi ŋun daa nyɛ Goliat Gaat nir la mabia, ka o kpani daɣu daa ŋmani kpalu daɣu.
en: Another time when the Israelites fought against the Philistines, Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi. Lahmi was Goliaths brother. Goliath was from the town of Gath. Lahmis spear was very big and heavy. It was like the large pole on a loom.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm daa nyɛla tin titali, amaa niriba bɛn be di ni daa bi yaɣ lala, dama bɛ daa na bi lab me yiya pam di ni.
en: Now the city was large and there was plenty of room. But there were few people in it, and the houses had not yet been rebuilt.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa dii zo n-chaŋ ti zaŋ gumdi tim komihigu ni n-zaŋ kaɣili gbab li zaŋ ti o ha ni o nyu.
en: One of them ran over, took a sponge full of vinegar, and put it on a pole. He offered it to Jesus to drink.

dag: Ka n daa labisi n garigibu zilinkom ti o ha yɛli: A ni yɛli yɛl shɛŋa yɛla ŋɔ zaa shɛli pa yɛlimaŋli, nyini n-kul ʒini tɛhi n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So I sent this answer back to Sanballat: Nothing you are saying is happening. You are just making all that up in your own head.

dag: Ti Duuma, nyam bɛ ni kpɛhi ti dabiɛm shɛm. Chɛ ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ na kul tɔɣisim a yɛligu ni suhukpeeni.
en: Now, Lord, take note of their threats and enable your servants to speak your word with complete confidence.

dag: Di bi tu ni bɛ ku bihi laamba bɛ bihi zuɣu bee n-ku bihi bɛ laamba zuɣu; kulila sokam maŋmaŋ tuumbiɛri zuɣu ka bɛ ni ku o.
en: Parents shouldnt be executed because of what their children have done; neither should children be executed because of what their parents have done. Each person should be executed for their own guilty acts.

dag: Ka n yɔri lee nyɛla dini? Di nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: M bi zaŋ n ni mali yolisim so shɛl la tumdi di tuma n lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu maa puuni, dama m bi yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu tiri niriba ka zaani ba ni bɛ yo shɛli di zuɣu.
en: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.

dag: Anabi Habakuk wunsuhigu. Di dolila Shigiɔnɔt ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: This is my prayer:.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Kulimiya ka daa labina dabisili din pahir ata dali. Ka niriba maa daa kuli.
en: Rehoboam answered, Come back to me in three days, and I will answer you. So the people left.

dag: Di saha ti Duuma ni ti bu wanzam ŋun nyɛ Asiria naa paa ka o yi Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli n-kana ti pini yi zuɣuri mini yi teensi ni yi niŋgbuna ni kɔbiri.
en: The Lord will use Assyria to punish Judah. Assyria will be hired and used like a razor to shave off Judahs beard and to remove the hair from his head and body.

dag: ka o chɛ ka bɛ laɣim o tɔbbihi min o kuriti chɛchɛbunsi kɔbisiwɛi la zaa na, ka bɛ daa yi Harɔshɛtihagɔim n-chaŋ Kishɔn Mɔɣili ni.
en: he called his troops together and got all iron chariots ready. Then he led his army away from Harosheth-Ha-Goiim to the Kishon River.

dag: ka m mi yi bɔhi ya, yi ku garigi ma.
en: And if I asked you a question, you wouldn't answer.

dag: A nyari paɣibu bibihi mini bimɔɣirisi noya ni a dimnim zuɣu. A chɛ ka a dima mini ŋun nyɛ biɛribɔhira fo bɛ noya.
en: From the mouths of children and babies come songs of praise to you. They sing of your power to silence your enemies who were seeking revenge.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Mɔdɛkai daa lan lab ti ʒi nayili samban dunol maa ni yaha; ka Haman mi daa zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu tabil o nina ŋ-ŋmaligi kuli yomyom ni suhugarigu.
en: Afterward, Mordecai returned to the Kings Gate, while Haman hurried home feeling great shame, his head covered.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ Naawuni tɛha? Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuh o shɛli? Amaa tinim nyɛla bɛn mali Masia tɛha.
en: The Scriptures ask, Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice? But we understand what Christ is thinking.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti liri Midiannim maa, dama n zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: That night the Lord commanded Gideon, Get up and attack the camp; I am giving you victory over it.

dag: Ti Duuma, neema! Bɔ n-niŋ ka a gbihira? Neema! Di chɛ ti bahi sahakam!.
en: Lord, wake up! Why are you sleeping? Get up! Dont ignore us forever!.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ŋunkam mi chɛ ka bibihi bɛn niŋ ma yɛda ŋɔ ni yino birigi, bɛ yi di zaŋ nɛ karili lo dilan nyiŋgol ni zaŋ o bahi teeku ni di naan so o zuɣu.
en: As for whoever causes these little ones who believe in me to trip and fall into sin, it would be better for them to have a huge stone hung around their necks and to be thrown into the lake.

dag: Ka Otiniɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb tizo Kɛnaz bidibiga la daa chaŋ ti tuhi deei tiŋ maa; ka Kalɛb daa shiri zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Akisa maa ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Othniel, the son of Caleb's brother Kenaz, captured the city, so Caleb gave him his daughter Achsah in marriage.

dag: Amaa pako so ŋun tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, hal o ni na ne maa zaa yoli, o nyɛla ŋun kpi.
en: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.

dag: Di saha hal ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhukpeeni kaman gbuɣinli la suhuri ni fuŋ dabiɛm zuɣu, dama Izraɛlnim zaa mi ni a ba mali kpiɔŋ. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be o sani maa nyɛla bɛn mali suhukpeeni.
en: Then even the bravest soldier, whose heart is like a lions, will melt in fear because all Israel knows that your father is a warrior and that those who are with him are brave.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti kpamdi ya jaande: Kpahimiya gbinyaɣinim zuɣu ni; ka kpaŋsimiya bɛn suhuri miligi la suhuri; ka sɔŋmiya bɛn gbarigi la; ka maliya suɣilo ni sokam.
en: We urge you, our friends, to warn the idle, encourage the timid, help the weak, be patient with everyone.

dag: Ka Musa daa chɛ ka bɛ ninvuɣ tuhilituhili bɛn yi Izraɛl zuliya kam ni na maa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas ŋun daa gbibi Naawuni jɛmbu shee lahi mini kikahi din ni piɛbi boli niriba o nuu ni la chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: Moses sent them to battle, one thousand from each tribe, along with Phinehas, Eleazar the priests son, who carried the sanctuary equipment and the trumpets for sounding the alarm in his hand.

dag: Ka o bipalitab bɛn min o daa laɣim zooi maa yɛl o, Di ni simdi ni a yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛl a, A ba daa ʒil ti ʒi tibisa pam, amaa nyin filimmi li ti ti la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, yɛlim ba, Man nubil kpaliŋga bari gari m ba shee!.
en: His younger advisors said: Here's what we think you should say to them: Compared to me, my father was weak.

dag: Laɣimmi niriba zaa n-gil amaŋa, ka ʒini a nam ʒiishee alizanda ni su ba.
en: Gather the nations around you, and take your place as judge.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn yɛli ba, M mabihi n-daa bala. M mini ba zaa nyɛla ma pu yin ni bihi. Yawɛ zuɣu, yi yi di daa chɛ ba, n naan ku kun ya.
en: Gideon said, Those men were my brothers, my mothers sons! As the Lord lives, if you had not killed them, I would not kill you now.

dag: Di saha maa man Daniɛl daa kul bela fabila ni zaŋ hal ti paai bakɔi muna ata.
en: Daniel wrote: For three weeks I was in sorrow.

dag: N niriba, zomiya yi di ni. Tiligimiya yi nyɛviya Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali ŋɔ ni.
en: Come out of the city of Babylon, my people. Run to save your lives. Run from the Lord s great anger.

dag: N dabeenzɔbo puuni n daa yɛliya, Bɛ kari ma a sani tahi katiŋa. Amaa ka n daa kuhi niŋ a bɔri sɔŋsim, ka a daa wum n ni kuhi niŋ a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu maa.
en: I was terrified and thought, They've chased me far away from you! But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.

dag: Bɛ bi muɣiri taba, bɛ zaa dolila bɛ soya. Bɛ tooi gariti bɛ ni gu ba soli luɣ shɛli, ka binshɛli ku tooi taɣ ba zali.
en: or get in each other's way. They swarm through defenses, and nothing can stop them.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o kpambaliba min o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm ni o gomnanim ni wulaannim ni tɔbbihi nyu dam buɣi. Bɛ ni gbihi go titali, ka ku lan yiɣisi. Naa ŋun yuli booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make its rulers drunk— men of wisdom, leaders, and soldiers. They will go to sleep and never wake up. I, the king, have spoken; I am the Lord Almighty.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ maa gba chɛmi ka n suhu dam, ka yiɣi yi di biɛhigu shee.
en: I am frightened and tremble all over.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ni wuhi ya o yurilim min o ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi sani; ka man gba ni niŋ ya zaɣ viɛlli yi ni daa tum tuun shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: The Lord will be kind and true to you, and so will I.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mi daa yɛli Filistia doo maa, Nyin kanila n sanna ni takɔbi mini kpan titali ni kpam bila, amaa man zaŋla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛl tɔbbihi Naawuni so a ni ta daɣiri ŋɔ yuli kan a sanna.
en: David said to the Philistine, You come to me using sword, spear, and javelin. But I come to you in the name of the Lord All-Powerful, the God of the armies of Israel. You have said bad things about him.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, yinima n-tum tuumbiɛri ŋɔ zaa, amaa di zaa yoli, di ŋmaligiya ka chɛ Yawɛ dolibu, amaa kul jɛmmiy o ni yi suhuri zaa.
en: But Samuel answered the people, Dont be afraid. Yes, youve done all this evil; just dont turn back from following the LORD. Serve the LORD with all your heart.

dag: Zimiri ni daa kul di n-ʒin o nam ʒiishee, di daa bi yuui ka o ku Baasha daŋ niriba zaa. O daa ku dɔbba bɛn nyɛ o daŋ ni niriba min o zɔnim zaa.
en: After Zimri became the new king, he killed all of Baashas family and friends. He did not let any male in Baashas family live.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mi bi tumdi tuma, amaa ka niŋ ŋun chɛ ka alahichilana yiri taali ni Naawuni sani yɛda, Naawuni zaŋd o gba zaani wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu maa zuɣu.
en: But you cannot make God accept you because of something you do. God accepts sinners only because they have faith in him.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum Yisa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka bɛ ni shɛb yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla bɛ ni daa yɛli anab so yɛla la.
en: When some in the crowd heard these words, they said, This man is truly the prophet.

dag: ni Hiburɔnnima ni ŋun Dauda min o niriba maa ni daa gɔri chani tiŋ shɛŋa zaa la nima.
en: Hebron, and all the places where David and his soldiers had spent time.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi tɛhi a zaligunim din yi kurimbuni na la yɛla, di kpaŋsirila n suhu.
en: When I remember your ancient rules, Im comforted, LORD.

dag: Naɣ kɔri bɛba ayopɔin bɛn daa yina n-kul gaŋsigaŋsi la gbinni nyɛla yuma ayopɔin, ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin din daa nyɛ biisim ni kpe shɛl la gba gbinni nyɛla kum lubu yuma ayopɔin.
en: The seven thin cows which came up later and the seven thin heads of grain scorched by the desert wind are seven years of famine.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di ni kɔbiri bi piɛla, ka di mi bi kpe puuni, amaa ka sabigi, maligumaana maa ŋun kparim o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: But if the priest looks at the spot, and there is no white hair in the bright spot, and the spot is not deeper than the skin but is faded, the priest must separate the person for seven days.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ba na kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi piɛri mini piɛlahi ni buhi tahiri nakɔha sani shɛm la.
en: Ill lead them off like lambs for slaughter, like rams and goats.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ waɣ biɛ titali ŋun nyɛ kurimbuni ha waɣ so bɛ ni booni Fiɣisira ni Sintani ŋun yɔhim dunia zaa la min o malaikanima m-bahi dunia ni na.
en: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.

dag: m-bɔh o, Zarai dabili Haga, ya ka a lee yina bee ya ka a lee chana? Ka o yɛli, N yila n lan Zarai sani zɔra.
en: The angel said, Hagar, Sarais slave girl, why are you here? Where are you going? Hagar said, I am running away from Sarai.

dag: Miri ka a di shɛhira jɛnd a kpee ka di ka daliri, ka miri ka a yɔhim so.
en: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ kabiɛlim maa ʒi n-kuli ti wuh o yidan ma o ni nya shɛm tariga. Ka daa lan zaŋ o ni ŋub ka guui bɔrɔbɔro shɛl la gba ti o.
en: Ruth carried the grain into town to show her mother-in-law what she had gathered. She also gave her the food that was left from lunch.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛl o bapir maa, O kahigimi wuhi ti ni yi nya bunsi maa. Amaa Samuɛl ni daa yɛl o nam yɛtɔɣa la dina, o daa bi saɣi yɛl o di shɛli yɛla.
en: He told us that the animals had been found, Saul answered—but he did not tell his uncle what Samuel had said about his becoming king.

dag: ka n ni lan ti o biɛŋmariga pahi.
en: They will have the same power I received from my Father, and I will give them the morning star.

dag: dama nyini m-pun nyɛ n sɔŋda, ka n kul be a kpiŋkpama mahim ni n-yiini suhupiɛlli yila.
en: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ n suhu saɣimmi zaa, ka wula ka n ni yɛli? N ni yɛli, M Ba, chɛ ka saha ŋɔ miligi n zuɣu? Aai, dama di zuɣu ka n kana nti kpalim beni hal ni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: Now I am very troubled. What should I say? Should I say, Father save me from this time of suffering? No, I came to this time so that I could suffer.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni vili tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba labi. N ni chɛ ka nandahima gbaai ba hal ka bɛ ni ti mii.
en: The LORD proclaims: Im going to eject those who live in the land at this time; I will badger them until they leave.

dag: Amaa o yɛla ni ti niŋ niriba pam alahiziba ka nanim ti kɔŋ bɛ noya yaabu o zuɣu. Dama bɛ nini ni ti nya bɛ ni daa bi yɛli ba shɛli yɛla; ka baŋ bɛ ni daa pun bi wum shɛli yɛla.
