en: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.

dag: Gol so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali ka o daa yi Babilɔn m-piligi chandi n-daa mali ti paai Jɛrusalɛm gol so ŋun pah anu dahin yini dali, dama o Naawuni daalibarika nuu daa pa o zuɣu.
en: Ezra left Babylon on the first day of the first month and arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month. With Gods blessing his trip went well.

dag: Izraɛlnim Naawuni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Izraɛl tampiŋ la yɛli ma: So yi doli yɛlimaŋli soli n-su o niriba, ka su ba ni Naawuni zɔbo.
en: The God of Israel spoke. The Rock of Israel said to me, Whoever rules people fairly, who rules with respect for God.

dag: Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Zaŋm a bia maa ti ma. Ka o daa deei bia maa paɣ maa sani n-zaŋ o du jirambisa zuɣusaa o ni daa be du shɛl ni nti zaŋ o sɔŋ omaŋmaŋ garo zuɣu;.
en: Bring me your son, Elijah said. Then he took the boy from her arms and carried him upstairs to the room where he was staying. Elijah laid the boy on his bed.

dag: Pɛriʒia Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ʒiɛman ni, Bishilam mini Mitrɛdat ni Tabiil ni bɛ tab bɛn kpalim daa sabila gbaŋ ti Pɛriʒia Naa Atazɛrikisɛs Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, ka daa lɛbigi li.
en: Later, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and their advisors got together and wrote a letter to Artaxerxes when he was king of Persia. It was written in Aramaic and had to be translated.

dag: Ka o daa yi n nyaaŋa n-kana ti ŋma ʒiri pa ma nyini n dan naa sani. Amaa nyini n dan naa ŋmanila Naawuni malaika, dinzuɣu niŋm a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani.
en: then he lied about me. You're as wise as an angel of God, so do what you think is right.

dag: ni Ɛlikana ni Ishia ni Azarɛl ni Jɔɛza ni Jashɔbiam bɛn daa nyɛ Kɔra daŋ niriba la.
en: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, all from the tribe of Korah;.

dag: Yiɣisim a suhu zaa pam n-lihi bɛnkam mali karimbaani, ka a filim ba.
en: Look at those who are proud; pour out your anger and humble them.

dag: Di galisim mini di wula wɔɣilim zuɣu daa chɛ ka di viɛla, dama di nyaɣa daa chaŋmi ti kpe kom pam ni.
en: It became beautiful in its greatness and in its lush foliage, because it took root in plentiful water.

dag: Ka Zarai daa ti yɛli Ibram, Nyama, Yawɛ bi chɛ ka n dɔɣi bihi, dinzuɣu zaŋmi n dab bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ dɔni, di pa shɛli o ni dɔɣi bihi ti ma. Ka Ibram daa saɣi Zarai ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: and Sarai said to Abram, The Lord has not given me any children. Sleep with my slave, and if she has a child, it will be mine. Abram agreed.

dag: Naa daa chɛ ka anzinfa galisi pam Jɛrusalɛm kaman kuɣa la, ka chɛ ka sida dari gba galisi pam kaman Shɛfɛla sinsabisi dari la.
en: While Solomon was king, there was silver everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as the sycamore trees in the western foothills.

dag: Biɛrim chɛ ka n nimbihi bi lan ne viɛnyɛliŋga, ka n niŋgbuŋ zaa ŋmanila shilinshia.
en: My eyes are almost blind from my grief. My whole body is as thin as a shadow.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa, Cham Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: he said to Moses: Go to the palace and tell the king of Egypt that I order him to let my people go, so they can worship me.

dag: Nyin daadam, bom tandaɣili sɔŋ a tooni, ka ŋme Jɛrusalɛm kɔtomsi pa di zuɣu.
en: Son of man, take a brick and scratch a picture on it. Draw a picture of a city—the city of Jerusalem.

dag: N naan wum o ni yɛn garigi ma shɛm, ka baŋ o ni yɛn yɛli ma shɛm.
en: I want to know what he would say and how he would answer me.

dag: Ŋun saɣindi maa ni ti liri tiŋ kam, ka tin shɛli ti ku yi. O ni ti wurim vinvamli ni tinsi, ka saɣim bɔpiɛligu ni tinsi, kaman Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: The destroyer will sweep through every town; no town will escape. The valleys will be ravaged; the plateaus will be destroyed, because the LORD has declared it so.

dag: Naawuni, yiɣisim zani n-zab amaŋ zuɣu! Teemi jɛra ni maan a ansarisi dabisi muni zaa puuni shɛm la yɛla.
en: God, get up and defend yourself! Remember, those fools challenged you.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ kpiimba kum ni neebu gba. Bɛ ni zaŋ niŋgbuŋ shɛli sɔɣi nyɛla din poora, ka din neerina mi nyɛ din bi poora.
en: Its the same with the resurrection of the dead: a rotting body is put into the ground, but what is raised wont ever decay.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni ŋmanila gɔ shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ labi; dama so ku tooi zaŋ o nuu kpuɣi ba.
en: But evil people are pulled up like thornbushes. They are not dug up by hand.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan chaŋ ti lu Keenannim bɛn be Hiburɔn la nim zuɣu n-tuhi nyaŋ Shɛshai mini Ahiman ni Talimai.
en: They marched against the Canaanites living in the city of Hebron, which used to be called Kiriath Arba. There they defeated the clans of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

dag: Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi zuliya kam niriba zuɣu. O suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ tɔbbihi zuɣu, ka zali ni o ni ku ba.
en: The LORD rages against all the nations, and is angry with all their armies. God is about to wipe them out and has prepared them for slaughter.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ shɛɣuni, ka Bɛnhadad laɣim Siria tɔbbihi n-chaŋ Afɛk ni o ti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: So in the spring of the year, Ben-hadad assembled the Arameans and marched up to Aphek to fight with Israel.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yɛn namla zuɣusaa zaɣ palli mini dunia palli, ka so ku lan teei binshɛŋa din pun gari la yɛla.
en: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be Jɔshua sani; ka o yuli daa du pam bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: So the Lord was with Joshua, and Joshua became famous throughout the whole country.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni yi lo ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni alikauli, naɣ wurimmiyala bɛ buɣa bimbina la. Amaa ka yi zaɣisi n ni zali ya shɛm maa niŋbu. Tuun bɔ ka yi lee tum maa?.
en: and you promised not to make any peace treaties with the other nations that live in the land. Besides that, you agreed to tear down the altars where they sacrifice to their idols. Why haven't you kept your promise?.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ nimaani chaŋ hal ti du Ɛkurɔn nuzaa polo kuŋkuni. Ka di tariga maa daa ŋmaligi chaŋ hal ni Shikɛrɔn n-zaŋ nimaani hal ti baɣisi Baala Zoli gari, ka lan zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Jabiniil; ka di daa naanyi kana ti paai di tariga teeku ni.
en: The border went to the slope of Ekron on the north. The border turned toward Shikkeron, passed on to Mount Baalah, and went to Jabneel. The border ended at the sea.

dag: Yinim bɛn be ʒilinsi ni ŋɔ, saha yuusim wula ka yi kul bɔri ni yi be ʒilinsi maa ni? Saha yuusim wula ka ansarisimaaniba kul yɛn be ansarisi malibu ni? Ka saha yuusim wula ka jɛra kul yɛn zaɣisiri yɛm?.
en: Foolish people! How long do you want to be foolish? How long will you enjoy making fun of knowledge? Will you never learn?.

dag: Amaa n dabili Kalɛb ni mali tɛhi shɛl la min o ni doli ma ni o suhu zaa la zuɣu, n ni zaŋ o kulis o ni daa chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni, ka o zuliya ti su li.
en: But because my servant Caleb has a different attitude and has remained loyal to me, I will bring him into the land which he explored, and his descendants will possess the land.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka sanʒiɛ tital shɛli bɛ ni booni pɔhim tilli la daa yiɣisi wulimpuhili duli polo ʒiɛrina.
en: But then a very strong wind called the Northeaster came from across the island.

dag: Jɛsi bidib kpamba ata daa dolila Sool chaŋ tɔb maa ni; o bidibis ata bɛn daa doli chaŋ tɔb maa ni yuya n-daa booni Ɛliab, ŋun daa nyɛ o bidib kpɛm la, ka ŋun daa pa o zuɣu yuli booni Abinadab, ka ŋun pah ata mi yuli booni Shamma.
en: the oldest was Eliab, the next was Abinadab, and Shammah was the third. The three of them had gone off to fight in Saul's army. David was Jesse's youngest son.

dag: A bia paɣ maa yur a, ka tum din gari bidibis ayopɔin tuma ti a. O dɔɣi yaaŋa ŋun nyɛ bidibiga ti a, ka o ni ti nyɛla ŋun ni kpaŋsir a ni ŋun ni ti gbib a a kuriginsim saha.
en: He will restore your life and sustain you in your old age. Your daughter-in-law who loves you has given birth to him. Shes better for you than seven sons.

dag: Bimbira kpila tiŋgban ni, ka ti kambɔna kpalim zaɣ kuma, ka ti kunchuna zaa saɣim, dama ti chi zaa kuuya.
en: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa zaŋ bɛ ni boli ninvuɣ shɛb yuya ŋɔ.
en: Moses and Aaron took the men who had been chosen to be leaders.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yi chɛ ka a kpalim zani dabari kaman niriba ni na ʒi n-ʒini tin shɛŋa ni, n yi zaŋ a niŋ kɔbulli ni, ka ko titali lim a.
en: I, the Lord God, will turn you into a ghost-town. The ocean depths will rise over you.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti ni yɛli? Ti tummi alahichi ti ni lan ka fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni ka bela Naawuni daalibarika sulinsi ni maa zuɣu? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: So what? Should we sin because we arent under Law but under grace? Absolutely not!.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa chɛ ka yɔɣili bili gara maa gbini n-zooi du nti pani gara maa zuɣusaa n-niŋ mahim ni Jona ʒi di lɔŋni ka o ni maha. Ka yɔɣili maa ni daa du m-pa Jona zuɣusaa shɛm maa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam.
en: Then the LORD God provided a shrub, and it grew up over Jonah, providing shade for his head and saving him from his misery. Jonah was very happy about the shrub.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔhi Yisa, Karimba, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn niŋ, ka shihir bɔ nti yɛn wuhi dimbɔŋɔnim niŋbu saha.
en: They asked him, Teacher, when will these things happen? What sign will show that these things are about to happen.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni bɛ jintɔriba zaa daa to jina naai noli, ka lo Yisa mihi zaŋ o tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: Early the next morning the chief priests, the nation's leaders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met together with the whole Jewish council. They tied up Jesus and led him off to Pilate.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka ninsalinim tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa? Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka bɛ nyɛ biriti bee tikpiranima bee n-nyara bee n-nyɛ zoomba? Pa man Yawɛ?.
en: The Lord said to him, Who gives man his mouth? Who makes him deaf or dumb? Who gives him sight or makes him blind? It is I, the Lord .

dag: Ka Asiria naa daa zaŋ Babilɔnnim mini Kutanim ni Avanim ni Hamatinim ni Sɛfarivaimnim na nti ʒili Samaria fɔntinsi ni ka chɛ Izraɛlnima. Ka niriba maa daa deei Samaria tiŋgbɔŋ m-be di fɔntinsi ni.
en: The Assyrian king brought people from Babylon, Cuth, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim, resettling them in the cities of Samaria in place of the Israelites. These people took control of Samaria and settled in its cities.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di wumdi ya anabi shɛb bɛn be yi sani ŋɔ yɛligu. Bɛ ŋmari ya la ʒiri; bɛ suhuyubu yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ tɔɣisiri maa. Di pala Yawɛ noli ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: The Lord Almighty said to the people of Jerusalem, Do not listen to what the prophets say; they are filling you with false hopes. They tell you what they have imagined and not what I have said.

dag: N sabila dimbɔŋɔ tin ya ni n yɛli ya bɛn bɔri ni bɛ yɔhim ya la yɛla;.
en: I am writing this to you about those who are trying to deceive you.

dag: Paɣiba pam gba daa be nimaani n-kaɣi ʒe kpaŋ ha yuuni din niŋ maa. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛn doli Yisa yi Galili na, ka nyɛ bɛn sɔŋd o la.
en: There were many women there, looking on from a distance, who had followed Jesus from Galilee and helped him.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nyo a yiya buɣim, ka kar a saria paɣiba pam ninni. N ni chɛ ka a ku lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma, ka a gba ku lan ti so pina.
en: and burn down your houses. Other women will watch these terrible things happen to you. I promise to stop you from being a prostitute and paying your lovers for sex.

dag: ka mali naŋgbaŋkuɣila ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ milimita pisopɔinnaanu niŋ li, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Make a frame around it that is four inches wide and a gold molding around the frame.

dag: Di tɛhiya ni n kamina ni n ti ti dunia ŋɔ nim suhudoo; m bi kamina ni n ti ti suhudoo, amaa takɔbi ka n tahina.
en: Do not think that I have come to bring peace to the earth. I did not come to bring peace. I came to bring trouble.

dag: din ni gu a ka a ku bo paɣ yoli, ka yih a paɣ zinalan naŋgbam malisim yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: It stops you from going to an evil woman, and it protects you from the smooth talk of another mans wife.

dag: Aduna ni daa nya li ka o me maligu bimbini zali di gbini, ka moli molo yɛli, Biɛɣuni ti sa yɛn puhila Yawɛ chuɣu.
en: Then Aaron built an altar in front of the gold bull-calf and announced, Tomorrow there will be a festival to honor the Lord .

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɔhim wuntizɔriba kpɛhi zaɣ biɛɣu ni ni ti lu bɛmaŋmaŋ ni gbi bɔɣ shɛŋa ni. Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi ni ti nya laara din viɛla.
en: Those who plan to hurt good people will fall into their own traps, but good things will happen to those who are good.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa garigi yɛli Firawuna, Pa mani n-wuhiri di gbinni maa, amaa Naawuni ni wuhi nyin Firawuna di gbinni ka di niŋ a nyaɣisim.
en: Joseph answered, I cannot, Your Majesty, but God will give a favorable interpretation.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni. Doliya n zalikpana la, ka gbibiya n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: I am the Lord . I am your God. Obey my laws and keep my commands. Do the things I tell you.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma!.
en: Anyone who hears these things should listen to this:.

dag: Zomiya yi Babilɔn, ka zo n-yi Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-be kaman bulahi m-be tooni mali bɛ tab chan la.
en: People of Israel, run away from Babylonia! Leave the country! Be the first to leave!.

dag: Leedan ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔn bidibisi ni yino la daa nyɛla zuliya pam zaŋ tabil o bia Jɛhiɛl daŋ niriba yabidoo.
en: from Ladans family, the family of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, and the heads of the households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

dag: Ka naa maa daa yɛli Haman, Niriba maa mini bɛ liɣiri maa zaa nyɛla a dini, niŋm bɛ min li a ni yu shɛm.
en: Do what you want with those people! You can keep their money.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa gbaai bipuɣiŋga maa nuu ni ka bol o, Bipuɣiŋga, yiɣisima.
en: But Jesus held her hand and called to her, Little girl, stand up.

dag: N daa kari doli n dimnima nti ku ba, ka n daa bi ŋmaligi labi n nyaaŋa hal ka ti naai bɛ balibu zaa.
en: I chased my enemies and defeated them. I did not stop until they were destroyed.

dag: Nimaani ka o kabisi piɛma din nyɛlisiri mini nyɔtaɣirisi ni takɔbiri ni tɔbutuhiri bidibbina.
en: It was there that he broke the fiery shafts of the bow, the shield, the sword—even the battle itself! Selah.

dag: Deem pina maa bɛ sani n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinima kaman sokam tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ zaŋ ba tum suɣili maa ni tuma.
en: Accept these gifts, so the Levites can use them here at the sacred tent for carrying the sacred things.

dag: Bɛn daa nyɛ jɛra maa daa zaŋla bɛ firilanima, ka lee bi ʒi kpam pahi ni bɛ ti gu bɛmaŋa;.
en: The foolish ones took their lamps but didnt bring oil for them.

dag: Ka Musa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Izraɛlnim maa lala. Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi li wumbu, bɛ suhugarigu mini bɛ ni daa be putɔɣu dabitim bandi shɛli ni maa zuɣu.
en: When Moses told this to the Israelites, they were too discouraged and mistreated to believe him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa chɛ ka gom gbaai doo maa pam, o ni daa gbihiri saha shɛli maa, ka o daa yih o sapir kɔb yini ka daai nimaani nimdi ŋari;.
en: So the Lord God caused the man to sleep very deeply. While he was asleep, God took one of the ribs from the mans body. Then he closed the mans skin where the rib had been.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti bɔri bɛ biɛrisuŋ bee m-bɔri bɛ tɔŋbu saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be yi nyɛvili ni.
en: Don't even think of signing a peace treaty with Moab or Ammon.

dag: Ka o yɛla daa dii moli gili Galili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: And so the news about Jesus spread quickly everywhere in the province of Galilee.

dag: Mahalalɛl ni daa ti paai yuun pihiyɔbunaanu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Jarɛd.
en: When Mahalalel was , he had a son named Jared.

dag: Ŋunkam vuɣi o kpee palo tariga kpaa, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: Cursed is anyone who tampers with their neighbors property lines. All the people will reply: We agree.

dag: Ifriimnim ni daa nya bɛ dɔro maa, ka Judanim mi nya bɛ daŋ la, di saha ka Ifriimnim daa chaŋ Asiria natital la sani ti bo sɔŋsim. Amaa o ku tooi chɛ ka yi kpaŋ bee n-tibi yi daŋ maa.
en: When Israel and Judah saw their sickness and wounds, Israel asked help from Assyria and its mighty king. But the king cannot cure them or heal their wounds.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa kpaɣi mii Sool, ka peentɔriba daa nya o n-to o piɛm ti o daŋ pam.
en: The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.

dag: Di saha yi ti paai ni di dabisa maa ni, bɛ ni ti bɔ Izraɛlnim taali kɔŋ, ka Judanim daalahichi ti kpihim. Dama n ni chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ n ni tiligi shɛb la taali. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will rescue a few people from Israel and Judah. I will forgive them so completely that their sin and guilt will disappear, never to be found.

dag: Ka o daa ti bol o nyaandoliba pinaayi la na nti tim ba niriba ayiyi; ka niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ kariti alizin biɛri bahira.
en: Jesus called his twelve apostles together. He sent them out in groups of two and gave them power over evil spirits.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa daa yiɣisi nimaani n-chani ka lihiri Sɔdom polo; ka Ibrahimma daa chani doli ba ni o zali ba soli.
en: The men got up from there and went over to look down on Sodom. Abraham was walking along with them to send them off.

dag: Nyamiya, n ni vil o bahi o bindoo zuɣu, ka o mini bɛnkam niŋ o zina ni nya wahala pam naɣila bɛ niŋla tuuba bɛ ni tum shɛm o sani maa zuɣu.
en: And so I will throw her on a bed where she and those who committed adultery with her will suffer terribly. I will do this now unless they repent of the wicked things they did with her.

dag: Yawɛ, di kpahi n zuɣu ni a suhuyiɣisili puuni. A mi di saɣisi ma a suhuyiɣisili saha!.
en: Please, LORD, dont punish me when you are angry; dont discipline me when you are furious.

dag: Amaa ka o ni daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb maa zaŋ li niŋ asahi, ka bɛ ni yino zaŋ kpa o puu polo, ka yino chaŋ o tuma shee.
en: But the invited guests paid no attention and went about their business: one went to his farm, another to his store.

dag: ni Joɛl Neetan mabia la ni Mibihar ŋun daa nyɛ Hagiri bia la.
en: Joel, Nathans brother; Mibhar, Hagris son.

dag: Yi vidibo ni yi filiŋ ni ti zani tariga. Yi ni ti be yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka yi daazichi ti nabi; ka yi ti mali suhupiɛlli sahakam.
en: They were terribly insulted and horribly mistreated; now they will be greatly blessed and joyful forever.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Moses spoke to the LORD.

dag: Wulimpuhili polo dunoli maa, niriba ayɔbuyɔbu n-daa yi gul li dabisili kam, ka niriba anahinahi daa yi guli nuzaa polo dunoya la dabisili kam, ka niriba ayiyi mi daa guli nɛma duu la dabisili kam.
en: each day the East had six, the North four, and the South four, with two at each of the storehouses.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Judanim mali kpiɔŋ; ka fa Izraɛlnim mi bahi. N ni zo ba nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ ba labisi yiŋ na. Bɛ ni be kaman n na ʒi n-zaɣisi ba. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni; ka ni wum bɛ suhigu.
en: I will strengthen the kingdoms of Judah and Israel. And I will show mercy because I am the Lord , their God. I will answer their prayers and bring them home. Then it will seem as though I had never rejected them.

dag: A ni niŋdi laasabu shɛŋa la zaa yoli, a gbarigiya. Chɛ ka bɛn mi zuɣusaa yɛla tilig a, ka chɛ ka saŋmaribaŋdiba bɛn mi zuɣusaa yɛla yɛl a goli kam puuni binshɛŋa din yɛn niŋ a.
en: You have many advisors. Are you tired of the advice they give? Then send out your men who read the stars. They can tell when the month starts, so maybe they can tell you when your troubles will come.

dag: Ti bɔrila suhudoo, amaa ka bi nya zaɣ viɛlli, Ti bɔrila alaafee nyabu saha, amaa ka dabiɛm n-naɣ kul beni.
en: We hoped for peace and a time of healing, but it was no use; terror came instead.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli yaha, Do kura mini paɣ kpamba bɛn dihiri jaaŋgbɛhi ni lan ʒiini Jɛrusalɛm puuni sɔnaŋgbanyɛhi.
en: Very old people with walking sticks will once again sit around in Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa ka di daa mali ti paai Naa Jɔash nam dibu yuun pisinaata saha ka maligumaaniba maa na bi mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa luɣ shɛli.
en: But by the twenty-third year of Joash's reign the priests still had not made any repairs in the Temple.

dag: Ahaz daa nyɛla Jɛhɔada ba, ka Jɛhɔada nyɛ Alɛmɛt mini Azimavɛt ni Zimiri ba; Zimiri mi daa nyɛla Mɔza ba;.
en: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah; Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri was the father of Moza.

dag: So bi jɛmd a, so mi bi bɔri sɔŋsim a sani. Dama a lɛbila a nyaaŋa biri ti, ka chɛ ti niŋ ti daalahichi maa ni.
en: No one calls on your name; no one bothers to hold on to you, for you have hidden yourself from us, and have handed us over to our sin.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ tiŋkpansi mini di paliti polo, Judanim shɛb daa bela Kiriatariba tiŋkpansi mini Dibɔn ni di tiŋkpansi ni Jɛkabiziil ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: Many of the people lived in towns near their farms. Those who were of the tribe of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba, Dibon, and Jekabzeel, and in the villages near these cities.

dag: Amaa ka n daa ti zahim dabiɛm zahindi n-nya ʒii shɛŋa n gom shee ka di muɣisi ma pam.
en: I had a dream that made me afraid. I was lying on my bed, and I saw pictures and visions in my mind. These things made me very afraid.

dag: Dama bɛ yihi ba la Izraɛlnim puuni n-zaŋ ba ti ma zaa ka n deei ba leei n ni su shɛba, ka chɛ Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba.
en: They are mine and will take the place of the first-born Israelite sons.

dag: a ni ti bɔhim bɛ biɛhigu maa, ka di chɛ ka a kpɛh amaŋ zana ni.
en: If you do, you may learn to be like them. Then you will have the same problems they do.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yimaŋmaŋ nyɛviya zuɣu, miriya ka yi ʒi ʒiya Vuhim Dabisili dali bee n-ʒi li doli dunɔdaya ŋɔ kpe Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The LORD says: Be on guard not to carry a load on the Sabbath day or conduct business at the gates of Jerusalem.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Wummiya, ka kpahi Yaakubu zuliya zuɣu ni yɛli.
en: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:.

dag: A yɛligu baŋbu nyɛla din tiri neesim. Di chɛmi ka tarim nyari baŋsim.
en: Access to your words gives light, giving simple folk understanding.

dag: bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Naawuni yɛligu, ka lihi ʒiɛm ŋun Zallakudura Naa wuhibu la zuɣu.
en: That was because they had fought against what God said. They refused to listen to the advice of God Most High.

dag: m-balind o yɛra, M bipuɣiŋga n-tarigi yɛn kpi. Kamina nti zaŋ a nuhi pa o zuɣu ka o kpaŋ n-lan niŋ nyɛvililana yaha.
en: and begged him earnestly, My little daughter is very sick. Please come and place your hands on her, so that she will get well and live.

dag: O ti o naa nasara pam, ka wuh o yurilim ni galisi shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o ninvuɣ gahindili Dauda min o zuliya sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.

dag: ka daa tari Izraɛlnim maa dɔbba ni paɣiba zaa bɔrɔbɔro kpillikpilli mini niŋkpillikpilli ni wain tihi wala mahilimahili ti kpa.
en: and distributed food to them all. He gave each man and woman in Israel a loaf of bread, a piece of roasted meat, and some raisins.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa lan chɛ ka tɔɣisigu niŋ o mini Izraɛl naa sunsuuni.
en: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

dag: Naawuni daa ti nachimbih anahi ŋɔ baŋsim mini yɛn bɔhimbu balibu kam puuni. Ka din pahi nyɛla o daa lan ti Daniɛl baŋsim shɛli din chɛ ka o tooi kahigiri ʒiinim mini zahima gbinni wuhira.
en: And God gave knowledge, mastery of all literature, and wisdom to these four men. Daniel himself gained understanding of every type of vision and dream.

dag: amaa yi ni daa deei Shia Kasi so Masia san la nyɛla ŋun kul kpalim be yi ni, ka di bi lan simdi ni so wuhi ya shɛli; Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri ya binshɛɣukam ka di nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ka pa ʒiri la zuɣu, kul benya Masia ni.
en: As for you, the anointing that you received from him remains on you, and you dont need anyone to teach you the truth. But since his anointing teaches you about all things , remain in relationship to him just as he taught you.

dag: O daa lan tuhi nyaŋ Mɔabnima, ka bɛ leeg o daba, ka yɔri farigu o sani.
en: He also defeated Moab, enslaving them and requiring payment.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ dunia ŋɔ yɛlimuɣisira polo, n tɛhiya ni nir yi kpalim be kaman o ni pun be shɛm, di so.
en: So I think this advice is good because of the present crisis: Stay as you are.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa kum Musa kuli Mɔabnim bɔpiɛligu maa ni hal ni biɛɣu pihita, di nyaaŋa ka Musa kuli maa kumbu daa naai.
en: The people of Israel stayed in the lowlands of Moab, where they mourned and grieved days for Moses, as was their custom.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa tiɣi Naawuni nin la bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, amaa ka daa na bi nya Naawuni ni daa lo ba binshɛŋa alikauli la;.
en: God was pleased with all of them because of their faith. But not one of them received Gods great promise.

dag: ka di nyɛ niriba bɛn gili ya wuna, bɛn be yoma bee katiŋ ni yinima, ka nyɛ bɛn be dunia yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa yaɣ din la;.
en: gods from all the neighboring peoples, whether nearby or far away, from one end of the earth to the other.

dag: Deemiya bɛ suɣa mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu ni bɛ pateesanima ni bɛ nɛma zaa. Taɣimiya bɛ laakuma chaŋ ti leei yi dini. Ka bɛ ŋme kuŋ yɛli, Yɛlibiɛɣu gili ti luɣilikam zaa.
en: Seize their tents and their flocks, their belongings and all their goods. Take off with their camels and shout as you go: Panic Lurks Everywhere.

dag: Di simdi ka yi niŋ yalim gari biŋkuma sara kam zaa ni, ka miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi mini Naawuni yalim alikauli la ti pooi yi sara maligu maa ni, dinzuɣu yi sara maligu kam ni di simdi ka yi chɛ ka yalim be di ni.
en: Salt is offered when you make an agreement with me, so sprinkle salt on these sacrifices.

dag: ni bɛ daa saɣiya ni ŋunkam mali dabili ka o nyɛ Hiburu nira, doo bee paɣa, ŋun bahim o din ni chɛ ka Izraɛl nira ku lan zaŋ o mabia Izraɛl nira n-leeg o dabili.
en: their Hebrew slaves, both male and female, so that no one would have an Israelite as a slave.

dag: m-mali Naawuni jilima, ka nyɛlisiri kaman bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛli jasipa la, ka lan ne kaman diɣi la.
en: and shining with the glory of God. The city shone like a precious stone, like a jasper, clear as crystal.

dag: M mi kɔŋsim biɛhigu, ka mi malibu gba biɛhigu. M pun bɔhim baŋ ashili ŋɔ: N ni be luɣ shɛlikam mini saha shɛlikam zaa puuni, n yi nya n-di bee n yi gbe kum, ka n yi mali pam bee n yi malila biɛla n nini tiɣiri li mi.
en: I know how to live when I am poor and when I have plenty. I have learned the secret of how to live through any kind of situation—when I have enough to eat or when I am hungry, when I have everything I need or when I have nothing.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi be ti niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ yili ŋɔ ni bee ti yi ka di ni, ti nia lɔbu nyɛla ni ti tiɣi o nini.
en: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.

dag: N daa lan nya ka bɛ me bimbini gili Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaa. Luɣa ni duri maa tanzahi buɣisibu daa nyɛla mita atata.
en: Then I looked at the temple: Its roof all around rested on the side chambers. Each raised section was ten and a half feet, and the indentations between them were nine feet.

dag: Guli ma, ka fa ma bahi; di chɛ ka n di vi, dama a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi.
en: Protect me and save me; keep me from defeat. I come to you for safety.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni lan zo Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ŋɔ nambɔɣu, ka lan pii ba n-zaŋ ba labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha; ka chɛ ka tinzunnim zaŋ bɛmaŋ pahi Yaakubu zuliya maa zuɣu n-doli ba labi.
en: The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel.

dag: Bɛ yɛra, Yiya mɛbu saha na bi miri. Tiŋ ŋɔ nyɛla duɣu, ka ti mi nyɛ nimdi.
en: They say, We will soon be building houses again. The city is like a cooking pot, and we are like the meat in it, but at least it protects us from the fire.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa chani gindi pihiri li na nti niɛmdi li nɛya zuɣu bee n-zaŋ li niŋdi toya ni tɔra, ka zaŋdi li niŋdi duɣuri ni duɣira, ka mal li maani maha; ka di nyaɣisim ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ kpam mali mahi shɛŋa.
en: The people would roam around and collect it and grind it with millstones or pound it in a mortar. Then they would boil it in pots and make it into cakes. It tasted like cakes baked in olive oil.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa daa yɛl o yiŋbihi, Amiliya lɔbu maa shili biya, amaa n ni pun boli ninvuɣ shɛb la bi simdi li.
en: Then he called his servants and said to them, My wedding feast is ready, but the people I invited did not deserve it.

dag: ka a kɔrigi piɛlaa maa, ka zaŋ o ʒim shɛli n-laɣi Aduna min o bidibisi maa nudiriti tib nyaɣa mini bɛ nudiriti nubihilɔri ni bɛ nudiriti napombihilɔri, ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam zaa.
en: Kill it, and take some of its blood and put it on the lobes of the right ears of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands and on the big toes of their right feet. Throw the rest of the blood against all four sides of the altar.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ gballi maa gbini, ka o suhu ti lan saɣim pam. Gballi maa daa nyɛla siliga, ka kuɣili yo di noli.
en: Jesus was still terribly upset. So he went to the tomb, which was a cave with a stone rolled against the entrance.

dag: Ka Hɔsa ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛrari bidibisi ni yino la gba daa mali bidibisi; Shimri n-daa nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana.
en: These are the gatekeepers from the Merari family: Hosah, son of Merari, chose his son Shimri to be the leader, even though he was not the oldest son.

dag: N ni yih a a tuma ni, ka yih a a zaashee maa. .
en: The Lord will remove you from office and bring you down from your high position.

dag: Ka Siria naa maa daa yɛl o, Cham pumpɔŋɔ! N ni sab gbaŋ ti a ka a mali ti ti Izraɛl naa. Ka Naaman daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhi pia mini salima laɣibaligu tusaayɔbu ni binyɛr suma din nyɛ chuɣu binyɛra pia chaŋ.
en: Then the king of Aram said, Go now, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel. So Naaman went to Israel. He took pounds of silver, pieces of gold and ten changes of clothes as gifts.

dag: Ka m mali suhupiɛlli pumpɔŋɔ, ka di pala yi suhuri ni daa saɣim maa zuɣu, amaa yi suhuri ni daa saɣim ka yi niŋ tuuba la zuɣu, dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun saɣi ka yi suhuri daa saɣim maa, dinzuɣu yi bi kɔŋ shɛli ti ni niŋ shɛm maa puuni.
en: Now Im glad—not because you were sad but because you were made sad enough to change your hearts and lives. You felt godly sadness so that no one was harmed by us in any way.

dag: Fiig tihi gbaai wolibu, ka wain tihi daai pum, ka di pum maa nyo kaman tulaale la. N yura ŋun nyɛ n ni yuri so pam, Yiɣisim ka n sanna.
en: Fig trees are bearing fruit, while blossoms on grapevines fill the air with perfume. My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.

dag: Lala ka naa maa daa kpi; ka bɛ daa zaŋ o kuli Samaria ti sɔɣi.
en: So died King Ahab. His body was taken to Samaria and buried.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛ niŋ kom biɛla tin ya na ka yi paɣi yi naba, ka ʒini tia ŋɔ gbini vuhi.
en: I'll have some water brought, so you can wash your feet, then you can rest under a tree.

dag: Nir yi be tiŋgban nɛl ni, di so ni o mali paɣ so ŋun mali suhuyiɣisili ka bɔri zabili.
en: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kuhi pam ka naanyi bahi.
en: Again Jesus cried out with a loud shout. Then he died.

dag: Niŋmiya suɣilo biɛla ka n wuhi ya, dama n na malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n zani Naawuni zaani yɛli.
en: Wait a little while so I can demonstrate for you that there is still something more to say about God.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, Anabi Musa min anabinim litaafinim be bɛ sani, dinzuɣu chɛ ka bɛ wum di yɛligu ka saɣisi bɛmaŋa.
en: Abraham answered, Your brothers can read what Moses and the prophets wrote. They should pay attention to that.

dag: Duri maa tooni, so shɛli daa beni kpɛri dundɔŋ puuni. Di yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita anu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu, ka di dunoya daa be nuzaa polo.
en: Along the north side of this building was a passageway feet wide and feet long, with entrances on that side.

dag: tɔbu ni lu yi zuɣu, ka yi birininim la zaa ti wurim. Di ni ti bemi kaman Naa Shaliman ni daa ŋme Bɛtaribɛlnim tɔbu, ka wurim li, ka zaŋ bihi mini bɛ manim tɔri taba n-kuri ba shɛm la.
en: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.

dag: Bɛ tuumbiɛri zaa bela Giligal. Nimaani ka n nyee daa piligi ba nyɔnibu. Bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu n ni kari ba yihi n yiŋa. N ku lan yuri ba yaha; bɛ kpamba zaa nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi ma.
en: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikaa goli palli dali, ka piɛbimi li goli maa yi ti niŋ goli muni ni ti chuɣu puhibu dali.
en: Blow the horn on the new moon, at the full moon, for our day of celebration!.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa chaŋ ni o ti sɔɣ o ba. Ka Firawuna kpambaliba zaa min o yiŋ kpamba ni Ijipti ninvuɣ zuɣuri zaa.
en: So Joseph went to bury his father. All the king's officials, the senior men of his court, and all the leading men of Egypt went with Joseph.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima mali nyɔtaɣirisi zaɣ yɛlima kɔbisiyi. Ka zaɣ yini kam daa di salima din tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayopɔin.
en: King Solomon made large shields of hammered gold. He used about pounds of gold for each shield.

dag: Daba ayopɔin ŋɔ puuni chuɣu ŋɔ puhibu saha, o bom naɣila pola ayopɔin mini piɛlahi ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ dahin yini kam, ka lan bo bulaa m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara dabisili kam.
en: For the seven days of the festival, he will provide seven flawless bulls and seven flawless rams, one for each day of the festival, as the entirely burned offering for the LORD, and, for the purification offering, one male goat for each day.

dag: ka chɛ ka maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan ni Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ni Chɛrɛtinim ni Pɛlɛtinim dol o chaŋ ti chɛ ka o ba naa buntaaŋa la.
en: He sent Zadok, Nathan, Benaiah, and the royal bodyguards to escort him. They had him ride on the king's mule.

dag: Di chɛ ka tuun biɛ shɛli nyaŋ a, amaa nyin zaŋmi zaɣ suŋ niŋbu nyaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Dont let evil defeat you, but defeat evil by doing good.

dag: Ka o paɣ tab bɛn mali yɛm daa garig o yɛli, Aai. Ka o garigi yɛl omaŋa.
en: Her wisest friends answered her, and she told herself over and over.

dag: Gɛmaria bia Mikaya ŋun daa nyɛ Shafan yaaŋa la ni daa wum Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaa gbaŋ maa puuni.
en: When Micaiah, Gemariahs son and Shaphans grandson, heard all the LORDs words from the scroll.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, bɛn daa nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ka nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa yɛr o yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ maa.
en: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the men and women who told him these things.

dag: M mabihi mini n zɔnim zuɣu, n ni yɛli, Chɛ ka suhudoo be a ni.
en: For the sake of my family and friends, I say, Peace be with you, Jerusalem.

dag: Ka daadam kam ŋun ti zaɣisi anab maa yɛligu wumbu ni ti bahi yoli zaa kahikahi.
en: Whoever doesnt listen to that prophet will be totally cut off from the people. .

dag: Timoti, gbib Naawuni ni zaŋ shɛli niŋ a nuu ni ni a yuuni li la viɛnyɛliŋga. Gbaam amaŋa ni din bi luri Naawuni sizuura mini naŋgbankpeeni yɛtɔɣ yo shɛŋa ninvuɣ shɛb ni chirim booni baŋsim la.
en: Timothy, protect what has been given to you in trust. Avoid godless and pointless discussions and the contradictory claims of so-called knowledge.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛ bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm tum din tuhi. Bɛ zaŋla bɛ ni ʒe neen shɛŋa mini bɛ ni fa neen shɛŋa m-pali bɛ nayiya.
en: The Lord says, These people fill their mansions with things taken by crime and violence. They don't even know how to be honest.

dag: Ti Duuma zaɣis o sara maligu bimbini, ka chɛ o jɛmbu duu bahi. O zaŋ di nayili goma la niŋ bɛ bɛ dimnim nuu ni. Bɛ ʒiɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu duu n-yɔri nasara dibu vuri kaman chuɣu dal la.
en: He rejected his altar, and he left his holy place of worship. He let the enemy pull down the walls of the palaces of Jerusalem. The enemy shouted with joy in the Lord s Temple. They made noise as though it were a festival.

dag: Ka zaŋ di shɛli mihi sara maligu bimbini zuɣu ʒiibuyopɔin, ka booi kpam maa bahi sara maligu bimbini maa mini di zuɣu lahi ni di kɔniŋdi bini ni di naba zaashee zuɣu m-mali di zaa kasi.
en: He sprinkled some of the anointing oil on the altar seven times. He sprinkled the oil on the altar, on all its tools and dishes, and on the bowl and its base. In this way he made them holy.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kɔzɔrim yi tampiŋ ni na n-zɔri kaman mɔɣa kom la.
en: He caused a stream to come out of the rock and made water flow like a river.

dag: Dauda ni daa yɛli Sool lala naai, ka Sool bɔhi, M bia Dauda, a kukoli m-bala? Ka Sool daa duh o yee kum pam.
en: When David had finished speaking, Saul said, Is that really you, David my son? And he started crying.

dag: Yawɛ, n yur a jɛmbu duu din nyɛ a ni be luɣ shɛli, ka a jilima be nimaani la.
en: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.

dag: Di saha ka Naa maa daa duhi Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo n-zaŋ ba zali zaashe kara ni Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: And the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to higher positions in the province of Babylon.

dag: Yi ni yɛn tiri kpam mi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kpa ŋmani kam puuni, yihimiya kuruwa pirigibu bupia puuni yim zuɣu ti.
en: / bath of olive oil for every cor of olive oil;.

dag: Zaliguzaɣisira maa ni ti yi zahira Sintani yiko ni, ka mali yiko pam din ni tum alahiziba tuma balibu kam ka wuhi shihira, ka tum alahiziba tumtumsa din nyɛ yɔhiŋgu.
en: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.

dag: Hal Babilɔn naa kpambaliba tuumba ni daa kana ni bɛ ti bɔhi baŋ shihirili shɛli din niŋ o tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, Naawuni daa chɛ o mi ni o niŋ o ni bɔri shɛm, ka di chɛ ka o zahim o baŋ dinkam zaa be o suhu ni.
en: Even when the leaders of Babylonia sent messengers to ask Hezekiah about the sign God had given him, God let Hezekiah give his own answer to test him and to see if he would remain faithful.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya ka bɛ zaŋ kikahi ayopɔin ti malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn ʒe Naawuni tooni.
en: Then I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ di gula, ka yɔɣiri li kom sahakam. N kul gul li mi yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka so ku tooi niŋ li shɛli.
en: I, the Lord , will protect it and always keep it watered. I will guard it day and night to keep it from harm.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ti ni daa wum yi yɛla hal ni pɔŋɔ, ti kul suhirila Naawuni tiri ya sahakam. Ti suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka yi baŋ o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm zaa, ka pahi ya yɛm mini baŋsim zaa din nyɛ Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri ya shɛl la.
en: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.

dag: Ɛli bidibisi daa nyɛla ninvuɣ yoya; bɛ baɣa daa ka Yawɛ ni.
en: The sons of Eli were scoundrels. They paid no attention to the Lord.

dag: Yisa ni daa naai ŋaha ŋɔ, o daa yila nimaani.
en: When Jesus finished telling these parables, he left that place.

dag: dama ninsal sujee mini Naawuni wuntia tuma bi dol taba.
en: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a ʒim zo n-tiɛli tiŋgbani hal ti taɣi zoya, ka a ti pali kulibɔna.
en: With your blood I will soak your irrigated land, and the streambeds will be filled with you.

dag: A niŋ bindirigu zali n tooni n dimnim ninni. A niŋ kpam ʒe n zuɣu. A chɛ ka m pipia pali hal ti puuri bahira.
en: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.

dag: A ni tooi yɛli saŋmarisi bɛ ni yɛn yina saha shɛli? Bee a ni tooi wuhi saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim taba ka bɛ booni ba Baa min o bihi la soli?.
en: Can you bring out the other constellations at the right times? Can you lead out the Bear with its cubs?.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ bi kɔŋ zaligu zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, dama Masia zaligu sulinsi ni ka m be, amaa n yi chaŋla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli fukumsi zaligu sani, m bemi kaman ŋun bi doli fukumsi zaligu ni di chɛ ka n tooi tiligi bɛn bi doli fukumsi zaligu maa.
en: To those who are without the law I became like someone who is without the law. I did this to help save those who are without the law.

dag: A ni saɣi je suli niŋ ti sahakam? A ni yiɣis a suhu bahi ti zuɣu sahakam? Yi ni yɛli shɛm m-bala, amaa yi tum tuumbiɛ shɛlikam yin ni tooi tum.
en: You won't always be angry; you won't be mad at me forever. Israel, that is what you said, but you did all the evil you could.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun gbibi duu maa zaa ka chɛ ka di mɛri zoori hal ti leeri jɛmbu du kasi ti Duuma ni.
en: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.

dag: Filistianim mini Izraɛlnim daa ti tuhiri tɔbu, ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Filistianima. Ka Filistianim maa daa doli ti ku ba Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: The Philistines fought against the Israelites. The Israelites ran away from the Philistines. Many Israelites were killed on Mount Gilboa.

dag: Bɛ vuhim yi ti naai, bɛ labirila tiŋgban ni; di saha ka bɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa zaa kpalim yoli.
en: When they die, they return to the dust; on that day all their plans come to an end.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Yisahaku sanna ti yɛl o, Di chaŋ Ijipti, kpalim be tiŋgban shɛli ni n ni yɛn wuh a.
en: The Lord spoke to Isaac and said, Dont go down to Egypt. Live in the land that I commanded you to live in.

dag: Ka sagbana daa kpaai kom bahina; ka saa daa tahira, ka a saa nyaɣisibu piɛma nyaɣisiri gindi luɣilikam zaa.
en: The clouds poured down rain; thunder crashed from the sky, and lightning flashed in all directions.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa niŋ nia ni o me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ yuli jilima, ka me omaŋmaŋ nam yili.
en: Solomon gave orders to build a temple for the LORDs name and to build a royal palace for himself.

dag: Mani m-piig a dɔɣiriba Lɛvinima Izraɛlnim ni; bɛ nyɛla Yawɛ ni su shɛba; ka o zaŋ ba ti a ni bɛ tumdi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni tuma.
en: I myself chose the Levites from among all the Israelites. They are as a gift to you. I gave them to you to serve the Lord and work in the Meeting Tent.

dag: Ka naa bɔh o, Napaɣ Ɛsta, wula? Bɔ ka a bɔra? N ni ti a a ni bɔri shɛli maa, hal di yi nyɛla n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
en: Then the king asked, What is bothering you Queen Esther? What do you want to ask me? I will give you anything you ask for, even half my kingdom.

dag: Dama a yi ti yi ya ŋɔ n-chaŋ ti baai du Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ dahin shɛli, nyin baŋmi ni a ni kpi ka biɛhiŋ kani, ka a ʒim yihibu taali kpalim ʒi amaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: If you leave the city and go any further than Kidron Brook, you will be killed, and it will be your own fault.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ lala, dama binshɛŋa din chihira ka nyɛ Yawɛ ni je shɛŋa zaa, bɛ niŋdi li tiri bɛ wuna maa, dama hal bɛ daa mi n-zaŋ bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi nyo buɣim mali bɛ wuna maa.
en: Dont act like they did toward the LORD your God because they did things for their gods that are detestable to the LORD, which he hates. They even burned their own sons and daughters with fire for their gods!.

dag: Dama n ni kul wum a puhigu maa, bia ŋun be m pul ni maa dii dammi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: When I heard your voice, the baby inside me jumped with joy.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka di pala pagɔrisigu gɔbu zuɣu ka kpuɣi paɣ so tum zina. Ka ŋunkam mi kpuɣi paɣ yihiŋ maa gba tum zina.
en: I tell you, then, that any man who divorces his wife for any cause other than her unfaithfulness, commits adultery if he marries some other woman.

dag: Di saha ka Chɛnaana bia Zɛdɛkia daa kana ti labi Mikaya tapaɣa ka bɔh o, So dini ka Yawɛ shia maa lee doli yi n ni n-kana ti yɛl a yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: Then the prophet Zedekiah went to Micaiah and hit him on the face. Zedekiah said, How is it that the Spirit of the Lord left me to speak through you.

dag: Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka alizin biɛ so ʒi Sool zuɣu maa daa yi ti kul lan siɣina saha shɛlikam, Dauda zaŋdila mɔɣilo maa ŋmɛra, ka alizin biɛɣu maa zo ka chɛ Sool, ka o ni maai, ka o nya omaŋa.
en: Any time the evil spirit from God came on Saul, David would take his harp and play it. The evil spirit would leave Saul and he would begin to feel better.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun bɔhi biɛri ti ma; ka nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be n sulinsi ni ti ma.
en: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.

dag: Ka m bɔh o, N Duuma, di yɛn be lala yuui hal ni bɔ saha? Ka o yɛli ma, Di ni be lala hal ka tinsi ti lu n-dahim, ka so ku lan be di yiya ni, ka tiŋgbani maa kpalim tiŋgban nɛli doya.
en: Then I asked, Lord, how long should I do this? He answered, Do this until the cities are destroyed and all the people are gone. Do this until there is no one left living in the houses and the land is destroyed and empty.

dag: Bɛ daa kul dolila nyaaŋa n-kuhiri yɛra, Kumiy o! Kumiy o.
en: The crowd followed and kept shouting, Kill him! Kill him.

dag: N daamiliya, yim Lɛbanɔn n-doli ma kuli. Yim Lɛbanɔn n-doli ma kuli. Sheemi Amana Zoli zuɣu na. Sheemi Sɛnir mini Hɛrimɔn Zoya din nyɛ gbuɣima mini jɛŋgbina ni be luɣ shɛl la zuɣu na.
en: Come down with me from Lebanon, my bride— if only you would come down with me from Lebanon. Descend from the peak of Amana, from the peaks of Senir and Hermon, from the lions dens, from the mountain lairs of leopards.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yɛn baai du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili dahin shɛli chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni, yin bomiya kuɣ kara n-niŋ tari ta li.
en: The same day you cross the Jordan River to enter the land the LORD your God is giving you, set up large stones and cover them with plaster.

dag: O zaŋ m malibu chaŋ katiŋa ka chɛ ma, ka n leei sana bɛn daa mi ma la zaa sani.
en: God has made my own family forsake me; I am a stranger to those who knew me;.

dag: Teemiya kurimbuni ha yɛla. Tɛhimiya yuun gbaliŋ din gari la yɛla. Bɔhimiya yi ba, o ni wuhi ya, ka bɔhi yi dɔɣirikpamba, bɛ ni yɛli ya.
en: Remember the days long past; consider the years long gone. Ask your father, he will tell you about it; ask your elders, they will give you the details.

dag: ka yuri puhigu dahi ni, ka lan yuri ni niriba booni ba bɛ karimbanima.
en: And when they are in the market, they like to have people greet them as their teachers.

dag: N nyari baŋsim a zaligunim maa puuni, dinzuɣu n je ʒiri soli kam.
en: I gain understanding from your instructions, so I hate anything that leads people the wrong way.

dag: Dama o daa teeg o daalikauli kasi la min o dabili Ibrahimma yɛla.
en: Because God remembered his holy promise to Abraham his servant.

dag: Dunia salinim zaa, yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila paɣi Yawɛ!.
en: Shout praises to the Lord , everyone on this earth.

dag: Dama ŋunkam bo n-nya ma, o nya nyɛvili, ka Yawɛ ni niŋ o nirilim.
en: Those who find me find life, and the Lord will reward them.

dag: Daadam, Izraɛlnim leela saɣiri n sani. Bɛ zaa bɛn nyɛ anzinfa mini daanya ni samafuu ni kurugu ni dalima ŋɔ, bɛ nyɛligibu shee ka bɛ daa leei saɣiri.
en: Mortal man, the Israelites are of no use to me. They are like waste metal—copper, tin, iron, and lead—left over after silver has been refined in a furnace.

dag: ka daa ti yɛl o nyaandoliba, Chɛliya ka ti lab Judia.
en: Then he said to his disciples, Now we will go back to Judea.

dag: Yisa noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka do so yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa yiŋ na ti yɛl o, A bipuɣiŋga maa bahiya. Di lan muɣisiri karimba maa yaha.
en: While Jesus was still speaking, someone came from the house of the synagogue leader and said, Your daughter has died! Dont bother the Teacher anymore.

dag: Dimiya li, di nyɛla din be kasi. Dɔbba kɔŋko n-ni tooi di li. Di nyɛla din be kasi yi sani.
en: You will eat it as a most holy thing. Every male may eat it. It will be holy to you.

dag: Naa Dauda daa yiɣisi zani yɛli ba, Wummiya, m mabihi mini n niriba; n lo n suhu ni ni m me yili n-zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka din nyɛ ti Naawuni napɔntamdigu ŋɔ zali di puuni; m pun mali di mɛbu shili zaa.
en: David stood before them and addressed them: My friends, listen to me. I wanted to build a permanent home for the Covenant Box, the footstool of the Lord our God. I have made preparations for building a temple to honor him.

dag: Bɛ sɔɣimi do bɛ sɔɣibu shee kaman gbuɣinli la guhira. Bɛ domi gu tarimba ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ zana bari gbahi ba n-vo n-chaŋ.
en: they wait in their hiding place like lions. They lie in wait for the poor; they catch them in their traps and drag them away.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yi Mɛsopoteemia m-mali hal ti paai Shɛkɛm din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ni alaafee nti ti suɣa dɔni tiŋ maa tooni polo.
en: On his return from Mesopotamia Jacob arrived safely at the city of Shechem in the land of Canaan and set up his camp in a field near the city.

dag: Wuntizɔriba solɔɣu nyɛla din lɔɣiri zaɣ biɛɣu. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi bɛmaŋ bɛ soli ni nyɛla bɛn tiligiri bɛ nyɛviya.
en: Those who are good travel a road that avoids evil; so watch where you are going—it may save your life.

dag: n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛtihɔgila n-yi nimaani zaŋ gari hal ti paai Bɛtaraba nuzaa polo. Ka di tariga maa zaŋ lala hal ni Rubin bia Bɔhan kuɣili la gbini;.
en: The border went up to Beth-hoglah and passed north of Beth-arabah. The border went up to the Stone of Bohan .

dag: Amaa yɛl yini zuɣu ka n naɣ galim ya: Yi bahi yi tuuli yurilim la.
en: But I have this against you: you have let go of the love you had at first.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam yɛli, M Ba Naawuni, n zaŋ n shia niŋ a nuu ni! O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka o dii bahi.
en: Jesus shouted, Father, I put my life in your hands! After Jesus said this, he died.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa lan yi Lakishi gari chaŋ Ɛgilɔn ti teei gil li n-liri ba.
en: Joshua along with all Israel moved on from Lachish to Eglon. They camped against it and attacked it.

dag: Nyin Asiria naa, a piɛguliba gbihiya. A ninvuɣ zuɣuri ʒeei gom. A niriba wurimya be zoya zuɣu, ka so kani ŋun ni laɣim ba.
en: King of Assyria, your officials and leaders are sound asleep, while your people are scattered in the mountains. Yes, your people are sheep without a shepherd.

dag: Samuɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Joɛl ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Abija ŋun daa pa o zuɣu.
en: Samuels sons were his oldest son Joel, and Abijah.

dag: ka dihi bɛn kpiri kum bindir suma, ka kari bundaannim ni nuzaŋa bahi.
en: He has filled the hungry with good things, and sent the rich away with empty hands.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, N yi bi chɛ ka Naawuni ni daa lo Dauda alikauli yɛli.
en: May God deal harshly with me, Abner, and worse still if I dont do for David exactly what the LORD swore to him.

dag: Dama laɣiyubo nyɛla bin biɛɣukam nyaɣili; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri daa kul ye liɣiri nyabu zuɣu la birigi ka chɛ yɛda niŋbu soli dolibu, ka suhugarigu balibu kam din be kaman piɛma la kuhi bɛ suhuri.
en: The love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. Some have wandered away from the faith and have impaled themselves with a lot of pain because they made money their goal.

dag: Ka paɣ so ŋun daa yi Taiatira na n-nyɛ ago chinchin kɔha, ka o yuli booni Lidia, ka o daa nyɛ ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni la daa be nimaani. Ka ti Duuma daa yoog o suhu ka o niŋ Pool ni daa yɛli shɛm yɛda.
en: There was a woman there named Lydia from the city of Thyatira. Her job was selling purple cloth. She was a worshiper of the true God. Lydia was listening to Paul, and the Lord opened her heart to accept what Paul was saying.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam bi doli buzɔŋ dunoli kpe, ka dula gooni kpe dilan nyɛla tayiɣa ni ŋmɛnditoli;.
en: Jesus said, I am telling you the truth: the man who does not enter the sheep pen by the gate, but climbs in some other way, is a thief and a robber.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ taaya n-yɔri vuri, ka di vuri kaman teeku vubu la. Aa, niriba maa yɔrila vuri, ka di vuri kaman kom pam vubu la.
en: Listen to all these people! Their loud crying sounds like the noise from the sea. Listen, it is like the crashing of waves in the sea.

dag: Ka nyin ŋun zani dabari ŋɔ, bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ situr ʒiɛkpain niŋ amaŋa? Bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ salima nɛma niŋ amaŋa, ka bali chilo? A kul dihirila amaŋ nachiinsi yoli, dama a mamanim lihi ʒiɛm a, ka bɔri ni bɛ ku a.
en: Jerusalem, you are doomed! Why do you dress in scarlet? Why do you put on jewelry and paint your eyes? You are making yourself beautiful for nothing! Your lovers have rejected you and want to kill you.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa wum lala maa di daa muɣis o mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa pam, ka bɛ kɔŋ ʒiya.
en: When King Herod heard about this, he was worried, and so was everyone else in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bo wɔr shɛb Pool ni ti yɛn ba n-zali, ka mal o baalim tahi Gomna Filiksi sani.
en: Provide some horses for Paul to ride and get him safely through to Governor Felix.

dag: ka sab bɛ puhigu gbaŋ ti ba. Bɛ ni daa sab yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Yisa tuumba mini cheechi kpamba puhiri yinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ mabihi bɛn pa Yɛhudianima m-be Antiɔk mini Siria ni Kilikia zaa ha.
en: and they sent the following letter by them: We, the apostles and the elders, your brothers, send greetings to all our brothers of Gentile birth who live in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.

dag: Ka di shɛŋa mi lu vuhim shee zooi viɛnyɛliŋga m-mali hal ti dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim kɔbigakɔbiga. Ka Yisa daa naai ŋahili ŋɔ ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: The rest of the seed fell on good ground. This seed grew and made times more grain. Jesus finished the story. Then he called out, You people who hear me, listen.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali, yin zaŋmiya naɣila polli ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka di niŋ kasi.
en: The Lord God said: On the first day of the first month, a young bull that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice to purify the temple.

dag: Tim ti suhupiɛlli dabisi gbaliŋ kaman a ni daa chɛ ka ti nya suhugarigu shɛm, ka chɛ ka ti suhuri paligi yuun gbaliŋ kaman ti ni daa nya zaɣ biɛɣu shɛm.
en: For years you have made life hard for us and have given us many troubles. Now make us happy for just as long.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli paɣ maa, N ni chɛ ka a nya biɛrim pam bihi dɔɣibu ni; a shiri ni nya biɛrim bihi dɔɣibu ni; amaa di zaa yoli, a kɔre kul ni be a yidan ni, ka o ni su a.
en: To the woman he said, I will make your pregnancy very painful; in pain you will bear children. You will desire your husband, but he will rule over you.

dag: hal ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa bi mi Yisifu daa ti di Ijipti nam.
en: At last a king who did not know about Joseph began to rule in Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu yimiya doli solɔri m-boli yi ni kul nya shɛb zaa ka bɛ ka amiliya lɔbu chuɣu ŋɔ ni na.
en: So go to the street corners and invite everyone you see. Tell them to come to my feast.

dag: ka Mɛrayɔt nyɛ Amaria ba, ka Amaria nyɛ Ahitub ba.
en: Meraioth was Amariahs father. Amariah was Ahitubs father.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa kpuɣi Dauda bia Jɛrimɔt bipuɣiŋga, Mahalat ŋun ma daa nyɛ Abiheel ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛsi bia Ɛliab bipuɣiŋga la.
en: Rehoboam married Mahalath, whose father was Jerimoth son of David, and whose mother was Abihail the daughter of Eliab and granddaughter of Jesse.

dag: A dimnim zaa yaala bɛ noya niŋ a. Bɛ chahirimi, ka dimdi bɛ nyina, ka kuhiri yɛra, Ti naag o zaa. Ti ni daa guhiri dabisi shɛl la m-bala, ti bahi nya li.
en: Zion, your enemies curse you and snarl like wild animals, while shouting, This is the day we've waited for! At last, we've got you.

dag: Kaman ninvuɣ fariba ni sɔɣi doya guli so shɛm, lala ka bɛ maligumaaniba gba laɣim doya. Bɛ kula niriba sol ni hal ni Shɛkɛm. Yɛlimaŋli bɛ tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma.
en: You priests are like a gang of robbers in ambush. On the road to Shechem you murder and commit other horrible crimes.

dag: Dama Daadam Bia gba bi kamina ni o ti ʒiya ka niriba tumdi tir o; amaa ni ŋun lee ti tumdi tiri ba, ka zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima niriba pam nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: Follow my example: Even the Son of Man did not come for people to serve him. He came to serve others and to give his life to save many people.

dag: Di saha ka binneen so ŋun daa ŋmani ninsala teeg o nuu na ti shihi n naŋgbampiba, ka n yɛl o, N dana, n ni nya ʒii shɛli maa chɛmi ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisichɔɣisi.
en: Then he appeared in human form and touched my lips. I said, Sir, this vision has brought me great pain and has drained my strength.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa dɔɣi bidibiga n-ti Hadad, ka bɛ bol o yuli Gɛnubat, ka napaɣ maa daa wums o nayili maa; ka bia maa mini Firawuna bidibisi daa laɣim be nayili maa.
en: She bore him a son, Genubath, who was raised by the queen in the palace, where he lived with the king's sons.

dag: Ilaisha kum dɔro ni daa ti gbaag o saha shɛli, ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash daa chaŋ o sani nti ʒi o tooni kumdi yɛra, M ba! M ba! Izraɛl chɛchɛbunsi ni di wɔribariba.
en: The prophet Elisha was sick with a fatal disease, and as he lay dying, King Jehoash of Israel went to visit him. My father, my father! he exclaimed as he wept. You have been the mighty defender of Israel.

dag: A ku zɔri yuŋ varisigu bee peen shɛŋa din yiɣiri wuntaŋ ni.
en: You will have nothing to fear at night and no need to be afraid of enemy arrows during the day.

dag: Di ku ba, a yi niŋ lala, n niriba maa ni ti tam, amaa nyin ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti nyɔtaɣirigu ŋɔ, zaŋm a kpiɔŋ wurim ba, ka bɛ lu.
en: Do not kill them, O God, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your strength and defeat them, O Lord, our protector.

dag: Dama Yawɛ m-pun zaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili n-sɔŋ ti mini yinim Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba ŋɔ sunsuuni wuhi ti tintarisi ni nyɛ shɛm, dinzuɣu yi ka tarili Yawɛ sani. Di saha, di pa shɛli ka yi yaansi ti chɛ ka ti yaansi chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu.
en: The Lord separated you people of Reuben and Gad from us by giving you the land on the other side of the Jordan River. So you are not part of the Lord s people. If your children said that, it might make our children stop worshiping the Lord .

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ moli gili nyaandoliba maa ni ni nyaandol ŋɔ ŋun ku kpi; amaa Yisa daa bi yɛli Pita ni nyaandol maa ku kpi. O daa yɛl o mi, N yi yu ni o kul kpalim beni hal ka n ti lan labina, di lee nya a ya.
en: Therefore, the word spread among the brothers and sisters that this disciple wouldnt die. However, Jesus didnt say he wouldnt die, but only, If I want him to remain until I come, what difference does that make to you.

dag: Miriya ka yi mɔŋ sana bee kpibiga o yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, ka miriya ka yi deei pakoli chinchini sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ binshɛli paŋ o.
en: Dont obstruct the legal rights of an immigrant or orphan. Dont take a widows coat as pledge for a loan.

dag: Yawɛ bela alizanda ni, ka lihiri dunia ŋɔ ni na n-nyari ninsalinim zaa.
en: The Lord looks at the world.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd daa tim ti gbaai Jɔn na ti kpɛhi duu, ŋun Hɛrɔd ni daa fa omaŋmaŋ tizo Filip paɣ Hɛrɔdias niŋ o paɣa la zuɣu.
en: He said this because Herod himself had arranged to have John arrested and put in prison because of Herodias, the wife of Herods brother Philip. Herod had married her.

dag: O ni dih o piɛri kaman piɛgul ni dihir o piɛri shɛm la. O laɣisi piɛbihi niŋ o bɔɣiri ni, ka zaŋ ba buɣi o nyɔɣu zuɣu, ka zaŋ bɛ manim baalim kuli.
en: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep.

dag: Yisa noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka do so yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa yiŋ na ti yɛl o, A bipuɣiŋga maa bahiya. Di lan muɣisiri karimba maa yaha.
en: While Jesus was still speaking, someone came from the synagogue leaders house, saying to Jairus, Your daughter has died. Dont bother the teacher any longer.

dag: Ka doo maa yɛl o, Bɛ zaŋ kpa luɣ shɛli polo, dama n wumya ka bɛ yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Dɔtan. Di saha ka Yisifu daa biɛh o biɛyanim maa naba nti nya ba Dɔtan maa.
en: The man said, They have already gone away. I heard them say that they were going to Dothan. So Joseph followed his brothers and found them in Dothan.

dag: Ka a daa zaŋ yuma pam di ba suɣilo, ka daa zaŋ a shia niŋ a daanabinim ni, ka bɛ kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni, amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi wumbu. Dinzuɣu ka a daa zaŋ ba niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa nim nuu ni.
en: You were patient with them for many years and warned them by your spirit through the prophets. But they wouldnt listen, so you handed them over to the neighboring peoples.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri maa daa yi doo maa ni n-chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim maa ni, ka bɛ daa dii zo wuriwuri nti sirigi kuligbiriŋ ni ha n-faai lu teeku ni, ka kom di ba.
en: and the demons left the man and entered the pigs. The herd rushed down the cliff into the lake and drowned.

dag: Ninvuɣ so beni n-diri binshɛɣukam, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛda bi kpɛm mi kul dirila bindir gahinda.
en: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.

dag: Ka o daa buɣisi di gooni maa gba kaman ninsal ni buɣisir binyara shɛm, ka di dubu nyɛ mita pihiyɔbu.
en: Then the angel measured the wall, and by our measurements it was about meters high.

dag: Ka o daa lan piri daanya muɣiri ka zaŋ daanya kpani pa o bɔɣusapima zuɣu.
en: He had bronze plates on his shins, and a bronze scimitar hung on his back.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Abarim zoya maa ni, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili Jɛriko polo la.
en: and finally in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.

dag: N suhu ni yuri so, yɛlim ma, Ya polo ka a zaŋd a piɛri chani ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri? Ya polo ka a chɛ ka bɛ dooni vuhiri wuntaŋ ni? Bɔzuɣu ka m be kaman paɣ so ŋun pa sariga dol a tab biŋkɔbbaligu.
en: I love you with all my soul! Tell me, where do you feed your sheep? Where do you lay them down at noon? I should come to be with you or I will be like a hired woman caring for the sheep of your friends.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa ti paai Yisa sani n-nya ka o pun kpimi, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi kabi ŋun gbaya.
en: But when they came to Jesus, they saw that he was already dead, so they did not break his legs.

dag: Chamiya Saipurus teeku noli ti nya, ka timiya Kɛdar ka bɛ ti lihi viɛnyɛliŋga n-nya lala na mi n-niŋ.
en: Go west to the island of Cyprus, and send someone eastward to the land of Kedar. You will see that nothing like this has ever happened before.

dag: Ka Sool mini Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm, ka o daa chani gindi mali Yisa yuli yihiri waazu ni suhukpeeni.
en: Saul moved about freely with the followers in Jerusalem and told everyone about the Lord.

dag: Ka sapashini ŋun pa o zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Jɛhɔhanan. O daa sula tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisiyi ni tuhi pihinii.
en: Second in rank was Jehohanan, with , soldiers.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn garigi yɛl o, Ndana, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ n-tooi fa Izraɛlnim bahi? Nyama, n daŋ niriba nyɛla bɛn ka yaa Manaasa zuliya ni, ka m mi nyɛ ŋun pɔri n yiŋnim ni.
en: But again Gideon said to him, With all due respect, my Lord, how can I rescue Israel? My clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and Im the youngest in my household.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ di chɛliya ka yi suhuri saɣim bee n-je suli niŋ taba, yi ni daa zaŋ ma kɔhi kpe ŋɔ maa zuɣu, dama Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka n daŋ yi tooni na ni n ti fa niriba nyɛviya bahi.
en: Don't worry or blame yourselves for what you did. God is the one who sent me ahead of you to save lives.

dag: Amaa ka Manaasa zuliya niriba maa daa bi tooi kari tinsi maa nima; ka Keenannim maa daa kul kpalim be tinsi maa ni.
en: The people of Manasseh, however, were not able to drive out the people living in those cities, so the Canaanites continued to live there.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa boli tiŋgban kuŋ maa Tiŋgbani, ka boli kom din laɣim do luɣ yini maa mi Teeku. Ka Naawuni daa nya li ka di viɛla.
en: God named the dry land Earth, and he named the gathered waters Seas. God saw how good it was.

dag: dama m mi ni yi wunsuhigu mini Yisa Masia Shia sɔŋsim ni fa ma bahi.
en: because I know that your prayers and the help the Spirit of Jesus Christ gives me will cause this trouble to result in my freedom.

dag: Di yi nyɛla piɛlaa sara, yin bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram ayi n-zaŋ kpam lita yini ni pirigili ŋmir li;.
en: When a ram is offered, pounds of flour mixed with pints of olive oil are to be presented as a grain offering.

dag: Ka a lan zaŋ anzinfa mini salima shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn nya Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam la ni pin shɛŋa niriba maa mini maligumaaniba ni ti ni bɛ suhuri zaa ni di zaŋ tum bɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la tuma gba mali chaŋ.
en: You must also go through all the provinces of Babylonia. Collect the gifts from your people, from the priests, and from the Levites. The gifts are for the Temple of their God in Jerusalem.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ yɛrigi pil li, ka zaŋ chinchin sabilitim yirigi pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: and then with a piece of fine leather, and cover it all with a solid blue cloth. After this they will put the carrying poles in place.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ saha din ka bahigu Naa ŋɔ ni deei n suhigu, ka nyaŋ ba ti ma, dama bɛ bi taɣi, ka mi bi zɔri Naawuni.
en: God, who has ruled from eternity, will hear me and defeat them; for they refuse to change, and they do not fear him.

dag: O ni ti nyɛla suhudoolana. Asirianim yi ti ka ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na ti liri ti, ti ni chɛ ka piɛguliba ayopɔin mini niriba anii shɛb ti ni zaŋ leei nanima la lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: and he will bring peace. When the Assyrians invade our country and break through our defenses, we will send our strongest leaders to fight them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Hiburɔn din nyɛ nir ni daa yi ku o kpee ka zo n-kuli tin shɛli n-tiligiri la mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la daŋ niriba. Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ Libina.
en: In addition to Hebron , the following cities were assigned to the descendants of Aaron the priest: Libnah.

dag: Ka Hɔshaya mini Juda zuɣulaannim pirigili daa pa bɛ zuɣu.
en: Hoshaiah marched behind the singers, followed by half the leaders of Judah.

dag: Di saha ka Abinɛr suhu daa yiɣisi pam Ishibɔshɛt yɛtɔɣa maa zuɣu, ka o daa bɔh o, Judanim baa n-nyɛ ma? N kul ʒiɛla a ba Sool min o mabihi ni o zɔnim zaa yim hal ni zuŋɔ, ka bi saɣi zaŋ a niŋ Dauda nuu ni, di zaa yoli ka a ti zaŋ ma taali paɣ zuɣu.
en: This made Abner very angry. He said, I have been loyal to Saul and his family. I did not give you to David. I am not a traitor working for Judah. But now you are saying that I did this bad thing.

dag: Di simdi ni sokam ti ti o yaa tariga kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni shɛm.
en: as he is able, in proportion to the blessings that the Lord your God has given him.

dag: Ka bɛ biriginsim zuɣu yi chɛ ka dunianim nya Naawuni daalibarika din galisi, ka bɛ ni kɔŋ shɛli nyabu zuɣu mi yi chɛ ka bɛn pa Izraɛlnim nya Naawuni daalibarika din galisi, dindina Izraɛlnim yi pahi bɛ zuɣu Naawuni daalibarika maa ni gari lala.
en: But if the rest of the world's people were helped so much by their sin and loss, they will be helped even more by their full return.

dag: Ka din nyɛ yɛlikpeeni nyɛla, baŋmiya ni anabitali yɛtɔɣa din be Naawuni Kundi ni pala ninsal ni ni tooi kahigi shɛli gbinni wuhi omaŋmaŋ baŋsim puuni;.
en: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.

dag: Ka timaŋmaŋ gba baŋ Naawuni yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ ti sani, ka niŋ yɛda. Naawuni nyɛla yurilim, ka ŋunkam kul be yurilim puuni nyɛla ŋun be Naawuni ni, ka Naawuni gba be o ni.
en: So we know the love that God has for us, and we trust that love. God is love. Everyone who lives in love lives in God, and God lives in them.

dag: Ka Manaasa zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaayi ni kɔbisiyi.
en: The total number of men counted from the tribe of Manasseh was .

dag: Nyɛvili be wuntizɔbo soli ni, ka nir yi doli di soli maa o ku kpi.
en: Along the path of goodness there is life; that is the way to live forever.

dag: Yurilim bi chɛ ka nir tumd o ʒiʒiinikpee zaɣ biɛɣu, dinzuɣu yurilim nyɛla din paani Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Love doesnt do anything wrong to a neighbor; therefore, love is what fulfills the Law.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ pinaanahi dali nyɛla Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu sara malibu dabisili.
en: The Lord s Passover will be on the th day of the first month.

dag: Dindali maa, Yawɛ ni ti guli bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm puuni, ka hal bɛ ni ninvuɣ gbarima ni ti mali kpiɔŋ kaman Dauda la. Ka Dauda zuliya maa ni ti gari tooni m-be kaman Yawɛ malaika la bee Naawuni maŋmaŋ la m-mali ba chana.
en: I, the Lord God, will protect Jerusalem. Even the weakest person there will be as strong as David, and David's kingdom will rule as though my very own angel were its leader.

dag: O daa mi ni nyuli ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa zab Yisa zaŋ o tahi maa na.
en: He knew that the chief priests had handed him over because of jealousy.

dag: Naawuni daa kahigi ashili nia shɛl o ni daa lo la wuhi ma. M pun sab di yɛla biɛla gbaŋ ŋɔ ni tin ya.
en: God let me know his secret plan by showing it to me. I have already written a little about this.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa ti wum niriba ni yɔri vuri, ka o yɛli Musa, Niriba yɔrila tɔb tuhibu vuri sansani maa ni.
en: When Joshua heard the noisy shouts of the people, he said to Moses, A battle must be going on down in the camp.

dag: Di ŋmanila zabiliga tibiɛl shɛli nir ni zaŋ biri; ka di pɔri gari tibiɛlinli kam la.
en: Gods kingdom is like a mustard seed, which is smaller than any other seed on earth that you can plant.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o zaŋ dari maa pirigili m-mali buɣim she nimdi ŋubi tiɣi; ka lan zaŋ di shɛŋa mali buɣim wuɣisi ka yɛra, Buɣim ŋɔ wuɣisibu kpe ma nyaɣisim, di kpe n kɔba ni.
en: Half of it he burns in the fire; on that half he roasts and eats meat, and he is satisfied. He warms himself and says, Ah, Im warm, watching the fire.

dag: Dauda ni daa tuhi Amalɛknim maa ka labina Naa Sool kum maa nyaaŋa, o daa kpalimla Zikilag daba ayi.
en: Saul was dead. Meanwhile, David had defeated the Amalekites and returned to Ziklag.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim mini maligumaaniba bɛn kpalim ni Lɛvinim bɛn kpalim daa bela Juda fɔntinsi zaa ni. Bɛ zaa daa bela bɛ tiŋgbana ni.
en: The rest of Israel, the priests, and the Levites were in all the towns of Judah, each of them in their own property.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgban ni, bɛ daa zaŋla Gɛba mini di momaha tiŋgbana ni Alɛmɛt mini di momaha tiŋgbana ni Anatɔt mini di momaha tiŋgbana ti ba. Bɛ ni daa su tin shɛŋa bɛ daŋ maa zaa ni daa nyɛla tinsi pinaata.
en: From the tribe of Benjamin they got the cities of Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth. They got all the cities and the fields around them. Thirteen cities were given to the Kohath families.

dag: Kpeen so daa ti bɔhi Yisa, Karimba suŋ, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: An important man asked Jesus, Good Teacher, what must I do to have eternal life.

dag: Niɣi mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa ni ti do di ni, ka vikpiluri mini vitahiŋgbana ti tam di mɔpilinyuhi zuɣu. Viri ni ti kumdi di takɔriti ni, ka kahiŋkɔri ti kumdi di dunɔbihi zuɣu; dama bɛ ni zaŋ sida dari tum di tuun shɛŋa la ni ti bahi yoli.
en: Herds of wild animals will live in its rubble; all kinds of desert owls will perch on its stones and hoot in the windows. Noisy ravens will be heard inside its buildings, stripped bare of cedar.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn kul maani ma ninʒeensi ansarisi ka bi chɛra, ka dimdi bɛ nyina niŋdi ma.
en: Worthless people make fun and never stop laughing.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tim Pisidia tiŋgbɔŋ puuni gari chaŋ Pamfilia.
en: After going through the territory of Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛb zaa zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri tuuli bihi nyɛla n ni su shɛba. N ni daa ku bikpamba zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛl la, ka n daa mali ba kasi ti mmaŋa.
en: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka n wum li. N wum a yɛtɔɣa maa vuri.
en: Now this is what I heard you say:.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti yɛli yili maa ni bihi maa, Niŋmiya kom pali sinsi ŋɔ. Ka bɛ daa niŋ kom pali di zaa ha nti paai di naŋgbanyɛra tarisi.
en: Jesus said to the servants, Fill these jars with water. They filled them to the brim.

dag: N ni zaŋ a niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ wurim a ni ko pin shɛli la min a ni daa me binshɛŋa din dundu zali luɣ shɛŋa zaa la. Bɛ ni ti pirig a situra zaa, ka yeeg a yɛ viɛla zaa, ka chɛ a zal a zaɣim.
en: I will put you in their power, and they will tear down the places where you engage in prostitution and worship idols. They will take away your clothes and jewels and leave you completely naked.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ŋaha puuni ka n yɛri ya dimbɔŋɔnima; saha kanna ka n ti ku lan yɛli ya shɛli ŋaha puuni, amaa ka ni ti kahigi m Ba yɛla wuhi ya.
en: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.

dag: Ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa yɛli Napaɣ Ɛsta mini Mɔdɛkai ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nir maa, Nyama, m pun chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Haman yili gar dari, o ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim polo la zuɣu, ka zaŋ o yiŋ ti Ɛsta.
en: King Xerxes then said to Queen Esther and Mordecai, the Jew, Look, I have hanged Haman for his plot against the Jews, and I have given Esther his property.

dag: Bansi maa daa baɣila di naŋgbaŋkuɣila din daa yɛn gbibi dapu shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali kpuɣiri teebuli maa.
en: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table were placed through these rings.

dag: Bɛ yuri sara maligu pam. Bɛ zaŋdi nimdi maani sara ka ŋubiri li. Amaa Yawɛ ŋun baɣa ka di ni. Pumpɔŋɔ o ni teei bɛ tuumbiɛri yɛla, ka darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu. Bɛ ni labi Ijipti.
en: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord , refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa siɣi teeku maa ni n-doli tiŋ kuŋ maa chana, ka koma maa be kaman goma la n-ʒe bɛ nudirigu mini bɛ nuzaa polo.
en: and the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with walls of water on both sides.

dag: O daa mali nyolɔrigu ka di be kaman bɛ ni daa she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la shɛm la. Bɛ daa zaŋla salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli mal li.
en: Then they made the judgment pouch. It was the work of a skilled person, just like the ephod. It was made from gold threads, fine linen, and blue, purple, and red yarn.

dag: Amaa n ni tɔɣisila Kpiɔŋlan Naa yɛtɔɣa, n yuya ni n yɛtɔɣa maa tɔɣisila Naawuni sani.
en: But my dispute is with God, not you; I want to argue my case with him.

dag: Mbusim be piɛgul so ŋun chɛ piɛri bahi maa zuɣu! Bɛ ni zaŋ sua n-chɛ o bɔɣu tabil o nudirigu nini. Ka o bɔɣu maa kpi, ka o nudirigu nini maa gba zom zaa.
en: Doom, foolish shepherd who forsakes the flock. A sword will strike his arm and his right eye. His arm will wither completely; his right eye will become blind.

dag: Dinzuɣu benya tibi kaman yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni be tibi shɛm.
en: What I am saying is that you must be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

dag: Naawuni, a mi n jɛrilim ni nyɛ shɛm. N ni pun tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa bi sɔɣ a sani.
en: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.

dag: Amaa n ni ti teei n ni daa lo a alikauli shɛli a bipolitali saha la yɛla, ka lan lo a alikauli shɛli din ku naai.
en: But I will remember the agreement we made when you were young. I made an agreement with you that will continue forever!.

dag: A paɣibu yɛla kul bela n nol ni, ka n yɛr a tibiginsim yɛla dabisili puuni zaa.
en: and I praise and honor you all day long.

dag: Nyin ʒirilana ŋɔ, a yu yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din biɛri niriba tɔɣisibu!.
en: You love all destructive words; you love the deceiving tongue.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Ammɔnnim polo tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi ba.
en: Mortal man, he said, denounce the country of Ammon.

dag: A guri a tɔbu, ka zali zaligu, ka piɛma pani di zuɣu. A zaŋ mɔɣa bɔɣi tiŋgbani.
en: Your arrows were ready and obeyed your commands. You split the earth apart with rivers and streams;.

dag: O ni deei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yihi tahima suhigu, o ku zaɣisi bɛ suhigu.
en: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.

dag: Amaa man ni yɛlimi, Yawɛ, n tum alahichi a sani, zom ma nambɔɣu ka tib ma.
en: I say, Lord , be kind to me. I sinned against you, but forgive me and make me well.

dag: Ka zuliya kam ni zaŋ bɛ tibiginsim mini bɛ jilima na nti kpe tiŋ maa ni.
en: They will bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

dag: ti yɛra, Doo ŋɔ wuhirila niriba ni bɛ doli Naawuni zaligu ni bi wuhi shɛm n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: and said, This man is trying to make our people worship God in a way that is against our Law.

dag: Bɛ tuma zaa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛli Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni nyɛla bɛ ʒiri Naawuni jɛmbu shee dasara mini di kuruwɔɣila ni daantalisi ni di binzahi.
en: When you travel, it is their job to carry the frames of the Meeting Tent. They must carry the braces, the posts, and the bases.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ suhudoo ni yiri so sanna ŋɔ ni chɛ ka di ku yuui ka yi du n-tam Sintani zuɣu n-no m-bɔr o. Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: And God, our source of peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali sara maa naai, ka naa mini bɛn zaa daa be o sani gbani n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: Then King Hezekiah and all the people knelt down and worshiped God.

dag: Ka o daa mali dundɔŋ, ka zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinahinaanahi n-yili di nudirigu polo.
en: He also set up the courtyard. The courtyards south side had drapes of fine twisted linen stretching one hundred fifty feet.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika maa, N suhir a, na di kuli, ka ti gbaai bubil polli kɔrigi niŋ bindirigu ti a.
en: Manoah said to the LORDs messenger, Please let us persuade you to stay so we can prepare a young goat for you.

dag: Niriba pam mini zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yiko pam ni ti ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka suh o ka o niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Many people and many powerful nations will come to Jerusalem to find the Lord All-Powerful and to worship him.

dag: Dama bɛn be kpiimba biɛhigu shee ku tooi puh a, bɛ mi ku tooi paɣ a. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be gbala ni ku tooi mali tahima zaŋ chaŋ a ʒiɛyimtali polo.
en: No one in the world of the dead can praise you; The dead cannot trust in your faithfulness.

dag: O kul ku nyari nir taali sahakam, bee n-jɛri suli sahakam.
en: He does not keep on rebuking; he is not angry forever.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi ŋmaligi n-jɛm binyoya din ka buchi, ka ku tooi tiligi ya ŋɔ, dama di ka buchi.
