en: Don't worship idols! They don't have any power, and they can't help you or save you when you're in trouble.

dag: Ɛlikana daa yi kɔrigi binshɛli m-mali sara dahin shɛli o ŋmahirila nimdi tar o paɣ Pɛnina min o bidibisi ni o bipuɣinsi zaa.
en: Whenever he sacrificed, Elkanah would give parts of the sacrifice to his wife Peninnah and to all her sons and daughters.

dag: Ti lo nia ni ti tumla din tuhi, ka di pala zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma sani kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ chaŋ ninsalinim gba sani.
en: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.

dag: Rubin zuliya nti yɛn ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli be nudirigu polo. Rubin niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Shɛdiu bia Ɛlizu.
en: On the south side will be the banner of Reubens camp with its military units. The chief of the people of Reuben is Elizur, Shedeurs son.

dag: Ka niriba daa nya o, ka bo nachimba pihita n-chɛ ka bɛ kana ti be o sani.
en: When the townspeople saw him, they selected thirty companions to be with him.

dag: Di saha maa Dɛbɔra ŋun daa nyɛ anabi, ka nyɛ Lapidɔt paɣ la n-daa nyɛ Izraɛlnim zuɣulana.
en: Now Deborah, the wife of Lappidoth, was a prophet, and she was serving as a judge for the Israelites at that time.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Yi zaa ni ti zo ka chɛ ma, dama di sabiya ni Naawuni yɛliya, N ni ku piɛgula, ka piɛri wurim.
en: Jesus said to them, You will all falter in your faithfulness to me. It is written, I will hit the shepherd, and the sheep will go off in all directions .

dag: Naawuni tamla o nirilim niŋbu la yɛla? O suhuyiɣisili chɛ ka o zaɣisila nambɔɣu zɔbu.
en: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger.

dag: Ka Amɔrinim maa tintariga daa kpuɣi Akirabim hal ni Sɛla n-yi nimaani zaŋ du ha.
en: The old Amorite-Edomite border used to go from Sela through Scorpion Pass into the hill country.

dag: Amaa ka Juda bituuli Ɛr maa daa nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛɣu Yawɛ sani, ka Yawɛ daa ku o.
en: But the LORD considered Judahs oldest son Er immoral, and the LORD put him to death.

dag: Ɛliɛza bidibisi ni daa nyɛ kpamba gari Itama bidibisi zuɣu ka bɛ daa piri ba la ʒiibupinaayɔbu zuɣu kaman bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni daa nyɛ shɛm, ka daa piri Itama bidibisi mi ʒiibunii zuɣu.
en: Since Eleazars family was found to have more male heads than Ithamars family, they divided them so that Eleazars family had sixteen household heads and Ithamars family had eight.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa chaŋ Giligal, ka bɛ ti zaŋ Sool n-leei naa Yawɛ tooni Giligal ka mali suhudoo sara Yawɛ tooni nimaani. Ka Sool mini Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri daa paligi pam.
en: All the people went to Gilgal. There, in front of the Lord , the people made Saul king. They offered fellowship offerings to the Lord . Saul and all the Israelites had a great celebration.

dag: Di zaŋ yɛm bahi, yɛm ni gbib a. Yum yɛm, ka yɛm gul a.
en: Dont abandon her, and she will guard you. Love her, and she will protect you.

dag: Dama Yawɛ pun pii Yaakubu n-leeg o dahalali nira. O zaŋ Izraɛlnim leeg o dahalali niriba.
en: He chose Jacob for himself, the people of Israel for his own.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli ma, Anabinim maa malila n yuli ŋmari ʒiri. Man bi tim ba bee n-zali ba shɛli bee n-tɔɣisi bɛ ni so yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ tɔɣisiri ya la ʒii din nyɛ ʒiri yɛtɔɣa. Di nyɛla baɣibuɣibo din ka buchi, ka nyɛ bɛ maŋmaŋ suhu ni yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa.
en: Then the Lord said to me, Jeremiah, those prophets are telling lies in my name. I did not send them or command them or speak to them. Their prophecies came from false visions, worthless magic, and their own wishful thinking.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kuri niriba maa, ka di daa ti kpalim n ko, ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nina kpa tiŋ kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ! A yɛn kula Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, a suhu ni yiɣisi bahi Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: I was then alone, so I bowed down and cried out to the Lord , Why are you doing this? Are you so angry with the people of Jerusalem that everyone must die.

dag: Dama bɛ ni na be bɛ nyɛvili ni ŋɔ, ŋun kɔhi maa ku lan nya o ni kɔhi shɛli maa, dama ʒii maa yɛrila bɛ zaa yɛla, ka di mi ku vuui, bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, bɛ ti ku lan mali bɛ nyɛviya.
en: The seller will never get back what was sold, even if both of them survive. The vision concerns the whole crowd. It wont be revoked. And the guilty ones— they wont even be able to hang on to their lives.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa bɔhi Yisa, Mami Naawuni zaligubaŋdib yɛli ni Anabi Ilaija n-yɛn daŋ kandina.
en: They asked Jesus, Why do the legal experts say that Elijah must come first.

dag: Yu suŋ so tulaale viɛlli, ka kum dali so dɔɣibu dali.
en: A good reputation at the time of death is better than loving care at the time of birth.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Bɛrishiiba; dama nimaani ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa laɣim po pɔri.
en: So they called the place Beersheba, because they made a treaty there.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-daa zaŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim leeg a dahalali niriba ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka leei bɛ Naawuni.
en: You made the people of Israel your very own people forever, and Lord , you became their God.

dag: Niriba yi turi ya ka niŋdi ya alaka, ka ŋmari ʒi biɛri balibu kam pari ya n zuɣu, yi mal alibarika.
en: God will bless you when people insult you, mistreat you, and tell all kinds of evil lies about you because of me.

dag: Yɛlim niriba, Bɛna m-bɔŋɔ! Molimi molo jɛndi Jɛrusalɛmnim yɛli, Bɛn yɛn teei gili ya yi tiŋgban shɛli ni katiŋ kanna. Bɛ tahirila Juda tinsinim zuɣu.
en: Warn the nations, proclaim it to Jerusalem! Armies are approaching from a far-away country, raising their war cries against the towns of Judah.

dag: Nyini Ijipti paɣipiɛliga, Cham Giliad ti bom tim. A ni niŋ tima pam maa zaa, yoli ka a niŋ li maa; a ku tibi kpaŋ.
en: Egypt, no medicine can heal you, not even the soothing lotion from Gilead.

dag: Man yɛm, m mini baŋsim m-be, ka baŋsim mini fahim be n sani.
en: I am Wisdom, and I have insight; I have knowledge and sound judgment.

dag: Naa Jɛhoyakim ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa Jɔsia bia la ni daa di nam ti paai yuma anahi saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Judanim zaa polo.
en: Jeremiah received the LORDs word concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Judahs King Jehoiakim, Josiahs son. This was the first year of Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: Bɛ bɔbindimi gindi liɣa, ka ka firila, ka o chɛ ka bɛ ʒiɛhiri gindi kaman nir ni nyu dam kul la.
en: They are like someone feeling their way in the dark. They are like drunks who dont know where they are going.

dag: Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihinahi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam n-su Izraɛlnim maa, o daa dila nam maa yuma ayi. Amaa Judanim bɛn daa dolila Dauda.
en: Ishbosheth was years old at the time, and he ruled for two years. But the tribe of Judah made David their king.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ maligumaana maa suhupiɛlli, ka o kpuɣi tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru maa mini binnan bihi ni dari binnani maa n-kpe m-be niriba maa sunsuuni ka bɛ chana.
en: The priest was convinced, so he took the priestly vest, the divine images, and the sculpted image and went along with the people.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin mini Hashub daa mali me bɛ yiŋ tooni m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Maasɛya bia Azaria ŋun daa nyɛ Anania yaaŋa la daa mali me o yiŋ luɣili ni m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: Benjamin and Hasshub built the next section, which was in front of their houses; Azariah, the son of Maaseiah and grandson of Ananiah, built the next section, which was in front of his house;.

dag: dama o zali dabisili ni o ti chɛ ka o ni pii so la zaŋ wuntia biɛhigu kari dunianim saria. Lala zuɣu ka o daa neeg o ni daa pii so maa kum ni ni di leei shɛhira sokam zaa sani.
en: This is because God has set a day when he intends to judge the world justly by a man he has appointed. God has given proof of this to everyone by raising him from the dead.

dag: Kpeen so daa ti bɔhi Yisa, Karimba suŋ, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: A Jewish leader asked Jesus, Good Teacher, what must I do to receive eternal life.

dag: Ŋuna n-filim kurimbuni ha wuna la, ka o nuhi din ka bahigu ŋɔ gbibi ya. O ni kari yi dimnim bɛn be yi tooni la bahi ka yɛli, Kumiya ba.
en: The most ancient God is a place of safety; the eternal arms are a support. He drove out the enemy before you. He commanded: Destroy them.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Neetan, N tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Ka Neetan garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ chɛ a taali maa, a ku lan kpi.
en: Ive sinned against the LORD! David said to Nathan. The LORD has removed your sin, Nathan replied to David. You wont die.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tim Pisidia tiŋgbɔŋ puuni gari chaŋ Pamfilia.
en: After Paul and Barnabas traveled through Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli m ba Dauda, A ni lo ni a me jɛmbu duu ti n yuli jilima maa, di viɛla.
en: But the LORD said to my father David: It is very good that you thought to build a temple for my name. Nevertheless.

dag: n-zaŋ di zaa niŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa nuhi ni, ka zaŋ bɛ nuhi maa gahigahi zuɣusaa, ka di leei nuhi gahibu sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Put all this food in the hands of Aaron and his sons and have them dedicate it to me as a special gift.

dag: Lala ka tuun suma gba yiri palo, hal tuun sun shɛŋa yi bi yi palo viɛnyɛliŋga, di mi kul ku bahi kpalim sɔɣiya.
en: In the same way good deeds are plainly seen, and even those that are not so plain cannot be hidden.

dag: O daa malila chɛchɛbunsi tuhili ni kɔbisiyi mini wɔribariba tuhi pihiyɔbu. Ka tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa yi Ijipti mini Libia ni Sukiim ni Itiɔpia n-dol o daa ka kalinli.
en: Accompanying Shishak from Egypt were twelve hundred chariots, sixty thousand horses, and countless Libyan, Sukkite, and Cushite warriors.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa nya ma kul maani ma la ansarisi; ka mɛrigiri bɛ noya niŋdi ma, ka viini bɛ zuɣuri niŋdi ma ka yɛra.
en: Everyone who sees me makes fun of me. They shake their heads and stick out their tongues at me.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee dola palo ni Naawuni tooni, ka bahiyoli ka binshɛli din ni pili.
en: The world of the dead lies open to God; no covering shields it from his sight.

dag: Bɛ maŋmaŋ niŋgbuna biɛrim kɔŋko n-naɣi mali ba, ka bɛ kuhiri bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: We feel only the pain of our own bodies and the grief of our own minds.

dag: ka soli be di tooni. Duri maa daa bemi kaman nuzaa polo duri la. Di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ zaa daa kul nyɛla yim. Ka niriba ni yɛn doli luɣ shɛŋa yira mini di mɛbu ni di dunoya zaa kul nyɛ yim.
en: in front of them. The design of the chambers resembled the ones to the north in length and width, as well as in all their exits. The arrangement of the entrances.

dag: Yi ni daa ŋme n-nyaŋ zuliya pam ka di bɛ nɛma la zuɣu, bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim gba ni ti ŋmɛn ya ka di yi nɛma, yi ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb mini yi ni daa chɛ ka damli shɛli dam dunia ni fɔntinsi ni n-tabili bɛnkam zaa be di ni la zuɣu.
en: You have stolen things from many nations, so they will take much from you. You have killed many people and destroyed lands and cities. You have killed all the people there.

dag: Ijipti naa Firawuna daa pun chaŋ ti tuhi deela Gɛza ka ku Keenannim bɛn daa be tiŋ maa ni, ka nyo li buɣim; ka zaŋ li ti o bipuɣin so Sulemaana ni daa kpuɣila ka di leeg o daamiliya lɔbu pini;.
en: In the past the king of Egypt had fought against the city of Gezer and burned it. He killed the Canaanites who lived there. When Solomon married Pharaohs daughter, Pharaoh gave him that city as a wedding present.

dag: Juda Naa Ahazia bia Naa Jɔash ni daa di Juda nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaata saha, ka Jɛhu bia Jɛhɔahaz daa di Izraɛl nam n-ʒi Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ la o nam maa ni yuun pinaayopɔin.
en: Jehoahaz, Jehus son, became king of Israel in Samaria in the twenty-third year of Judahs King Jehoash, who was Ahaziahs son. He ruled for seventeen years.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba chaŋ ni alaafee, ka dabiɛm bi mali ba, ka teeku daa zaŋ bɛ dimnim la vali.
en: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ mi ni n nuu zuɣu tuma ka n daa zaŋ dihi m mini n dolintaba, hal ka daa yɛli ba situra pahi.
en: You know that I always worked to take care of my own needs and the needs of the people who were with me.

dag: Zaŋm a nudirigu di nasara, ka deei ti suhigu, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka a fa a ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bahi.
en: Save me by your power and answer me so that the people you love might be rescued.

dag: O chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa be viɛnyɛliŋga yi ʒiɛman ni. Tiliginsim mini yɛm ni baŋsim din galisi bela o sani. Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ Ziɔn azichi.
en: Jerusalem, you are rich with wisdom and knowledge of God. You are rich with salvation. You respect the Lord , and that makes you rich.

dag: Ka ti daa ti chani Naawuni suhibu shee n-tuhi bipuɣin so ŋun daa nyɛ dabili ka lan nyɛ kpilikparisilana soli. Bɛn daa su o daa diri kpilikparisi maa baɣitali nyɔri pam.
en: One day on our way to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl. She had a spirit in her that gave her the power to tell the future. By doing this she made a lot of money for her owners.

dag: Nir na mi n-zaŋ tuŋ wula niŋ binshɛli? Ka nir na mi n-zaŋ tuŋ wula kpahi kpa n-zaŋ binyɛra yili li?.
en: Can you use that wood from a grapevine to make anything? Can you use that wood to make pegs to hang dishes on?.

dag: Lala zuɣu yinim paɣiba, deemiya yi yidaannim noya, ka bɛ ni shɛb bɛn bi deei Naawuni yɛligu la ni niŋ Naawuni yɛda bɛ paɣiba biɛhigu zuɣu, ka pa ni yi ni yɛli shɛm zuɣu.
en: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa po pɔri di saha maa ha yɛli, Ŋunkam ti yiɣisi ni o lab me Jɛriko zali, Yawɛ ŋun yɛlim noli ti o ka di di o. Ŋunkam ti zali di tanzaa, o bidib kpɛm ni kpi; Ŋunkam mi ti mali di duno yɔriti, o bidibiga ŋun nyɛ biasani ni kpi.
en: At that time Joshua made this important promise. He said, Whoever rebuilds Jericho will be in danger from the Lord . When he lays the foundation, he will lose his oldest son. When he sets up the gates, he will lose his youngest son.

dag: Di saha o bia Finɛhas paɣ puli daa kurigimi ka o saɣi dɔɣibu. O gba ni daa wum ni bɛ fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa, ka o yidan min o yidan ba zaa lan kpi maa, ka dɔɣim biɛrim dii pilig o, ka o gbani dɔɣi bidibiga. Ka tarigi n-yɛn kpi.
en: The wife of Phinehas was about to give birth. And soon after she heard that the sacred chest had been captured and that her husband and his father had died, her baby came. The birth was very hard.

dag: Binshɛŋa din ŋmani sakuɣa la na mi n-kɔŋ Lɛbanɔn tampima la lɔna ni? Ka zoya ni kulibɔŋ maha la kɔzɔrim na mi n-nyuui?.
en: Does the snow on the mountains of Lebanon ever melt entirely off their rocky cliffs? Do the cool mountain streams ever dry up?.

dag: M bɔri ni zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani din ya shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni n zaŋla nyɛvili mini kum ni alibarika mini noli dibu zali ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Dinzuɣu piimiya nyɛvili, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi mini yi zuliya be.
en: I call heaven and earth as my witnesses against you right now: I have set life and death, blessing and curse before you. Now choose life—so that you and your descendants will live.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa bɔhi Yisa, Mami Naawuni zaligubaŋdib yɛli ni Anabi Ilaija n-yɛn daŋ kandina.
en: And they asked Jesus, Why do the teachers of the Law say that Elijah has to come first.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi nyɛla bɛ shɛhiranim mini bɛ nyaanzaaniba, dama bɛna n-daa shiri ku ba, ka yi mi ti mɛri duri gindi bɛ gbala maa.
en: In this way, you testify that you approve of your ancestors deeds. They killed the prophets, and you build memorials!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ daba ayi nimaani, ka yɛdaniŋdiba maa daa ti chɛbisi ba ni suhupiɛlli ka bɛ lab bɛn daa tim ba na maa sani. .
en: Judas and Silas stayed there awhile, then were sent back with a blessing of peace from the brothers and sisters to those who first sent them.

dag: ka chɛ ka yi maŋgbibbu pahi yi baŋsim zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi ʒiɛyimtali pahi yi maŋgbibbu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi Naawuni sizuura lubu pahi yi ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu.
en: to your knowledge add self-control; to your self-control add patience; to your patience add devotion to God;.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa bɔhi nachimbil so ŋun yɛl o li maa, Wula ka a lee niŋ baŋ ni Sool min o bia Jɔnatan lu tɔb maa ni.
en: David said to the young soldier, How do you know Saul and his son Jonathan are dead.

dag: Ka m mini m paɣa ŋun nyɛ anabi la daa dɔni, ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga. Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Bolim o yuli Mahɛshalalihashibaz.
en: Sometime later, my wife and I had a son, and the Lord said, Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.

dag: Nyin ka n kul zaŋ mmaŋ dalim n dɔɣibu saha hal ni wayo, nyini n-daa yihi ma m ma puli ni na. N kul ni paɣir a sahakam.
en: Ive depended on you from birth— you cut the cord when I came from my mothers womb. My praise is always about you.

dag: Ka Harihaya bia Uziɛl ŋun daa nyɛ machɛli ŋun doori salima la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Hanania ŋun daa nyɛ tulaale maana la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu, ka bɛ daa lab mali Jɛrusalɛm hal ti paai Goon Yɛlinli la shee.
en: Uzziel son of Harhaiah the goldsmith rebuilt the next section. Hananiah the perfume maker rebuilt the section next after that, and it went as far as Broad Wall.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-ʒila Jɛrusalɛm. O daa niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pisinaanu. O ma daa nyɛla Shilihi bipuɣiŋga; ka o yuli booni Azuba.
en: Jehoshaphat was years old when he became king, and he ruled in Jerusalem for years. His mother was Azubah, the daughter of Shilhi.

dag: Di bɔhiya so biɛri, amaa tummiyala din viɛla ka sokam zaa nya.
en: If someone does you wrong, dont try to pay them back by hurting them. Try to do what everyone thinks is right.

dag: Naawuni, a ni daa be a niriba tooni m-mali ba chani la, a ni daa kpe mɔɣu ni gari la.
en: When you went forth before your people, God, when you marched through the wasteland, Selah.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa lan bɔhi Ibrahimma, Wula ka a daa lee tɛhi hal ti niŋ lala maa.
en: Abimelech said to Abraham, What were you thinking when you did this thing.

dag: Bee miri ka a bo a kpee paɣa, ka miri ka a chɛ ka a suhu ye a kpee yili zuɣu bee o puu zuɣu bee o dabili ŋun nyɛ doo bee paɣa bee o naɣilaa bee o buŋa bee a kpee ni su binshɛlikam zuɣu.
en: Do not desire and try to take your neighbors wife. Do not crave your neighbors house, field, male or female servant, ox, donkey, or anything else that belongs to your neighbor.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira gba daa bela Ɛnɔn tin shɛli din miri Salim la m-baptaiziri niriba, dama kom daa be nimaani pam; ka niriba chani o sani ka o ti baptaiziri ba.
en: John also was baptizing in Aenon, not far from Salim, because there was plenty of water in that place. People were going to him, and he was baptizing them. .

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni dɔɣiri bidib shɛb mini bipuɣin shɛb kpe mini bɛ manim ni bɛ banim bɛn dɔɣi ba polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what the LORD proclaims concerning children who are born in this place and their mothers and fathers who give birth to them in this place.

dag: Yɛlim ba yaha, Yi yi ti yihi zaɣ viɛla maa zaka di ni, yinim Lɛvinim yin zaŋmiya din kpalim kaman kabɔɣili ni chi bee wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni wain zaka la.
en: After you have dedicated the best parts to me, you can eat the rest, just as the Israelites eat part of their grain and wine after offering them to me.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wummi Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli cheechinim shɛm! Ŋun di nasara, n ni ti chɛ ka o di nyɛvili ti shɛli din be Naawuni yil la wala.
en: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibisi maa ni ŋun leei maligumaana ni o zan o zaani la ni mali sara maa ti Yawɛ kaman zaligu din nyɛ din ka bahigu, ka bɛ ti zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim.
en: In the future, when Aarons descendants take their place as the anointed priests, they will continue to make this grain offering to the Lord. This rule will continue forever. The grain offering must be completely burned for the Lord .

dag: Di bi simdi ka a nya a mabia nahu bee o piɛɣu ni chaŋ yirigi ka a baɣa ka o ni; di simdi ka a taɣ o labisi ti ti o lana.
en: If you see an Israelite's cow or sheep running loose, do not ignore it; take it back.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi binnana ka mali wun shɛŋa din ka buchi nyuri bara la zaa di vi; dama wuna maa gbaanila o tooni.
en: People worship their idols. They brag about their gods. But they will be embarrassed. And all their gods will bow down before the Lord.

dag: yi ni sɔŋ ma lahibal suŋ la tuma ni di piligu dali hal ti paai pumpɔŋɔ shɛm la zuɣu.
en: I thank God for the help you gave me while I told people the Good News. You helped from the first day you believed until now.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka bɛnkam je Ziɔn di vi, ka ŋmaligi lab bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: Let everyone who hates Zion be ashamed, thoroughly frustrated.

dag: Izraɛl ninvuɣ so bee saan shɛb bɛn be bɛ sani ninvuɣ so yi ti ŋubi bin so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni, n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi dilan zuɣu, ka yih o n niriba ni.
en: I will turn against those who eat blood whether they are citizens of Israel or foreigners living among you, I will separate them from their people.

dag: Ka Sool min o bia Jɔnatan ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be bɛ sani maa daa kpalim be Gɛba din be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni la. Amaa ka Filistianim maa mi daa ti bɛ suɣa do Mikimash.
en: Saul, his son Jonathan, and the soldiers went to Geba in Benjamin. The Philistines were camped at Micmash.

dag: Lɔtan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɔri mini Hɛman. Lɔtan tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Timna.
en: Lotans sons are Hori and Heman, and Lotans sister was Timna.

dag: Nir na mi n-zaŋ tuŋ wula niŋ binshɛli? Ka nir na mi n-zaŋ tuŋ wula kpahi kpa n-zaŋ binyɛra yili li?.
en: because the wood of a grapevine can't be used to make anything, not even a small peg to hang things on.

dag: O daa ŋahila ŋaha tusaata, ka o ni daa yili yil shɛŋa mi daa nyɛ tuhilinaanu.
en: Solomon spoke three thousand proverbs and one thousand five songs.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ ti nyaya ka ninvuɣ biɛri n-lee mali suhupiɛlli. Tuumbiɛtumdiba biɛhigu kul tɔŋdimi, ka pa di kɔŋko, hal bɛ yi buɣisi Naawuni ni bɛ nya, binshɛli bi niŋdi ba. .
en: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.

dag: Amaa ka Ahaz daa yɛli, N ku yɛl o. N ku buɣisi Yawɛ ni n nya.
en: Ahaz answered, I will not ask for a sign. I refuse to put the Lord to the test.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kab chaŋ bɛ ni daa tuhi fa neen shɛŋa maa gbini nti kɔri piɛri mini naɣilahi ni naɣinyama sɔŋ, ka niriba maa daa ŋub ba, bɛ mi daa bi kɔri ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: They grabbed the food they had captured from the Philistines and started eating. They even killed sheep and cows and calves right on the spot and ate the meat without draining the blood.

dag: Amaa bɛ kul domi gu ni bɛ ŋmaligi ku bɛmaŋa. Bɛmaŋmaŋ nyɛviya ka bɛ doya gu maa.
en: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.

dag: Dama ŋunkam niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnima nyɛla Yawɛ ni bi bɔri so, binyɛra din chihiri ŋɔ niŋbu zuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daŋ kariti ba maa.
en: The Lord hates anyone who does these things. And because these other nations do these terrible things, the Lord your God will force them out of the land as you enter it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani chaŋ Gujɔda n-daa ti yi nimaani chaŋ Jɔtibata tiŋgbɔn shɛli din kulibɔna mali kom la.
en: From there they went to Gudgodah and then on to Jotbathah, a well-watered place.

dag: Ti Naawuni maa bela zuɣusaa. O ni yu shɛm ka o tumda.
en: Our God is in heaven— he can do whatever he wants!.

dag: Dama ti Duuma NAAWUNI lan yɛli, N niriba daa tuui kulila Ijipti ti be nimaani. Nyama, di nyaaŋa ka Asirianim gba daa ti nahim ba yoli.
en: When you went to live in Egypt as foreigners, you did so of your own free will; Assyria, however, took you away by force and paid nothing for you.

dag: Saɣimmi ninvuɣ biɛri mini tuumbiɛtumdiba yiko; darigim bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu hal ka bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ti ku lan beni yaha.
en: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.

dag: Ka o daa tim o nyaandoliba ayi n-yɛli ba, Chamiya fɔŋ ni; yi yi ti chirigi do so sol ni ka o ʒiri koyuli, yin doliy o.
en: Jesus sent two of his followers into the city. He said to them, Go into the city. You will see a man carrying a jar of water. He will come to you. Follow him.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn ku niriba me tiŋ zali, ka tum tuumbiɛri zali fɔntiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: You're doomed! You built a city on crime and violence.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali firilatamdigu. O daa zaŋla matarika n-kuri firilatamdigu maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu mini di mundili. Ka di mini di pipihi ni di bintira kɔtomsi la ni di tipuma kɔtomsi la zaa daa nyɛ zaɣ yini.
en: Bezalel made a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, was made from a single piece of hammered gold.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a tam ti yɛla zaa? Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ti bahi dabisi gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa?.
en: Why do you forget us continually; why do you abandon us for such a long time?.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni zab o niriba zuɣu. O ni zo o daba nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord will defend his people; he will take pity on his servants.

dag: Ka bɛ yi zaŋ bɛ liɣiri paŋ so, bɛ bi yɛri dilana ni o niŋm ba nyɔri di yɔbu ni. Bɛ mi bi diri birapu ka diri ʒiri shɛhira n-jɛndiri ŋun ka taali. Bɛnkam tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim kul ku vuui bɛ zaashee.
en: If they loan money to someone, they do not charge them interest. And they refuse to testify against an innocent person, even if someone offers them money to do it. Whoever lives like this will always stand strong.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi gbibi alikauli.
en: Tell them that this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Bad things will happen to anyone who does not obey this agreement.

dag: Ka a chɛ ka a min a bidibisi maa kpe yi duu ka yo yimaŋ niŋ di puuni, ka zaŋ kpam maa m-boori niŋdi ŋmana maa ni; ŋman yini yi ti pali, ka yi vuui li zali kpaŋa.
en: Then go to your house and close the doors. Only you and your sons will be in the house. Then pour the oil into all the bowls. Fill them, and put them in a separate place.

dag: Wuntizɔriba je ninvuɣ biɛri yɛlli, ka ninvuɣ biɛri gba je wuntizɔriba yɛlli.
en: The unjust person is disgusting to the righteous; the straight path is disgusting to the wicked.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa yɛli, Yawɛ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi a ni daa zaŋ a nuu din mali kpiɔŋ mini yiko n-yih a ninvuɣ shɛb Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa zuɣu?.
en: But Moses begged the Lord his God, Lord , dont let your anger destroy your people. You brought them out of Egypt with your great power and strength.

dag: O ʒiinila o yiŋ dunɔdali gbini bee tiŋ puuni luɣ shɛŋa din du pam shee.
en: She sits at the door of her house or on a seat in the highest part of town.

dag: Di ni lan chɛ ka tarimba nya fahim, ka wuhi bipola baŋsim mini yɛm.
en: They make the naive mature, the young knowledgeable and discreet.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri firila na mi n-kpi? Bɛ na mi n-nya ashaara? Ka Naawuni suhu na mi n-yiɣisi ka o chɛ ka biɛrim paai ba?.
en: Was a wicked person's light ever put out? Did one of them ever meet with disaster? Did God ever punish the wicked in anger.

dag: Yisa daa ti yɛli salo pam, Yi yi ti nya ka sagbani dɔni gbinni, yi yɛrimi ni saa ni mi, ka o ti shiri mi.
en: Jesus said to all the people: As soon as you see a cloud coming up in the west, you say, It's going to rain, and it does.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi mini Jɔn bɛn daa nyɛ Saimɔn tumtumdi tab la gba alahiziba. Ka Yisa yɛli Saimɔn, Di zɔri dabiɛm, a nyɛla kulipal ŋun gbahiri zahim, amaa zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, a ni leela ŋun vɔri ninsalinim tiri Naawuni.
en: His partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee, were surprised too. Jesus told Simon, Don't be afraid! From now on you will bring in people instead of fish.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku o min o bihi ni o niriba zaa hal ka o ninvuɣ yino gba bi tiligi; ka daa deeg o tiŋgbɔŋ maa su.
en: So the Israelites wiped out Og, his family, and his entire army—there were no survivors. Then Israel took over the land of Bashan.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa lo naa alikauli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni. Ka Jɛhɔiada daa yɛli ba, N-nyɛ nabia maa, chɛliya ka o di nam kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Dauda zuliya polo la.
en: and gathered at the temple, where they agreed to help Joash. Jehoiada said to them: Joash will be our next king, because long ago the Lord promised that one of David's descendants would always be king.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa boli Izraɛl kpamba zaa na nti yɛli ba, Sokam bom biŋkɔb bila kaman o malibu ni nyɛ shɛm nti kɔrigi puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu.
en: So Moses called all the elders together and told them, Get the lambs for your families. Kill the lambs for the Passover.

dag: Ŋunkam ti mali dalinli ŋun di mirina, do so ŋun nyɛ zoma bee wɔbiga bee ŋun ninni mali dansi bee ŋun bɔɣu yini gari zaɣ yini.
en: No one who has an imperfection will be allowed to make an offering: this includes anyone who is blind, crippled, disfigured, or deformed.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Wula ka di lee sab Naawuni zaligu ni? Wula ka a lee karindi li.
en: Jesus answered, What is written in the Scriptures? How do you understand them.

dag: Ka omaŋmaŋ ni ka yaa yɛla pam ni zuɣu, o ni tooi di suɣilo o tuma ni zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be ʒilinsi ni mini bɛn chirindi polo.
en: Since he himself is weak in many ways, he is able to be gentle with those who are ignorant and make mistakes.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka yi yɛn gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du n-chaŋ ti deei zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi ka mali yaa gari ya fɔntin shɛŋa bɛ ni me goma gili hal ka di ti tɔri sagbana.
en: Listen, people of Israel! Today you are about to cross the Jordan River and occupy the land belonging to nations greater and more powerful than you. Their cities are large, with walls that reach the sky.

dag: N ni daa kari yi yaannim saria Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni tiŋgban nɛli ni shɛm la, lala ka n yɛn kari yi gba saria. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Just as I judged your ancestors in the desert of the land of Egypt, so will I judge you. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa deei nyuli zabbu sara chi zim maa paɣ maa nuu ni n-zaŋ li gahi zuɣusaa Yawɛ tooni, ka zaŋ li pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu;.
en: the priest shall take the offering of flour out of the woman's hands, hold it out in dedication to the Lord , and present it on the altar.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim maa daa kana ka o mini ba ti dɔni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ kɔre maa saɣim o, o ni daa saɣim omaŋ maa nyaaŋa, ka o daa yi bɛ sani chaŋ ni suhuyiɣisili.
en: The Babylonians came to have sex with her. They used her and defiled her so much that finally she became disgusted with them.

dag: Nyini n-su teeku din kul damdi pampam ŋɔ yiko; di kɔgbana yi ti yiɣisi, nyini n-chɛri ka di maari dooni baalim.
en: You rule over the surging sea: When its waves rise up, its you who makes them still.

dag: Amaa ka farigudeera maa ʒe o ko ha, ka bi saɣi ni o kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa, ka naɣ kul malila o nuhi bur o nyɔɣu ka yɛra, Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, zom man alahichilan ŋɔ nambɔɣu.
en: The tax collector stood alone too. But when he prayed, he would not even look up to heaven. He felt very humble before God. He said, O God, have mercy on me. I am a sinner.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa niŋ lala; bɛ daa niŋ Yawɛ ni zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Moses and Aaron did what the Lord told them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Asiria naa sapashin kpamba kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba, ka gbaai Manaasa n-zaŋ mii tu o nyee ni, ka lo o daanya zoligɔnima n-zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: So he let Assyrian army commanders invade Judah and capture Manasseh. They put a hook in his nose and tied him up in chains, and they took him to Babylon.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Di pala yɛlimaŋli, yɛlim ti o ni yɛli shɛm. Ka o yɛli ba, O yɛli ma mi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, M boola kpam ŋɔ bah a zuɣu ni ni a leei Izraɛl naa. .
en: The officers said, No, tell us the truth. What did he say? Jehu told the officers what the young prophet said. Jehu said, He said a few things and then he said, This is what the Lord says: I have anointed you to be the new king over Israel.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu ni tɛha bi kpɛma yi nya nyin ŋun mali baŋsim ŋɔ ka a ʒi buɣili maligu shee diri bindirigu, di ku kpaŋsi dilan maa suhu ka o di bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli mali buɣa?.
en: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.

dag: N kul tɛhirila di yɛla sahakam ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi.
en: I cant help but remember and am depressed.

dag: Ka Salimɔn daa nyɛ o paɣ Reehab bia Bɔaz ba, ka Bɔaz nyɛ o paɣ Rut bia Obɛd ba, ka Obɛd nyɛ Jɛsi ba.
en: Salmon was the father of Boaz. Boaz was the father of Obed. Obed was the father of Jesse.

dag: nyin wummi bɛ suhigu mini bɛ fabila a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni ka niŋ bɛ ni suh a bɔri shɛli maa ti ba, ka chɛ a niriba bɛn tum birig a maa taali.
en: then listen to their prayer and request from your heavenly dwelling place. Do what is right for them, and forgive your people who have sinned against you.

dag: Doo yi chirigi bɛ ni bi zaŋ paɣisaribil so ti doo n-zaŋ o dɔni ka bɛ gbahi ba.
en: A man might find a virgin girl who is not engaged and force her to have sexual relations with him. If other people see this happen.

dag: Dinzuɣu n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim na kul mali duŋ ni Dauda yilinim hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So Israel rebelled against the family of David, and this is how things are even today.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi ma, Jɛrimia, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n gari yɛli, N nyala fiig tiwala din viɛl pam, ka nya fiig tiwala din bie pam, ka di biɛbu maa zuɣu chɛ ka so ku tooi di li.
en: The Lord said to me, What do you see, Jeremiah? I answered, I see figs. The good figs are very good, and the rotten figs are very rotten. They are too rotten to eat.

dag: Ka a mini Rɔdinim daa laɣindi niŋdi daabiligu, teeku duli tinsi pam daa nyɛla a da gahinda, ka bɛ zaŋdi wɔbinyina mini lanjiŋ dari yɔr a nɛma zuɣu.
en: The people of Rhodes traded with you. You sold your things in many places. People brought ivory tusks and ebony wood to pay you.

dag: Ka kuriti nyɔtaɣirisi din ŋmani zahim paɣiri pɔb bɛ nyɔri, ka bɛ kpiŋkpama vuri kaman chɛchɛbunsi wɔr bɔbili ni yi zɔri chani tɔbu tuhibu shɛm la.
en: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.

dag: A nyɛla jilimalana, ka mali dariza gari zo shɛŋa din zuɣu pali mɔɣu ni nimdi.
en: You are more glorious than the eternal mountains.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Kpiɔŋlan yi lo kpara n-ʒe n-gul o yili, o nɛma zaa tiligirimi;.
en: When a strong man arms himself and guards his home, everything he owns is safe.

dag: M biyurisi, pa zaligu palli ka n sabiri tiri ya, amaa di nyɛla zaligu kur shɛli yi ni daa pun mali piligu ni ha la. Zaligu kurili maa nyɛla yi ni daa pun wum yɛligu shɛl la yɛla.
en: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.

dag: Lihimiya nya bɛ ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa nyɛla din viɛl bee din bie, ka nya bɛ ni be fɔntin shɛŋa ni lee nyɛla tin yari bee di nyɛla bɛ ni me goma gili shɛŋa.
en: and if they live in open towns or walled cities. See if the land is good for growing crops and find out what kinds of trees grow there. It's time for grapes to ripen, so try to bring back some of the fruit that grows there.

dag: Ka Barak daa laɣim Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali zuliya niriba maa Kɛdɛshi, ka ninvuɣ tuhi pia daa dol o mini Dɛbɔra chaŋ.
en: At the city of Kedesh, Barak called the tribes of Zebulun and Naphtali together. He gathered , men to follow him from these tribes, and Deborah also went with him.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n kpiɔŋ mini m birini ŋɔ, a ninni ka n-kul lihira.
en: God, my strength, I look to you for help. You are my place of safety, high in the mountains.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Bundaan so n-daa be n-yɛri ago kpariti mini binyɛr suma, ka dir o suhu yubu sahakam.
en: There was once a rich man who dressed in the most expensive clothes and lived in great luxury every day.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ ni pirigi yi situra n-dihi ya vi.
en: You were married to me, but you were unfaithful. You even became a prostitute by worshiping disgusting gods on hilltops and in fields.

dag: Ka Maluk daa nyɛ Hashabia bia, ka Hashabia nyɛ Amazia bia, ka Amazia nyɛ Hilikia bia.
en: son of Hashabiah son of Amaziah son of Hilkiah.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni labisi o ni ʒiɛm m pɔri shɛl la min o ni saɣim alikauli shɛli la ʒil o.
en: He made a promise in my name and swore to honor the treaty. And now that he has broken that promise, my name is disgraced. He must pay for what he's done.

dag: Di bi simdi ka a nya a mabia nahu bee o piɛɣu ni chaŋ yirigi ka a baɣa ka o ni; di simdi ka a taɣ o labisi ti ti o lana.
en: Dont just watch your fellow Israelites ox or sheep wandering around and do nothing about it. You must return the animal to its owner.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa loya ni a ni darigi ti tibili, ka mi shiri niŋ lala. Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, a kul tumdila din tuhi, dama tinima n-zaɣis a yɛligu wumbu.
en: The Lord kept the terrible things ready for us—he made them happen to us. The Lord our God did this because he is fair in everything he does. But we still have not listened to him.

dag: O daa chɛ ka poloya waɣi pam bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kpe m-pali bɛ nanim dugbɛra ni.
en: Their country was overrun with frogs; even the palace was filled with them.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbuɣinli ni yi nyɔŋ ni na ti ku ba, ka kunduŋ yi mɔɣu ni na ti dari tɔhi ba, ka jɛŋgbini do bɛ fɔntinsi ni gu ba, ka ŋunkam yi di ni na, o ni dari tɔh o, dama bɛ daalahichi maa galisiya, ka bɛ kul lan zɔri ka chɛri ma, ka di ka tariga.
en: The people have rebelled and rejected the Lord too many times. So enemies will attack like lions from the forest or wolves from the desert. Those enemies will watch the towns of Judah, and like leopards they will tear to pieces whoever goes outside.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tahi alizin biɛɣu ŋun be bia maa ni zuɣu, ka o zo ka chɛ o, ka bia maa dii kpaŋ zaa.
en: Jesus gave a strong command to the demon inside the boy. The demon came out of the boy, and the boy was healed.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lihi Kɛnnim gba, ka tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛli, Yi biɛhigu shee nyɛla barina ni ka luɣ shɛli. Yi biɛhigu shee maa ŋmanila tiɛɣu din pa kuɣili zuɣu.
en: And this is what I saw about the Kenites: They think they're safe, living among the rocks.

dag: Nuhu daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pihinu, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: He lived a total of years; then he died.

dag: ka yɛl o, M ba, pa lala; dama ŋumbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ kpɛma. Zaŋm a nudirigu maa pala o zuɣu ni.
en: Joseph said, Father, you have made a mistake. This is the older boy. Put your right hand on him.

dag: nyin gbilisim tibili alizanda ni wum a daba bɛn nyɛ a niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ suhigu ka chɛ bɛ taali maa, ka wuhi ba so viɛl shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ka a chɛ ka saa mi a tiŋgban shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti a niriba ni bɛ su li ŋɔ ni.
en: O Lord , listen to them in heaven and forgive the sins of your servants, the people of Israel, and teach them to do what is right. Then, O Lord , send rain on this land of yours, which you gave to your people as a permanent possession.

dag: Bɛnjamin bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bɛla mini Bɛcha ni Jɛdiayɛl, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ata.
en: Benjamin had three sons. Their names were Bela, Beker, and Jediael.

dag: Ka salo bɛn dol o maa yɛli, Yisa ŋun nyɛ anabi n-yi Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na m-bala.
en: The crowds answered, This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.

dag: Ka Musa daa tim ni bɛ ti puɣisi nya Jaza. Ka bɛ daa tuhi fa di tiŋkpansi, ka kari Amɔrinim bɛn daa be nimaani maa.
en: Moses sent spies to Jazer. They captured its villages and took possession of the Amorites who were there.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Midian tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, Labimi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa lo ni bɛ ku a maa zaa kpiya.
en: While Moses was still in Midian, the Lord said to him, Go back to Egypt, for all those who wanted to kill you are dead.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa bi bɔri ni o saɣi ka yɛl o, Mani n-naan ka a sanna ka a ti baptaizi ma, amaa ka nyini nti lee kani n sanna.
en: But John tried to make him change his mind. I ought to be baptized by you, John said, and yet you have come to me.

dag: Wuntaŋ puhibu na saha ka Yaakubu daa yi Pɛnuɛl chana ka luri wɔbiliwɔbili, o sakpuɣu maa zuɣu.
en: The sun rose as Jacob was leaving Peniel, and he was limping because of his hip.

dag: Yawɛ galisiya pam, ka simdi paɣibu pam Naawuni tiŋ la ni, o zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain.

dag: Doo bee paɣ yi ti po pɔri din nyɛ Nazari pɔri ni o wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: If a man or a woman makes a binding promise to be a nazirite in order to be dedicated to the LORD.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A nina maa neema. A yɛda niŋbu n-neeg a nina maa.
en: Jesus said to him, Receive your sight! Your faith has healed you.

dag: Kɛdar peentɔriba bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiriba la ni ti kpalimla biɛla. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The archers are the bravest warriors of Kedar, but few of them will be left. I, the Lord God of Israel, have spoken.

dag: Ka o daa buɣisi di gooni maa gba kaman ninsal ni buɣisir binyara shɛm, ka di dubu nyɛ mita pihiyɔbu.
en: He also measured the thickness of its wall. It was two hundred sixteen feet thick, as a person—or rather, an angel—measures things.

dag: Miriya ka yi pahi yɛtɔɣ shɛli n ni zali ya zaligu shɛli ŋɔ ni bee n-yihi shɛli di ni. Amaa doliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya ŋɔ.
en: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka Yawɛ yɛli Musa mini Aduna ni Miriam, Yi niriba ata maa kam Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la gbin na. Ka bɛ niriba ata maa daa kana.
en: So suddenly, the Lord came and spoke to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam. He said, You three, come to the Meeting Tent, now! So Moses, Aaron, and Miriam went to the Tent.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa yɛl o paɣa, Ti nini nya Naawuni, dinzuɣu biɛhiŋ kani, ti ni kpi.
en: Manoah said to his wife, We are certainly going to die, because weve seen God.

dag: Di saɣiya Hɛzɛkia ni yɛli shɛm maa. Dama Asiria naa yɛliya, Kamiyana ti niŋ sandaani niŋ ma din ni chɛ ka yi zaa yinoyino tooi di omaŋmaŋ tiwala min o fiig tia wala, ka nyu omaŋmaŋ kɔbiliga ni kom.
en: Dont listen to Hezekiah, because this is what Assyrias king says: Surrender to me and come out. Then each of you will eat from your own vine and fig tree and drink water from your own well.

dag: O yaar o noli yɛra, ka di nyɛligira, ka chɛ ka pɔhim ʒiɛri li, ka di leeri kom zɔra.
en: Then God issues his word and melts it all away! God makes his winds blow; the water flows again.

dag: Dauda bapira Jɔnatan n-daa nyɛ saawaralana ŋun mi niriba yɛlimuɣisira, ka lan nyɛ gbansabira karimba. O mini Jɛhiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Hachimɔni bia la n-daa nyɛ bɛn lihiri naa bidibisi.
en: Jonathan, Davids uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel, Hachmonis son, took care of the kings sons.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli nyɛla din mali yiko; o kukoli mali jilima pam.
en: The voice of the Lord is heard in all its might and majesty.

dag: ni yi doli niriba ŋɔ tatabo niŋsim maa mini ŋunkam pahi bɛ zuɣu tumdi bɛ ni tumdi shɛm maa naba.
en: to follow the leadership of such people as these, and of anyone else who works and serves with them.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ ma bahi kɔbulli ŋɔ ni, ka m mali hal ti paai teeku ŋɔ puuni kɔtiŋa. Ka kokpɛɣu kul gili n luɣilikam, ka a kɔgban kara la zaa zɔri duri ma garita.
en: You threw me down to the bottom of the sea. The water was churning all around; I was completely covered by your mighty waves.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi booi kpam maa bahi bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la gba mini di nɛma la zaa zuɣu, ka malimali sara maligu bimbini maa ka di leei din be kasi zaa.
en: Do the same thing with the altar for offering sacrifices and its equipment.

dag: Nir ni dɔɣi bi shɛb o bipolitali ni ŋmanila piɛma din be tɔbutuhira nuu ni.
en: The sons a man has when he is young are like arrows in a soldier's hand.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A shiri ni saɣi kpi n zuɣu? Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, a ni ti chihi paai siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma ka nolɔɣu na bi kum.
en: Jesus answered, Are you really ready to die for me? I am telling you the truth: before the rooster crows you will say three times that you do not know me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gindi napɔŋ din pahir ayopɔin maa ka maligumaaniba piɛbiri kikahi saha shɛli, ka Jɔshua daa yɛli niriba maa, Tahimiya! Dama Yawɛ zaŋ tiŋ maa niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: The seventh time, the priests blew the trumpets. Then Joshua said to the people, Shout, because the LORD has given you the city!.

dag: Ka a ti deei nyɛviya tiliginsim liɣiri maa Izraɛlnim sani n-chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li tum tuma Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni, ka di leei yi nyɛviya tiligibu sara maligu, ka lala chɛ ka Izraɛlnim kul teeri di yɛla Yawɛ sani.
en: Collect this money from the people of Israel and spend it for the upkeep of the Tent of my presence. This tax will be the payment for their lives, and I will remember to protect them.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka salo pam daa ti doli Yisa, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli ba.
en: Large crowds were traveling with Jesus. Turning to them, he said.

dag: Ti zaŋdi galigɛnima n-lɛri yuri ni bɛ tum ti yubu, ka ti ŋmaligiri bɛ niŋgbuŋ zaa kpari ti ni bɔri shɛli polo.
en: We put a bit into the mouth of a horse to make it obey us, and we are able to make it go where we want.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi zɔri nambɔɣu ti ku nya nambɔzɔbo saria karibu puuni; amaa ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu ni ti di nasara saria karibu puuni.
en: There will be no mercy in judgment for anyone who hasnt shown mercy. Mercy overrules judgment.

dag: Dama Anabi Musa daa yɛliya, Tim a ba min a ma jilima. O daa lan yɛli, Ka ŋunkam tur o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: Moses said, Honor your father and your mother, and The person who speaks against father or mother will certainly be put to death .

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, yiɣisima, yiɣisima, niŋmi yaa! Naawuni tiŋ kasi ŋɔ, zaŋm a situr suma ye. Chɛfirinim mini daɣirinim ku lan kpe a puuni yaha.
en: Wake up! Wake up! Zion, clothe yourself with strength. Holy city of Jerusalem, stand up and put on your beautiful clothes! Those filthy foreigners will not enter you again.

dag: Di simdi ni yi chɛ ka dapaɣili kam mali dashɛbira ayi din ni chɛ ka yi zaŋ dapaɣa maa tuɣi taba. Niŋmiya m biɛhigu shee dapaɣa maa zaa lala.
en: with two matching projections, so that the frames can be joined together. All the frames are to have these projections.

dag: Bɛ zaa birigimi; bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn tumdi din chihira. Bɛ ni so bi tumdi din tuhi, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: But everyone has turned away from him. Everyone has become evil. No one does anything good. No, not one person!.

dag: M bolila do so ni o yi wulimpuhili polo kana. O yɛn kabimina kaman suligu la nti niŋ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛli. Mani n yɛli maa, ka di mi shiri ni niŋ lala.
en: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa lan gbaag o yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: Then Job took up his topic again.

dag: Jɛsi dapala maa ŋun dee yi be o nyɛvili ni, nyini bee a nam kul ku nya zaashee zani. Dinzuɣu timmi ka bɛ ti zaŋ o na, dama di kpala talahi ni o kpi.
en: You'll never be safe, and your kingdom will be in danger as long as that son of Jesse is alive. Turn him over to me now! He deserves to die.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka Hɛrɔdias lo Jɔn zaɣ biɛɣu m-bɔri ni o ku o; amaa ka daa bi tooi.
en: So Herodias hated John. She wanted him dead, but she was not able to persuade Herod to kill him.

dag: Di ni tɔɣisi binshɛŋa yɛla zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma so polo ŋɔ daa bi yi Lɛvi zuliya ni na, ka o zuliya ni so mi daa bi tum maligumaaniba tuma bimbini gbini.
en: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa chaŋ ti liri Keenannim mini Pɛrizinima ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ tuhi ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pia Bɛzɛk.
en: The Lord helped the men of Judah defeat the Canaanites and the Perizzites. They killed , men at the city of Bezek.

dag: Izraɛlnima, yi daa zaŋ sara mini pina na ti ti ma saha shɛli n ni daa mali ya be mɔɣu ni la?.
en: Israel, for forty years you wandered in the desert, without bringing offerings or sacrifices to me.

dag: Ka Samsin daa yɛli, Buŋ yɛno kɔbili ka n zaŋ ku ninvuɣ tuhili. Buŋ yɛno kɔbili ka n zaŋ ku ba n-laɣim ba sɔŋ gbilligbilli.
en: Then Samson said, With a donkeys jawbone, I killed men! With a donkeys jawbone, I piled them into a tall pile.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahi pinaayi, ka bɛ boon o Ada la biɛɣ pinaata dali ka bɛ daa yɛn zaŋ zaligu maa tum tuma Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni. Dindali maa ka bɛ daa zali ni bɛ kum Yɛhudianim maa.
en: The one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus on which they could do so was the thirteenth day of the twelfth month .

dag: Yɛm tiri yɛndan kpiɔŋ gari nanim pia bɛn be tiŋ puuni.
en: Wisdom makes a wise person stronger than ten rulers who are in a city.

dag: Sokam daa yola bɛkabɛka . Bɛ ni daa kali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuma nyɛ yuun pisi zaŋ chani maa, bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla dɔbba tuhi kɔbisiyɔbunaata ni kɔbisinu ni pihinu.
en: Everyone who was counted paid the required amount, and there was a total of , men who were years old or older.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa kpalim Antiɔk, ka niriba pam daa pahi bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ yihiri waazu ka wuhiri niriba ti Duuma yɛligu.
en: Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, where, together with many others, they taught and proclaimed the good news of the Lords word.

dag: Wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ yinim Ifriimnima? Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ yinim Judanima? Yi yurilim ŋmanila asiba sagbaŋ, di ŋmanila maligim din bi yuuri ka kpahiri luri la.
en: But the Lord says, Israel and Judah, what am I going to do with you? Your love for me disappears as quickly as morning mist; it is like dew, that vanishes early in the day.

dag: Ka o daa kpabigi li n tooni, di daa sabila di tooni mini di nyaaŋa zaa. Ka sabbu din daa be di ni daa nyɛla fabila mini kuyila ni mbusim.
en: He spread it open in front of me, and it was filled with writing on both sides, songs of mourning, lamentation, and doom.

dag: Yinim bɛn ʒiri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu lahi la, miriya ka yi shihi binshɛŋa din nyɛ daɣiri. Malimiya yimaŋ be kasi. Yimiya Babilɔn chaŋ.
en: Be sure to leave Babylonia, all you that carry the Temple equipment. Touch no forbidden thing; keep yourselves holy and leave.

dag: Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛn zɔr o ni, bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba zaa.
en: God will bless those who honor the LORD— from the smallest to the greatest.

dag: Ŋunkam mini yɛnnim be leerila yɛndana, amaa ŋun mini jɛra be nyarila biɛrim.
en: Be friends with those who are wise, and you will become wise. Choose fools to be your friends, and you will have trouble.

dag: Lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu ka n diri wahala, ka bɛ ba ma bandi kaman tuumbiɛrilana n-nyɛ ma la, amaa so ku tooi ba Naawuni yɛligu bandi.
en: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail.

dag: Zaŋmiya zuliya kam na, ka chɛ ka niriba laɣimna. Bɛ ni ŋuni m-pun yɛl ti dimbɔŋɔ yɛla, ka yɛl ti kurimbuni ha yɛla zali? Bɛ zaŋm bɛ shɛhiranim na ka bɛ ti zani bɛ nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka bɛ wum ka yɛli ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: All the nations are gathered together; the peoples are assembled. Which of them announced this? Who predicted to us the past events? Let them bring their witnesses as a defense; let them hear and say, Its true.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda kaman Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la, nyɛvili kom ni ti zɔri yir o suhu ni na kaman mɔɣa kom ni zɔri shɛm la.
en: whoever believes in me should drink. As the scripture says, Streams of life-giving water will pour out from his side.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mali tahima ŋɔ kul maanila omaŋa m-be kasi kaman o ni be kasi shɛm.
en: Everyone who has this hope in Christ keeps himself pure, just as Christ is pure.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi kul ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔ ka nyuri pipia ŋɔ ni binnyurigu ŋɔ, yi wuhirila ti Duuma kum yɛla hal ni o ti labina.
en: This means that every time you eat this bread and drink this cup, you are telling others about the Lords death until he comes again.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni dunia ŋɔ ni, n ku lan nya Yawɛ bee ninsala yaha.
en: I thought that in this world of the living I would never again see the Lord Or any living person.

dag: Nina nyɛla niŋgbuŋ firila. Ka a nina yi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa bela neesim ni; amaa a nina yi bi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa bela zibisim ni.
en: The only source of light for the body is the eye. When you look at people and want to help them, you are full of light. But when you look at people in a selfish way, you are full of darkness.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim maa jilima la ni ti kpaai kaman fiig tihi walibu saha tiwal shɛŋa din daŋ moobu ni yi luna ka bɛ pihi li, ka di nuu ni paabu n-to ka bɛ pun di li la.
en: The fading glory of those proud leaders will disappear like the first figs of the season, picked and eaten as soon as they are ripe.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, zaɣ viɛlli mini yurilim din galisi kul ni be m biɛhigu ni n nyɛvili ni zaa, ka n kul ni be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa yiɣisi kuli ti be Ninive.
en: So King Sennacherib of Assyria went back to Nineveh and stayed there.

dag: To, ka yi yi ti nya ka Daadam Bia labiri o ni daa pun be luɣ shɛl la, wula ka di lee ni ti ben ya?.
en: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?.

dag: bɛ yi tiri yɛlimaŋgɔba, yi tɛhiya ni ti Duuma bi nyari li?.
en: and he knows when you refuse to give someone a fair trial.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔh o, Bɔ m-poog a n sani ka a bɔri ni a kul a ya pumpɔŋɔ? Ka Hadad yɛl o, Kul chɛ ka n kuli.
en: Why? asked the king. Do you want something I haven't given you? No, I just want to go home.

dag: ka bɛ dɔbba bɛn zaa daa mali suhukpeeni daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti zaŋ Sool min o bihi maa niŋgbuna maa chaŋ Jabɛshi nti zaŋ ba sɔɣi Jabɛshi oki tia gbini, ka daa lo noli daba ayopɔin.
en: all their warriors arose and recovered the corpses of Saul and his sons. They brought them back to Jabesh, buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted for seven days.

dag: Ka Yaakubu zuliya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ni ti be zuliya pam sunsuuni kaman maligim n-yi Yawɛ sanna la. Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila saa ŋun miri bahiri mɔri zuɣu ka di baɣa ka niriba ni bee n-lihiri daadam ninni la.
en: The people of Israel who survive will be like refreshing dew sent by the Lord for many nations, like showers on growing plants. They will depend on God, not people.

dag: Filistianim mini Izraɛlnim daa ti tuhiri tɔbu, ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Filistianima. Ka Filistianim maa daa doli ti ku ba Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: The Philistines fought against Israel in a battle at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed.

dag: Ka o daa wum yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ ka o suhu saɣim pam, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: When the man heard this, he was sad, because he was very rich.

dag: Ka din gari shɛlikam zaa nyɛla, zaŋmiya yurilim din lɔri binshɛɣukam laɣindi taba ka di leeri zaɣ yin la pahi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu.
en: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.

dag: A ni ti bahi yɛmbahiga, dama tahima beni; Naawuni ni ti gul a, ka a vuhiri ka barina kani.
en: You will be secure, for there is hope; you will look around and rest safely.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Mɛnahɛm daa chaŋ ti lu Tapua zuɣu n-tuhi nyaŋ bɛnkam zaa be di ni zaŋ tabili di tintarisi tinsinima. O daa kpuɣila Tiriza zaŋ chaŋ, bɛ ni daa bi taɣ deeg o zuɣu. Ka o daa nyaŋ bɛ zaa, ka kuhi karigi paɣipuhinim puya.
en: As Menahem was on his way from Tirzah, he completely destroyed the city of Tappuah, its inhabitants, and the surrounding territory, because the city did not surrender to him. He even ripped open the bellies of all the pregnant women.

dag: Ka o daa mali sara zoli zuɣu n-laɣim o dɔɣiriba ni bɛ kana ka bɛ min o ti laɣim di bindirigu, ka bɛ daa kana ka bɛ min o ti laɣim di bindirigu maa ka kpalim be zoli maa zuɣu yuŋ hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: He killed an animal, which he offered as a sacrifice on the mountain, and he invited his men to the meal. After they had eaten, they spent the night on the mountain.

dag: N yi yɛn kal li, di galisi gari bihigu. N yi gbihi nti neei, n kul bela a sani.
en: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa lan yɛl o, Ilaisha, n suhir a, kpalimmi kpe; Yawɛ n-tim ma Jɛriko. Amaa ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n kul ku chɛ a dolibu. Ka bɛ daa laɣim doli chaŋ Jɛriko.
en: Elijah then said, Elisha, now the Lord wants me to go to Jericho, but you must stay here. Elisha replied, I swear by the living Lord and by your own life, that I will stay with you no matter what! And he went with Elijah to Jericho.

dag: Di saha maa ka teeku puuni daa yi palɔni, ka tiŋgbani tanzaa daa yi palɔni. Yawɛ, a tahigu min a suhuyiɣisili tuma m-bala.
en: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.

dag: Ti ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm ka ti mabihi la zaŋ ti nti kpɛhi bɛ yinsi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: When we arrived in Jerusalem, the believers welcomed us warmly.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔab mini Abishai bɛn daa kari doli Abinɛr, zaŋ chaŋ wuntan luhili saha ka bɛ daa paai Amma Zoli din be Gia polo Gibiɔn mɔɣu ni soli zuɣu la gbini.
en: but Joab and Abishai continued chasing Abner. The sun was just going down when they came to Ammah Hill.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka n shɛhiranima ayi pil buri, ka n niŋ ba yiko ka bɛ tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihiyɔbu.
en: And I will allow my two witnesses to prophesy for one thousand two hundred sixty days, wearing mourning clothes.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu yi ti paai ti, kaman tibidarigibo tɔbu bee alɔbo bee fifali, ka ti ka a duu ŋɔ gbin na nti zani a tooni n-fabili niŋ a ti muɣisigu saha a ni wum ti fabila maa ka tiligi ti dama a be duu ŋɔ ni. .
en: They believed that whenever this land is struck by war or disease or famine, your people can pray to you at the temple, and you will hear their prayer and save them.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ mi daa bi yɛli ni o ni kpihim Izraɛl yuli dunia ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka Jɔash bia Jɛrɔbɔam tiligi ba.
en: But it was not the Lord 's purpose to destroy Israel completely and forever, so he rescued them through King Jeroboam II.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni zab o niriba zuɣu. O ni zo o daba nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord defends his people; he is kind to his servants.

dag: Dindina, bɔ ka nir lee yɛn zaŋ Naawuni ŋmahindi bee bɔ ka nir lee yɛn zaŋ o buɣisi?.
en: So to whom will you equate God; to what likeness will you compare him?.

dag: Jɔab mabia Asahɛl n-daa nyɛ ŋun pah anahi n-su gol so ŋun pah anahi ni. O kalinsi nyaaŋa, o bia Zɛbadia n-daa zan o zaani, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: in the fourth month, Asahel the brother of Joab, whose son Zebadiah took over command after him;.

dag: N ni zani n ni guli luɣ shɛli polo, ka tam n gooni zuɣu lihiri nya o ni yɛn yɛli ma shɛm min o ni yɛn garigi shɛm zaŋ chaŋ n fabila polo.
en: I will take my post; I will position myself on the fortress. I will keep watch to see what the Lord says to me and how he will respond to my complaint.

dag: Bɛ mi baɣa daa ka maligumaaniba tuma ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ niriba maa sani. So daa yi kɔrigi biŋkɔbigu mali sara n-zaŋ di nimdi maa duɣira, maligumaana yiŋbia zaŋdila dirigu din mali jɛba ata kana.
en: They did not care about how priests were supposed to treat people. Whenever someone brings a sacrifice, priests are supposed to put the meat in a pot of boiling water. Then their servant is supposed to get the three-pronged fork.

dag: ka wuntaŋ ti kpe li ka di zaɣi kpi, di ni dii bi ba jila viɛnyɛliŋga zuɣu.
en: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched and dried up, because they did not have deep roots.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa boli Izraɛl kpamba zaa na nti yɛli ba, Sokam bom biŋkɔb bila kaman o malibu ni nyɛ shɛm nti kɔrigi puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu.
en: Moses called for all the leaders of Israel and said to them, Each of you is to choose a lamb or a young goat and kill it, so that your families can celebrate Passover.

dag: Bi so ŋun buɣisi ni o yɛli noli ti o ba bee o ma o firila ni kpi bumbɔn ni.
en: If you curse your parents, your life will end like a lamp that goes out in the dark.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: Then the Lord spoke to Moses. He said.

dag: n-daa puhi zani o sani ni jilima, ka bɛ min o tɔɣisiri ŋun Yisa ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛlikam Jɛrusalɛm ka naanyi kpi la yɛla.
en: They also looked bright and glorious. They were talking with Jesus about his death that would happen in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli, Paɣ ni tooi tam o bimɔɣirigu yɛla bee n-zaɣis o ni dɔɣi bi so nambɔɣu zɔbu? Hal o yi ni tam gba, man Yawɛ ku tam yi yɛla.
en: The Lord answered, Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.

dag: Yɛlimiya m ba n ni nya jilima shɛli zaa Ijipti ŋɔ mini yimaŋmaŋ nini ni nya shɛlikam zaa. Niŋmiya yomyom chaŋ ti zaŋ m ba kuli kpe na.
en: Tell my father about my great power here in Egypt and about everything you have seen. Hurry and bring him here.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka yi ni ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni; mani n-nyɛ ŋun tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: This happened so that my people will learn about me. My people will know who I am. My people will know my name, and they will know that I Am He is speaking to them.

dag: Di saha ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn min o daa chaŋ maa yɛli, Ti ku tooi tuhi niriba maa, dama bɛ mali kpiɔŋ gari ti.
en: But the men who had gone with him said, We cannot fight those people! They are much stronger than we are.

dag: Di ni ʒiɛya lala sahakam, ni di chɛ ka niriba doli zaligunim maa ni ʒiɛyimtali mini din tuhi tumbu ni.
en: They last for all time; they were given in truth and righteousness.

dag: Ijiptinim ni ti di vi, bɛ ni ti zaŋ ba niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi nuzaa polo na nuu ni. .
en: Egypt will be ashamed. The enemy from the north will defeat her.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, pomiya saŋkpalima bee muli zaɣ nyama ni yi ku chɛ ka ti tab bɔbu kɔre yiɣisi bee n-kpaŋsi li, ka di saha na bi paai.
en: Promise me, women of Jerusalem; swear by the swift deer and the gazelles that you will not interrupt our love.

dag: Yinim Chɛrɛti zuliya bɛn be teeku noli ŋɔ, mbusim be yi zuɣu. Yawɛ yɛligu nyɛla din jɛndi nyini Keenan din nyɛ Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ; n ni saɣim a zaa hal ka so ti ku lan kpalim be a ni.
en: To you people of Philistia who live along the coast, the Lord has this to say: I am now your enemy, and I'll wipe you out.

dag: Lala n-yɛn niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛmaŋ naani mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ daazichi naani.
en: Thats how it goes for those who are foolish, as well as for those who follow their lead, pleased with their talk. Selah.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Farisiinim zuɣu! Dama yi yuri kpamba ʒiishee ʒinibu yi jɛmbu duri ni, ka lan yuri puhigu dahi ni.
en: How terrible for you Pharisees! You love the most prominent seats in the synagogues and respectful greetings in the marketplaces.

dag: N teei dabisa shɛŋa din gari ha yɛla; N tɛhir a tuma zaa yɛla. N kul tɛhir a nuhi tuma zaa yɛla.
en: I remember the days gone by; I think about all that you have done, I bring to mind all your deeds.

dag: N yi di bɔra, n naan tooi mali tahima bina lala tatabo ni. Ka so yi tɛhi ni o ni tooi mali tahima ninsalinim ni niŋdi shɛli bɛ niŋgbuna ni yɛla ni, m mali daliri ni n niŋ lala gar o.
en: although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Taɣimiya yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma, ka n chɛ ka yi be kpe.
en: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, says: Change your lives and do good things. If you do this, I will let you live in this place.

dag: N suhu saɣimmi ka kuui kaman mɔri la, ka n kɔre ka bindirigu ni gba.
en: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam je o mabia, o bela zibisim ni ka kul chanila zibisim maa puuni ka ʒi o ni kpari shɛli polo, dama zibisim maa zom o nina.
en: But if we hate others, we are in the darkness; we walk in it and do not know where we are going, because the darkness has made us blind.

dag: Ka ti yi mi ni ti yi suh o shɛlikam o deeri ti suhigu, dindina ti mi ni o tiri ti ti ni suhir o shɛlikam.
en: If we know that he listens to whatever we ask, we know that we have received what we asked from him.

dag: Chɛ ka wuntizɔriba mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani, ka sɔɣ o sani. Bɛnkam zaa bebu be tibi bɛ suhuri ni tibigim o.
en: Good people are happy to serve the Lord . They depend on him to protect them. All those who want to do right will praise him!.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, a chɛ ka o takɔbi noli gbilim; ka bi zan o nyaaŋa tɔbu ni.
en: You helped them defend themselves. You did not help your king win the battle.

dag: Di saha maa bɛ daa na bi kpɛhi Jɔn duu.
en: This was before John had been put in prison.

dag: Nuhu ʒiɛman ni, n ni daa lo alikauli ni n ku chɛ ka kom lan di dunia la, lala ka n lo alikauli ni n ku lan chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bah a zuɣu, ka mi ku lan darig a tibili.
en: These are like the days of Noah for me, when I promised that Noahs waters would never again cover the earth. Likewise I promise not to rage against you or rebuke you.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! N ni puhi Yawɛ ni n suhu zaa, o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Praise the Lord ! I thank the Lord with all my heart in the assembly of his good people.

dag: Javan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlisha mini Tarishish ni Kitim ni Rodanim.
en: Javan was the ancestor of Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

dag: Dinzuɣu, buɣim ni diri mɔgbina mini mɔ kuma shɛm la, lala ka yi wula yɛn taai buɣim, ka pɔhim ʒe yi puma chaŋ kaman taŋkpaɣ la. Dama yi zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni wuhi ya shɛm, ka ʒiɛm Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ yɛligu.
en: You will go up in flames like straw and hay! You have rejected the teaching of the holy Lord God All-Powerful of Israel. Now your roots will rot, and your blossoms will turn to dust.

dag: Ŋuni ka m mal alizanda ni pah a zuɣu? Ka binshɛli mi ka dunia ŋɔ ni ka m bɔri li pah a zuɣu.
en: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Damaskusnim polo. Hamatinim mini Aripadnim birimmi, dama bɛ wumla lahiba biɛɣu. Dabiɛm kpe ba pam, ka bɛ kɔŋ ʒiya kaman teeku kom din ku tooi fo n-doya la.
en: This message is about the city of Damascus: The towns of Hamath and Arpad are afraid. They are afraid because they heard the bad news. They are discouraged. They are worried and afraid.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o kɔrigi nahu maa, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la zaŋ binʒim maa ti ti Yawɛ, ka zaŋ li mihi gili Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: Then you will slaughter the bull before the LORD. Aarons sons the priests will present the blood and toss it against every side of the altar at the meeting tents entrance.

dag: Daadam ni tooi lo nianim pam o suhu ni, amaa Yawɛ ni yu shɛli n-niŋda.
en: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.

dag: ka daa lee yɛli, Ti di niŋ li chuɣu maa dali, dama di pa shɛli ka niriba ti taai duŋ o gbaabu maa zuɣu.
en: They said, But we cannot arrest Jesus during the festival. We dont want the people to be angry and cause a riot.

dag: Ti mi ni ti ni be dunia ŋɔ ni Tanti yil shɛl ni ŋɔ yi saɣim, ti mali yil shɛli Naawuni sani, ka di nyɛ din ni be alizanda ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka di mi pala ninsal nuhi ni me shɛli.
en: We know that our body—the tent we live in here on earth—will be destroyed. But when that happens, God will have a home for us to live in. It will not be the kind of home people build here. It will be a home in heaven that will continue forever.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni fabili Mɔabnim zuɣu. N ni kum Mɔabnim zaa zuɣu pam, ka fabili Kirihɛrɛsinim zuɣu.
en: So I cry for Moab. I cry for everyone in Moab. I cry for the men from Kir Hareseth.

dag: Nyama, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ suhukpeennim dolila soya kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim, ka sandaantimdiba kuhiri pampam.
en: But listen! The messengers are crying outside. The messengers who bring peace are crying very hard.

dag: dindina di simdi ka dilan pini. Amaa o di pini dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa ni be luɣ shɛli maa, ka maligumaana maa lan zaŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun mali dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa niŋ duu daba ayopɔin yaha.
en: the person must shave. But the diseased area should not be shaved. The priest must separate that person for seven more days.

dag: Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la daa nyɛla ŋun su tɔbbihi pihita fukumsi. Ka o daa zaŋ o kpani lu niriba kɔbisita zuɣu n-daa ku bɛ zaa, ka gba daa zali yuli pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu.
en: Abishai, Joabs brother, was chief of the Thirty. He raised his spear against the three hundred men he had slain, but he wasnt considered one of the Three.

dag: Amaa ka Naa Sihɔn daa bi saɣi ni Izraɛlnim kpe o tiŋgbani maa ni gari, ka daa laɣim o tɔbbihi na ti dɔni Jahaz n-tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: But Sihon would not let Israel do it. He brought his whole army together, camped at Jahaz, and attacked Israel.

dag: amaa di simdi ni ti naɣ sabimi yɛli ba ni bɛ di diri buɣa maligu nimdi mini jifa ni binʒim, ka mi di niŋdi zina.
en: Instead, we should write a letter telling them not to eat any food that is ritually unclean because it has been offered to idols; to keep themselves from sexual immorality; and not to eat any animal that has been strangled, or any blood.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti dɔni Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko polo.
en: Then the Israelites traveled to the Jordan Valley in Moab. They camped near the Jordan River across from Jericho.

dag: Dama Adam ka Naawuni daa daŋ nam ka naanyi ti nam Awa.
en: because Adam was made first. Eve was made later.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaai Yisa n-zaŋ o tahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋa; ka Pita daa puɣisiri doli nyaaŋa.
en: They arrested Jesus and took him away to the house of the high priest. Peter followed Jesus but stayed back at a distance.

dag: Ka Kɔnania min o mabihi Shɛmaya ni Nɛtanɛl ni Hashabia ni Jɛiɛl ni Jɔzabad bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim kpamba la gba daa ti Lɛvinim piɛbihi pola mini bubihi pola ka bɛ zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi tusaanu ni naɣilahi kɔbisinu ni bɛ zaŋ puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu.
en: Conaniah and his brothers Shemaiah and Nethanel, along with Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, the leaders of the Levites, provided the Levites with five thousand lambs and five hundred bulls as Passover sacrifices.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla n ni nam shɛb ti mmaŋa, ka bɛ kul ni yiini yila paɣiri ma.
en: I made them, and they will sing songs of praise to me.

dag: Bɛ ni ti wurim Mɔab, ka di niriba ku lan beni, bɛ ni duhi bɛmaŋ ti yaɣi Yawɛ san la zuɣu.
en: You are finished as a nation, because you dared oppose me, the Lord .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa zaŋ ya na ti paai Amɔrinim bɛn be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka bɛ daa tuhi ya, amaa ka n daa chɛ ka yi nyaŋ ba; ka n ku ba ka chɛ ka yi deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa su.
en: Then I brought you into the land of the Amorites who lived on the other side of the Jordan. They attacked you, but I gave them into your power, and you took over their land. I wiped them out before you.

dag: Di yihi yɛlimaŋli n nol ni hal biɛla gba, dama n tahima bela a zaligunim ni.
en: Enable me to speak the truth at all times, because my hope is in your judgments.

dag: Ka bia maa tizɔpaɣa daa ʒe kpaŋa ni o nya din yɛn niŋ o.
en: The baby's sister stood some distance away to see what would happen to him.

dag: O tiri nandaamba pina, ka tiri bɛn ka pina.
en: and she helps the poor and the needy.

dag: Yi daa be muɣisigu ni ka kuhi boli ma, ka n tiligi ya. N daa bela n daashili biɛhigu shee din nyɛ saa tahibu la puuni, ka garigi ya. N daa zahim ya Mɛriba kom la shee.
en: When you were in trouble, you called for help, and I set you free. I was hidden in the storm clouds, and I answered you. I tested you by the water at Meribah. Selah.

dag: Amaa Musa daa yi chaŋ Yawɛ sani ni o min o ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, o piligirila sariga maa o ninni, naɣila o ti yina. Ka o daa yi yina ti yɛli Izraɛlnim Naawuni ni yɛl o shɛm.
en: Whenever Moses went into the Tent of the Lord 's presence to speak to the Lord , he would take the veil off. When he came out, he would tell the people of Israel everything that he had been commanded to say.

dag: O na ʒi n-zaɣisi bee n-siŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun nyari nahiŋgu; bee n-chɛ ka o baɣa ka n ni. O mi bi lɛbir o nyaaŋa biriti ma, amaa n yi kuhi niŋ o bɔri sɔŋsim, o wumda.
en: He does not ignore those who need help. He does not hate them. He does not turn away from them. He listens when they cry for help.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ dabindi niŋ n sara maligu ʒim ni, yi mi di chɛ ka Yaɣigari chuɣu sara nimdi zani kaai biɛɣu.
en: Do not offer bread made with yeast when you sacrifice an animal to me. Do not keep until the following morning any part of the animal killed at the Passover Festival.

dag: Ka zoya tiŋgban la ni kul nyɛ nyɔŋ la zaa yoli, yi ni tooi ŋma n-neei li ka di leei yi dini di piligu shee zaŋ ti kpa di tariga. Ka Keenannim maa ni kul mali kuriti chɛchɛbunsi ka mali kpiɔŋ la zaa yoli, yi ni tooi kari ba.
en: You will take these mountains. It is a forest, but you can cut down the trees and make it a good place to live. You can take it from the Canaanites and force them to leave. You can defeat them, even if they are strong and have iron chariots.

dag: ni bɛ zaa leei zaɣ yini kaman nyini m Ba ni be n ni ka n gba be a ni shɛm la, ka di chɛ ka bɛ gba be ti ni, ka dunianim niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: Father, I pray that all who believe in me can be one. You are in me and I am in you. I pray that they can also be one in us. Then the world will believe that you sent me.

dag: Ka naa maa ni ti zaŋ yɔhiŋgu n-saɣim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun zaɣisi adiini soli maa, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Naawuni bɛn ni ti zani dɛde, ka chɛ ka bɛ min o tuhi.
en: The northern king will use lies and smooth talking to trick those who quit following the holy agreement, so they will sin even worse. But those who know God and obey him will be strong. They will fight back.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ʒiʒiinitab nya a ni niŋ ti shɛm maa, ka maani ti ansarisi, ka bɛn gili ti lari ti.
en: You made us a joke to our neighbors. They laugh and make fun of us.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛn tuui chɛ ka Hozia zaŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnima, o daa yɛlila ŋun Hozia, Cham ti kpuɣi pagɔrili n-dɔɣi pagɔrili bihi. Dama tiŋgbani ŋɔ nim tum yolimyolim pam ka zaɣisi man Yawɛ, ka bi ʒe ma yim.
en: When the Lord first spoke to Israel through Hosea, he said to Hosea, Go and get married; your wife will be unfaithful, and your children will be just like her. In the same way my people have left me and become unfaithful.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Cham ti yɛli niriba maa, Yi ni wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ di gbinni. Yi ni lihi m-maan lab lihi, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni nya shɛli.
en: So he told me to go and give the people this message: No matter how much you listen, you will not understand. No matter how much you look, you will not know what is happening.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa yi o sani kuli nti chɛ ka o min o bihi maa kpe duu ka yo bɛmaŋ niŋ di puuni; ka o bihi maa zaŋdi ŋmana n-zaan o, ka o boori kpam maa niŋdi di ni.
en: So the woman went into her house with her sons, closed the door, took the small jar of olive oil, and poured oil into the jars as her sons brought them to her.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la garigi yɛli.
en: Is there anyone, even the wisest, who could ever be of use to God?.

dag: Tinsi maa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee din nyɛ yi ni yɛn zaŋ luɣ shɛŋa ti Lɛvinim maa yɛn zaŋla tinsi maa goma gbini n-chaŋ ti paai mita kɔbisinahi ni pihinu tariga n-gili tinsi maa.
en: The pasture around each of these towns must be in the shape of a square, with the town itself in the center. The pasture is to measure meters on each side, with meters of land outside each of the town walls. This will be the Levites' pastureland.

dag: Ŋun biriti omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre biɛhigu bimbira ni ti chɛla din poora niŋgbuŋ kɔre maa zuɣu; amaa ŋun biriti Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu bimbira ni ti chɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu, Naawuni Shia Kasi maa zuɣu.
en: If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life.

dag: Naftali zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Jaziil daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Jaziilnima; ka Guni daŋ niriba nyɛ Guninima;.
en: The family groups from the tribe of Naphtali were Jahzeel—the Jahzeelite family group; Guni—the Gunite family group;.

dag: A viɛli pam, ka a viɛlim maa mali kɔre, n yura ŋun nyɛ paɣ viɛlli.
en: You are so beautiful, so lovely— my love, delightful one!.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ti wum dabiɛm maa yɛla ka zɔri ni ti lu bɔɣili ni, ka ŋun mi ti zo n-yi bɔɣili maa ni na, zana ni gbaag o. Dama sa kurili ni ti luna, ka tiŋgbani zaa sɔhira.
en: Anyone who tries to escape from the terror will fall in a pit, and anyone who escapes from the pit will be caught in a trap. Torrents of rain will pour from the sky, and earth's foundations will shake.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Abimilɛk ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn su Shɛkɛm pii la zaa laɣim bela nimaani.
en: but Abimelech found out where they were.

dag: Nyamiya, Yawɛ dabisili maa dali shiri kanna. Di ti yɛn nyɛla o sujee min o suhuyiɣisili ni o putɔɣu niŋbu dali. O ni ti chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ kpalimla tiŋgban nɛli, ka ku alahichinim bɛn be di ni zaa.
en: The day of the Lord is coming—that cruel day of his fierce anger and fury. The earth will be made a wilderness, and every sinner will be destroyed.

dag: Fukumsinim yi bɔhi ti zuŋɔ taabu ŋɔ gbinni, ti ni kpe yɛla ni di zuɣu, dama ti ka daliri yɛlli ŋɔ puuni din ni zaŋ wuhi ba.
en: As for us, we are in danger of being charged with rioting today, since we cant justify this unruly gathering.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa yi tɔɣisi viɛnyɛliŋga, di ŋmanila salima zaɣ kpil shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ kpɛh anzinfa binyara ni.
en: Words spoken at the right time are like gold apples in a silver setting.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ n ni boli shɛb la, wummiya! Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni; Mani n-nyɛ piligu. Mani n-nyɛ naabu.
en: Jacob, listen to me! Israel, I called you to be my people. So listen to me! I am the Beginning, and I am the End.

dag: Naa daa lan bahi noli ni o tim ba nayili bindira mini wain shɛli o ni nyura n-dihi ba lala yuma ata. Ka yuma ata maa ti paai ka o zaŋ ba tahi ŋun naa sanna.
en: The king also gave orders that every day they were to be given the same food and wine as the members of the royal court. After three years of this training they were to appear before the king.

dag: Pa yinim m-bo yɛla ŋɔ ti yimaŋa yi ni zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun mali ya chana la zuɣu?.
en: This trouble is your own fault. The Lord your God was leading you the right way, but you turned away from him.
