dag: Ka Jona daa deei Yawɛ noli, ka yiɣisi chaŋ Ninive. Ninive daa nyɛla tin titali. Daba ata ka nir daa naan zaŋ chaŋ kpe di ni gari.
en: So Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. It was a very large city. A person had to walk for three days to travel through it.

dag: Amaa saha kanna ka bɛ ni ti yihi aŋgo maa bɛ sani, di dabisa maa puuni ka bɛ ni ti lo noli.
en: But the day will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

dag: A ni ti yɛli n ni zal a ni a yɛlim shɛlikam zaa, ka a mabia Aduna mi ti yɛli Firawuna ni o chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: You will say everything that I command you, and your brother Aaron will tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites out of his land.

dag: Fomiya ti Duuma Yawɛ tooni, d amaa Yawɛ dabisili la miriya. Yawɛ niŋla sara maligu shili, o mal o ni boli ninvuɣ shɛba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: The day is near when the Lord will sit in judgment; so be silent in his presence. The Lord is preparing to sacrifice his people and has invited enemies to plunder Judah.

dag: ka chɛ ka sochandiba ku yɛli, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni! Ti suhir alibarika tiri ya Yawɛ yuli zuɣu.
en: Let no one who passes by say to them: May the LORDs blessing be on you! We bless you in the LORDs name.

dag: Di chaŋya; di chɛliya ka yi dimnim maa ti kun ya, dama Yawɛ ka yi sani.
en: Don't go. The Lord is not with you, and your enemies will defeat you.

dag: Ka paɣ shɛb bɛn zaa suhuri daa yu daa zaŋ bɛ baŋsim n-zaŋ buhi kɔbiri mi gali.
en: All the women who were eager to use their skill spun the goats hair.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu bi ʒe yim ku tɔŋ. Ka ŋunkam ŋmari ʒiri kul bela barina ni.
en: Crooks will not profit from their crimes, and those who plan to cause trouble will be trapped when it comes.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ŋunkam ʒe n nyaaŋa niriba ni, n gba ni ti ʒe dilan nyaaŋa m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sani;.
en: If you stand before others and are willing to say you believe in me, then I will tell my Father in heaven that you belong to me.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka m biɛrim maa bi naara? Bɔzuɣu ka di zaɣisi naabu? Yɛlimaŋli a ŋmanila kulibɔn shɛli din nyɛ yɔhiŋ; ka ŋmani ko shɛŋa din nyuui.
en: I am badly injured and in constant pain. Are you going to disappoint me, like a stream that goes dry in the heat of summer?.

dag: Paɣ shɛb gba daa ʒe kpaŋ ha yuuni Yisa; Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Jeemsibila ni Jɔsis ma Mariama ni Salomi daa be bɛ ni.
en: Some women were standing away from the cross, watching. Among these women were Mary Magdalene, Salome, and Mary the mother of James and Joses.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri din viɛla ni nimmoo ni nya jilima, amaa zaɣ biɛɣu chanila ŋun bɔri li sani.
en: People are pleased with those who try to do good. Those who look for trouble will find it.

dag: Nahiŋgu balibu kam n-kul beni, ka yɔhiŋgu balibu kam beni! Bɛ zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku baŋ ma. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You live in a world of deceit, and in their deceit they refuse to know me, declares the LORD.

dag: Ka n dan maa paɣ Zara dɔɣi bidibiga ti o, o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni; ka n dan maa zaŋ o binshɛɣukam zaa ti o bia maa.
en: Sarah, my master's wife, bore him a son when she was old, and my master has given everything he owns to him.

dag: n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣi omaŋmaŋ silig pal shɛli o ni daa yoli chib tampiŋ ni la ni; ka daa bilim kuɣ titali na ti yo di noli, ka ŋmaligi kuli.
en: He put Jesus body in a new tomb that he had dug in a wall of rock. Then he closed the tomb by rolling a very large stone to cover the entrance. After he did this, he went away.

dag: O yɛla ka n daa yɛri ni o doli n nyaaŋ na ka nyɛ ŋun gari ma la, dama o daa be saha shɛli n ni daa na kani.
en: This is the one I was talking about when I said, A man is coming after me, but he is greater than I am, because he existed before I was born.

dag: N suhu kul bɔrila binshɛli nyabu, amaa ka na bi nya li. N nya do yino niriba tuhili puuni, amaa ka bi nya paɣ yino niriba tuhili maa puuni.
en: But theres something that I constantly searched for but couldnt find: I found one man among a thousand, but I couldnt find a woman among any of these.

dag: Ɛlipaal bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛba mini Misham ni Shɛmɛd ŋun daa me Ono mini Lɔd ni di tiŋkpansi la.
en: Elpaals sons were Eber, Misham, Shemed, Beriah, and Shema. Shemed built the towns of Ono and Lod and the small towns around Lod. Beriah and Shema were the leaders of the families living in Aijalon. They forced the people who lived in Gath to leave.

dag: Ifriimnim yɛliya, Aa, ti mali buni, ti bo buni zali timaŋa! Amaa bɛ buni maa zaa ku tooi yo bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa samli.
en: You say to yourself, I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.

dag: Niriba bɛn daa ʒi zibisim ni la yipa nya neesim titali; ka bɛn daa ʒi kum zibisim ni be luɣ shɛli polo la gba nya ka neesim maa neei m-paai ba.
en: The people who live in darkness will see a great light. On those who live in the dark land of death the light will shine.

dag: Tɔrokɔnim maa zaa daa malila daanya gbaya mini daanya spindilinima, ka di yaɣa anahi maa zaa mali taha tambu shee. Ka o daa niŋ biŋgolima niŋ taha maa tambu shee kam polo.
en: There were four bronze wheels with bronze axles for each stand. There were four feet and supports cast for each basin with wreaths on their sides.

dag: Bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni ka o leei maligumaana zan o ba zaani n-ni ti ye binyɛr piɛl kasi m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara maa.
en: The priest who is anointed and ordained to serve as priest after his father will perform the reconciliation, wearing the holy linen clothes.

dag: Ka Hagai lan bɔh o, Ka nir yi shihi kpima, ka kana ti shihi bindira maa, di ni chɛ ka bindira maa leei din pa kasi? Ka Maligumaana maa garigi yɛli, Iin.
en: Haggai said, If an unclean person touches any of these things, will it become unclean? And the priests responded, It will be unclean.

dag: dindina nyin bom peeŋkpaa n-zaŋ o tibili tabili dunoli naŋgbanyee n-chib li voli, ka o nyɛ a dabili sahakam. Zaŋ chaŋ a dabili ŋun nyɛ paɣ gba polo, di simdi ni a niŋ o lala.
en: Then take him to the door of your house and there pierce his ear; he will then be your slave for life. Treat your female slave in the same way.

dag: M puhiri Rufus ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ gahindili ti Duuma ni la min o ma ŋun nyɛ n gba ma la.
en: I send greetings to Rufus, that outstanding worker in the Lord's service, and to his mother, who has always treated me like a son.

dag: Ka Mariama daa ti paai Yisa sani n-gban o tooni yɛl o, N Duuma, a yi di daa be ya ŋɔ, n tizɔdoo ŋɔ daa naan ku kpi.
en: Mary went to where Jesus was. Then as soon as she saw him, she knelt at his feet and said, Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun kpaŋsiri ya, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zɔri daadam ŋun ni kpi ŋɔ dabiɛm? Daadam ŋmanila mɔri, o kul ku beni sahakam.
en: I am the Lord , the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Gidiɔn zuɣu na, ka o zaŋ kikaa piɛb boli Abiɛza daŋ niriba ni bɛ kana ti dol o.
en: The spirit of the Lord took control of Gideon, and he blew a trumpet to call the men of the clan of Abiezer to follow him.

dag: Ka Bɛrɛkia mini Ɛlikana daa nyɛ Alikauli Adaka duu maa dunɔguliba.
en: Berechiah and Elkanah, along with Obed Edom and Jehiah, were chosen as guards for the Covenant Box. The priests Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer were chosen to blow trumpets in front of the Covenant Box.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa lan yɛli, Molimiya Baal jɛmbu dabisili molo. Ka bɛ daa moli di molo maa.
en: He said, Announce a day of worship for Baal! After the day had been announced.

dag: Amaa n ŋmanila zunzuli, ka pa ni ninsala; ka n tab ʒiɛm ma, ka niriba maani ma ansarisi!.
en: But Im just a worm, less than human; insulted by one person, despised by another.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ŋubirila binkpima, ka jɛmdi buɣa, ka kuri niriba, yi ni tooi su tiŋgbɔŋ maa?.
en: Tell them what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying: You eat meat with the blood still in it. You worship idols. You commit murder. What makes you think that the land belongs to you?.

dag: O daa dɔɣila bidibisi pihita mini bipuɣinsi pihita. Ka o daa zaŋ o bipuɣinsi pihita maa ti dɔbba kpaŋa bɛn pa o daŋ puuni niriba; ka daa bo paɣiba pihita kpaŋ na ti ti o bidibisi maa mi. O daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuma ayopɔin.
en: He had thirty sons and thirty daughters. He married his thirty daughters to those outside his clan, and brought in thirty young women from outside for his sons. He led Israel for seven years.

dag: Dinzuɣu di ni ti nyɛla yuŋ yi sani, ka yi ku lan nya ʒii, ka liɣa ti be yi sani, ka binshɛli ku kahigi wuhi ya. Wuntaŋ ni ti lu anabinim maa sani, ka biɛkaali nyaaŋa ti nyɛ zibisim bɛ sani.
en: Therefore, it will become night for you, without vision, only darkness without divination! The sun will set on the prophets; the day will be dark upon them.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt daa yɛli ba, Aai, n duumanima, n suhiri ya.
en: But Lot said to the two men, Sirs, please dont force me to run so far!.

dag: Ɛzra daa yila Babilɔn labina, o daa nyɛla gbansabira so ŋun mi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛli ti Musa la viɛnyɛliŋga, ka naa daa ti o o ni suh o shɛlikam zaa, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ nuu daa pa o zuɣu.
en: Ezra came to Jerusalem from Babylon. He was a teacher and knew the Law of Moses very well. The Law of Moses was given by the Lord , the God of Israel. King Artaxerxes gave Ezra everything he asked for because the Lord was with Ezra.

dag: Ijiptinima, o daa wuhi shihira, ka tum alahiziba tuma yi sunsuuni n-darigi Firawuna min o niriba zaa tibili.
en: There he performed miracles and wonders to punish the king and all his officials.

dag: Yawɛ viɛla, ka nyɛ bɛ ni sɔɣiri so sani muɣisigu saha; o guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔɣir o sani.
en: The LORD is good, a haven in a day of distress. He acknowledges those who take refuge in him.

dag: Bɛ ŋme Ifriimnima, ka bɛ nyaɣa zaa kuui, bɛ ku lan dɔɣi bihi. Hal bɛ yi kul dɔɣi bihi gba, n ni ku bɛ biyurisi zaa.
en: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o pah o yaannim bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl nanim zuɣu; ka o bia Zakaria di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jeroboam died and was buried in the royal tombs, and his son Zechariah succeeded him as king.

dag: Di teeri ya binshɛŋa din daa niŋ ka di yuui yɛla bee n-lihiri binshɛŋa din daa pun niŋ kurimbuni ha la.
en: Forget what happened long ago! Don't think about the past.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ, Zomiya n sani! dama Yawɛ wum n kumsi maa;.
en: Go away, you wicked people, because the Lord has heard my cries.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi Bɛrɔtibɛnɛjaakan n-chaŋ Mɔsɛra. Nimaani ka Aduna daa kpi, ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o nimaani, ka o bidibiga Ɛliɛza daa leei maligumaana zan o zaani.
en: The Israelites traveled from the wells of the people of Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died and was buried. Aarons son Eleazar served in Aarons place as priest.

dag: Bɛ yi kurim bee bɛ yi damdi, bɛ ni yɛn gbahi shɛb maa lurimi bɛ kpiɔŋ zuɣu.
en: Their helpless victims are crushed; they collapse, falling prey to the strength of the wicked.

dag: Ka naa daa zali Jɛrusalɛmnima ni bɛ tim maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim bɛ tarili kaman di ni simdi shɛm din ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ zaŋsim zaa niŋ Yawɛ zaligu tuma ni.
en: He told the people of Jerusalem to bring the offerings that were to be given to the priests and Levites, so that they would have time to serve the Lord with their work.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa yɛr o bia Iso maa, ka Ribɛka beni wumda. Dinzuɣu saha shɛli Iso ni daa yi n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni ni o ti ku nimdi maa na, ka Ribɛka daa yɛl o bia Yaakubu.
en: Rebekah had been listening, and as soon as Esau left to go hunting.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Nir yi yuri ma, o ni doli n yɛligu, ka m Ba ni yur o, ka ti ni ka dilan sanna ka ti min o ti laɣim be.
en: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.

dag: Di saha maa n daa lan yɛli niriba maa, Yi mini sɔŋdiba zaa kpalimmi gbɛm Jɛrusalɛm din ni chɛ ka bɛ guli ti yuŋ ka tumdi tuma wuntaŋ ni.
en: I asked the men in charge and their workers to stay inside Jerusalem and stand guard at night. So they guarded the city at night and worked during the day.

dag: Ka Juda daa yɛl o, Chɛ ka o zaŋ nɛma maa leeg o dini, di yi pa lala, niriba ni la ti; nyama, n-chɛ ka a zaŋ bubil polli maa ni a ti ti o, ka a bi tooi bo n-nya o.
en: So Judah said, Let her keep the things. I dont want people to laugh at us. I tried to give her the goat, but we could not find her. That is enough.

dag: O daa zaŋ ma zali pal tital ni. O daa tiligi ma, dama o nini daa tiɣi ma.
en: He helped me out of danger; he saved me because he was pleased with me.

dag: So yi tahir a sariakarita sani ka a min o be soli chani yɛtɔɣa maa ni, nyin chɛ ka yi naai noli m-mali yi yɛtɔɣa maa; di yi pa lala o ni zaŋ a chaŋ sariakarita maa sani, ka sariakarita maa ti zaŋ a ti dansarika gula, ka o mi kpɛh a duu.
en: If someone brings a lawsuit against you and takes you to court, do your best to settle the dispute before you get to court. If you don't, you will be dragged before the judge, who will hand you over to the police, and you will be put in jail.

dag: Di bi wumdi bɛ ni so, bɛ so mi bi tuura. Gom bi gbaari ba bee ka bɛ ti gbihi. Bɛ ni so shɛlɔrigu bi wɔɣisi bee bɛ namdili ti chihi.
en: None of them grow tired; none of them stumble. They never doze or sleep. Not a belt is loose; not a sandal strap is broken.

dag: O ni daa kpi kum shɛl la, o daa kpimi yim zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo, amaa nyɛvil shɛli o ni mali be ŋɔ, Naawuni zuɣu ka o be maa.
en: And so, because he died, sin has no power over him; and now he lives his life in fellowship with God.

dag: O daa niŋ yɛm n-zaŋ o bidibisi maa shɛba tahi Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgbana yaɣa zaa ni ti ʒili bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa la zaa ni, ka ti ba bɛ ni bɔri shɛlikam, ka lan bo paɣiba pam ti ba.
en: He wisely placed some of his sons in every region of Judah and Benjamin, in every fortified city, and gave them plenty of food and sought many wives for them.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima ni o tiligi ti ti tuumbiɛri zaa ni ka mali ti ka ti be kasi, ka zaŋ ti leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba bɛn suhuri ye tuun suma tumbu zuɣu.
en: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi chɛ ka anabinim ni daa yɛli shɛm la ti niŋ pali yi ni. Bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Take care, then, so that what the prophets said may not happen to you:.

dag: ni Hɛshibɔn zaŋ hal ti paai Ramatimizipa mini Bɛtɔnim ni zaŋ hal ti paai Mahanaim zaŋ chaŋ Dɛbir tintariga.
en: The land given to Gad stretched from Heshbon in the south to Ramath-Mizpeh and Betonim in the north, and even further north to Mahanaim and Lidebor.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Galimi dini ka yi yaannim daa lee nya n sani, ka zo n-chaŋ katiŋ ti jɛmdi binyoya ka chɛ ma, ka bɛ gba maŋmaŋ daa leei ninvuɣ yoya la?.
en: The Lord says: What accusation did your ancestors bring against me? What made them turn away from me? They worshiped worthless idols and became worthless themselves.

dag: Yi daa tam tampiŋ din dɔɣi ya yɛla, ka daa tam Naawuni ŋun dɔɣi ya yɛla.
en: They forgot their God, their mighty savior, the one who had given them life.

dag: Maliya suhupiɛlli sahakam n ni nam shɛli zuɣu. Suhupiɛlli ni be n ni nam Jɛrusalɛm shɛli maa ni, ka di niriba mali suhupiɛlli.
en: My people will be happy and rejoice forever and ever because of what I will make. I will make a Jerusalem that is full of joy, and I will make her people happy.

dag: Yuun piniyini puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni daba ayopɔin dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the seventh day of the first month of the eleventh year of our exile, the Lord spoke to me.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Gomna Pailɛt maŋmaŋ daa yina ti bɔhi ba, Yi ni tahi do so ŋɔ na taali lee nyɛla dini.
en: Pilate came out and asked, What charges are you bringing against this man.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa yi Firawuna sani chaŋ, ka Musa daa ti fabili niŋ Yawɛ zaŋ chaŋ poloya maa polo kaman o mini Firawuna ni daa saɣi shɛm maa.
en: After Moses and Aaron had left Pharaoh, Moses cried out to the LORD about the frogs that the LORD had brought on Pharaoh.

dag: ni firila kpam ni tulaale shɛŋa mini kpa shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali kpa shɛli bɛ ni mali boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni tulaale shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali tulaale zim shɛli din nyom viɛla.
en: They also brought sweet-smelling spices to be mixed with the incense and olive oil that were for the lamps and for ordaining the priests.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla dunia ŋɔ ni, n nyaya ka zaligu dolibu ni be shɛli ninvuɣ biɛtali bela nimaani; ka lan nya ka wuntitali ni be shɛli ninvuɣ biɛtali lan bela nimaani gba.
en: I saw something else under the sun: in the place of justice, there was wickedness; and in the place of what was right, there was wickedness again!.

dag: ka bɛn be zibisim ni mini kum mahim ni ni ti nya neesim maa, ka di ni ti wuhi ti ti ni yɛn doli so shɛli nya suhudoo.
en: to give light to those who are sitting in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide us on the path of peace.

dag: ni yi chirimya pam. Dama yimaŋmaŋ n-daa tim ma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani yɛra, Suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ti ti, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ yi yɛli shɛli, nyin yɛlimi ti ka ti niŋ li.
en: you are making a mistake that will cause your deaths. You sent me to the Lord your God. You said to me, Pray to the Lord our God for us. Tell us everything the Lord our God says to do. We will obey him.

dag: O ni daa karindi litaafi shɛli maa daa sabi yɛlila ŋ-ŋɔ: Bɛ daa zaŋ o mi tahi kaman bɛ ni tahiri piɛɣu o kɔrigibu shee shɛm la bee kaman bɛ ni chɛri piɛbil so kɔbiri, ka o bi yaar o nol la.
en: The man was reading the passage that said, He was led like a sheep on its way to be killed. He was silent as a lamb whose wool is being cut off, and he did not say a word.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti yɛl o zuliya maa, N saɣi kpibu; amaa Naawuni ni ti ka yi sanna nti yihi ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-zaŋ ya kulisi o ni daa po pɔri n-zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la ni.
en: Before Joseph died, he told his brothers, I won't live much longer. But God will take care of you and lead you out of Egypt to the land he promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Ka o daa kana ti zani, ka kuhi bahi Izraɛl tɔbbihi na, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi lo tɔbu na ni yi ti tuhi ti? Pa Filistia nira n-nyɛ ma? Ka yi mi pala Sool tɔbbihi? Dinzuɣu piimiya yi ni ninvuɣ yino n-chɛ ka o siɣi n sanna.
en: He stopped and shouted to the Israelite troops, Why have you come and taken up battle formations? I am the Philistine champion, and you are Sauls servants. Isnt that right? Select one of your men, and let him come down against me.

dag: Chamiya chuɣu maa ni. Man na ku chaŋ di ni, dama n saha na bi paai.
en: So you go to the festival. I will not go now, because the right time for me has not yet come.

dag: Ka bɛ ti mal o ansarisi ka fiɛb o, ka tuhi nintɔri vie o ka naanyi ku o; amaa di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: who will laugh at him and spit on him. They will beat him with whips and kill him. But on the third day after his death, he will rise to life again.

dag: Man Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ni chɛ ka n ni niŋ n tɔbbi shɛb naani, ka mali ba nyuri bara la tuhi n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu.
en: I have commanded my holy ones; I have called my warriors, my proud, jubilant ones, to execute my wrath.

dag: Timoti, gbib Naawuni ni zaŋ shɛli niŋ a nuu ni ni a yuuni li la viɛnyɛliŋga. Gbaam amaŋa ni din bi luri Naawuni sizuura mini naŋgbankpeeni yɛtɔɣ yo shɛŋa ninvuɣ shɛb ni chirim booni baŋsim la.
en: Timothy, keep safe what has been entrusted to your care. Avoid the profane talk and foolish arguments of what some people wrongly call Knowledge.

dag: Bɛ kuri pakoya mini saamba, ka kuri kpibisi.
en: They kill widows and foreigners living in our country. They murder orphans.

dag: A ni daa piligi balindi Naawuni saha shɛl la ka o daa garig a. Naawuni yur a pam. Lala zuɣu ka n kana ni n ti yɛl a o ni garig a yɛli shɛm. Dinzuɣu luɣim a tiba wum n ni yɛn wuh a ʒii maa gbinni shɛm.
en: When you first started praying, the command was given to come speak to you. God loves you very much! You will understand this command, and you will understand the vision.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb niŋdi kaman bɛ nyɛla bundaannima, amaa ka ka shɛli, ka shɛb mi niŋdi kaman bɛ nyɛla faranima, amaa ka mali buni pam.
en: Some people pretend they are rich, but they have nothing. Others pretend they are poor, but they are really rich.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla a zaligunim zuɣu. A wuntitali puuni, tim ma nyɛvili.
en: See how much I want to obey your instructions! Be good to me, and let me live.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa bɔhi Naa Zɛdɛkia, Taali bɔ ka n lee tum a bee a kpambaliba bee niriba ŋɔ ka yi chɛ ka bɛ kpɛhi ma duu maa?.
en: Then Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, What have I done wrong? What crime have I done against you or your officials or the people of Jerusalem? Why have you thrown me into prison?.

dag: Ka Musa daa kɔrig o n-zaŋ o ʒim maa shɛli niŋ Aduna nudirigu polo tibinyaɣili min o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu.
en: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Yisa, Jɔn Baptaizira mini Farisiinim nyaandoliba lɔri noli waawaayili ka suhiri Naawuni, amaa ka nyin nyaandoliba bɛn kul diri ka nyura.
en: Some people said to Jesus, The disciples of John fast often and pray frequently. The disciples of the Pharisees do the same, but your disciples are always eating and drinking.

dag: Ka ŋun zaŋ li ti Yawɛ maa yi bɔr ni o yo di zuɣu ka dee li, o ni yo di daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi di daa maa zuɣu, ka di leeg o dini.
en: But if you want to get the house back, you must add one-fifth to the price. Then you will get the house back.

dag: Biɛrim yɛn ti ma la daŋa, n dimnim ni tam a yɛligu yɛla zuɣu.
en: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa du Zoli maa zuɣu, ka sagbani limsi li.
en: Moses went up Mount Sinai, and a cloud covered it.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ma, Daniɛl, cham a chandi shee pumpɔŋɔ, dama yɛla ŋɔ nyɛla din yɛn be ashilɔni n-sɔɣiya hal ti paai saha tariga.
en: He said, Get going now, Daniel, because these words must remain secret and sealed up until the end time.

dag: Pini nyɛla din maani soli tiri nira, di nyɛla din chɛ ka nir tooi nyari ninvuɣ wɔɣira.
en: Gifts can open many doors and help you meet important people.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, a galisiya pam. A zaŋla jilima mini nam yiko ye kaman situra la.
en: My soul, praise the Lord ! Lord my God, you are very great! You are clothed with glory and honor.

dag: Yiɣisimiya chaŋ gili yɛli niriba maa ni bɛ bom bindira m-mali shili gu, dama ni di kpalim daba ata ni bɛ gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du n-kuli ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ tin ya la ni.
en: to go through the camp and tell everyone: In a few days we will cross the Jordan River to take the land that the Lord our God is giving us. So prepare as much food as you'll need for the march into the land.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Juda zuliya maa daŋ kam na ti zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Zɛra daŋ; ka o daa zaŋ Zɛra daŋ maa ni sokam ni o malibu zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Zabidi yiŋnima.
en: He made the clans of Judah come forward. He selected the clan of Zerah. He made the clan of Zerah come forward as individual soldiers. Zabdi was selected.

dag: Dinzuɣu miri ka a chɛ ka neesim din be a ni ti leei zibisim.
en: Make certain, then, that the light in you is not darkness.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa yɛl o yaha, Zaŋm a nuu maa labisi niŋ a binyɛrigu maa ni. Ka o daa lan zaŋ o nuu maa labisi niŋ o binyɛrigu maa ni, o ni daa ti yihi li na ka di min o niŋgbuŋ zaa lan nyɛla yim.
en: Then God said, Now put your hand into your robe again. So Moses put his hand into his robe again. Then he brought his hand out, and his hand was changed. Now his hand was good again, as it was before.

dag: Naa Ahaz ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Ahazs deeds, arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings?.

dag: Ka din pah anahi gbaai Iziri min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the fourth to Izri, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Di yɛla daa naɣ ti yila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pa ti mabi maŋa la sanna. Bɛ daa kamina nti kpe ti ni ni bɛ puɣisi baŋ ti ni mali yolisim shɛli Yisa Masia ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpɛhi ti dabitim ni.
en: But false brothers and sisters, who were brought in secretly, slipped in to spy on our freedom, which we have in Christ Jesus, and to make us slaves.

dag: Ka o daa bahi niriba maa dabisi shɛli din pahi daba anii dali. Ka bɛ daa paɣi naa, ka kuli bɛ yinsi ni suhupiɛlli, Yawɛ ni daa niŋ alibarika shɛŋa niŋ o dabili Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni la zuɣu.
en: On the eighth day, Solomon dismissed the people. They blessed the king and went back to their tents happy and pleased about all the good that the LORD had done for his servant David and for his people Israel.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, ŋunkam yɛn mali suhudoo sara maligu ti man Yawɛ, ŋun zaŋm li ka man Yawɛ sanna. O suhudoo sara maligu maa ni.
en: for the people of Israel. When any of you offer a fellowship offering you must bring part of it as a special gift to the Lord .

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, ka Sool daa piligi m-bɔri Dauda soya.
en: So from that time on, Saul watched David very closely.

dag: Bundan maa daa mali piɛri mini niɣi pam.
en: The rich man had lots of sheep and cattle.

dag: Ka zuɣulan maa yɛl o, N Duuma, kamina paai m bia maa ka o na bi kpi.
en: The man replied, Lord, please come before my son dies.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita daa bɔhi Yisa, N Duuma, ya ka a chana? Ka o garigi n-yɛl o, N ni chani luɣ shɛli maa, a ku tooi doli ma pumpɔŋɔ; amaa a ni ti doli ma saha shɛli.
en: Simon Peter asked Jesus, Lord, where are you going? Jesus answered, Where I am going you cannot follow now. But you will follow later.

dag: dama kaman sokam zaa ni kpi Adam ni shɛm, lala ka sokam zaa ni neei kum ni Masia zuɣu.
en: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.

dag: ni Hɛshibɔn ni Jaza zaŋ tabili di momaha tiŋgbana zaa.
en: Heshbon with its pasturelands, and Jazer with its pasturelands.

dag: ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram yini pahi piɛlabihi pinaanahi maa zaɣ yino kam zuɣu.
en: and one-tenth for each of the fourteen lambs.

dag: Ka naa min o tuma zuɣulaannim maa nini daa tiɣi o ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka naa maa daa shiri niŋ kaman Mɛmukan ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: The king and his important officials were happy with this advice, so King Xerxes did as Memucan suggested.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yawɛ malaika maa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, a suhu ni yiɣisi bahi Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda tinsi zuɣu yuun pisopɔin m-bɔŋɔ pumpɔŋɔ. Ka bɔ saha ka a lee yɛn zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: Then the Lord s angel said, Lord All-Powerful, how long before you comfort Jerusalem and the cities of Judah? You have shown your anger at these cities for years now.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbibiya n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa zaa, ka tummiya di tuma, dina n-ni chɛ ka n ni zaŋdi ya kuni tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa ti ku gbuɣi ya bahi.
en: The Lord said, Keep all my laws and commands, so that you will not be rejected by the land of Canaan, into which I am bringing you.

dag: Heei! Kɔnyuri ni mali sokam, ŋun kam kom ŋɔ gbin na! Ka yinim bɛn mi ka liɣiri, kamiyana ti da bindirigu di! Kamiyana ti da wain mini bihim nyu ka di yɔnya shɛli!.
en: All you people who are thirsty, come! Here is water for you to drink. Dont worry if you have no money. Come, eat and drink until you are full! You dont need money. The milk and wine are free.

dag: Dindali maa di simdi ka yi moli molo, ka laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka di tumiya tuma, di nyɛla zaligu ʒiɛmani kam ni yi biɛhigu shee zaa.
en: On that same day you will call a holy meeting. You must not do any work. This law continues forever in all your homes.

dag: Cham ti yɛli n dabili Dauda, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pa nyini n-yɛn me yili ti ma ka m be di ni.
en: Go and tell my servant David that I say to him, You are not the one to build a temple for me to live in.

dag: Ka Hiram daa tim ti yɛli Sulemaana, N wum a ni tim na nti yɛli ma shɛm la, ka m mali shili ni n-niŋ a ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ sida dakuɣiri mini sipirɛs dakuɣuri ŋmabu polo la.
en: Then he sent back his answer: I received your message and will give you all the cedar and pine logs you need.

dag: ka nachimbil maa fuɣ o chinchini maa bahi, ka guui ni nyɔfindili.
en: he left the cloth in their hands and ran away naked.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli Ahija, Zaŋmi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la na. Dama din dali maa Izraɛlnim daa zaŋla Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa mali chaŋ.
en: At that time, Ahijah was serving as priest for the army of Israel, and Saul told him, Come over here! Let's ask God what we should do.

dag: Bɛ daa nyuri binnyura maa dolila zaligu ni wuhi shɛm. Bɛ daa bi muɣisi so ni o nyu li; dama naa maa daa pun yɛl o yiŋbihi ni bɛ tim sokam wain maa kaman bɛ ni bɔri li shɛm tariga.
en: There were no limits on the drinks; the king had given orders to the palace servants that everyone could have as much as they wanted.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ; o ni deei n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir o ni o zom ma nambɔɣu la zuɣu.
en: Give praise to the Lord ; he has heard my cry for help.

dag: A bi wum ni m pun lo dimbɔŋɔnim zaa nia ka di waɣa? Ka pumpɔŋɔ n chɛ ka di niŋ pali. N daa ti a yiko ka a wurim bɛ ni me goma gili tin shɛŋa, ka di leei dabari.
en: Havent you heard? I set this up long ago; I planned it in the distant past! Now I have made it happen, making fortified cities collapse into piles of rubble.

dag: Salima bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bɛtilihɛm ŋun daa lan nyɛ Nɛtɔfa nir la mini Atirɔtibɛtijɔab ni Manahatinim pirigili ni Zɔrinima.
en: Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites.

dag: Bɛ tuumbiɛri maa tirila naa suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ biɛriyoli maa tiri bɛ kpamba suhupiɛlli.
en: By their wickedness they make the king glad, and give joy to the officials with their lies.

dag: Nir ni tooi ba wɔhu n-kari kuɣa ni? Ka nir ni tooi zaŋ naɣikɔra n-ko teeku ni? Amaa yi zaŋ yɛlimaŋli leei ʒiri, ka zaŋ din tuhi leei din bi tuhi.
en: Do horses run on rocks? Does one plow the sea with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Kpiɔŋlan yi lo kpara n-ʒe n-gul o yili, o nɛma zaa tiligirimi;.
en: When a strong man with many weapons guards his own house, the things in his house are safe.

dag: N tiligim ba kpiimba biɛhigu shee chandi? N tiligim ba kum ni? Nyin kum, a daalɔbɔnim la lee be ya? Nyin kpiimba biɛhigu shee, a bahiyol la lee be ya? N nini bi lan zɔri nambɔɣu.
en: Will I ransom them from the power of the grave Will I redeem them from deaths hold? Death, where are your diseases? Grave, where is your destruction? Compassion is hidden from my eyes.

dag: Naawuni daa lola Ibrahimma min o yaaŋa alikaulinima. Naawuni daa bi yɛli Ibrahimma, N lo a min a yaansi alikaulinima, ka di wuhiri ni bɛ ninvuɣ bɔbili. Amaa o daa yɛl o mi, N lo a min a yaaŋa alikaulinima, ka di wuhirila ninvuɣ yino ŋun nyɛ Masia la.
en: The promises were made to Abraham and to his descendant. It doesnt say, and to the descendants, as if referring to many rather than just one. It says, and to your descendant, who is Christ.

dag: Bɛ gba daa zaŋla bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi bahi tiŋa, ka di leei waɣiri. Amaa ka Aduna jaaŋgbee maa daa zaŋ bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi maa vali.
en: they threw down sticks that turned into snakes. But Aaron's snake swallowed theirs.

dag: ni Hɛlikat ni Rɛhɔb ni di zaa ha biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Helkath, and Rehob, with their pasture lands.

dag: Ti mini ti yaannim zaa tum alahichi. Ti nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri, ka tum tuumbiɛri.
en: We and our ancestors have sinned terribly.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa zo. Ka nachimbil so ŋun daa guli nayili maa daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya niriba pam ni doli Hɔrɔnaim soli m-baɣisiri zoli kanna.
en: and Absalom has fled. Just then the young man on watch looked up and saw many people coming on the road behind him alongside the mountain.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ni sokam zaa be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, amaa Naawuni tiri sokam la pin kɔŋkɔba ka di saɣisirila o biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm; ka so dini be di ko ka chɛ o kpee dini.
en: Actually I would prefer that all of you were as I am; but each one has a special gift from God, one person this gift, another one that gift.

dag: Dindali maa ti Duuma ni ti lan zaŋ o niriba bɛn kpalim be tinduya ni la labisi yiŋ na yaha. O ni ti yihi ba Asiria mini Ijipti ni Patrɔs ni Itiɔpia ni Ɛlam ni Babilɔn ni Hamat ni teeku duli tinsi ni teeku noli tinsi ni na.
en: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.

dag: Bɛ bɔbindimi gindi liɣa, ka ka firila, ka o chɛ ka bɛ ʒiɛhiri gindi kaman nir ni nyu dam kul la.
en: they grope in the dark and stagger like drunkards.

dag: Wummiya, dama n yɛn tɔɣisila bintitaŋa yɛtɔɣ viɛla, ka din yɛn yi n noli ni na nyɛla din tuhi.
en: Listen, for I speak things that are correct; from my lips comes what is right.

dag: Bɛ ŋumdimi kaman gbuɣima la. Bɛ ŋumdimi, ka gbahiri bɛ ni yɛn gbahi biŋkɔb shɛba m-mali ba chana ka so ku tooi fa ba bahi.
en: The shouts of the enemy sound like the roar of lions. Like strong, young lions, they growl and grab their prey. The captives struggle and try to escape, but there is no one to save them.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ liɣiri da bindirigu a sani di, ka zaŋ liɣiri da kom a sani nyu. N kul bɔri ni a chɛ ka n chaŋla n naba zuɣu na ti gari.
en: We will pay for the food we eat and the water we drink. All we want to do is to pass through your country.

dag: A zaligunim nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Yawɛ, a jɛmbu duu nyɛla din simdi ni di kul be kasi sahakam.
en: Your laws are eternal, Lord , and your Temple is holy indeed, forever and ever.

dag: N suhir a yɛra, Di chɛ ka n dimnim di suhupiɛlli dari niŋ ma, a mi di chɛ ka bɛ di dari niŋ ma n napɔŋ sarigibu zuɣu.
en: Because I prayed: Dont let them celebrate over me or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.

dag: Dinzuɣu a biɛhigu daa be di ko ka chɛ paɣ shɛb dini a pagɔrisigu tuma maa ni. Pa so m-puh a ni a tummi pagɔrisigu tuma. Pa bɛna n-daa yɔr a, amaa nyini n-daa lee yɔri ba, a biɛhigu daa shiri be di ko.
en: You are a special kind of prostitute. No one forced you to become one. You didn't get paid; you paid them! Yes, you are different.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi cheechi sɔŋdiba tuma ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga zaani yu suma, ka tooi mali suhukpeeni n-tɔɣisiri bɛ ni niŋ Yisa Masia yɛda shɛm yɛla palɔni.
en: Those who have served well gain a good standing and considerable confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka bɛ laɣim bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa sɔŋ kaman zunzuya ni laɣindi binyara shɛm la, ka yiɣiri luri di zuɣu kaman toli ni yiɣiri luri binyara zuɣu shɛm la.
en: You people stole things in war. Those things will be taken from you. Many will come and take your wealth. It will be like the times when locusts come and eat all your crops.

dag: Amaa Ɛlihu ni daa nya ka niriba ata maa ni so bi yaag o noli garigi maa zuɣu ka o suhu daa yiɣisi.
en: But when he saw that Jobs three friends had nothing more to say, his anger forced him to speak.

dag: Ka n dan maa paɣ Zara dɔɣi bidibiga ti o, o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni; ka n dan maa zaŋ o binshɛɣukam zaa ti o bia maa.
en: My masters wife Sarah gave birth to a son for my master in her old age, and hes given him everything he owns.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun doli wuntitali soli o tuma zaa ni, ka zɔri nambɔɣu o ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa ni.
en: Everything the Lord does is good. Everything he does shows how loyal he is.

dag: a kul lɔrila saɣiŋgu nia. A zilinli ŋmanila piliŋ. A kul dolila ʒiŋmabo soli sahakam.
en: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.

dag: Ka Yawɛ jilima daa yiɣisi zani chɛrubinim maa zuɣusaa n-chaŋ ti tam Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunɔbia zuɣu, ka sagbani maa daa pali duu maa puuni. Ka Yawɛ jilima neesim daa pali dundɔŋ maa.
en: The dazzling light of the Lord 's presence rose up from the creatures and moved to the entrance of the Temple. Then the cloud filled the Temple, and the courtyard was blazing with the light.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ pagɔr liɣiri bee bɛ tuma liɣiri ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu na ti yo yi ni po pɔri shɛli samli, dama bina ayi ŋɔ zaa nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Also, no money earned in this way may be brought into the house of the Lord your God in fulfillment of a vow. The Lord hates temple prostitutes.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Pool daa yi Atɛnsi n-chaŋ Kɔrinti.
en: After this, Paul left Athens and went on to Corinth.

dag: Ka ti daa kul be gooni maa mɛbu ni, ka gooni maa zaa daa me n-tuɣi taba hal ti paai di dubu pirigili, dama niriba maa suhuri daa be tuma maa ni.
en: We built the wall of Jerusalem all the way around the city. But it was only half as tall as it should be. We did this much because the people worked with all their heart.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, labisimiya bɛ puri mini bɛ wain tihi puri ni bɛ olivi tihi puri ni bɛ yiya ti ba. Ka labisi yi ni niŋdi ba nyɔri shɛli yi liɣiri mini yi chi ni yi wain ni yi kpam zuɣu la ti ba.
en: Now give back the fields, vineyards, olive orchards, and houses you have taken and also the interest you have been paid.

dag: Pa yinima m-pii ma, amaa mani m-pii ya, ka zali ya ni yi chaŋ ti pum puma n-wali ka yi wala maa ku kpihim; ka yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam m Ba sani, o ni tin ya li.
en: You did not choose me. I chose you. And I gave you this work: to go and produce fruit—fruit that will last. Then the Father will give you anything you ask for in my name.

dag: Zaŋmi Aduna min o bidibisi ni binyɛra la ni bɛ ni boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la ni alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa ni piɛlah ayi ni bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi piɛɣu.
en: Take Aaron and his sons with him and the clothes, the anointing oil, the bull of the sin offering, the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Neetan daa yiɣisi kul o yiŋa. Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka dɔro gbaai Yuria paɣ ni dɔɣi bidib so ti Dauda maa.
en: Then Nathan went home. And the Lord caused the baby boy who was born to David and Uriahs wife to become very sick.

dag: Mɛtusɛla ni daa dɔɣi Lamɛk maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihiniinaayi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Lamechs birth, Methuselah lived years; and he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama bɛ daa bi deei Yawɛ noli. Ka bɛ daa mali hal ti paai Tapanhɛs.
en: They went to the land of Egypt, as far as Tahpanhes, for they wouldnt obey the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zanimi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni n-yɛli Juda fɔntinsinim bɛn zaa yɛn kana ti jɛm Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa n ni zal a ni a yɛli, ka miri ka a sɔɣi ba yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: Jeremiah, I have a message for everyone who comes from the towns of Judah to worship in my temple. Go to the temple courtyard and speak every word that I tell you.

dag: O daa ku Bashan Naa Ogi. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He defeated Og king of Bashan. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Amaa bɛ zuɣu n ni teei n ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛl la yɛla, n ni daa yihi shɛb Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na zuliya pam ninni nti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni la. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will renew the covenant that I made with their ancestors when I showed all the nations my power by bringing my people out of Egypt, in order that I, the Lord , might be their God.

dag: yin ti piimiya yi ni yɛn tuui kpuɣi puu atam shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni zaa niŋ piɛri puuni n-zaŋ li chaŋ ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii luɣ shɛli ni o yuli be nimaani la.
en: each of you must place in a basket the first part of each crop that you harvest and you must take it with you to the one place of worship.

dag: dama Naawuni chɛ ka sokam kpe bɛmaŋmaŋ nɔzaɣisibo ni m-be kaman dansarikanima n-nyɛ ba la ni di chɛ ka o zo sokam nambɔɣu.
en: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.

dag: Ka Malikija ŋun daa nyɛ salindoora la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. O daa mal li mi me hal ti paai Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba mini kɔhigɔriba yili din daa be Vihibu Dunɔdali shee la hal ti paai zuɣusaa duu din daa be gɔŋbu shee la.
en: Malchijah, a goldsmith, rebuilt the next section, as far as the house used by the temple workers and merchants. This area was across from Gathering Gate, near the room on top of the wall at the northeast corner.

dag: Ka n daa lan kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya chɛchɛbunsi anahi ka di yi daanya zoya ayi sunsuuni na.
en: Then I turned around. I looked up and saw four chariots going between two bronze mountains.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa ŋma kuyila n-yili niŋ Naa Jɔsia. Ka baansi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa na kul yiini kuyila yɛri Jɔsia yɛla hal ni zuŋɔ. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li leei kali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka sab li niŋ fabila litaafi ni.
en: Jeremiah composed a funeral song for Josiah, and to this day every singer, man or woman, continues to remember Josiah in their funeral songs. They are now traditional in Israel and are written down among the funeral songs.

dag: Maligumaana Aduna bidibisi mi n-yɛn piɛbiri kikahi maa. Kikahi maa n-yɛn nyɛ yi kali soli bini yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Aarons sons the priests will blow the trumpets. This will be a permanent regulation for you throughout time.

dag: Miri ka a bɔhi, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yuun shɛŋa din gari la so pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ? Dama lala bɔhigu pala yɛm bɔhigu.
en: Dont ask, How is it that the former days were better than these? because it isnt wise to ask this.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim maa daa mali bɛmaŋ kasi, ka mali niriba maa ka bɛ niŋ kasi; ka lan mali dunɔdaya mini gooni maa ka di gba niŋ kasi.
en: The priests and Levites held special ceremonies to make themselves holy, and then they did the same for the rest of the people and for the gates and walls of the city.

dag: dama nir yi sabi wuh o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm zali, di bi tumdi tuma o yi na be o nyɛvil ni.
en: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.

dag: m-pahi Yisifu yiŋnim zaa min o biɛyanim ni o ba yiŋnim zaa daa pahi Yisifu zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ. Kulla bɛ bihi mini piɛri ni buhi ni niɣi kɔŋko n-daa kpalim be Goshɛn tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: Josephs entire household, his brothers, and his fathers household. Only the children, flocks, and cattle remained in the land of Goshen.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni Shia Kasi n-tahiri ma Jɛrusalɛm, ka m mi bi mi din ti yɛn niŋ ma nimaani.
en: And now, in obedience to the Holy Spirit I am going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there.

dag: A daalikauli nyɛla din tiri ma nyɛvili; dina n-nyɛ n suhu kpaŋsibo n wahala dibu puuni.
en: Even in my suffering I was comforted because your promise gave me life.

dag: Di zaa yoli, n kul bela a sani sahakam, ka a gbibi n nudirigu.
en: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-yɛri sakuɣa, Lum tiŋgban ni, ka yɛli sa titali ŋɔ, Lumina pam.
en: Snow and heavy rainstorms.

dag: Bi jɛrigu nyɛla ŋun tiri o ba suhugarigu. Yidaampaɣ so ŋun yuri zabili ŋmanila saa ŋun yɔrita.
en: A foolish son brings a flood of troubles to his father, and a complaining wife is like the constant dripping of water.

dag: Bɛ ni bi nyari saɣisigu zuɣu ka bɛ kpira, ka bɛ jɛrilim din galisi zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zuɣuri kpi.
en: Those without instruction will die, misled by their own stupidity.

dag: Do so daa lan beni ŋun mali Yawɛ yuli tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa. O yuli n-daa booni Yuria. O daa nyɛla Shɛmaya ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim nir la bia. O daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi tiŋ ŋɔ mini tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ kaman Jɛrimia ni kul tɔɣisiri shɛm ŋɔ.
en: There was another man who prophesied in the LORDs name: Uriah, Shemaiahs son from Kiriath-jearim. He prophesied the same things that Jeremiah did about this city and against this land.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛli niriba maa, Nyamiya, n da yi mini yi puri n-ti Firawuna zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Pumpɔŋɔ deemiya bimbira ŋɔ zali nti biri.
en: Joseph said to the people, Since Ive now purchased you and your farmland for Pharaoh, heres seed for you. Plant the seed on the land.

dag: Rɛkab bia Jɔnadab daa zal o zuliya ni bɛ di nyu wain, ka bɛ na ʒi n-nyu wain hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, dama bɛ dolila bɛ yabidoo ni daa zali ba zaligu shɛli. Amaa mmaŋmaŋ kul tɔɣisiri ya la yɛtɔɣa waawaayili, ka yi bi deeri n noli.
en: from the Rechabite clan. Their ancestor Jonadab told his descendants never to drink wine, and to this very day they have obeyed him. But I have spoken to you over and over, and you haven't obeyed me!.

dag: Dama di nyɛla Naawuni yubu ni yi tum din tuhi, ka di chɛ ka yi mum jɛra bɛn tɔɣisiri ʒilinsi yɛtɔɣa la noya.
en: For God wants you to silence the ignorant talk of foolish people by the good things you do.

dag: Kum zana n-daa kul gili ma; ka kpiimba biɛhigu shee dabiɛm gbaai ma; ka wahala mini suhusaɣiŋgu gbaai ma pam.
en: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun bɔri piɛri kɔbiri mini gumdi shee, ka zaŋ o nuhi tumdi tuma ni o suhu zaa.
en: She seeks out wool and flax; she works joyfully with her hands.

dag: Nandahimalana n-nyɛ ma! Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi fa ma n ninsalitali biɛhigu din tahiri ma kum ni ŋɔ bahi?.
en: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?.

dag: O daa boli nimaani yul la Bɛtɛl. Amaa nimaani yuli daa pun boonila Luz.
en: He named the place Bethel.

dag: Dama ninsal suhu ni ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha yirina. Dina n-nyɛ: Tɛhi biɛri mini zina niŋbu balibu kam ni tayiɣisigu ni ninvuɣ kubo.
en: Out of your heart come evil thoughts, vulgar deeds, stealing, murder.

dag: Nahiŋgu mini biɛrim pam m-mali ba dabiɛm. Di lula bɛ zuɣu kaman naa ni mali shili ni o chaŋ tɔb tuhibu shɛm la.
en: disaster, like a powerful king, is waiting to attack them.

dag: Ka o tizɔdoo Absalom daa nya o ka bɔh o, A tizɔdoo Amnɔn zaŋ a mi dɔni yɔɣu? Ka daa yɛl o, N tizɔpaɣa niŋmi suɣilo, a tizɔdoo m-bala, di chɛ ka di muɣis a. Di saha ka Tama daa leei bɛ ni ku lan bo paɣ so, ka o kpalim ʒi o tizɔdoo Absalom yiŋa.
en: Her brother Absalom said to her, Has your brother Amnon been with you? Keep quiet about it for now, sister; hes your brother. Dont let it bother you. So Tamar, a broken woman, lived in her brother Absaloms house.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli nyin Baruk shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Then later, the Lord God of Israel told me to say to Baruch:.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum Dauda yɛtɔɣa maa ka bɛ chaŋ ti yɛli Sool, ka o daa tim ti bol o na.
en: Some soldiers overheard David talking, so they told Saul what David had said. Saul sent for David, and David came.

dag: A yi ʒini tiŋa, a ku zɔri dabiɛm; ka a yi dɔni tiŋa, a ni gbihi go nyaɣisili.
en: You will not be afraid when you go to bed, and you will sleep soundly through the night.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa nya li maa ka di gar o pam, ka o tirisi mir li ha ni o lihi li viɛnyɛliŋga, ka wum ti Duuma kukoli.
en: Moses was amazed by what he saw, and went near the bush to get a better look. But he heard the Lord's voice:.

dag: Doo yi chɛ ka o dɔbilim yina, ŋun sum o niŋgbuŋ zaa kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: When a man has an emission of semen, he must bathe his whole body, and he remains unclean until evening.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Bia maa ku tooi niŋ shɛli omaŋmaŋ yubu ni naɣila o ni nya ka o Ba niŋdi shɛli, dama Ba maa ni niŋdi shɛli, dina ka Bia maa gba niŋda.
en: But Jesus answered, I assure you that the Son can do nothing alone. He does only what he sees his Father doing. The Son does the same things that the Father does.

dag: Bɛ lɔɣiri ŋmanila gbal yari. Bɛ zaa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: Their arrow bags are like open graves. All their men are strong soldiers.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa yɛrila laakum kɔbiri binyɛrigu, ka mali gbaŋ lɔr o shee ni, ka o bindirigu daa nyɛla toli mini shiri.
en: John wore clothes made of camels hair, with a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

dag: Ka salo pam daa ʒin gil o niŋ sunsuuni ka bɛ yɛl o, A tizɔbihi min a ma be samban ni bɔr a.
en: A crowd was seated around him, and those sent to him said, Look, your mother, brothers, and sisters are outside looking for you.

dag: Harim daŋ — tuhili ni pinaayopɔin.
en: of Harim .

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bibil so na nti zali bɛ sunsuuni n-kpuɣ o buɣi ka yɛli ba.
en: Jesus reached for a little child, placed him among the Twelve, and embraced him. Then he said.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa wum yi yɛligu maa ka o suhu yiɣisi ka o po pɔri yɛli.
en: The LORD heard what you said. He was angry and he swore.

dag: Tirimiya wuhi soli din kuni Ziɔn. Zomiya yomyom tiligi, ka di niŋya zinchili, dama n yɛn chɛmi ka zaɣ biɛɣu yi nuzaa polo na. Ka di ni ti di niriba pam.
en: Head for Jerusalem or another walled town! Jeremiah, tell them I'm sending disaster from the north.

dag: A niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni sahakam; a chɛ ka o mali suhupiɛlli din yi a sanna.
en: You have given him blessings that will last forever. You have given him the joy of being near you.

dag: N kul ni be yi sani chana, ka nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka yi nyɛ n niriba.
en: I will walk with you and be your God. And you will be my people.

dag: Yi ni nyɛ n ninvuɣ gahinda, ka n tiri ya jilima, ka yuri ya la zuɣu, n ni zaɣisi zuliya pam niriba, ka tiligi ya.
en: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.

dag: Amalɛknima m-be Nɛgɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka Hitinim mini Jɛbusinim ni Amɔrinim be zoya ni tinsi ni; ka Keenannim mi ʒi m-baɣi teeku mini Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili.
en: Amalekites live in the southern part of the land; Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country; and Canaanites live by the Mediterranean Sea and along the Jordan River.

dag: Di saha ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim mini Shɛbina ni Jɔa daa yɛli Rabishake, Ti suhir a, yɛlim tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, dama ti wumdi li, ka di lan yɛri ti Judahili ni ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi gooni ŋɔ zuɣu ŋɔ wumda.
en: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah told the official, Speak Aramaic to us, sir. We understand it. Don't speak Hebrew; all the people on the wall are listening.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pii bɛ mabihi maa shɛb ni bɛn pa bɛ zuɣu pahi n-daa nyɛ: Zakaria mini Jaaziɛl ni Shɛmiramɔt ni Jɛiɛl ni Unni ni Ɛliab ni Bɛnaaya ni Maasɛya ni Matitia ni Ɛlifɛlɛhu ni Mikinɛya; ka Obɛdɛdom mini Jɛiɛl daa nyɛ dunɔguliba.
en: and second in rank with them their relatives: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, and Obed-edom and Jeiel the gatekeepers.

dag: Di daa nyɛla Naawuni yubu ni ŋun Naawuni biɛhigu zaa be o Bia maa ni.
en: Because all the fullness of God was pleased to live in him.

dag: N zaŋdi n yɛlimuɣisira n-yɛr o asiba mini wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa, ka ŋuhiri niŋd o, ka o mi ni wum n kuhigu maa.
en: I speak to God morning, noon, and night. I tell him what upsets me, and he listens to me!.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa kuhi bahi Jɔnatan min o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa zuɣu n-yɛli, Dumiya ka ti sanna ka ti wuhi ya binshɛli. Ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa, Doli n nyaaŋa na, dama Yawɛ zaŋ ba niŋ Izraɛlnim nuu ni.
en: The Philistines in the fort shouted to Jonathan and his helper, Come up here. Well teach you a lesson. Jonathan said to his helper, Follow me up the hill. The Lord is letting Israel defeat the Philistines.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛl o, Ti ni doli solɔɣu maa gari; ka ti mini ti biŋkɔbiri yi nyu yi kom, ti ni yo di zuɣu; ti ni kul bɔri shɛli nyɛla yi chɛ ka ti kana ti gari.
en: The people of Israel said, We will stay on the main road, and if we or our animals drink any of your water, we will pay for it—all we want is to pass through.

dag: Ka Musa daa kpe kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la n-daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi maa gbib o nuu ni n-du Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: So Moses made two more stone tablets like the first ones. Early the next morning Moses went up Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded. Moses carried the two stone tablets with him.

dag: Zaŋmiya salima alali mali di buɣim saligbabirisi mini di buɣim moorisi.
en: Use pure gold to make the lamp snuffers and trays.

dag: A ni tiligi pagɔrili ŋun nyɛ zinalana naŋgbammalisim ni.
en: Wisdom will save you from that other woman, another mans wife, who tempts you with sweet words.

dag: n-zaŋ ba zali tuumba maa tooni, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu suhi Naawuni ti ba.
en: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu nyɛla din ni chɛ ka nir ti nya binshɛŋa o ni niŋdi tahima ni o ni ti nya la; di lan nyɛla din ni chɛ ka o shiri mi ni o nina ni ku tooi nya binshɛŋa beni.
en: To have faith is to be sure of the things we hope for, to be certain of the things we cannot see.

dag: Ka Abigeel daa yiɣisi gbani n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa ka yɛli, Nyamiya, man ŋun nyɛ yi dabipaɣ ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun ni paɣi n dan tumtumdiba naba.
en: She bowed low to the ground and said, I am your servant, ready to serve and wash the feet of my masters helpers.

dag: Ka Keen min o paɣ daa laɣim ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi Inok. Ka Keen daa me o tiŋa n-zaŋ o bia Inok maa yuli m-bol li Inok.
en: Cain and his wife had a son and named him Enoch. Then Cain built a city and named it after his son.

dag: Amaa zuliya shɛli din zaŋ di nyiŋgoli niŋ Babilɔn Naa naɣikɔra dapua lɔŋni n-jɛmd o, n ni chɛ di zuliya maa ʒili bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bɛ be nimaani kɔra. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But if any nation submits to the king of Babylonia and serves him, then I will let it stay on in its own land, to farm it and live there. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: ka yɛl o, N dana, di zaŋ man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ taali bee n-lan teei n ni daa tum gala shɛm dahin shɛli nyini n dan ni daa yi Jɛrusalɛm n-zɔrila yɛla. Naa, di zaŋ li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: He said to the king, May my master not hold me guilty or remember your servants wrongdoing that day my master the king left Jerusalem. Please forget about it, Your Majesty.

dag: Dama ti yi di bi kpalim ʒiya, ŋ-ŋɔ ti di pun chaŋ pahi buyi ka labina.
en: If we had not waited so long, we could have been there and back twice by now.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka niriba ŋmaligi paɣiri ba, ka bi nya bɛ taali.
en: Thats why people keep going back to them, keep approving what they say.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma doli nuzaa polo dunɔdali yi n-gili samban ni n-chaŋ samban ni dunɔdali din kpa wulimpuhili polo la gbini, ka kom maa zɔri yiri nudirigu polo na.
en: The man then took me out of the Temple area by way of the north gate and led me around to the gate that faces east. A small stream of water was flowing out at the south side of the gate.

dag: Amaa bɛ bi mi ni kpiimba be nimaani, ka o saamba be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: But they dont know that the dead are there; her guests are in the depths of the grave.

dag: Ka n daa wum ninvuɣ so kukoli ka di yi Ulai Mɔɣili la ni na m-booni yɛra, Gabirɛl, wuhim o o ni nya shɛli maa gbinni.
en: I heard a voice call out over the Ulai River, Gabriel, explain to him the meaning of what he saw.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaanahi saha ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa kana ti liri Judanim ni daa me birininim gili fɔntin shɛŋa zaa n-tuhi deei li.
en: Assyrias King Sennacherib marched against all of Judahs fortified cities and captured them in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah.

dag: ka yɛri ba, Di sabiya, Man Naawuni duu nyɛla wunsuhigu duu. Amaa yinim zaŋ li leela ŋmɛnditoya duu! .
en: He said to them, Its written, My house will be a house of prayer, but you have made it a hideout for crooks. .

dag: Miriya ka yi yi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni, di yi pa lala yi ni kpi, dama bɛ ni boori Yawɛ kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la be yi ni. Ka bɛ daa niŋ kaman Musa ni yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: But you must not even leave the entrance of the Meeting Tent. If you leave, you will die because the Lord s anointing oil is on you. So Aaron, Eleazar, and Ithamar obeyed Moses.

dag: Amaa ka Farisiinima bɛn daa wum lala ka yɛli, Kulla alizin biɛri naa ŋun yuli booni Biilzibul la n-niŋ o yiko ka o kariti alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: When the Pharisees heard this, they said, This man uses the power of Satan to force demons out of people. Satan is the ruler of demons.

dag: Nyamiya, n ni vil o bahi o bindoo zuɣu, ka o mini bɛnkam niŋ o zina ni nya wahala pam naɣila bɛ niŋla tuuba bɛ ni tum shɛm o sani maa zuɣu.
en: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.

dag: Bɛ ni bahi yoli yomyom n-chaŋ ti kpe luɣ shɛli din mali dabiɛm!.
en: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.

dag: Ka bɛ fo, dama bɛ daa ŋmɛrila tab naŋgbankpeeni sol ni ni bɛ baŋ ŋun gar o kpee bɛ ni.
en: But they would not answer him, because on the road they had been arguing among themselves about who was the greatest.

dag: Ka yi ni ŋuni n-lee bo paɣa ka bɛ na bi kulis o na? Dilan labimi kuli yiŋa, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb maa ni ka so kpuɣ o paɣ maa.
en: Or is there anyone here who is engaged but not yet married? He may leave and go back to his house; otherwise, he might die in the battle and someone else would marry his fiancée.

dag: nti yɛli ba, M mi ni Yawɛ zaŋ ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya; ka dabiɛm pun gbahi ti pam yi zuɣu; ka bɛnkam zaa be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni suhuri fuŋmi.
en: She said, I know that the Lord has given this land to your people. You frighten us. Everyone living in this country is afraid of you.

dag: Ka Giliad kpamba maa yɛli Jɛfita, Di zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti ka a sanna pumpɔŋɔ maa. Ti bɔrimi ni a kana ti pahi ti zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka a leei Giliadnim zaa zuɣulana.
en: But we do want you to come back, the leaders said. And if you lead us in battle against the Ammonites, we will make you the ruler of Gilead.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ paɣ maa yina, ka o tim ti yɛl o yidan ba Juda, Do so ŋun su nɛma ŋɔ n-ti ma pua maa. N suhir a, lihim li nya ŋuni n-lee su li. Nɛma maa n-nyɛ: nintua din mali dalinli ŋɔ mini zoligo ŋɔ ni jaaŋgbee ŋɔ.
en: As she was being taken out, she sent word to her father-in-law: I am pregnant by the man who owns these things. Look at them and see whose they are—this seal with its cord and this walking stick.

dag: Dunia zaa ni kul be ŋun nyɛ Tuumbiɛrilan la sulinsi ni la zaa yoli, tinim mi ni ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi.
en: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.

dag: Ti yaannim ni daa be mɔɣu ni la bɛ daa malila Naawuni shɛhira tanti kaman ŋun Naawuni ni daa wuhi Anabi Musa ni o malim li kaman o ni daa nya li ka di be shɛm la.
en: The tent of testimony was with our ancestors in the wilderness. Moses built it just as he had been instructed by the one who spoke to him and according to the pattern he had seen.

dag: dama bɛ daa zaŋla daba ayopɔin n-zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa ti Naawuni, ka zaŋ daba ayopɔin mi m-puhi chuɣu, ka daa laɣim dabisi shɛli din pah anii dali jɛm Naawuni.
en: Then on the next day, everyone came together for worship. They had celebrated a total of days, days for the dedication of the altar and more days for the festival.

dag: Yiɣisima, dama di nyɛla a tuma, ka ti gba ʒe a nyaaŋa, mali yaa, ka niŋ li.
en: It is your responsibility to act. We are behind you, so go ahead and get it done.

dag: Bɛna n-yɛn ʒiri Naawuni jɛmbu shee pateesanim mini Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni di bimpindigu ni biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ din yɛn pa di zuɣusaa la ni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni pateesa la.
en: They must carry the curtains of the Holy Tent, the Meeting Tent, its covering, and the covering made from fine leather. They must also carry the curtain at the entrance of the Meeting Tent.

dag: Dindali maa dɔbba ayi ni ti be puu ni; ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la.
en: At that time two men will be working in a field: one will be taken away, the other will be left behind.

dag: Ka Ribɛka dɔɣibu dali daa ti paai, ka jahi m-be o pul ni.
en: When Rebekah gave birth.

dag: Kaman yim bee buyi ka kɔhigɔriba mini bɛn kɔhiri nɛma balibu kam daa kana ti gbe Jɛrusalɛm gooni maa sambani polo.
en: Once or twice the traders and sellers of all kinds of merchandise spent the night outside Jerusalem.

dag: Yɛndan nyɛla ŋun tumdi din tuhi, amaa ka jɛrigu mi nyɛ ŋun tumdi din bi tuhi.
en: It is natural for the wise to do the right thing and for fools to do the wrong thing.

dag: Amaa Jɔab daa bi kali Lɛvi zuliya mini Bɛnjamin zuliya bɛna, dama naa zaligu maa daa bi niŋ o nyaɣisim.
en: Because Joab disapproved of the king's command, he did not take any census of the tribes of Levi and Benjamin.

dag: Dama bɔhimi ninkura nya bɛ yaannim ni daa mi shɛli.
en: Ask a previous generation and verify the findings of your ancestors.

dag: Hal a niriba Izraɛlnim ni kul galisi kaman teeku noli bihigu maa, kulla bɛ ni niriba biɛla kɔŋko n-ni ti labina. Bahiyoli din simdi ba kul ʒiɛmi guli ba.
en: Although your people, Israel, were like the sand of the sea, only a few survivors will return. The end is announced, overflowing with justice.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be tibi ni ŋun niŋdi din viɛla, dinzuɣu ka o wuhiri alahichinima di soli maa.
en: Because the Lord is righteous and good, he teaches sinners the path they should follow.

dag: Wummiya n ni yɛri ya shɛm. Chɛliya ka yi baɣa be n yɛligu ni.
en: Listen and hear my voice; pay attention and hear my word.

dag: Ka Musa deemba ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛn nir la daŋ niriba daa yiɣisi abie tihi tiŋ la ni n-dol Juda zuliya niriba maa ti ʒini Juda tiŋgban ni din lab Nɛgɛb polo m-miri Arad la. Bɛ daa ʒini pahila nimaani nim zuɣu.
en: The Kenites left the City of Palm Trees and went with the men of Judah. They went to the desert of Judah to live with the people there. This was in the Negev near the city Arad.

dag: Naawuni ni daa duh o n-zaŋ o ʒili o nudirigu polo maa ka o deei Shia Kasi so o Ba Naawuni ni daa zaŋ lo ti alikauli la n-ti ti na. Alikauli maa palibu shihira ka yi nya ka wum ŋɔ.
en: Jesus was lifted up to heaven. Now he is with God, at Gods right side. The Father has given the Holy Spirit to him, as he promised. So Jesus has now poured out that Spirit. This is what you see and hear.

dag: Ka tin shɛŋa din pahi n-daa lan nyɛ: Maɔn mini Kamɛl ni Zif ni Juta.
en: The eighth region was located in the southeastern part of the hill country, and it had the following ten towns with their surrounding villages: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah, Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah, Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah.

dag: Zuɣusaa ni du ka chɛ tiŋgbani shɛm, lala ka o yurilim maŋli galisi zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o sani.
en: because as high as heaven is above the earth, thats how large Gods faithful love is for those who honor him.

dag: Ka salo maa kpamba daa yɛli, Ti mi pun ku Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba paɣiba zaa. Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ nya paɣiba ti bɛ ni bɛn kpalim ŋɔ.
en: Then their leaders said: All the women of the Benjamin tribe were killed. How can we get wives for the men of Benjamin who are left?.

dag: Lala ka tuun suma gba yiri palo, hal tuun sun shɛŋa yi bi yi palo viɛnyɛliŋga, di mi kul ku bahi kpalim sɔɣiya.
en: It is the same with the good things people do. Some are easy to see. But even if they are not obvious now, none of them will stay hidden forever.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa chaŋ ti liri Keenannim mini Pɛrizinima ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ tuhi ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pia Bɛzɛk.
en: Together they attacked an army of , Canaanites and Perizzites at Bezek, and the Lord helped Judah defeat them. During the battle, Judah's army found out where the king of Bezek was, and they attacked there.

dag: Amaa ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ omaŋmaŋ taali? Chɛli n daashilɔni taali.
en: People cannot see their own mistakes, so dont let me commit secret sins.

dag: N niŋgbunzabili ŋɔ, n niŋgbunzabili ŋɔ! Biɛrim mali ma, ka n lɛbiri ginda. Mbaye, n suhu ni, n suhu kul tɔrila pampam. N ku tooi shini, dama n wumla kikahi kumsi, di nyɛla tɔbuchiriga.
en: The pain! I can't bear the pain! My heart! My heart is beating wildly! I can't keep quiet; I hear the trumpets and the shouts of battle.

dag: Zɛdɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisiniyini saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun piniyini.
en: Zedekiah was years old when he was appointed king of Judah, and he ruled from Jerusalem for years.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa chɛ ka niriba bɛn ʒe dunol ni n-nyɛ ninkura mini bipola maa zaa zom, ka chani bɔbindi bɔri dunoli shee.
en: Then they struck all the men outside with blindness, so that they couldn't find the door.

dag: hal ka daa mi ni Naawuni pun yɛli ŋun ti yab Ibrahimma, Yisahaku ni ka a zuliya ni zani.
en: He had been told concerning him, Your legitimate descendants will come from Isaac. .

dag: Bɛ wurim m biɛhigu shee kaman bɛ ni sibigiri piɛgul tanti suɣili shɛm la. N daa kpabi la n nyɛvili kaman kpalua ni kpabiri tana shɛm la, ka bɛ ŋmaai ma yihi kpalu dari ni. Wuntaŋ ni zaŋ hal ni yuŋ, o kul wuhirila n nyɛvili tariga.
en: My life was cut off and ended, Like a tent that is taken down, Like cloth that is cut from a loom. I thought that God was ending my life.

dag: Yawɛ yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je alahichi; o gul o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim; o fari ba ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahira.
en: The Lord loves those who hate evil; he protects the lives of his people; he rescues them from the power of the wicked.

dag: ka yɛli Ɛfurɔn niriba maa zaa ninni, Amaa a yi di saɣi n naan yo a palo maa liɣiri. Saɣimi dee li, ka n zaŋ n kpim maa ti sɔɣi nimaani.
en: and said to Ephron, so that everyone could hear, May I ask you, please, to listen. I will buy the whole field. Accept my payment, and I will bury my wife there.

dag: Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ nya paɣiba ti bɛ ni shɛb bɛn kpalim la? Dama ti pun po Yawɛ sani ni ti ni so di zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga ti ba.
en: Only a few men of Benjamin weren't killed in the war. We need to get wives for them, so the tribe won't completely disappear. But how can we do that, after promising in the Lord 's name that we wouldn't let them marry any of our daughters.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa sabi zaligu shɛli Musa ni daa pun sab zal la pa kuɣa maa zuɣu Izraɛlnim ninni.
en: There, with the Israelites looking on, Joshua made on the stones a copy of the Law which Moses had written.

dag: Amaa bɛ ku mali fali bɛ mabihi sani, Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ fali kaman o ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛm la.
en: but they wont share an inheritance with their fellow Israelites. The LORD alone is the Levites inheritance—just as God promised them.

dag: Ka Dauda yɛl o, Yɛlim ma din niŋ. Ka o yɛl o, Tɔbbihi maa ŋmaligimi guui, ka bɛ pam lu tɔb maa ni, ka Sool min o bia Jɔnatan gba lu tɔb maa ni.
en: Whats the report? David asked him. Tell me! The man answered, The troops fled from the battle! Many of the soldiers have fallen and died. Whats more, Saul and his son Jonathan have also died.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa yiɣisi doli Giliad kpamba maa kuli, ka Giliadnim ti zaŋ o leei bɛ zuɣulana ni bɛ sapashin kpɛma. Ka Jɛfita daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa ni nyɛ shɛm zaa Yawɛ sani Mizipa.
en: So Jephthah went with the elders from Gilead, and the people made him their leader and commander. Jephthah repeated all of his words in front of the Lord at the city of Mizpah.

dag: Mɔɣ shɛli din daŋ tooni yuli m-booni Pishɔn. Dina n-zɔri gindi Havila tiŋgbɔŋ zaa, ka salima be nimaani.
en: The first one is the Pishon River that flows through the land of Havilah.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa daa yiɣisi zani bɔh o, A ka noli din ni garigi? Shɛhira bɔ ka bɛ lee dir a ŋɔ?.
en: The high priest stood up and asked Jesus, Why don't you say something in your own defense? Don't you hear the charges they are making against you.

dag: Abigeel ni daa ti kul nya Dauda, o dii sheela o buŋ maa zuɣu na yom lu n-gbani Dauda tooni, ka zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa.
en: Abigail quickly got off her donkey and bowed down in front of David.

dag: ni bɛ zaa leei zaɣ yini kaman nyini m Ba ni be n ni ka n gba be a ni shɛm la, ka di chɛ ka bɛ gba be ti ni, ka dunianim niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.

dag: N yi yihi ya yi ni wurim be tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni maa zaa na, n ni ti deei ya kaman sara shɛli din nyom viɛl la, ka chɛ ka n kasitali yi zahira yi sani yi ni be zuliya shɛb sani maa ninni.
en: When I bring you home from the places where you are now scattered, I will be pleased with you, just as I am pleased with the smell of the smoke from your sacrifices. Every nation on earth will see that I am holy.

dag: Jɛhoyachin yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisaayika saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa niŋla chira ata Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Nɛhushita. Ka Nɛhushita mi ba daa nyɛ Ɛlnatan ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm nir la.
en: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for three months. His mother was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan from Jerusalem.

dag: yi ni guhi hal ni bɛ ti zooi bi dɔbba? Ka dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ni chɛ ka yi ku kuli dɔb shɛba? Aai, m bihi, yi mi ni dimbɔŋɔ ku tooi nani. Yawɛ ni niŋ ma shɛm maa biɛri ma pam yi zuɣu.
en: would you wait until they grew up? Would you refrain from having a husband? No, my daughters. This is more bitter for me than for you, since the LORDs will has come out against me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mmaŋmaŋ ni vihi bo m piɛri, n shiri ni bo bɛ shee.
en: The Lord God then said: I will look for my sheep and take care of them myself.

dag: Yi daanabinim ŋmanila ŋɔri m-be Izraɛl dikilijina ni.
en: Israel's prophets are no better than jackals that hunt for food among the ruins of a city.

dag: Saha shɛli Yaakubu ni daa nya o ŋahiba Leeban bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl mini ŋun Leeban piɛri maa, o daa chaŋmi ti paai kuɣili maa kɔbiliga maa noli ka ŋɔŋ kom ti o ŋahiba Leeban piɛri maa ka bɛ nyu.
en: When Jacob saw Rachel with his uncle Laban's flock, he went to the well, rolled the stone back, and watered the sheep.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti daŋ yibu asiba n-chaŋ o ni daa ʒe Yawɛ tooni luɣ shɛl la.
en: Early the next morning, Abraham got up and went to the place where he stood before the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka paɣ maa daa shiri niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga shɛɣuni kaman Ilaisha ni daa yɛl o ni o ni dɔɣi saha shɛli maa.
en: But, as Elisha had said, at about that time the following year she gave birth to a son.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee tiri kahiŋkɔɣu nimdi saha shɛli kum yi ti mal o bihi ka bɛ kumdi niŋdi man Naawuni, ka chani bɔri bindirigu?.
en: Who feeds the ravens when their babies cry out to God and wander around without food?.

dag: Be baalim Yawɛ sani, ka di suɣilo guhir o; di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛri tɔŋsim yɛla muɣis a.
en: Be patient and wait for the Lord to act; don't be worried about those who prosper or those who succeed in their evil plans.

dag: Ka Sool mini Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm, ka o daa chani gindi mali Yisa yuli yihiri waazu ni suhukpeeni.
en: And so Saul stayed with the followers and went all around Jerusalem speaking boldly for the Lord.

dag: Amaa bɛ so bi bɔhi, Naawuni ŋun nam ma, ka nyɛ ŋun tiri ma yaa yuŋ ŋɔ lee be ya?.
en: But no one says, Where is God my maker; who gives songs in the night.

dag: Ka Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl mini Jɔzadak bia Jɛshua daa piligi n-lab mɛri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa Jɛrusalɛm, ka Naawuni daanabinim daa be bɛ sani sɔŋdi ba.
en: So Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the priest urged the people to start working on the temple again, and God's prophets encouraged them.

dag: Mɛmiya tinsi ti yi bihi ka me piɛri buzɔna ti yi piɛri mini yi buhi, ka niŋ kaman yi ni lo alikauli ni yi ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: So build your towns and the enclosures for your sheep, but do what you have promised.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Daadam Bia yi ti labina ni o jilima m-pahi malaikanim zaa, o ni ti ʒin o nam ʒiishee din mali jilima pam.
en: The Son of Man will come again with divine greatness, and all his angels will come with him. He will sit as king on his great and glorious throne.

dag: Yawɛ kul bela alizanda ni, ka lihiri ninsalinima ni o nya bɛ ni shɛb mali yɛm, ka nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi ŋun Naawuni.
en: The Lord looks down from heaven to see if there is anyone who is wise, anyone who looks to him for help.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim taba n-ka Dauda sanna Hiburɔn ti yɛl o, Nyama, ti nyɛla a daŋ niriba.
en: All the Israelites came to David at the town of Hebron. They said to David, We are your own flesh and blood.

dag: Bɛna n nyɛ Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Juda fɔntinsinim ni di nanima ni bɛ kpambaliba ni di chɛ ka di leei dabari, ka niriba maani ba ansarisi ka turi ba kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Jerusalem and all the towns of Judah, together with its kings and leaders, were made to drink from it, so that they would become a desert, a terrible and shocking sight, and so that people would use their name as a curse—as they still do.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa ti paai tiŋ maa ni n-nya ka bɛ nyo li la buɣim, ka gbahi bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bidibisi ni bipuɣinsi zaa chaŋ.
en: When David and his soldiers got to the town and found it burned down, and their wives, their sons, and their daughters taken prisoner.

dag: So ku lan zaŋ jɛrigu boli ninvuɣ titali bee n-zaŋ yɛmbimbiɛrilana boli ninvuɣ suŋ.
en: Then a fool will no longer be called honorable, nor a villain considered respectable.

dag: Ka Sisɛra daa dɔni gbihi di ni daa wum o pam zuɣu. Ka Jaɛl Hɛbɛr paɣ maa daa kpuɣi tanti kpaa mini zali m-puɣisi chaŋ ti zaŋ li ba Sisɛra tapaɣa n-kpahi li ti ba tiŋ ka o kpi.
en: Sisera was exhausted and soon fell fast asleep. Jael took a hammer and drove a tent-peg through his head into the ground, and he died.

dag: nti nya Izraɛlnim Naawuni maa, ka o naba tiŋli daa ŋmanila bɛ zaŋla bɛ ni booni kuɣ shɛŋa safaya la mal li. Di daa kul nɛmi kaman sagbana ni yi kani ka zuɣusaa ne shɛm la.
en: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something that looked like a pavement made out of sapphire, and it was as bright as the sky.

dag: ka o yɛl o dɔɣira maa, Naomi ŋun yi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la mali tiŋgbani din nyɛ ti dɔɣira Ɛlimɛlɛk dini m-bɔri ni o kɔhi li.
en: he said to his relative, Now that Naomi has come back from Moab, she wants to sell the field that belonged to our relative Elimelech.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Dindali maa, nayili yila ni ti leei fabila kuhigu. Niriba ni ti kpi n-do luɣ shɛlikam. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ ba labi ka fo baalim.
en: Instead of singing in the temple, they will cry and weep. Dead bodies will be everywhere. So keep silent! I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Tahima shɛlikam bɛ ni niŋ zaŋ chaŋ o gbaabu polo ku di nasara. Hal niriba yi nya o, dabiɛm gbahiri ba mi.
en: Such hopes would be delusional; surely the sight of him makes one stumble.

dag: Ŋunkam maani fiig tia viɛnyɛliŋga ni di di wala; ka ŋunkam lihir o dana viɛnyɛla ni nya jilima.
en: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa yɛli Yisa, Karimba, ti nyala so ka o mal a yuli karit alizin biɛri, ka ti kar o, o ni pa ti ni yino zuɣu.
en: Then John said, Teacher, we saw a man using your name to force demons out of someone. He is not one of us. So we told him to stop, because he does not belong to our group.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yinim alahichinim ŋɔ yiɣisimi zani yi yaannim zaashee ni yi chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu!.
en: And now you have taken your ancestors' place, a new generation of sinful people ready to bring down the fierce anger of the Lord on Israel again.

dag: O guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli zaligu soli, ka taɣiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe o yim barina ni.
en: He protects the paths of justice and guards the way of those who are loyal to him.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ tɔto tɔhi ti Yisa nyaandoliba la polo, m bɔri ni yi gba niŋ li kaman n ni daa wuhi cheechinim din be Galɛshia tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm la.
en: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.

dag: daa su ʒiʒiriba fukumsi, ka wuhiri bɛnkam daa tumdi tuma balibu kam bɛ ni yɛn tumdi li shɛm. Ka Lɛvinim maa shɛb daa nyɛ gbansabiriba, ka shɛb nyɛ kpamba, ka shɛb mi nyɛ dunɔguliba.
en: were in charge of carrying supplies and supervising the workers. Other Levites were appointed to stand guard around the temple.

dag: Solɔɣu ni ti be nimaani ka di yuli booni Soli din be kasi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be daɣiri ni ti ku doli soli maa; ka sochanda ŋun nyɛ jɛrigu gba ti ku yirigi soli maa zuɣu.
en: A highway will be there. It will be called The Holy Way. The unclean wont travel on it, but it will be for those walking on that way. Even fools wont get lost on it.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Gbibiya n jɛmbu dabisili la, dama dina n-yɛn nyɛ shihirili m mini ya sunsuuni yi ʒiɛmani kam ni din ni chɛ ka yi baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-mali ya ka yi be kasi.
en: to tell the people of Israel, Keep the Sabbath, my day of rest, because it is a sign between you and me for all time to come, to show that I, the Lord , have made you my own people.

dag: Nyama, dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa ka n daa lihi alizanda ni n-nya ka duno shɛli yooi yɛya, ka n wum n ni daa pun tuui wum kukol shɛl la ka di be kaman kikaa kumsi la yɛri ma na: Dum kpe na ka n ti wuh a din yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa.
en: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔ ka nyuri ti Duuma pipia ŋɔ ni binnyurigu ŋɔ ka bi doli so shɛli din tiri Naawuni jilima di ni, o ni mali taali zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma niŋgbuŋ min o ʒim polo.
en: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.

dag: Bundaannim buni n-nyɛ bɛ fɔntin titali din mali yaa, ka bɛ tɛhi ni di nyɛla goon shɛli din du pam.
en: The rich think their wealth will protect them. They think it is a strong fortress.

dag: Bɛ ni daa me birini gili fɔŋ kar shɛŋa n-nyɛ: Zidim mini Zɛr ni Hammat ni Rakat ni Kinɛrɛt.
en: There were some very strong cities inside these borders. They were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Kinnereth.

dag: ni tiŋgban nɛl ni viɣu ni jukangba ni kulijuɣu.
en: desert owls, ospreys, cormorants.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, Amaŋmaŋ mi n ni tum shɛm ti a, ka lan mi n zuɣu ni chɛ ka a niɣi yɛligi shɛm.
en: Jacob answered, You know how I have worked for you and how your flocks have prospered under my care.

dag: N yi darigi yi tibili ŋ-ŋɔ ka yi bi labi n sanna ka na kul kpɛrila yɔɣu.
en: If after all of this punishment you still do not listen to me, but continue to defy me.

dag: Amaa ka Rut daa yɛli Naomi, Di yɛri ma ni n labimi ka chɛ a, dama a ni kuni shɛli, nimaani ka n kuna, ka a ni kpɛri shɛli, nimaani ka n gba yɛn kpe. A niriba ni leei n niriba, ka a Naawuni leei n Naawuni.
