en: But Ruth replied, Dont urge me to abandon you, to turn back from following after you. Wherever you go, I will go; and wherever you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God will be my God.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ʒe Gomna Pailɛt tooni, ka Gomna Pailɛt maa bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: Jesus was brought before Pilate the governor, who asked him, Are you the king of the Jews? Those are your words! Jesus answered.

dag: ka Gomna Pailɛt lan bɔh o yaha, A ka noli din ni garigi? A bi wum bɛ ni fiɣisir a shɛm maa.
en: So Pilate asked Jesus another question. He said, You can see that these people are accusing you of many things. Why dont you answer.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa daŋ yibu asibaasi m-bol o kpambaliba na nti zaŋ yɛla maa zaa yɛli ba, ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ba pam.
en: Early the next morning Abimelech called all his officials and told them what had happened, and they were terrified.

dag: Ka bɛ ti zaŋ takɔbi ku o tɔbutuhiri biinsi zaa, ka bɛn mi ti gali ni wurim kpe luɣilikam. Ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: His best soldiers will be killed in battle, and the survivors will be scattered in every direction. Then you will know that I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Daadam, nyama, bɛn Izraɛlnim yɛra, O ni nyari ʒii shɛŋa maa yuma na galisiya, ka o daanabitali maa nyɛ saha shɛli din be katiŋ yɛtɔɣa.
en: Son of man, the people of Israel think that the visions I give you are for a time far in the future. They think you are talking about things that will happen many years from now.

dag: Dama Masia daa bi kpɛla daadamnim ni me Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee din nyɛ alali din la ŋmahinli la ni, amaa alizanda maŋmaŋ ni ka o kpe nti zani Naawuni tooni ti zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: For Christ did not go into a Holy Place made by human hands, which was a copy of the real one. He went into heaven itself, where he now appears on our behalf in the presence of God.

dag: Juda nabihi ni daa wum din niŋ maa, ka bɛ daa yi nayili n-kabi chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni nti ʒini bɛ ʒiishɛhi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa Dunɔdal Palli la shee.
en: Now the rulers of Judah heard about everything that was happening. So they came out of the kings palace. They went up to the Lord s Temple. They took their places at the entrance of the New Gate. The New Gate is a gate leading to the Lord s Temple.

dag: Dama Naawuni bindirigu nyɛla din yi alizanda ni na, ka nyɛ din tiri dunianim nyɛvili.
en: The bread of God is the one who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-tiri yɛm. O noli ni ka baŋsim mini yɛla baŋbu yirina.
en: The Lord is the source of wisdom; knowledge and understanding come from his mouth.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa paai Dauda tiŋ maa ni, ka Sool bipuɣiŋga Mikal la daa lihi takɔro ni na n-nya ka Naa Dauda kul wari waa, ka yiɣiri jamdi Yawɛ tooni, ka o lihi ʒiɛm Dauda o suhu ni.
en: Sauls daughter Michal was looking out the window. While the Lord s Holy Box was being carried into the city, David was jumping and dancing before the Lord . Michal saw this, and she was upset at David.

dag: Ti mali tahima ni Naawuni ni ti yihi ti taali ni o sani; ka dimbɔŋɔnima n-nyɛ ti ni guhiri shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko din tumdi di tuma ti yɛda niŋbu ni la puuni.
en: As for us, our hope is that God will put us right with him; and this is what we wait for by the power of God's Spirit working through our faith.

dag: ka Abija daa laɣim dɔbba bɛn mali suhukpeeni din ni tuhi tɔbu ka lan nyɛ bɛn mi tɔb tuhibu ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinahi ni bɛ chaŋ tɔbu tuhibu. Ka Jɛrɔbɔam mi daa laɣim tɔbutuhiri biinsi bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinii ni bɛ tuhi taba.
en: Abijah raised an army of , soldiers, and Jeroboam opposed him with an army of .

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!.

dag: Niriba bɛn be zibisim ni baŋdi a daalahiziba tuma yɛla? Bee bɛ baŋd a tiliginsim sɔŋsim yɛla bɛ tamsim shee?.
en: Are your miracles seen in that place of darkness or your goodness in the land of the forgotten?.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa zaŋ o ba min o biɛyanim maa ʒili Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka ŋmaai tiŋgban viɛlli Ramɛsis tiŋgban ni ti ba kaman Firawuna ni daa yɛl o shɛm.
en: Joseph settled his father and brothers and gave them property in the land of Egypt, in the best location in the land of Rameses, just as Pharaoh had ordered.

dag: Amaa ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya nyɔtaɣirisi zali di zaani, ka o daa zaŋ li niŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa ʒe n-guli nayili dunol la kpamba nuu ni.
en: To replace them, Rehoboam made bronze shields and entrusted them to the officers responsible for guarding the palace gates.

dag: Bɛ wurim m biɛhigu shee kaman bɛ ni sibigiri piɛgul tanti suɣili shɛm la. N daa kpabi la n nyɛvili kaman kpalua ni kpabiri tana shɛm la, ka bɛ ŋmaai ma yihi kpalu dari ni. Wuntaŋ ni zaŋ hal ni yuŋ, o kul wuhirila n nyɛvili tariga.
en: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.

dag: N daa yɛli ya, Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-zɔri ba dabiɛm.
en: Then I said, Don't worry!.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sara maligu bimbini zaligunim m-bɔŋɔ: dahin shɛli di yi ti naai, ka yi yɛn mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu, ka zaŋ ʒim vie li.
en: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, after the altar is built, it must be dedicated by offering sacrifices on it and by splattering it with blood. Here is what you must do:.

dag: Di tahi dokurili zuɣu, amaa zaŋm zilim balli n-tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa kaman a ba la; ka niŋmi nachimbihi kaman a mabihi la;.
en: Dont speak angrily to an older man. But talk to him as if he were your father. Treat the younger men like brothers.

dag: O tihi nyɔŋ maa ni tihi din kpalim ni nyɛla biɛla, hal ka bia ni tooi kal li.
en: its forests remaining trees will be no more than a child can count.

dag: Ka bɛ lan bɔh o yaha, Wula ka o daa lee niŋ a? Wula ka o daa lee niŋ neeg a nina maa.
en: What did he do to you? they asked. How did he heal your eyes.

dag: Naawuni bi zaɣis o ni pun piig o ninvuɣ shɛb la. Yi bi mi Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Anabi Ilaija ni daa yɛli shɛm n-galim Izraɛlnima Naawuni san la yɛla?.
en: God hasnt rejected his people, whom he knew in advance. Or dont you know what the scripture says in the case of Elijah, when he pleads with God against Israel?.

dag: Di saha maa ka Hagai daa yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya ni lala n-nyɛ yi zuliya ŋɔ niriba mini bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi tum shɛlikam; dinzuɣu bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛlikam m-mali sara pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu nyɛla din pa kasi n sani.
en: Then Haggai said, This is what the Lord God said: This is also true for the people of this nation. They were not pure and holy before me. So anything they did with their hands and anything they offered at the altar became unclean.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be binnɛma anahi maa sunsuuni ŋ-ŋmani buɣim sal nɛma, ka ŋmani buɣim mokpala chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa binnɛma maa sunsuuni. Buɣim maa daa ne pam, ka saa nyaɣisibu daa yiri buɣim maa ni na.
en: Among the creatures there was something that looked like a blazing torch, constantly moving. The fire would blaze up and shoot out flashes of lightning.

dag: Naawuni ni daa neeg o kum ni ka o ku lan labi niŋgbuŋ poobu ni zuɣu ka o daa lan yɛli: N ni zaŋ alibarika suŋ shɛli n ni daa niŋniŋ Naa Dauda ni la n-niŋ a ni.
en: God raised Jesus from death. Jesus will never go back to the grave and become dust. So God said, I will give you the true and holy promises that I made to David. Isaiah :.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya din be di ni maa tim nandaamba; ka binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ nyam yi sani.
en: So pay attention to what is inside. Give to the people who need help. Then you will be fully clean.

dag: M mi noonsi zaa, ka biŋkɔbiri zaa bɛn gɔri ginda nyɛla n dini.
en: All the wild birds are mine and all living things in the fields.

dag: Ka so yi ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ni yo ka deei li, dindina omaŋmaŋ yi nya liɣiri ka ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li.
en: If you have no relative to buy it back, you may later become prosperous and have enough to buy it back yourself.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Chamiya tiŋkpan shɛli din be yi tooni ŋɔ ha; yi yi ti paai ni, yi ni nya bunnyaŋ min o bia ka bɛ loya ka yi lɔrigi ba na.
en: with these instructions: Go to the village there ahead of you, and at once you will find a donkey tied up with her colt beside her. Untie them and bring them to me.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa dii yi Mizipa na n-kar doli Filistianim maa n-kuri ba hal ti miri Bɛtikar.
en: The Israelites marched out from Mizpah and pursued the Philistines almost as far as Bethcar, killing them along the way.

dag: N kul ni puhir a sahakam, a ni tum shɛm zuɣu. N ni duh a yuli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim sani, dama a yuli maa viɛla.
en: I will give thanks to you, God, forever, because you have acted. In the presence of your faithful people, I will hope in your name because its so good.

dag: Ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa ti laɣim o tɔbbihi m-pahi nanim pihitanaayi bɛn ʒe o nyaaŋa ni bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi n-kana ti liri Samarianima n-teei gili ba ni bɛ tuhi ba.
en: King Benhadad of Syria called his army together. He was joined by other kings with their horses and chariots, and together they marched to Samaria and attacked.

dag: Nyamiya, n paɣimi neei ya zaa. Pa bɛ ni paɣiri anzinfa shɛm la, amaa wahala ka n zaŋ buɣisi ya.
en: See, I have refined you, but not like silver; I have tested you in the furnace of misery.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa be mɔɣu ni saha shɛli maa, ka bɛ daa ti nya do so ka o kabiri dari Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: While the Israelites were in the desert, some of them saw a man gathering firewood on the Sabbath day.

dag: Ɛtan bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Azaria.
en: Ethans son was Azariah.

dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa bɔhi Ahitɔfɛl, Wuhim ti ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Then Absalom turned to Ahithophel and said, Now that we are here, what do you advise us to do.

dag: N kɔba zaa kul yimi paya. Bɛ kul kpaala bɛ nina kpa ma lihiri ma.
en: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.

dag: Ka ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Ninvuɣ suŋ la pun tin ya Naawuni Shia Kasi, ka di chɛ ka yi zaa baŋ din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: But you have had the Holy Spirit poured out on you by Christ, and so all of you know the truth.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka sariakaritib la daa tim pirinsi nti yɛli dansarika gula maa ni o yoomi Pool mini Silas bahi ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The next morning the Roman authorities sent police officers with the order, Let those men go.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ko n-dolisi kulibɔŋ bindira ni niŋ pam, ka bɛ suhiri paligi, ka niɣi mini bunsi gba nya mɔ suma ŋubi.
en: How happy everyone will be with plenty of water for the crops and safe pasture everywhere for the donkeys and cattle.

dag: Ka o daa mali ti paai yili maa ni n-zaŋ Pita mini Jɔn ni Jeemsi pah omaŋ zuɣu kpe yili maa ni, ka daa bi saɣi ni so dol o kpe naɣila bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma.
en: When he came to the house, he didnt allow anyone to enter with him except Peter, John, and James, and the childs father and mother.

dag: ka zaŋ o nudirigu nubila n-tim kpa shɛli din be o nuzaa ni maa n-zaŋ mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin.
en: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.

dag: Kaman yinyaa ni zaŋdi buɣim datɛhi labiri ka tɔri piɛma din mali lɔɣu shɛm la.
en: It's no crazier to shoot sharp and flaming arrows.

dag: Nimaani sarikanim laɣimmi be ni suhudoo; bɛ bi lan wumdi bɛ guliba tahigu.
en: Even prisoners find relief there; they no longer hear their guards shouting at them.

dag: Yawɛ n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb nyɛ nandaamba, ka chɛ ka shɛb mi nyɛ bundaannima. Ŋuna n-filindi nira, ŋuna n-lan duhiri nira.
en: Our Lord , you are the one who makes us rich or poor. You put some in high positions and bring disgrace on others.

dag: ni Bɛnaaya so ni Bɛdɛya ni Kɛluhi.
en: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim daa ti bɔr o shee chuɣu maa ni, ka bɔhir o yɛla yɛra, Ya polo ka o lee be.
en: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, Where is he.

dag: Ka buɣim daa taai bɛ salo maa sunsuuni n-di ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: fire came down on their followers and burned up those wicked people.

dag: Ka bɛ bihi maa yi zooi mɔɣu maa ni n-niŋ yaa, bɛ chanimi ka ku lan labi bɛ sani yaha.
en: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ tuma nyɔri labisi ti ka ku di li, bɛ ni wolim nya nyɔ shɛl la, bɛ ku di di nyaɣisim.
en: They wont receive the reward for their labor; they wont enjoy the wealth from their business.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus bɔh o, Ninsal yi kurigi, wula ka o lan yɛn niŋ ka bɛ dɔɣ o yaha? O ni lan tooi kpe o ma puuni ka o dɔɣ o yaha.
en: Nicodemus asked, How can a grown man ever be born a second time.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa bol o kpambal so na ti yɛl o, Cham ti zaŋ Imla bia Mikaya maa na yomyom.
en: Then Ahab called in a court official and told him to go and get Micaiah at once.

dag: Amaa lee miriya ka yi ti ŋubi binʒim, chɛliya ka di yi m-bahi tiŋgban ni kaman kom la.
en: But you must not consume any of the animals blood. Pour it out on the ground, just like water.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa chɛ ka bɛ duɣi bindira pam ti ba, ka bɛ di ka nyu n-naai, ka o chɛ ka bɛ lab kuli bɛ naa sani. Ka Sirianim daa bi lan kana ti liri Izraɛlnim yaha.
en: So the king gave them a great feast, and they ate and drank. Then the king let them go, and they returned to their master. After that, Aramean raiding parties didnt come into Israel anymore.

dag: Masia daa yihi ti dabitim ni, ka ti leei bilichinnima. Dinzuɣu ʒiɛnya viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di lan niŋya nti leei daba yaha.
en: We have freedom now, because Christ made us free. So stand strong in that freedom. Dont go back into slavery again.

dag: Dahin shɛli tinzunnim ni daa kana ti ʒi bɛ daazichi chaŋ la, dindali maa yi daa kaɣimi ʒe kpaŋa. Saamba maa ni daa kpe bɛ dunɔdaya ni nti pihi kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya bɛ ni yɛn piri Jɛrusalɛm nɛma shɛm la, yi gba daa bemi kaman bɛ ni daa be shɛm.
en: You stood there and watched as foreigners entered Jerusalem and took what they wanted. In fact, you were no better than those foreigners.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbaai nachimbil maa nuu ni n-zaŋ o yi kpaŋa nti bɔh o ashilɔni, Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka a mali ni a yɛli ma.
en: The commander took the young man aside and asked him in private, What do you want to tell me.

dag: Firawuna yuri min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba la ni daa siɣi teeku maa puuni, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka teeku maa kom lan nahi taba n-lim ba, amaa Izraɛlnim maa bɛn daa dolila teeku tiŋ kuŋ zuɣu ti du.
en: Yes, it really happened! Pharaohs horses and riders, and chariots went into the sea. And the Lord brought all the water of the sea down on top of them. But the Israelites walked through that sea on dry land.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba maa ni daa kuli naai, ka Yisa piligi tɔɣisiri salo maa Jɔn yɛla ka bɔhiri ba, Bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ mɔɣu ni ni yi ti nya la? Gbiŋgban shɛli pɔhim ni ʒɛra?.
en: After John's messengers had left, Jesus began to speak about him to the crowds: When you went out to John in the desert, what did you expect to see? A blade of grass bending in the wind?.

dag: Ti tum tuumbiɛri, ka yi Yawɛ nyaaŋa, ka zaɣisi ti Naawuni jɛmbu. Ti nahindi ti taba, ka taari duŋ. Ti nyɛla bɛn ŋmari ʒiri din yiri ti suhuri ni na.
en: We have rebelled against you, rejected you, and refused to follow you. We have oppressed others and turned away from you. Our thoughts are false; our words are lies.

dag: A ni yɛn yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛ ka n kul kumdi ni nintam yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka di bi chɛra, dama bɛ ŋme n niriba bɛn be kaman m bipuɣiŋga ŋun ʒi doo maa kurili luhi, ka bɛ nya dan titali.
en: Jeremiah, speak this message to the people of Judah: My eyes fill with tears night and day without stopping. I cry for my virgin daughter, and for my dear people, because someone hit them and crushed them. They have been hurt very badly.

dag: Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa bol o o Duuma, ka di chaŋ wula ka o ni lan nyɛ ŋun Naa Dauda yaaŋa.
en: David calls the Messiah Lord. So how can the Messiah also be Davids son.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zali sagbana din be zuɣusaa ŋɔ zaligu ka zuɣusaa dunoya daa yooi;.
en: But he spoke to the sky above and commanded its doors to open;.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma alahiziba pam. Ka Yisa daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni n-yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so din niŋ maa yɛla.
en: Her parents were surprised, but Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Wummi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: Isaiah said to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli daadamnima, Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni zɔbo n-nyɛ yɛm ka tuumbiɛri chɛbu mi nyɛ baŋsim.
en: God told us, Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.

dag: Dina n-yɛn nyɛ bɛ zaligu sahakam. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ ko shɛli din yihiri nir daɣiri ni maa mihi so, ŋun paɣim o binyɛra; ka ŋun mi shihi kom maa ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: These laws will never change. The man who sprinkled the water and the ashes on you when you were unclean must also wash his clothes. And whoever touches this water is unclean until evening.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi nini tiɣi yi yɛm pam, ka wuhi ni yi nyɛla yɛnnima.
en: They think they are so smart. They think they are very intelligent.

dag: A chɛ ka ti lu zana ni, ka a zaŋ ʒi tibisa ʒil ti.
en: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.

dag: Di bi wuhiri ni n yula pina deebu hali, amaa n lee bɔrimi ni yi nya laara pahi.
en: Really, it is not that I want to get gifts from you. But I want you to have the benefit that comes from giving.

dag: Bɛ nyarila tibiginsim saha biɛla, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛ ni suui lu n-kuui kaman vari la; ka bɛ ŋmahi bɛ zuɣuri kaman ka zuɣuri la.
en: For a while the wicked prosper, but then they wither like weeds, like stalks of grain that have been cut down.

dag: N yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ wuhirila n ʒiɛyimtali n suhu ni, ka n ni mi shɛli dina, ka n yɛn yɛli ni n suhu zaa.
en: is true and sincere.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla Hiburunima? N gba nyɛla Hiburu. Bɛ nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya? N gba nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya. Bɛ nyɛla Ibrahimma yaansi? N gba nyɛla o yaaŋa.
en: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋ doli Yawɛ zaligu shɛŋa o ni daa chɛ ka o dabili Musa zali ya la. Dina n-nyɛ: Yumiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ka tumm o yubu, ka dol o zaligunima, ka zaŋ yimaŋ tabil o, ka kul jɛmm o ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shia zaa.
en: Just be very careful to carry out the commandment and Instruction that Moses the LORDs servant commanded you. Love the LORD your God. Walk in all his ways and obey his commandments. Hold on to him and serve him with all your heart and being.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ gba benya kaman kuɣ nɛma la kana, ka Naawuni zaŋ ya me o jɛmbu duu ka yi leei Naawuni maligumaaniba bɛn be kasi, ka maani sara maligu shɛŋa Naawuni ni deeri Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: You also are like living stones, and God is using you to build a spiritual house. You are to serve God in this house as holy priests, offering him spiritual sacrifices that he will accept because of Jesus Christ.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Oi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ! Bɛ kul yɛrila n yɛla yɛra, Pa saliŋ lɔha ka o lɔhi maa? .
en: But I complained, Lord God, I don't want to do that! People already say I confuse them with my messages.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda ni Ahitɔfɛl gba pahila Absalom zuɣu. Ka Dauda yɛli, Yawɛ, n suhir a mi, chɛ ka Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛn wuhi yikombiɛlim yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa leei jɛrilim.
en: When David was told that Ahithophel had joined Absalom's rebellion, he prayed, Please, Lord , turn Ahithophel's advice into nonsense.

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, palim a ni daa lo a dabili m ba Dauda alikauli shɛli n-yɛli, Ninvuɣ so ŋun ni ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kul ku kɔŋ a zuliya ni, a bihi yi ni lihi bɛ soya viɛnyɛliŋga ka doli ma kaman a ni daa doli ma shɛm la.
en: And now, Lord God of Israel, I pray that you will also keep the other promise you made to my father when you told him that there would always be one of his descendants ruling as king of Israel, provided they obeyed you as carefully as he did.

dag: Ka Rubin daa ti chaŋ mɔɣu ni alikama chɛbu saha ti bo ŋmaankpihiga na ti ti o ma Liya. Ka Reechɛl daa yɛli Liya, N suhir a, niŋm a bia ŋmaankpihiga maa shɛli ti ma.
en: During the wheat harvest Reuben went into the fields and found some special flowers. He brought them to his mother Leah. But Rachel said to Leah, Please give me some of your sons flowers.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa ti nya do so ŋun yuli booni Ɛnias, ka o gbaya kpi ka o do tiŋa yuma anii zaa.
en: There he met a man named Aeneas, who was paralyzed and had not been able to get out of bed for the past eight years.

dag: O yuli daa duya pam ninvuɣ pihita maa ni, amaa di daa bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa yuya. Ka Dauda daa zaŋ o leei o tɔbbihi bɛn gul o zuɣulana.
en: He was outstanding among them, but was not as famous as The Three. David put him in charge of his bodyguard.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa mali shili n-kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ ni chaŋ Goshɛn ni o ti nya o ba Izraɛl. Bɛ ni daa ti nya taba, ka Yisifu chaŋ o sani nti zaŋ o nuhi m-bɔb gbaag o ba n-zaŋ o zuɣu pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu n-kum yuui.
en: So Joseph got in his chariot and went to meet his father. When they met, Joseph hugged his father around the neck and cried for a long time.

dag: amaa ninsal ku tooi maai zilinli nini. Di nyɛla din bi saɣi ni so su li, ka lan nyɛ lɔɣu ni pali shɛl ni!.
en: But no one can control the tongue. It is wild and evil, full of deadly poison.

dag: A chɛ ka pɔhim kpuɣi ma, ka chɛ ka m ba pɔhim maa, ka a tɔri ma gindi sanʒiɛɣu ni.
en: You lift me to the wind and make me ride; you melt me in its roar.

dag: Dama bɛ zaa pinila bɛ zuɣuri mini bɛ teensi, ka chihi bɛ bɔɣiri zaa chiha ka so buri.
en: The people of Moab mourn on the rooftops and in the streets. Men cut off their beards, people shave their heads; they make cuts on their hands and wear sackcloth. And it's all because I, the Lord , have shattered Moab like a jar that no one wants.

dag: Nyama, Yawɛ ni gbib buɣim kana. O chɛchɛbunsi yuri zɔbu yɛn ŋmanila pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga, ka o zaŋ li kana ti darig o suhu ni yiɣisi bahi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu tibili.
en: Look, the Lord is coming with fire. His armies are coming with clouds of dust. He is angry, and he will punish his enemies with flames.

dag: Dama m be yi sani ni n tiligi ya. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. N ni ku n-naai n ni kari ya tahi zuliya shɛb sani maa zaa balibu. Amaa yinim bɛna, n ku naai yi balibu. N kul ni darigila yi tibili kaman di ni simdi shɛm. N kul ku chɛ yi tibili darigibu.
en: I am with you and will rescue you, declares the LORD. I will put an end to all the nations where I have scattered you. But I wont put an end to you. I wont let you remain unpunished: I will discipline you as you deserve.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun tim ya n sani maa na.
en: and she told them to go back to the king and give him.

dag: N yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔnim ni di saha ti paai ka yi teei ni n daa pun yɛli ya di yɛla. N daa bi pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔnima piligu ni, ka di nyɛla n ni daa na be yi san la zuɣu.
en: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.

dag: Ka yaɣ yini yi biɛra, yaɣa maa zaa biɛrimi; ka yaɣ yini yi nya jilima, yaɣa maa zaa malila suhupiɛlli.
en: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.

dag: Zuliya kam ni zo Yawɛ yuli, ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa lu o sizuura o jilima zuɣu.
en: Our Lord , the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni ti dee li su n-ʒini di ni ka yɛli, Ti ni bo naa ka o su ti kaman zuliya kam bɛn gil ti ŋɔ ni mali nanim shɛm.
en: You will enter the land that the Lord your God is giving you. You will take that land and live in it. Then you will say, We will put a king over us, like all the nations around us.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ wain pipia n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li ti ba ka bɛ zaa nyu.
en: Jesus picked up a cup of wine and gave thanks to God. He gave it to his disciples, and they all drank some.

dag: Dinzuɣu kul gbibiya yi ni pun mali shɛl la kirikiri hal ka n ti kana.
en: But until I come, you must hold firmly to what you have.

dag: Musa daa yɛli ba, Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya bɛn zaa lo kpara ni bɛ chaŋ tɔbu ni Yawɛ ninni ŋɔ, yi doli ya gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du, ka yi ti tuhi deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, dindina yin zaŋmiya Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ti ba ka bɛ su li.
en: Moses said to them, If the Gadites and the Reubenites cross the Jordan with you, each equipped for battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you will give them the land of Gilead as a possession.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka alahichi su yi niŋgbuna din kpiri ŋɔ n-chɛ ka yi deei yi niŋgbuna maa noli tum di kɔr biɛri tuma.
en: So then, dont let sin rule your body, so that you do what it wants.

dag: Amaa yi yi na kul tumdi tuumbiɛri, dindina o ni kpihim yi mini yi naa maa zaa birili.
en: But if you continue to sin, you and your king will be destroyed.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Paɣa, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kumda? Ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ yihila n Duuma, ka m bi mi bɛ ni zaŋ o ti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: The angels asked Mary, Why are you crying? She answered, They have taken away my Lord's body! I don't know where they have put him.

dag: Ka yi gba be biɛr yoli n-gari yi yaannim maa ni daa be shɛm maa. Yinim m-bɔŋɔ: yi zaɣ yino kam niŋla tipawumli n-doli zaɣ biɛɣu soli, ka zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu.
en: But you have done even worse than your ancestors. All of you are stubborn and evil, and you do not obey me.

dag: Man Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisiya pam bahi yi yaannim zuɣu.
en: The Lord became very angry with your ancestors.

dag: O ni daa ti yiɣisi o Naawuni suhibu maa shee o daa labila o nyaandoliba maa sani nti nya ka bɛ gbihirimi, suhugarigu ni daa mali ba zuɣu.
en: When he got up from praying, he went to the disciples. He found them asleep, overcome by grief.

dag: Dinzuɣu bahim noli ka bɛ chaŋ ti guli siliga maa viɛnyɛliŋga hal ti paai daba ata maa dali, ka di chɛ ka o nyaandoliba ti ku chaŋ ti zu n-yih o ka yɛli niriba ni o neela kum ni, ka yɔhiŋgu din bahindi nyaaŋa maa ni ti bie n-gari tuuli din la.
en: Therefore, order the grave to be sealed until the third day. Otherwise, his disciples may come and steal the body and tell the people, Hes been raised from the dead. This last deception will be worse than the first.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun kura, ka lan nyɛ ŋun tiri nyɛvili. Ŋuna n-tahiri niriba kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka lan neeri ba.
en: The Lord causes people to die, and he causes them to live. He sends people down to the grave, and he can raise them up to live again.

dag: Zaŋmiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali nina ka nyɛ zoomba la na, ka zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tiba ka nyɛ tikpiranim la na.
en: Bring my people together. They have eyes and ears, but they can't see or hear.

dag: Di saha piɛri ni ti ŋubiri mɔri nimaani kaman bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee, ka piɛbihi mini bubihi ti ŋubiri mɔri dabari maa ni.
en: Lambs will graze as if in their pasture; young goats will feed among the ruins of the rich.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa zo n-chaŋ o biŋkɔbiri sani nti gbaai naɣilabil polli ŋun viɛla n-ti o tumtumda, ka o kɔrig o mal o yomyom.
en: After saying this, he rushed off to his herd of cattle and picked out one of the best calves, which his servant quickly prepared.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Di simdi ni a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi.
en: The Lord answered, What right do you have to be angry.

dag: Dauda daa nyɛla Jɛsi bia, ka Jɛsi mi nyɛ Ɛfirat daŋ ni nira, ka be Bɛtilihɛm din be Juda tiŋgban ni la. O daa malila bidibis anii. Sool ʒiɛmani maa ni Jɛsi daa kurigiya pam.
en: David was the son of Jesse. Jesse was from the Ephrathah family in Bethlehem, Judah. Jesse had eight sons. In Sauls time Jesse was an old man.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaɣisi Izraɛl daŋ niriba zaa, ka daa nahim ba, ka zaŋ ba niŋ bɛn yɛn bahi ba yoli nuu ni hal ti kari ba o sani bahi.
en: So the Lord turned his back on everyone in Israel and let them be punished and defeated until no one was left.

dag: M mali yiko ni n di niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa a ba Yisahaku Naawuni la sa yɛli ma yuŋ la, Miri ka a yɛli Yaakubu yɛtɔɣ viɛlli bee zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: and I have the power to punish you. However, your fathers God told me yesterday, Be careful and dont say anything hastily to Jacob one way or the other.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ŋmaligi zaŋ din buɣisiri maa m-buɣisi nuzaa polo, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu.
en: the north side, seven hundred fifty feet; and.

dag: Amaa o ni zaŋ kokpɛɣu naag o dimnim zaa, ka kar o dimnim maa kpɛhi zibisim ni.
en: But he will completely destroy his enemies. He will wash them away like a flood and chase them into the darkness.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, n na ʒi n-zaɣisi nandaamba sɔŋbu, bɛ yi ti be muɣisigu ni n-kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: Surely he wont strike someone in ruins if in distress he cries out to him.

dag: Shɛla ŋun daa nyɛ Juda bia la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛka ba la mini Laada ŋun daa nyɛ Marɛsha ba la ni kpalu shɛb bɛn daa be Bɛtashibia n-wuɣiri bimpiɛla la.
en: The family of Shelah, Judahs son: Er, Lecahs father; Laadah, Mareshahs father; the clans of the linen workers at Beth-ashbea.

dag: N daa tɔɣisi anabinim yɛtɔɣa ka chɛ ka bɛ nya ʒiinim pam. Mani n-daa chɛ ka anabinim maa ŋahi yɛtɔɣ ŋaha.
en: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Juda paɣ ŋun daa nyɛ Shua bipuɣiŋga la daa kpi. O ni daa mal o kuli naai nyaaŋa ka o min o zo Hira ŋun daa nyɛ Adulam nir la chaŋ Timna ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chɛr o piɛri kɔbiri la sani.
en: Some years later Judah's wife died, and he mourned for her. He then went with his friend Hirah to the town of Timnah, where his sheep were being sheared.

dag: Amaa n ni ti woligi Izraɛlnim bɛn biŋkɔbiri ka chɛ Ijiptinim biŋkɔbiri, ka Izraɛlnim maa bɛn so biŋkɔbigu ti ku kpi. .
en: But the LORD will distinguish Israels livestock from Egypts livestock so that not one that belongs to the Israelites will die.

dag: Ibram ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbigayinika saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa; doli ma, ka tummi din tuhi.
en: When Abram was years old, the Lord appeared to him again and said, I am God All-Powerful. If you obey me and always do right.

dag: Amaa nyamiya! Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ nyaannim ni ti leei toonnima, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ toonnim mi ti leei nyaannima.
en: Look! Those who are last will be first and those who are first will be last.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali binnana bee n-zaŋ dari kpe biŋŋmahima bee n-sa daantalisi bee n-zaŋ kuɣa biŋŋmahima sa yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-jɛmdi li, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: The Lord said, Do not make idols or set up statues, stone pillars, or carved stones to worship. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Amaa ti mabihi, yinim bi be zibisim ni ka dindali maa ni ti libigi ya kaman tayiɣa ni libigiri niriba shɛm la.
en: But you, friends, are not in the darkness, and the Day should not take you by surprise like a thief.

dag: Di tamya zaɣ viɛlli niŋbu yɛla, ka zaŋmiya yi ni mali shɛli sɔŋdi taba, dama dina n-nyɛ sara shɛŋa din tiɣiri Naawuni nini.
en: Do not forget to do good and to help one another, because these are the sacrifices that please God.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri mini tiliginsim shee waɣ pam, dama bɛ bi bɔri a zaligunima.
en: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ŋma dakuɣiri maa pam ti ma, dama n ni yɛn me du shɛli maa ni galisi pam ka viɛla.
en: because I'll need a lot of lumber to build such a large and glorious temple.

dag: Tahat ni Uriɛl ni Uzia ni Shaul.
en: his son Tahath, his son Uriel, his son Uzziah, and his son Shaul.

dag: ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka saa tahibu mini tiŋgbani dambu ni pɔhim biɛɣu ni buɣim biɛɣu kana nti fa a bahi.
en: the Lord All-Powerful will punish you with earthquakes, thunder, and loud noises. There will be storms, strong winds, and a burning, destructive fire.

dag: Wula ka a be kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun bi lan mi o yɛla nini, bee kaman tɔbutuhiri biiŋa ŋun ku tooi sɔŋ so maa? Amaa nyini Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be ti sani. Ti nyɛla a niriba, di zaŋ ti bahi.
en: You seem like a man who has been attacked by surprise, like a soldier who does not have the power to save anyone. But, Lord , you are with us. We are called by your name, so dont leave us without help.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, N dana, a tiligi ti nyɛviya; ka di yi niŋ a nyaɣisim, ti ni leei Firawuna daba.
en: The people said, You have saved our lives. We are happy to be slaves to Pharaoh.

dag: A ni zaŋ binshɛli biri maa kul nyɛla bimbiɛlli ka pa ni bimbilli maŋmaŋa, di pa shɛli di ni nyɛla kabiɛlli bee bimbiɛl shɛli.
en: And what you plant is a bare seed, perhaps a grain of wheat or some other grain, not the full-bodied plant that will later grow up.

dag: Ka Dauda daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa zali o ni daa mali luɣ shɛli zal li maa.
en: David told all the Israelites to meet together at Jerusalem to see the Lord s Holy Box carried to the place he had made for it.

dag: Musa ni daa zaŋ fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim m-bɔŋɔ;.
en: Moses gave Gods law to the Israelites.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn bahila yoli zama laɣiŋgu ni.
en: And suddenly I found myself publicly disgraced.

dag: Amaa o yiko pam maa puuni, o nam maa ni ti wurim m-pirigi ʒii bunahi. Ka nanim bɛn bi yi o zuliya ni na ni ti deeg o nam maa di n-zan o zaani, amaa ka bɛ lee ti ku mali yiko shɛli o ni daa mali maa tatabo.
en: But at the height of his power his empire will break up and be divided into four parts. Kings not descended from him will rule in his place, but they will not have the power that he had.

dag: ka zaɣisi n saɣisigunima, ka lihi ʒiɛm n ni kpahi yi zuɣu ni shɛm la zuɣu.
en: You have never wanted my advice or paid any attention when I corrected you.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Amaa yi yi ti nya ka tɔbbihi teei gili Jɛrusalɛm, yin baŋmiya ni di wurimbu saha miriya.
en: You will see armies all around Jerusalem. Then you will know that the time for its destruction has come.

dag: Yawɛ suhu piɛl o niriba zuɣu pam. O tiri bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋ nasara.
en: The Lord is happy with his people. He did a wonderful thing for his humble people. He saved them!.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb daa chaŋ Farisiinim sani ti yɛli ba Yisa ni tum shɛm maa.
en: Others went to the Pharisees and told what Jesus had done.

dag: O ni daa ti nya o, ka o zaŋ o lab Antiɔk. Ka bɛ daa be nimaani Yisa nyaandoliba sani yuun muni zaa n-wuhiri niriba pam Naawuni yɛligu. Antiɔk maa ka bɛ daa tuui boli Yisa nyaandoliba Kristiɛnnima.
en: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.

dag: ka di be kaman taŋkpa balli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni n-chɛ ka bintɔra din puhigiri niŋdi yuma tɔri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: This will become dust that will go throughout the land of Egypt. Whenever the dust touches a person or an animal in Egypt, sores will break out on the skin.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be tiŋ shɛŋa ni n-daa nyɛ: Bɛrishiiba mini Molada ni Hazarishual.
en: They lived in Beer-sheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔɣi ma, ka zoya na kani, ka daboya gba na kani.
en: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills, I was brought forth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Dum Abarim zoya din pie tab ŋɔ zuɣu ti nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim maa.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Go up this mountain, Abarim, and look at the land that Ive given to the Israelites.

dag: Ti paɣiri Zallakudura Naa ŋun chɛ ka a nyaŋ a dimnim ŋɔ! Ka Ibram daa zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa pia puuni zaɣ yiniyini yihi Mɛlikizɛdɛk zaka.
en: And we praise God Most High, who helped you defeat your enemies. Abram gave Melchizedek one-tenth of everything he had taken during the battle.

dag: A malila ninsal nina? A nyarila binyɛra kaman ninsalinim ni nyari shɛm?.
en: Do you look at things the way we humans do?.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam li pa teeku zuɣu, ka chɛ ka di pa mɔɣa zuɣu.
en: He built the earth on the water. He built it over the rivers.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii yiɣisi di saha maa lab Jɛrusalɛm nti nya ka Yisa tuumba piniyini maa mini ninvuɣ shɛb laɣim ʒiya.
en: So the two men got up then and went back to Jerusalem. There they found the followers of Jesus meeting together. The eleven apostles and the people with them.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni darigi bɛ tibili; bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ nachimba, ka kum ku bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi.
en: So the Lord Almighty said, I will punish them! Their young men will be killed in war; their children will die of starvation.

dag: O maani ansarisimaaniba ansarisi, amaa ka niŋdi tarimba nirilim.
en: He has no use for conceited people, but shows favor to those who are humble.

dag: Hal o yi kari ma o tuma maa ni pumpɔŋɔ, m mi n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka m mini niriba be.
en: I know what I will do! I will do something to make friends, so that when I lose my job, they will welcome me into their homes.

dag: N dooni gbihira, ka lan yirisira, dama Yawɛ n-guli ma.
en: I lie down, sleep, and wake up because the LORD helps me.

dag: Ti Duuma kul yɛn zaɣisi ti mi pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chani ka kul ku lan niŋ ti nirilim sahakam?.
en: Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni niŋ a ni lo ma alikauli ni a ni niŋ shɛlikam ti ma. Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam. Di zaŋ a nuhi tuma bahi.
en: The LORD will do all this for my sake. Your faithful love lasts forever, LORD! Dont let go of what your hands have made.

dag: Ka a ti lan mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi nyolɔrigu maa puuni naŋgbambiya, ka di miri binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa.
en: Then make two rings of gold and attach them to the lower corners of the breastpiece on the inside edge next to the ephod.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa tim tuumba Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa zaa sani nti bɔhi ba, Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka yi lee tum la?.
en: The tribes of Israel sent messengers to every town and village in Benjamin. And wherever the messengers went, they said, How could those worthless men in Gibeah do such a disgusting thing?.

dag: N je tuumbiɛtumdiba; ka m mi bi ʒiini ninvuɣ biɛri sani.
en: I hate being around evil people. I refuse to join those gangs of crooks.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa zaa daa labi Giligal sansani maa ni.
en: Then Joshua along with all Israel came back to the camp at Gilgal.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, A kul ku paɣi n naba hal abada. Ka Yisa yɛl o, N yi bi paɣi a naba maa, shɛl lan ka m min a sunsuuni.
en: No! Peter said. You will never wash my feet! Jesus replied, Unless I wash you, you wont have a place with me.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, Naawuni ni deei ŋun Naawuni nam yi sani n-zaŋ li ti zuliya shɛb bɛn ni wali o nam maa wala. .
en: So I tell you that Gods kingdom will be taken away from you. It will be given to people who do what God wants in his kingdom.

dag: Dunɔguliba maa daa ʒiɛla luɣ anahi zuɣu, wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili ni nuzaa ni nudirigu polo.
en: The gatekeepers were on the four sides: east, west, north, and south.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn bolila zuliya shɛb bɛn be nuzaa polo ŋɔ nanima, ka bɛ zaa kana ti kpa bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdaya gbini. Bɛ ni ti teei gili di goondahi din gil li la mini Juda fɔntinsi zaa.
en: because I am calling all the nations in the north to come. Their kings will set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem and around its walls and also around the other cities of Judah.

dag: Kul leemiya jɛra! Kul leemiya zoomba! Buɣimiya n-chani laana, ka bi nyu wain bee binnyuri kpɛma!.
en: Be shocked and stunned, you prophets! Refuse to see. Get drunk and stagger, but not from wine.

dag: Amaa ka Sihɔn daa zaɣisi ni Izraɛlnim di kpe o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gari. O daa laɣimla o tɔbbihi zaa n-chaŋ Jahaz din daa be yɔɣu maa ni la nti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: But Sihon would not permit the people of Israel to pass through his territory. He gathered his army and went out to Jahaz in the wilderness and attacked the Israelites.

dag: Bɛ daa tam Naawuni ŋun nyɛ bɛ tiligira, ka lan nyɛ ŋun daa tum tuun kara Ijipti la yɛla.
en: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you.

dag: N Naawuni, tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni; fam ma bɛn yiɣisi wuɣili n zuɣu la nuu ni bahi.
en: Save me, God! Protect me from enemy attacks!.

dag: Dabisi shɛli din pahir anahi dali ka bɛ daa laɣim Bɛraka Vinvamli ni, dama nimaani ka bɛ daa paɣi Yawɛ. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani Bɛraka Vinvamli hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: On the fourth day they assembled in Beracah Valley and praised the Lord for all he had done. That is why the valley is called Beracah.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, tinim tɔɣisirila ti ni mi shɛli yɛla, ka diri ti nini ni nya shɛli shɛhira; amaa ka yi bi niŋdi ti shɛhira maa yɛda.
en: I am telling you the truth: we speak of what we know and report what we have seen, yet none of you is willing to accept our message.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kahi kuɣa m-pa Akan zuɣu hal ti duhi li sɔŋ, ka di na kul do nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Akɔr Vinvamli hal ni zuŋɔ. Ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa daa naanyi maai.
en: They covered the remains with a big pile of rocks, which is still there. Then the Lord stopped being angry with Israel. That's how the place came to be called Trouble Valley.

dag: A ni sɔɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Zallakudura Naa sani ka zaŋ o leeg a biɛhigu shee la zuɣu.
en: You have made the Lord your defender, the Most High your protector.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim bunu ka Yɛhudianim fiɛb ma barazim pihinahiyinikaka.
en: I received the forty lashes minus one from the Jews five times.

dag: Dinzuɣu bomiya nya o ni sɔɣiri luɣ shɛŋa zaa ka labina ti yɛli ma yɛlimaŋli, ka m mini ya chaŋ; ŋun dee yi be tiŋgbani maa ni, n ni bɔ o shee Judanim zaa niriba tusatusa puuni.
en: Find out exactly the places where he hides, and be sure to bring back a report to me right away. Then I will go with you, and if he is still in the region, I will hunt him down, even if I have to search the whole land of Judah.

dag: Amaa yinim ŋmaligimiya labi yi nyaaŋa kpe tiŋgban nɛl ni zaŋ labi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo.
en: Now, turn around and go back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, labimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, dama yi tuumbiɛri zuɣu ka yi daa tuui lu.
en: Israel, you fell and sinned against God. So come back to the Lord your God.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa wurim nimaani, ka sokam lab omaŋmaŋ daŋ niriba min o malibu sani, ka bɛ daa yi nimaani lab bɛ ni su tiŋgban shɛŋa ni.
en: Then the Israelites went home. They went to their own land and tribe.

dag: Yi nyɛla ninvuɣ gahinda, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi n sani. Miriya ka yi ŋubi mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni ku binshɛli, di simdi ni yi zaŋ li tila bahi.
en: You are my special people. So dont eat the meat from something that was killed by wild animals. Let the dogs eat that dead animal.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana n-yɛra, Gbuɣinli be sol ni, gbuɣinli be solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: A lazy person says, Theres a lion in the path! A lion in the plazas.

dag: ka Annas mini Kaiafas mi daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulaannima. Di saha maa ka Naawuni zilinli daa ti paai Zakaria bia Jɔn ŋun daa be mɔɣu ni la.
en: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas—Gods word came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness.

dag: Ka niriba pam tah o zuɣu ni o foma; amaa ka o maan kuhi pam yɛli, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: Many of the people scolded him and told him to be quiet. But he shouted even more loudly, Son of David, have mercy on me.

dag: ka malimiya sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabil yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi.
en: Present a burnt offering to the Lord , an odor pleasing to him: one young bull, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all without any defects.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Mbusim be n zuɣu, n lan ka tahima, dama yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-yiri n nol ni na, ka m mini yɛtɔɣ biɛri ni yiri ninvuɣ shɛb noya ni na laɣim be; amaa ka n nini nya naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: I said, Mourn for me; Im ruined! Im a man with unclean lips, and I live among a people with unclean lips. Yet Ive seen the king, the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: So ka ti sunsuuni ŋun ni tooi gooi ti.
en: I wish there were someone who could listen to both sides, someone to judge both of us in a fair way.

dag: N ni sabiri shɛli ŋɔ puuni, n niŋ naani ni a ni niŋ n ni suh a ni a niŋ shɛli ŋɔ hal n-niŋ li yaɣi lala zuɣu gba.
en: Im writing to you, confident of your obedience and knowing that you will do more than what I ask.

dag: Amaa man ni mali shɛli nyɛla, a chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn be Dan zaŋ hal ni Bɛrishiiba zaa laɣim a sanna kaman teeku noli bihigu la, ka a maŋmaŋ yina n-gari tooni zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: This is what I suggest: You must gather all the Israelites together from Dan to Beersheba. Then there will be many people, like the sand by the sea. Then you yourself must go into the battle.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni, ŋun zaŋm omaŋa n-leei yi zaa ha bia.
en: Whoever is the greatest should be the servant of the others.

dag: N ŋmanila tikpiralana, m bi tooi wumda, ka ŋmani birigu ŋun ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa.
en: But Im like someone who is deaf, who cant hear; like someone who cant speak, whose mouth wont open.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yiɣisi kpe duu, ka anab bil maa ti booi kpam maa bah o zuɣu ni ka yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, M boola kpam ŋɔ bah a zuɣu ni ni a leei n niriba Izraɛlnim naa;.
en: So Jehu got up and went inside. The prophet then poured oil on his head and said to him, This is what the LORD, Israels God, says: I anoint you king over the LORDs people, over Israel.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri karimbaani puuni bɛ niŋdi nandaamba alaka. Chɛ ka bɛ ni bari tɔn shɛŋa ŋmaligi gbahi ba.
en: The wicked are proud and persecute the poor; catch them in the traps they have made.

dag: Zomiya yi Babilɔn, ka zo n-yi Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-be kaman bulahi m-be tooni mali bɛ tab chan la.
en: Now wander far from Babylon. Get out of that country. Like rams of the flock, lead the way home.

dag: Bɛn daŋ niriba galisi, nyin pirigim pal titali ti ba, ka bɛn mi daŋ niriba pɔra, nyin pirigim palo din pɔri ti ba. Tim daŋ kam niriba bɛ tarili ni nyɛ shɛli kaman bɛ ni sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Divide the land by drawing lots, and give a large share to a large tribe and a small one to a small tribe.

dag: Ŋunkam ku biŋkɔbigu, ŋun bom biŋkɔb so yo o samli; nyɛvili la nyɛvili.
en: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kɔrigi naɣilaa maa, ka zaŋ bia maa mi chaŋ ti ti Ɛli.
en: After they had killed the bull, they took the child to Eli.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Pa sokam zaa n-ni tooi doli dimbɔŋɔ naɣila Naawuni ni zaŋ lala ti shɛba.
en: He answered, This statement is true for some, but not for everyone—only for those who have been given this gift.

dag: A yi ti nya bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ tuma, a ni baŋ ni n ni daa niŋ shɛlikam maa, pa yoli ka n daa niŋ lala di ni maa, ka a suhu ni maai. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will see how they live and all the bad things they do. Then you will know that I had a good reason for punishing them. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Yi vinvam shɛŋa din mali kulim puuni zaa daa palila chɛchɛbunsi, ka wɔribariba ʒe dunɔdaya ni.
en: Your finest valleys were filled with chariots, and horsemen doggedly guarded the gate.

dag: Ka o daa ti lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna ti nya ka bɛ gbihirimi ka o bɔhi Pita, Yi ku tooi gali gom biɛla n zuɣu?.
en: He came back and found his disciples sleeping. So he said to Peter, Can't any of you stay awake with me for just one hour?.

dag: ni noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ ni teeku ni zahim ni binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun be teeku ni.
en: They rule over the birds in the sky and the fish that swim in the sea.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋunkam yɛn nyu bara, ŋun nyum li la ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: Whoever boasts should boast only about the Lord.

dag: Ka o kpamba daa yi o nyaaŋa n-ku o o yiŋa.
en: His servants made plans against him. They killed Amon in his own house.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔhi Naawuni, N na doli Filistianim maa? A ni zaŋ ba niŋ Izraɛlnim nuu ni? Amaa ka o bi garig o dindali maa.
en: So Saul questioned God: Should I go after the Philistines? Will you hand them over to Israel? But God did not answer him that day.

dag: Di chɛ ka tuun biɛ shɛli nyaŋ a, amaa nyin zaŋmi zaɣ suŋ niŋbu nyaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.

dag: Ka Musa daa garigi yɛl o deemba maa, Niriba maa kanimina ni bɛ ti bɔhi baŋ Naawuni yɛla.
en: Moses said to his father-in-law, Because the people come to me to inquire of God.

dag: A dolila a biɛli naba, dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ o pipia maa gbibil a.
en: You have turned out no better than your older sister, and now you must drink from the cup filled with my anger.

dag: O kalinsi nyaaŋa ka o bia Amazia daa di nam zan o zaani. Bɛ sabi o bidibisi yɛla mini bɛ ni daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa pam jɛnd o la ni o ni daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu me shɛm la, niŋ Nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: The list of Jehoashs sons, the many prophecies against him, and the account of his restoration of Gods temple are written in the comments on the records of the kings. His son Amaziah succeeded him as king.

dag: Hal tɔbbihi yi teei gili ma, n ku zo dabiɛm; ka hal bɛ ni kul lo tɔbu na ti liri ma maa zaa yoli, n kul ni niŋ naani.
en: If an army camps against me, my heart wont be afraid. If war comes up against me, I will continue to trust in this.

dag: Hɔrinim nanima n-daa nyɛ: Lɔtan mini Shɔbal ni Zibiɔn ni Ana.
en: These are the Horite tribal chiefs: Chiefs Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah.

dag: ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o, ka o neei kum ni daba ata dali kaman Naawuni Kundi ni wuhi shɛm.
en: that he was buried and was raised to life on the third day, as the Scriptures say;.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla nyin Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu. Naawuni, ka bɔ saha ka n yɛn kana ti nya a ninni?.
en: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?.

dag: Bɛ nol ni yɛtɔɣa zuɣu, o ni chɛ ka bɛ bahi ba yoli zaa, ka bɛnkam zaa nya ba, dabiɛm gbahiri ba mi, ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔhi Yisa, Karimba, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn niŋ, ka shihir bɔ nti yɛn wuhi dimbɔŋɔnim niŋbu saha.
en: Some people asked, Teacher, when will all this happen? How can we know when these things are about to take place.

dag: A ni tooi baŋ Naawuni tɛha din zilim ŋɔ? A ni tooi baŋ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ yɛm tariga?.
en: Can you understand the mysteries surrounding God All-Powerful?.

dag: Ka doo maa yi taali ni, amaa ka paɣ maa ŋun taali ʒi o zuɣu.
en: The husband shall be free of guilt, but the woman, if guilty, must suffer the consequences.

dag: Kul kpaŋmiya yimaŋ chɛ ka suhudoo be yi mini sokam sunsuuni, ka maliya Naawuni biɛrikasitali din nyɛ nir ni ka shɛli ka ku tooi nya ti Duuma la.
en: Try to be at peace with everyone, and try to live a holy life, because no one will see the Lord without it.

dag: dama niriba pam ni ti zaŋ n yuli kana ti yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Bɛ ni ti birigi niriba pam.
en: Many people will come and use my name. They will say, I am the Messiah. And they will fool many people.

dag: Dama naa ni wum n fabila maa ka fa m mini m bia ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔr ni o ku ti n-kpihim ti birili Naawuni ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti ŋɔ ni la nuu ni bahi.
en: The king will listen to me and save me from the man who wants to kill me and my son. That man just wants to keep us from getting what God gave us.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni daa duh o pam zaŋ o ʒili jilima ʒiishee, ka ti o yuli din tibisi gari yuli kam.
en: Therefore, God highly honored him and gave him a name above all names.

dag: A malila ninsal nina? A nyarila binyɛra kaman ninsalinim ni nyari shɛm?.
en: Do you see things as we do?.

dag: Chɛ ka ti bidibisi zoori kaman tipola din zoori ni kpiɔŋ la, ka ti bipuɣinsi mi be kaman nayili zɔŋ daantalisi la.
en: May our sons be as strong as trees and our daughters as beautiful as the carved columns of a palace.

dag: O tuumba pinaayi maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la min o tizo Anduru ni Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi min o tizo Jɔn ni.
en: These are the names of the twelve apostles: Simon , Andrew, the brother of Peter, James, the son of Zebedee, John, the brother of James.

dag: ka m mi yi bɔhi ya, yi ku garigi ma.
en: And if I ask you a question, you wont answer.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛli Mikal, Yawɛ ŋun daa pii ma ka duhi ma gar a ba min o yiŋnim zaa, ka zaŋ ma leei nabia ni n su Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ ŋun Yawɛ niriba ŋɔ tooni ka n di wari waa maa, ka di simdi ni m mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni.
en: David answered, I was dancing to honor the Lord , who chose me instead of your father and his family to make me the leader of his people Israel. And I will go on dancing to honor the Lord .

dag: Niriba pam ni nyuri bara dunia ŋɔ binyara zuɣu shɛm, n gba ni nyu bara lala.
en: Since so many people are bragging based on human standards, that is how Im going to brag too.

dag: Di yi pa lala, o na kpee maa yi ti na be katiŋ kanna o ni tim ti balim o ni o chɛ ka bɛ ku zabili maa.
en: And if he didnt think he could win, he would send a representative to discuss terms of peace while his enemy was still a long way off.

dag: ka yɛl o, Cham Sailom biaŋ ni ti paɣ a nina maa. Ka o chaŋ ti paɣ o nina maa, ka di dii neei, ka o labina.
en: and told him, Go and wash your face in the Pool of Siloam. So the man went, washed his face, and came back seeing.

dag: Ka yili maa ni bipuɣiŋga ŋun daa guli dunoli maa bɔhi Pita, A pala doo ŋɔ nyaandoliba ni yino? Ka Pita garigi yɛl o, M pala o nyaandola.
en: The girl at the gate said to Peter, Are you also one of the followers of that man? Peter answered, No, I am not.

dag: Dinzuɣu yihimiya biɛr biɛɣu zaa mini yɛmbimbiɛri ni bilikɔnsi ni nyuli zabbu zaa ni munaafichi niŋbu zaa yi biɛhigu ni.
en: Rid yourselves, then, of all evil; no more lying or hypocrisy or jealousy or insulting language.

dag: Di saha tiŋ maa dɔbba zaa bɛn labim o kuɣa ku o. Lala ka yi ni niŋ n-yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni, ka Izraɛlnim zaa wum di yɛla ka dabiɛm gbahi ba.
en: Then all the people of that town will stone him until he dies. Remove such evil from your community! All Israel will hear about this and be afraid.

dag: o naan zo dilan nambɔɣu ka yɛli, Famiy o bahi, ka o ku siɣi gballi ni; dama n nya soli ni n fa o bahi.
en: In mercy the angel will say, Release them! They are not to go down to the world of the dead. Here is the ransom to set them free.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa chaŋ Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, M ba mini m biɛyanim zaŋ bɛ piɛri mini bɛ niɣi ni bɛ ni su shɛlikam yi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, bɛ be Goshɛn tiŋgban ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Joseph went to inform Pharaoh and said, My father and brothers with their flocks, herds, and everything they own have come from the land of Canaan and are now in the land of Goshen.

dag: Dama yi yi ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ sani, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa gbahi yi mabihi mini yi bihi la ni zo ba nambɔɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ labi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔra, ka yi yi lab o sani, o ku zaɣisi ya.
en: and the enemies that have captured your families will show pity and send them back home. The Lord God is kind and merciful, and if you turn back to him, he will no longer turn his back on you.

dag: ka n yi daa mali suhupiɛlli m buni ni galisi pam zuɣu, bee n ni zaŋ n nuhi tum tuma n-nya binshɛli pam zuɣu.
en: if Ive rejoiced because my wealth was great, when my hand found plenty.

dag: Niŋmiya ma yɛda ni m be m Ba maa ni ka m Ba gba be n ni; ka di yi pa lala, yin niŋmiya ma yɛda n tuma zuɣu.
en: Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me. Or believe because of the miracles I have done.

dag: Ka din pahi pinaayɔbu daa gbaai Hanania min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Sixteenth, there were men chosen from Hananiahs sons and relatives.

dag: Ka anabinim maa zaa daa tɔɣisi bɛ daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛl lala. Bɛ daa yɛl o mi, Cham Ramɔtigiliad nti tuhi di nasara; Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba niŋ nyin naa nuu ni.
en: All the other prophets agreed with Zedekiah and said, Your army should march now to go fight against the Arameans at Ramoth Gilead. You will win the battle. The Lord will let you defeat them.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa, Saɣisimiya miri ma na. Ka bɛ daa saɣisi mir o. Ka o yɛli ba, Mani yi tizo Yisifu so yi ni daa zaŋ kɔhi Ijipti ŋɔ la m-bala.
en: Joseph said to his brothers, Come closer to me, and they moved closer. He said, Im your brother Joseph! The one you sold to Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kul kpaŋdi mmaŋa n-tumdi din tuhi ni di chɛ ka n ku mali galimi n suhu tɛha ni Naawuni mini salinim sani.
en: On account of this, I have committed myself to maintaining a clear conscience before God and with all people.

dag: Zaŋmiya li na nti yɛli ti ashili yɛl shɛŋa din yɛn niŋ. Yɛlimiya ti kurimbuni ha yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ti zahim li nya din yɛn niŋ di puuni bee wuhimiya ti ashili yɛl shɛŋa din yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha.
en: Come here and predict what will happen, so that we will know it when it takes place. Explain to the court the events of the past, and tell us what they mean.

dag: Timiya ti naɣilah ayi, ka chɛ ka bɛ pii naɣila yino kɔrigi ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o pa dari zuɣu, ka di niŋ buɣim niŋ li; ka n gba kɔrigi naɣila ŋun la ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o pa dari zuɣu ka ku niŋ buɣim niŋ li.
en: Bring us two bulls. Baal's prophets can take one of them, kill it, and cut it into pieces. Then they can put the meat on the wood without lighting the fire. I will do the same thing with the other bull, and I won't light a fire under it either.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu ka naanyi ŋmaligi chaŋ.
en: After Jesus blessed the children, he left there.

dag: Di simdi ni paɣiba shini baalim, ka bɔhim baŋ din tuhi maŋsiɣisibu puuni.
en: A wife should learn quietly with complete submission.

dag: Naawuni ni daa saɣindi vinvamli ni tinsi maa saha shɛli maa, ka o daa teei Ibrahimma yɛla, ka yihi Lɔt o ni daa saɣindi tin shɛŋa din nyɛ Lɔt ni daa ʒi luɣ shɛl la n-tilig o.
en: When God destroyed the cities in the valley, God remembered Abraham and sent Lot away from the disaster that overtook the cities in which Lot had lived.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋm a mabihi bɛn nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ka nyɛ a daŋ niriba la na ka bɛ ti pah a zuɣu n-sɔŋd a min a bidibisi maa saha shɛli yi yi ti be alikauli suɣili maa gbini tumdi tuma.
en: Bring with you your brothers from the tribe of Levi, your fathers tribe, so that they can assist you and serve you and your sons before the covenant tent.

dag: Yi ni tooi zaŋ biŋkɔb so ŋun kpi o zuɣu biŋkpam bee mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni gbaai biŋkɔb so biŋkpam tum tuun shɛli, amaa miriya ka yi ŋub li.
en: If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it.

dag: Dinzuɣu n dana, yɛlim a tumtumdib zaa bɛn be a sani ŋɔ ni bɛ lihim nya ninvuɣ so ŋun mi mɔɣilo ŋmɛbu viɛnyɛliŋga ti a, ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka alizin biɛ so kana ti muɣisir a maa yi ti lan siɣ a zuɣu na, ka dilan ŋme mɔɣilo maa, a ni nya amaŋa.
en: So give us the order, sir, and we will look for a man who knows how to play the harp. Then when the evil spirit comes on you, the man can play his harp, and you will be all right again.

dag: Amaa nyamiya, m mini ŋun yɛn yi n nyaaŋa maa n-laɣim ʒi teebuli gbini diri ŋɔ.
en: But, look! The one who betrays me is here at the table with me!.

dag: Wuhim ti a yurilim maŋli la asiba, din ni chɛ ka ti yili suhupiɛlli yila, ka ti suhuri piɛli ti dabisa zaa ni.
en: Fill us with your love every morning. Let us be happy and enjoy our lives.

dag: Bee m mini Baanabas kɔŋko n-ka soli ni ti chɛ ti nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuma tum dihi timaŋa?.
en: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?.

dag: Bɛ ni zaɣisi yɛlimaŋli wumbu ka zaŋ bɛ zaɣa niŋla kurimbuni ha lahibaya din pa yɛlimaŋli ni.
en: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yiɣisi asiba n-yɛli Balak kpamba maa, Labimiya kuli yi ya, dama Yawɛ zaɣisiya ni n di doli ya chaŋ.
en: The next morning Balaam went to Balak's messengers and said, Go back home; the Lord has refused to let me go with you.

dag: Ka yi zaŋ bulaa mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu, ka zaŋ piɛlabihi ayi bɛn paai yuun yini m-mali suhudoo sara.
en: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering and two one-year-old male lambs as a fellowship offering.

dag: O darigiri bɛ tibili ka niriba nyara bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu;.
en: He will punish them for the evil they have done, and he will do it where everyone can see.

dag: Muɣisigu yi ti paai ba ka bɛ kuhira, Naawuni ni sɔŋ ba?.
en: Will God hear their cries when distress comes to them.

dag: Ŋmaligim a nini ka chɛ n daalahichi, ka kpihim n tuumbiɛri zaa.
en: Close your eyes to my sins and wipe out all my evil.

dag: ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ yabiga gari wain shɛl ni ti o ni o nyu; amaa ka o lam li ka zaɣisi li nyubu.
en: There they offered Jesus wine mixed with a bitter substance; but after tasting it, he would not drink it.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o dolila adiini soli ka bi gbib o zilinli, o yɔhindila omaŋa o suhu ni, ka o daadiini soli dolibu nyɛla yoli.
en: Do any of you think you are religious? If you do not control your tongue, your religion is worthless and you deceive yourself.

dag: Luk kɔŋko n-kul kpalim be n sani. Zaŋm Maak m-pah amaŋ zuɣu kana, dama o nyɛla ŋun tooi sɔŋdi ma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Luke is the only one still with me. Get Mark and bring him with you when you come. He can help me in my work here.

dag: ni nintuhi ni nyee nintuhi.
en: the rings they wear on their fingers and in their noses;.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan zaŋ o yɛligu ti Hagai m-pahi buyi kulla gol yino maa biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali n-yɛl o.
en: And the LORDs word came to Haggai a second time on the twenty-fourth of the month, saying.

dag: ni Shabɛtai mini Jɔzabad bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn su Naawuni jɛmbu duu Samban ni tuma fukumsi la.
en: Shabbethai and Jozabad .

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ di gula, ka yɔɣiri li kom sahakam. N kul gul li mi yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka so ku tooi niŋ li shɛli.
en: I, the Lord , will care for the vineyard. I will water it at the right time. I will guard it day and night. No one will hurt it.

dag: A biɛli n-nyɛ Samaria ŋun min o bipuɣinsi be a nuzaa polo la, ka a tizo nyɛ Sɔdom ŋun min o bipuɣinsi be a nudirigu polo la.
en: Your older sister is Samaria, who lives with her daughters in the north. Your younger sister is Sodom, who lives with her daughters in the south.

dag: Di saha ka Naa maa ni ti yɛli bɛn ʒe o nudirigu polo la, Yinim bɛn mal alibarika m Ba Naawuni sani ŋɔ, kamiyana ti di nam shɛli o ni daa pun zaŋ zali ya tum dunia piligu ni la ha.
en: Then the king will say to the godly people on his right, Come, my Father has great blessings for you. The kingdom he promised is now yours. It has been prepared for you since the world was made.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Malimiya yimaŋa, dama biɛɣuni Yawɛ sa ni tum alahiziba tuma yi sani.
en: Then Joshua told the people, Make yourselves pure. Tomorrow the Lord will do amazing things among us.

dag: ka o ti niŋ ni biɛɣ pihinahi; ka Sintani daa ti zahim o. Yisa daa bi di shɛli di dabisa maa ni, ka di dabisa maa daa ti gari ka kum wum o.
en: For days Jesus was tested by the devil, and during that time he went without eating. When it was all over, he was hungry.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yaa ka wɔɣawɔɣa, ka nyɛ Anaki zuliya bɛn nyɛ yi ni pun mi shɛb la. Yi pun wum ka niriba yɛri bɛ yɛla, Ŋuni n-leei ni tooi zani Anakinim tooni.
en: These people are large and tall—they are the Anakim. You know and have heard what people say: Who can stand up to the Anakim.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro maa m-paɣi Naawuni di zuɣu, ka zaŋ li tari salo maa; ka lan niŋ zahim la gba lala hal ka bɛ zaa ti nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛm tariga.
en: Jesus took the loaves of bread and gave thanks for them. Then he gave them to the people who were waiting to eat. He did the same with the fish. He gave them as much as they wanted.

dag: O miri ka o ti chaŋ nir ni kpi n-do luɣ shɛli. O miri ka o saɣim omaŋa, hal di yi nyɛla o ba bee o ma.
en: He must not make himself unclean by touching a dead body. He must not go near a dead body, even if it is his own father or mother.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa daa zaŋ o mabia Ɛliakim leei Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm naa, ka taɣ o yuli m-bol o Jɛhoyakim; amaa ka daa zaŋ Jɛhoyakim mabia Jɛhɔahaz kuli Ijipti.
en: Then the king of Egypt made Jehoahazs brother Eliakim king of Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Neco took his brother Jehoahaz prisoner and carried him off to Egypt.

dag: Dama naa yɛtɔɣa mali kpiɔŋ pam, ka so ku tooi ŋme o naŋgbankpeeni.
en: The king acts with authority, and no one can challenge what he does.

dag: Jɔn nyaandoliba maa ni daa kuli naai, ka Yisa piligi tɔɣisiri salo maa Jɔn yɛla ka bɔhiri ba, Bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ni yi ti nya la? Gbiŋgban shɛli pɔhim ni ʒɛra?.
en: While John's disciples were leaving, Jesus spoke about him to the crowds: When you went out to John in the desert, what did you expect to see? A blade of grass bending in the wind?.

dag: Amaa o yiko pam maa puuni, o nam maa ni ti wurim m-pirigi ʒii bunahi. Ka nanim bɛn bi yi o zuliya ni na ni ti deeg o nam maa di n-zan o zaani, amaa ka bɛ lee ti ku mali yiko shɛli o ni daa mali maa tatabo.
en: But even as he takes control, his kingdom will be broken, divided to the four winds of heaven. It wont pass to his descendants. No one will rule like he did because his kingdom will be uprooted. It will belong to others, not to these.

dag: Zimiri ni daa baŋ ni bɛ nyaŋ bɛ tiŋ maa nim maa, ka o daa du nayili birini nti niŋ buɣim nyo nayili maa, ka di di n-ku omaŋmaŋa.
en: When Zimri saw that the town was captured, he ran into the strongest part of the palace and killed himself by setting it on fire.

dag: Ka n ŋubirila naɣilahi nimdi bee n nyurila buhi ʒim?.
en: Do I eat bulls meat? Do I drink goats blood?.

dag: Ka o paɣ Zipɔra daa bo kuɣili din dira n-gun o bidibiga, ka zaŋ di ʒim ʒe Musa naba ka yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ, a nyɛla n yidana ni yɛlimaŋli ʒim yihibu puuni.
en: But Zipporah took a flint knife and circumcised her son. She took the skin and touched his feet. Then she said to Moses, You are a bridegroom of blood to me.

dag: Mɛtusɛla ni daa paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihiniinaayopɔin saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Lamɛk.
en: After Methuselah was years old, he had a son named Lamech.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa yɛl o, Labisim a takɔb maa su di tɔɣu ni, dama ŋunkam ŋoori takɔbi ti kpirila takɔb kum.
en: Jesus said to the man, Put your sword back in its place. People who use swords will be killed with swords.

dag: Ka tumtumdiba maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Sool Dauda ni yɛli shɛm.
en: The officials went back to Saul and told him exactly what David had said.

dag: Ka tiŋgbani daa sɔŋ paɣ maa bɔɣi, ka waɣ titali maa ni daa tuhi ko shɛli o nol ni na ka di be kaman mɔɣili kom maa zɔna ti kpe di ni, ka di nyu di zaa.
en: But the earth helped the woman. The earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river that came from the mouth of the dragon.

dag: Nyama, a nya Yawɛ ni zaŋ a niŋ n nuu ni shɛm vol la ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka n niriba shɛb di yɛli ni n kum a, amaa ka man lee tilig a. N di yɛlimi, Man ku zaŋ n nuu shihi n dana, dama o nyɛla Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ni.
en: You can see for yourself that just now in the cave the Lord put you in my power. Some of my men told me to kill you, but I felt sorry for you and said that I would not harm you in the least, because you are the one whom the Lord chose to be king.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Sal yi lee nya dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa ka ti kɔŋ o nyɛvili, nyɔ bɔ ka o lee di bee bin bɔ ka sal lee yɛn zaŋ o nyɛvili taɣi?.
en: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself? What would you give to get back your soul?.

dag: Ifriim zuliya bɛn daa gbibi tɔbiri daa ŋmaligi guui tɔbu tuhibu dali.
en: The children of Ephraim, armed with bows, retreated on the day of battle.

dag: Farisiinim ni daa laɣim Yisa sani maa ka o bɔhi ba.
en: So while the Pharisees were together, Jesus asked them a question.

dag: dinzuɣu ka n diri wahala ŋɔ. Amaa vi bi mali ma, dama m mi n ni niŋ so yɛda, ka mi ni o ni tooi gbibi n ni zaŋ shɛli niŋ o nuu ni la hal ti paai ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: This is also why Im suffering the way I do, but Im not ashamed. I know the one in whom Ive placed my trust. Im convinced that God is powerful enough to protect what he has placed in my trust until that day.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ salima mali bans ayi n-zaŋ li goli sara maligu bimbini maa yaɣ yini naŋgbaŋkuɣila salima din kɔɣili li maa lɔŋni, ka lan mali bans ayi niŋ yaɣ din la gba, ka bɛ ti zaŋ dapuhi turi di ni kpuɣiri sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Make two gold rings and attach them under the molding on two opposite sides of the altar. They will house the poles used to carry the altar.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ kɔba mini jila tuɣituɣi ma, ka zaŋ niŋgbuŋ mini gbaŋ pili ma.
en: You clothed me with skin and flesh, wove me from bones and sinews.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ ma Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni nti tam zo titali din du pam zuɣu n-wuhi ma tiŋ kasi din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm, ka di yi Naawuni sani alizanda ni n-sirigirina.
en: He took me in a Spirit-inspired trance to a great, high mountain, and he showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God.

dag: Yawɛ, kokpɛɣu kpuɣi zani, kokpɛɣu duhi di yee, kokpɛɣu gbaai vubu.
en: The ocean is roaring, Lord ! The sea is pounding hard.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ salima da li, ka nir ku tooi zaŋ anzinfa buɣisi di daa.
en: You cannot buy wisdom with even the purest gold. Theres not enough silver in the world to pay for it.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be vinvamli maa yaɣ din la mini bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dul la daa nya ka Izraɛlnim ŋmaligi guui, ka Sool min o bidibisi kpi, ka bɛ daa yi n-zo ka chɛ bɛ tinsi, ka Filistianim maa daa kana ti be di ni.
en: The Israelites who lived on the other side of the valley saw the Israelite army running away. They saw that Saul and his sons were dead, so they left their cities and ran away. Then the Philistines came and lived in their cities.

dag: Noli ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalim Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu, dama di sabiya: Noli ni di ŋunkam bi deei binshɛɣukam zaa din sabi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni n-dol li.
en: But people who depend on following the law to make them right are under a curse. As the Scriptures say, They must do everything that is written in the law. If they do not always obey, they are under a curse.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti Duuma ni pii ninvuɣ shɛba ka bɛ be yi sani tumd o tuma la, ti suhiri ya ni yi lum ba sizuura. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn wuhiri ya ka kpamdi ya jaande la.
en: Now brothers and sisters, we ask you to recognize the value of those who work hard among you—those who, as followers of the Lord, care for you and tell you how to live.

dag: Bɛ zaa ni ti yaai bɛ noli yɛl a, A gba gbarigimi kaman ti ni gbarigi shɛm. Ti min a zaa niŋla yim.
en: They will make fun of you, saying, Now you are as dead as we are. Now you are just like us.

dag: Ka ti yi pahi Masia zuɣu kpi, ti niŋ yɛda ni ti min o ni lan laɣim mali nyɛvili.
en: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.

dag: Di ti chɛliya ka so nya dabindi yi sani daba ayopɔin ŋɔ puuni, yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa bee n-chɛ ka yi ni kɔrigi biŋkɔb so dabisi tuuli dali maa nimdi zani yuŋ hal ti neei biɛɣu.
en: For seven days no one in your land is to have any yeast in the house; and the meat of the animal killed on the evening of the first day must be eaten that same night.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuun suma bi zɔri nam fukumsinim dabiɛm, amaa bɛn tumdi tuun biɛri n-zɔri ba dabiɛm. A bɔri ni a ku zɔri ŋun be nam fukumsi ni dabiɛm? Dindina tummi din viɛla, ka a ni nya paɣibu o sani.
en: The authorities dont frighten people who are doing the right thing. Rather, they frighten people who are doing wrong. Would you rather not be afraid of authority? Do whats right, and you will receive its approval.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Shihira ni ti be wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi ni; ka wahala ni ti be dunia ni hal ka zuliya kam ti birim teeku kɔgbana vubu zuɣu;.
en: Amazing things will happen to the sun, moon, and stars. And people all over the earth will be upset and confused by the noise of the sea and its crashing waves.

dag: di zaa yoli, pa nyini n-yɛn me n jɛmbu duu maa, amaa a ni ti yɛn dɔɣi bidib so nti yɛn me n jɛmbu duu maa ti ma.
en: But you're not the one to do it. Your son will build a temple to honor me.

dag: N daa zaɣis a la saha biɛla puuni, amaa n nambɔzɔbo din galisi pam puuni, n ni lan zaŋ a labisi n sanna.
en: For a brief moment I abandoned you, but with great mercy I will bring you back.

dag: Yi yi ti lo tɔb chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnima, ka nya bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ni bɛ tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam gari yi tɔbbihi, yin di chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la be yi sani.
en: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and you see horses, chariots, and many more people than you have, you must not be afraid of them. The Lord your God is with you—and he brought you out of Egypt.

dag: Ka a napɔŋ yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a napɔn yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali napɔna ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim din bi kpiri ni, .
en: And if your foot makes you lose your faith, cut it off! It is better for you to enter life without a foot than to keep both feet and be thrown into hell.

dag: Hal bɛ yi kul lo noli, n ku wum bɛ kuhigu. Hal bɛ yi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini chi sara, n ku deei li. Amaa n ni chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ku ba.
en: Even if they fast, I will not listen to their cry for help; and even if they offer me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not be pleased with them. Instead, I will kill them in war and by starvation and disease.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, n daa zaŋla n nuu kpɛh a biɛhigu ni zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu. Biɛhiŋ kani, mani n-daa piɛl a dimnim maa bah a zuɣu a wahala saha min a nandahima saha.
en: Then the Lord replied, I promise to protect you, and when disaster comes, even your enemies will beg you for help.

dag: Dama tulaale ŋɔ naan tooi kɔhi liɣiri pam ka bɛ zaŋ li ti nandaamba.
en: This perfume could have been sold for a large amount and the money given to the poor.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhi niŋ ma, ka n daa zaŋ zibisim niŋ bɛ mini Ijiptinim maa sunsuuni, ka chɛ ka teeku kom mum ba niŋ n-di ba, ka yi nini daa nya n ni niŋ Ijiptinim maa shɛm. Ka yi daa be mɔɣu ni yuui pam.
en: Then they cried for help to the LORD. So he set darkness between you and the Egyptians. He brought the sea down on them, and it covered them. With your own eyes you saw what I did to the Egyptians. You lived in the desert for a long time.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi laɣim taba ni naŋgban yini m-paɣiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋɔ.
en: That way you can glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ together with one voice.

dag: A biɛhigu ni ti ne kaman wuntaŋ ni la, ka di zibisim ti ne kaman asiba neesim la.
en: A life span will rise brighter than noon; darkness will be like morning.

dag: Naawuni yɛligu kam nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, o nyɛla nyɔtaɣirigu n-taɣiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe o yuli.
en: God keeps every promise he makes. He is like a shield for all who seek his protection.

dag: N nyaɣa daa chaŋmi ti gbaai kom, ka maligim kul luri n wula zuɣu yuŋ zaa.
en: I was like a tree whose roots always have water and whose branches are wet with dew.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa bɔri ni o ku Jɔn, amaa ka zɔri niriba, dama sokam daa saɣiya ni o nyɛla anabi.
en: Although Herod wanted to kill him, he feared the crowd because they thought John was a prophet.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibiga Ɛliɛza daa kpuɣi Putiɛl bipuɣinsi ni yino n-daa zaŋ o dɔɣi Finɛhas. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya maa ni kpamba kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Aaron's son Eleazar married one of Putiel's daughters, and their son was Phinehas. This ends the list of those who were the heads of clans in the Levi tribe.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zaŋ alikauli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-pah o ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛli Sinai Zoli gbin la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the words of the covenant the LORD commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in the land of Moab in addition to the covenant he had made with them at Horeb.

dag: Kaman kuɣikpɛra ni zaŋdi chiriga n-chirigiri binyɛra pari kuɣa zuɣu shɛm, lala ka a ti yɛn zaŋ chiriga n-chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yuya, ka zaŋ li taɣili di salima bintaɣindisi ni.
en: Have a skillful jeweler engrave on the two stones the names of the sons of Jacob, and mount the stones in gold settings.

dag: ka daa zaŋ o niŋ bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la ni, ka yo li n-kpar o niŋ di ni ni o di lan yɔhim zuliya kam hal ti paai yuun tuhili maa tariga. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa di nyɛla talahi ni bɛ ti lan yoog o bahi biɛla.
en: He threw him into the abyss, then locked and sealed it over him. This was to keep him from continuing to deceive the nations until the thousand years were over. After this he must be released for a little while.

dag: Pur maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ booni vuhim dabisa chuɣu maa Purim. Bɛ ni daa sab gban shɛl la mini dinkam daa niŋ ba la zuɣu.
en: That is why people call these days Purim, by using the ancient word pur . It all fit with what this letter said, with what they saw happen, and with what they themselves went through.

dag: Ka malaika so daa yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu na n-duh o yee kuhiri yɛri ŋun ʒi sagbani zuɣu maa, Dunia atam biya zaa ka di chɛbu saha paai. Zaŋm a gɔrigu maa n-tim di ni chɛ.
en: Then another angel came out from the temple and cried out in a loud voice to the one who was sitting on the cloud, Use your sickle and reap the harvest, because the time has come; the earth is ripe for the harvest.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi malaika maa, N dana, bɔ ka binyara ŋɔ lee wuhira.
en: Then I asked the angel, What do these things stand for, sir.

dag: Bɛ lo ba yolisim nyabu alikauli, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ nyɛ bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ leei bahiyotali tuun shɛŋa bɛ ni tum ka di mili ba la daba, dama ninsal nyɛla binshɛɣukam din nyaŋ o dabili.
en: These false teachers promise those people freedom, but they themselves are not free. They are slaves to a mind that has been ruined by sin. Yes, people are slaves to anything that controls them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa nya lala ka o suhu yiɣisi, ka o tabig o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi bahi.
en: The Lord saw this and became upset. His sons and daughters made him angry!.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun doli anyinsi soli biri shɛli ni ti kpuɣila mbusim, ka o suhuyiɣisili mi ku ti o nasara.
en: Those who sow injustice will harvest evil; the rod of their fury will come to an end.

dag: Ti paɣiri Naawuni! Ŋuna n-chɛ ka ti doli Masia o nasara dibu dari dibu chandi ni m-be kaman o ni ŋme tɔbu gbahi dab shɛba, ka chɛ ka ti moli Masia yɛla ka di be kaman tulaale nyom la gili luɣilikam.
