en: But thanks be to God! For in union with Christ we are always led by God as prisoners in Christ's victory procession. God uses us to make the knowledge about Christ spread everywhere like a sweet fragrance.

dag: Ka Huram daa lan mali kɔniŋdi bini, ka di nyɛ zaɣ kpilli ka di naŋgbanyɛra yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa di yaɣ yini yɛliŋ nyɛ mita anahi ni biɛla, ka di dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka booli din daa gili di sunsuuni wɔɣilim mi nyɛ mita pinaata ni biɛla.
en: He also made a tank of cast metal called the Sea. It was circular in shape, fifteen feet from rim to rim, seven and a half feet high, forty-five feet in circumference.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Yawɛ daba, paɣimiy o; paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli.
en: Shout praises to the Lord ! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.

dag: Mani n-daa guli ya mɔɣu ni tiŋgban kuŋ ni.
en: I took care of you in a dry, desert land.

dag: Zaŋm a yiko ŋɔ shɛli ti o, ka di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa deer o noli.
en: You will give him some of your power so that the entire Israelite community may obey.

dag: Bɛ loya ni bɛ yihi ma la dunia ŋɔ ni, amaa m bi zaɣis a zaligunim maa.
en: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.

dag: A kul malila shɛhira pala jɛndiri ma, ka a suhuyiɣisili kul pahiri zaŋ chaŋ m polo; ka a kul zaŋdi tɔbbi pala liriti ma.
en: You bring witness after witness to prove that I am wrong. Again and again you show your anger as you send army after army against me.

dag: Yawɛ, di chɛ ma bahi. N Naawuni, di be ma katiŋa!.
en: Do not abandon me, O Lord ; do not stay away, my God!.

dag: Bɛ ka zuɣulana bee sapashin kpɛma.
en: They have no leader, chief, or ruler.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yiɣisi asiba m-pa o buŋ nyaampara doli Mɔab kpamba maa chaŋ.
en: So Balaam arose in the morning, saddled his donkey, and went with the officials of Moab.

dag: Fɔntiŋ kara mini tiŋkpansi ŋɔ ka Musa daa zaŋ ti Gaad zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ su li.
en: These were the cities and towns given to the families of the tribe of Gad as their possession.

dag: Bɛ yi ti piɛbi kikah ayi maa saha shɛli, niriba maa zaa bɛn laɣimm a sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: When long blasts are sounded on both trumpets, the whole community is to gather around you at the entrance to the Tent of my presence.

dag: Bɛ yi daa pun mali tɛha ŋɔ tatabo ni bɛ zɔri ma, ka doli n fukumsi zaligunima zaa sahakam, dindina binshɛɣukam naan niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga bɛ mini bɛ bihi sani.
en: If only they would always feel this way! If only they would always honor me and obey all my commands, so that everything would go well with them and their descendants forever.

dag: Jɔsia yuma daa nyɛla yuma anii saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pihitaniyini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛdida, o daa nyɛla Adaya, Bɔzikat nir la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to rule. He ruled years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

dag: A chɛ a suhuyiɣisili la zaa, ka chɛ a sujee din kpɛm pam la.
en: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.

dag: Yi ŋmanila lala n sani pumpɔŋɔ, Yi nya n nahiŋgu maa ka dabiɛm gbahi ya.
en: just as I am with you. Only one look at my suffering, and you run away scared.

dag: ka pɔb o nina ka yɛl o, A daanabitali puuni, wuhim ti bɛn ŋmɛr a ŋɔ.
en: They put a blindfold on him and said, Tell us who struck you.

dag: Hɛbɛr n-daa nyɛ Jafilɛt mini Shoma ni Hɔtam ni bɛ tizɔpaɣ Shua ba.
en: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and of their sister Shua.

dag: Ka baŋ daa be binzaa maa zuɣusaa, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi. Binzaa maa zuɣusaa polo mini di bintaɣirisi ni di dapaɣa daa nyɛla zaɣ mundili yini.
en: There was a -inch band around the top of each cart; its supports and the panels were of one piece with the cart.

dag: ni m mini ya ti laɣim ʒini n nam ʒiishee n-diri ka nyura, ka yi ti ʒini nam kuɣisi zuɣu n-kari Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la saria.
en: You will eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom, and you will sit on thrones to rule over the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Naa maa yoli nti yaɣi, amaa ka o pɔri la mini saamba la zuɣu chɛ ka o daa bi bɔri ni o yi o pɔri maa nyaaŋa m-mɔŋ bipuɣiŋga maa o ni suh o shɛli maa.
en: This made the king very sad, but he could not refuse her because of the vows he had made in front of all his guests.

dag: daa gili Yisa nyaaŋa nti shih o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili, ka o dɔro maa dii naai.
en: As soon as she came up behind Jesus and barely touched his clothes, her bleeding stopped.

dag: Ka Leeban yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, a shiri nyɛla n ʒim. Ka Yaakubu daa be o sani goli yini.
en: Laban said to him, Yes, you are my flesh and blood. After Jacob had stayed with Laban for a month.

dag: Yi ni ŋmaligi yomyom ka chɛ Naawuni ŋun boli ya Masia daalibarika puuni, ka lan ŋmaligi n-doli lahibal sun shɛli din be di ko ka chɛ Masia lahibal suŋ la yɛla gari ma pam.
en: Im amazed that you are so quickly deserting the one who called you by the grace of Christ to follow another gospel.

dag: Gbib a tima min a tabibi tima maa. A bilim ni ha ka a pun mal li tumdi tuma. Di pa shɛli di ni sɔŋ a bee di pa shɛli di ni kpɛh a dimnim dabiɛm.
en: Continue with your enchantments, and with your many spells, which you have practiced since childhood. Maybe you will be able to succeed. Maybe you will inspire terror.

dag: Bɛ yɛra, Ti noya ni yɛtɔɣa ka ti mali nyari ti ni bɔri shɛlikam. Ti noya maa mi kul be ti sani, ka ŋuni n-leei nyɛ ti duuma.
en: that says, Were unbeatable with our tongues! Who could get the best of us with lips like ours.

dag: Di saha ka Asa daa zaŋ anzinfa mini salima din daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini nayil la n-tim ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti Naa Bɛnhadad ŋun daa nyɛ Siria naa, ka be Damaskus la ka yɛl o.
en: Asa took silver and gold from the treasuries of the LORDs temple and the royal palace and sent them to Arams King Ben-hadad, who ruled in Damascus, with the following message.

dag: Ka bintɔra daa tɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi kpi mi, ka tiŋ maa nim daa kum pam.
en: and those who had survived were suffering from the sores. They all cried to their gods for help.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔh o, Amaŋmaŋ n-kul bɔhi ma lala bee shɛba n-yɛl a n yɛla lala.
en: Jesus answered, Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa yihi ti kum barina titali maa ni, ka na kul yihiri ti di ni, ka ti mali tahima ni o ni lan yihi ti yaha.
en: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ ni daa chɛ ka bɛ chibi sil shɛli ka di be Dauda tiŋ la ni la puuni. Bɛ daa zaŋ o sɔŋla garibil zuɣu, ka daa chɛ ka tulaale duɣiriba zaŋ tulaale mih o, ka bɛ zaŋ o ti sɔɣi, ka mali buɣim titali sɔŋ ti o kuli maa jilima.
en: Earlier, Asa had his own tomb cut out of a rock hill in Jerusalem. So he was buried there, and the tomb was filled with spices and sweet-smelling oils. Then the people built a bonfire in his honor.

dag: o yi doli n zaligunima, ka niŋdi n ni zali shɛlikam viɛnyɛliŋga, ka ʒe yim, o nyɛla wuntizɔra, biɛhiŋ kani, o ni be. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Such a man obeys my commands and carefully keeps my laws. He is righteous, and he will live, says the Sovereign Lord .

dag: di yiŋbia maa yiŋlan maa ni ti kuna o ni bi yuun o soli dahin shɛli bee saha shɛli.
en: If that happens, the master will surely come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him.

dag: Ijipti naa ni ti mali kpiɔŋ, amaa o sapashinnim ni yino ni ti mali kpiɔŋ gar o, ka ni ti di nam din galisi.
en: The king of Egypt will be strong. One of his generals, however, will be even stronger and rule a greater kingdom.

dag: A du zoli din du pam zuɣu ka zaŋ daba pam mali chaŋ; ka deei pina niriba sani hal zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba bɛn je ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ be nimaani la sani.
en: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.

dag: O bi labir o nini kpaŋ ka chɛri wuntizɔriba, amaa o zaŋdi ba mi ʒiini bɛ nanim sani bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi, ka niriba duhiri ba sahakam.
en: He watches over those who live right. He lets them rule in high places.

dag: Ŋunkam tumdi tuumbiɛri, ŋun na kul be tuumbiɛri maa tumbu ni; ka ŋunkam mali tabizahim, ŋun na kul be o tabizahim tuma maa ni; ka ŋunkam nyɛ wuntizɔra, ŋun na kul be din tuhi tumbu ni; ka ŋunkam mi be kasi, ŋun na kul kpalimmi be kasi.
en: Let anyone who is doing wrong continue to do wrong. Let anyone who is unclean continue to be unclean. Let anyone who is doing right continue to do right. Let anyone who is holy continue to be holy.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli, yi ni ti nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia maa ni, amaa n nudirigu mini n nuzaa polo ʒinibu maa din pala man tibu; amaa m Ba Naawuni ni mal li zali ninvuɣ shɛba n-ni ti ʒin nimaani.
en: Jesus replied, You certainly will drink from my cup! But it isn't for me to say who will sit at my right side and at my left. This is for my Father to say.

dag: O chɛ n daalahichi zaa, ka tibi n dɔriti zaa.
en: how God forgives all your sins, heals all your sickness.

dag: Ka nyaandoliba ayi maa daa ti paai Yisa sani nti yɛl o, Jɔn Baptaizira n-tim ti a sanna ni ti ti bɔh a ni nyini n-nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn kana la bee ni ti na yulim dilan soli.
en: So the men came to Jesus. They said, John the Baptizer sent us to you with this question: Are you the one who is coming, or should we wait for someone else.

dag: Ka din pah anu gbaai Nɛtania min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the fifth to Nethaniah, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Bɛ dɔɣ ti la Yɛhudianima, ka ti pala bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ.
en: We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles.

dag: N dima, di chɛ ka a suhu piɛla n lubu zuɣu; dama n ni lan yiɣisi. N yi ʒini zibisim ni, Yawɛ n-yɛn nyɛ n neesim.
en: I have fallen, but enemy, dont laugh at me! I will get up again. I sit in darkness now, but the Lord will be a light for me.

dag: O daɣiri maa daa yila palo, ka o baɣa daa ka yɛl shɛŋa din yɛn paag o ni. O lubu maa daa mali alahiziba, ka so daa kani ŋun ni maag o suhu. Yawɛ, lihimi n ni nyari nahiŋgu shɛm, dama n dimnim di nasara.
en: Jerusalems skirts were dirty. She gave no thought to what would become of her. Her fall was amazing. She had no one to comfort her. She says, Lord , see how I am hurt! See how my enemy thinks he is so great.

dag: M bilim ni zaa, n nyɛla nandahimalana ka miri kum. A ni kpɛhi ma dabiɛm shɛli chɛ ka n di wahala, ka n lan ka tahima.
en: Ever since I was young, I have suffered and been near death; I am worn out from the burden of your punishments.

dag: Maligumaana Ɛliashib ŋun daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu nɛma duri fukumsi la mini Tɔbaya daa nyɛla dɔɣim.
en: Now before this, however, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed to be in charge of the storerooms of our Gods house and who was related to Tobiah.

dag: hal nimaani gba n yɛn bela a nuu ni, ka a nudirigu gbib ma kirikiri.
en: even there your hand would guide me; even there your strong hand would hold me tight!.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Wula ka a lee niŋ ka a nina maa neei.
en: So they asked him, How are you now able to see.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa ti tim tuumba ashilɔni nti yɛli Izraɛl zuliya zaa, Yi yi ti kul wum kikaa kumsi yin yɛlimiya, Absalom leei naa Hiburɔn.
en: But Absalom sent secret agents throughout the tribes of Israel with this message: When you hear the sound of the trumpet, then say, Absalom has become king in Hebron.

dag: Cham ti yɛli n dabili Dauda ni man Yawɛ bɔhir o, A yɛn mɛla duu ti ma ka m be di ni.
en: Go and tell my servant David, This is what the Lord says: You are not the one to build a house for me to live in.

dag: Dama di sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli: Nyama, n zaŋ kuɣ shɛli sɔŋ Ziɔn. Di nyɛla kuɣ gahindili shɛli Naawuni ni pii ka lihi li ka di mali buchi. Ka ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku di vi.
en: For the scripture says, I chose a valuable stone, which I am placing as the cornerstone in Zion; and whoever believes in him will never be disappointed.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ ta bɛmaŋ daɣiri bɛ tumtumsa ni, ka bɛ tuma maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ bi ʒe yim.
en: They were unfaithful to him, and they became dirty with the sins of other nations.

dag: Bɛn mali suhupiɛlli, yin pahimiya bɛ zuɣu m-mali suhupiɛlli; bɛn fabinda, yin pahimiya bɛ zuɣu fabili.
en: When others are happy, you should be happy with them. And when others are sad, you should be sad too.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa bo salichee kɔriti omaŋa. O daa ʒila tampiligim ni.
en: Then Job sat on the ash-heap to show his sorrow. And while he was scraping his sores with a broken piece of pottery.

dag: Amaa ka padiriba maa daa ti nya o ka yɛli taba, O falidir la m-bɔŋɔ na; chɛliya ka ti ku o, ka fali maa leei ti dini. .
en: But when they saw him, they said to each other, This is the heir. Lets kill him so the inheritance will be ours.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka bɛ be ni alaafee, amaa ka o lee pa nina lihiri bɛ tuma.
en: They might feel safe and secure, but God is watching how they live.

dag: Ko zurili nyaɣisa, ka nir ni sɔɣi di bindir shɛli nyaɣisa.
en: Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ suhuri fuŋ bɛ ni daa nya Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa zuɣu, ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa daa ku ba pam Gibiɔn, ka kari doli bɛn kpalim hal ni Bɛtihɔrɔn zolɔŋni n-kul kuri ba hal ti paai Azɛka mini Makɛda.
en: The Lord made the enemy panic, and the Israelites started killing them right and left. They chased the Amorite troops up the road to Beth-Horon and kept on killing them, until they reached the towns of Azekah and Makkedah.

dag: Bɛ mali tiba, amaa bɛ ku tooi wum; bɛ mi bi vuhira.
en: They have ears, but cannot hear; they are not even able to breathe.

dag: Di saha ka Zarai daa yɛli Ibram, N ʒiɛmbu ŋɔ taali ʒi a zuɣu. Mani n-zaŋ n dab bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ ti a, ka o ti nya ka o mali pua, ka lihi ʒiɛm ma. Yawɛ ni woligi ti m min a.
en: Then Sarai said to Abram, My slave girl now hates me, and I blame you for this. I gave her to you, and she became pregnant. Then she began to feel that she is better than I am. I want the Lord to judge which of us is right.

dag: N sabila dimbɔŋɔ tin ya ni n yɛli ya bɛn bɔri ni bɛ yɔhim ya la yɛla;.
en: I am writing this letter about those who are trying to lead you into the wrong way.

dag: Di zaa ni ti nyɛla dapaɣa anii mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu pinaayɔbu; ka dapaɣili kam tam diba ayi zuɣu.
en: There will be a total of eight frames for the west end of the Tent. There will be silver bases—two bases under each frame.

dag: Dama n suhuyiɣisili maa dirimi kaman buɣim la, ka ni di hal ni kpiimba biɛhigu shee. Di saɣindi dunia mini di binshɛɣukam, ka niŋdi buɣim nyɔri zoya tanzahi.
en: My people, I will breathe out fire that sends you down to the world of the dead. It will scorch your farmlands and burn deep down under the mountains.

dag: Nyama, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ suhukpeennim dolila soya kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim, ka sandaantimdiba kuhiri pampam.
en: The brave are calling for help. The ambassadors who tried to bring about peace are crying bitterly.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ kɔŋko ka buchi; shia n-nyɛ ŋun tiri nyɛvili. Ka n ni pun tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la mi nyɛla shia mini nyɛvili yɛla.
en: The Spirit is the one who gives life and the flesh doesnt help at all. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and life.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi Maika yiŋ maa chaŋ ha, ka Maika daa kuhi bol o ʒiʒiinitaba n-chɛ ka bɛ pah o zuɣu ka bɛ kari Dan zuliya niriba maa naba.
en: They had traveled for some time before Micah asked his neighbors to help him get his things back. He and his men caught up with the people of Dan.

dag: Hal Yɛhudianim zuɣulaannim pam daa niŋ Yisa yɛda, amaa bɛ ni daa zɔri Farisiinim zuɣu ka bɛ daa bi bɔri ni bɛ yihi li palo, ka Farisiinim maa ti kari ba bɛ jɛmbu duu;.
en: Even so, many leaders believed in him, but they wouldnt acknowledge their faith because they feared that the Pharisees would expel them from the synagogue.

dag: Zaŋm neen shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni zaŋ ti a ni a zaŋ ti Jɛrusalɛm Naawuni, ka bɛ mal li tumdi yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuma la ti.
en: Take all these things to the God of Jerusalem. They are for the worship in the Temple of your God.

dag: Ka sagban shɛli daa sirigina ti lim ba, ka bɛ wum ka kukol shɛli yɛri sagbani maa ni, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ! Wummiy o noli.
en: Then a cloud overshadowed them, and a voice spoke from the cloud, This is my Son, whom I dearly love. Listen to him.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ me bimbin shɛŋa tabili jɛmbu duu maa dukpina mini di puuni dubila zaŋ tabili luɣ kasi shee la. Ka lan me dubihi ka di dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla tabili di luɣa ni ti gili.
en: and built side rooms against the temple walls around both the main hall and the most holy place.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Pa Anabi Musa n-daa zaŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu la tin ya? Amaa yi ni so bi dol li. Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bɔri ni yi ku ma.
en: Didnt Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you keep the Law. Why do you want to kill me.

dag: Bolimi ma, ka n garig a, ka yɛl a yɛl kara mini binshɛŋa din sɔɣi ka a bi mi li.
en: Ask me, and I will tell you things that you don't know and can't find out.

dag: Di saha maa, yi ni ti fabili pam yi ni pii na so maa zuɣu, amaa ka Yawɛ ti ku garigi ya dindali maa.
en: When that day comes, you will cry out because of the king you chose for yourselves, but on that day the LORD wont answer you.

dag: Dɔbba mini paɣiba n-daa kul pali duu maa ni, ka Filistianim nanim zaa gba be nimaani. Ka dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn kalinli daa nyɛ kaman tusaata daa be duu maa dufahirili zuɣusaa lihiri Samsin ni diɛmdi maa.
en: The temple was crowded with men and women. All the Philistine rulers were there. There were about men and women on the roof of the temple. They were laughing and making fun of Samson.

dag: Ka Absalom min o niriba zaa ni Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ ti kpe Jɛrusalɛm, ka Ahitɔfɛl gba daa be o sani.
en: Absalom and all the Israelites with him entered Jerusalem, and Ahithophel was with them.

dag: Di zɔri dabiɛm, m be a sani. Mani n nyɛ a Naawuni. Kul di zɔri dabiɛm! N ni ti a kpiɔŋ ka sɔŋ a, n ni tilig a ka gul a, ka chɛ ka a di nasara.
en: Do not be afraid—I am with you! I am your God—let nothing terrify you! I will make you strong and help you; I will protect you and save you.

dag: Hal n yi nyɛla ŋun ʒi yɛtɔɣa, amaa n lee bi kɔŋ baŋsim dina; binshɛɣukam puuni ti pun kahigiri dimbɔŋɔ yɛla n-wuhiri ya palɔni sahakam.
en: But even if Im uneducated in public speaking, Im not uneducated in knowledge. We have shown this to you in every way and in everything we have done.

dag: Yihim ma bɛ daansarisi mini bɛ ninvuɣ tubo ni, dama n dol a zaligunima.
en: Dont let me be ashamed and embarrassed. I have obeyed your rules.

dag: Ti mabihi, din bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla, suhimiya Naawuni tiri ti ka o chɛ ka ti Duuma yɛligu yɛligi yomyom ka di nasara kaman di ni daa di nasara yi sani shɛm la.
en: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.

dag: o biɛhigu shee mini di suɣili ni din yɛn pil li ni di bansi ni di dapaɣa ni di dapuhi ni di daantalisi ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: the Tent, its covering and its outer covering, its hooks and its frames, its crossbars, its posts, and its bases;.

dag: Hal Naawuni yi chɛ ka n nyɛvili pahi yi yɛda niŋbu sara zuɣu n-leei sara maligu ŋun Naawuni sani, di ni niŋ ma suhupiɛlli, ka yi zaa gba pahi n zuɣu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Perhaps my life's blood is to be poured out like an offering on the sacrifice that your faith offers to God. If that is so, I am glad and share my joy with you all.

dag: N kuhiri boonila Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ. Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri ma binshɛlikam din simdi ma.
en: I call out to God Most High— to God, who comes through for me.

dag: Kalimiya yuma ayopɔin ʒiibuyopɔin. Di yuma maa ni ti nyɛla yuun pihinuyinika.
en: Count off seven weeks of years—that is, seven times seven—so that the seven weeks of years totals forty-nine years.

dag: Amaa n daa je ni n yuli saɣim bɛ mini zuliya shɛb bɛn be maa sani, dama bɛ zaa ninni ka n daa zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ba, ka yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: But that would have made me look like a liar, because I had already promised in front of everyone that I would lead them out of Egypt.

dag: Ka Iso daa yɛl o, Malim shili ka m min a doli kuli.
en: Esau said, Lets break camp and set out, and Ill go with you.

dag: Bɛ bihi yi nya jilima, bɛ bi mi; ka bɛ yi nya filiŋ, so baɣa ka di ni.
en: Our children win honor, but we never know it, nor are we told when they are disgraced.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa ti niŋ ŋun kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria. Ka o bia Jɛhɔahaz daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehu died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz became king.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika maa, N tum alahichi, dama m bi mi ni a ʒiɛla sol ni gu ma soli. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, di yi bi luhi a sani, n ni ŋmaligi labi kuli.
en: Then Balaam said to the Lord s angel, I have sinned. I did not know that you were standing in the road. If I am doing wrong, I will go back home.

dag: Zɔfa bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Sua mini Harinɛfa ni Shual ni Bɛri ni Imira.
en: The descendants of Zophah were Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa chaŋ Giliad mini Kadɛshi din be Hitinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nti yi nimaani chaŋ Dan n-yi Dan zaŋ goligi Sidɔn polo.
en: They went to Gilead and to Kadesh in Syria. Then they went to Dan, Ijon, and on toward Sidon.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ saria karibu saha; ka Naawuni ni yihi dunia ŋɔ naa bahi.
en: This world's people are now being judged, and the ruler of this world is already being thrown out!.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ mi din be Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Miri ka a niŋ zina; miri ka a ku ninsala; miri ka a zu; miri ka a di shɛhira kpɛma; ka tim a ba min a ma jilima. .
en: You know the commandments: Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not tell lies about others. Respect your father and mother. .

dag: O daa yɛli ba mi, Wummiya n ni sa zahim zahindi shɛli ŋɔ:.
en: Joseph said, Let me tell you about my dream.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ o yiko nam dunia ŋɔ, ka zaŋ o yɛm zali dunia ŋɔ, ka zaŋ o baŋsim nam zuɣusaa.
en: God is the one who used his power and made the earth. He used his wisdom and built the world. With his understanding he stretched the sky over the earth.

dag: Bɔhimmiya zaɣ viɛlli tumbu. Niŋmiya din tuhi, ka sɔŋdi bɛn be nahiŋgu ni, ka niŋdi kpibisi di ni simdi ni yi niŋ ba shɛm, ka sɔŋmiya pakoya.
en: Learn to do good. Treat people fairly. Punish those who hurt others. Speak up for the widows and orphans. Argue their cases for them in court.

dag: Ka Judanim daa ti paai luɣ shɛli din du pam mɔɣu ni la shee, ka bɛ daa du li n-lihi tɔbbi gbaliŋ la polo, n-nya ka kpiimba n-do tiŋa, ka bɛ so bi tiligi.
en: When the Judean army reached a tower that was in the desert, they looked toward the enemy and saw that they were all lying on the ground dead. Not one had escaped.

dag: ka bɛ ni yino daa kani ka chɛ ma, ka n daa yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, ŋ-ŋɔ bini n-dari chɛrisichɛris o; ka m bi lan nya o hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: One of them has already left me. He must have been torn to pieces by wild animals, because I have not seen him since he left.

dag: Sɛrug ni daa dɔɣi Nahɔr maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Nahor was born, Serug lived another years. During that time he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Saimɔn Isikariɔt bia Judas la yɛla ka o daa yɛri maa, dama ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn yi o nyaaŋa ka mi nyɛ bɛ pinaayi maa ni yino la.
en: He was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. Judas was one of the twelve apostles, but later he would hand Jesus over to his enemies.

dag: Ka o daa tim ka bɛ ti zaŋ o na. O daa nyɛla ŋun mal alaafee, ka o nimbihi kul viɛla, ka o lan nyɛ nachimbil viɛlli. Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Samuɛl, Yiɣisim booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni; ŋuna m-bala.
en: Jesse sent someone to get his youngest son. This son was a good-looking, healthy young man. He was very handsome. The Lord said to Samuel, Get up and anoint him. He is the one.

dag: Ka n daa kul lihira, ka na kul wumdi yilli zaɣ bil la yɛtɔɣ kara la. Ka n ni daa na kul lihiri maa, ka n ti nya ka bɛ ku biŋkɔb so ŋun pah anahi la n-zaŋ o ti bahi buɣim ni, ka di di n-saɣim o.
en: I kept on looking because the little horn was bragging. I kept watching until finally the fourth animal was killed. Its body was destroyed, and it was thrown into the burning fire.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Kalidianim mini Sirianim ni Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim tɔbbihi kana ti liri Judanim ni bɛ ku ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka o daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: At that time, the Lord started sending troops to rob and destroy towns in Judah. Some of these troops were from Babylonia, and others were from Syria, Moab, and Ammon. The Lord had sent his servants the prophets to warn Judah about this.

dag: Yi bindiri pala din daŋ niŋbu dabisili din nyɛ yi ni zaŋdi kapala tiri Yawɛ yi dakulɔdakulo churi puhibu ni la dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya yi tuun shɛli.
en: The day of the early produce, when you present your new grain offering to the LORD at your Festival of Weeks, will be a holy occasion for you. You will not do any job-related work.

dag: Kukoli maa ni daa tɔɣisi naai ka bɛ nya ka Yisa kɔŋko n-kpalim. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yɛlli maa shini ka bi yɛli so bɛ ni daa nya shɛli maa yɛla di saha maa.
en: Even as the voice spoke, Jesus was found alone. They were speechless and at the time told no one what they had seen.

dag: a ni niŋ tuuba a suhu ni, ka siɣis amaŋ Naawuni sani n-darigi cheeg a binyɛrigu ka kum niŋ ma zaŋ chaŋ a ni wum ka n yɛli ni n ni niŋ Jɛrusalɛm mini di niriba shɛm la polo, man Yawɛ yɛliya, N gba wumya.
en: Josiah, when you heard my words against this city and its people, you were sorry and humbled yourself before me. You even tore your clothes to show your sorrow and cried before me. Because your heart was tender, I the Lord , have heard you.

dag: Ka o daa dihiri Izraɛlnim vi, ka Dauda mabia Shimɛi bia Jɔnatan mi daa ku o.
en: When he insulted Israel, Jonathan, who was the son of Davids brother Shimei, killed him.

dag: Ka ti daa yɛl o, Ti ku tooi labi. Ti tizo ŋɔ yi ku dol ti chaŋ, dindina ti ku chaŋ; dama ti tizo maa yi ka ti sani, doo maa nini ku nya ti.
en: We said to our father, We cannot go without our youngest brother. The governor said he will not sell us grain again until he sees our youngest brother.

dag: dama bɛn zaa piila bɛ bun ni na ti tɔhi, amaa pakoli ŋɔ ŋun zaŋla o duu ni o yiŋ zaa na ti tɔhi.
en: For the others offered their gifts from what they had to spare of their riches; but she, poor as she is, gave all she had to live on.

dag: Be a biɛhigu shee din be kasi alizanda ni ka lihi tiŋ na n-niŋ alibarika niŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim min a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti ŋɔ ni kaman a ni daa po pɔri yɛli ti yaannima ni di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam la.
en: Look down from your holy home, from heaven, and bless your people Israel. And bless the land that you gave us. You promised our ancestors to give us this land—a land filled with many good things.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di nyɛla m mini yi pinaayi ŋɔ ni yino ŋun laɣim mali bɔrɔbɔro suɣiri ʒiɛri la yin ni ŋɔ.
en: Jesus answered, Its one of the Twelve, one who is dipping bread with me into this bowl.

dag: amaa ka Maata ŋun tɛha kul bela bindirigu niŋbu ni, ka daa ti chaŋ Yisa sani ti bɔh o, N Duuma, a baɣa ka n tizo maa ni chɛ tuma jɛli ma ŋɔ ni? Yɛlim o ni o sɔŋm ma.
en: Martha was upset over all the work she had to do, so she came and said, Lord, don't you care that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself? Tell her to come and help me.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa zaŋ kpa shɛli din kpalim be o nuu ni la n-ʒe ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa nudirigu polo tibinyaɣili min o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu ni taali sanyoo sara ʒim la zuɣu.
en: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔh o kpambaliba maa, Ti ni tooi nya ninvuɣ so ka o be kaman Naawuni Shia ni be do so ni ŋɔ.
en: So the king said to them, Who could possibly handle this better than Joseph? After all, the Spirit of God is with him.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ daa tɛhi ni di luhiya ni n tum shɛlikam chihi Yisa Nazarɛt nira yuli.
en: I used to think that I should do everything I could against Jesus from Nazareth.

dag: Yi pala shɛli, ka yi tuma gba pa shɛli. Ŋunkam pii ya tum din chihira.
en: Look, you false gods are worthless. You cannot do anything. Only some horrible fool would want to worship you.

dag: Tizɔriba kul zɔrimi doli taba, ka tuumba kul zɔri doli taba ni bɛ chaŋ ti yɛli Babilɔn naa ni bɛ deeg o tiŋ la zaa.
en: Courier joins courier, messenger joins messenger to relate the news to the king of Babylon that his entire city has fallen.

dag: O dimnim fa o bin viɛla zaa. Hal o nya zuliya shɛba ni kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu la puuni; a ni daa zali ni di chihiri ni zuliya shɛb kpe a niriba laɣiŋgu ni la.
en: The enemy stretched out his hand. He took all her nice things. In fact, she saw the foreign nations go inside her Temple. And you said those people could not join in our assembly!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di kana, di niŋya. Dabisili ŋɔ yɛla ka n daa yɛl la.
en: The day is coming when these things will happen, just as I have promised.

dag: Ka o daa bol o na ti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n go n-wumd a yɛla shɛm ŋɔ? Malimi m binshɛɣukam din be a sani laasabu n-zaŋ ti ma, dama a ku lan niŋ n tumtumdi kpɛma.
en: so he called him in and said, What is this I hear about you? Turn in a complete account of your handling of my property, because you cannot be my manager any longer.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so yɔhim ya baabiɛla, dama di dabisili maa ku kana faashee Naawuni zaɣisibu din bahindi nyaaŋa la ti niŋ, ka Zaliguzaɣisir so Naawuni ni pun lo ni o bah o yol la gba ti yi zahira.
en: Do not let anyone deceive you in any way. For the Day will not come until the final Rebellion takes place and the Wicked One appears, who is destined to hell.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ yihi dɔro maa ni be kuɣ shɛŋa ni maa n-yihi tiŋ maa kpaŋa nti bahi tampuli zuɣu.
en: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka dɔro balibu kam ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb pam kpaŋ, ka daa kari alizin biɛri niriba pam zuɣu bahi, ka bi saɣi ni alizin biɛri maa yɛli shɛli, dama bɛ daa mi o ni nyɛ so.
en: Jesus healed many who were sick with all kinds of diseases and drove out many demons. He would not let the demons say anything, because they knew who he was.

dag: Ti paɣiri Zallakudura Naa ŋun chɛ ka a nyaŋ a dimnim ŋɔ! Ka Ibram daa zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa pia puuni zaɣ yiniyini yihi Mɛlikizɛdɛk zaka.
en: bless El Elyon, who gave you the victory over your enemies. Abram gave Melchizedek one-tenth of everything.

dag: O ni tiligi ma ni alaafee n ni tuhiri tɔb shɛŋa la ni, dama bɛn tuhiri ma maa galisiya pam.
en: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa nam saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim be ka bɛ booni ba Gbuɣinli la mini saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim be ka bɛ booni ba Jɛŋgbini la, ni saŋmaribihi shɛba bɛ ni booni Gbiŋgbiŋ min o bihi bɛn nyɛ nudirigu polo saŋmarisi la.
en: and set the stars in place— the Big Dipper and Orion, the Pleiades and the stars in the southern sky.

dag: Amaa di chaŋya Bɛrishiiba ni yi ti jɛm ma bee n-chaŋ Bɛtɛl ni yi ti nya ma, dama Bɛtɛl ni kpalim yoli. Yi mi di chaŋya Giligal, dama bɛ ni gbahi Giligalnim kuli tinduli ni.
en: Do not go to Beersheba to worship. Do not try to find me at Bethel—Bethel will come to nothing. Do not go to Gilgal—her people are doomed to exile.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli ma, Anabinim maa malila n yuli ŋmari ʒiri. Man bi tim ba bee n-zali ba shɛli bee n-tɔɣisi bɛ ni so yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ tɔɣisiri ya la ʒii din nyɛ ʒiri yɛtɔɣa. Di nyɛla baɣibuɣibo din ka buchi, ka nyɛ bɛ maŋmaŋ suhu ni yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa.
en: Then the LORD said to me: The prophets are telling lies in my name. I havent sent them. I havent commanded them. I havent spoken to them. They are prophesying to you false visions, worthless predictions, and deceit they have made up on their own.

dag: A yi paai nimaani, nyin lihim bo Jɛhɔshafat bia Jɛhu ŋun nyɛ Nimshi yaaŋa la shee n-kpe nti bol o o tab sani n-zaŋ o kpe duu ashilɔni.
en: When you arrive there, look for Jehu, Jehoshaphats son and Nimshis grandson. Go to him, then pull him away from his associates, taking him to a private room.

dag: Di saha maa ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa chaŋ ti bɔhi Pool, Yɛlim ma, a shiri nyɛla Rom tiŋbia? Ka Pool saɣi, Iin.
en: The commander came to Paul and said, Tell me, are you really a Roman citizen? He answered, Yes.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the message that came to Jeremiah from the Lord .

dag: Amaa nyin yihirila Naawuni zɔbo a kɔbili ni. Ka guri Naawuni jɛmbo soli.
en: Your words are enough to make others turn from God and lead them to doubt.

dag: Yɛm shɛli kani, tɛhi zilima shɛli kani, saawara shɛli mi kani din ni tooi nyaŋ Yawɛ.
en: No wisdom, understanding, or advice can stand up against the LORD.

dag: Yi bi teei ni n ni daa be yi san la, n daa pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla?.
en: I told you before that all these things would happen. Remember?.

dag: Amaa wula ka n kɔŋko lee ni tooi maani yi yɛlimuɣisira ŋɔ, ka maani yi zabili yɛtɔɣa?.
en: But I cannot take care of you and solve all your arguments by myself.

dag: Yɛhudianim maa daa bi niŋ yɛda ni doo maa daa nyɛla zoma ka ti neei maa faashee bɛ ni daa ti bol o ba min o ma na.
en: The Jewish authorities, however, were not willing to believe that he had been blind and could now see, until they called his parents.

dag: Bɛ mini Pool zaa tuma daa nyɛla tanti wuɣibu tuma, dinzuɣu ka Pool daa chaŋ ti be bɛ sani ni o mini ba laɣim wolindi dira.
en: They were tentmakers, the same as Paul, so he stayed with them and worked with them.

dag: Naawuni ni niŋ din tuhi. O ni ti chɛ ka bɛn niŋdi ya wahala la gba di wahala.
en: God will do what is right: he will bring suffering on those who make you suffer.

dag: Dama n yɛn chɛmi ka zuliya shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ yi nuzaa polo tiŋgbɔŋ ni kana ti liri Babilɔn. Bɛ ni ti pie tab zani liri li n-ŋme n-deei li. Bɛ piɛma tɔbu ŋmanila tɔbbi yɛndaan so ŋun na ʒi n-to n-ziŋ.
en: Im stirring up against Babylon a coalition of mighty nations. It will mobilize in the north, and from there she will be captured. Their arrows are like those of an expert archer who does not return empty-handed.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di sabiya, Pa bindirigu kɔŋko zuɣu ka daadam be. .
en: Jesus replied, Its written, People wont live only by bread .

dag: Nyini n-su Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ fukumsi, zaŋm a ba min a biɛyanim maa ʒili luɣ viɛlli shee; chɛ ka bɛ ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni. Ka a yi mi bɛ ni bɛn mi biŋkɔbiri gbibbu, nyin chɛ ka bɛ guli n niɣi.
en: the land of Egypt is available to you. Settle your father and brothers in the lands best location. Let them live in the land of Goshen. And if you know capable men among them, put them in charge of my own livestock.

dag: Bɛ daa ti tahi alizin biɛɣu ni ʒi zoom bir so zuɣu Yisa sanna, ka o daa chɛ ka o kpaŋ zaa, ka o nina maa gba neei, hal ka o lan leei ŋun tɔɣisira.
en: Then some people brought a man to Jesus. This man was blind and could not talk, because he had a demon inside him. Jesus healed the man, and he could talk and see.

dag: Dinzuɣu n lan zaŋ ya taali yaha, ka zaŋ yi yaansi gba taali. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: That is why I will take you to court and charge even your descendants, declares the LORD.

dag: Niŋmiya ma yɛda ni m be m Ba maa ni ka m Ba gba be n ni; ka di yi pa lala, yin niŋmiya ma yɛda n tuma zuɣu.
en: Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me. If not, believe because of the things I do.

dag: Ŋun bɔri ni o jɛm ma, ŋun doli ma. N ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka n yiŋbia gba ni ti be. Ŋun jɛmdi ma, dilana ka m Ba Naawuni tiri jilima.
en: Whoever serves me must follow me. Wherever I am, there my servant will also be. My Father will honor whoever serves me.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli, M Ba Naawuni, nyin ŋun su alizanda mini dunia ŋɔ, m paɣir a, dama a zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnima n-sɔɣi yɛnnim mini baŋdiba, ka lee kahigi li wuhila biliɛri;.
en: At that time Jesus said, I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because youve hidden these things from the wise and intelligent and have shown them to babies.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ kpa viɛl shɛli mini wain viɛla zaa ni chi ni bindiri daŋda shɛŋa zaa ti man Yawɛ, n zaŋ li tin ya.
en: For example, when the Israelites bring me the first batches of oil, wine, and grain, you can have the best parts of those gifts.

dag: Bɛna n-daa sɔŋ Dauda tuhi ŋmɛnditoya la, dama bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi ka lan nyɛ sapashin kpamba.
en: They helped David against the raiding bands because they were all warriors and officers in the army.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yɛn ku ninvuɣ shɛb dindali ni ti yɛrigi luɣilikam, ka so ti ku fabili bɛ zuɣu bee n-kpuɣi ba bee n-sɔɣi ba. Bɛ ni ti do tiŋgban ni kaman naɣ bina la.
en: The dead bodies of those killed by the Lord will reach from one end of the earth to the other. No one will cry for them. No one will gather up their bodies and bury them. They will be left lying on the ground like dung.

dag: Ka Ɛkan daa yɛli Jɔshua, Yɛlimaŋli, n tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ sani; N ni tum alahichi shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: It's true, Achan answered. I sinned and disobeyed the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Dama Naawuni nir maa ni daa yɛli naa, Biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha bɛ sa ni kɔhi zim balli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini, ka kɔhi chi din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayɔbu mi anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini Samaria dunɔdal ni la.
en: Elisha had said, A person will be able to buy a basket of fine flour or two baskets of barley for only one shekel in the marketplace by the city gates of Samaria.

dag: Maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di nyɛla din kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka di kɔbiri paligi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu n-zaŋ kpe bintɔrili maa ni maa.
en: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, This is leprosy—you are unclean.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛli, Nyamiya o ni yuri Lazarɔs shɛm.
en: and the people said, See how much he loved Lazarus.

dag: Nir ni tooi zaŋ buɣim buɣi ka di ku di o situra?.
en: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;.

dag: din ni chɛ ka bɛ doli n zaligunima, ka gbibi n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la, ka saɣi li. Di saha bɛ ni ti nyɛ n niriba, ka m mi nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: so that they may follow my regulations and carefully observe my case laws. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim, m mihirila n ninni niŋdi ba, bɛ ni bi dol a zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: When I look at those traitors, I am filled with disgust, because they do not keep your commands.

dag: mini Jɔana ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛrɔd yiŋ tumtumdi so ŋun yuli daa booni Chuza la paɣa ni Suzaana ni niriba pam bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ ni mali shɛli zɔri Yisa min o nyaandoliba kuŋ la.
en: Joanna, Susanna, and many others had also used what they owned to help Jesus and his disciples. Joanna's husband Chuza was one of Herod's officials.

dag: Nuzaa polo dunɔdali maa tooni, dunoli daa beni kpɛri dundɔŋ ni kaman di ni daa be shɛm wulimpuhili polo la. Ka o daa buɣisi dunoli zaŋ ti kpa dunoli, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: Directly across the outer courtyard was a gate that led to the inner courtyard, just as there was for the east gate. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was meters.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Bɔ ka n niŋ? Pa bɔhigu yini kɔŋko ka m bɔhi.
en: What did I do wrong this time? David replied. It was just a question.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa daa bi lan yi o ya kana, dama Babilɔn naa daa deeg o ni su tiŋgban shɛli zaa din zaŋ Ijipti kulibɔŋ shee hal ti paai Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni.
en: The king of Egypt and his army never marched out of Egypt again, because the king of Babylonia now controlled all the territory that had belonged to Egypt, from the Euphrates River to the northern border of Egypt.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yuli ba ka bɔhi ba, Wula ka di lee sabi Naawuni Kundi ni yɛl la? Di sabiya: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili. .
en: But Jesus looked into their eyes and said, Then what does this verse mean: The stone that the builders refused to accept became the cornerstone? Psalm :.

dag: N ni wurim Ijiptinim kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka kari ba kpɛhi tiŋgbɔna zaa ni.
en: I am going to scatter the Egyptians throughout the world.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali, ŋun bom ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi n-ka Yawɛ tooni na Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni nti zaŋ ba ti maligumaana.
en: On the eighth day he will take two turtledoves or two pigeons and come before the LORD to the meeting tents entrance and give these to the priest.

dag: N Duuma, luɣim a tiba wum mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ suhigu min a daba bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ti a yuli jilima la suhigu. Tim a dabili nasara zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka o nya nambɔzɔbo naa sani. Di saha maa mani n-daa nyɛ ŋun boori wain tiri naa.
en: Please answer my prayer and the prayer of your other servants who gladly honor your name. When I serve the king his wine today, make him pleased with me and let him do what I ask.

dag: Chɛ ka a ni niŋ yɛda shɛm a suhu ni be a mini Naawuni sunsuuni. Ninvuɣ so ŋun tɛha bi chihir o suhu o ni niŋdi shɛli zuɣu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: You should keep your beliefs about these things a secret between yourself and God. It is a blessing to be able to do what you think is right without feeling guilty.

dag: ka Hɔshia ŋun daa nyɛ Azazia bia la daa nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ni kpɛma, ka Joɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Pɛdaya bia la mi nyɛ Manaasa zuliya pirigili la kpɛma.
en: for the Ephraimites—Hoshea, Azaziahs son; for half the tribe of Manasseh—Joel, Pedaiahs son.

dag: ni nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha pam dunia ŋɔ ni, ka ti lan nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu dunia shɛli din kanna ni.
en: will receive many times more in this age and eternal life in the coming age.

dag: Hal sagbani maa daa yi kpalim ʒe Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa zuɣusaa dabisi gbaliŋ gba, Izraɛlnim maa kul dolila Yawɛ zaligu maa ka ku yiɣisi chaŋ.
en: When the cloud stayed over the Tent for a long time, they obeyed the Lord and did not move on.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa chɛ ka o mini Sool labi, ka Sool ti jɛm Yawɛ.
en: Samuel went back with Saul, and Saul worshiped the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka n niriba zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu; Izraɛlnim zaɣisiya ni bɛ kul ku deei n noli.
en: But my people did not listen to me. Israel did not obey me.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa mini Karia bia Jɔhanan ni Hɔshaya bia Azaria ni niriba maa zaa, bihi zaŋ tabili ninkura daa chaŋ.
en: Then all the army leaders, including Johanan son of Kareah and Azariah son of Hoshaiah, came with people of every class.

dag: Ka so daa yɛl o, A tizɔbihi min a ma be samban ni m-bɔri ni bɛ nya a n-tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: Someone said to him, Look, your mother and brothers are outside wanting to speak with you.

dag: amaa n suhu daa bi doya n ni daa bi nya ti mabia Taitus nimaani la zuɣu. Dina n-daa chɛ ka n chɛbisi bɛn be nimaani ka chaŋ Masidɔnia.
en: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti niŋ bindirigu ti o nimaani, ka Maata kpuɣ bindirigu maa na ti zali, ka Lazarɔs gba daa be bɛn ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu maa ni.
en: Lazarus and his sisters hosted a dinner for him. Martha served and Lazarus was among those who joined him at the table.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, nahiŋgu nyɛla din chɛri ka yɛndan niŋdi jɛrigu, ka birapu dibu mi saɣindi nira.
en: Corruption makes fools of sensible people, and bribes can ruin you.

dag: Ka Jɛhoyakim daa ti kani ka o bia Jɛhoyachin di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoiakim died, and his son Jehoiachin succeeded him as king.

dag: Di mɔŋya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini kpibisi saria karibu din doli zaligu soli; ka di mɔŋya tarima mini nandana bɛ yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: Give justice to the lowly and the orphan; maintain the right of the poor and the destitute!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaai Naa Zɛdɛkia n-zaŋ o tahi Babilɔn Naa sani Ribila, ka o daa kar o saria.
en: So the Chaldeans captured the king and brought him back to the Babylonian king, who was at Riblah. There his punishment was determined.

dag: Ka kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb diri bɛ puri bindira, hal ka kpɛri gɔhi ni ti yihiri li; ka kɔnyuri ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb suhuri ye bɛ buni zuɣu.
en: Then hungry and greedy people gobble up their crops and grab their wealth.

dag: Nyamiya, m mali bipuɣins ayi bɛn na ʒi dɔbba, chɛliya ka n zaŋ ba tin ya na ka yi niŋ ba yi ni bɔri shɛm; ka di niŋ ya niriba ŋɔ shɛli, bɛ ni kpe n yili ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Look, I have two daughters who have never slept with a man before. I will give my daughters to you. You can do anything you want with them. But please dont do anything to these men. They have come to my house, and I must protect them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa ni niriba maa zaa daa bi deei Yawɛ ni yɛli ba ni bɛ ʒinimi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa.
en: So neither Johanan nor any of the army officers nor any of the people would obey the Lord 's command to remain in the land of Judah.

dag: Kaman nira ni so jinjɛŋŋmaa ka di tab o niŋgbuŋ shɛm la, lala ka n daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa mini Judanim tabi ma din ni chɛ ka bɛ nyɛ n niriba, ka n yuli du, ka n nya paɣibu mini jilima, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Just as shorts fit tightly around the waist, so I intended all the people of Israel and Judah to hold tightly to me. I did this so that they would be my people and would bring praise and honor to my name; but they would not obey me.

dag: N yi kpi n-do gballi ni, nyɔ bɔ ka n kum maa lee yɛn ti a? Taŋkpaɣu ni tooi paɣ a? Di ni tooi yɛl a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla?.
en: What will you gain from my death? What profit from my going to the grave? Are dead people able to praise you? Can they proclaim your unfailing goodness?.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli, N jilima naaya. N ni daa niŋdi binshɛŋa zaa tahima Yawɛ san la naaya.
en: I tell myself, I am finished! I can't count on the Lord to do anything for me.

dag: ka Avitinim me Nibihaz mini Taritak buɣili zali, ka Sɛfarivaimnim mi daa mali bɛ bihi nyɔri buɣim tiri Adirammɛlɛk mini Anammɛlɛk bɛn daa nyɛ Sɛravimnim buɣa la.
en: The Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak. The Sepharvites burned their children alive as a sacrifice to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the Sepharvite gods.

dag: Dan ni ti ŋmanila sokpaŋ tinvurigu. O nyɛla sokpaŋ gariŋga ŋun dimdi wɔhu napɔŋkpaa, ka ŋun bar o lɛbiri lur o kpali zuɣu.
en: You are a snake that bites the heel of a horse, making its rider fall.

dag: n-zaŋ li na ti zali Sool min o tumtumdiba maa tooni ka bɛ di, ka daa yiɣisi kuli yuŋ maa.
en: She set the food before Saul and his officers, and they ate it. And they left that same night.

dag: M pun yɛl a, Chɛ ka m bia maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma, ka a zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka o chaŋ, dinzuɣu n ni ku a bidib kpɛma.
en: I told you to let my son go, so that he might worship me, but you refused. Now I am going to kill your first-born son.

dag: Pa ŋun Hɛzɛkia n-daa wurim o buɣa maligu shee min o sara maligu bimbina zaa, ka zali Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima yɛli Bimbini yini kɔŋko gbini ka yi ni jɛmdi Naawuni ka maani sara di zuɣu la.
en: Isnt this the same Hezekiah who got rid of his shrines and altars, and then demanded of Judah and Jerusalem, You must worship and burn incense before only one altar?.

dag: Ka Shitirai ŋun daa nyɛ Sharɔn nir la daa lihiri naɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Sharɔn ka Shafat ŋun daa nyɛ Adilai bia la daa lihiri naɣ shɛb bɛn be vinvamli ni.
en: in charge of the cattle that grazed in Sharon—Shitrai the Sharonite; in charge of the cattle in the valleys—Shaphat, Adlais son.

dag: Nyɛvili din ka bahigu maa nyɛla ni ninsalinim baŋ nyin ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maŋli ŋɔ, ka baŋ man Yisa Masia so a ni timna la.
en: This is eternal life: to know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you sent.

dag: Daadam ŋun nyɛ paɣ ni dɔɣi so ŋɔ dabisa bi yaɣi lala, ka wahala n-kul pali di ni.
en: All of us are born of women, have few days, and are full of turmoil.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa wum Yisa yuli dubu yɛla.
en: At that time Herod the ruler heard the news about Jesus.

dag: Ka Rut daa shiri doli Bɔaz kachɛriba maa n-yihiri kayiha maa hal ka bɛ ti chɛ chi maa zaa naai. Ka Rut daa kul kpalim be o yidan ma maa sani.
en: And so, Ruth stayed close to the women, while picking up grain in his field. Ruth worked in the fields until the barley and wheat were harvested. And all this time she lived with Naomi.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti paai Siizaria Filipai tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka o bɔh o nyaandoliba, Niriba lee yɛri ni Daadam Bia nyɛla ŋuni.
en: Jesus went to the territory near the town of Caesarea Philippi, where he asked his disciples, Who do people say the Son of Man is.

dag: Ka o daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya sochanda ka o ʒi tiŋ maa sokpaŋa; ka ninkurigu maa bɔh o, Ya ka a yina? Bee ya ka a lee chana.
en: He noticed that the Levite was just in town to spend the night. Where are you going? the old man asked. Where did you come from.

dag: N di yuya ni o be n sani n-zan a zaani n-sɔŋdi ma n ni be sarika ŋɔ ni lahibal suŋ la zuɣu saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: I considered keeping him with me so that he might serve me in your place during my time in prison because of the gospel.

dag: ka Yɛhudianim maa daa zaŋ li leei bɛmaŋmaŋ mini bɛ zuliya ni ŋunkam yu ni o zaŋ omaŋ leei Yɛhudia nira kali. Ka di saha daa yi ti paai yuuni kam puuni, bɛ puhirila di chuɣu maa kaman di ni wuhi shɛm.
en: the Jews made it a rule for themselves, their descendants, and anyone who might become a Jew, that at the proper time each year these two days would be regularly observed according to Mordecai's instructions.

dag: Dinzuɣu Mɔabnima, kummiya! Sokam kummi Mɔabnim zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti kum Kiriharɛsɛt bindira zuɣu.
en: The people of Moab will weep because of the troubles they suffer. They will all weep when they remember the fine food they used to eat in the city of Kir Heres. They will be driven to despair.

dag: Yi zura, ka kuri niriba, ka niŋdi zina, ka ŋmari ʒiri pɔri pɔri, ka maani maligu tiri Baal, ka jɛmdi buɣ shɛŋa yi ni daa pun bi mi.
en: Will you steal and murder? Will you commit adultery? Will you falsely accuse other people? Will you worship the false god Baal and follow other gods that you have not known?.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Jɔn Baptaizira, ka shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Anabi Ilaija, ka shɛb mi yɛri ni a nyɛla anabinim la ni yino.
en: They told him, Some say John the Baptist, others Elijah, and still others one of the prophets.

dag: A ni tiligi pagɔrili ŋun nyɛ zinalana naŋgbammalisim ni.
en: Wisdom will rescue you from the mysterious woman, from the foreign woman with her slick words.

dag: Bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu n-nyɛ Hɛman mini Jɛdutun ni bɛ ni daa lan pii ninvuɣ shɛb zali ni bɛ paɣiri Yawɛ o yurilim din bi naara ŋɔ zuɣu la.
en: Heman and Jeduthun were their assistants, as well as the other men who had been chosen to praise the Lord for his never-ending love.

dag: A viɛlim zuɣu ni chɛ ka naa bɔr a. Ka o ni nyɛ a duuma la zuɣu, lum o sizuura.
en: Let the king desire your beauty. Because he is your master, bow down to him now.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni ka bɛ ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛl la niŋ pali: So m-birita, ka so mi chɛra.
en: So the saying proves true, Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.

dag: O darigiri bɛ tibili ka niriba nyara bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu;.
en: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil.

dag: Yi mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani zaligu yɛn nyɛla zaɣ yini, di nyɛla zaligu shɛli din kul yɛn be yi ʒiɛmana zaa ni. Yi mini tinzunnim zaa yɛn nyɛla yim Yawɛ sani.
en: This law will never change. I am the Lord , and I consider all people the same, whether they are Israelites or foreigners living among you.

dag: Ka maligumaana so ŋun ti zaŋ li mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu maa ni ti ŋub li. O ti ŋubim li luɣ kasi shee Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dundɔŋ ni.
en: The priest who offers the sin offering must eat it. But he must eat it in a holy place, in the courtyard around the Meeting Tent.

dag: ka o ti su Yaakubu zuliya sahakam, ka o nam ti ku mali bahigu.
en: He will rule over the people of Jacob forever; his kingdom will never end.

dag: N teeri yi yɛla zaa, ka kul paɣiri Naawuni yi zuɣu.
en: I thank God every time I remember you.

dag: Bɛ daa tuui zaŋ o tahila Annas sani, dama Annas daa nyɛla Kaiafas ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana di yuuni maa la deemba.
en: and brought him to Annas, the father-in-law of Caiaphas. Caiaphas was the high priest that year.

dag: Ka o daa lan pii Daniɛl mini niriba ayi shɛba m-pahi ni bɛ lihiri kpambaliba maa ka bɛ tumdi ŋun naa maa tuma ka di mali nyɔri.
en: and to set over them three main officers to whom they would report so that the king wouldnt have to be bothered with too much. One of these main officers was Daniel.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o sɔɣ omaŋmaŋ gballi ni. Ka bɛ daa kum o kuli yɛra, Mbaye, m mabia.
en: He buried the body in his own family tomb and cried for the prophet.

dag: Bɛ ni daa guni ba naai, Izraɛlnim zaa daa kpalim dola luɣ yini hal ka bɛn guni maa yuma ti naai zaa.
en: Joshua finished circumcising all the men. The people camped at that place until all the men were healed.

dag: Niriba maa daa yi ti nya ka sagbani maa ʒe suɣili maa dunol ni, sokam yiɣisirimi zan o suɣili dunol ni n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: So when the people saw the cloud at the entrance of the tent, they would go to the entrance of their own tents and bow down to worship God.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ n-daa yɛli ma.
en: Then I said to them, The word of the Lord came to me. He told me.

dag: Kika biɛɣu ni kum tiŋ ni, ka dabiɛm ku gbahi niriba? Yɛlibiɛɣu ni niŋ tiŋ ni, ka pa ni Yawɛ n-niŋ li?.
en: If people hear the warning blast of a trumpet, they shake with fear. If trouble comes to a city, the Lord caused it to happen.

dag: N Duuma ŋun nyɛ n tiligira ŋɔ, niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma!.
en: Come quickly and help me, my Lord, my salvation!.

dag: Ka Yisahaku yɛli Yaakubu, M bia, saɣisim mirina ka n shih a nya a shiri nyɛla m bia Iso bee a pa o.
en: Isaac said to Jacob, Please come closer so that I can touch you. Are you really Esau.

dag: Di simdi ka yi chɛ ka buɣim kul be sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu dira sahakam, di bi simdi ni di kpi.
en: The fire must always be kept burning on the altar and never allowed to go out.

dag: Ninsalinim ninvuɣ biɛtali dirimi kaman buɣim din diri suligunyinyari mini gɔhi ka diri neeri yɔɣu zaa, ka di nyɔhi kpuɣiri duri zuɣusaa la.
en: That evil was like a small fire that started among the weeds and thorns and then spread to the larger bushes in the forest. Finally, it became a giant fire, and everything went up in smoke.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla, yi na bi karim Anabi Musa ni daa sabi Naawuni ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa tutuɣu ni yɛli shɛm la yɛla? O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni.
en: As for the resurrection from the dead, havent you read in the scroll from Moses, in the passage about the burning bush, how God said to Moses, I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?.

dag: Yawɛ, m mi ni ninsalinim ni doli so shɛŋa maa, bɛ bi yurimi. Bɛ ni nyɛ daadamnim bɛn mali bahigu zuɣu bɛ ku tooi be viɛnyɛla.
en: I know, Lord , that we humans are not in control of our own lives.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai nti suhi Naawuni ti ba ni bɛ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: Peter and John went down to Samaria where they prayed that the new believers would receive the Holy Spirit. .

dag: Amaa zuliya shɛb bee nam shɛli din niriba zaɣisi ya jɛmbu, bɛ ni bahi yoli zaa.
en: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.

dag: Ka Sool daa po Yawɛ yɛli, Hal ka Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, a ku nya tibidarigibo shɛli dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Saul replied, I swear by the living Lord that nothing will happen to you because of this.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni yɛn pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la shɛm tarisi m-bɔŋɔ: Yisifu ni ti malila tarili buyi.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: These are the borders for dividing the land among the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph will have two parts.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa di zuɣu.
en: Make the poles from acacia wood and cover them with gold.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa bo salichee kɔriti omaŋa. O daa ʒila tampiligim ni.
en: Job sat on the pile of ashes where he was mourning and used a piece of broken pottery to scrape his sores.

dag: Ka o yɛli salo maa ni bɛ ʒinim tiŋa; ka daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin maa niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ zaŋ li tari salo maa; ka bɛ daa zaŋ li tari salo maa zaa.
en: He told the crowd to sit on the ground. He took the seven loaves, gave thanks, broke them apart, and gave them to his disciples to distribute; and they gave the bread to the crowd.

dag: ti daa ti zahimla zahindi yuŋ dahin yini, ka ti zaa yino kam zahindi daa mali di gbinni.
en: One night we both had dreams, and each dream had a different meaning.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Nakɔn kabɔɣili ni, ka naɣila shɛb bɛn daa vɔri tɔroko maa tuui, di saha ka Yuza daa teeg o nuu gbaai Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa mali.
en: But when they came to Nacon's threshing-floor, the oxen stumbled, so Uzzah reached out and took hold of the sacred chest.

dag: Ka zom maa ʒiʒiinitab mini bɛn daa pun mi ka o nyɛ barimaana la ti bɔhira, Pa doo ŋɔ n-yi ʒiya maani bara la.
en: His neighbors, then, and the people who had seen him begging before this, asked, Isn't this the man who used to sit and beg.

dag: Amaa ka ti daa yɛl o, Ti pala puɣisiriba, ti nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba.
en: We told him, We are honest men, not spies.

dag: Di saha maa ka o nyaandoliba maa daa baŋ ni Jɔn Baptaizira yɛla ka o yɛri ba maa.
en: Then the disciples understood Jesus was talking to them about John the Baptist.

dag: M paɣiri ti Duuma Yisa Masia ŋun ti ma yaa ni n tum ŋɔ. M paɣir o o ni lihi ma ka n simdi ni o pii ma ka n tum o tuma.
en: I give thanks to Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me strength for my work. I thank him for considering me worthy and appointing me to serve him.

dag: Amaa Naawuni nambɔzɔbo galisiya, ka o yurilim gba galisi zaŋ chaŋ ti polo.
en: But God is rich in mercy, and he loved us very much.

dag: Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim ni Hɛna ni Iva nanim la lee kpalim ya.
en: Where now is Hamaths king, Arpads king, or the kings of Lair, Sepharvaim, Hena, or Ivvah.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛnkam be yoma ni katiŋ zaa wum n ni niŋ shɛm ka baŋ ni m mali yiko.
en: You people in faraway lands, listen to what I have done. You people who are near me, learn about my power.

dag: Dundɔŋ maa wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla mita pihinahinaanahi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka yi ti zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli pateesa yil li, ka di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ti nyɛ daanya.
en: The courtyard will be one hundred fifty feet long and seventy-five feet wide. Its walls height will be seven and a half feet of fine twisted linen and its copper bases.

dag: Bɛ daa kpiya ka bɛ saha na bi paai kaman kom ni ʒiri tanzaa chani shɛm la.
en: Even before their time had come, they were washed away by a flood.

dag: Timiya ma soli ka n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka n yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa maa naai, di nyaaŋa, yin malimiya ma ansarisi.
en: Bear with me so I can speak, I myself; and after my reply you can mock.

dag: Di saha ka Ijiptinim zaa ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. A ni daa leei kariŋmaaŋa jaaŋgbee Izraɛlnim sani maa zuɣu.
en: Everyone living in Egypt will know that I am the LORD. Because they were a flimsy crutch for the house of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Izraɛlnima, ŋmaligimiya lab yi ni yi man so nyaaŋa pam la sanna.
en: God said, People of Israel, you have sinned against me and opposed me. But now, come back to me!.

dag: Amaa binshɛɣukam zaa yi ti be o naba ni, di saha Naawuni Bia maa maŋmaŋ gba ni ti zaŋ omaŋ ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ŋun zaŋ binshɛɣukam sɔŋ o naba ni maa, ka di chɛ ka Naawuni su binshɛɣukam zaa, ka nyɛ binshɛɣukam sokam zaa sani.
en: After everything has been put under Christ, then the Son himself will be put under God. God is the one who put everything under Christ. And Christ will be put under God so that God will be the complete ruler over everything.

dag: Yi chɛ ka yi yɛtɔɣa nyɔni Yawɛ nyee. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee chɛ ka o nyee nyɔni? Yi ni yɛra, Ŋunkam tum zaɣ biɛɣu, di nyɛla din viɛli Yawɛ sani, ka nyɛ o ni bɔri shɛl la. Bee yi ni bɔhira, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilan maa lee be ya la.
en: You have taught wrong things, and it makes the Lord very sad. People were doing evil things, but you said that this pleased the Lord and that he accepted those things. And you taught that God does not punish people for the evil they do.

dag: Ka bɛ ni so ti ku wuhi o kpee bee o mabia yɛra, Baŋmi ti Duuma! Sokam zaa ni ti mi ma, hal bɛn nyɛ tarimba zaŋ tabili wɔɣira.
en: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord. All of them will know me, no matter who they are.

dag: N yi darigi yi tibili ŋ-ŋɔ ka yi bi labi n sanna ka na kul kpɛrila yɔɣu.
en: If you remain my enemies after this.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa garigi yɛli Leeban, N daa zɔr a mi, dama n daa tɛhimi ni di pa shɛli ka a ti zaŋ kiŋkansi fa a bipuɣinsi maa n sani.
en: Jacob answered, I left without telling you, because I was afraid. I thought you would take your daughters away from me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa ka o sanna siɣimsiɣim buyi nti yɛl o ni o miri ka o jɛm buɣa la zaa yoli; Sulemaana daa zaɣisi Yawɛ noli ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ o jɛmbu. Ka Yawɛ daa je suli niŋ Sulemaana.
en: The Lord God of Israel had appeared to Solomon two times and warned him not to worship foreign gods. But Solomon disobeyed and did it anyway. This made the Lord very angry.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o suhudoo pina din nyɛ bɔrɔbɔro kpila din mali dabindi m-pahi o wumpaɣibo sara maligu maa zuɣu na.
en: In addition, you shall offer loaves of bread baked with yeast.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛlnim lan ka bidibisi? Bɛ lan ka falidiriba? Bɔzuɣu ka Milikom niriba kari Gaad zuliya ka ʒini bɛ fɔntinsi ni.
en: Concerning the Ammonites, the LORD proclaims: Doesnt Israel have children? Arent there heirs to his land? Why then has Milcom taken over Gad? Why have his people settled in its towns?.

dag: Ka Yisifu zuliya la daa ti bɔhi Jɔshua, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ tiŋgbani maa yaɣ yini polo din nyɛ din bi galisi ti ti? Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni zuɣu, ti galisiya pam.
en: The tribe of Joseph spoke to Joshua and said, You gave us only one area of land, but we are many people. Why did you give us only one part of all the land that the Lord gave his people.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi halibiɛri zuɣu ka Anabi Musa daa zali ya lala.
en: Jesus replied, Moses gave you this law because you are so heartless.

dag: Ka o daa ti tim ti yɛli Dauda, N tuhi nyaŋ Rabanim maa hal ka fa bɛ tin shɛli din mali kom la gba.
en: and sent a messenger to tell David: I have attacked Rabbah and captured the fortress guarding the city water supply.

dag: Ka a zaŋ binyɛra yɛli Aduna. Dina n-nyɛ: zabbanim mini alichɛbba ni binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa ni nyolɔrigu; ka zaŋ binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la shɛlɔrigu lo o.
en: Put the special clothes on Aaron. Put on him the white woven robe and the blue robe that is worn with the ephod. Put the ephod and the judgment pouch on him. Then tie the beautiful cloth belt on him.

dag: O daa chɛ ka teeku tiŋgbani leei zaɣ kuŋ, ka o niriba daa chaŋ bɛ naba zuɣu mɔɣili tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du. Ka ti daa mali suhupiɛlli o sani nimaani.
en: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.

dag: Pita ni daa kul ʒiya tɛhiri ʒii maa yɛla maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛl o, Nyama, niriba ata kana ti bɔr a.
en: Peter was still trying to understand what the vision meant, when the Spirit said, Listen! Three men are here looking for you.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kɔzɔrim yi tampiŋ ni na n-zɔri kaman mɔɣa kom la.
en: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.

dag: Mɔabnim daa zaŋla piɛbila n-yi Sɛla din be tiŋgban nɛli polo la kana ti ti ŋun diri nam ʒi Jɛrusalɛm la.
en: From the city of Sela in the desert the people of Moab send a lamb as a present to the one who rules in Jerusalem.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti puhiri yiri kom maa ni na, o dii nyami ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi zuɣusaa na kaman ŋmani la nti tam o zuɣu.
en: As Jesus was coming up out of the water, he saw the sky torn open. The Spirit came down on him like a dove.

dag: Ka zaŋya taaŋkɔro tim ʒi shɛli yi ni taɣi niŋ taha ni zali la ni n-zaŋ vie yi dunoya zuɣusahi mini dunɔpaɣira, ka di chɛliya ka so doli dunoli maa yi hal ni asiba.
en: Take bunches of hyssop and dip them in the bowls filled with blood. Paint the blood on the sides and top of each doorframe. No one must leave their house until morning.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha ka Baasha daa ku Nadab, ka di nam zan o zaani.
en: Baasha killed Nadab in the third year of Judahs King Asa and ruled in Nadabs place.

dag: Pɛriʒia mini Lidia ni Libia tɔbbihi daa nyɛla bɛn be a tɔbbihi bɛn nyɛ a tɔbutuhiri biinsi la ni. Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ nyɔtaɣirisi mini bɛ kuriti zuɣupila sɔŋ a ni. Bɛ daa tir a jilima.
en: Brave soldiers from Persia, Lydia, and Libya served in your navy, protecting you with shields and helmets, and making you famous.

dag: Hanania bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pɛlatia mini Jɛshaya ni o bia Rɛfaya ni o bia Arinan ni o bia Obadia ni o bia Shɛkania.
en: Hananiah had two sons, Pelatiah and Jeshaiah. Jeshaiah was the father of Rephaiah, who was the father of Arnan, the father of Obadiah, the father of Shecaniah.

dag: Ka daa gbaai gbarigu maa nudirigu n-yiɣis o zali, ka o naba min o napɔŋkpuɣila dii teei n-kpaŋ zaa.
en: Then he grasped the mans right hand and raised him up. At once his feet and ankles became strong.

dag: Bɛ leeri nanima, ka bi niŋdi ma saawara. Bɛ piiri kpamba, amaa ka m bi mi di yɛla. Bɛ zaŋdi bɛ salima mini bɛ daanzinfa maani binnana din yɛn bahi bɛn maŋmaŋ yoli.
en: They set up kings, but not through me; they chose princes, but without my knowledge. With silver and gold they crafted idols for their own destruction.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa lan labina ti yɛl o, Naa, A mi ni Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianim zaligu shɛŋa naa ni zali ku tooi taɣi.
en: But these men, all ganged together, came and said to the king, You must realize, Your Majesty, that the law of Media and Persia, including every law and edict the king has issued, cannot be changed.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, labisim doo maa paɣa ti o; dama o nyɛla anabi, ka o suhi Naawuni ti a ka a be. Amaa a yi bi labis o ti o, nyin baŋmi ni biɛhiŋ kani a min a ni su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni kpi.
en: Her husband is a prophet. Let her go back to him, and his prayers will save you from death. But if you don't return her, you and all your people will die.

dag: O daa zaŋla o ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa yiɣisi zo n-chaŋ ti gbaai Yufretiiz Mɔɣili du n-zaŋ o zuɣu kpa zoya ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Giliad la polo.
en: He took everything he owned and left in a hurry. He crossed the Euphrates River and started for the hill country of Gilead.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi maa ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas Isikariɔt la daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba sani.
en: Then one of the Twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests.

dag: Yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma m-bo yɛlli ŋɔ tin ya. Di mali ya. Di biɛri pam! Di nyooi yi suhuri.
en: Judah, you have brought this on yourself by the way you have lived and by the things you have done. Your sin has caused this suffering; it has stabbed you through the heart.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa ʒiri pina kani Jɛrusalɛm na nti tiri Yawɛ, ka tiri Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia neen viɛla ka di daa chɛ ka zuliya kam tibig o di saha maa zaŋ chana.
en: Many people brought offerings to the LORD in Jerusalem and costly gifts to Judahs King Hezekiah, who was highly regarded by all the nations from then on.

dag: M bia wumma, deemi n yɛligu ka nya nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: Listen to me, my child. Take seriously what I am telling you, and you will live a long life.

dag: yimaŋmaŋ di ʒiɛnya nimaani, amaa yinim karimiya doli yi dimnim maa nyaaŋa nti liri ba, ka di chɛliya ka bɛ zo m-paai bɛ ya, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: But you and everyone else must keep going after the enemy troops, because they will be safe if they reach their walled towns. Don't let them get away! The Lord our God is helping us get rid of them.

dag: Luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti bɛ ni zaŋdi sara maligu shɛli nyɔri buɣim biŋkɔbiri la, nimaani ka bɛ yɛn kɔriti taali sanyoo biŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ bɛ ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini luɣilikam.
en: The animal for this offering is to be killed on the north side of the altar, where the animals for the burnt offerings are killed, and its blood is to be thrown against all four sides of the altar.

dag: Amaa sokam zaa ni o saha: Masia n-nyɛ ŋun daŋ tooni; ka o ni ti yɛn su shɛb o labbuna saha mi naanyi paya.
en: But everyone will be raised to life in the right order. Christ was first to be raised. Then, when Christ comes again, those who belong to him will be raised to life.

dag: Dama a yi zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ, biɛɣuni n sa ni tahi toli a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na.
en: If you keep on refusing, then I will bring locusts into your country tomorrow.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi baɣa be yi taba yɛla ni kaman di ni be yimaŋmaŋ yɛla ni shɛm.
en: Instead of each person watching out for their own good, watch out for what is better for others.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dindali maa Gɔg yi ti kana ti liri Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ, n suhu ni yiɣisi pam.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, On the day when Gog invades Israel, I will become furious.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Baasha daa ti chaŋmi ti liri Judanima, ka me Rama zali ni o chɛ ka so ku lan tooi yi Juda Naa Asa sani chaŋ luɣ shɛli bee n-yi shɛli polo ka o sanna.
en: Once Baasha attacked Judah and then built up the city of Ramah to keep Asa from leaving Judah on any kind of military campaign.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa deei gbaŋ maa tuumba maa sani karim; ka kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nti teei li sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni.
en: Hezekiah took the letters from the messengers and read them. Then he went to the temple and spread them out before the LORD.

dag: Naa Uzia ni daa niŋ binshɛŋa pahi o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, anabi Aizaia ŋun daa nyɛ Amɔz bia la daa sab li.
en: Everything else Uzziah did, from beginning to end, is written by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

dag: Di saha ka Nɛbukadnɛza suhu daa yiɣisi pam ka o je suli, ka o ninni biɛhigu taɣi zaŋ chaŋ Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo polo, ka yɛl o niriba ni bɛ malim buɣim maa n-chɛ ka di bii ʒii buyopɔin zuɣu n-gari di ni yi pun biiri shɛm.
en: Nebuchadnezzar's face twisted with anger at the three men. And he ordered the furnace to be heated seven times hotter than usual.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam, yin di kpuɣiya yi putarisi zaa daatam bee ka yi ti lan labi ti yihi binyiha yi daatam kpuɣibu maa nyaaŋa.
en: When you cut your crops at harvest time, dont cut all the way to the corners of your fields. And if grain falls on the ground, you must not gather up that grain.

dag: Ka ŋun daŋ tooni daa yina m-mɔha, ka o niŋgbuŋ zaa mali kɔbiri m-be kaman biŋkɔbigu kɔbiri siturili la; ka bɛ daa bol o yuli Iso.
en: the first baby was covered with red hair, so he was named Esau.

dag: Yisa mini ba ni daa laɣim maa ka o yɛli ba ni bɛ di yi Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ luɣ shɛli, amaa ni bɛ kul guhim hal ka bɛ ni wum ŋun Yisa sani ni o ba Naawuni lo ba alikauli shɛl la ti niŋ pali.
en: While he was still with them, he said: Don't leave Jerusalem yet. Wait here for the Father to give you the Holy Spirit, just as I told you he has promised to do.

dag: Dama n yi kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa n ti kuhirimi ka tahi yɛli, Duŋtaabo mini saɣiŋgu! Dama nyin Yawɛ yɛligu maa leela turi mini ansarisi bini n sani asiba hal ni yuŋ.
en: Every time I open my mouth, I cry out and say, Violence and destruction! The LORDs word has brought me nothing but insult and injury, constantly.

dag: ka yɛra, Naawuni chɛ o bahi; doliy o ti gbaag o, dama so kani n-ni fa o bahi.
en: They say, Go get him! God has left him, so there is no one to help him.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yiɣisi zo, ka o yiŋ nim zaa daa yiɣisi dol o. Naa daa naɣ chɛla o mamanim pia niŋ nayili maa puuni ni bɛ maani li.
en: So the king left, with his entire household following him, but he left ten secondary wives behind to take care of the palace.

dag: dindina wula ka tinim ni tooi zo n-yi tibidarigibo maa ni, ti baɣa yi ka tiliginsim din galisi ŋɔ ni? Ti Duuma maŋmaŋ daa tuui yɛli tiliginsim maa yɛla, ka bɛn daa wum o yɛligu di o shɛhira ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: So surely we also will be punished if we dont pay attention to the salvation we have that is so great. It was the Lord Jesus who first told people about it. And those who heard him proved to us that it is true.

dag: Nimaani ka Yawɛ ni su zuliya shɛb chana. Di nyɛla zaligu Izraɛlnim sani ni bɛ paɣi Yawɛ nimaani.
en: That is where the tribes go up— the LORDs tribes! It is the law for Israel to give thanks there to the LORDs name.

dag: O daa saɣim bɛ wain tihi mini bɛ fiig tihi, ka chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tihi zaa kab lu.
en: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.

dag: Teem a daba bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu yɛla, ka di doli niriba ŋɔ tipawumli bee bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali bee bɛ daalahichi ŋɔ.
en: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and do not pay any attention to the stubbornness, wickedness, and sin of this people.

dag: Nyamiya, Balaam ni daa wuhi yikombiɛlim so shɛl la ni, bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum din bie zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani Pɛɔr yɛla la ni, ka alɔbo daa lu Yawɛ niriba zuɣu la.
en: These very women, on Balaams advice, made the Israelites break faith with the LORD in the affair at Peor, so there was a plague among the LORDs community.

dag: Di saha ka n yura maa yɛli Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanima, Nyamiya m mini n tihi puu ŋɔ yɛla ŋɔ.
en: My friend said, You people living in Jerusalem and you people of Judah, think about me and my vineyard.

dag: dama bɛ zaa daa nya o ka dabiɛm gbahi ba pam. Ka o dii yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Chɛliya ka yi suhuri kpɛma! Mani m-bala.
en: It scared them all to see him. But he spoke to them and said, Dont worry! Its me! Dont be afraid.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ni n ni yɛn tiligi n niriba yuun shɛli paaya, ka n ni yɛn darigi n niriba dimnim tibili saha shɛli gba paai.
en: I decided that the time to save my people had come; it was time to punish their enemies.

dag: Saha paaya ni saria karibu piligi; Naawuni niriba mi n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn daŋ tooni saria karibu maa ni. Ka di yi piligi ti sani, wula ka di ni ti bahindi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi deeri Naawuni lahibal suŋ la sani?.
en: because its time for judgment to begin with Gods own household. But if judgment starts with us, what will happen to those who refuse to believe Gods good news?.

dag: Sulemaana daa yuri Yawɛ, ka dol o ba Dauda ni daa zal o shɛm, o daa naɣ maanila sara maligunim ka tuɣindi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbina zuɣu.
en: Solomon showed that he loved the Lord by obeying everything his father David told him to do, except that Solomon continued to go to the high places to offer sacrifices and to burn incense.

dag: Dunia ni ti zaɣi n-kuui zaa; ka sagbana mini dunia zaa zaɣi.
en: The earth dries up and wilts; the world withers and wilts; the heavens wither away with the earth.

dag: N ni lan kpaŋsi bɛ ʒiɛyimtali n sani. N ni yuri ba ni n suhu zaa, dama n suhuyiɣisili zaŋ chaŋ bɛ sani maaya.
en: I will heal their faithlessness; I will love them freely, for my anger has turned from them.

dag: Ka bɛ kul maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bɛ ni nyɔr li buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la n-tiri Yawɛ asiba mini zaawuni sahakam kaman di ni sabi Yawɛ fukumsi zaligu shɛl o ni daa zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim la puuni shɛm.
en: Every morning and evening Zadok and the other priests offered burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of burnt offerings. They did this to follow the rules written in the law of the Lord , which he had given Israel.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa suhi Yawɛ ti o paɣ maa, dama o daa nyɛla paɣiŋoo; ka Yawɛ daa deeg o suhigu maa, ka chɛ ka o paɣ Ribɛka niŋ pua.
en: Because Rebecca had no children, Isaac prayed to the Lord for her. The Lord answered his prayer, and Rebecca became pregnant.

dag: O nam dibu yuma ata saha ka o daa laɣim o kpambaliba min o tuma zuɣulaannim na ni bɛ ti puhi bindira dibu mini binnyura nyubu chuɣu. Pɛriʒia mini Miidia tɔbbihi zuɣulaannim gba daa beni nti pahi gomnanim mini tiŋgbana maa nabihi.
en: During the third year of his rule, Xerxes gave a big dinner for all his officials and officers. The governors and leaders of the provinces were also invited, and even the commanders of the Persian and Median armies came.

dag: Dama buɣim daa yi Hɛshibɔn na, ka buɣim niɛm daa yi Sihɔn fɔŋ ni na. Di daa di Ar din be Mɔab la, ka di Arinɔn zoya zuɣu.
en: His armies marched out like fiery flames, burning down the town of Ar and destroying the hills along the Arnon River.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bol o na ka o min o ti di ka nyu, ka Dauda daa chɛ ka o nyu dam kuli, ka di daa ti niŋ yuŋ ka o yi samban ni nayili guliba maa sani nti dɔni o bindoo zuɣu, ka daa bi kul o yiŋa.
en: David invited him for dinner. Uriah ate with David, who gave him so much to drink that he got drunk. But Uriah still did not go home. He went out and slept on his mat near the palace guards.

dag: N ni yihi tɔbutuhiri chɛchɛbunsi Ifriim, ka yihi yuri Jɛrusalɛm; ka kab tɔb shɛŋa bɛ ni mali tuhiri tɔbu. Yi naa maa ni tim sandaani zuliya ni zuliya sunsuuni. O ni su teeku noli zaŋ ti kpa di tarisi. Yufretiiz Mɔɣili noli zaŋ ti kpa dunia tariga.
en: He will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the warhorse from Jerusalem. The bow used in battle will be cut off; he will speak peace to the nations. His rule will stretch from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the earth.

dag: Ka shɛb mi yɛli, Di kpa ti la talahi ni ti paŋ liɣiri n-yo farigu ti puri mini ti wain tihi puri zuɣu naa sani.
en: And still other people were saying, We have to pay the kings tax on our fields and vineyards. But we cannot afford to pay, so we are borrowing money to pay the tax.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Gaad zuliya paya. Gaad niriba maa toondan n-yɛn nyɛ Riuɛl bia Ɛliasaf.
en: On the other side will be the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph son of Deuel as the leader of its , troops.

dag: Gbarigu napɔna ni bi shihiri tiŋ shɛm, lala ka jɛrigu ŋahili gba be.
en: As legs dangle from a disabled person, so does a proverb in the mouth of fools.

dag: Bee m mini Baanabas kɔŋko n-ka soli ni ti chɛ ti nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuma tum dihi timaŋa?.
en: And are Barnabas and I the only ones who must work to earn our living?.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti niŋ Lɛvinim yi baɣaka saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: But be sure that you always share these meals with the Levites. Do this as long as you live in your land.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛli Naawuni, Ti tum alahichi, amaa ti suhir a zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, fam ti bahi; ka niŋ ti a ni bɔri ni a niŋ ti shɛm.
