en: But the people of Israel said to the Lord , We have sinned. Do whatever you like, but please, save us today.

dag: Kamiyana ti nya Naawuni ni tum tuun shɛŋa, o tuma mali dabiɛm pam ninsalinim sani.
en: Come and see Gods deeds; his works for human beings are awesome.

dag: dama ŋun puh o gba leela ŋun pah o zuɣu tum o tuumbiɛri maa.
en: because welcoming people like that is the same thing as sharing in their evil actions.

dag: Amaa dilan yi ku tooi nyaŋ piɛɣu, dindina ŋun bom ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi na ti ti Yawɛ o ni tum taal shɛli maa zuɣu. Ka yino ti nyɛ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ so nyo buɣim mali sara.
en: If you cannot afford a lamb, you must bring two doves or two young pigeons to the Lord . These will be the guilt offering for your sin. One bird must be for a sin offering, and the other must be for a burnt offering.

dag: Bɛnaaya ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ wɔɣirili ŋun be ninvuɣ pihita la ni, ka nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana. O bia Amizabad n-daa nyɛ ŋun zan o zaani n-su o niriba maa fukumsi.
en: He was the same Benaiah who was a brave soldier from the Thirty Heroes. He led these men. His son Ammizabad was in charge of Banaiahs group.

dag: Ka o daa shiri fa ba bahi m-mali ba ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa, ka wuhiri shihira Ijipti tiŋ puuni mini Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni ni mɔɣu ni yuun pihinahi.
en: So Moses led the people out of Egypt. He worked wonders and miraculous signs in Egypt, at the Red Sea, and then in the desert for years.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛl kpamba maa zaa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Ti pun pola Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ka lo ba alikauli maa, dinzuɣu ti ku tooi niŋ ba shɛli pumpɔŋɔ.
en: But the leaders answered, We have given our promise. We promised before the Lord , the God of Israel. We cannot fight against them now.

dag: Di ti Sintani soli hal biɛla!.
en: Dont provide an opportunity for the devil.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nahim Izraɛlnim ka niŋ ba alaka pam di yuuni maa ni. Yuun pisaayika ka bɛ daa nahim Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli Amɔrinim tiŋgban shɛli din be Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Starting that year and for the next eighteen years, they beat and bullied the Israelites, especially all the Israelites who lived on the east side of Jordan in the territory of the Ammonites in Gilead.

dag: Amaa bumbil tuuli kam, yin zaŋmiya piɛɣu zal o zaani, ka yi yi bi niŋ lala, dindina yin ŋmɛlimiya kab o nyiŋgoli. Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ binshɛli taɣi yi bidib tuuli kam, ka so miri ka o ti ka n sanna ni nu zaŋa.
en: but you are to buy back every first-born donkey by offering a lamb in its place. If you do not buy it back, break its neck. Buy back every first-born son. No one is to appear before me without an offering.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ninsalinim zɔr o; o bi lihi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lihi bɛmaŋ yɛnnim la.
en: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni hal Sulemaana min o jilima zaa ha, o daa bi ye situra ka di viɛli kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom zaɣ yini gba viɛlim.
en: But I tell you that Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of them.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka di kul yɛn be lala? A suhuyiɣisili kul yɛn beni la sahakam? A nyuli zabbu suhuyiɣisili maa yɛn dirimi kaman buɣim la?.
en: Our Lord , will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim mini ʒiŋmariba bihi ŋɔ, ŋuni ka yi lee maani ansarisi? Bee ŋuni ka yi lee mɛrigiri yi noya niŋda?.
en: Whom are you mocking? Against whom do you open your mouth wide and stick out your tongue? Arent you children of rebellion, offspring of lies.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim pala ti ni niriba; lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa yi ti ni. Bɛ yi di daa nyɛla ti ni niriba, bɛ daa naan kpalim be ti sani. Amaa bɛ daa yi ti ni ni di kahigi wuhi ni bɛ zaa pala bɛn be ti ni.
en: They went out from us, but they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But by going out from us, they showed they all are not part of us.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ daa kul teei gilila tiŋ maa hal ti paai Naa Zɛdɛkia nam dibu yuun piniyini saha.
en: The city of Jerusalem was surrounded by the army of Babylon until the eleventh year that Zedekiah was king.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa tɔɣisi nabihi maa mini niriba maa zaa yɛtɔɣa n-yɛli, Yawɛ n-tim ma na ni n ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi jɛmbu duu ŋɔ mini tiŋ ŋɔ yi ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa ŋɔ puuni.
en: Then I told the judges and everyone else: The Lord himself sent me to tell you about the terrible things he will do to you, to Jerusalem, and to the temple. But if you change your ways and start obeying the Lord , he will change his mind.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ mi ni n nuu zuɣu tuma ka n daa zaŋ dihi m mini n dolintaba, hal ka daa yɛli ba situra pahi.
en: You know how I have worked with my own hands to make a living for myself and my friends.

dag: Ka paɣ maa bɔh o, N dana, a ka guuka, ka kɔbiliga ŋɔ mi zilim pam; ka wula ka a lee yɛn niŋ nya nyɛvili kom maa?.
en: Sir, the woman said, you don't have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where would you get that life-giving water?.

dag: ka m bi zaŋ m piɛri kɔbiri situra ti o ka o pili ka paɣi ma o suhu ni.
en: and I was praised for supplying woolen garments to keep them warm.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ bi kɔŋ zaligu zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, dama Masia zaligu sulinsi ni ka m be, amaa n yi chaŋla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli fukumsi zaligu sani, m bemi kaman ŋun bi doli fukumsi zaligu ni di chɛ ka n tooi tiligi bɛn bi doli fukumsi zaligu maa.
en: I act like Im outside the Law to those who are outside the Law, so I can recruit those outside the Law .

dag: ni o chɛ ka binshɛɣukam mali zani dɛde daadam mini Naawuni sani kaman nir min o ʒiʒiinikpee la.
en: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa mali alahichi sanyoo sara maa n-yo ŋun yi daɣiri ni maa daalahichi samli. Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kɔrigi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara biŋkɔb so nyɔri buɣim la.
en: Then the priest shall offer the sin offering and perform the ritual of purification. After that, he shall kill the animal for the burnt offering.

dag: Wulinluhili polo tiŋgbani maa tariga daa nyɛla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku la. Tintariga bɔbili maa n-daa gili Juda zuliya maa niŋ sunsuuni.
en: which formed the western border. Within these borders lived the people of the families of Judah.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ; o ni deei n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir o ni o zom ma nambɔɣu la zuɣu.
en: Praise the Lord ! He has heard my prayer for mercy.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ sahakam. Ami, ami.
en: Praise the Lord forever! Amen and Amen!.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya ti ti bɛ suɣa zali gbilligbilli nuzaa polo. Dan zuliya niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Ammishadai bia Ahiɛza.
en: Dan and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the north side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The , troops of the tribe of Dan will be arranged by divisions and led by Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm a nuu tiri zuɣusaa ka zibisim titali zibigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, ka sokam ti kpalim bɔbinda.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Raise your hand toward the sky so that darkness spreads over the land of Egypt, a darkness that you can feel.

dag: Ti ni ti wum wumpaɣibo yila din tibigiri Wuntialan ŋɔ dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Amaa ka n yɛli, Mbusim paai ma. N lan ka tahima, dama bilikɔɣinim kul tumdila bɛ bilikɔnsi tuma pahira.
en: From the ends of the earth we have heard songs: Glory to the righteous one! But I say, I waste away; I waste away; Im doomed! Betrayers betray; treacherously betrayers betray.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb daa tahiri yɛra, ŋ-ŋɔ nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ; ka bɛn la mi yɛra, ŋ-ŋɔ nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ; dama salo daa kul tahirila yiriŋ, hal bɛ shɛb daa bi mi din chɛ ka bɛ laɣimna.
en: Some people were shouting one thing and others were shouting something else. The meeting was very confused. Most of the people did not know why they had come there.

dag: Amaa yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka gbibiya yi maŋ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi ku tam yi nina ni daa nya binshɛŋa la bee n-chɛ ka di yi yi suhuri ni saha shɛli zaa yi ni be yi nyɛviya ni ŋɔ; zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi mini yi yaansi.
en: But you must be careful! Be sure that as long as you live you never forget what you have seen. You must teach these things to your children and grandchildren.

dag: O zaŋ li bahi sagbana tiŋli zaa, ka chɛ ka o saanyaɣisibu paai dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: He sends the lightning across the sky, from one end of the earth to the other.

dag: Yiɣisim zabi n zuɣu, n Duuma ni n Naawuni! Yiɣisim mali n yɛla maa ti ma!.
en: Wake up! Get up and do justice for me; argue my case, my Lord and my God!.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi la daa lo ni bɛ ku dansarikanim maa, dama ni di yi pa lala bɛ ni duɣi kom maa du n-zo n-tiligi.
en: The soldiers decided to kill the prisoners so that none of the prisoners could swim away and escape.

dag: Ka o daa kuhi pam ka Ijiptinim ti wum o kuhigu maa, hal ka Firawuna yiŋnim gba ti wum o kuhigu maa.
en: He wept so loudly that the Egyptians and Pharaohs household heard him.

dag: Ka biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn ni chɛ ka yi kpe daɣiri ni m-bɔŋɔ, ka ŋunkam shihi bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛlikam ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: You make yourself unclean by the following animals—whoever touches their dead bodies will be unclean until evening.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu, hal n ni mali suhukpeeni Masia zuɣu ni n tooi wuh a di ni niŋ kamaata ni a niŋ shɛm la zaa yoli.
en: Therefore, though I have enough confidence in Christ to command you to do the right thing.

dag: Yi mi ni dali nyɛla Yaɣigari Chuɣu, ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia ti ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: In two days, as you know, it will be the Passover Festival, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.

dag: Ŋunkam bi yuri ma je ni o doli n yɛligu. Yɛl shɛŋa yi ni wumdi ŋɔ pala n dini, amaa di nyɛla m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa dini.
en: Whoever doesnt love me doesnt keep my words. The word that you hear isnt mine. It is the word of the Father who sent me.

dag: ka di daa niŋ niriba maa suhupiɛlli pam, dama bɛ daa zaŋ li ti Yawɛ ni suhu yini ka di nyɛ bɛ suhuyubu. Ka di daa niŋ Naa Dauda gba nyaɣisim pam.
en: The people rejoiced at this response, because they had presented their offerings to the LORD so willingly and wholeheartedly. King David also rejoiced greatly.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ garigi yɛli naa maa, Daniɛl ŋun nyɛ Juda daba la ni yino la bi lihi nya a bee n-dol a ni zali zaligu shɛli maa. O kul suhirila o Naawuni siɣimsiɣim butata dahin yini puuni.
en: The men then told the king, That Jew named Daniel, who was brought here as a captive, refuses to obey you or the law that you ordered to be written. And he still prays to his god three times a day.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N Duuma, bɛ ni so bi lan yɛl lala. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Man gba bi yɛli ni a simdi kubu. Cham a chandi, amaa ka di lan tum alahichi yaha. .
en: She said, No one, sir. Jesus said, Neither do I condemn you. Go, and from now on, dont sin anymore.

dag: dama mani n-nyɛ ŋun pɔri o tuumba maa zaa ni, hal ka m bi simdi ni bɛ boli ma o tumo gba, n ni daa niŋ Naawuni cheechi alaka la zuɣu.
en: All the other apostles are greater than I am. I say this because I persecuted the church of God. That is why I am not even good enough to be called an apostle.

dag: Mbusim be dunia ŋɔ zuɣu binshɛŋa din be di ni n-chɛri ka niriba birigiri tumd alahichi zuɣu! Biriginsim din ni kpɛhi nira alahichi ni ku chɛ, amaa mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun chɛ ka o kpee birigi zuɣu.
en: How terrible for the world that there are things that make people lose their faith! Such things will always happen—but how terrible for the one who causes them!.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa lo o nia biɛɣu. Ka naa daa bahi ba noli ka bɛ lab kuɣa ku o Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni.
en: King Joash joined in a conspiracy against Zechariah, and on the king's orders the people stoned Zechariah in the Temple courtyard.

dag: Di ni leei tim tib a niŋgbuŋ, ka chɛ ka a niŋgbuna maai.
en: Then your body will be healthy and your bones strengthened.

dag: Ka Abijam daa ti leei ŋun kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Asa daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Abijah died, he was buried in the City of David. Abijahs son Asa became the new king after him.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ wumya ni Sool ni ka Kɛila ŋɔ na nti wurim li n zuɣu.
en: Then David said, LORD God of Israel, I, your servant, have heard that Saul plans on coming to Keilah and will destroy the town because of me.

dag: Ka bɛ naa ŋun be bɛ sani ni ti kah o nɛma buɣ o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu zaawun yuŋ yi, ka bɛ ti chibi gooni voli ka o doli dini yi. O ni ti zaŋ bini pil o nina din ni chɛ ka o nini ku nya tiŋgbani.
en: The leader of Jerusalem will lift his own bag to his shoulders at sunset and leave through a hole that the others have dug in the wall of his house. He will cover his face, so he can't see the land he is leaving.

dag: Ti Duuma, a ni nam zuliya shɛb la zaa ni kana ti gbani a tooni tibig a yuli.
en: All the nations that you have created will come and bow down to you; they will praise your greatness.

dag: Gbibiya Vuhim Dabisili ka chɛ ka di be kasi kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya shɛm.
en: Show respect for the Sabbath Day—it belongs to me.

dag: N kuhirila pampam niŋdi Yawɛ. N kul suhirila Yawɛ pampam ni o zo ma nambɔɣu.
en: I call to the Lord for help; I plead with him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe ŋariŋ ni yiri kpaŋa.
en: So Jesus and his followers went away alone. They went in a boat to a place where no one lived.

dag: Amaa a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm yi pɔri ŋɔ taali ni nyɛla a yi chaŋ n dɔɣiriba maa sani, ka bɛ ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku ti a paɣ na, dindina a yi m pɔri maa taali ni.
en: But if you go to my fathers country, and they refuse to give you a wife for my son, you will be free from this promise.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda mini niriba kɔbisinahi daa kul be niriba maa naba biɛhibu ni. Ka niriba kɔbisiyi la bɛn daa gbarigi pam, ka kɔŋ Bɛso kulibɔŋ maa dubu.
en: David continued on his way with four hundred men; the other two hundred men were too tired to cross the brook and so stayed behind.

dag: Nyama, n kpahi n nuhi bah a zuɣu a ni zaŋ zalinsi soya nya bun shɛŋa maa min a ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb a ni la zuɣu.
en: I will bring my fist down on your robberies and murders.

dag: Di saha n ni ti chɛ ka di koma niŋ viɛlim, ka chɛ ka di kulibɔna kom zɔri kaman kpam la. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will let your waters settle and become clear and let your rivers run calm. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka a niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti tum alahichi a sani, ka bɛ dimnim nyaŋ ba tɔbu ni, bɛ yi ŋmaligi lab a sanna n-kuhi bol a yuli ka suh a duu ŋɔ ni.
en: Sometimes your people Israel will sin against you, and their enemies will defeat them. Then the people will come back to you and praise you. They will pray to you in this Temple.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya li, ka tɛhi di yɛla, ka lan lihi li, ka deei wuhibu di ni.
en: I observed this and took it to heart; I saw it and learned a lesson.

dag: Ti Duuma, teemi bɛ ni maani mani a dabili ŋɔ ansarisi shɛm la yɛla; teemi niriba ni turi ma tu shɛŋa la zaa yɛla.
en: My Lord, please remember how people insulted your servant. Lord , I had to listen to all the insults from your enemies. They insulted your chosen king wherever he went.

dag: Yi zaa laɣimmiya na nti wum! Wun ŋuni n-lee pun yɛli dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla zali? Yawɛ ni pii ninvuɣ so la ni niŋ o ni lo ni o niŋ Babilɔnnim shɛm. O ni tuhi Babilɔnnim maa.
en: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?.

dag: Amaa zaŋmiya bi biɛ yoli ŋɔ ti bahi kpaŋ ha, zibisim ni be shɛl la. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: Now take the worthless servant and throw him out into the farthest darkness. People there will be weeping and grinding their teeth.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa pun zaŋ fɔntinsi maa kɔbu paliti mini di tiŋkpansi tila Jɛfune bia Kalɛb ka di leeg o dini.
en: However, the fields of the city, as well as its towns, had already been given to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.

dag: Ka Chɛrubi ŋun maa gba kpiŋkpaŋ yini din wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla la daa chaŋ ti shihi dukpini. Ka kpiŋkpaŋ din la, din gba wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla maa mi daa chaŋ ti shih o kpee la kpiŋkpaŋa.
en: Similarly, one wing of the other creature was seven and a half feet long and touched the temple wall, while the other wing was seven and a half feet long and touched the other creature.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yolitim zaŋ chaŋ n ni niŋ wahala nya shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni maa polo.
en: So I became sad about all the work I had done.

dag: O chɛ ka sokam chɛ o tuma, ni di chɛ ka bɛ tɛhi ŋun Naawuni tuma yɛla.
en: God does this to stop everyones work and to show the people he made what he can do.

dag: Dama ti bi be kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali Naawuni yɛligu n-niŋdi kaman neen shɛŋa bɛ ni kɔhiri alaha, amaa ti nyɛla yɛlimaŋlinima ka nyɛ Naawuni ni pii shɛb tim, ka zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, ti nyɛla bɛn tɔɣisiri Masia yɛla.
en: We are not like so many others, who handle God's message as if it were cheap merchandise; but because God has sent us, we speak with sincerity in his presence, as servants of Christ.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn ʒiini nyuri wain yuura ni binnyuri kpɛma balibubalibu.
en: those who linger over wine; those who go looking for mixed wine.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka ti tim Judas mini Silas ni bɛ ti yɛli ya ti ni sab yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ bɛmaŋmaŋ nol ni pahi.
en: So we have sent Judas and Silas with them. They will tell you the same things.

dag: Ka bɛn daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa bɔhi, Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi.
en: When the crowd heard this, they asked, How can anyone ever be saved.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi ti booi kpam maa bahi tahili la mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu, ka di leei din be kasi.
en: Also dedicate the washbasin and its base in the same way.

dag: A zaligunim nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Yawɛ, a jɛmbu duu nyɛla din simdi ni di kul be kasi sahakam.
en: Lord , your laws will continue forever. Your holy Temple will stand for a long time.

dag: Judas ni daa deei laɣ shɛli o daalahichi tumbu ni la, o daa zaŋ li dala palo, ka daa ti lu ka o zuɣu sani tiŋa, ka o puli tahi ka o nyɔri zaa yina.
en: Judas was paid money for doing this. His money was used to buy him a field. But he fell on his head, his body broke open, and all his intestines poured out.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka chɛrubinim la daa wuɣi bɛ kpiŋkpama mini din daa baɣi ba la zuɣusaa, ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa be bɛ zuɣusaa.
en: Then the Cherub angels raised their wings and flew into the air. The wheels went with them. The Glory of the God of Israel was above them.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka vi gbahi ba, ka sokam baŋ a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Lord , cover them with shame until they come to you for help.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai waɣ biɛ titali ŋun nyɛ kurimbuni ha waɣ so bɛ ni booni Fiɣisira ni Sintani la n-lo o ni o sɔŋ yuun tuhili.
en: He seized the dragon, the old snake, who is the devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.

dag: Amaa zaligu ŋɔ ka n daa naɣ zali ba, Deemiya n noli, ka n nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka yi mi nyɛ n niriba, ka yi tumdi n ni zali ya ni yi tummi shɛm, ka biɛhigu niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani.
en: Rather, this is what I required of them: Obey me so that I may become your God and you may become my people. Follow the path I mark out for you so that it may go well with you.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba maa daa saɣi ni bɛ ku lan deei liɣiri niriba maa sani; ka lan saɣi ni bɛn maligumaaniba maa ku mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money or be in charge of the temple repairs.

dag: Ti zaa nyɛla alahichinima, ka ti wuntia tuma zaa ŋmanila binchɛr biɛri. Ti daalahichi zuɣu chɛ ka ti ŋmanila vari din kuui n-suui lu ka pɔhim ʒe li bahi.
en: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.

dag: Teemiya n dabili Musa wuhibu la yɛla; n ni daa zal o zali kpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi Sinai Zoli gbini ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim zaa la.
en: Don't ever forget the laws and teachings I gave my servant Moses on Mount Sinai.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ di vi, ka dabiɛm mali ba sahakam; ka chɛ ka bɛ kpi ni vi.
en: May they be forever ashamed and afraid. Disgrace and defeat them.

dag: N ni boli n niriba n-laɣim ba. N ni fa ba bahi, ka chɛ ka bɛ kalinli zooi kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: I will call my people and gather them together. I will rescue them and make them as numerous as they used to be.

dag: dama bɛ wahala dibu zahimbu pam nyabu puuni mini bɛ ni kul nyɛ faranim la zaa yoli, bɛ suhupiɛlli din galisi pam zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ tɔhiri tɔto ni bɛ suhuri zaa.
en: While they were being tested by many problems, their extra amount of happiness and their extreme poverty resulted in a surplus of rich generosity.

dag: nti bi nya Yisa siliga maa ni; ka labina ti yɛli ti ni bɛ naɣ nyala malaikanim ʒii, ka malaikanim maa yɛli ba ni o neei kum ni.
en: but could not find his body. They came back saying they had seen a vision of angels who told them that he is alive.

dag: Ka Juda daa yɛl o ba Izraɛl, Chɛ ka bia maa doli ma ka ti yiɣisi chaŋ, ka di chɛ ka ti mini ya ni ti bihi ŋɔ ku kpi.
en: Judah said to his father Israel, Send the young man with me. Lets get ready to leave so that we can stay alive and not die—we, you, and our children.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa tam Naawuni yɛla ŋmanila lala. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni tahima ni zani tariga.
en: Such is the hopeless future of all who turn from God.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa sabi zaligu shɛli Musa ni daa pun sab zal la pa kuɣa maa zuɣu Izraɛlnim ninni.
en: There Joshua copied onto the stones the law Moses had written down. This was for all the people of Israel to see.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ahija, Nyama, Naa Jɛrɔbɔam paɣ kanna ni o ti bɔh a nya din yɛn niŋ o bia ŋun ka alaafee. A ni ti yɛn yɛl o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O ni daa ti paai, o daa taɣila o biɛhigu ni o be kaman paɣ so la.
en: But the Lord said to him, Jeroboams wife is coming to ask you about her son because he is sick. I will tell you what to say to her. When she came to Ahijahs house, she pretended to be someone else.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu Naawuni ni daa ti buɣisi ti yab Ibrahimma saha shɛl la, o daa zaŋ Yisahaku mali sara ŋun Naawuni sani. Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa nyɛ Naawuni ni lo so alikaulinim la zaa yoli, o daa saɣiya n-zaŋ o bi gaŋ Yisahaku mali sara Naawuni sani.
en: It was faith that made Abraham offer his son Isaac as a sacrifice when God put Abraham to the test. Abraham was the one to whom God had made the promise, yet he was ready to offer his only son as a sacrifice.

dag: yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Gɔg ŋun nyɛ Mɛshɛk mini Tubal nazuɣu ŋɔ, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa.
en: and say, The LORD God proclaims: I challenge you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal!.

dag: Dabisili din pah ayi dali, Zua bia Nɛtanɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Isaka zuliya zuɣulan la n-daa mali sara.
en: On the second day Nethanel, Zuars son, the chief of Issachar, presented his offering.

dag: O ni darigi bɛ tibili kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm. O suhu ni yiɣisi bah o dimnim zuɣu pam, ka o bɔhi ba biɛri. Hal o ni bɔhi bɛn be tiŋgban shɛŋa din be katiŋ gba biɛri kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: He will punish his enemies according to what they have done, even those who live in distant lands.

dag: Ti Duuma wurim Yaakubu zuliya ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa, ka bi zo ba nambɔɣu. O suhuyiɣisili pam puuni ka o daa wurim Juda bipuɣiŋga yaa ni be luɣ shɛli polo la. O chɛ ka nama mini di nanim lu tiŋa n-nya filiŋ.
en: The Lord destroyed the houses of Jacob. He destroyed them without mercy. In his anger he destroyed the fortresses of Daughter Judah. He threw the kingdom of Judah and its rulers to the ground. He ruined the kingdom of Judah.

dag: O nyaandoliba ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ je suli ka yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka paɣ ŋɔ saɣim tulaale maa lala?.
en: But when his disciples saw this, they became angry and complained, Why such a waste?.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A shiri ni saɣi kpi n zuɣu? Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, a ni ti chihi paai siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma ka nolɔɣu na bi kum.
en: Would you really die for me? Jesus asked. I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.

dag: Puhimiya tab yurilim puhigu! Naawuni tim yinim bɛn nyɛ Masia ni su shɛb la zaa suhudoo!.
en: Greet each other with the kiss of love. Peace to you all who are in Christ.

dag: O ni daa nya ka lala niŋbu tiɣi Yɛhudianim nini zuɣu ka o daa gbaai Pita gba. Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la puhibu saha ka o daa niŋ lala maa.
en: When Herod saw that this pleased the Jewish people, he had Peter arrested during the Festival of Thin Bread.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka Yawɛ wuhiri ya la zaligu yiniyini mini wuhibu yiniyini ni kuligakuliga ni biɛlifu kpe ni biɛlifu kpe. O niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka yi lɛb lu yi kpaya zuɣu n-nya dansi, ka zana gbahi ya, ka bɛ zaŋ ya chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: So the Lord s words will be senseless sounds to them: Saw lasaw saw lasaw. Qaw laqaw qaw laqaw. Zeer sham zeer sham. When the people try to walk, they will fall backwards. They will be defeated, trapped, and captured.

dag: Niriba ni yɛli a yiko tuma din mali dabiɛm ŋɔ yɛla, ka n gba yɛli a ni galisi shɛm yɛla.
en: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.

dag: Di ŋmariya ʒiri ka mali n yuli pɔri pɔri, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi dihi yi Naawuni yuli vi. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must not use my name to make false promises. If you do that, you will show that you dont respect the name of your God. I am the Lord !.

dag: a ni daa zaŋ ti a daba bɛn nyɛ anabinima ka bɛ zaŋ ti ti ka yɛra, Yi ni kuni tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ni yi ti deei li su maa nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba ni zaŋ bɛ din chihiri tumbu saɣim tiŋgbɔn shɛli. Bɛ chɛ ka tuumbiɛri maa yɛligi gili di luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: that were given to us by your servants the prophets. They said the land you are giving us is full of sinful and wicked people, who never stop doing disgusting things.

dag: Niriba pam yɛr ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒe yim, amaa bɛ ni ŋuni n-lee nyɛ nir ni yɛn dihi so tabili?.
en: Many people will say that they are loyal, but who can find a reliable person?.

dag: A daŋ maa nyɛla din ni ku nira, ka binshɛli din maari biɛrim mi kani. Bɛnkam zaa wum a yɛla, bɛ kpahirila bɛ nuhi. Dama bɛ ni ŋuni ka a lee bi niŋ a ninkuunsi din ka naabu ŋɔ?.
en: There is no remedy for your injury; your wound is grievous. All who hear the news about you clap their hands over you. Who has not suffered from your continual cruelty?.

dag: Dindali maa Ijiptinim ni ti ŋmanila paɣiba, dabiɛm ni ti kpe ba ka bɛ ni sɔhira, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni ti yɛn doli so shɛli liri ba zuɣu.
en: On that day, the Egyptians will be like women and will tremble with terror before the hand that the LORD of heavenly forces will raise against them.

dag: Ɛlikana daa yi kɔrigi binshɛli m-mali sara dahin shɛli o ŋmahirila nimdi tar o paɣ Pɛnina min o bidibisi ni o bipuɣinsi zaa.
en: Each time Elkanah offered his sacrifice, he would give one share of the meat to Peninnah and one share to each of her children.

dag: Zoomba nina neera, ka wɔbisi chana, ka kɔnsi tibiri kpaŋda, ka tikpiranim wumda, hal ka kpiimba gba neeri kum ni, ka lahibal suŋ waazu mi yihiri tiri tarimba.
en: The blind can see. The crippled can walk. People with leprosy are healed. The deaf can hear. The dead are brought back to life. And the Good News is being told to the poor.

dag: Dama ti ni daa naan ku tooi sɔŋ timaŋa saha shɛl la dɛde, ka Yisa Masia daa kpi alahichinim zuɣu.
en: Christ died for us at a time when we were helpless and sinful.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ku Sirianim maa chɛchɛbunduhiriba tusaayopɔin mini tɔbbihi bɛn chani tiŋa tuhi pihinahi. Ka o daa lan ku Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ Kamɔna kpɛm maa, ka Sirianim maa daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Izraɛlnima.
en: the Arameans fled before Israel, and David killed seven thousand Aramean chariot drivers and forty thousand foot soldiers. Shophach the commander of their army was killed too.

dag: dama o nyɛla Naawuni ni zali so a sɔŋsim zuɣu. Amaa a yi tum birigi, nyin zom dabiɛm, dama o bi sula fukumsi maa yoli; o nyɛla Naawuni ni zali so ni o zaŋ ŋun Naawuni suhuyiɣisili darigi bɛn tum birigi tibili.
en: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.

dag: Samarianim pam daa niŋ Yisa yɛda paɣ la ni daa yɛli ni Yisa yɛl o binshɛɣukam zaa o ni pun niŋ la zuɣu.
en: Many Samaritans in that city believed in Jesus because of the womans word when she testified, He told me everything Ive ever done.

dag: Bindirigu maa dibu nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ wain pipia ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli palli n ʒim ni. Kul nyumiya li waawaayili teemi n yɛla.
en: He did the same thing with the cup, after they had eaten, saying, This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Every time you drink it, do this to remember me.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔh o, Ka daɣila Yawɛ suhu yula bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti ŋun Yawɛ mini sara pina n-gar o noli deebu? Nyama, noli deebu gari sara maligu, ka o yɛligu wumbu mi gari piɛla kara.
en: Then Samuel replied, Does the LORD want entirely burned offerings and sacrifices as much as obedience to the LORD? Listen to this: obeying is better than sacrificing, paying attention is better than fat from rams.

dag: Yi dim nahu bee o buŋ yi chihi chani ka yi nya o, yin taɣim o labisi ti ti o.
en: If you happen to see your enemy's cow or donkey running loose, take it back to him.

dag: Saha shɛli yi yi ti yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ, Aduna min o bidibisi bɛn kpɛm suɣili maa ni nti yiligi pateesa shɛli din yiliya la n-zaŋ li pili Alikauli Adaka la.
en: The Lord gave Moses the following instructions. When it is time to break camp, Aaron and his sons shall enter the Tent, take down the curtain in front of the Covenant Box, and cover the Box with it.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni baansi. Bɛ daa nyɛla bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba m-be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni duri ni tumdi tuma wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa. Bɛ daa bi lan tumdi tuun shɛli pahi di zuɣu.
en: The singers were the heads of the households of the Levites. They lived in temple rooms and were free from other service because they were on duty day and night.

dag: Shihira ŋɔ ni ti be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ lahibal suŋ maa yɛda yɛligu ni: Bɛ ni ti mali n yuli karit alizin biɛri, ka ni ti tɔɣisi tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa.
en: And the people who believe will be able to do these things as proof: They will use my name to force demons out of people. They will speak in languages they never learned.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn be dahima biɛhigu Ziɔn zuɣu. Mbusim be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be luɣ viɛlli shee Samaria Zoli zuɣu ŋɔ zuɣu. Yinim bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya ninvuɣ kara bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni kani shɛb sanna nti bɔri sɔŋsim ŋɔ.
en: Do you rulers in Jerusalem and in the city of Samaria feel safe and at ease? Everyone bows down to you, and you think you are better than any other nation. But you are in for trouble!.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaanu ni kɔbisinahi.
en: His military unit and those enlisted in it are .

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa zaŋ Sool min o tumtumda maa kpɛhi du tital ni nti ti ba ʒiishe gahinda bɛ ni daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb na maa sani, niriba maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ pihita laasabu.
en: Then Samuel led Saul and his servant into the large room and gave them a place at the head of the table where the guests, about thirty in all, were seated.

dag: Chɛ ka wuntitali be o ʒiɛman ni, ka chɛ ka suhudoo pam beni kaman goli ni beni ka o neesim be shɛm la sahakam.
en: May righteousness flourish in his lifetime, and may prosperity last as long as the moon gives light.

dag: N nyɛla Yɛhudia nira. Bɛ dɔɣi ma la Taasus, Kilikia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, amaa n zoola Gamaliɛl sani ya ŋɔ; ka bɔhim n yaannim zaligunim mini bɛ kaya yɛla o sani, ka n suhu ye Naawuni zuɣu kaman yi zaa ni niŋdi shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: I am a Jew, born in the city of Tarsus in Cilicia. But I grew up here in Jerusalem where I was a student of Gamaliel and was taught to follow every single law of our ancestors. In fact, I was just as eager to obey God as any of you are today.

dag: Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa ni yɛli shɛm maa tuhiya. Timiya ba bɛ tarili bɛ ba mabihi maa sani, ka bɛ ba tarili leei bɛ dini.
en: The daughters of Zelophehad are right. They should share the land with their fathers brothers. So give them the land that you would have given to their father.

dag: Amaa di nyɛla nyini ŋun nyɛ n kpee ni m mini ŋun doli ni n zo simo.
en: But it is you, the one so close to me, my companion, my good friend, who does this.

dag: Dinzuɣu suhimiya Naawuni ka o chɛ ka yɛla ŋɔ ti ku niŋ tu kikaa saha;.
en: Pray that it won't happen in winter.

dag: Ti yaannim mini ti nanim ni ti zuɣulaannim ni ti maligumaaniba daa zaɣis a fukumsi zaligu la dolibu, ka daa lan zaɣisi a zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la mini zuɣu ni kpahibu yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa a ni daa zaŋ ti ba la.
en: Our kings, leaders, priests, and fathers did not obey your law. They didnt listen to your commands. They ignored your warnings.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Miriya ka yi yɔhim yimaŋ yɛra, Babilɔnnim maa shiri zoya ka chɛ ti, dama bɛ ku zo ka chɛn ya.
en: I, the Lord , warn you not to deceive yourselves into thinking that the Babylonians will not come back, because they will.

dag: Di niŋ a zo yɛda, a mi di niŋ a ni yuri so naani. Gbaam a noli yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ paɣa so ŋun do m-baɣa sani.
en: Dont rely on a friend; put no trust in a companion; guard the doors of your mouth from she who lies in your embrace.

dag: Amaa n yi ti neei kum ni, n ni daŋ yi tooni chaŋ Galili.
en: But after Im raised up, Ill go before you to Galilee.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpahind o, ka tim niriba ni bɛ ti niŋ kaman bɛ nyɛla bɛn nini mooi yɛlimaŋli zuɣu la m-puɣisi gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o niŋ gomnanti fukumsi ni.
en: The legal experts and chief priests were watching Jesus closely and sent spies who pretended to be sincere. They wanted to trap him in his words so they could hand him over to the jurisdiction and authority of the governor.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sakuɣa luna ku bɛ niɣi, ka chɛ ka saa tahi ku bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu.
en: He killed their animals with hail and their cattle with lightning.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gaad ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda daanab la.
en: Then the Lord said to Gad, David's prophet.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim zani; di chɛ ka ninsalinim yaa gari a yaa! Chɛ ka zuliya kam ka a sanna ka a ti kari ba saria.
en: Come, Lord ! Do not let anyone defy you! Bring the heathen before you and pronounce judgment on them.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ bi simdi ni di gari ti, dama Sintani gba lɛbigir omaŋa m-be kaman neesim malaika n-nyɛ o la.
en: Well, no wonder! Even Satan can disguise himself to look like an angel of light!.

dag: Di dubihi mini di pilanim ni di zɔŋ mini dina la zaa daa nyɛla yim, ka takɔriti be di puuni zaa gili ni di zɔntua ni. Di ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: Its rooms, arches, and porch measured the same as the others, as well as its windows and porch all the way around. It was seventy-five feet long and thirty-seven and a half feet wide.

dag: Ɛdom yɛla ni ti mali dabiɛm. Ŋunkam ti gari nimaani dabiɛm ni gbaag o, ka di gar o yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa zaa din yɛn niŋ nimaani la zuɣu.
en: Edom will be destroyed. People will be shocked to see the destroyed cities. They will whistle from amazement at the destroyed cities.

dag: Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa ni daa wum bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa, ka o zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-jɛm Yawɛ.
en: Abraham's servant bowed down and thanked the Lord .

dag: Yi bi da tulaale viɛlli ti ma bee n-zaŋ yi sara maligu biŋkɔbiri kpam ti ma. Amaa yinim lee chɛmi ka yi daalahichi yɛla muɣisi ma, ka chɛ ka n nyee nyɔni yi tuumbiɛri.
en: You didn't buy incense for me or satisfy me with the fat of your animals. Instead you burdened me with your sins; you wore me out with the wrongs you have committed.

dag: Amaa hal yi ni sari li ka di daari pum dindali, ka neeri biɛɣu zoori la zaa yoli, di ku wali ka yi pɔhi li; di kul yɛn tin ya la nandahima ni biɛrim.
en: But even if they sprouted and blossomed the very morning you planted them, there would still be no harvest. There would be only trouble and incurable pain.

dag: O daa tuɣindila tulaale zim Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli la ni, ka doli Yawɛ ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbɔn maa ni ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini la ni daa tumdi din chihiri shɛl la soli n-zaŋd o bidibisi nyɔri buɣim maani buɣa.
en: He burned incense in the Valley of Ben Hinnom and sacrificed his own sons by burning them in the fire. He did the same terrible sins that the peoples living in that land did. The Lord had forced them out when the Israelites entered that land.

dag: Bɛ mali tiba, amaa bɛ ku tooi wum; bɛ mi bi vuhira.
en: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.

dag: Ka di lahibali daa ti nti to Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ daa tim Baanabas Antiɔk.
en: News of what was happening reached the church in Jerusalem. Then they sent Barnabas to Antioch.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Ahimɛlɛk bia Abiata ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la, Zaŋmi tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru la ti ma na. Ka Abiata daa zaŋ tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru maa na ti ti Dauda.
en: and he said to the priest, Abiathar, let's ask God what to do. Abiathar brought everything he needed to get answers from God, and he went over to David.

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o jaaŋgbee maa tiri Ijipti tiŋgbani maa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka pɔhim yi wulimpuhili polo na n-ʒe dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu ti yɛn neei ka pɔhim maa ʒi toli na.
en: Moses held out his walking stick, and the Lord sent an east wind that blew across Egypt the rest of the day and all that night. By morning, locusts.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ bi wuhiri ni so pun nya m Ba maa; naɣila ŋun yi ŋun Naawuni sanna la n-naɣ nyɛ ŋun nya o.
en: No one has seen the Father except the one who is from God. He has seen the Father.

dag: Ti valim ba zaɣ nɛma kaman kpiimba biɛhigu shee ni niŋdi shɛm la. Ti ni vali ba zaɣ muna kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe gballi ni.
en: Lets swallow up the living like the grave— whole, like those who go down into the pit.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala n-chɛ ka bɛ zaa ʒini.
en: After the disciples had done so.

dag: Ka anabi Ilaija daa sabi gbaŋ ti o na yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a yab Dauda Naawuni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A bi dol a ba Jɛhɔshafat soli bee n-doli Juda Naa Asa naba.
en: One day, Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet that said: I have a message for you from the Lord God your ancestor David worshiped. He knows that you have not followed the example of Jehoshaphat your father or Asa your grandfather.

dag: Ti yi yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti kpe tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, kum be di ni, ka ti ni kpi; ka ti mi yi ʒi kpe, ti ni kpi. Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Sirianim sansani ŋɔ ni, bɛ yi ti chɛ ti, ti ni be; ka bɛ yi ti ku ti, ka ti dii kpi.
en: If we decide, Lets go into the city, the famine is there, and well die in the city. But if we stay here, well die just the same. So lets go and surrender to the Aramean camp. If they let us live, well live. If they kill us, well die.

dag: M bɔri ni n yɛli ya n ni mɔri mɔ shɛli yi mini Laodisianim ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi mi ma ni nini la zuɣu yɛla.
en: Let me tell you how hard I have worked for you and for the people in Laodicea and for all others who do not know me personally.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm leei tampuli, ka leei kunduna biɛhigu shee. N ni chɛ ka Juda fɔndi zan dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: I heard the Lord reply, When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.

dag: Yi tibidarigibo dali, wula ka yi lee ti yɛn niŋ, ka zaɣ biɛɣu ni ti yɛn yi katiŋ na ti paai ya dahin shɛli, wula ka yi lee ti yɛn niŋ? Ŋun sani ka yi lee ti yɛn zo n-chaŋ ti bo sɔŋsim bee luɣ dini ka yi lee ti yɛn zaŋ yi daazichi sɔŋ?.
en: What will you do when God punishes you? What will you do when he brings disaster on you from a distant country? Where will you run to find help? Where will you hide your wealth?.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, n lo nia ni n niŋ alibarika niŋ Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim ni, dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: But now I have changed my mind. And in the same way I have decided to be good to Jerusalem and to the people of Judah. So dont be afraid!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Dinzuɣu tihi puu maa lana yi ti kana, wula ka o lee yɛn niŋ padiriba maa.
en: When the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenant farmers.

dag: Nyama, n chɛ ka a nini kpɛma n-gari bɛ nini ni kpɛm shɛm, ka chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma n-gari bɛ suhuri ni kpɛm shɛm.
en: Now I will make you as stubborn and as tough as they are.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛl o nyaandoliba, N kamina ni n ti niŋ buɣim juui dunia ŋɔ, ka n di bi zaɣisi ka di pun taai dira.
en: I came to set the earth on fire, and how I wish it were already kindled!.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋme n-ku nira, bɛn kum o gba.
en: Whoever hits someone and kills him is to be put to death.

dag: Ka naa mini Haman daa chaŋ ni bɛ mini Ɛsta ti laɣim di.
en: The king and Haman were dining with Esther.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bahi noli ni bɛ cham ti gbaai Daniɛl na nti niŋ gbuɣima bɔɣili maa ni. Naa maa daa yɛli Daniɛl, A ni jɛmd a Naawuni so viɛnyɛliŋga maa ni fa a bahi.
en: So Darius ordered Daniel to be brought out and thrown into a pit of lions. But he said to Daniel, You have been faithful to your God, and I pray that he will rescue you.

dag: Bɛ ni ti va bɛ yiŋ daazichi chaŋ, Naawuni suhuyiɣisili dali ka bɛ ti yɛn va li maa.
en: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.

dag: Yi mi ni Masia daa kana ni o ti kpihimla ninsalinim daalahichi, ka alahichi ka o ni.
en: You know that Christ came to take away peoples sins. There is no sin in Christ.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, N yi nya wuntizɔriba pihinu Sɔdom puuni, n ni chɛ bɛ taali maa bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord answered, If I find fifty innocent people in Sodom, I will spare the whole city for their sake.

dag: Ka sapashinnim maa daa niŋ kaman maligumaana Jɛhɔiada ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa. Ka bɛ zaa daa zaŋ bɛ niriba bɛn bi yɛn be tuma ni mini bɛn yɛn be tuma ni Vuhim Dabisili dali n-ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada sanna.
en: The captains obeyed everything that Jehoiada the priest commanded. Each captain took his men, both those who were going on duty on the Sabbath day and those who were going off duty. All these men went to Jehoiada the priest.

dag: Dama o ni ŋubiri mɔ shɛŋa bela zoya ni luɣ shɛli mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa ni diɛmda.
en: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *.

dag: Ka o daa lu soli n-kariti anab maa naba nti nya o ka o ʒila oki tia gbini, ka o bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ anab so ŋun yi Juda na la? Ka o garigi yɛli Iin, mani.
en: and rode off to look for the prophet from Judah. The old prophet found him sitting under an oak tree and asked, Are you the prophet from Judah? Yes, I am.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa kpaŋsi Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Juda gomna la mini Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Maligumaaniba Zuɣulaan la ni niriba maa zaa suhuri, ka bɛ yiɣisi n-gbaai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu.
en: So the Lord God All-Powerful made everyone eager to work on his temple, especially Zerubbabel and Joshua.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the Lord said:.

dag: Yisahaku daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihinii dunia yili.
en: Isaac lived to be a hundred and eighty years old.

dag: N ku chɛ ka n suhu ŋmaligi ka chɛ din tuhi. N ku tum zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: A corrupt heart will be far from me. I wont be familiar with evil.

dag: ka gbilisiri tibili wumdi n ni timdi n dab shɛb bɛn nyɛ anabinim yi sanna la yɛligu, dama yi pun bi gbilisiri tibili wumdi li.
en: You must listen to what my servants say to you. The prophets are my servants. I have sent my prophets to you again and again, but you did not listen to them.

dag: Ka ti daa yɛl o, Ti ku tooi labi. Ti tizo ŋɔ yi ku dol ti chaŋ, dindina ti ku chaŋ; dama ti tizo maa yi ka ti sani, doo maa nini ku nya ti.
en: We answered, We cannot go; we will not be admitted to the man's presence unless our youngest brother is with us. We can go only if our youngest brother goes also.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi siliga maa gbini zo yomyom, dama di daa gari ba mi pam ka bɛ ni sɔhira; bɛ mi daa bi yɛli so shɛli sol ni, dama dabiɛm daa kpe ba. .
en: When the women ran from the tomb, they were confused and shaking all over. They were too afraid to tell anyone what had happened.

dag: Yi mi ni dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa o ni daa ti bɔri alibarika o ba san la, o daa bi tooi nya li, dama o daa bi nya soli din ni doli taɣi o ni daa tum shɛm la hal o ni daa kul bo li ni nintam la zaa yoli.
en: You remember that after Esau did this, he wanted to get his fathers blessing. He wanted that blessing so much that he cried. But his father refused to give him the blessing, because Esau could find no way to change what he had done.

dag: O ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa din nyɛ o ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Yawɛ san la zuɣu, ka o daa kpi lala maa. O daa dolila Jɛrɔbɔam soli min o daalahichi shɛŋa o ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la soli.
en: Zimri had disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zali Izraɛl zuɣulaannim ni bɛ sɔŋm o bia Sulemaana, ka lan yɛli ba.
en: Then David ordered all of Israels leaders to help his son Solomon.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa tim tuumba Dauda sani Hiburɔn ni bɛ ti yɛl o, Ŋuni n-lee lan su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ? Chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli, ka n sɔŋ a n-zaŋ Izraɛlnim zaa na ti ti a.
en: Abner sent messengers to represent him to David and to say, Who will own the land? Make a covenant with me, then Ill help bring all Israel over to your side.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa mali buni ka lan mali jilima pam, ka o daa ti bɔri paɣa Ɛhab sani ni o ti o daŋ ni so.
en: When King Jehoshaphat of Judah became rich and famous, he arranged a marriage between a member of his family and the family of King Ahab of Israel.

dag: Yɛlimiya m ba n ni nya jilima shɛli zaa Ijipti ŋɔ mini yimaŋmaŋ nini ni nya shɛlikam zaa. Niŋmiya yomyom chaŋ ti zaŋ m ba kuli kpe na.
en: Tell my father about my power in Egypt and about everything youve seen. Hurry and bring my father down here.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka bɛ ŋmaligi yi tooni guui, ka kari ba ka bɛ zo ka chɛn ya. Ka yi deei bɛ tiŋgbana maa su kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa pun lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: But the Lord your God will force the people living there to leave. You will take that land. The Lord will force them to leave, just as he promised.

dag: O yi je suli, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani? O suhi yi yiɣisi pam, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi beni? O suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila buɣim, ka tampima wurind o zuɣu.
en: When he is angry, who can survive? Who can survive his terrible fury? He pours out his flaming anger; rocks crumble to dust before him.

dag: Yi ni lo shɛli yi suhuri ni maa ku niŋ. Yi ni tɛhi shɛm nyɛla, chɛ ka ti gba be kaman zuliya shɛb ni be shɛm tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka jɛmdi dari mini kuɣa.
en: You keep saying you want to be like the other nations. You live like the people in other nations. You serve pieces of wood and stone idols.

dag: Bindir maŋli nyɛla ninkura bɛn zaŋ bɛ tɛha bɔhim baŋ zaɣ suŋ mini zaɣ biɛɣu woligibu ni nyɛ shɛm dini.
en: Solid food, on the other hand, is for adults, who through practice are able to distinguish between good and evil.

dag: Buɣa palila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ jɛmdi bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: His land is full of gods that the people bow down to worship. They made those idols themselves.

dag: Chɛ ka o doli wuntia soli kariti a niriba saria, ka doli zaligu kariti a tarimba saria.
en: so that he will rule over your people with justice and govern the oppressed with righteousness.

dag: Amaa ka a bi so ŋun zaŋ a buni chaŋ ti nahi pagɔra ŋɔ lee ti kuna, ka a gbaari naɣila kpabili kɔrigir o zuɣu.
en: This other son of yours wasted your money on prostitutes. And now that he has come home, you ordered the best calf to be killed for a feast.

dag: Di ti tumiya tuma, amaa lee ti malimiyala bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ.
en: You must not do any work. You must bring an offering as a gift to the Lord .

dag: O ni ti di nasara o yɛŋkiŋkabina min o ninvuɣ yɔhimbo soya puuni. O ni ti duh omaŋa, ka ni ti bahi niriba pam yoli n-libigi ba. Hal o ni ti mo nanim zaa Naa, amaa o ni ti bahi yoli ka ninsal nuu ka di ni.
en: Because he is cunning, he will succeed in his deceitful ways. He will be proud of himself and destroy many people without warning. He will even defy the greatest King of all, but he will be destroyed without the use of any human power.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa zaa daa lab Giligal sansani maa ni.
en: After this, Joshua and his army went back to the camp at Gilgal.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai waɣ biɛ titali ŋun nyɛ kurimbuni ha waɣ so bɛ ni booni Fiɣisira ni Sintani la n-lo o ni o sɔŋ yuun tuhili.
en: He chained the dragon for , years. It is that old snake, who is also known as the devil and Satan.

dag: To, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisifu kuli Ijipti, ka tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa guli Firawuna la sapashin kpɛm ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti nir ka o yuli booni Pɔtifa la daa da o Ishimail zuliya bɛn daa ʒi o kuli nimaani maa sani.
en: Now the Ishmaelites had taken Joseph to Egypt and sold him to Potiphar, one of the king's officers, who was the captain of the palace guard.

dag: Pa ti ninni ka bindira maa zaa zani m-bahi yoli, ka suhupiɛlli mini nyaɣisim lan ka ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu?.
en: Our food is gone. Joy and happiness are gone from the Temple of our God.

dag: Ŋun zo n-tiligi maa kandina dazɔhigu dali zaawuni, Yawɛ nuu daa pala n zuɣu. Amaa ŋun zo n-tiligi maa ni daa paai n sanna asiba saha shɛli maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka n zilinli lɛbigi, ka n noli yaai, ka n-tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa.
en: The evening before he came, I had felt the powerful presence of the Lord . When the man arrived the next morning, the Lord gave me back the power of speech.

dag: Yi ni deei Yisa Masia n-leei yi Duuma la zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi min o laɣim be.
en: You accepted Christ Jesus as Lord, so continue to live following him.

dag: bɛ ni tooi zaŋ li duhi, amaa ninvuɣ suma n-ni ye li, ka bɛn ka taali mi ti pirigi anzinfa maa ti taba.
en: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.

dag: Ka o yiŋlan maa yɛl o, Nyin bi biɛ vinnyaɣilan ŋɔ! A mi ni n dirila n ni bi di binshɛli wahala, ka kpuɣiri n ni bi di atam shɛli wahala bebɔ?.
en: You bad and lazy servant! his master said. You knew, did you, that I reap harvests where I did not plant, and gather crops where I did not scatter seed?.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim leeg a dahalali niriba sahakam; ka nyin Yawɛ nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: You took Israel to be your people forever, and you, Lord , became their God!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa baŋ ni yɛm so jɛrilim kaman neesim ni so zibisim shɛm la.
en: I saw that wisdom is better than foolishness in the same way that light is better than darkness.

dag: O ni ti nyu bara o nasara dibu maa min o ni gbahi tɔbbihi pam ku ba zuɣu, amaa o kul ku nyɛ ŋun diri nasara sahakam.
en: He will be proud of his victory and of the many soldiers he has killed, but he will not continue to be victorious.

dag: Ka sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ tahilaa chim shɛli, di simdi ka di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl shɛli ni, ka dabindi ka di ni.
en: If you bring a grain offering cooked in a baking pan, it must be made from fine flour without yeast and mixed with oil.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm anzinfa mali kikah ayi.
en: The Lord told Moses:.

dag: A ku chɛ ka sula a wuni Chɛmɔshi ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti a ni a su la? Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛŋa zaa ti ti la, ka ti mi su li.
en: Shouldnt you possess what Chemosh your god has given you to possess? And shouldnt we possess everything that the LORD our God has given us to possess?.

dag: Maliya suhukpeeni, ka ti zabi ti niriba mini ti Naawuni tinsi ŋɔ zuɣu; ka chɛ ka Yawɛ niŋ o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: Be brave and fight hard to protect our people and the towns of our Lord God. I pray he will do whatever pleases him.

dag: Ka naa maa daa zaŋ Daniɛl n-zali zaashe tital ni; ka ti o pin kara pam; ka zaŋ o leei ŋun su Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ fukumsi ni baŋdiba zaa zuɣulana.
en: Then the king gave Daniel a very important job in his kingdom and gave him many expensive gifts. Nebuchadnezzar made Daniel ruler over the whole province of Babylon and put him in charge of all the wise men of Babylon.

dag: Di ni ti leei teeku sunsuuni luɣ shɛli bɛ ni deeni lansi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Di ni leei niriba ni yɛn ŋmɛri diri nɛma luɣ shɛli.
en: Tyre will become a place by the sea for spreading fishing nets. I have spoken! The Lord GOD says, Tyre will be like the valuable things soldiers take in war.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yinim bɛn niŋ yɛda sani, o mali buchi; amaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛn bi niŋ o yɛda la sani, o nyɛla bɛ ni booni so: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi, ka di yipa leei kuɣ gahindili la.
en: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.

dag: A pun wum Asiria naa ni niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa shɛm ni o ni saɣim li zaa shɛm yɛla. A tɛhiya ni nyin ni tiligi?.
en: You have heard what an Assyrian emperor does to any country he decides to destroy. Do you think that you can escape?.

dag: Amaa n ni ti darigi zuliya shɛb bɛn zaŋ ba leei bɛ daba maa tibili, ka di nyaaŋa, bɛ ni ti ʒi azichi pam yi nimaani na.
en: But after I punish the nation they serve, they will leave it with great wealth.

dag: Amaa paɣ ni tiligi bihi dɔɣibu puuni, ka di mi ni yila o yi kul mali yɛda niŋbu mini yurilim ni biɛr kasi zaŋ tabil omaŋgbibbu ni na.
en: But women will be saved in their work of having children. They will be saved if they continue to live in faith, love, and holiness with sensible behavior.

dag: dama omaŋmaŋ daa pun yɛli ni anabi ka jilima omaŋmaŋ ya.
en: Jesus himself had testified that prophets have no honor in their own country.

dag: Bɛ yɛli bɛmaŋa, Ti ni nyaŋ ba zaa. Bɛ daa nyo Naawuni jɛma laɣiŋgu shɛhi zaa din be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni buɣim.
en: They wanted to crush us completely; they burned down every holy place in the land.

dag: Ka Jɛhoyachin daa yeeg o sarika binyɛra sɔŋ, ka o mini naa daa kul laɣindi diri bindirigu sahakam hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: So Jehoiachin was permitted to change from his prison clothes and to dine at the king's table for the rest of his life.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda niriba maa daa bɔh o, Nyama, ti na be Juda tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ŋɔ ka dabiɛm mali ti mi, ka ti yi ti chaŋ Kɛila ni ti ti tuhi Filistia tɔbbihi ŋɔ, wula ka di lee yɛn be.
en: But Davids men said to him, Look, our men are afraid here in Judah. Just think how afraid we will be if we go to Keilah, where the Philistine army is lined up and ready for battle.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi yomyom bɛ tɛha ni ni ti leei baŋdiba, ka bɛn tɔri birilim ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa din niŋ kamaata ni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: People who are now confused would be able to understand. Those who cannot speak clearly now would be able to speak clearly and quickly.

dag: Ka o daa saɣi ka shiri niŋ ba lala biɛɣu pia.
en: He agreed to let them try it for ten days.

dag: ka doo maa gba ti lan je o ka sabi amiliya larigibu gbaŋ ti o, ka yih o o yiŋa bee do so ŋun kpuɣ o maa yi kpi.
en: who then either divorced her in the same way or died.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yimaŋmaŋ nyɛviya zuɣu, miriya ka yi ʒi ʒiya Vuhim Dabisili dali bee n-ʒi li doli dunɔdaya ŋɔ kpe Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Tell them that if they love their lives, they must not carry any load on the Sabbath; they must not carry anything in through the gates of Jerusalem.

dag: Iso ni daa wum o ba ni yɛl o shɛm maa, ka o kum suhusaɣiŋgu kumsi pam ka yɛl o ba, M ba, niŋm alibarika niŋ n gba ni.
en: When Esau heard what his father said, he let out a loud agonizing cry and wept bitterly. He said to his father, Bless me! Me too, my father.

dag: Ka Bɛtishɛmɛshi ninvuɣ shɛba daa lihi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa puuni, ka o daa ku bɛ ninvuɣ pisopɔin zaa. Ka niriba daa kum bɛ zuɣu, Yawɛ ni daa ku ba pam shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: But God struck down some of the people from Beth-shemesh because they looked into the LORDs chest. God struck seventy people, and the community grieved because the LORD had struck them so severely.

dag: O ni daa ti paai yuun pihinahi ka di daa lu o suhu ni ni o lab ti kaag o zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim la.
en: When Moses was years old, he decided to visit his family, the Israelites.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa tim ti boli Reechɛl mini Liya ni bɛ ka o sanna o ni daa mal o biŋkɔbiri be mɔɣu ni luɣ shɛli la.
en: So Jacob sent for Rachel and Leah and summoned them into the field where his flock was.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ dabindi gari chi bee kawana sara ti Yawɛ, dama di bi simdi ni yi zaŋ dabindi bee shiri nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: None of the grain offerings which you present to the Lord may be made with yeast; you must never use yeast or honey in food offered to the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka ŋarin shɛŋa din daa yi Taibɛrias na kana ti zani miri luɣ shɛli ti Duuma Yisa ni sa paɣi Naawuni bɔrɔbɔro zuɣu ka zaŋ li ti niriba ka bɛ ŋub la.
en: Other boats, which were from Tiberias, came to shore near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

dag: ka tumo daa ti kana ti yɛli Ayuba, Ti di malila naɣilahi la kɔra, ka bunsi la ʒe m-baɣi ba ŋubiri mɔri.
en: A messenger came to Job and said, We were plowing the fields with the oxen and the donkeys were eating grass nearby.

dag: Di saha maa Dauda daa ʒila tiŋ maa dunoya ayi sunsuuni, ka tiŋgula daa ti du n-tam dunɔdali dufahirili zuɣusaa n-lihi ha nya do so ni zɔrina o kɔŋko.
en: Meanwhile, David was sitting between the inner and outer gates in the city wall. One of his soldiers was watching from the roof of the gate-tower. He saw a man running toward the town.

dag: amaa cheechi ni m paɣi ni n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa diba anu m milinsi puuni din ni chɛ ka n wuhi niriba gari ni n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa tuhi pia tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: But in church worship I would rather speak five words that can be understood, in order to teach others, than speak thousands of words in strange tongues.

dag: O daa lan wuhi ma shɛli. Nyama, n daa nyami ka n Duuma ʒe bɛ ni zaŋ bimbuɣisirigu buɣisi m-me goon shɛli gbini; ka bimbuɣisirigu maa be o nuu ni.
en: I had another vision from the Lord . In it I saw him standing beside a wall that had been built with the use of a plumb line, and there was a plumb line in his hand.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o dimnim di vi, amaa ka chɛ ka o nam mali jilima.
en: I will cover his enemies with shame, and on his head will be a shining crown.

dag: Man maŋmaŋ ni ti pa nina lihiri dilana, ka yih o n niriba ni, o ni zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk n-ta m biɛhigu shee daɣiri, ka dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi zuɣu.
en: Moreover, I will set my own face against such a person, cutting them off from their people, because they gave their children to Molech, making my sanctuary unclean and degrading my holy name by doing so.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yɛli Firawuna, Tinim a daba ŋɔ kamina ni ti ti ʒini tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, dama kum maa miiya pam Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka ti biŋkɔbiri bi nyari mɔri ŋubira; ka pumpɔŋɔ ti suhir a mi ni a chɛ ka ti ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni.
en: They said to Pharaoh, The famine is very bad in Canaan. There are no fields left with grass for our animals, so we have come to live in this land. We ask you to please let us live in Goshen.

dag: ka n niriba bɛn nyɛ n ni su shɛb maa yi siɣisi bɛmaŋa n-suhi ma, ka niŋ tuuba, ka bo sɔŋsim n sani, ka zo n-yi bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali ni, n ni be alizanda ni ka wum bɛ suhigu maa, ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi maa, ka tibi bɛ tiŋgbani maa.
en: If my own people will humbly pray and turn back to me and stop sinning, then I will answer them from heaven. I will forgive them and make their land fertile once again.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi kumdi bɔri sɔŋsim, Yawɛ wumda, ka yihiri ba bɛ muɣisigu kam zaa ni.
en: Pray to the Lord , and he will hear you. He will save you from all your troubles.

dag: M pun kahig a yuli wuhi ba, ka ni lan kahigi li wuhi ba pahi, ka di chɛ ka yurilim shɛli a ni yuri ma la be bɛ ni, ka n gba be bɛ ni.
en: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi ku o kpee, yin chɛ ka ŋun ku o kpee maa kul dari ginda hal ti kpi; ka di chɛliya ka so sɔŋ o.
en: If someone feels guilty about murder, dont hold them back from fleeing to the pit.

dag: amaa di yi ti bilina, di zoorimi gari tutuɣ kam n-niŋ wul kara hal ka noonsi ni tooi te bɛ tɛri di wula maa zuɣu.
en: But when you plant it, it grows and becomes the largest of all the plants in your garden. It has branches that are very big. The wild birds can come and make nests there and be protected from the sun.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa zaliya ni Jɔram kaabu maa n-yɛn nyɛ Ahazia bahigu. Dama o ni daa yi nimaani ka o mini Jɔram doli tab chana, ka bɛ daa chirigi Nimshi bia Jɛhu, Yawɛ ni daa zali so ni o kum Ɛhab daŋ ni niriba zaa la.
en: But God used this visit to Joram to bring about Ahaziahs downfall. After his arrival, Ahaziah went with Joram to meet Jehu, Nimshis son, whom the LORD had anointed to destroy Ahabs dynasty.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Let the LORDs name be blessed from now until forever from now!.

dag: Amaa Masia daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima n-fa ti fukumsi zaligu noli din daa doli ti la ni bahi, o ni daa zani ti zaani n-chɛ ka noli di o ti zuɣu la puuni, dama di sabiya: Noli di bɛ ni zaŋ sokam yili tia.
en: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.

dag: A dolila a biɛli naba, dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ o pipia maa gbibil a.
en: You followed in your sister's footsteps, and so I will give you the same cup of punishment to drink.

dag: Ŋunkam kpɛri kuɣa ni nya daŋ di ni, ka ŋunkam mi wɔriti dari ni be di daŋ nyabu barina ni.
en: You could even get hurt by chiseling a stone or chopping a log.

dag: Ka yili maa ni bipuɣiŋga ŋun daa guli dunoli maa bɔhi Pita, A pala doo ŋɔ nyaandoliba ni yino? Ka Pita garigi yɛl o, M pala o nyaandola.
en: The servant woman stationed at the gate asked Peter, Arent you one of this mans disciples? Im not, he replied.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi daa palila Yisa ka o yi Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili polo na, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi maa daa zaŋ o chaŋ mɔɣu ni.
en: When Jesus returned from the Jordan River, the power of the Holy Spirit was with him, and the Spirit led him into the desert.

dag: Kpambaliba yi wum ni n tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa, ka kana ti yɛl a, Kul yɛlim ti a ni yɛli naa shɛm, di sɔɣi ti shɛli, di yi pa lala ti ni ku a. Wula ka naa lee yɛl a.
en: And I'm sure that if my officials hear about our meeting, they will ask you what we said to each other. They might even threaten to kill you if you don't tell them.

dag: Neemiya n-kpaŋsi din kpalim be yi ni n-yɛn kpi maa, dama n nya ka yi tuma bi be dɛde n Duuma Naawuni sani.
en: Wake up and strengthen whatever you have left, teetering on the brink of death, for Ive found that your works are far from complete in the eyes of my God.

dag: Amaa ka doo maa daa chaŋ ti mol o kpaŋbu maa yɛla gili luɣilikam, dina n-daa chɛ ka Yisa ku lan tooi yi palɔni kpe tiŋ kam ni yaha, amaa ka kul bela mɔɣu ni, ka niriba yiri luɣ shɛlikam chan o sani.
en: The man talked about it so much and told so many people, that Jesus could no longer go openly into a town. He had to stay away from the towns, but people still came to him from everywhere.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti kabisi Izraɛlnim bidibbina zaa Jɛziriil Vinvamli ni.
en: and in Jezreel Valley I will break the power of Israel.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n tɔbutuhiri guliŋguɣu, ka nyɛ n tɔbutuhiri bidibbini. Nyin ka n zaŋ ŋme n-wurim zuliya kam, nyini ka n zaŋ ku nanima.
en: You are my hammer, my weapon of war. With you I will crush the nations. With you I will destroy kingdoms.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛn be tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ni ti ku ba, amaa bɛn ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ niŋ Babilɔnnim maa nuu ni, bɛn ni be. Bɛ ni ti leei bɛ ni ŋme tɔbu di shɛba ka be.
en: This is what the Lord says: Everyone who stays in Jerusalem will die from war, hunger, or disease. But everyone who surrenders to the army of Babylon will live and escape with their lives.

dag: Ka sapashin maa yɛl o, N Duuma, m pɔri ni a ka n yiŋ na; amaa kul yɛlim yɛtɔɣ shɛli a ni yɛn yɛli, ka n yiŋbia maa kpaŋ.
en: The officer answered, Lord, I am not good enough for you to come into my house. You need only to give the order, and my servant will be healed.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ daa ti miri lubu ka bɛ ŋme kuŋ yɛli Izraɛl tɔbbihi, Sokam lab kul o ya o tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Near sunset the order went out through the Israelite ranks: Each of you go back to your own country and city.

dag: Di saha ka Batishiiba daa yiɣisi chaŋ Naa Sulemaana sani ni o ti tɔɣis o di yɛtɔɣa ti Adɔnija. Ka naa daa yiɣisi ti tuh o soli n-damd o tiŋa, ka lab ti ʒin o nam ʒiishee, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ kuɣ na nti ti naa ma ka o ʒin o nudirigu polo.
en: When Bathsheba went to see Solomon, he stood up to meet her, then bowed low. He sat back down and had another throne brought in, so his mother could sit at his right side.

dag: Hɛshibɔnnima, kuhimiya, dama Ai wurimya. Raba paɣiba, kummiya. Somiya buri; kummiya, ka fiɛbimiya yimaŋ fiɛbisi. Dama bɛ ni ti gbahi Milikom min o tindaannima ni bɛn jɛmd o daba chaŋ.
en: People of Heshbon, cry out! Ai is destroyed! Women of Rabbah, go into mourning! Put on sackcloth and mourn. Run about in confusion. Your god Molech will be taken into exile, together with his priests and princes.

dag: Wain nyɛla ansarisimaana, ka dam din kpɛma mi nyɛ vuyɔra, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun chɛ ka di kpɛh o yɔɣu nyɛla ŋun ka yɛm.
en: Wine is a mocker; beer a carouser. Those it leads astray wont become wise.

dag: Alizanda ni nima, yilimiya yila! Dunianima, maliya suhupiɛlli! Zoya, yilimiya yila! Dama Yawɛ ni kpaŋs o niriba suhuri. O ni zo o niriba bɛn be muɣisigu ni nambɔɣu.
en: Heavens and earth, be happy! Mountains, shout with joy! The Lord comforts his people. He is good to his poor people.

dag: N ni chɛ ka di maligumaaniba zaŋ tiliginsim ye kaman situra la, ka chɛ ka di niriba bɛn ʒe yim yili suhupiɛlli yila.
en: I will clothe the priests with salvation, and my followers will be filled with joy.

dag: dama n zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa a ni daa tɔɣisi ma la tɔɣisi ba, ka bɛ dee li ka baŋ ni n shiri yila a sanna, ka niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.

dag: ni Dibɔn ni Nɛbo ni Bɛtidibilateem.
en: to Dibon, Nebo, and Beth-diblathaim.

dag: Tɛhimi n ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ yɛla, dama ti Duuma ni chɛ ka a baŋ shɛlikam zaa gbinni.
en: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o kpamba daa yɛl o, N dan naa, chɛ ka ti bo paɣisarili na nti chɛ ka o be a sani gbib a, ka doon a sani, ka di chɛ ka nyini n dan naa ni tula.
en: His officials said, Your Majesty, we will look for a young woman to take care of you. She can lie down beside you and keep you warm.

dag: A yi ni jɛm Naawuni, ka suhi Kpiɔŋlan Naa.
en: But turn now and plead with Almighty God;.

dag: Ka binyɛra din bindi tiŋgban ni ka mali biɛlim mini tihi din wala mali kpila balibu kam zaa shiri bili. Ka Naawuni daa nya li ka di viɛla.
en: So the earth produced all kinds of plants, and God was pleased with what he saw.

dag: ni Hanan ŋun daa nyɛ Maaka bia la ni Jɔshafat ŋun daa nyɛ Mitan nir la.
en: Hanan son of Maacah; Joshaphat the Mithnite;.

dag: Mbusim be dunia ŋɔ zuɣu binshɛŋa din be di ni n-chɛri ka niriba birigiri tumd alahichi zuɣu! Biriginsim din ni kpɛhi nira alahichi ni ku chɛ, amaa mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun chɛ ka o kpee birigi zuɣu.
en: The world is in for trouble because of the way it causes people to sin. There will always be something to cause people to sin, but anyone who does this will be in for trouble.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa kuri Ɛhab daŋ niriba maa saha shɛli maa, ka o daa tuhi Juda kpambaliba mini Ahazia mabihi bidibisi bɛn daa doli Ahazia maa soli n-daa ku ba.
en: While Jehu was executing judgment on Ahabs dynasty, he discovered the princes of Judah, Ahaziahs nephews, serving Ahaziah, and Jehu killed them.

dag: nyuli yi kpe o yidan maa suhu ni ka o zab nyuli o paɣ maa ni tum daɣiri tuuni maa zuɣu bee o yi zab nyuli n-zilisi ni o paɣ maa tum daɣiri tuuni maa ka o mi bi tum li;.
en: But the husband might begin to think that his wife sinned against him, whether she has or not. He might become jealous. He might begin to believe that she is not pure and true to him.

dag: N yi yɛli ninvuɣ biɛri, Yinima ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ, biɛhiŋ kani, yi ni kpi, ka a bi saɣisi ninvuɣ biɛri maa ka bɛ niŋ tuuba, ninvuɣ biɛri maa ni kpi bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu, amaa bɛ kum maa taali ni ʒila a zuɣu.
en: I might say to you, These evil people will die. Then you must go warn them for me. If you dont warn them and tell them to change their lives, those evil people will die because they sinned. But I will make you responsible for their deaths.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei zaa ka bɛ bi tooi baŋ tiŋgban shɛli din bala, amaa ka bɛ lee nya kulinol shɛli ka di duli viɛla, ka bɛ daa lɔri nia ni di yi ni nani bɛ ni zaŋ ŋariŋ maa du ni.
en: When day came, the sailors did not recognize the coast, but they noticed a bay with a beach and decided that, if possible, they would run the ship aground there.

dag: Amaa n niriba Izraɛlnim bɛna, baa bi yɛn ŋuhi bɛ biŋkɔbigu gba bee daadam din ni chɛ ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ woligi Izraɛlnim ka chɛ Ijiptinima.
en: But none of the Israelites or their animals will be hurt—not even a dog will bark at them. Then you will know that the Lord has treated Israel differently from Egypt.

dag: Dama bɛn be ʒilinsi ni biriginsim n-kuri ba, ka jɛra mi nini ni tiɣi bɛmaŋmaŋ shɛm kuri ba.
en: Fools die because they refuse to follow wisdom. They are content to follow their foolish ways, and that will destroy them.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Ahaz daa tim Asiria naa sani ti yɛl o ni o zo o kuŋa.
en: At that same time the people from Edom came again and defeated the people of Judah. The Edomites captured people and took them away as prisoners. So King Ahaz asked the king of Assyria to help him.

dag: O daa lan bɔhi, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nya bimburiginli a mabia ninni, ka daantaliga lee sa amaŋmaŋ ninni ka a bi nya li?.
en: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.

dag: A min a bidibisi yi yɛn kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ ni, yin di nyu wain bee binnyɔr kpiɔŋ, yi yi niŋ lala yi ni kpi; di nyɛla zaligu din kul ni be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni sahakam.
en: Both you and your sons must not drink wine or beer when you enter the meeting tent so that you dont die—this is a permanent rule throughout your future generations.

dag: Bɛ lɔna ŋmanila gbala din kabi, ka bɛ mali bɛ zilima yɔhindi niriba. Tinvura lɔɣu be bɛ naŋgbampiba ni.
en: Their words come from mouths that are like open graves. They use their lying tongues to deceive others. Psalm : Their words are like the poison of snakes. Psalm :.

dag: Yisa daa ti ʒi Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu, ka o nyaandoliba ka o sanna ashilɔni ti bɔh o, Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔnim ti yɛn niŋ, ka bɔ nti yɛn nyɛ a kandina mini dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu shihira? Ti bɔri ni a yɛl ti.
en: Later, Jesus was sitting at a place on the Mount of Olives. The followers came to be alone with him. They said, Tell us when these things will happen. And what will happen to prepare us for your coming and the end of time.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa gbaai mɔɣili du ni o ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka Yawɛ daa shiri zaŋ ba niŋ o nuu ni.
en: Jephthah crossed over to fight the Ammonites, and the LORD handed them over to him.

dag: Amaa ka o pagɔrisigu tuma maa daa lan pahi, ka o lan teeg o bilim saha o ni daa tumdi pagɔrisigu tuun shɛŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yɛla.
en: But Oholibah thought about her time as a prostitute in Egypt when she was young, and she turned to even more prostitution.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa ni o ni daa zaŋ wɔb nyina n-dih o nam yil shɛli nachiinsi la ni o ni daa me tin shɛŋa zaa la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Ahab did while he was king, including the towns he strengthened and the palace he built and furnished with ivory, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Vinnyaɣilan tɛhiya ni o mali yɛm gari niriba ayopɔin bɛn ni tooi garigi yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: A lazy person says, I am smarter than everyone else.

dag: Chɛ ka a ninni neesim neei niŋ man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ, ka wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛshua mini Bani ni Kadimiɛl ni Shɛbania ni Bunni ni Shɛrɛbia ni Bani so mi ni Kɛnani daa yiɣisi zani Lɛvinim ni daa ʒe bimbin shɛli zuɣu ka duhi bɛ yee n-suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Then these Levites stood on the stairs: Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Kenani. They called out to the Lord their God with loud voices.

dag: Bɛ daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Naawuni ka bɔhi, Naawuni ni tooi ti ti bindirigu tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni?.
en: They complained about him and said, Can God give us food in the desert?.

dag: ka n daa ti chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ka Yɛhudianim maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa yɛli ma o yɛla, ka yɛli ni n karim o saria n-luh o ti ba.
en: When I went to Jerusalem, the leading priests and the older Jewish leaders there made charges against him. They wanted me to order his death.

dag: Yɛm shee wɔɣa, ka di biɛhigu shee zilim pam; ka di bo n-nya to pam.
en: How can anyone discover what life means? It is too deep for us, too hard to understand.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti bi tumdi tuumbiɛri ni di tahi zaɣ viɛlli na? Lala ka ninvuɣ shɛb zuri nyaaŋa yɛri ni lala ka n shiri wuhiri niriba. Bɛn yɛl lala maa simdi tibidarigibo.
en: Why not say, then, Let us do evil so that good may come? Some people, indeed, have insulted me by accusing me of saying this very thing! They will be condemned, as they should be.

dag: N suhu ni yɛla yi ti galisi pam, a suhukpaŋsibo nyɛla din tiri ma suhupiɛlli.
en: Whenever I am anxious and worried, you comfort me and make me glad.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni yubu puuni mini ti mabia Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni cheechi din be Kɔrinti mini Yisa nyaandoliba zaa bɛn be Akaia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.
en: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.

dag: O yiko ni ka o chɛ ka teeku fo n-dɔni baalim. O yɛm ka o daa zaŋ ku Reehab.
en: With his own power God calmed the sea. With his wisdom he destroyed Rahab.

dag: Yi dim nahu bee o buŋ yi chihi chani ka yi nya o, yin taɣim o labisi ti ti o.
en: If you find an ox or a donkey that has wandered off, take it back where it belongs, even if the owner is your enemy.

dag: Amaa sabimi Aduna min o bidibisi maa yuya n-chɛ ka bɛ tumdi maligumaanitali tuma, ka ninvuɣ zino yi ka bɛ sanna, yin kum o.
en: Appoint Aaron and his sons to be priests. They must do their duty and serve as priests. Anyone else who tries to come near the holy things must be killed.

dag: Bɛn daa be n sani daa nya neesim maa, amaa ka lee bi wum kukoli maa ni yɛli ma shɛm maa.
en: The men with me saw the light, but did not hear the voice of the one who was speaking to me.

dag: Ka Jabɛshinim maa daa yɛli Naa Nahash, Biɛɣuni ti sa ni zaŋ timaŋ ti a, ka a niŋ ti a ni bɔri shɛm.
en: Then the people of Jabesh said to Nahash the Ammonite, Tomorrow we will come to you, and you can do whatever you want to us.

dag: Nimdi din shihi binshɛli din bi be kasi bi simdi ni bɛ ŋub li. Di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ li nyo buɣim. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be kasi ni tooi ŋubi Yawɛ suhudoo sara maligu nimdi.
en: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.

dag: Din daa chɛ ka bɛ yɛl lala maa nyɛla bɛ daa zɔrila Yɛhudianima, dama Yɛhudianim maa daa pun yɛli ni so yi ti yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla Masia, bɛ ni kar o bɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: The man's parents said this because they were afraid of their leaders. The leaders had already agreed that no one was to have anything to do with anyone who said Jesus was the Messiah.

dag: Ka bɛ dɔɣiriba bɛn daa be tiŋkpansi daa yi kani bɛ sanna sahasaha nti sɔŋdi ba daba ayopɔinpɔin.
en: Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Ya ka a yina? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Izraɛlnim sansan ni ka n yi n-zo na maa.
en: David asked him, Where have you come from? The man answered, I just came from the Israelite camp.

dag: Kom daa ka nimaani ka niriba maa ni nyu, ka bɛ daa laɣim taai duŋ niŋ Musa mini Aduna.
en: The Israelites had no water, so they went to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Ka paɣiba daa yɛli Naomi, Paɣimi Yawɛ! O ti a yaaŋa ŋun nyɛ bidibiga zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni o ti gbib a. Yawɛ chɛ ka bia maa yuli ti du pam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni!.
en: After his birth, the women said to Naomi: Praise the Lord ! Today he has given you a grandson to take care of you. We pray that the boy will grow up to be famous everywhere in Israel.

dag: So ku tooi yi taali ni Naawuni sani fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu, dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa kul nyɛla din wuhiri ti alahichi ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: It follows that no human being will be treated as righteous in his presence by doing what the Law says, because the knowledge of sin comes through the Law.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi kɔŋko n-kul be ti sani kpe.
en: All we have here are five loaves and two fish, they replied.

dag: A ni tooi gbahi binnɛma ti gbuɣinli bee n-dihi gbuɣimbihi ka bɛ tiɣi.
en: When lions are hungry, do you help them hunt?.

dag: Tulaale viɛlli nyom ku be bɛ sani, naɣila nyom biɛɣu. Bɛ ku mali shɛlɔri viɛla lɔra, naɣila gabisi, bɛ ku mali zab viɛla, naɣila zuɣukpina, bɛ ku mali binyɛr viɛla yɛra, naɣila buri. Bɛ viɛlim ni ŋmaligi leei vi.
en: Instead of using perfumes, they will stink; instead of fine belts, they will wear coarse ropes; instead of having beautiful hair, they will be bald; instead of fine clothes, they will be dressed in rags; their beauty will be turned to shame!.

dag: Ka o ʒiʒiinitab min o dɔɣiriba daa wum ti Duuma ni zo o nambɔ shɛli maa yɛla, ka di niŋ bɛ min o zaa suhupiɛlli pam.
en: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord was very good to her, and they were happy for her.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa be Yisa sani saha shɛl o ni daa neei Lazarɔs kum ni gballi ni la daa di o shɛhira.
en: The people who had been with Jesus when he called Lazarus out of the grave and raised him from death had reported what had happened.

dag: Dama o yɛliya, N sapashinnim zaa nyɛla nanima.
en: He boasts, Every one of my commanders is a king!.

dag: N zaŋla sagani ŋɔ niŋ sagbana ni ni di nyɛ n ni lo dunia ŋɔ alikauli shɛli maa shihirili.
en: I have placed my bow in the clouds; it will be the symbol of the covenant between me and the earth.

dag: ka tiligi shɛba kaman buɣim ni ka yi tim yihi ba la. Ka chɛliya ka shɛb mi yɛla niŋ ya nambɔɣu ni dabiɛm; ka leeya bɛn je bɛ binyɛr taɣilima din be tiŋli ka bɛ niŋgbuŋ kɔre gabisi li la.
