en: Rescue those who are living in danger of hells fire. There are others you should treat with mercy, but be very careful that their filthy lives dont rub off on you.

dag: Di saha tiŋ maa dɔbba zaa bɛn labim o kuɣa ku o. Lala ka yi ni niŋ n-yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni, ka Izraɛlnim zaa wum di yɛla ka dabiɛm gbahi ba.
en: The men of the town will stone that son to death, because they must get rid of the evil he brought into the community. Everyone in Israel will be afraid when they hear how he was punished.

dag: N ni ti saɣim yi binnana la mini yi binwɔɣila din be yi san la, ka yi ku lan jɛm yi ni zaŋ yi nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: I will cut down your images and your sacred pillars in your midst. You will no longer bow down to the works of your hands!.

dag: Naawuni Shi so ni yɛlimaŋli ni bela yi ti kana, o ni wuhi ya yɛlimaŋli zaa soli; dama o bi ti yɛn yɛli shɛli omaŋmaŋ yiko ni, amaa o ni wum shɛlikam, dina ka o ti yɛn zaŋ yɛli, ka ni ti wuhi ya binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ.
en: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.

dag: m-pahi ŋun Sulemaana tuma zuɣulaannim tusaata ni kɔbisita shɛb bɛn daa lihiri tumtumdiba maa ka bɛ tumdi tuma la.
en: and over , assistants to keep track of the work and to supervise the workers.

dag: dama bɛ daa yurila salinim paɣibu gari Naawuni paɣibu.
en: They believed, but they loved human praise more than Gods glory.

dag: Ka o gba daa fuɣ o situra zaa ka tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa Samuɛl tooni, ka daa do o zaɣim dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa. Dindali maa ka bɔhigu ŋɔ daa piligi, Sool gba nyɛla anabi.
en: He took off his clothes and danced and shouted in Samuel's presence, and lay naked all that day and all that night.

dag: Ka n zoli maa ni nam vinvamli shɛli sɔŋ maa zuɣu ni chɛ ka yi guui kaman yi ni daa pun guui guuri shɛli tiŋgbani dambu la ni Juda naa Yuzaia saha la. Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti zaŋ wuntizɔriba m-pa omaŋ zuɣu kana.
en: You will flee through the valley of my mountain, because the valley of the mountains will reach to Azal. You will flee just as you fled from the earthquake in the days of Judahs King Uzziah. The LORD my God will come, and all the holy ones with him.

dag: N dana, wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ, n zaŋ palo maa mini siliga din be di ni maa zaa ti a n niriba ŋɔ ninni ni a sɔɣ a kpim maa nimaani.
en: Sir, the whole field, including the cave, is yours. With my own people as witnesses, I freely give it to you as a burial place for your dead.

dag: Firawuna yi ti nya ba, o suhu ni maai zaŋ chaŋ o tɔbbihi zaa polo. Bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi ku Firawuna min o tɔbbihi zaa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The sight of all these who were killed in battle will be a comfort to the king of Egypt and his army, says the Sovereign Lord .

dag: Naawuni ŋun yihi ya Ijipti na ŋmanila yɔnaɣ yila yi sani. Yi nyandi zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ yi dimnima. Yi kabiri bɛ kɔba. O ni to ba o piɛma.
en: God, who brought him from Egypt, is like a magnificent wild bull for him. He will devour enemy nations and break their bones; he will strike with his arrows.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ kpalua ni wuɣi tan piɛl viɛl shɛli n-she zabbanim ti Aduna min o bidibisi maa.
en: Skilled workers wove shirts for Aaron and his sons. These shirts were made from fine linen.

dag: N ni ŋmalig a gili n-voog a yihi nuzaa polo maa katiŋ na n-kar a tahi Izraɛl zoya ni.
en: I will turn him in a new direction and lead him out of the far north until he comes to the mountains of Israel.

dag: N ni ti ŋme a tɔbu a nuzaa ni bahi, ka a piɛma yi a nudirigu ni lu.
en: Then I will knock his bow out of his left hand and his arrows out of his right hand.

dag: Bɛ mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam ni yiŋ biŋkɔbiri balibu kam ni biŋgbamda balibu kam ni noonsi balibu kam ni binyiɣira zaa n-daa kpe di ni.
en: They and every kind of animal on the earth were in the boat. Every kind of cattle, every kind of animal that crawls on the earth, and every kind of bird were in the boat.

dag: Yɛm so tɔbutuhiri bidibbina. Amaa alahichilan yino saɣindi bin viɛla pam.
en: Wisdom is better than weapons of war, but one fool can destroy much good.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi chuɣu yila yilibu mal alibarika. Yawɛ, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a tooni neesim ni mal alibarika.
en: How happy are the people who worship you with songs, who live in the light of your kindness!.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti mali wuni ŋ-ŋmahindi binshɛli din be zuɣusaa bee binshɛli din be tiŋgbani puuni bee binshɛli din be kom ni tiŋgbani puuni.
en: Do not make an idol for yourself—no form whatsoever—of anything in the sky above or on the earth below or in the waters under the earth.

dag: Ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa zali yuma ata shɛŋa la saha daa ti paai, ka Ashpɛnaz zaŋ nachimbihi maa zaa tahi ŋun Nɛbukadnɛza sani.
en: At the end of the three years set by the king, Ashpenaz took all the young men to Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yimaŋmaŋ mini n tizo Bɛnjamin zaa nini nyaya ni mmaŋmaŋa n-yaagi n noli yɛli ya yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Surely you can see that I really am Joseph. Even my brother Benjamin knows it is me, your brother, talking to you.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ n-daa zaŋ a ba Nɛbukadnɛza leei na titali, ka ti o di viɛlim mini di tibiginsim ni di jilima.
en: The Supreme God made your father Nebuchadnezzar a great king and gave him dignity and majesty.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: If you have ears, pay attention!.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim maa mini Firawuna yuri ni chɛchɛbunsi ni wɔribariba zaa ni o tɔbbihi zaa daa doli Izraɛlnim maa ti paai ba, ka bɛ dola teeku noli luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Pihahirɔt din daa be Baalizɛfɔn tooni polo la.
en: The Egyptians, including all of Pharaohs horse-drawn chariots, his cavalry, and his army, chased them and caught up with them as they were camped by the sea, by Pi-hahiroth in front of Baal-zephon.

dag: anabi Jɛrimia sani ti yɛl o, Niŋmi ania wummi ti fabila ŋɔ ka suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ti ti. Suhim o ti tinim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ zaa, dama ti daa nyɛla ninvuɣ gbaliŋ, amaa pumpɔŋɔ, kulla ti niriba biɛla ŋɔ n-kpalim kaman a nini ni nya ti shɛm ŋɔ.
en: and said to me, Please do what we ask you! Pray to the Lord our God for us. Pray for all of us who have survived. Once there were many of us; but now only a few of us are left, as you can see.

dag: Dinzuɣu n-chɛ ka di wɔɣ zuɣusaa gari mɔɣu ni tihi zaa. Di wulikpani daa bara, ka di wula wɔɣa, di ni daa nyari kom pam zoori la zuɣu.
en: Because it was well-watered, It grew taller than other trees. Its branches grew thick and long.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ o tɛha niŋ o ninsalitali biɛhigu yɛla ni, di bahigu ti nyɛla kum, amaa nir yi zaŋ o tɛha niŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla ni, di bahigu ti nyɛla nyɛvili mini suhudoo.
en: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.

dag: Naa Baasha ni daa wum lala, ka o daa chɛ Rama mɛbu, ka o tuma maa daa zani tariga.
en: As soon as Baasha learned of this, he stopped building Ramah and abandoned his work.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ o yi bɛ biɛhigu shee maa kpaŋa nti lih o, ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa yi naai dilan ni.
en: The priest must go to them outside the camp and look to see if the skin disease is healed.

dag: Karimi bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Akar ŋun daa bo yɛla bahi Izraɛlnim la. O daa kpuɣila bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli ti Naawuni.
en: Achan, who was a descendant of Zerah and the son of Carmi, caused trouble for Israel, because he kept for himself things that belonged only to the Lord .

dag: Amaa zaŋmiya Masia niŋ yi suhuri ni ka o nyɛ yi Duuma. Ka kul malimiya shili guri ni yi garigi ŋunkam bɔhi ya bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ yi ni mali tahima shɛli yi ni la polo.
en: But keep the Lord Christ holy in your hearts. Always be ready to answer everyone who asks you to explain about the hope you have.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti zaŋ omaŋ wuhi Ibrahimma Mamri oki tihi la gbini, o ni daa ʒi o tanti suɣili dunol ni wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha la.
en: One hot summer afternoon while Abraham was sitting by the entrance to his tent near the sacred trees of Mamre, the Lord appeared to him.

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋ bɔhim baŋ din tiɣiri ti Duuma nini.
en: Try to learn what pleases the Lord.

dag: N ni daa mi dimbɔŋɔ yɛla zuɣu ka n daa daŋ lo nia ni n ka yi sanna, ka di chɛ ka yi nya suhupiɛlli buyi:.
en: I was so sure of all this that I made plans at first to visit you, in order that you might be blessed twice.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi niɣi chani vinvamli ni shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ Shia daa ti o niriba vuhim. Lala ka o daa wuh o niriba maa soli, ka di ti o yuli jilima.
en: Like cattle going down to the valley, The Spirit of the Lord led them. This is how you led your people and made your name wonderful.

dag: N ni ti daai bɛ ninkura mini bihi zaa to taba. N yi ti yɛn ku ba, n ku chɛ so bee n-zo so nambɔɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make them stumble and fall against each other, even the fathers and sons. This message is from the Lord . I will not feel sorry or have pity for them. I will not allow compassion to stop me from destroying the people of Judah.

dag: Yuma ayi nyaaŋa ka Firawuna daa ti zahim zahindi n-nya ka o ʒiɛla Nail Mɔɣili duli.
en: Two years later, Pharaoh dreamed that he was standing near the Nile.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka dol o ba min o ma ni Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam bɛn daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la naba.
en: He sinned against the Lord , following the wicked example of his father Ahab, his mother Jezebel, and King Jeroboam, who had led Israel into sin.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan tɛhiya ni o mali yɛm gari niriba ayopɔin bɛn ni tooi garigi yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Lazy people think they are seven times smarter than the people who really have good sense.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zali Izraɛl zuɣulaannim ni bɛ sɔŋm o bia Sulemaana, ka lan yɛli ba.
en: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Di zɔri dabiɛm, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N nyala so shia ka di yiri tiŋgban ni na.
en: The king said to the woman, Dont be afraid! What do you see? The woman said, I see a spirit coming up out of the ground. .

dag: Kum maa daa miiya pam tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The famine in Canaan got worse.

dag: Chira ayɔbu zaa ka o daa zaŋ wuh o niriba maa azichi din be o nam puuni mini di jilima ni di dariza ni nyɛ shɛm zaa.
en: For six whole months he made a show of the riches of the imperial court with all its splendor and majesty.

dag: Di simdi ni yi ko yi gbansɔri yuma ayɔbu n-kpuɣi di daatam.
en: For six years plant your land and gather in what it produces.

dag: Ka paɣ ŋɔ ti dɔni marig o bia yuŋ ka o kpi.
en: One night while we were all asleep, she rolled over on her baby, and he died.

dag: Yisifu dan maa ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa o paɣ ni zaŋ yɛl o ka lan yɛli, Lala ka a dabili maa niŋ ma, ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam.
en: Joseph's master was furious.

dag: N niriba bahi yoli bɛ ʒilinsi zuɣu. Yi ni zaɣisi baŋsim zuɣu n gba zaɣisi ya, yi lan pala m maligumaaniba. Ka yi ni tam n zaligu yɛla zuɣu, n gba ni tam yi bihi yɛla.
en: My people are doomed because they do not acknowledge me. You priests have refused to acknowledge me and have rejected my teaching, and so I reject you and will not acknowledge your sons as my priests.

dag: Ti mi ni Masia ni daa neei kum ni maa, o ku lan kpi yaha; dama kum lan ka o yiko.
en: For we know that Christ has been raised from death and will never die again—death will no longer rule over him.

dag: Yɛlim o, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, A kula nira, ka lan deeg o ni su shɛli? Ka lan yɛl o, Yawɛ ni lan yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bahi ni lɛli Nabɔt ʒim luɣ shɛli maa, nimaani ka bahi yɛn lɛl a gba ʒim. .
en: Go tell him that I say, Ahab, you murdered Naboth and took his property. And so, in the very spot where dogs licked up Naboth's blood, they will lick up your blood. When Elijah found him.

dag: Shɛli ni n ni tooi yɛli zuliya shɛli bee nam shɛli niriba ni n ni vuɣi ba bee n-wurim ba ka ku ba.
en: If I threaten to uproot and shatter an evil nation.

dag: Miriya ka yi zura bee n-niŋdi tab bilikɔnsi bee ŋ-ŋmar tab ʒiri.
en: You must not steal nor deceive nor lie to each other.

dag: Ka ŋun daa deei pɔŋ tusaayi la yiɣisi zani yɛli, N dana, a daa zaŋla pɔŋ tusaayi ti ma, ka n nya pɔŋ tusaayi nyɔri pahi di zuɣu.
en: The second servant also came forward and said, Master, you gave me two valuable coins. Look, Ive gained two more.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla a daba ni a ninvuɣ shɛb a ni daa zaŋ a yiko min a nuu din mali kpiɔŋ tiligi.
en: They are your servants and your people. They are the ones whom you have redeemed by your great power and your strong hand.

dag: Di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yalim be yi yɛtɔɣa ni ka di viɛla, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi mi yi ni yɛn garigi sokam shɛm.
en: When you talk, you should always be kind and wise. Then you will be able to answer everyone in the way you should.

dag: N daa kari doli n dimnim hal ti gbahi ba; n daa bi chɛ ba dolibu hal ti ku bɛ zaa ha.
en: I chased my enemies and caught them! I didnt come home until I finished them off.

dag: Napɔŋ din pahir ayopɔin maa ni, ka o daa ti yɛli, N nya sagban bila ka di be kaman ninsal nuu la n-yi teeku polo na. Ka o yɛl o, Cham ti yɛli Ɛhab, Malim a chɛchɛbuŋ shili n-yiɣisi kuli, di yi pa lala saa ni taɣ a sɔŋ. .
en: The seventh time the assistant said, I see a small cloud the size of a human hand coming up from the sea. Elijah said, Go and tell Ahab, Pull yourself together, go down the mountain, and dont let the rain hold you back.

dag: Di saha maa ka Amɔz bia Aizaia daa tim ti yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: N wum suhigu shɛli a ni suhi zaŋ chaŋ Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib polo la.
en: Then Isaiah sent a message telling King Hezekiah that in answer to the king's prayer.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli yaha, Di saha maa tinzun tiŋ kam niriba pia ni ti kana nti ʒe n-gbaai Yɛhudia nira binyɛrigu ka yɛli, Chɛ ka ti dol a kul a ya, dama ti wumya ni Naawuni be yi sani.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, At that time many foreigners speaking different languages will come to a Jewish man, take hold of the hem of his robe, and ask, We heard that God is with you. Can we come with you to worship him.

dag: Juda zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ni bɛ su li m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is the land that the families of the tribe of Judah received as their possession.

dag: Bɛla bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Arid mini Naaman, ka Arid daŋ niriba nyɛ Aridnima; ka Naaman daŋ niriba nyɛ Naamannima.
en: Belas descendants were Ard and Naaman: from Ard, the Ardite clan; from Naaman, the Naamite clan.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan labi pahi buyi ti suhiri Naawuni yɛra, M Ba, pipia ŋɔ yi ku miligi n zuɣu ka pa ni n nyu li mi, nyin chɛ ka a yubu n-niŋ.
en: A second time he went away and prayed, My Father, if its not possible that this cup be taken away unless I drink it, then let it be what you want.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu.
en: My inner being delights in the law of God.

dag: Wuntitali ni daŋ o tooni nti mali soli zal o.
en: Righteousness will go before the Lord and prepare the path for him.

dag: Amaa mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun kpihindi yi daalahichi. Mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ka n niŋdi lala maa. N ku lan teei yi daalahichi maa yɛla.
en: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Ti bi mi di ni daa yi so sanna.
en: So they told Jesus, We don't know who gave John the right to baptize.

dag: Ɛlam daŋ ni: Matania mini Zakaria ni Jɛhiɛl ni Abidi ni Jɛrɛmɔt ni Ɛlia.
en: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;.

dag: Tahimi pam, ka di shini! Duhim a kukoli kaman kikaa kumsi la n-yɛli n niriba Izraɛlnima bɛ tipawumli mini bɛ daalahichi yɛla.
en: Shout loudly; dont hold back; raise your voice like a trumpet! Announce to my people their crime, to the house of Jacob their sins.

dag: Yawɛ yɛli n dana, Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti zaŋ a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: The Lord said to my lord, Sit here at my right side until I put your enemies under your feet.

dag: Tiŋ maa niriba zaa bɔrila bindirigu ka kul ŋuhira. Bɛ zaŋ bɛ daazichi zaa taɣi bindirigu ni bɛ lan nya yaa. Yawɛ, lihimi nya n ni bahi yoli shɛm.
en: Her people groan as they look for something to eat; They exchange their treasures for food to keep themselves alive. Look at me, Lord , the city cries; see me in my misery.

dag: chɛliya ka paɣiba shini baalim cheechinim ni, dama bɛ ka soli ni bɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Di bi simdi ni bɛ nyɛ toondaannim kaman Naawuni zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: the women should keep quiet in the meetings. They are not allowed to speak; as the Jewish Law says, they must not be in charge.

dag: N kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma zuɣu ni yi karimmi gbaŋ ŋɔ wuhi ti mabihi la zaa.
en: I tell you by the authority of the Lord to read this letter to all the believers there.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Zaŋm li ti niŋ Yawɛ liɣiri pɔŋ ni. Bɛ ni daa zali n daa shɛm m-bala. Ka n daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita maa niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu liɣiri ni.
en: The LORD said to me, Put it in the treasury. They value me at too magnificent a price. So I took the thirty shekels of silver and put them in the treasury of the LORDs house.

dag: Bahi n-kul gili ma; tuumbiɛtumdiba pam n-teei gili ma. Bɛ malila binyara kuhiri n nuhi mini n naba.
en: An evil gang is around me; like a pack of dogs they close in on me; they tear at my hands and feet.

dag: Wuntizɔra ba ni mali suhupiɛlli pam; ŋunkam dɔɣi bi so ŋun mali yɛm ni mali suhupiɛlli o zuɣu.
en: A righteous person's parents have good reason to be happy. You can take pride in a wise child.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi nimaani ka Lɛvi zuliya nachimbil ŋun daa be Maika yiŋ maa sanna nti bɔh o o daalaafee yɛla.
en: So they stopped at Micahs house, where the young Levite lived. They asked the young man how he was.

dag: Suhudoo be ŋmɛnditoya yinsi, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ wuna niŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ nuu ni, ka nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka Naawuni suhu yiɣisiri ŋɔ lee nyɛ bɛn yiri barina ni.
en: Raiders tents are prosperous and Gods provokers secure, who carry God in their hands.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then this message from the Lord came to me:.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛl o zahindi maa ni, Iin, m mi ni a bi tɛhi a suhu ni ni a tum taali, amaa mani n-chɛ ka a bi tum alahichi n sani maa; di zuɣu ka m bi chɛ ka a shih o maa.
en: God replied in the dream, Yes, I know that you did it with a clear conscience; so I kept you from sinning against me and did not let you touch her.

dag: Di saha ka Dilaila daa bɔhi Samsin, Wula ka a yɛri ni a yuri ma ka a suhu ka n ni? Siɣimsiɣim buta zaa ka a boli ma jɛrigu, ka bi saɣi yɛli ma a kpiɔŋ din galisi pam maa ni be a luɣ shɛli.
en: Delilah said to him, How can you say, I love you, when you wont trust me? Three times now youve made a fool out of me and not told me what gives you such great strength.

dag: A ni lo nia ni a niŋ bin suŋ shɛŋa ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a sizuura galisiya pam. Ka a lan nyɛ ŋun lo nia ni a niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zo na ti sɔɣ a sani din viɛli pam sokam zaa ninni.
en: How wonderful are the good things you keep for those who honor you! Everyone knows how good you are, how securely you protect those who trust you.

dag: N ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu dihi niriba tusaanu la, piɛr ala ka yi daa lee laɣisi di zaɣ chɛhi pali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Piɛri pinaayi.
en: When I broke five loaves of bread for those five thousand people, how many baskets full of leftovers did you gather? They answered, Twelve.

dag: Ka bɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Ti ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa na kul be o nyɛvil ni ka mal alaafee. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri silim tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: They said, Your servant our father is fine. Hes still alive. And they bowed down again with deep respect.

dag: Isaka zuliya tiŋgbani maa tariga wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni su tiŋgban yini.
en: Along the boundary of Issachar from the eastern border to the western border: Zebulun, one portion.

dag: Nia shɛŋa din be ninsal suhu ni ŋmanila kɔbil zilinli puuni kom, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun mali baŋsim ni tooi ŋɔŋ di kom maa.
en: A person's thoughts are like water in a deep well, but someone with insight can draw them out.

dag: Yi niɣi ni tuui dɔɣi naɣilabihi shɛb mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu ni tuui dɔɣi zaɣ la shɛb zaa, yin zaŋmiya ba ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ. Di zaŋya yi naɣilabihi tuulinim tum tuma, yi mi di chɛnya yi biŋkɔbbaligu ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛb kɔbiri.
en: You must devote every oldest male animal from your herds or flocks to the LORD your God. Dont plow with your oldest male ox and dont shear your oldest male sheep.

dag: Miriya ka yi pɔhi yi puri ni tiwala zaa bee n-gahim yi wain wal shɛŋa din lu tiŋa. Chɛliya li ti nandaamba mini saamba. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Bɛria daa nyaŋ niriba gari bɛn daa be Tɛsalɔnaika la, dama bɛ daa taɣi deei yɛligu maa ni suhupiɛlli, ka vihiri Naawuni litaafinim ni biɛɣukam ni bɛ nya yɛla maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: The Beroean Jews were more honorable than those in Thessalonica. This was evident in the great eagerness with which they accepted the word and examined the scriptures each day to see whether Paul and Silas teaching was true.

dag: Sulemaana daa tum din nyɛ alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka daa bi lan doli Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga kaman o ba Dauda la.
en: So Solomon did what the Lord said was wrong. He did not follow the Lord completely as his father David did.

dag: O yi daa kala o zaɣ zaŋli na, di simdi ka o lan chaŋ o zaɣ zaŋli. Ka di yi nyɛla o min o paɣa n-daa kana, dindina di simdi ka o min o paɣa maa zaa lan chaŋ.
en: If he came in single, he will leave single. If he came in married, then his wife will leave with him.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim sɔŋ ti! Zaŋm a yiko tiligi ti; zaŋm a yiko maa niŋ kaman a ni daa pun niŋ shɛm kurimbuni ha la. Nyini n-daa chɛ ŋ-ŋmahi teeku ni biŋkɔb so bɛ ni booni Rahab la.
en: Wake up! Wake up! Arm of the Lord , clothe yourself with strength. Show your power the way you did long ago, as you have from ancient times. You are the one who destroyed Rahab. You defeated the Dragon.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli Ayuba sanʒiɛɣu puuni.
en: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:.

dag: Ti ni tɔɣisiri zuɣu ni kpahibu yɛl shɛŋa yɛla ŋɔ daliri nyɛla ni di kpaŋsi yurilim din yiri suhu din ka daɣiri mini suhu ni tɛha din ka galimi ni yɛda niŋbu maŋli ni na.
en: The purpose of this order is to arouse the love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and a genuine faith.

dag: Nir yi wum yɛndana saɣisigu, di so ni o wum jɛrigu yila.
en: It is better to have wise people reprimand you than to have stupid people sing your praises.

dag: N niŋ ti Duuma naani ni yi ku doli din be di ko ka chɛ n ni doli so shɛl la. Ka ŋun chirindi ya yi kul nyɛ sokam, o ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: Im convinced about you in the Lord that you wont think any other way. But the one who is confusing you will pay the penalty, whoever that may be.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bia Jɔab la daa su tɔbbihi fukumsi ka Jɛhɔshafat Ahilud bia la nyɛ gbansabira wulana.
en: Joab the son of Zeruiah was the commander in chief of the army. Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud kept the government records.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba pia la daa wum lala ka je suli niŋ Jeemsi mini Jɔn.
en: When the other ten disciples heard about it, they became angry with James and John.

dag: Buŋ maa ni daa nya Yawɛ malaika maa, ka o chaŋ ti tabili gooni n-zaŋ Balaam napɔnvaɣu sooi gooni maa; ka o daa lan fiɛbi buŋ maa.
en: Again the donkey saw the Lord s angel. So the donkey walked very close to one wall. This crushed Balaams foot against the wall. So Balaam hit his donkey again.

dag: A ni ti yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tin shɛli puuni bɛ ni kuri niriba, ka maani buɣa n-ta bɛmaŋ daɣiri la saha paaya.
en: Tell the city what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying: Because you have murdered so many of your own people and have defiled yourself by worshiping idols, your time is coming.

dag: Ka kahiŋkɔri maa daa shiri tahiri bindirigu mini nimdi na nti tir o asiba ni zaawuni; ka o daa nyuri kulibɔŋ maa ni kom.
en: He drank water from the brook, and ravens brought him bread and meat every morning and every evening.

dag: Ka a zaŋ li sɔŋ pie taba kulis ayi salima teebuli la zuɣu. Kul yini kam zuɣu zaɣ kpil ayɔbu.
en: Put them in two rows on the golden table before the Lord . Six loaves will be in each row.

dag: di saha doo ŋun paai yuun pisi zaŋ hal ni yuun pihiyɔbu, o daa yɛn nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu bini pihinu kaman jɛmbu duu liɣiri zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: if it is the value for a male between and years old, his value is fifty silver shekels according to the sanctuarys shekel.

dag: Tibidarigibo dabisili dali, Ifriim tiŋ ni ti kpalim dabari. Izraɛl zuliya ka n yɛri din shiri ti yɛn niŋ maa.
en: Ephraim will become a horrible place on the Judgment Day. Against the tribes of Israel I will certainly announce what is to take place.

dag: Bɛ yi di daa tɛhirila bɛ ni daa pun yi tin shɛl na la yɛla, bɛ daa naan nya soli n-lan lab nimaani.
en: They did not keep thinking about the country they had left; if they had, they would have had the chance to return.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Apis guui? Bɔzuɣu ka yi naɣilaa maa di bi zani? Yawɛ ni ŋme o luhi zuɣu.
en: Why has your mighty god Apis fallen? The Lord has struck him down.

dag: A yi lo ni a niŋ shɛli, di ni niŋ; ka neesim lan neei a soya zuɣu.
en: If you decree something, it will stand; light will shine on your ways.

dag: Amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn soli ŋmanila biɛkaali neesim, di kul neerimi pahiri hal ti be kaman wuntaŋ yi ti zani zuɣu ni la.
en: The way of the righteous is like morning light that gets brighter and brighter till it is full day.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o dabili zooi kaman bimbilin shɛli din jila ba tiŋa tiŋkuŋ ni. Ti ni daa nya o, o daa ka dariza bee viɛlim. Shɛli daa ka o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu lihibu ni din ni chɛ ka ti bɔr o.
en: He was always close to the Lord. He grew up like a young plant, like a root growing in dry ground. There was nothing special or impressive about the way he looked, nothing we could see that would cause us to like him.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔhi bɛ takɔbiri ka guri bɛ tɔbiri ni bɛ nyaŋ faranim mini nandaamba, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi.
en: The wicked draw their swords and bend their bows to kill the poor and needy, to slaughter those who do what is right;.

dag: Bɛ ni ti lu bɛ dimnim zuɣu n-ku bɛ dimnim maa zaa.
en: You will lift your hand against your enemies, and you will destroy them.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk daa boli Ibrahimma na nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ti lala? Taal bɔ ka n lee tum a ka a ti chɛ ka m mini n nam ŋɔ tum alahichi titali ŋɔ? A niŋ ma di ni bi simdi ni nir niŋ o kpee shɛm.
en: Then Abimelech summoned Abraham and said to him, What have you done to us? What sin did I commit against you that you have brought this terrible sin to me and my kingdom, by doing to me something that simply isnt done.

dag: Iso paɣ Oholibama bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ nanima n-daa nyɛ: Jɛushi mini Jalam ni Kɔra. Iso paɣ Oholibama Ana bipuɣiŋga la ni daa dɔɣi na shɛba m-bala.
en: These are the sons of Esaus wife Oholibamah: Chief Jeush, Chief Jalam, and Chief Korah. They are the tribal chiefs of Esaus wife Oholibamah the daughter of Anah.

dag: Ka ŋun nyɛ sana bee yi ni bu so paa bi simdi ni o di li.
en: No temporary resident or hired worker may eat it.

dag: Dama Aram tinzuɣu nyɛla Damaskus, ka Rɛzin gba nyɛ Damaskus zuɣulana.
en: Why? Because Syria is no stronger than Damascus, its capital city, and Damascus is no stronger than King Rezin. As for Israel, within sixty-five years it will be too shattered to survive as a nation.

dag: Izraɛlnima, wummiya: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti Naawuni, kulla Yawɛ kɔŋko.
en: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa yɛr o bia Iso maa, ka Ribɛka beni wumda. Dinzuɣu saha shɛli Iso ni daa yi n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni ni o ti ku nimdi maa na, ka Ribɛka daa yɛl o bia Yaakubu.
en: So Esau went hunting. Rebekah was listening when Isaac told this to his son Esau.

dag: Paɣ so daa beni n-nyɛ anabi, ka o yuli booni Anna. O daa nyɛla Fanuɛl bia, ka nyɛ Asha zuliya ni nira. O daa kurigiya pam; o daa ʒini doo yil la yuma ayopɔin.
en: Anna, a prophetess, was there at the Temple. She was from the family of Phanuel in the tribe of Asher. She was now very old. She had lived with her husband seven years.

dag: Magibish — kɔbiga ni pihinunaayɔbu.
en: of Magbish.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi Filistianim zuɣu. N ni ku Chɛrɛtinima, ka ku bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim be teeku dul la.
en: So now the LORD God proclaims: I will overpower the Philistines, eliminate the Cherethites, and obliterate all who are left along the coastline.

dag: Amaa nyin Daniɛl, kul ʒe yim hal ni di bahigu ni. A ni ti vuhi, ka ni ti zani a zaashee zaadali.
en: Now as for you, go on to the end. You will rest and will stand to receive your reward at the end of days.

dag: Ka Piɛbil maa daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah anahi, ka binnɛɔŋ ŋun pah anahi yɛli, Kamina.
en: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, Come.

dag: bee o bapir bee o bapir bia ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o bee o daŋ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ o talahi nir ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o bee o yi ti nya buni o ni tooi yo ka deeg omaŋa.
en: their uncle or cousin can buy them back; one of their blood relatives from their family can buy them back; or they may be able to afford their own purchase.

dag: Amaa bɛ zuɣu n ni teei n ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛl la yɛla, n ni daa yihi shɛb Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na zuliya pam ninni nti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni la. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord , and I will never forget our agreement.

dag: A yi yɛn niŋ ma la lala, nyin niŋm ma nirilim n-dii ku ma, ka lala chɛ ka n ku nya n nandahima biɛhigu.
en: If you plan to continue giving me their troubles, kill me now. If you accept me as your servant, let me die now. Then I will be finished with all my troubles.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka niriba maa galisi kaman ʒii bukɔbiga zuɣu pahi, ka chɛ ka n dan naa nini nya li, ka bɔzuɣu ka nyin n dan naa lan bɔr ni a niŋ dimbɔŋɔ yaha.
en: But Joab said to the king, May the Lord your God give you times as many people, no matter how many there are! And may your eyes see this thing happen. But why do you want to do this.

dag: Paɣimiy o; ŋuna n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun tum tuun kara din mali dabiɛm ka yi nina nya maa.
en: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Hashimɔna maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Mɔsɛrɔt.
en: They left Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti ni yɛli ni Naawuni bi niŋ din tuhi? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: So what does this mean? That God is not fair? We cannot say that.

dag: bɛ ni yɛn yo ti sam shɛli nyɛla bɛ kana ni bɛ ti kari ti a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti ni ti su maa ni.
en: This is how they repay us—they come to drive us out of the land that you gave us.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti du Olivi tihi Zoli n-chani ka kumda. O daa zaŋla bini pil o zuɣu, ka chani napɔn zaŋa. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani gba zaŋ bina pil bɛ zuɣuri n-kumdi dol o chana.
en: David walked up the path to the Mount of Olives. He was crying, his head was covered, and he went without sandals on his feet. All the people with David also covered their heads and were crying as they walked with him.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, M bihi, n ku lan yuui yi sani. Yi ni ti bo ma kɔŋ; n ni daa yɛli Yɛhudianim shɛm la, lala ka n yɛri yi gba maa, n ni chani luɣ shɛli maa yi ku tooi ka nimaani na.
en: Jesus said, My children, I will be with you only a short time more. You will look for me, but I tell you now what I told the Jewish leaders: Where I am going you cannot come.

dag: O nyɛla Naawuni Shi so ni yɛlimaŋli ni be, ka dunianim ku tooi deeg o, dama bɛ bi nyar o, bɛ mi bi mi o; amaa yinim mi o, dama o be yi sani ka ni ti be yi ni.
en: This Companion is the Spirit of Truth, whom the world cant receive because it neither sees him nor recognizes him. You know him, because he lives with you and will be with you.

dag: Ziɔnnima, dumiya zoya zuɣu nti moli lahiba suŋ molo. Jɛrusalɛmnima, duhimiya yi yee moli lahiba suŋ molo. Duhimiya yi kukoya pam yɛli Juda fɔntinsi ni nima, Yi Naawuni kanna! Di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: Jerusalem, go up on a high mountain and proclaim the good news! Call out with a loud voice, Zion; announce the good news! Speak out and do not be afraid. Tell the towns of Judah that their God is coming!.

dag: Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt ni daa wum ni bɛ ku Nɛr bia Abinɛr la Hiburɔn, o kɔba ni daa chɔɣisimi, ka Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri zɔhira.
en: When Saul's son Ishbosheth heard that Abner had been killed in Hebron, he was afraid, and all the people of Israel were alarmed.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn muɣisiri bɛ yinsinim ti ku lan mali binshɛli yaha, ka jɛra ni ti tumdi tuma tiri yɛnnima.
en: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Mara nti kɔŋ di kom nyubu, dama di daa tomi, di zuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Mara.
en: When they came to Marah, they couldnt drink Marahs water because it was bitter. Thats why it was called Marah.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ daa ti yɛn lu, ka Jɔshua bahi noli ka bɛ siɣisi ba tihi maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ ba bahi vo shɛl ni bɛ ni daa zo nti sɔɣ la ni, ka bilim kuɣ kara ti ŋari di noli, ka di na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: At sundown, Joshua gave an order, and they took them down from the trees. They threw them into the cave where they had hidden themselves, and they set large stones over the mouth of the cave. The stones are still there to this very day.

dag: A nyɛla jilimalana, ka mali dariza gari zo shɛŋa din zuɣu pali mɔɣu ni nimdi.
en: You are ablaze with light, mightier than the mountains that give food.

dag: Mani n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka nam ninsalinim niŋ di ni. N nuhi ka n daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa, ka su binshɛɣukam din be nimaani fukumsi.
en: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.

dag: ka gbilisiri tibili wumdi n ni timdi n dab shɛb bɛn nyɛ anabinim yi sanna la yɛligu, dama yi pun bi gbilisiri tibili wumdi li.
en: Again and again I have sent my servants the prophets to preach to you, but you ignored them as well. Now I am warning you that if you don't start obeying me at once.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa ka Leeban ŋun nyɛ Aram nir maa sanna yuŋ zahindi ni ti yɛl o, Miri ka a yɛli Yaakubu yɛtɔɣ viɛlli bee yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu.
en: But God appeared to Laban in a dream that night and warned, Don't say a word to Jacob. Don't make a threat or a promise.

dag: Yɛhudianim n-daa gbaai do so n ni tahi a sanna ŋɔ n-yɛn ku o, ka n daa wum ni o nyɛla Rom tiŋbia ka daa zaŋ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti fa o bahi.
en: Some Jews grabbed this man and were about to kill him. But when I found out that he was a Roman citizen, I took some soldiers and rescued him.

dag: Dinzuɣu kulim a ya pumpɔŋɔ. N daa yɛliya ni n ni ti a pin titali, amaa Yawɛ chɛ ka a kɔŋ pini maa.
en: Now get on home! I promised to reward you, but the Lord has kept you from getting the reward.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ o yɛligu n-yɛli Pɛtuɛl bia Joɛl shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Joel son of Pethuel received this message from the Lord :.

dag: ka do so zaŋ o dɔni, ka paɣ maa niŋ zina, amaa ka o yidan bi baŋ, ka so mi bi di li shɛhira, bɛ ni bi gbaai paɣ maa di niŋbu ni maa zuɣu.
en: that a man has had intercourse with her unknown to her husband and that she has defiled herself in secret—even though there are no witnesses and she isnt caught.

dag: Yinim wuntizɔriba, maliya suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani, ka paɣ o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ!.
en: Rejoice in the LORD, righteous ones! Give thanks to his holy name!.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, yin yɛlimiya ŋ-ŋɔ: Ti Ba Naawuni, chɛ ka a yuli du, ka chɛ ka a nam kana.
en: Jesus told them, When you pray, say: Father, uphold the holiness of your name. Bring in your kingdom.

dag: Daanya viɛlli ka Huram daa zaŋ mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu binyara din nyɛ duɣuri mini soobuya ni taha la zaa ti Naa Sulemaana.
en: pans for hot ashes, and also shovels and sprinkling bowls. Hiram made these bronze things for Solomon.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni niŋ ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ na bi vuui.
en: You can be sure that some of the people of this generation will still be alive when all of this takes place.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Zuf, ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumda so ŋun daa be o sani maa, Kamina ka ti lab kuli, di yi pa lala m ba ni chɛ bunsi ŋɔ yɛla tɛhibu ka kpalim tɛhirila ti yɛla.
en: Finally, Saul and the servant came to the town named Zuph. Saul said to his servant, Lets go back. My father will stop worrying about the donkeys and start worrying about us.

dag: Dama n daa doli Yawɛ zaligunima, ka daa bi tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma ŋ-ŋmaligi ka chɛ ŋuna ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni maa.
en: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Judas, puhigu mini kpariŋ mɔɣisibu ka a yɛn zaŋ yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa.
en: But Jesus said, Judas, is it with a kiss that you betray the Son of Man.

dag: Yi yi ti suhiri Naawuni, yi boon o la yi Ba. Ŋun Naawuni n-nyɛ sariakarita ŋun kariti sokam zaa yinoyino saria kaman o tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bi yaari so yuri ka chɛ so, dinzuɣu lumiy o sizuura saha shɛli yi ni be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ.
en: You pray to God and call him Father, but he will judge everyone the same way—by what they do. So while you are visiting here on earth, you should live with respect for God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam dunia ŋɔ, ŋuna ŋun daa pil li, ka zal li ŋɔ, o yuli m-booni Yawɛ, O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord made the earth, and he keeps it safe. The Lord is his name. He says.

dag: Di saha ka peentɔriba daa tam gooni zuɣu ka tɔri ti piɛma na. Bɛ daa ku naa tɔbbihi maa shɛba, hal naa tɔbbia Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la gba kpiya.
en: Then the men on the city wall shot arrows at your officers. Some of your officers were killed, including Uriah the Hittite.

dag: Ka n daa nya tiŋ kasi din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm palli, ka di yi Naawuni sani alizanda ni n-sirigirina, ka malimali m-be kaman amiliya ni yi mal omaŋa n-gu o daaŋgo shɛm la.
en: And I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God. It was prepared like a bride dressed for her husband.

dag: A yɛtɔɣa daa taɣiri bɛn tuuri zaana. A daa kpaŋsi bɛn duna ni ka yaa la.
en: Your words helped those who were ready to fall. You gave strength to those who could not stand by themselves.

dag: Di saha a ni ti teei a ni daa be shɛm la yɛla, ka vi gbaag a. Saha shɛli n yi ti zaŋ a mabihi bɛn nyɛ a biɛli min a tizo la ti a kaman a bipuɣinsi la. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ pala n ni lo a alikauli shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: When you think about how you acted, you will be ashamed, especially when I return your sisters to you as daughters, even though this was not part of our agreement.

dag: Fɔntinsi zaa din daa be tintan ni mini Giliad zaa ni Bashan zaa zaŋ hal ni Salɛka ni Ɛdirɛi, fɔn shɛŋa din daa be Bashan Naa Ogi nam sulinsi ni la.
en: We took all the cities in the high plain and all of Gilead. We took all of Bashan, all the way to Salecah and Edrei. Salecah and Edrei were cities of Ogs kingdom of Bashan.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zaa lee tumdila din ni tiɣi ti kpee nini o zaɣ viɛlli nyabu min o kpaŋsibu zuɣu.
en: Instead, we should all please other believers for their own good, in order to build them up in the faith.

dag: Yisifu ŋmanila ti shɛli din wandi wala, ka nyɛ din ʒe n-tab kulibɔŋ, ka di wula zooi yaɣi kuligbiriŋ zuɣu.
en: Joseph is like a wild donkey, like a young donkey by a spring, like colts grazing in a pasture.

dag: Ti Duuma ŋun daa kahigi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha piligu ni wuhi la n-yɛl lala.
en: All this has been known from the beginning of time.

dag: Di saha ka o daa chɛbis o biɛyanim maa. Bɛ ni daa yiɣisi ni bɛ chaŋ, ka Yisifu yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi ŋme tab naŋgbankpeeni sol ni.
en: He sent his brothers off; and as they were leaving, he told them, Dont be worried about the trip.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi, ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi mini zimburisa din guui pali piɛr ayopɔin.
en: Everyone ate all they wanted, and the leftovers filled seven large baskets.

dag: Yi tiŋ daa lumi dahim leei dabari, amaa di pɔri pam pumpɔŋɔ, ka bɛn kanna ni bɛ ti be di ni ni muɣi li. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wurim li maa ni zo n-chaŋ katiŋ ka chɛn ya.
en: As for your ruins and desolate places and destroyed land— you will soon be crowded with settlers, and those who swallowed you will be far away.

dag: O daa bi wuhiri ba shɛli ka pa ni yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni, amaa di daa yi ti kpalim o min o nyaandoliba maa ko, o kahigirila binshɛɣukam gbinni wuhiri ba.
en: He spoke to them only in parables, then explained everything to his disciples when he was alone with them.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ʒi tibisa ʒili ti n-daari ti chana; di wum ti, ka bɛ bi chɛ ka ti vuhi.
en: Our hunters have been at our necks; we are worn out, but have no rest.

dag: Bakibakar ni Hɛrɛsh ni Galal ni Matania ŋun daa nyɛ Maika bia la, Maika daa nyɛla Zikiri bia, ka Zikiri nyɛ Asaf bia.
en: Also living in Jerusalem were Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah. Mattaniah was Micas son. Mica was Zicris son. Zicri was Asaphs son.

dag: Ka a yi yɛn bah o ka o chaŋ, nyin di chɛ ka di muɣis a, dama o tum tuma yuma ayɔbu ti a, ka di gar a ni di yɛn zaŋ laɣ shɛli bu padiriba paa ʒii buyi, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ a tuuni kam ni.
en: Don't complain when you have to set a slave free. After all, you got six years of service at half the cost of hiring someone to do the work.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim maa daa yina nti teei zani tiŋ maa dunol ni, ka Siria tɔbbihi bɛn daa yi Zɔba mini Rɛhɔb ni Tɔb ni Maaka na la mi laɣim ʒe mɔɣu ni mɔɣu ni.
en: The Ammonites marched out and formed a battle line at the entrance to the city. The Arameans of Zobah and Rehob and the soldiers from Tob and Maacah remained in the countryside.

dag: Ti min o ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini mini ti ni niŋ o yɛda la zuɣu ka ti mali suhukpeeni ka niŋ naani ti ni nya soli ni ti tooi chaŋ Naawuni sani la zuɣu.
en: In Christ we come before God with freedom and without fear. We can do this because of our faith in Christ.

dag: Ammɔnnim ni daa nya ka Sirianim maa ŋmaligi guui maa, ka bɛ gba daa ŋmaligi Abishai tooni guui ti kpe bɛ tiŋ maa puuni. Di saha ka Jɔab daa yi Ammɔnnim maa tuhibu yɔɣu n-lab Jɛrusalɛm.
en: When the Ammonite soldiers saw that the Arameans had run away, they ran from Abishai's soldiers and went back into their own city. Joab stopped fighting the Ammonites and returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni tilig a, ka bɛ ku zaŋ a niŋ a ni zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb la nuu ni.
en: But I will save you on that day, Ebed Melech. This is the message from the Lord . You will not be given to the people you are afraid of.

dag: Nyama, karimbaannima! Bɛ suhuri ni tɛha bi tuhi, amaa wuntizɔriba ni bela bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: I, the Lord , refuse to accept anyone who is proud. Only those who live by faith are acceptable to me.

dag: Ka o ye binyɛr shɛl din ŋam ʒim, ka o yuli daa booni Naawuni Yɛligu.
en: The rider wore a robe that was covered with blood, and he was known as The Word of God.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli Aruna, Aai, n ni da li mi kaman di daa ni kul nyɛ shɛm. N ku zaŋ binshɛli din nyɛ a dini ti Yawɛ bee n-zaŋ n ni bi da binshɛli m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la.
en: But the king answered, No, I will pay you the full price. I will not give as an offering to the Lord something that belongs to you, something that costs me nothing.

dag: O daa poya yɛli ni o ni chɛ ka ti tiligi ti dimnim nuu ni, ka jɛmdi ŋun ti Duuma Naawuni ka ku lan zɔri dabiɛm;.
en: that we would be rescued from the power of our enemies so that we could serve him without fear.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ dunia ŋɔ niŋ o nuu ni? Ka ŋuni n-lee zaŋ dunia zaa fukumsi ti o?.
en: No one chose God to be in charge of the earth. No one gave him responsibility for the whole world.

dag: Yawɛ be o jɛmbu duu din be kasi ni; ka o nam ʒiishee be alizanda ni. O nini nyari daadamnima, ka kpahindi ba.
en: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.

dag: Maligim maa ni daa ti vuui, ka Izraɛlnim maa nya ka binkpil bihi piɛla yɛrigi tiŋgban ni zaa.
en: After the dew had gone, the desert was covered with thin flakes that looked like frost.

dag: A yi lo ni a niŋ shɛli, di ni niŋ; ka neesim lan neei a soya zuɣu.
en: You will succeed in all you do, and light will shine on your path.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba ka chaŋ ti kpe do so ŋun yuli daa booni Taitius Justus la yiŋa. O daa nyɛla ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni, ka o yiŋ daa baɣi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu.
en: So he left them and went to live in the house of a Gentile named Titius Justus, who worshiped God; his house was next to the synagogue.

dag: Bɛ ku ninkura mini bihi sɔŋ solɔri zuɣu; bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri ku m paɣisara mini n nachimba. A suhu ni daa yiɣisi dahin shɛl la ka a daa ku ba maa. A daa kɔrikɔri ba, ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: Young and old alike lie on the ground in the streets; my young women and young men fall dead by the sword. On the day of your anger, you killed; you slaughtered, showing no compassion.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka o yɛn chaŋ, ka yihi liɣiri kaman tumtumda daba ayi yɔri ti o yilikpɛrilana, ka yɛl o ni o lihim bara maa viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka lan yɛli ni hal o yi ti di laɣ shɛli o ni ti o maa pooi ka di omaŋmaŋ liɣiri pahi, o yi ti labina o ni yo o.
en: The next day he took out two silver coins and gave them to the innkeeper. Take care of him, he told the innkeeper, and when I come back this way, I will pay you whatever else you spend on him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Mɔabnim mini Ammɔnnim ni Miunnim shɛb daa ti lo tɔb na ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛhɔshafat.
en: Some time later, the armies of Moab and Ammon, together with the Meunites, went to war against Jehoshaphat.

dag: Yawɛ, a bi lihiri bɔrila yɛlimaŋli? A ŋme ba, amaa di bi mii ba, a darigi bɛ tibili, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi ni bɛ ku deeg a saɣisigu. Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ suhuri kpɛm gari kuɣili. Bɛ zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku niŋ tuuba.
en: LORD, dont you look for integrity? You have struck them down, but they didnt even cringe. You have crushed them, but they have ignored your discipline. They make their faces harder than rock and refuse to return.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni zali shɛli ŋɔ yi ti yiɣisi n sani, dindina Izraɛl zuliya gba ku lan nyɛla zuliya n sani sahakam.
en: He promises that as long as the natural order lasts, so long will Israel be a nation.

dag: Jɔn daa nyɛla firila din diri ka ne, ka yi daa saɣi m-mali suhupiɛlli o neesim maa ni daba ayi.
en: John was a burning and shining lamp, and, at least for a while, you were willing to celebrate in his light.

dag: Di saha yi ni baŋ wuntitali mini zaligu soli ni biɛrisuntali ni so viɛlli kam.
en: If you listen to me, you will know what is right, just, and fair. You will know what you should do.

dag: Yi yaannim daa zahim ma hal bɛ ni daa kul nya n ni tum shɛm la zaa yoli.
en: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ gulila m ba piɛri, ka gbuɣinli bee kunduŋ daa yi ti kana ti gbaai piɛbila guui;.
en: But David said to Saul, There were times when I was taking care of my fathers sheep that wild animals came to take some sheep from the flock. Once there was a lion and another time, a bear.

dag: Ka yi yi deei so chinchini sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ o ni bɔr shɛli paŋ o, yin labisim li ti o pɔi ka wuntaŋ naanyi lu.
en: If you take a piece of clothing from someone as a security deposit, you should return it before the sun goes down.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb malila bɛ chɛchɛbunsi nyuri bara; ka shɛb mi mali bɛ yuri nyuri bara, amaa tinim malila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ yuli nyuri bara.
en: Some give the credit for victory to their chariots and soldiers, but we honor the Lord our God.

dag: Ka Yisifu yɛli, Naawuni di saɣi ka n niŋ lala! Kulla n ni nya pipia maa so sani maa kɔŋko n-ni leei n dabili; amaa yinim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, kulimiya yi ba sani ni alaafee.
en: Joseph said, Id never do such a thing. Only the man found with the cup will be my slave. As for the rest of you, you are free to go back to your father.

dag: Shɛli ni n ni tooi yɛli zuliya shɛli bee nam shɛli niriba ni n ni vuɣi ba bee n-wurim ba ka ku ba.
en: At any time I may announce that I will dig up, pull down, and destroy a nation or kingdom.

dag: Ka yi yi saɣi, ŋuna n-nyɛ Anabi Ilaija so ŋun yɛn kana la.
en: If you are willing to accept it, he is Elijah who is to come.

dag: Bɛ bi tɔɣisiri suhudoo yɛtɔɣa; amaa bɛ nyɛla ʒiŋmariba bɛn tɔɣisiri ʒiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din bi niŋ kamaata zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be baalim be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni polo.
en: They have no friendly words for others, but plan ways to hurt those who want to live in peace.

dag: Yi yi nya ka ninsal kpi n-do mɔɣu ni ka yi bi mi ŋun ku o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ka yi su li maa ni.
en: Suppose someone is found murdered in a field in the land that the Lord your God is going to give you, and you do not know who killed him.

dag: Chɛ ka di leei liɣa, ka zibisim titali be di ni. Chɛ ka sagbana zibigi niŋ di ni. Chɛ ka zibisim nyaŋ di neesim.
en: and send thick, gloomy shadows to fill it with dread.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Musa zuɣu ka o yɛl o, Pa a mabia n-nyɛ Aduna ŋun nyɛ Lɛvi nir la? M mi ni o nyɛla ŋun ni tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga. Nyama, o nyɛla ŋun yɛn yina ti tuh a soli, ka o yi ti nya a, o suhu ni paligi pam.
en: Then the LORD got angry at Moses and said, What about your brother Aaron the Levite? I know he can speak very well. Hes on his way out to meet you now, and hes looking forward to seeing you.

dag: So ti ku tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yɔn ya. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti chɛ ka yi yɛla gbahi yi ni yɛn chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa nim zaa dabiɛm kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: No one will be able to stand up to you. Just as he promised, the LORD your God will make the entire land deathly afraid of you wherever you advance in it.

dag: Simiɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛmuɛl mini Jamin ni Ohad ni Jachin ni Zɔhar ni Shaul ŋun daa nyɛ Keenan paɣ bia la. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya ni kpamba.
en: The Simeonites: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, a Canaanite womans son. These were Simeons clans.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ kuɣili na nti yo bɔɣili maa noli, ka naa maa daa zaŋ o min o kpambaliba dalinli n-dalim kuɣili maa ni di chɛ ka shɛli ku taɣi zaŋ chaŋ Daniɛl polo.
en: A stone was rolled over the pit, and it was sealed. Then Darius and his officials stamped the seal to show that no one should let Daniel out.

dag: ka o baŋ ni o Ba pun zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ o nuu ni, ka lan mi ni o daa yila Naawuni sanna ka ni lan lab o sani.
en: Jesus knew he had come from God and would go back to God. He also knew that the Father had given him complete power.

dag: Ibrahimma kum nyaaŋa, Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o bia Yisahaku ni. Yisahaku daa bela Bɛrilahairoi.
en: God blessed Isaac after this, and Isaac moved to a place called The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ bɛ ni daa gbahi shɛba chaŋ Tɛlabib, ka bɛ be Kɛba Mɔɣili duli la sani. Ka n daa ʒini bɛ sani nimaani daba ayopɔin.
en: I went to the people of Israel who were forced to live in Tel Aviv by the Kebar Canal. I sat there among them for seven days, shocked and silent.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni tum alahiziba tuma niriba ŋɔ sani, ka di gari ba ka niŋ ba alahiziba. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yɛnnim ni leei jɛra, ka bɛ yɛm maa leei din ka buchi.
en: So once again I will do things that shock and amaze them, and I will destroy the wisdom of those who claim to know and understand.

dag: Di saha ka o daa neei bɛ nini ni bɛ baŋ Naawuni litaafinim maa gbinni.
en: Then he helped them understand the Scriptures.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaŋ o pagɔrisigu tuma maa chaŋ katiŋa. O daa nya bɛ ni mali dɔbba kɔtomsi pa dukpini zuɣu. Di daa nyɛla Babilɔnnim anfooni ka bɛ mali pa dukpina zuɣu, ka bɛ ye neen ʒiɛfaa.
en: but she was even more promiscuous. She saw men carved in wall reliefs, images of Chaldeans outlined in vermilion.

dag: Bɛ ku kpalim be Yawɛ tiŋgbani maa ni. Amaa Ifriimnim ni labi Ijipti nti di bindir shɛli din bi be kasi Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The Israelites will not stay in the Lord s land. Ephraim will return to Egypt. In Assyria they will eat food that they should not eat.

dag: Musa mini Izraɛlnim ni daa be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni n-kumdi saha shɛli maa, ka Izraɛl do so daa zaŋ Midian paɣ na ti kpe o suɣili ni bɛ zaa ninni.
en: Later, Moses and the people were at the sacred tent, crying, when one of the Israelite men brought a Midianite woman to meet his family.

dag: Midian mi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛfa mini Ɛfɛr ni Hanok ni Abida ni Ɛldaa. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Kɛtuura zuliya.
en: Midians family: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were members of Keturahs family.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Kpuɣim tɔbu mini piɛma; ka o kpuɣi tɔbu mini piɛma maa.
en: Elisha said to Jehoash, Take a bow and some arrows. Jehoash took a bow and some arrows.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun daa tiligi Ibrahimma o muɣisigu puuni la yɛli Yaakubu zuliya, Yi ku lan di vi, yi mi ninni biɛhigu ku lan taɣi.
en: So now the Lord , the God of Israel, who rescued Abraham from trouble, says, My people, you will not be disgraced any longer, and your faces will no longer be pale with shame.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn fiɣisiri ma la di vi ka bahi yoli. Chɛ ka bɛn bɔri ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu la di vi ka nya filiŋ.
en: May those who attack me be defeated and destroyed. May those who try to hurt me be shamed and disgraced.

dag: Miri ka a sɔɣi doya ni a liri wuntizɔra yiŋa kaman ninvuɣ biɛɣu la. Miri ka a liri wuntizɔriba biɛhigu shee.
en: Don't be like the wicked who scheme to rob honest people or to take away their homes.

dag: Ka a nudirigu mi yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nu yini, di so ni a niŋgbuŋ zaa ti kpe buɣim ni.
en: And if your right hand causes you to fall into sin, chop it off and throw it away. Its better that you lose a part of your body than that your whole body go into hell.

dag: Bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Zakur bia Shammua, o daa yila Rubin zuliya ni na;.
en: These are their names: from the tribe of Reuben—Shammua son of Zaccur;.

dag: ka o daa tim Tɛkɔa nti zaŋ paɣ so ŋun mali yɛm na ti yɛl o, Niŋmi kaman a nira n-kpi ka a kumd o zuɣu la. Zaŋmi kuyili situra niŋ amaŋa ka di ʒe kpam, amaa kul niŋmi kaman paɣ so ŋun nir kpi ka o kumd o zuɣu dabisi gbaliŋ la.
en: So Joab sent someone to Tekoa and brought a wise woman from there. He said to her, Pretend to be in mourning. Dress in mourning clothes. Dont anoint yourself with oil. Act like a woman who has spent a long time mourning over someone who has died.

dag: M mabihi, n kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma Yisa Masia mini yurilim shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri ti la zuɣu ni yi pahimi n zuɣu n-suhi Naawuni ti ma.
en: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.

dag: ka din pahi anii gbaai Jɛshaya min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Eighth, there were men chosen from Jeshaiahs sons and relatives.

dag: Yi bi ka la din nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni daa naan ku tooi shihi shɛl la gbin na, dina n-nyɛ: Zo shɛli buɣim ni diri mini zibisim ni sagbana zibigibu ni sanʒiɛɣu ʒiɛbu.
en: You havent drawn near to something that can be touched: a burning fire, darkness, shadow, a whirlwind.

dag: M mabihi, ti Duuma Yisa Masia n-nyɛ Duuma ŋun nyɛ Jilimalana. Ka yi ni doli yɛda niŋbu adiini so shɛli o ni zal la zuɣu, di yaaya so yuri ka chɛ so.
en: My brothers and sisters, when you show favoritism you deny the faithfulness of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has been resurrected in glory.

dag: Di ni ti yɛn kpalim dabari saha shɛli maa ni zaa di ni ti vuhi vuhim shɛli yi ni daa be nimaani ka di bi nyari yi vuhim dabisa dal la.
en: During the whole time it is devastated, it will have the rest it didnt have during the sabbaths you lived in it.

dag: Di daa niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim nya Ibrahimma ni daa nya alibarika shɛl la Yisa Masia zuɣu, ka ti zaa tooi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi so o ni daa lo ti alikauli la yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: He redeemed us so that the blessing of Abraham would come to the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, and that we would receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛm daa yɛl o ba Hamɔr, Bom paɣisarili ŋɔ ti ma ka n niŋ m paɣa.
en: He told his father, I want you to get Dinah for me as my wife.

dag: Ka o yɛli Yisa, N dana, wuhim ma o ni nyɛ so, ka n niŋ o yɛda.
en: He replied, Sir, if you will tell me who he is, I will put my faith in him.

dag: Duri maa tooni, so shɛli daa beni kpɛri dundɔŋ puuni. Di yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita anu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu, ka di dunoya daa be nuzaa polo.
en: In front of the chambers there was a passage fifteen feet wide, and to the inside, a passage eighteen inches wide. The entrance to the chambers was on the north.

dag: Dinzuɣu di gbihiriya, dama yi gba bi mi yi Duuma ni yɛn labina dahin shɛli.
en: Watch out, then, because you do not know what day your Lord will come.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ mi bɛ ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa zaa ni bɛ ku ma. Di chɛ bɛ taali maa, a mi di kpihim bɛ daalahichi a sani. Chɛ ka bɛ lu a tooni, ka a darigi bɛ tibili a suhuyiɣisili ŋɔ saha.
en: But you, LORD, you know all their sinister plots to kill me. Dont overlook their wrongdoing; dont cleanse their sin from before you. May they stumble before you; when you become angry, do something about them.

dag: A yi lo Naawuni alikauli, nyin palimi li yomyom, dama o je jɛra yɛlli. Niŋm a ni lo alikauli ni a niŋ shɛli.
en: God doesn't like fools. So don't be slow to keep your promises to God.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi yɛli teeku ni di nyuuma. N ni chɛ ka yi mɔɣa kom nyuui.
en: He tells the deep waters, Become dry! I will make your streams dry too.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ yɛda ni Yisa nyɛla Masia, dilana nyɛla Naawuni bia, ka ŋunkam yuri ba so ŋun dɔɣi bia ni yur o bia maa gba.
en: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.

dag: Nyama, bɛ zali ma la zaligu ni n niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni. O pun niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka n ku tooi vuui li.
en: I have been instructed to bless, And when God blesses, I cannot call it back.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, n yi ti niŋ ya din viɛla n yuli zuɣu ka pa ni yi tuumbiɛri mini yi biɛri yoli ni simdi shɛm zuɣu, yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then, house of Israel, you will know that I am the LORD, when I deal with you for the sake of my name and not according to your wicked ways and ruinous deeds. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Kuriinius n-daa nyɛ Siria Gomna niriba yuya tuui sab maa saha.
en: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Pa nyini n-yɛn ʒi lahibali maa kuli zuŋɔ, dahin shɛli ka a ni ti ʒi lahibali maa kuli, amaa zuŋɔ dina a ku ʒi lahibali maa kuli, dama nabia maa kpiya.
en: Joab answered Ahimaaz, No, you will not carry the message today. You can do it some other time, but not today because it is the kings son who is dead.

dag: Izraɛl naa ni daa nya ba, o daa bɔhila Ilaisha, M ba, n kum ba? N kum ba.
en: The king of Israel saw them and asked Elisha, Should I kill them, sir.

dag: Ka o ti lan lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna nti nya ka bɛ lan gbihirimi, dama gom n-daa mali ba pam.
en: He returned once more and found the disciples asleep; they could not keep their eyes open.

dag: A ni niŋ shɛm maa bi viɛla. Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi simdila kubu, dama yi bi gul yi dan naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni maa. Ka pumpɔŋɔ nyam naa kpan la min o ko gaɣili din ʒe o zuɣusaa la ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: You're a complete failure! I swear by the living Lord that you and your men deserve to die for not protecting the Lord 's chosen king. Look and see if you can find the king's spear and the water jar that were near his head.

dag: Amaa niriba pam bɛn daŋ tooni ni ti leei nyaannima, ka bɛn be nyaaŋa mi ti leei toonnima.
en: Many people who are first now will be last in the future. And many who are last now will be first in the future.

dag: Niŋgbun yini mini Shi yino m-beni kaman tahima yini din nyɛ Naawuni ni boli ya shɛli zuɣu ni beni shɛm la.
en: You are one body and one spirit, just as God also called you in one hope.

dag: Yaakubu daa kul bela Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni din nyɛ o ba ni daa be luɣ shɛl la.
en: Jacob continued to live in the land of Canaan, where his father had lived.

dag: Bɛ daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la jɛmbu, ka ŋmaligi jɛmdila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa gil ba la wuna. Ka bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm maa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhi yiɣisi.
en: They stopped worshiping the Lord , the God of their ancestors, the God who had brought them out of Egypt, and they began to worship other gods, the gods of the peoples around them. They bowed down to them and made the Lord angry.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli, Yi ni yino yɛliya, M bia n-nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ ŋɔ, ka bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ nyɛ a bia, ka ŋun la mi yɛli, Aai! M bia n-nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ maa, ka bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ nyɛ a bia. .
en: The king said, This one says, My son is alive and your son is dead. The other one says, No! Your son is dead and my son is alive.

dag: Nɛma nyaɣinyaɣi nyɛla yɔhiŋ, ka viɛlim nyɛ din naara, amaa paɣ so ŋun zɔri Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu.
en: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yiɣisi dari chah o binyɛra, ka teei dɔni tiŋgban ni ka kpambaliba bɛn daa be o sani gba dari chahi bɛ binyɛra.
en: David got up, and in his sorrow he tore his clothes and lay down on the ground. His servants remained standing, but they tore their clothes too.

dag: N zaŋ ya tahi tiŋgban shɛli din mali bindira pam ni ni yi ti di di tiwala mini di bin viɛla. Amaa ka yi ni kpe di ni yi saɣimla n tiŋgbani maa, ka zaŋ m pini maa leei zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: I brought you into a good land, a land filled with many good things. I did this so that you could eat the fruit and crops that grow there. But you only made my land dirty. I gave that land to you, but you made it a bad place.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali tipuma kɔtomsi mini firilanima ni gbabɔnima.
en: flower designs, lamps and tongs.

dag: Yɛm so tɔbutuhiri bidibbina. Amaa alahichilan yino saɣindi bin viɛla pam.
en: Wisdom does more good than weapons, but one sinner can undo a lot of good.

dag: ka o daa po pɔri n-lo alikauli ni bipuɣiŋga maa yi suh o shɛlikam zaa, o ni ti o li.
en: that he promised her, I swear that I will give you anything you ask for.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba paai sariakaritib sani ti yɛli, Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla Yɛhudianima, ka saɣindi ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: When her owners approached the legal authorities, they said, These people are causing an uproar in our city. They are Jews.

dag: Saliŋgbiriba zaŋdi bɛ firilanima n-nyandi zibisim tiŋgbani puuni, ka gbiri chani bɛ ni ni tooi paai luɣ shɛli tariga m-bɔri tahiʒiɛɣu kuɣa bumbɔn ni.
en: Humans put an end to darkness, dig for ore to the farthest depths, into stone in utter darkness.

dag: ka n ti tir a bindira nimaani, dama kum maa yuma na kpalim yuma anu, di yi pa lala kum maa ni ti miig a min a yiŋnim ni a ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: I will take care of you during the next five years of hunger. So you and your family will not lose everything you own.

dag: Ka Lazarɔs ŋun daa kpi maa shiri yina. Ka kahiŋga pɔb o n-lo o nuhi min o naba, ka bantabiga vil o zuɣu tabil o ninni. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yihimiya kahiŋga maa, ka viligi bantabiga maa, ka chɛ ka o chaŋ.
en: The dead man came out, his feet bound and his hands tied, and his face covered with a cloth. Jesus said to them, Untie him and let him go.

dag: Ka o ni daa tim shɛb maa chaŋ ti shiri nya o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: Those who had been sent found it exactly as he had said.

dag: Ka o ma daa wuh o o ni yɛn suhi shɛli; ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa yɛli Naa Hɛrɔd, Ŋmam Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu n-niŋ pɔŋ ni na ti ti ma.
en: At her mothers urging, the girl said, Give me the head of John the Baptist here on a plate.

dag: Nimdi mini gbaŋ dina, o daa zaŋ li yila bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa ti nyo li buɣim.
en: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.

dag: Buɣim daa di n-ku bɛ nachimbihi, ka paɣisara daa kɔŋ amiliya lɔbu yila.
en: Their young men were burned to death, and there were no wedding songs for their young women.

dag: Saha shɛli Judas ŋun daa yi Yisa nyaaŋa la ni daa ti wum ka bɛ yɛli ni bɛ kum Yisa, ka o daa galim omaŋa, ka zaŋ anzinfa kpil pihita la labisi ti ti maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba.
en: Judas had betrayed Jesus, but when he learned that Jesus had been sentenced to death, he was sorry for what he had done. He returned the silver coins to the chief priests and leaders.

dag: Pa mani ka o di tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa maa jɛndira, ka n ku zaŋ yi yɛtɔɣa maa garig o.
en: Now Job hasnt addressed me, and I wont quote you to him.

dag: Ninsal ni tooi fa Naawuni? Amaa yinim fari ma mi. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee fa a? Yi binyara pirigibu bupia kam puuni yim tibu mini yi sara pina tibu puuni.
en: I ask you, is it right for a person to cheat God? Of course not, yet you are cheating me. How? you ask. In the matter of tithes and offerings.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Daadam Bia n-su Vuhim Dabisili dali gba.
en: Then he said to them, The Human Oneis Lord of the Sabbath.

dag: So bi jɛmd a, so mi bi bɔri sɔŋsim a sani. Dama a lɛbila a nyaaŋa biri ti, ka chɛ ti niŋ ti daalahichi maa ni.
en: We dont call to you for help. We arent excited about following you, so you have turned away from us. We are helpless before you, because we are full of sin.

dag: Pirigimiya bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa na maa ʒiibuyi n-zaŋ yim ti tɔbbihi bɛn chaŋ tɔbu ni maa, ka zaŋ yim la mi ti Izraɛlnim zaa.
en: and divide the valuable property between the warriors who went into battle and the entire community.

dag: Ŋun Yawɛ n-daa lan kari Amɔrinim zaa bɛn daa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu tinim gba ni jɛmla Yawɛ, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni.
en: And when we fought the Amorites and the other nations that lived in this land, the Lord made them run away. Yes, we will worship and obey the Lord , because the Lord is our God.

dag: A chɛ ka tiŋ kara zani dabari; ka saɣim bɛ ni me bin shɛŋa taɣi bɛmaŋa. Tinzunnim ni me nayiya shɛŋa luya, ka so ku lan lab me li zali yaha.
en: You have turned cities into ruins and destroyed their fortifications. The palaces which our enemies built are gone forever.

dag: ka yuri puhigu dahi ni, ka lan yuri ni niriba booni ba bɛ karimbanima.
en: They love to be greeted with honor in the markets and to be addressed as Rabbi.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ maa ka paɣ so be salo maa ni kuhi yɛli, A ni daa yi pu shɛl ni na min a ni daa mɔɣ bihi shɛŋa mal alibarika.
en: When Jesus had said this, a woman spoke up from the crowd and said to him, How happy is the woman who bore you and nursed you.

dag: Nyum amaŋmaŋ kɔduɣu ni kom din yi amaŋmaŋ kɔbiliga puuni na.
en: Be faithful to your own wife and give your love to her alone.

dag: N yɛli Yawɛ, Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni. Yawɛ, gbilisim tibili wum n suhigu.
en: You, Lord , are my God! Please listen to my prayer.

dag: Ka a yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, nyin di niŋdi kaman bilikɔɣinim ni niŋdi shɛm la, dama bɛ yuri ni bɛ zani bɛ jɛmbu duri ni mini sochira zuɣu n-suhiri Naawuni ni niriba nyari ba. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛn pun nya bɛ laara.
en: When you pray, dont be like hypocrites. They love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners so that people will see them. I assure you, thats the only reward theyll get.

dag: O ni ti zaɣisi binshɛɣukam ninsalinim ni jɛmdi mini ninsalinim ni lihi so Naawuni la; o ni ti duh omaŋ gari dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha; hal o ni ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ti ʒini, ka yɛri ni o nyɛla Naawuni.
en: He will oppose every so-called god or object of worship and will put himself above them all. He will even go in and sit down in God's Temple and claim to be God.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi yi di mali yɛda ka di be kaman zabiliga tibiɛlim la, yi naan tooi yɛli sinsabiga ŋɔ ni di vuɣim di zaashee ŋɔ chaŋ ti zani teeku ni, ka di di niŋ lala.
en: The Lord replied, If you had faith the size of a mustard seed, you could say to this mulberry tree, Be uprooted and planted in the sea, and it would obey you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Bɛ daa lan ŋmaligi jɛmdila Baal mini Ashitarɔt din nyɛ Sirianim mini Sidɔnnim ni Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim buɣa la, ka zaɣisi Yawɛ, ka chɛ o jɛmbu.
en: Then the Israelites again did things that the LORD saw as evil. They served the Baals and the Astartes, as well as the gods of Aram, Sidon, Moab, the Ammonites, and the Philistines. They went away from the LORD and didnt serve him.

dag: N ŋmanila tikpiralana, m bi tooi wumda, ka ŋmani birigu ŋun ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa.
en: I am not able to hear or speak a word;.

dag: Karimbaannim maani ma la ansarisi ka di ka yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka m bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ a zaligu maa dolibu.
en: The arrogant make fun of me to no end, but I havent deviated from your Instruction.

dag: Rubin, nyini n-nyɛ m bituuli, nyini n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ; ka lan nyɛ n dɔtali tuuli bia. A nyɛla toondana ka mali kpiɔŋ pam.
en: Reuben, my first-born, you are my strength And the first child of my manhood, The proudest and strongest of all my sons.

dag: Ka bɛ daa daŋ ti tooni chaŋ Troas nti gul ti.
en: These men went first, ahead of Paul. They waited for us in the city of Troas.

dag: N yi ti niŋ buɣim dabi Ijipti, ka bɛnkam sɔŋdi ba maa lu, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will set fire to your land, and anyone who defended your nation will die. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, kɔba ŋɔ ŋmanila Izraɛlnim zaa. Bɛ yɛra, Ti kɔba kuuya zaa, ka ti lan ka tahima; ti yɛla naaya zaa.
en: God said to me, Mortal man, the people of Israel are like these bones. They say that they are dried up, without any hope and with no future.

dag: Ka pirigibu buyi zuɣu bɛn bi kanna tuma ni Vuhim Dabisili dali la mi ni guli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Your two divisions who go off duty on the Sabbath day will stand guard at the Lord s Temple and protect King Joash.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛli Firawuna, A zahima maa nyɛla zaɣ yini, Naawuni n-kahig o ni yɛn niŋ shɛli wuhi nyin Firawuna maa.
en: Joseph said to Pharaoh, Pharaoh has actually had one dream. God has announced to Pharaoh what he is about to do.

dag: Di saha ka kpamba maa ni yino yɛli ma, Di kumda! Nyama, Naa Dauda zuliya ni bɛ ni booni so Juda zuliya ni Gbuɣinli la di nasara. Dinzuɣu o ni tooi tabigi bintabinda ayopɔin maa ka bɔɣi litaafi maa.
en: Then one of the elders said to me, Dont weep. Look! The Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has emerged victorious so that he can open the scroll and its seven seals.

dag: dama yɛlimaŋli maa be ti ni, ka kul ni kpalim be ti ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: We love you because of the truth—the truth that lives in us. That truth will be with us forever.

dag: Di nyaaŋa di bahigu saha ni ti paai ka o bahi nam balibu kam mini bɛn su fukumsi ni yiko balibu kam yoli, ka zaŋ o nam ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o Ba la.
en: and then the end, when Christ hands over the kingdom to God the Father, when he brings every form of rule, every authority and power to an end.

dag: Yawɛ kɔŋko n-daa wuh o soli, ka tinzun buɣili daa ka o sani.
en: The LORD alone led Israel; no foreign god assisted.

dag: Dinzuɣu Vuhim Dabisili na kul ʒiɛmi guli Naawuni niriba ni bɛ vuhi;.
en: This shows that the seventh-day rest for Gods people is still to come.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ tan sabilifaa n-she alichɛbba shɛli zuɣu o ni yɛn yɛri binyɛribila la para.
en: The robe that goes under the ephod is to be made entirely of blue wool.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N loya ni n chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu, ka n kpihim Judanim zaa birili.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have decided to wipe you out with disasters.

dag: Dunɔguliba zuɣulaannim anahi bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim la n-daa nyɛ bɛn su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni du shɛŋa mini neen shɛŋa din mali bukaata fukumsi.
en: The four chief guards were Levites and had the final responsibility. They were also responsible for the rooms in the Temple and for the supplies kept there.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa yi kpaŋ ti yɛli ba, Nyamiya, ti chanila Jɛrusalɛm; ka anabinim ni daa sab shɛlikam zaŋ chaŋ Daadam Bia polo la ni ti niŋ pali.
en: Jesus took the Twelve aside and said, Look, were going up to Jerusalem, and everything written about the Human Oneby the prophets will be accomplished.

dag: ka yɛli nachimba maa, Chamiya n tooni ka n doli yi nyaaŋa na. Amaa o daa bi saɣi yɛl o yidan Nabal.
en: and told her servants, Go on ahead of me. Ill be right behind you. But she didnt tell her husband Nabal.

dag: Juda naa Ahaz ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔtam bia, ka nyɛ Uzia yaaŋa la ʒiɛman ni ka Aram naa Rɛzin mini Izraɛl naa Pɛka ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛmalia bia la daa chaŋ ti liri Jɛrusalɛmnima, amaa ka daa bi tooi nyaŋ ba.
en: Ahaz, the son of Jotham and the grandson of Uzziah, was king of Judah when King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah son of Remaliah of Israel went to attack Jerusalem. But they were not able to do what they had planned.

dag: Yawɛ ʒin o nam ʒiishee kokpɛɣu zuɣu. Yawɛ n-ʒi o nam ʒiishee n-nyɛ naa ŋun kul beni sahakam.
en: The LORD sits enthroned over the floodwaters; the LORD sits enthroned—king forever!.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛl lala maa, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba bɛn ʒe nimaani ni yino lab o tapaɣa ka bɔh o, Lala ka a garigi maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa.
en: When Jesus said this, one of the guards standing there hit him. The guard said, You should not talk to the high priest like that.

dag: Ka bɛ daa piɛbi kikahi; ka niriba maa tahira. Niriba maa ni daa kul wum kikahi maa kumsi; bɛ daa duhila bɛ yee tahiri pampam, ka tiŋ maa goondaa maa dii kabi ti lu tiŋa; ka niriba maa dii zɔri tuhi bɛ tooni dɛde n-kab kpe tiŋ maa ni ti ŋme n-deei li.
en: Then the people shouted. They blew the trumpets. As soon as the people heard the trumpet blast, they shouted a loud war cry. Then the wall collapsed. The people went up against the city, attacking straight ahead. They captured the city.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim Naawuni ŋɔ, n kul bela a tooni kumdi niŋd a yuŋ mini wuntaŋ ni zaa.
en: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Tiŋ kani ka a lee yina? Ŋuni n-lee su a? Ka o garigi yɛli, N nyɛla Ijipti nachimbila, ka nyɛ ŋun tumdi Amalɛk do so tuma. N daa kala alaafee, ka ŋun su ma maa chɛ ma bahi ka chaŋ, di zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ.
en: David asked him, Who is your master, and where are you from? I am an Egyptian, the slave of an Amalekite, he answered. My master left me behind three days ago because I got sick.

dag: Azaria n-daa nyɛ Hɛlɛz ba, ka Hɛlɛz mi nyɛ Ɛliasa ba.
en: Azariah was the father of Helez, Helez was the father of Eleasah.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be yɔɣu maa ni yuun pihinahi la, a daa dihi ba, ka binshɛli daa bi pooi ba; bɛ situra daa bi kpi, ka bɛ naba mi daa bi mɔri.
en: Through forty years in the desert you provided all that they needed; their clothing never wore out, and their feet were not swollen with pain.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti nya Nataniɛl ka o kan o sanna, o daa yɛlimi, Nyama, n-nyɛ Izraɛl nir alali ŋun ka yɛmbimbiɛri biɛhigu o ni hal baabiɛla.
en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him and said about him, Here is a genuine Israelite in whom there is no deceit.

dag: O suhu kul yɛla yi zaa nyabu zuɣu, ka o suhu bi doya, dama yi daa wum ni o biɛra.
en: He is anxious to see you all and is very upset because you had heard that he was sick.

dag: N ŋmanila Sharɔn tutuɣu din pum viɛli pam, ka ŋmani vinvamli ni Paɣiviɛligakushihikom.
en: I am a rose on the plain of Sharon, a lily in the valleys.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma doli nuzaa polo dunɔdali yi n-gili samban ni n-chaŋ samban ni dunɔdali din kpa wulimpuhili polo la gbini, ka kom maa zɔri yiri nudirigu polo na.
en: We walked out of the temple area through the north gate and went around to the east gate. I saw the small stream of water flowing east from the south side of the gate.

dag: Niriba pam ni ti bɔhi ma zaadali, Ti Duuma, ti Duuma, ti daa bi malila a yuli yihiri waazu, ka mal a yuli kariti alizin biɛri, ka mal a yuli tumd alahiziba tuma.
en: On that last Day many will call me Lord. They will say, Lord, Lord, by the power of your name we spoke for God. And by your name we forced out demons and did many miracles.

dag: Diri ka nyuri nyɛla din tahiri lari na; ka wain nyɛ din tiri nir suhupiɛlli; amaa liɣiri n-chɛ ka nir nyar o suhuyubu.
en: Eating and drinking make you feel happy, and money can buy everything you need.

dag: Ka paɣiri ti Ba Naawuni ŋun mali ya ka yi simdi ni yi nya tarili ŋun Naawuni ni zaŋ shɛli zal o ninvuɣ gahinda o neesim nam ni la.
en: and give thanks to the Father. He has made you able to have what he has promised to give all his holy people, who live in the light.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee buɣisi di tariga, bee n-teei mii sɔŋ buɣisi li? Biɛhiŋ kani, a mi di zaa!.
en: Who decided how large it would be? Who stretched the measuring line over it? Do you know all the answers?.

dag: Dindali zaŋ chana Izraɛlnim ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: The Israelites will know from then on that I am the Lord their God.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgbɔŋ ni, fɔntins anahi m-pahi di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti ba. Dina n-nyɛ: Gibiɔn mini Gɛba.
en: From the tribe of Benjamin: Gibeon and its pastures, Geba and its pastures.

dag: Jɛfita ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir la daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biiŋa, amaa ka lee nyɛ pagɔrili bia. Jɛfita ba n-daa nyɛ Giliad.
en: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty warrior. Gilead was his father, but he was a prostitutes son.

dag: Ka bɛ daa woligi n-kpuɣi yɛŋkiŋkabina soli. Bɛ daa bola bindira niŋ bɔto kura din chahi ka bɛ liɣiliɣi li ni n-zaŋ pa bunsi zuɣu; ka zaŋ wain kol kura din chahi ka bɛ liɣiliɣi li pahi;.
en: So they decided that some of their men should pretend to be messengers to Israel from a faraway country. The men put worn-out bags on their donkeys and found some old wineskins that had cracked and had been sewn back together.

dag: N di suɣilo guhi Yawɛ, ka o gbilis o tibili wum n kuhigu.
en: I put all my hope in the LORD. He leaned down to me; he listened to my cry for help.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n suhu yuya ni n lola alikauli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili maa miligi ti zuɣu.
en: So now I, Hezekiah, have decided to make an agreement with the Lord , the God of Israel. Then he will not be angry with us anymore.

dag: Ka sapashin maa yɛl o, N Duuma, m pɔri ni a ka n yiŋ na; amaa kul yɛlim yɛtɔɣ shɛli a ni yɛn yɛli, ka n yiŋbia maa kpaŋ.
en: But the officer said, Lord, I'm not good enough for you to come into my house. Just give the order, and my servant will get well.

dag: Ka yi mi yi suhi li, yi bi nyari li, dama yi tɛha bi tuhi lala niŋbu ni; yi suhirila binshɛŋa yi ni yɛn zaŋ tum yimaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre nyaɣisim tuma.
en: You ask and dont have because you ask with evil intentions, to waste it on your own cravings.
