dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ sapashin kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi zaa la yi nti yɛli ba, Gbaamiy o tim tɔbbihi maa sunsuuni chaŋ, ka so yi dol o na, yin zaŋmiya takɔbi ku dilana. Dama maligumaana maa daa yɛliya, Di kuny o Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ puuni.
en: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, Don't kill her near the Lord 's temple. Take her out in front of the troops, and be sure to kill all of her followers.

dag: Uzia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayɔbu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihinunaayi. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛkolia. O ya n-daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Uzziah was years old when he became king. He ruled years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Jecoliah. Jecoliah was from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa chaŋ ti niŋ Ɛsta ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: So Mordecai went away and did everything Esther told him to do.

dag: Ka ŋun yɛli ni o be Naawuni ni, di niŋ kamaata ni o be kaman Masia ni daa be shɛm la.
en: If we say we live in God, we must live the way Jesus lived.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mbusim be piɛgul shɛb bɛn ku m piɛri, ka wurim ba kpɛhi yɔɣu ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: It will be very bad for the shepherds of the people of Judah. They are destroying the sheep. They are making the sheep run from my pasture in all directions. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpe ŋariŋ maa ni, ka pɔhim maa dii chɛ ʒɛbu.
en: They both got into the boat, and the wind died down.

dag: Yawɛ, n kuhirimi niŋd a yɛra, Nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani. A kɔŋko n-nyɛ n ni bɔri so dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: I pray to you, Lord ! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.

dag: Ka man Yawɛ kul ni wuhiri ya soli sahakam, ka tiri ya binshɛŋa din simdi ya wuntaŋ tulim pam tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka tin ya yaa; ka chɛ ka yi be kaman pu shɛli din puuni mali kom; ka lan chɛ ka yi be kaman kɔbil nini din kom bi ŋmaara.
en: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.

dag: Di saha ka o paɣ daa bɔh o, A na kul gbibila a galimi kalinsi maa kirikiri? Tum Naawuni ka kpi.
en: His wife said to him, You are still as faithful as ever, aren't you? Why don't you curse God and die.

dag: Ŋun Masia maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ ŋun daa ʒi ti daalahichi o niŋgbuŋ ni dapulli zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti kpi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo, ka lee mali nyɛvili zaŋ chaŋ wuntia polo. O fiɛbbu bɔba ni dansi la zuɣu ka yi nyari dɔriti tibi kpaŋ.
en: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.

dag: Ŋuna m-pii ti tarili ni nyɛ shɛli ti ti, din nyɛ Yaakubu so o ni yuri la ni nyuri bara shɛli zuɣu la.
en: He chooses our inheritance for us: the heights of Jacob, which he loves. Selah.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛl o, Kpalimmi kpe zuŋɔ yaha, ka n sa bah a ka a lab biɛɣuni. Ka Yuria daa kpalim Jɛrusalɛm dindali maa neei biɛɣu.
en: David said to Uriah, Stay here today. Tomorrow I will send you back to the battle. Uriah stayed in Jerusalem until the next morning.

dag: Kul di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia chɛ ka yi zaŋ yimaŋ dalim Yawɛ ka yɛra, Yawɛ shiri ni fa ti bahi, ka Asiria naa ku tooi ŋme n-fa tiŋ ŋɔ.
en: Dont let Hezekiah persuade you to trust the LORD by saying, The LORD will certainly rescue us. This city wont be handed over to Assyrias king.

dag: Amaa di nyɛla Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ piɛbil so ŋun ka galimi bee liɣisibu la ʒim din mali shaara la ka o daa zaŋ pa talima tiligi ya.
en: You were bought with the precious blood of Christs death. He was a pure and perfect sacrificial Lamb.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Asiria naa polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ ni bee n-to piɛm di ni bee n-zaŋ nyɔtaɣira ka di ni na bee n-kana ti kɔri taŋkpaɣu duhiduhi gil li.
en: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.

dag: Pa ninsal ka n fabindi niŋdi maa, ka bɔzuɣu ka n yɛn niŋ suɣilo?.
en: Are my complaints against another human; why is my patience short?.

dag: A ni ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, ka lihir a ninni la suhudo maŋli, bɛ ni niŋ a naani zuɣu.
en: Those with sound thoughts you will keep in peace, in peace because they trust in you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa ti duhi do so ŋun yuli booni Haman n-zaŋ o leei zuɣulaampaa. Haman daa nyɛla Hamɛdata bia, ka lan nyɛ ŋun yi Agag zuliya ni na.
en: Later, King Xerxes promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha to the highest position in his kingdom. Haman was a descendant of Agag.

dag: A daanzinfa saɣimya, ka kom gari a wain ni.
en: Your silver is fake, and your wine is watered down.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, pa nyini n-yɛn me n jɛmbu duu maa, amaa a ni ti yɛn dɔɣi bidib so n-ti yɛn me jɛmbu duu maa ti n yuli jilima.
en: but you will never build it. It is your son, your own son, who will build my temple.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi m-pahi piɛla yino zuɣu;.
en: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram.

dag: Ti Duuma, wuna puuni, wun so kani m-be ka nyini, ka tuun shɛli mi kani ŋ-ŋman a tuma.
en: My Lord! There is no one like you among the gods! There is nothing that can compare to your works!.

dag: N Naawuni, teemi n ni niŋ niriba ŋɔ shɛlikam zaa ŋɔ yɛla, ka niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli.
en: I pray that God will bless me for everything I have done for my people.

dag: Naa ti ku lan beni n-su bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka nabihi zaa ti ku lan beni.
en: There will be no king to rule the country, and the leaders will all be gone.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla bɛ ni mali maligumaaniba shɛba ka bɛ be kasi, ka nyɛ Zadok zuliya bɛn doli n zaligu la dini. Bɛna n-daa bi birigi kaman Lɛvinim ni daa niŋ shɛm saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa birigi la.
en: This holy area is for the Zadokite priests who kept my charge and didnt stray as the Levites did when the house of Israel strayed away from me.

dag: Chɛ ka dilan maa biɛhigu ti be kaman Yawɛ ni daa wurim fɔntin shɛŋa ka bi zo li nambɔɣu la. Chɛ ka o kul wumdi kuhigu asiba, ka wumdi tɔbuchiriga wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha.
en: Let that man be like the cities the Lord destroyed. He had no pity on them. Let him hear shouts of war in the morning; let him hear battle cries at noontime.

dag: Firawuna daa lan yɛli Yisifu, Nyama, n zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa fukumsi niŋ a nuu ni.
en: I now appoint you governor over all Egypt.

dag: Ka Sool bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala, n Duuma? Ka kukoli maa yɛli, Man Yisa ŋun nyɛ a ni niŋdi so alaka maa m-bala.
en: Saul asked, Who are you, Lord? I am Jesus, whom you are harassing, came the reply.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa zaŋla naɣilahi tuhi pisinaayi mini piɛri tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pisi mali sara. Naa min o niriba maa zaa ni daa zaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ti Naawuni shɛm m-bala.
en: King Solomon sacrificed twenty-two thousand oxen and one hundred twenty thousand sheep when the king and all the people dedicated Gods temple.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa, dɔɣim bihi ka yi nabi; ka zuliya pam yi a ni na; ka nanim pam gba ti yi a zuliya ni na.
en: God said to him, I am God All-Powerful, and I give you this blessing: Have many children and grow into a great nation. Other nations and other kings will come out of you.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, ŋun niŋdi alibarika niŋdi niriba ni gari o ni niŋ li niŋ ninvuɣ so ni.
en: There is no doubt that the one who blesses is greater than the one who is blessed.

dag: Amaa ka Ijipti naa maa daa yɛli ba, Musa mini Aduna, bɔzuɣu ka yi chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa bi tumdi bɛ tuma? Chamiya ti tum yi tuma.
en: The king said, Moses and Aaron, why are you keeping these people from working? Look how many you are keeping from doing their work. Now everyone get back to work.

dag: Ka din pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu nyɛla, bɔɣilɔ titali n-do ti mini ya sunsuuni, ka so ku tooi yi ti sani m-baai yaɣ li ka yi sanna; ka so mi ku tooi yi yi sani ka ti sanna.
en: Moreover, a great crevasse has been fixed between us and you. Those who wish to cross over from here to you cannot. Neither can anyone cross from there to us.

dag: ni pateesa shɛŋa din yɛn yiini ni mini di daantalisi ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni pateesa shɛli din yɛn yiini dundɔŋ maa dunoli.
en: the curtains for the enclosure, its posts and bases; the curtain for the entrance of the enclosure;.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi mini kom ni ʒim, ka shɛhira diba ata ŋɔ zaa mi yɛla saɣisila taba.
en: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and the three are united in agreement.

dag: Ka anab maa yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, A ni zaŋ n ni yɛl a ni a ku do so la bahila zuɣu, a ni zaŋ a nyɛvili yo o nyɛvili samli; ka zaŋ a tɔbbihi gba nyɛviya yo o tɔbbihi nyɛviya samli. .
en: Then the prophet said to the king, The Lord says to you, You set free the man I said should die. So you will take his place—you and your people will die.

dag: Momaha be mɔɣu ni pam, ka suhupiɛlli pali daboya zuɣu.
en: The pastures are filled with flocks; the hillsides are full of joy.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ ti liri Juda tiŋgbɔŋ n-saɣim li, ka fa li leei timaŋmaŋ tiŋa, ka zaŋ Tabiil bia la leei di naa. .
en: to invade and defeat Judah and Jerusalem and to let the son of Tabeel be king in his place.

dag: Dama n daa fa nandaamba bɛn kuhiri bahi, ka fa kpibisi bɛn ka ŋun ni sɔŋ ba bahi.
en: When the poor cried out, I helped them; I gave help to orphans who had nowhere to turn.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu yi be a nuu ni, nyin yihimi li kpaŋa, ka miri ka a chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu be a yiŋa.
en: Put away evil and wrong from your home.

dag: Ka yiŋbi so ŋun mi o duuma yubu ni nyɛ shɛli ka bi mali shili bee n-tum kaman o duuma maa yubu ni nyɛ shɛm ni nya buri pam.
en: The servant who knows what his master wants him to do, but does not get himself ready and do it, will be punished with a heavy whipping.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni ti ŋmanila tipum zuɣupiligu din mali jilima o niriba bɛn tiligi sani.
en: When this time comes, the Lord All-Powerful will be a glorious crown for his people who survive.

dag: Bɛ daa mali karimbaani, ka tum din chihiri n sani ka n nya li, dinzuɣu ka n daa ku ba.
en: Sodom and her daughters became too proud and began to do terrible things in front of me. So I punished them!.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa boli Musa mini Aduna labisi Firawuna sanna, ka o ti yɛli ba, Chamiya ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa; amaa ka banima n-lee yɛn chaŋ maa.
en: The king had Moses and Aaron brought back, and he said, All right, you may go and worship the Lord your God. But first tell me who will be going.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka lo a dabili alikauli ni a ni niŋ o zaɣ viɛlli ŋɔ.
en: LORD, you are truly God, and you promised this good thing to your servant.

dag: N nyar alibarika a zaligunim maa dolibu zuɣu.
en: This happened because I carefully obey your instructions.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni tiligi Ziɔn, ka lan me Juda tinsi zali, ka o daba ti be nimaani su li.
en: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ Izraɛlnim maa Teeku Ʒiɛɣu duli n-chaŋ ti kpe Shur tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka bɛ daa chaŋ dabisi muna ata chandi ka bi nya kom.
en: Then Moses led the people of Israel away from the Red Sea into the desert of Shur. For three days they walked through the desert, but found no water.

dag: Di saha ka Balak daa yɛli Balaam, A yi ku yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu hal baabiɛla, nyin di niŋ alibarika gba niŋ bɛ ni hal baabiɛla.
en: Then Balak said to Balaam, Dont curse them or bless them.

dag: Ka yi yi ti paai tin shɛli ka bɛ bi deei ya, yi yi ti yɛn yi di tiŋ maa ni, yin pihimiya yi napɔna taŋkpaɣu bahi tiŋ maa nim zuɣu, ka di niŋ shɛhira biɛɣu jɛndi ba.
en: Wherever they dont welcome you, as you leave that city, shake the dust off your feet as a witness against them.

dag: Ka Naa Jɛhɔram daa dii yiɣisi Samaria di saha maa n-chaŋ ti laɣim Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa.
en: So King Joram set out from Samaria at once. He prepared all Israel for war.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋ bindir shɛli nyo buɣim mali sara din nyom viɛl ti Yawɛ. Biŋkpam zaa nyɛla Yawɛ dini.
en: Then the priest will bring that food as a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord. The fat belongs to the Lord .

dag: Naawuni, darigim bɛ tibili. Chɛ ka bɛmaŋmaŋ nia biɛri ŋmaligi di ba. Karim ba a sani, bɛ daalahichi din galisi pam la zuɣu; dama bɛ bi zan tuh a.
en: Punish them, God! Let them be caught in their own traps. They have turned against you, so punish them for their many crimes.

dag: Chɛ ka zoya zuɣu niŋ bindira ka di niŋ niriba anfaani pam, ka chɛ ka wuntitali mi yi zahira daboya zuɣu.
en: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.

dag: ka booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni kaman a ni niŋ bɛ ba shɛm maa, ka bɛ leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi n tuma, ka kpam booi bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni maa ni ti ba soli ka bɛ kul nyɛ maligumaaniba sahakam bɛ ʒiɛman ni.
en: Anoint the sons in the same way you anointed their father. Then they can also serve me as priests. When you anoint them, they will become priests. That family will continue to be priests for all time to come.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi ti suh a, nyin gbilisim tibili wum, ka sɔŋ ma yomyom.
en: Lord , I call to you for help. Listen to me as I pray. Please hurry and help me!.

dag: Wuntaŋ puhibu na saha ka Yaakubu daa yi Pɛnuɛl chana ka luri wɔbiliwɔbili, o sakpuɣu maa zuɣu.
en: The sun rose as Jacob passed Penuel, limping because of his thigh.

dag: ni Mɛjarikɔn ni Rakɔn ka bɛ tintariga bɔbili chaŋ ti gili Jɔpa.
en: Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, along with the territory opposite Joppa.

dag: di saha yin miriya ka yi ti tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni na la yɛla.
en: be sure that you do not become proud and forget the Lord your God who rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii kpamba cheechi kam puuni ti ba, ka daa lo noli n-suhi ti Duuma ka zaŋ ba niŋ Naawuni so bɛ ni niŋ yɛda maa nuu ni.
en: They also chose elders for each church and stopped eating for a period of time to pray for them. These elders were men who had put their trust in the Lord Jesus, so Paul and Barnabas put them in his care.

dag: Ka Aruna daa yɛli Dauda, N dana, zaŋmi li tum a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani. Naɣikɔra m-bɔŋɔ, a ni tooi kɔri ba nyo buɣim mali sara, bɛ nyiŋgoya ni dapuhi mini kaburi dari din ni mali buɣim mi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Araunah said to David, My lord and king, you can take anything you want for a sacrifice. Here are some oxen for the burnt offering, and the threshing boards and the yokes for the wood.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa zaa m-pahi ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri.
en: Israel's soldiers gathered together everything they had taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku lan chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ.
en: But the Lord caused Pharaoh to be stubborn again, and Pharaoh did not let the Israelites go.

dag: Yisa ni daa pun mi binshɛɣukam zaa din yɛn niŋ o maa zuɣu ka o daa chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli bɔhi ba, Ŋuni ka yi bɔra.
en: Jesus knew everything that was going to happen to him, so he stepped forward and asked them, Who is it you are looking for.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ la shɛŋa din kpalim be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini Juda nayili ni Jɛrusalɛm la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Yes, this is what the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims about the equipment that is left in the LORDs temple and in the royal palace in Judah, and in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ yi yab Ibrahimma Mɔɣili duli maa polo na nti chɛ ka o chaŋ gili Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa. Ka n daa ti o bihi pam. N daa chɛ ka o dɔɣi Yisahaku;.
en: I took Abraham your ancestor from the other side of the Euphrates. I led him around through the whole land of Canaan. I added to his descendants and gave him Isaac.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord gave Moses.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi Duuma ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n zaŋla duu tanzaa kuɣili sɔŋ Ziɔn. Di nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din viɛli ka mali kpiɔŋ; ka ni chɛ ka duu tanzaa mali yaa. Ka ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku zo dabiɛm.
en: And so the Lord says, I'm laying a firm foundation for the city of Zion. It's a valuable cornerstone proven to be trustworthy; no one who trusts it will ever be disappointed.

dag: Ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa lab kul o ya Jɛrusalɛm ni alaafee.
en: Upon the safe arrival of Judahs King Jehoshaphat to his palace in Jerusalem.

dag: Alichɛbba maa nyiŋgoli daa ŋmanila kurugu gbaɣino nyiŋgoli, ka bɛ niŋ tani kɔɣili di nyiŋgoli maa zaa gili din ni chɛ ka di ku cheei.
en: with an opening in the center for the head. The material around the collar was bound so as to keep it from wearing out.

dag: Dinzuɣu sokam bɔɣiri ni cheei kom, ka bɛ ku lan mali suhukpeeni.
en: People will lose their courage. Fear will make them weak.

dag: Di saha ka Neetan daa bɔhi Sulemaana ma Batishiiba, A bi wum ni Hagit bia Adɔnija leei naa, ka ti dan Dauda ʒi di yɛla?.
en: When Nathan heard about this, he went to Solomons mother Bathsheba and asked her, Have you heard what Haggiths son, Adonijah, is doing? He is making himself king. And our master, King David, knows nothing about it.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ m biɛhigu shee maa zali kaman n ni daa pun wuh a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.
en: Build the Holy Tent the way I showed you on the mountain.

dag: N niriba Izraɛlnima, yinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ ni niŋ shɛb kaman bɛ ni bu ka shɛli n-yɛl li ŋɔ, n ni wum shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ sani ka n zaŋ yɛri ya maa.
en: Then I said, My people, you have suffered terribly, but I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti lan yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ ti dɔni Arinɔn Mɔɣili yaɣili yɔ shɛli din zaŋ hal ni Amɔrinim tintariga la ni; dama Arinɔn Mɔɣili n-nyɛ Mɔabnim tintariga m-be Mɔabnim mini Amɔrinim sunsuuni.
en: From there they marched and camped across the Arnon in the desert that extends from the border of the Amorites, for the Arnon was the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm wun so yaha; miriya ka yi gbani n-jɛm tinzunnim wuni.
en: Dont worship any of the false gods that the foreigners worship.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe o ka o yɛli, Kpe nyɛla dabiɛm zɔbu shee! Kpe nyɛla Naawuni yiŋa. Alizanda dunoli m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then Jacob became frightened and said, What a frightening place! It must be the house of God and the gateway to heaven.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Yɛhudianim zuɣulaannim mini bɛ kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni maligumaaniba zuɣulan Annas mini Kaiafas nti pahi Jɔn mini Alikizanda ni bɛnkam daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan dɔɣiriba zaa daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The next day the Jewish rulers, the older Jewish leaders, and the teachers of the law met in Jerusalem.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni yi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri ŋɔ tatabo saria, o sariakaribo maa nyɛla din tuhi.
en: God judges all who do such things, and we know his judgment is right.

dag: Bɛ ni daa labiri kuna ka Yisa doli ba. O ni daa ti miri sapashini maa yiŋa ka sapashini maa lan tim o zɔnim Yisa sanna ni bɛ ti yɛl o ni o di nahim omaŋa, dama ni ŋun sapashini maa pɔri ni Yisa ka o yiŋ na.
en: So Jesus went with them. He was not far from the house when the officer sent friends to tell him, Sir, don't trouble yourself. I do not deserve to have you come into my house.

dag: M mabihi, ti Duuma Yisa Masia n-nyɛ Duuma ŋun nyɛ Jilimalana. Ka yi ni doli yɛda niŋbu adiini so shɛli o ni zal la zuɣu, di yaaya so yuri ka chɛ so.
en: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.

dag: Cham biŋkɔbiri la sani ti gbahi bubihi pol ayi ti ma na ka n zaŋ ba duɣi bindir nyaɣisili shɛli a ba ni yuri pam;.
en: Go to the flock and get me two healthy young goats so I can prepare them as the delicious food your father loves.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di bindirigu ka nyu n-naai Shilo maa nyaaŋa, ka Hanna suhu daa saɣim pam ka o yiɣisi chaŋ Yawɛ tooni ti suh o, ka kum pam. Di saha Ɛli ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la daa ʒila kuɣ zuɣu Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni tab dunoli.
en: After eating and drinking, Hannah quietly got up and went to pray to the Lord. Eli the priest was sitting on a chair near the door of the Lord s Holy Building.

dag: Di saha ka Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm daa chaŋ tiŋ maa dunol ni nti yɛli tiŋ maa ni dɔbba.
en: Hamor and Shechem went to the meeting place of their city. They spoke to the men of the city and said.

dag: Lala ka di simdi ni yidaannim gba yuri bɛ paɣiba kaman bɛ ni yuri bɛmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ shɛm la. Ŋun yur o paɣa yurila omaŋa.
en: And husbands should love their wives like that. They should love their wives as they love their own bodies. The man who loves his wife loves himself.

dag: Bee bɔndali ka ti daa nya o ka a biɛra bee nti be sarika ni, ka ti ka a sanna ti kaag a.
en: When did we see you sick or in prison and visit you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun bi guni, amaa ka doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm, Naawuni ku lih o kaman ŋun guni?.
en: In fact, if they obey the Law, they are as good as anyone who is circumcised.

dag: Hiburɔn yuli piligu ni ha daa nyɛla Kiriatariba; Ariba ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Anakinim ni wɔɣirili. Ka tɔbu daa chɛ tuhibu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Hebron used to be called Arba's Town, because Arba had been one of the greatest of the Anakim. There was peace in the land.

dag: N yi pala tumo zaŋ chaŋ shɛb sani, amaa biɛhiŋ kani, n nyɛla tumo yinim sani, dama yinima n-nyɛ n tumɔtali shihirili ti Duuma sani.
en: Others may not accept me as an apostle, but surely you do. You are proof that I am an apostle in the Lord.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhiya ni bi so ŋun nyɛ falidira yi na nyɛ bia, hal o ni kul su binshɛɣukam maa zaa yoli, o bi gari dabili.
en: Im saying that as long as the heirs are minors, they are no different from slaves, though they really are the owners of everything.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Susa maa daa lan laɣim tab bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaanahi dali n-lan ku ninvuɣ kɔbisita tiŋ maa puuni pahi. Amaa bɛ daa bi di bɛ nɛma.
en: Then on the fourteenth day of Adar the Jews of the city got together and killed more people. But they still did not take anything that belonged to their enemies.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni ti yaannim zaa daa bela sagbani tiŋli, ka bɛ zaa daa lan doli soli kpe teeku ni gari.
en: I want you to remember, my friends, what happened to our ancestors who followed Moses. They were all under the protection of the cloud, and all passed safely through the Red Sea.

dag: Bɛ ti ku lan bol a, Chɛ m-bahi, bee m-bol a tiŋgbani, Zaɣ nɛli. Amaa bɛ ni ti bol a la, Naawuni nini ni tiɣi so, ka boli a tiŋgbani, Dooyililana. Dama Yawɛ nini tiɣ a, ka a tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti mali yidana.
en: You will never again be called The People God Left. Your land will never again be called The Land God Destroyed. You will be called The People God Loves. Your land will be called Gods Bride, because the Lord loves you, and your land will be his.

dag: Naawuni, a shiri zaɣisi ti mi? Naawuni, a bi lan doli ti tɔbbihi chani tɔb ni.
en: But you have rejected us, God, havent you? God, you no longer accompany our armies.

dag: Ka Farisiinim maa bɔhi ba, O birigila yi gba?.
en: The Pharisees said to them, Have you also been fooled?.

dag: ni Magidiɛl ni Iram. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Ɛdom nanima; di gbinni nyɛla Iso ŋun nyɛ Ɛdomnim yab la kaman bɛ biɛhigu shee ni daa nyɛ luɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa su tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni.
en: Magdiel, and Iram. These clans descended from Esau, who was known as Edom, the father of the Edomites. They took their names from the places where they settled.

dag: Ka Dauda daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa zali o ni daa mali luɣ shɛli zal li maa.
en: Next, David invited everyone to come to Jerusalem and watch the sacred chest being carried to the place he had set up for it.

dag: Man Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisiya pam bahi yi yaannim zuɣu.
en: The LORD was terribly angry with your ancestors.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul niŋdi lala hal ka wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha ti gari, ka bɛ kul mali lala hal ti paai zaawuni sara malibu saha, ka bi wum so kukoli, ka so mi bi garigi ba.
en: and they kept it up until time for the evening sacrifice. But there was no answer of any kind.

dag: Amaa di daa bi yuui ka bɛ tam a tuma maa yɛla, ka daa bi guhi n-deeg a wuhibu.
en: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.

dag: ni Dɔri naa ni Goiim naa.
en: the king of Dor at Mount Dor, the king of Goyim in Gilgal.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Sɔdomnim azaaba nyabu ni ti so tiŋ maa nim dini.
en: I tell you that on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than the people of that town!.

dag: O ni daa ti paai Siizaria o daa chaŋla Jɛrusalɛm nti puhi Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn be nimaani ka naanyi gari chaŋ Antiɔk.
en: He arrived in Caesarea, went up to Jerusalem and greeted the church, and then went down to Antioch.

dag: Napombihi maa shɛli polo ni nyɛ kuriti, ka di shɛli polo mi nyɛ yaɣiri la, lala ka di nam maa yaɣ shɛli polo ni ti mali kpiɔŋ, ka di yaɣ shɛli polo mi gbarigi.
en: The toes—partly iron and partly clay—mean that part of the empire will be strong and part of it weak.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o suhu ni, Pumpɔŋɔ Sool ni ti bahi ku ma dahin shɛli. N lan ka n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm pahila n zo n-kuli Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni din ni chɛ ka Sool yihi n shee bɔbu tahima Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka n yi o nuu ni.
en: David said to himself, One of these days Saul will kill me. The best thing for me to do is to escape to Philistia. Then Saul will give up looking for me in Israel, and I will be safe.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi Sukɔt n-chaŋ ti dɔni Itam tiŋgban nɛl naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ.
en: The Israelites left Succoth and camped at Etham. Etham was near the desert.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli maligumaaniba, Kpuɣimiya Alikauli Adaka maa m-be niriba maa tooni chana. Ka bɛ daa kpuɣi Alikauli Adaka maa m-be niriba maa tooni chana.
en: Then Joshua said to the priests, Take the Box of the Agreement and go across the river in front of the people. So the priests lifted the Box and carried it in front of the people.

dag: Ka a yi ti lan chɛ ka bɛ piɛbi kika biɛɣu pahi buyi, bɛn suɣa be nudirigu polo la bɛn yiɣisim gbaai chandi. Bɛ yi ti yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ saha shɛlikam, bɛn piɛbimi kika biɛɣu maa.
en: The second time you blow a short blast on the trumpets, the tribes camping on the south side of the Meeting Tent will begin to move.

dag: ni Rakalnima ni Jɛramiilnim tinsi ni Kɛnnim tinsi.
en: Racal, the cities of the Jerahmeelites and the cities of the Kenites.

dag: di saha ka naa daa yɛli anab Neetan, Nyama, m bela sida dari yil ni, amaa ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ dim be suɣili ni.
en: King David said to Nathan the prophet, Look, I am living in a fancy house made of cedar wood, but Gods Holy Box is still kept in a tent.

dag: Amaa n ni ti woligi Izraɛlnim bɛn biŋkɔbiri ka chɛ Ijiptinim biŋkɔbiri, ka Izraɛlnim maa bɛn so biŋkɔbigu ti ku kpi. .
en: But the Lord will treat Israels animals differently from the animals of Egypt. None of the animals that belong to the Israelites will die.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ni n tiligira ŋɔ, chɛ ka n nol ni yɛtɔɣa mini n suhu ni tɛha zaa nyɛ din tiɣi a nini.
en: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord , because you are my mighty rock and my protector.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa yɛli, Ŋun ni tooi chaŋ ti liri Kiriatisɛfanima n-tuhi nyaŋ ba ka deei bɛ tiŋ maa, n ni zaŋ m bipuɣiŋga Akisa ti o paɣ pini.
en: Caleb told his troops, The man who captures Kiriath-Sepher can marry my daughter Achsah.

dag: Anabi yi zaŋ Yawɛ yuli tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛli ka di bi niŋ bee ka shɛli bi wuhi ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, di pala Yawɛ ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli: Anabi maa n-kul ŋme nyɔɣu n-tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa maa; yin di chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya.
en: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord . Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa paɣ o ninni ka yina nti maag o ni ka yɛli, Zaŋmiya bindirigu ti ti na.
en: After washing his face and returning, he was able to control himself and said, Serve the meal.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ puuni ka yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ka buchi be; ka di mi ka buchi so sani.
en: Because the more words increase, the more everything is pointless. What do people gain by it?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Rɛkab bia Jɔnadab kul ku kɔŋ bidibiga ŋun ni jɛmdi ma sahakam. .
en: So I, the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, promise that Jonadab son of Rechab will always have a male descendant to serve me.

dag: N ni daa wum bɛ fabila maa mini bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka n suhu daa yiɣisi pam.
en: When I heard their complaints, I grew angry.

dag: Paɣ yi nya sɔrilim ka di na bi naai, nyin di mir o ni a bo o.
en: You must not approach a woman for sexual contact during her menstrual uncleanness.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chana nti nya Matiu, ka o ʒi farigu deebu shee; ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli ma. Ka o yiɣisi dol o.
en: As Jesus continued on from there, he saw a man named Matthew sitting at a kiosk for collecting taxes. He said to him, Follow me, and he got up and followed him.

dag: ni Humta ni Kiriatariba ni Ziɔr: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara awɛi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Humtah, Kiriath-arba , and Zior. In total: nine cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: Ninsal noli ni yɛtɔɣa puuni ka o nyari bin viɛla, ka o nuhi tuma mi mali di nyɔri.
en: From the fruit of their speech, people are well satisfied; their work results in reward.

dag: Amaa hal o yi bi yihi ti, Naa, nyin baŋmi ni ti ku jɛm a wuna ŋɔ min a ni mali salima binnan shɛli zali maa.
en: But if he doesnt, know this for certain, Your Majesty: we will never serve your gods or worship the gold statue youve set up.

dag: O yi bi niŋ bini ata ŋɔ ti o, dindina paɣ maa ŋun yim chaŋ yoli, ka di yo shɛli.
en: If he does not fulfill these duties to her, he must set her free and not receive any payment.

dag: Lala ka Izraɛlnim daa piripiri tinsi maa ni di momaha tiŋgbana maa tari Lɛvinima.
en: In this way the people of Israel assigned towns for the Levites to live in, together with the pasture lands around the towns. .

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Ninvuɣ kɔbisita shɛb bɛn mali bɛ zilima nyuri kom ŋɔ ka n ni zaŋ fan ya bahi, ka zaŋ Midiannim maa niŋ yi nuu ni. Dinzuɣu chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim maa zaa lab kuli.
en: The Lord said to Gideon, I will use the men who lapped the water like a dog. I will use them to save you, and I will allow you to defeat the Midianites. Let the other men go home.

dag: O daa bi wuhiri ba shɛli ka pa ni yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni, amaa di daa yi ti kpalim o min o nyaandoliba maa ko, o kahigirila binshɛɣukam gbinni wuhiri ba.
en: He would not speak to them without using parables, but when he was alone with his disciples, he would explain everything to them.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di nyɛla m mini yi pinaayi ŋɔ ni yino ŋun laɣim mali bɔrɔbɔro suɣiri ʒiɛri la yin ni ŋɔ.
en: Jesus answered, It will be one of you twelve, one who dips his bread in the dish with me.

dag: ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ni ti nya alibarika la bɛ zuɣu; a ni deei n noli maa zuɣu.
en: You have obeyed me, and so you and your descendants will be a blessing to all nations on earth.

dag: Dinzuɣu Oholiba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka a ni ŋmalig a mamanim shɛb sani chaŋ ni suhuyiɣisili la suhuri yiɣisi bahi a zuɣu, ka n chɛ ka bɛ yi luɣilikam na ti lir a.
en: The Lord God said: Oholibah, though you no longer want to be around your lovers, they will surround you like enemies, when I turn them against you.

dag: Wuntizɔriba mi bɛ biŋkɔbiri ni bɔri shɛli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛna, bɛ nambɔzɔbo nyɛla putɔɣu niŋbu.
en: Good people take care of their animals, but wicked people are cruel to theirs.

dag: Sulemaana daa me omaŋmaŋ yili. Yuun pinaata ka o daa zaŋ me li naai.
en: Now as for Solomons palace, it took thirteen years for him to complete its construction.

dag: Anabi Musa n-daa deei Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ti ti, amaa ka Yisa Masia mi tahi anfaani mini yɛlimaŋli na.
en: God gave the Law through Moses, but grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

dag: N lan yɛri ya mi, yi ni niriba ayi yi naai noli dunia ŋɔ ni bɛ ni suhi Naawuni yɛl shɛli zuɣu, m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka di niŋ.
en: Again I assure you that if two of you agree on earth about anything you ask, then my Father who is in heaven will do it for you.

dag: Di daa lan ŋmaligi kpala nuzaa polo n-chaŋ hal ti paai Ɛnshɛmɛsh n-yi nimaani zaŋ hal ni Gɛlilɔt din be Adumim bimbini tooni la. Ka daa lan zaŋ nimaani hal ni Rubin bia Bɔhan kuɣili la gbini.
en: There it turned north, went to En Shemesh, and then continued on to Geliloth. The border went down to the Great Stone that was named for Bohan, the son of Reuben.

dag: N ni chɛ ka daadamnim nyabu ti niŋ tom kaman salima din viɛla nyabu ni to shɛm la, ka chɛ ka ninsalinim nyabu niŋ tom kaman Ofiri salima nyabu ni to shɛm la.
en: Survivors will be harder to find than the purest gold.

dag: Dunoya, yoomiya yomyom! Duno kurisi ŋɔ, yoomiya! Ka Na so ŋun mali jilima ŋɔ gari kpɛna.
en: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, n gba ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛli noli ti a, n gba ni yɛli noli ti ba. Ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni ti nya alibarika a zuɣu.
en: I will bless those who bless you, but I will put a curse on anyone who puts a curse on you. Everyone on earth will be blessed because of you.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi waɣa ti kpɛri sagbana ni, ka bɛ zuɣuri tɔri sagbana.
en: Maybe an evil mans pride will reach up to the sky, and his head will touch the clouds.

dag: ni m mali suhugarigu pam, ka nandahima din bi naari kul mali ma.
en: my heart is broken and I am in great sorrow.

dag: Dama dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu ka zuliya kam kul jiɣindi biɛɣukam, amaa yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ mi ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha simdi ya.
en: Thats what those people who dont know God are always thinking about. Dont worry, because your Father in heaven knows that you need all these things.

dag: A daa ku ba Ɛndo, ka bɛ niŋgbuna dɔni tiŋgban ni ti pooi.
en: You destroyed the enemy at Endor, and their bodies rotted on the ground.

dag: O daa yaag o noli yɛli ka zɔhi mini nanviri waɣi pali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa.
en: God commanded, and flies and gnats swarmed throughout the whole country.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɛ mabihi m-mali bɛmaŋ be kasi n-kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni nti mal li ka di be kasi kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuhi naa ka o zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm.
en: These men gathered their relatives, made themselves holy, and went in to purify the LORDs temple by obeying the kings command as the LORD had told him.

dag: Nyini n-su teeku din kul damdi pampam ŋɔ yiko; di kɔgbana yi ti yiɣisi, nyini n-chɛri ka di maari dooni baalim.
en: You rule the roaring sea and calm its waves.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Saha yipa paaya ni Daadam Bia nya jilima.
en: Jesus answered them, The hour has now come for the Son of Man to receive great glory.

dag: Yawɛ, sɔŋm ti! Dama wundaba lan kani; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim lan ka daadamnim ni.
en: Save me, Lord ! We can no longer trust anyone! All the good, loyal people are gone.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ din ni tiɣi Yawɛ nini gari nir yi zaŋ naɣila lantabili bee naɣilaa ni yila ni takarifiɛma mali sara.
en: This will please the Lord more than offering him cattle, more than sacrificing a full-grown bull.

dag: Ka Juda daa ti nya Keenan do so ŋun yuli daa booni Shua la bipuɣiŋga n-kpuɣ o; ka daa zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: There Judah saw the daughter of a Canaanite whose name was Shua, and he married her. After he slept with her.

dag: Yi bi niŋ tuuba bee n-lu ma sizuura hal ni zuŋɔ, yi mi bi doli n ni daa zaŋ n zaligu shɛŋa ti yi mini yi yaannim la.
en: To this day you havent shown any sorrow for what you have done. And you havent revered me or followed my Instruction and my laws that I set before you and your ancestors.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa be nimaani daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: The following priests rebuilt the next several sections of the wall: Priests from the area around Jerusalem built the next section;.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti a tɛhi zilima mini baŋsim, ka o yi ti zaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ fukumsi niŋ a nuu ni, a ni doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ zaligunima.
en: He will make you the king of Israel. May the Lord give you wisdom and understanding so that you can lead the people and obey the law of the Lord your God.

dag: Amaa kom yi be bimbira maa ni ka bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛli lu di zuɣu, bimbira maa leei daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: But if the seed is soaking in water and one of them falls on it, the seed is unclean.

dag: Daadam bahirila yoli kaman bin pɔŋ la, ka ŋmani lɛla ni yi ŋubi chahi situra shɛli.
en: So I am becoming weaker and weaker, like a piece of wood rotting away, like a piece of cloth eaten by moths.

dag: Lala ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba la gba daa maan o ansarisi yɛra.
en: The chief priests, the leaders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses also made fun of Jesus. They said.

dag: Nyin Lɛbanɔn nira ŋun me a yili zali sida tihi sunsuuni ŋɔ, biɛrim yi ti paag a, a ni ŋuhi pam kaman paɣa ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi la.
en: You rest secure among the cedars brought from Lebanon; but how pitiful you'll be when pains strike you, pains like those of a woman in labor.

dag: O shɛrila tan piɛla binyɛra kɔhira, ka maani shɛlɔriti kɔhiri kɔhigɔriba zuɣu.
en: She makes clothes and belts, and sells them to merchants.

dag: Yi yi baŋ dimbɔŋɔnima ka dol li, yi ni nya alibarika.
en: Now that you know this truth, how happy you will be if you put it into practice!.

dag: Naawuni, wuhim a yiko ni nyɛ shɛli, wuhim a kpiɔŋ kaman a ni pun niŋdi shɛm ti zuɣu la.
en: God, show us your power! Show us the power you used for us in the past.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, man Nɛbukadnɛza paɣiri alizanda Naa, ka tir o jilima; ka tibigir o. O ni tumdi shɛlikam zaa nyɛla din tuhi mini yɛlimaŋli, ka o ni tooi siɣisi ŋunkam mali karimbaani.
en: Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, give praise, honor, and glory to the King of Heaven. Everything he does is right. He is always fair, and he is able to make proud people humble!.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka n dii tim a sanna maa, ka a mi ni kana maa a niŋ viɛnyɛla. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ ti zaa bela Naawuni tooni ni ti wum ŋun Naawuni ni ti a zilin shɛli ni a ti ti. .
en: And so I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. Now we are all here in the presence of God, waiting to hear anything that the Lord has instructed you to say.

dag: Ka di lan sabi yɛli, Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa.
en: That is why a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife.

dag: O daa mi ni nyuli ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa zab Yisa zaŋ o tahi maa na.
en: Pilate knew that the chief priests had brought Jesus to him because they were jealous.

dag: Nyini, yilimi fabila yilli ŋɔ niŋ Izraɛl nanima.
en: The Lord said to me, You must sing this sad song about the leaders of Israel:.

dag: Uzia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayɔbu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihinunaayi. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛkolia. O ya n-daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Uzziah became king at the age of sixteen, and he ruled in Jerusalem for fifty-two years. His mother was Jecoliah from Jerusalem.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim zani; di chɛ ka ninsalinim yaa gari a yaa! Chɛ ka zuliya kam ka a sanna ka a ti kari ba saria.
en: Do something, Lord ! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.

dag: N ni lan yɛli yaha, so di tɛhi ni n nyɛla jɛrigu, ka yi yi tɛhi lala, yin shiri lihimiya ma kaman jɛrigu din ni chɛ ka n gba tooi nyu bara biɛla.
en: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Mɔab bɔpiɛligu din daa miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili Jɛriko maa:.
en: While Israel was camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, the Lord told Moses.

dag: Man ŋuna, di pala m malila baŋsim gari sokam zuɣu ka Naawuni kahigi ashili maa gbinni wuhi ma maa, amaa o niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka nyin naa baŋ zahindi maa gbinni mini tɛhi shɛŋa din daa ka a sanna maa gbinni.
en: Now, this mystery was revealed to me, not because I am wiser than anyone else, but so that Your Majesty may learn the meaning of your dream and understand the thoughts that have come to you.

dag: Saha shɛli Yaakubu ni daa chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti ka Ijiptinim maa daa ti muɣisiri ba ka bɛ fabili niŋ Yawɛ la, ka o daa tim Musa mini Aduna ka bɛ ti yihi yi yaannim maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-zaŋ ba na ti ʒili kpe ŋɔ.
en: Jacob went to Egypt. Later, the Egyptians made life hard for his descendants. So they cried to the Lord for help. The Lord sent Moses and Aaron, and they took your ancestors out of Egypt and led them to live in this place.

dag: Ka Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim daa ka Yisa sanna nti bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka o wuhi ba alizanda ni shihirili.
en: Some Pharisees and Sadducees who came to Jesus wanted to trap him, so they asked him to perform a miracle for them, to show that God approved of him.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yɛli taba, Ti bi niŋ din tuhi. Zuŋɔ nyɛla lahiba suŋ dabisili. Ka ti yi zaŋ li shini hal ni biɛɣu ti neei, tibidarigibo shɛli ni ti paai ti. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛliya ka ti chaŋ ti yɛli nayilinima.
en: But then they said to each other, What were doing isnt right. Today is a day of good news, but were keeping quiet about it. If we wait until dawn, something bad will happen to us. Come on! Lets go and tell the palace.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Yi yi yuri ma, yi ni doli n zaligunima.
en: If you love me, you will do what I command.

dag: Ka zuliya tital dini n-lee beni m-mali zalikpana mini zaligunim din pahi ka wuntizɔbo be di ni kaman n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa zali ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ?.
en: No other nation, no matter how great, has laws so just as those that I have taught you today.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi fiɣisi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda? Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun wuhi ni bɛ ka taali.
en: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni ti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka n dabili Dauda ti nyɛ bɛ naa be bɛ sunsuuni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then I, the Lord , will be their God, and my servant David will be the ruler living among them. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa ni daa deei fɔntin shɛŋa zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila tinsi pia ni di zaa ha biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: In all, the rest of the people from the Kohath family groups got ten towns and some land around each town for their animals.

dag: Ka bɛ daa na bi kpe gom, ka Sɔdom tiŋ puuni dɔbba bɛn nyɛ ninkura mini bipola zaa daa laɣimna nti teei gili yili maa.
en: Before Lot and his guests could go to bed, every man in Sodom, young and old, came and stood outside his house.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli, Ninvuɣ so ŋun daŋ Jɛbusinim ŋɔ kubu ni leei toondana, ka lan leei sapashin kpɛma. Ka Jɔab ŋun nyɛ Zɛruya bia la daa daŋ chaŋ, ka daa leei toondana.
en: David had said, The first one to kill a Jebusite will become commander in chief! Joab, Zeruiahs son, was the first to attack and so became commander in chief.

dag: Dauda ni daa ti paai zoli maa zuɣu luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa yi jɛmdi Naawuni la, nyama, ka Hushai ŋun nyɛ Ariki nir la daa chɛh omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣ o zuɣu n-ka Naa Dauda sanna.
en: When David reached the top of the Mount of Olives, he met Hushai the Archite at a place of worship. Hushai's robe was torn, and dust was on his head.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa vaai yiɣisi bindirigu maa dibu shee ni suhuyiɣisili pam, ka daa bi di bindirigu goli palli daba ayi dali maa, dama Dauda yɛla daa muɣis o pam ni o ba ni daa dih o vi shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Jonathan was angry and hurt that his father had insulted David so terribly. He got up, left the table, and didn't eat anything all that day.

dag: Ka di simdi ni ŋun nyo li maa paɣ o situra ka su kom, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni na.
en: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp.

dag: O daa piila Bɛza din be tiŋgban nɛl ni tintani ni la n-ti Rubin zuliya niriba, ka pii Ramɔt din be Giliad la n-ti Gaad zuliya niriba, ka pii Golan din be Bashan la mi ti Manaasa zuliya niriba.
en: For the tribe of Reuben there was the city of Bezer, on the desert plateau; for the tribe of Gad there was Ramoth, in the territory of Gilead; and for the tribe of Manasseh there was Golan, in the territory of Bashan.

dag: bee o bapir bee o bapir bia ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o bee o daŋ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ o talahi nir ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o bee o yi ti nya buni o ni tooi yo ka deeg omaŋa.
en: or an uncle or a cousin or another close relative may buy them back; or if they themselves earn enough, they may buy their own freedom.

dag: Bɛ kuri pakoya mini saamba, ka kuri kpibisi.
en: They kill widows and orphans, and murder the strangers who live in our land.

dag: Yidaampaɣ zinalana ŋɔ, a nyɛla ŋun chɛ ka a mini saamba n-doona ka chɛ a yidana.
en: You are like an adulterous wife: you take in strangers instead of your husband.

dag: Yi zuliya mini yi bihi galisim naan ŋmanila mɔɣ bihigu; ka n naan ku chɛ ka bɛ birili kpihim hal baabiɛla gba.
en: Your offspring would be like the sand, and your descendants like its grains. Their name would never be eliminated, never wiped out from before me.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o, Pom n nini ŋɔ ni; ka Yisifu daa shiri po. Di saha ka Izraɛl daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa o bindoo zuɣusaa polo.
en: Jacob said, Make a vow that you will. Joseph made the vow, and Jacob gave thanks there on his bed.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ a saɣisigu wuhiri ma soli, ka dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, a ni ti deei ma ni jilima.
en: You guide me with your instruction and at the end you will receive me with honor.

dag: Nyin Bɛtilihɛm, tiŋ din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ, a pala tin bila Juda nabihi sani, dama a ni ka na so ŋun ni su n niriba Izraɛlnim ni ti yina. .
en: Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, you are important among the rulers of Judah. Yes, a ruler will come from you, and that ruler will lead Israel, my people. Micah :.

dag: Ibram daa lan yɛli, Nyama, a ni bi ti ma bia maa zuɣu, bɛ ni dɔɣi dab so n yiŋ puuni la nti yɛn di n fali.
en: You have not given me any children, and this servant of mine will inherit everything.

dag: Ti mali tahima maŋli zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, dama ti mi ni ti mini ya ni laɣim di wahala shɛm, lala ka ti mini ya ni ti lan laɣim nya suhumaabo.
en: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.

dag: Ŋmaligim m polo na n-zo ma nambɔɣu; zaŋm a kpiɔŋ ti a dabili ŋɔ, tiligim a dab bipuɣiŋga bia ŋɔ.
en: I serve you, Lord , and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.

dag: Bɛ daa yi tuhi tɔbu ka di nɛma shɛŋa, bɛ piirila di ni shɛli n-zaŋ li mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: They gave some of the things taken in wars. They gave these things to be used for the Lord s Temple.

dag: Ka paɣ maa ba maa yɛli kpamba maa, N daa zaŋla m bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ ti doo ŋɔ ka o niŋ o paɣa, amaa ka o ti bi lan bɔr o.
en: The young womans father will say to the elders: I gave my daughter to this man to be his wife, but he doesnt like her anymore.

dag: Ninvuɣ suma nimmaŋtali n-wuhiri ba soli, amaa bilikɔɣinim bilikɔnsi bahiri ba la yoli.
en: Integrity guides the virtuous, but dishonesty ruins the treacherous.

dag: Ti Duuma, a ni nam zuliya shɛb la zaa ni kana ti gbani a tooni tibig a yuli.
en: My Lord, you made everyone. I wish they all would come worship you and honor your name.

dag: Alahichi daa pun bela dunia ŋɔ ni hal ka Naawuni ti naanyi zaŋ o fukumsi zaligu ti ti, amaa fukumsi zaligu ni daa na kani la, shɛli daa kani din ni wuhi ni alahichi tumbu chihira.
en: There was sin in the world before the Law was given; but where there is no law, no account is kept of sins.

dag: A ni ti dɔni, ka so ku lan kpɛh a dabiɛm, ka niriba pam ti bɔri ni a niŋ ba nirilim.
en: You will lie down without fear of anyone. Many people will come to you for help.

dag: Di saha ka naazɔnim bɛn daa kul be o san la yɛl o, Naa, chɛ ka bɛ vihi nya paɣisara bɛn nyɛ paɣipiɛl viɛla na ti ti a.
en: So his young male servants said, Let the king have a search made for beautiful young women who havent yet married.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, Yi mali so shɛŋa din ni doli zaɣisi Naawuni zaligunima, ka doli yimaŋmaŋ kaya!.
en: Then he said, You show great skill in avoiding the commands of God so that you can follow your own teachings!.

dag: Dama ti bi be kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali Naawuni yɛligu n-niŋdi kaman neen shɛŋa bɛ ni kɔhiri alaha, amaa ti nyɛla yɛlimaŋlinima ka nyɛ Naawuni ni pii shɛb tim, ka zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, ti nyɛla bɛn tɔɣisiri Masia yɛla.
en: Certainly not those who are out there selling Gods message for a profit! But we dont do that. With Christs help we speak Gods truth honestly, knowing that we must answer to him.

dag: M mi ni bin sun shɛli ka n ni. N ninsalitali biɛhigu yɛla ka n yɛri maa. Hal n ni yu zaɣ suŋ tumbu n suhu ni maa zaa yoli, n kul bi tooi tumdi li.
en: Yes, I know that nothing good lives in me—I mean nothing good lives in the part of me that is not spiritual. I want to do what is good, but I dont do it.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa niŋ pua, ka tim na ti yɛli Dauda ni o malila pua.
en: But later, when she found out that she was going to have a baby, she sent someone to David with this message: I'm pregnant.

dag: Bɛ kul bela nimaani n-yaari bɛ noya kumda, ka yɛtɔɣ yoya yiri bɛ noya ni na. Bɛ tɛhiya, Ŋuni n-lee ni wum ti ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Listen to their insults and threats. Their tongues are like swords in their mouths, yet they think that no one hears them.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa ti bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: Pilate questioned him, Are you the king of the Jews? Jesus answered, So you say.

dag: Amaa n ni mali tahima sahakam; ka kul ni paɣir a waawaayili.
en: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka salo kabiri laɣindina maa, ka o tah alizin birigu maa zuɣu yɛli, Nyin alizin tikpiralan birigu ŋɔ, n yɛr a mi, wari ka chɛ bia maa, ka di lan lab o sanna yaha.
en: Jesus saw that all the people were running there to see what was happening. So he spoke to the evil spirit. He said, You evil spirit that makes this boy deaf and stops him from talking—I command you to come out of him and never enter him again.

dag: Hal n ni daa yɛli ya lala maa, yi daa zaɣisi wumbu ka zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligu, ka ŋme nyɔɣu chaŋ zoya ni tiŋ maa ni.
en: I reported this to you but you wouldnt listen. You disobeyed the LORDs instruction. Hotheadedly, you went up into the hills.

dag: Di saha naa maa ni ti ŋmaligi zaŋ kpa omaŋmaŋ ya sansana polo, amaa o ni ti tuui lu n-kpi.
en: He will retreat to his fortresses in his own country, but on the way he will be defeated and never again be seen.

dag: Ka yilibila daa bili yina tam yila anahi maa zaɣ yini zuɣu. Ka di yiko daa yɛligi kpa nudirigu polo mini wulimpuhili polo ni Alikauli Tiŋgbɔŋ la polo.
en: A little horn came from one of these, and its power reached to the south, the east, and even to the holy land.

dag: Man karimba ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa m-be Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ.
en: I, the Teacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mbusim be piɛgul shɛb bɛn ku m piɛri, ka wurim ba kpɛhi yɔɣu ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: You leaders of my people are like shepherds that kill and scatter the sheep.

dag: Neesim neeri zibisim ni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi mini bɛn niŋdi nirilim, ni nambɔzɔriba ni wuntizɔriba.
en: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ bɛ ni boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-booi bah o zuɣu ni.
en: Take the anointing oil and pour it on his head to anoint him.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka di zaa laɣim bi, ka chɛbu saha ti paai ka n yɛli bɛn yɛn chɛ li: Daŋmiya piriŋkpana la chɛbu n-laɣim li lo bɔba n-nyo buɣim, amaa ka chɛ alikama la zaa n-laɣimna nti niŋ n kambɔŋ ni. .
en: Let the wheat and the weeds both grow together until harvest. Then I will tell the harvest workers to pull up the weeds first, tie them in bundles and burn them, and then to gather in the wheat and put it in my barn.

dag: Iso bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlifaz mini Riuɛl ni Jɛushi ni Jalam ni Kɔra.
en: Esau was the father of Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

dag: A ni neei zoomba nina, ka yihi dansarikanim bɛn be zibisim ni la bahi.
en: You will open the eyes of the blind and set free those who sit in dark prisons.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali teebuli, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihiwɛiayika ka di yɛlim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanahi, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Bezalel built a table of acacia wood centimeters long, centimeters wide, and centimeters high.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:.

dag: Bɛ daa bi gbibi Naawuni ni lo ba alikauli shɛl la, ka daa zaɣis o zaligu dolibu.
en: They did not keep their agreement with God. They refused to obey his teachings.

dag: Ka bee binshɛli beni, ka bɛ ni yɛli, Nyamiya, bini ŋɔ din nyɛla bin palli? Di nyɛla binshɛli din pun beni hal ka bɛ na bi dɔɣi ti gba.
en: Someone might say, Look, this is new, but that thing has always been here. It was here before we were.

dag: Dabisili kam yɛrila dabisili din dolina di yɛla, ka yuŋ kam yɛri yuŋ din dolina di yɛla.
en: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.

dag: n-kpe Zakaria yiŋ ti puhi Ɛlizabɛt.
en: She went into Zechariahs house and greeted Elizabeth.

dag: Ka Gaal daa gari tooni zaŋ Shɛkɛmnim chaŋ, ka bɛ mini Abimilɛk ti tuhi.
en: So Gaal marched out at the head of the leaders of Shechem and fought with Abimelech.

dag: Ɛlizabɛt puu maa chira ayɔbu ni ka Naawuni daa tim malaika Gabirɛl Galili fɔntin shɛli din yuli booni Nazarɛt la.
en: When Elizabeth was six months pregnant, God sent the angel Gabriel to Nazareth, a city in Galilee.

dag: Anabi ninkur so daa be Bɛtɛl di saha maa. Ka o bidibisi daa kuli ti yɛl o Naawuni nir maa ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa Bɛtɛl dindali maa yɛla; ka lan yɛl o o ni daa yɛli Naa Jɛrɔbɔam shɛlikam zaa la gba yɛla.
en: There was an old prophet living in Bethel. His sons came and told him what the man of God did in Bethel and what he said to King Jeroboam.

dag: Judanim naa Jɔtam mini Izraɛl naa Jɛrɔbɔam ʒiɛmana ni ka bɛ daa sabi bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba ŋɔ yuya maa sɔŋ.
en: They were all listed in the records in the days of Judahs King Jotham and Israels King Jeroboam.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salim zim mali nyɔtaɣirisi zaɣ yɛlima kɔbisiyi. Ka bɛ ni daa zaŋ salim paɣila mali di zaɣ yini kam tibisim daa nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayopɔin.
en: King Solomon made large shields of hammered gold. He used about pounds of gold for each shield.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o nuu shihi bɛ nina ka yɛli, Yi yɛda niŋbu ni nyɛ shɛm, di niŋmiya lala.
en: Then Jesus touched their eyes and said, Let it happen, then, just as you believe!—.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Aminadab mini Kɔra ni Asir.
en: Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.

dag: Yisa daa ti be Bɛtani Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ kɔŋlan la yiŋa.
en: Jesus was in Bethany at the house of Simon, a man who had suffered from a dreaded skin disease.

dag: Ziɔnnim teei bɛ nuhi, amaa ka so kani ŋun ni maai bɛ suhuri. Yawɛ daa yɛli Yaakubu ni o ʒiʒiinitaba ni ti leeg o dimnima. Jɛrusalɛm leela binshɛli din nyɛ daɣiri bini bɛ sani.
en: Zion spread out her hands. There was no one to comfort her. The Lord had given orders to Jacobs enemies. He ordered them to surround the city. Jerusalem has become a dirty rag that her enemies threw away.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi ni, Joɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbiga ni pihita pah o zuɣu.
en: Joel, the leader of the Gershon clan, and of his relatives;.

dag: N ni chɛ ka di maligumaaniba zaŋ tiliginsim ye kaman situra la, ka chɛ ka di niriba bɛn ʒe yim yili suhupiɛlli yila.
en: I will dress its priests in salvation, and its faithful will shout out loud with joy!.

dag: Laɣimmi niriba zaa n-gil amaŋa, ka ʒini a nam ʒiishee alizanda ni su ba.
en: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.

dag: Ka n daa pii yi bi shɛba n-leeg anabinima, ka pii yi nachimba shɛba n-leei Nazarinima. Izraɛlnima, bee pa lala n-nyɛ li? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I made some of your sons to be prophets and some of your young men to be Nazirites. People of Israel, it is true. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bidibis ata daa be nimaani, bɛna n-nyɛ Jɔab mini Abishai ni Asahɛl. Asahɛl daa guurimi kaman molifu la.
en: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel, who could run as fast as a wild deer.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi Naa Agiripa, Naa, a niŋ anabinim yɛligu yɛda? M mi ni a niŋ bɛ yɛligu yɛda.
en: Then Paul said to Agrippa, Do you believe what the prophets said? I know you do.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa tim tuumba ka bɛ gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, ka Baal jɛmdiba zaa daa laɣimna, ka so daa bi kpalim ka bi kana. Ka bɛ daa kpe Baal duu maa ni hal ti pal li, ka di luɣilikam zaa ti nyɛla niriba.
en: Jehu sent an invitation to everyone in Israel. All the worshipers of Baal came, and the temple was filled from one end to the other.

dag: N niriba ni wuhi ni yi yuli leela noli n-din ya, ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni chɛ ka yi kpi, amaa n ni ti n niriba maa yuli din nyɛ zaɣ palli.
en: My chosen people will use your name as a curse. I, the Sovereign Lord , will put you to death. But I will give a new name to those who obey me.

dag: Ka Juda daa zaŋ o bia pakoli Tama maa n-lan dɔɣi bidibisi ayi pahi, bɛna n-nyɛ Pɛrɛz mini Zɛra. Juda bidibisi zaa daa nyɛla niriba anu.
en: Judahs daughter-in-law Tamar gave birth to Perez and Zerah. So Judah had five sons.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni n ni ti zaŋ n Shia Kasi niŋ daadam kam ni. Ka yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa; ka yi nachimba ti nya ʒii; ka yi ninkura mi ti zahim zahima.
en: When the last days come, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.

dag: Ka di tiri mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri kom, ka mɔɣu ni bunsi nyuri li kuri kɔnyuri.
en: They provide water for the wild animals; there the wild donkeys quench their thirst.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla; ka o yurilim maŋli kul beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the LORD because he is good, because his faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Labisim li su di tɔɣu ni. N yɛn kari ya la saria n ni daa nam ya luɣ shɛl la, tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ yi piligu shee la ni ka n yɛn kari ya saria.
en: Your days to punish others are over, so put your swords away. You will be punished in the land of your birth.

dag: O mi yi ŋme n-vuɣ o dabipaɣ bee o dabidoo nyini, ŋun chɛ ka dabili maa chaŋ yoli, o nyini maa zuɣu.
en: If he knocks out a tooth of a male or female slave, he should let the slave go free on account of the tooth.

dag: Wuntaŋ ku ti a daŋa dabisili puuni, ka goli gba ku ti a dɔro yuŋ.
en: The sun wont strike you during the day; neither will the moon at night.

dag: ka din pahi pinaata daa gbaai Shubaɛl min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the thirteenth to Shubael, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Di simdi ni yi zaŋdi yi ni tuui ŋɔri bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini tiri Yawɛ yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: For all time to come, this special gift is to be given to the Lord from the bread you bake.

dag: Di dubihi mini di pilanim ni di zɔntuhi mini dina la zaa daa nyɛla yim. Ka takɔriti be di ni zaa gili. Di ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: rooms, arches, and porch, and also its windows all around. It was seventy-five feet long and thirty-seven and a half feet wide.

dag: Hal Yɛhudianim zuɣulaannim pam daa niŋ Yisa yɛda, amaa bɛ ni daa zɔri Farisiinim zuɣu ka bɛ daa bi bɔri ni bɛ yihi li palo, ka Farisiinim maa ti kari ba bɛ jɛmbu duu;.
en: Even then, many Jewish authorities believed in Jesus; but because of the Pharisees they did not talk about it openly, so as not to be expelled from the synagogue.

dag: Niriba pam ni ti bɔhi ma zaadali, Ti Duuma, ti Duuma, ti daa bi malila a yuli yihiri waazu, ka mal a yuli kariti alizin biɛri, ka mal a yuli tumd alahiziba tuma.
en: When the Judgment Day comes, many will say to me, Lord, Lord! In your name we spoke God's message, by your name we drove out many demons and performed many miracles.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a ka a tiri ninvuɣ so dabili zalige? O zanibu bee o lubu nyɛla o duuma yɛla. Ka o shiri ni zani, dama ti Duuma Naawuni ni tooi chɛ ka o zani.
en: Who are you to judge someone elses servants? They stand or fall before their own Lord .

dag: Di saha yin yɛlimiya ba Izraɛlnim ni daa chaŋ taŋkpa kuŋ zuɣu Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ ni n-du li shɛm yɛla.
en: Then you will let your children know: Israel crossed over the Jordan here on dry ground.

dag: ni n ni ti yɛn darigi Izraɛlnim tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu dahin shɛli, n ni ti saɣim Bɛtɛl sara maligu bimbina, ka ŋme n-kabisi di lɔrisi ni tandaɣa din sansaya la bahi tiŋa.
en: On the day I punish the crimes of Israel, I will also visit the altars of Bethel; the horns of the altar will be cut off and will fall to the ground.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa neei, ka Pashihur chɛ ka bɛ baai Jɛrimia bandi maa, ka Jɛrimia yɛl o, Yawɛ daa bi bol a yuli Pashihur, amaa o daa bol a yuli la Dabiɛm be luɣilikam zaa .
en: The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said: No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, yinima n-shiri nyɛ ti barinyubo mini ti suhupiɛlli!.
en: Indeed, you are our pride and our joy!.

dag: Amaa nyin ŋuna, di simdi ni a mali suhukpeeni, di chɛ ka a kɔba ni chɔɣisi, dama a nya a ni tum tuun shɛli maa laara.
en: But Asa, you and the people of Judah and Benjamin, be strong. Dont be weak and dont give up, because you will get a reward for your good work.

dag: Naawuni ni daa wum li, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam, ka o daa zaɣisi Izraɛlnim zaa di zuɣu.
en: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.

dag: N lee bɔrila paɣibu ninsalinim sani bee Naawuni sani? Bee n kpaŋdi mmaŋ ni n tiɣila ninsalinim nini? N yi na kul tiɣiri ninsalinim nini, dindina n ku tooi nyɛ Masia dabili.
en: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ.

dag: yin piimiya fɔntins ata Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa ni.
en: you must designate three cities for your use in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess.

dag: Ka o daa lan sabi gbana n-ta Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ daɣiri, ka tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ yoya pam jɛnd o yɛra, Tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa niriba buɣa ni daa bi tooi tiligi bɛ niriba n nuu ni shɛm, lala ka Hɛzɛkia Naawuni ŋɔ gba ku tooi tilig o niriba n nuu ni.
en: He wrote other letters insulting the LORD God of Israel, defying him by saying, Just as the gods of the nations in other countries couldnt rescue their people from my power, Hezekiahs god wont be able to rescue his people from my power.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ daa kul timd anabinim bɛ sani waawaayili, dama o niriba maa mini ŋun Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la yɛla daa mal o nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord , the God of their ancestors, sent prophets again and again to warn his people. He did this because he felt sorry for them and for his Temple. He didnt want to destroy them or his Temple.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Ɛshikol vinvamli ni ŋ-ŋmaai nimaani wain tia wala yilli, ka niriba ayi zaŋ li pa dapua zuɣu buɣira; ka bɛ daa lan ʒi pumpɔrinchihi mini fiig tia wala gba na.
en: Then they entered the Cluster ravine, cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and carried it on a pole between them. They also took pomegranates and figs.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku saɣi guni kaman ti ni yɛli shɛm maa, dindina ti ni zaŋ ti bipuɣiŋga maa yiɣisi chaŋ.
en: If you refuse to be circumcised, we will take Dinah away.

dag: N gbilisi tibili ni n wum, amaa ka bɛ bi tɔɣisi yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ ninvuɣ so bi niŋ tuuba o tuumbiɛri zuɣu yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka n niŋ lala? Bɛ zaa kparila bɛ kpabu kaman wɔhu ni sibigi ʒi n-kpɛri tɔb gɔɣu ni shɛm la.
en: I listen carefully, but none of you admit that you've done wrong. Without a second thought, you run down the wrong road like horses running blindly into battle.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yihiri laɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ tahi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na la saha shɛli ka maligumaana Hilikia daa nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Musa ni o ti o niriba la kundi.
en: While they were bringing out the money that had been brought into the LORDs temple, Hilkiah the priest found the Instruction scroll that the LORD had given through Moses.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yiɣisi asiba n-yɛli Balak kpamba maa, Labimiya kuli yi ya, dama Yawɛ zaɣisiya ni n di doli ya chaŋ.
en: The next morning, Balaam said to Balak's officials, Go on back home. The Lord says I cannot go with you.

dag: Nyamiya, n paɣimi neei ya zaa. Pa bɛ ni paɣiri anzinfa shɛm la, amaa wahala ka n zaŋ buɣisi ya.
en: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.

dag: Maligumaana bidibbil kam ni tooi ŋub li. Di simdi ka bɛ ti ŋub li la luɣ kasi shee, di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: Any male of the priestly families may eat it, but it must be eaten in a holy place, because it is very holy.

dag: Dabiɛm ni kpe ba kaman kokpɛɣu la, ka pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ti ʒe ba chaŋ yuŋ.
en: Terror will strike like a sudden flood; a wind in the night will blow them away;.

dag: ni suligu ni baŋtooŋa min o balibu zaa.
en: kites, all kinds of falcons.

dag: Vihimi Yawɛ kundi ni n-karim di ni yɛli shɛm. Biŋkɔbiri ŋɔ zaɣ yino ku pooi, ka bɛ mi zaa so ku kɔŋ bala. Dama Yawɛ n-zali ni di niŋ lala. Omaŋmaŋ Shia ni laɣim ba na.
en: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.

dag: N nya n niriba ni diri wahala shɛŋa Ijiptinim nuu ni, ka lan wum bɛ fabila la, lala zuɣu ka n kana ni n ti fa ba bahi. Ka yɛl o, Dinzuɣu kamina ka n tim a Ijipti.
en: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.

dag: Bɛ ŋme n-deei Babilɔn, dunia zaa ni daa mali shɛli nyuri bara la. Babilɔn leela din yɛla mali dabiɛm zuliya kam sani.
en: Sheshach will be defeated. The best and proudest country of the whole earth will be taken captive. People from other nations will look at Babylon, and what they see will make them afraid.

dag: Ka m biɛhigu shee maa duɣuri mini di lahi zaa zaŋ tabili di kpahi mini dundɔŋ maa kpahi zaa ti nyɛ daanya binyɛra.
en: All the equipment that is used in the Tent and all the pegs for the Tent and for the enclosure are to be made of bronze.

dag: Lee miriya ka yi ŋubi nimdi din ʒim bi yi di ni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The one thing you must not eat is meat with blood still in it; I forbid this because the life is in the blood.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Then the LORDs word came to Jeremiah.

dag: Di saha ka Juda zuliya ninvuɣ shɛb daa ka Jɔshua sanna Giligal; ka Jɛfune ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛnizi nir la bia Kalɛb ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ ni yino la ti yɛli Jɔshua, A mi Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir la m min a yɛla shɛm Kadɛshibarinia la.
en: One day some people from the tribe of Judah came to Joshua at Gilgal. One of them, Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, said to him, You know what the Lord said in Kadesh Barnea about you and me to Moses, the man of God.

dag: Ka yi ni diri ka nyur la, pa yimaŋmaŋ kɔre ka yi niŋdi lala kura? .
en: And when you eat and drink, isn't it for your own enjoyment?.

dag: Ka di nyɛla Baasha min o bia Ɛla ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa la mini bɛ ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim jɛm buɣa n-tum alahichi shɛŋa ka di yiɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ suhu la zuɣu.
en: This happened because of all Baashas sins, as well as the sins of his son Elah and because they caused Israel to sin. They angered Israels God, the LORD, with their insignificant idols.

dag: ka Samuɛl mi daa do Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni luɣ shɛli Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ni daa be la, ka bɛ daa na bi kpihi Naawuni firila.
en: and Samuel was sleeping on a mat near the sacred chest in the Lord 's house. They had not been asleep very long.

dag: Dama di ni ti a nyɛvili wɔɣinli, ka chɛ ka a biɛhigu tɔŋ pam.
en: What I teach will give you a good, long life, and all will go well for you.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka di pala pagɔrisigu gɔbu zuɣu ka kpuɣi paɣ so tum zina. Ka ŋunkam mi kpuɣi paɣ yihiŋ maa gba tum zina.
en: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for the problem of sexual sin, and marries another woman is guilty of adultery.

dag: Dinzuɣu naa, kamina pumpɔŋɔ kaman a suhu ni yu dahin shɛli, di nyɛla ti talahi tuma ni ti gbaag o ti a.
en: So whenever you want to come down, Your Majesty, do it! Leave it to us to hand him over to the king.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋda maa yɛl o, Karimba, achiika! A yɛli yɛlimaŋli; dama Naawuni yino n-shiri beni, ka Naawuni so lan kani pah o zuɣu.
en: The teacher of the Law said to Jesus, Well done, Teacher! It is true, as you say, that only the Lord is God and that there is no other god but he.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, niriba yi nuzaa polo tiŋgbɔŋ ni kanna. Bɛ nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ka lo tɔbu n-yi katiŋ damdi dunia ŋɔ bɔba ni yaɣa ni.
en: This is what the Lord says: An army is coming from the north. A great nation is coming from faraway places on earth.

dag: Nyamiya, ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ kanimina ni o ti zaŋ yiko pam di nam. O ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani; o laara gba be o sani.
en: Here is the LORD God, coming with strength, with a triumphant arm, bringing his reward with him and his payment before him.

dag: Amaa ka jintɔriba maa ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ Farisii, ka o yuli booni Gamaliɛl ka o daa nyɛ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu karimba so sokam ni tiri jilima la daa yiɣisi zani n-yɛli ni bɛ na zaŋmi Yisa tuumba maa yi kpaŋ pɔi.
en: But one of them, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, who was a teacher of the Law and was highly respected by all the people, stood up in the Council. He ordered the apostles to be taken out for a while.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ yɛliya, A ku lan yiɣis a ni do bindo shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ, amaa biɛhiŋ kani, a ni kpi. Ka Ilaija daa chaŋ.
en: Tell the king that the Lord says, You will not recover from your injuries; you will die! Elijah did as the Lord commanded.

dag: amaa ŋun mali kpiɔŋ gar o yi ti lir o n-nyaŋ o, o farila o bidibbin shɛŋa o ni niŋ yɛda maa, ka fa o nɛma maa.
en: But as soon as a stronger one attacks and overpowers him, the stronger one takes away the armor he had trusted and divides the stolen goods.

dag: Malimiya shili kaman yi daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm ka di doli bɛ ni daa piripiri ya kaman Izraɛl Naa Dauda ni daa sabi wuhi shɛm la ni kaman o bia Sulemaana ni daa sabi wuhi shɛm la.
en: Take your places in the Temple by clans, according to the responsibilities assigned to you by King David and his son King Solomon.

dag: Di bi simdi ka Izraɛl bipuɣinsi ni so ti niŋ jɛmbu duu pagɔrili bee ka bidibisi ni so ti niŋ jɛmbu duu dagɔrili.
en: No Israelite daughter is allowed to be a consecrated worker. Neither is any Israelite son allowed to be a consecrated worker.

dag: Amaa yi yi zaɣisi, ka niŋ tipawumli, Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi kun ya. .
en: But if you defy me, you are doomed to die. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka a niŋ Yawɛ naani. N chɛ ka a baŋ li zuŋɔ, iin, n chɛ ka a baŋ li.
en: I want you to put your trust in the Lord ; that is why I am going to tell them to you now.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Raba gooni n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa la zaa. Di saha tɔbu tuhibu tahigu ni ti tahiri dindali maa, ka zabili ti be kaman sanʒiɛɣu la.
en: So I will send fire upon the city walls of Rabbah and burn down its fortresses. Then there will be shouts on the day of battle, and the fighting will rage like a storm.

dag: Tibigim yɛm, ka o duh a. A yi vili yɛm gbibi, o ni ti a jilima.
en: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Timiya ba bindirigu ka bɛ di. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi kɔŋko n-kul bɛ ti sani; naɣila ti chaŋmi ti da bindirigu din ni saɣi niriba ŋɔ zaa na.
en: He replied, You give them something to eat. But they said, We have no more than five loaves of bread and two fish—unless we go and buy food for all these people.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yiɣisi asiba m-pa o buŋ nyaampara doli Mɔab kpamba maa chaŋ.
en: The next morning, Balaam got up, put a saddle on his donkey, and went with the Moabite leaders.

dag: Zaligu lola paɣa tabil o yidana hal ni o nyɛvil tariga, amaa o yidan maa yi ti kpi, o nya yolisim din ni tooi kuli do so o suhu ni bɔra; di mi simdi ni o kul la ŋun doli ti Duuma.
en: A woman should stay with her husband as long as he lives. But if the husband dies, the woman is free to marry any man she wants, but he should belong to the Lord.

dag: nti gbaag o fiɣisibu yɛra, Ti nya ka doo ŋɔ birigirila ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa, ka yɛri ni ti di yo farigu Naa Siiza sani, ka lan yɛri ni ŋuna n-nyɛ Masia ni naa.
en: They began to accuse Jesus and said to Pilate, We caught this man trying to change the thinking of our people. He says we should not pay taxes to Caesar. He calls himself the Messiah, a king.

dag: Hiburɔn daŋ ni bɛ daa piila Hashabia min o mabihi niriba tuhili ni kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn daa mali kpiɔŋ viɛnyɛliŋga ni bɛ lihiri Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo la Yawɛ tuma zaa mini naa tuma.
en: Among the descendants of Hebron, Hashabiah and seventeen hundred of his relatives, all outstanding men, were put in charge of the administration of all religious and civil matters in Israel west of the Jordan River.

dag: Di saha ka malaika ŋun pah ayopɔin la piɛb o kikaa, ka kukol kara kul kuhiri pampam alizanda ni yɛra, Dunia nam leela ti Duuma Naawuni min o Masia dini hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The seventh angel blew his trumpet. Then there were loud voices in heaven. The voices said, The kingdom of the world has now become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Messiah. And he will rule forever and ever.

dag: Ka do so yi nyɛla faralana ka ku tooi yo yi ni zali da shɛli maa, dindina yin zaŋmi dilan chaŋ maligumaana sani, ka o ti zal o daa, maligumaana ni zal o daa maa ka di dolila ŋun po pɔri maa dahima ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: If anyone is too poor to pay the price, bring that person to the priest. The priest will decide how much money the person can afford to pay.

dag: Ka dabili mi na ʒi n-kpalim be ŋun su o yiŋa sahakam, amaa yilibia ŋun kul ni beni sahakam.
en: And slaves don't stay in the family forever, though the Son will always remain in the family.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋ bindir shɛli nyo buɣim mali sara din nyom viɛl ti Yawɛ. Biŋkpam zaa nyɛla Yawɛ dini.
en: The priest shall burn all this on the altar as a food offering pleasing to the Lord . All the fat belongs to the Lord .

dag: N daa wuhi ba n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi. Ka ŋunkam dol li ni be di zuɣu.
en: I gave them my commands and taught them my laws, which bring life to anyone who obeys them.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ba na kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi piɛri mini piɛlahi ni buhi tahiri nakɔha sani shɛm la.
en: I will lead them away to die, like sheep, lambs, and goats being led to the butcher.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka Izraɛlnim gbibi jɛmbu dabisili maa bɛ ʒiɛmana zaa ni, ka di leei alikauli din kul ni beni sahakam shihirili.
en: Every generation of Israelites must respect the Sabbath.

dag: Ka saa daa luna m-mi wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi.
en: and rain fell on the earth for forty days and nights.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya kul diri nam sahakam, ka chɛ ka a nam kul ʒiɛya ʒiɛmani kam ni. .
en: David, one of your descendants will always be king.

dag: N ni bɔhi ba biɛri bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa zuɣu ka ku kpihim bɛ taali maa. Dama Man Yawɛ bela Ziɔn.
en: I will forgive their bloodguilt, which I had not forgiven. I will act on their account; I will not pardon the guilty. The LORD dwells in Zion.

dag: Yawɛ soli dolibu nyɛla gooni din mali kpiɔŋ bɛn biɛhigu be tibi sani, amaa di nyɛla din kuri ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: The path of the LORD is a refuge for the innocent and ruin for those who do evil.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka yurilim niŋ dɛde ti ni ni di chɛ ka ti ti tooi mali suhukpeeni saria karibu dali, dama o ni be shɛm, lala ka ti gba biɛhigu be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: This is how love has been perfected in us, so that we can have confidence on the Judgment Day, because we are exactly the same as God is in this world.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka sokam buɣis omaŋmaŋ tuma nya, di nyaaŋa o ni mali dalir shɛli ni o nyu bara ni bela omaŋmaŋ tuma ni, ka pa ni o ʒiʒiinikpee tuma ni.
en: Each person should test their own work and be happy with doing a good job and not compare themselves with others.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ o niriba maa kaman piɛri la chaŋ, ka wuhi ba soli mɔɣu ni kaman biŋkɔbbaligu n-nyɛ ba la.
en: Then he led Israel like a shepherd. He led his people like sheep into the desert.

dag: Miri ka a bɔh a kpee biɛri bee n-je suli niŋ o, amaa yum a kpee kaman amaŋ la. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Do not take revenge on others or continue to hate them, but love your neighbors as you love yourself. I am the Lord .

dag: Ninsalinim mi lee nyɛla bɔ, ka a tibigi ba pam, ka zaŋ a zaŋsim niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Why are people so important to you? Why pay attention to what they do?.

dag: Amaa yin teemiya yi nuu n-zaŋ o ni bɔri shɛli maa paŋ o ni yi suhu zaa ka di saɣ o, hal di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam.
en: Instead, be generous and lend them as much as they need.

dag: O zaŋ binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni niŋ a nuu ni ni a su. Dina n-nyɛ: ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri ni noonsi. Nyini n-nyɛ zuɣu din nyɛ salima la.
en: God has delivered into your care human beings, wild creatures, and birds in the sky—wherever they live—and has made you ruler of all of them. You are the gold head.

dag: Kaman bɛ ni yi dooi samafuu pa yaɣiri duɣu zuɣu shɛm la, lala n-nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ viɛla o noli ni, ka zaɣ biɛɣu be o suhu ni.
en: Insincere talk that hides what you are really thinking is like a fine glaze on a cheap clay pot.

dag: Ka zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkpam la nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: He will completely burn the fat of the purification offering on the altar.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lab Ilaisha sanna Jɛriko o ni daa be luɣ shɛli, ka o bɔhi ba, N daa pun bi yɛli ya ni yi di chaŋ.
en: So the men went to Jericho where Elisha was staying and told him. Elisha said to them, I told you not to go.

dag: Rubin mini Simiɔn ni Lɛvi ni Juda.
en: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa nyɛ kulipalinima bɛn labiri ziŋgɔhi mini bɛn mali yilima bee nɛri gbahiri zahim Nail Mɔɣili maa ni ni ti fabili.
en: The fishermen, all those who catch fish from the Nile River, will become sad and they will cry. They depend on the Nile River for their food, but it will be dry.
