dag: Ka maligumaaniba shɛb bɛ ni daa zaŋ yi Samaria chaŋ maa ni yino daa labi nti ʒini Bɛtɛl n-wuhiri ba Yawɛ jɛmbu.
en: One of the Israelite priests was chosen to go back to Israel. He lived in Bethel and taught the people how to worship the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Job said to the Lord :.

dag: Ka Ɛliab mi zuliya daa nyɛ Nɛmuɛl mini Datan ni Abiram. Datan mini Abiram daa nyɛla niriba ni daa pii shɛba. Bɛna n-daa pahi Kɔra min o nyaaŋa zuɣu n-taai duŋ niŋ Yawɛ, ka yɛli Musa mini Aduna finafina.
en: Eliabs descendants: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the Dathan and Abiram chosen by the community who fought against Moses and Aaron with the community of Korah, when they fought against the LORD.

dag: Yaakubu daa di n-tiɣi. Jɛshurun daa ŋmɛlimya ka tiri gbini. A ŋmɛlimya piri m-muɣi lɔŋ. O daa zaɣisi Naawuni ŋun nam o, ka maani o tiliginsim tampiŋ ansarisi.
en: The Lord 's people grew rich, but rebellious; they were fat and stuffed with food. They abandoned God their Creator and rejected their mighty savior.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ pahi yɛli, Alizanda nam lan ŋmanila lan shɛli kulipalinim ni zaŋ lab kom ni n-gbahi zahim balibu kam;.
en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that people threw into the lake and gathered all kinds of fish.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Amaa yi yi ti nya ka tɔbbihi teei gili Jɛrusalɛm, yin baŋmiya ni di wurimbu saha miriya.
en: When you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then you will know that it will soon be destroyed.

dag: Ti dimnim maa kpiya, ka buɣim di bɛ ni kani ka chɛ shɛli.
en: Surely our enemies are destroyed! Their wealth burned up in the fire.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb mi yɛli, Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ pala alizin biɛɣu ni ʒi so zuɣu yɛtɔɣa. Alizin biɛɣu ni ʒi so zuɣu ni tooi neei zom nina.
en: Others said, These arent the words of someone who has a demon. Can a demon heal the eyes of people who are blind.

dag: ka o yɛli ma, Nyuma, ka chɛ ka n ŋɔŋ ti a laakumnim ŋɔ gba ka bɛ nyu, nyin chɛ ka ŋuna n-nyɛ nyin Yawɛ ni bɔri ni so leei n-dan bia paɣa maa.
en: If she agrees and also offers to bring water for my camels, may she be the one that you have chosen as the wife for my master's son.

dag: Kaman chɛulɔnim ni kul gbibi punu ka di viini gindi shɛm la, lala ka vinnyaɣilan gba be o garo zuɣu.
en: As a door turns on its hinge, so do lazy people in their beds.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla shia, ka di niŋ kamaata ni bɛn jɛmd o, jɛmd o ni bɛ shihi ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: God is spirit, and it is necessary to worship God in spirit and truth.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi ti nya omaŋa, ŋun kalimi daba ayopɔin, di nyaaŋa o ni yi daɣiri ni.
en: After her flow stops, she must wait seven days, and then she will be ritually clean.

dag: Ka paɣ maa mi daa zo n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni daa mali zal o tiŋgban nɛli ni ni o be nimaani ka o dihir o hal ti paai biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihiyɔbu la.
en: The woman ran away into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for days.

dag: ka daa zaŋ salima gabisi ayi la gɔhi bans ayi din daa goligoli nyolɔrigu maa naŋgbambiya la.
en: They fastened the two gold cords to the two rings.

dag: Ka zuliya shɛli niriba bɛn ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ti jɛm Naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, saa ku mi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: No rain will fall on the land of anyone in any country who refuses to go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ di yipa kahigi wuhi ti Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti tiligira kandina la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun daa nyaŋ kum zaa, ka kahigi wuhi ni nyɛvili mini niŋgbun shɛli din bi poori beni lahibal suŋ la zuɣu.
en: And now it has been shown to us in the coming of our Savior Christ Jesus. He destroyed death and showed us the way to have life. Yes, through the Good News Jesus showed us the way to have life that cannot be destroyed.

dag: ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛril mini oniɣisi ni jasipa m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir anahi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li niŋ salima bintaɣindisi la ni.
en: and in the fourth row, a beryl, a carnelian, and a jasper. These were mounted in gold settings.

dag: Di daba ayi nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chaŋ Galili;.
en: Jesus had said, Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country. Then two days later he left.

dag: Ka paɣ maa bɔh o, N dana, a ka guuka, ka kɔbiliga ŋɔ mi zilim pam; ka wula ka a lee yɛn niŋ nya nyɛvili kom maa?.
en: The woman said, Sir, where will you get that living water? The well is very deep, and you have nothing to get water with.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yaakubu daa kuli Ijipti na. O daa nyɛla sana m-be nimaani luɣ shɛli din yuli daa booni Ham la.
en: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Musa daa yihi fɔntinsi ata Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo.
en: Then Moses chose three cities on the east side of the Jordan River.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, pomiya ni yi yi nya n yura maa, yi ni yɛl o ni n lula bole o zuɣu.
en: I place you under oath, daughters of Jerusalem: If you find my love, what should you tell him? That Im weak with love!.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka ti daa kpam Taitus jaande ni o ni daa pun piligi niŋdi shɛm la o kul niŋmi lala n-naai yurilim tuuni ŋɔ yi gba sani.
en: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.

dag: Chamiya, amaa nyamiya, n tim ya mi kaman piɛbihi ni be kunduna sunsuuni shɛm la.
en: You can go now. But listen! I am sending you, and you will be like sheep among wolves.

dag: N kpalimla kɔba noli, biɛla n-chɛ n naan kpi.
en: My skin hangs loose on my bones; I have barely escaped with my life.

dag: A bi wum ni m pun lo dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ka di saha waɣa? Kurimbuni ha ka m pun lo lala, ka chɛ ka di niŋ pali pumpɔŋɔ maa. Dina n-nyɛ: Ni a saɣim fɔntin kara, ka di leei dabari.
en: Havent you heard? I set this up long ago; I planned it in the distant past! Now I have made it happen, making fortified cities collapse into piles of rubble.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa po pɔri n-lo Dauda alikauli, ka mi ku lan yi di nyaaŋa. A daa yɛliya, N ni ti zaŋ a bidibisi ni yino n-leei naa ʒil a nam ʒiishee.
en: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, I, the Lord , promise that someone in your family will always be king.

dag: Chamiya ti maan lihi viɛnyɛliŋga n-nya o shiri beni, ka baŋ o ni be luɣ shɛli maa, ka lan baŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun nya o nimaani maa, dama bɛ yɛli ma ni o neeya pam.
en: Go and learn more about David. Keep track of where he goes and who goes to see him. I am told that David is smart and that he is trying to trick me.

dag: n ni zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ba nuu ni. Bɛ niŋgbuna ni ti leei juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu.
en: I will hand them over to their enemies, who want to kill them, and their corpses will be eaten by birds and wild animals.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun wumdi Naawuni yɛligu, o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. Ŋun nyari Kpiɔŋlan Naa ʒii, o luya, amaa ka o nina bi pɔbi.
en: These are the words I heard from God. I saw what God All-Powerful showed me. I humbly tell what I clearly see.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mbusim be anabi shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra, ka doli bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu, ka bi nyari shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The LORD God proclaims: Doom to the foolish prophets who follow their own whims but see nothing.

dag: Zaŋm o ti lih o viɛnyɛliŋga, ka miri ka a niŋ o zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa niŋm o ni yɛl a ni a niŋmi shɛli.
en: Find Jeremiah and keep him safe. Take good care of him and do whatever he asks.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ bimbuɣisirigu din ŋmani jaaŋgbee ti ma ka yɛli ma: Yiɣisima m-buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini di bimbini, ka kali bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni di ni.
en: Then I was given a measuring rod, which was like a pole. And I was told, Get up and measure Gods temple, the altar, and those who worship there.

dag: ni bɛnkam zaa daa be zoya zuɣu tinsi ni Lɛbanɔn hal ti paai Misirɛfɔtimaim hal ni Sidɔnnim zaa. Man maŋmaŋa n-yɛn be Izraɛlnim tooni n-kari ba bahi, nyin dini nyɛla a piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛlnim ka bɛ su li kaman n ni pun yɛl a shɛm la.
en: The people of Sidon are living in the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim. But I will force them out for the Israelites. Be sure to remember this land when you divide the land among the Israelites. Do this as I told you.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa ŋme ba naŋgbankpeeni ni o chɛ ka gomna maa ku niŋ yɛda.
en: But they were opposed by the magician Elymas , who tried to turn the governor away from the faith.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛliya n taali yim ŋɔ yaha, ka suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa ti ma ka o yihi ma kum ŋɔ ni n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Now, forgive me for my sins this time. Ask the Lord to remove this death from me.

dag: M mabihi, pumpɔŋɔ m bɔri ni n teei ya n ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa yihi lahibal suŋ waazu tin ya la. Yi daa dee li ka ʒe di ni.
en: Now, brothers and sisters, I want you to remember the Good News I told you. You received that Good News message, and you continue to base your life on it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ mɛɛr din to kaman yabiga la gari wain ni ti o ni o nyu; amaa ka o daa zaɣisi li.
en: There they gave him some wine mixed with a drug to ease the pain, but he refused to drink it.

dag: A zo yi ti a dansi di mali daliri, amaa a dim ŋun kul yɛn mɔɣisirila a kpariŋ bushɛm.
en: Friends mean well, even when they hurt you. But when an enemy puts his arm around your shoulder—watch out!.

dag: N nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zɔr a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa dol a zaligunim maa zo.
en: I am a friend to everyone who worships you. I am a friend to everyone who obeys your instructions.

dag: N zaŋ n faako tibu mirina yomyom. N tiliginsim be soli, n ni bo yɛlimaŋli soli ti niriba. Bɛn be katiŋ ha kul guhiri ma mi, ka niŋ n yaa naani.
en: I will come quickly and save them; the time of my victory is near. I myself will rule over the nations. Distant lands wait for me to come; they wait with hope for me to save them.

dag: Wuntizɔriba solɔɣu nyɛla din lɔɣiri zaɣ biɛɣu. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi bɛmaŋ bɛ soli ni nyɛla bɛn tiligiri bɛ nyɛviya.
en: Good people try to avoid evil. They watch what they do and protect themselves.

dag: Ti daa lola Ijiptinim mini Asirianim alikauli ni bɛ tiri ti bindirigu ka ti diri tiɣira.
en: We had to surrender to Egypt and Assyria because we were hungry.

dag: Di nyaaŋa di bahigu saha ni ti paai ka o bahi nam balibu kam mini bɛn su fukumsi ni yiko balibu kam yoli, ka zaŋ o nam ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o Ba la.
en: Then the end will come. Christ will destroy all rulers, authorities, and powers. Then he will give the kingdom to God the Father.

dag: A yi shin a noli saha shɛli ti ni be ŋɔ ni, sɔŋsim ni yi luɣ shɛl polo na nti tiligi Yɛhudianima, amaa ka nyin lee kpi ka a ba zuliya kpihim. Bee ŋuni n-ni tooi baŋ ni pa lala zuɣu ka a ʒe a ni ʒe zaashe tital shɛl ni ŋɔ.
en: If you keep quiet now, help and freedom for the Jews will come from another place. But you and your fathers family will all die. And who knows, maybe you have been chosen to be the queen for such a time as this.

dag: Ka ti yaannim maa daa zaɣis o noli, ka woligi bɛmaŋa ka chɛ o, ka daa paɣila Ijipti labbu bɛ suhuri ni.
en: But our ancestors refused to obey him; they pushed him aside and wished that they could go back to Egypt.

dag: O daa bi siɣis omaŋa Yawɛ tooni kaman o ba Manaasa ni daa siɣis omaŋ shɛm la, amaa Amɔn ŋɔ ŋun daa kul tumdila tuumbiɛri pahira.
en: But unlike his father, he did not become humble and turn to the Lord ; he was even more sinful than his father had been.

dag: ka di nyɛla yi ni bɔri ni yi nya shihirili din wuhiri ni Masia yiko ni ka n tɔɣisirila zuɣu. Masia pala ninvuɣ gbariŋ zaŋ chaŋ o ni niŋdi ya shɛm polo, amaa o nyɛla ŋun wuhir o yiko yi sunsuuni.
en: You will have all the proof you want that Christ speaks through me. When he deals with you, he is not weak; instead, he shows his power among you.

dag: Sokam mi o yidana tiŋ maa dunɔdaya gbini, ka o mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kpamba laɣindi ʒiina.
en: Her husband is known in the city gates when he sits with the elders of the land.

dag: Luɣ dini ka n lee yɛn zo n-chaŋ ka chɛ a Shia? Bee ya ka n lee yɛn zo n-kuli n-yi a sani?.
en: Where could I go to get away from your spirit? Where could I go to escape your presence?.

dag: So miri ka o ti ta Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ pin kasi shɛŋa na ti mali sara ti Yawɛ la daɣiri.
en: The Israelites must not make the holy offerings impure that they offer up to the LORD.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima m-pa chɛrubinima ayi maa luɣilikam zaa zuɣu.
en: The creatures were also covered with gold.

dag: Amaa Firawuna ni daa nya ka saa maa mini sakuɣa ni satahinsi maa zaa naai maa, ka o daa lan gbaai taali tumbu yaha, o min o kpamba maa daa lan niŋ tipawumli.
en: But when Pharaoh saw that the rain, hail, and thunder had stopped, he sinned again. Pharaoh and his officials became stubborn.

dag: ni kom baptaizibu ni nuhi zaŋ pa niriba zuɣu mini kpiimba kum ni neebu ni tibidarigibo din ka bahigu yɛla.
en: And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ti ni daa wum yi yɛla hal ni pɔŋɔ, ti kul suhirila Naawuni tiri ya sahakam. Ti suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka yi baŋ o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm zaa, ka pahi ya yɛm mini baŋsim zaa din nyɛ Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri ya shɛl la.
en: Since the day we heard these things about you, we have continued praying for you. This is what we pray: that God will make you completely sure of what he wants by giving you all the wisdom and spiritual understanding you need;.

dag: Ka Pita daa yiɣisi zo n-chaŋ siliga maa gbini nti kurim lihi di puuni n-nya ka kahiŋga kɔŋko n-doya; ka o ŋmaligi kuna, ka bɔhir o suhu din niŋ maa zuɣu.
en: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb; he bent down and saw the grave cloths but nothing else. Then he went back home amazed at what had happened.

dag: Alahichi nyɛla din tɔɣisiri ninvuɣ biɛri yɛtɔɣa bɛ suhuri puuni. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura bɛ suhuri ni.
en: Sinners don't respect God; sin is all they think about.

dag: N suhu ni daa miligi ka biɛrim lan mali ma n suhu ni la.
en: When my heart was bitter, when I was all cut up inside.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn zaŋ a bibihi fiɛbi tampima ni ti mali alibarika!.
en: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!.

dag: Amaa ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka di ku moli gili m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛliya ka ti kpɛhi ba dabiɛm pam ni bɛ miri ka bɛ lan boli Yisa yuli n-tɔɣisi o yɛla so sani.
en: To keep it from spreading further among the people, we need to warn them not to speak to anyone in this name.

dag: Di saha maa ti ti ku lan be kaman bihi, ka ninvuɣ yɔhindiba bɛn zaŋ yɛŋkiŋkabina soli birigi niriba la ni zaŋ yɔhiŋgu wuhibu din be kaman pɔhim la n-chɛ ka di ʒiɛri ti laani ginda.
en: Then we shall no longer be children, carried by the waves and blown about by every shifting wind of the teaching of deceitful people, who lead others into error by the tricks they invent.

dag: Tol bɔbili kana nti lu ti tiŋgbɔŋ zuɣu. Bɛ mali yiko pam, ka lan galisi hal nti ka kalinli. Bɛ nyina dirimi kaman gbuɣinli nyina la, ka bɛ nyindari be kaman gbuɣinnyaŋ nyindari la.
en: because a nation, powerful and beyond number, has invaded my land. Its teeth are like lions teeth; its fangs are like those of a lioness.

dag: mini dundɔŋ ni duri la sunsuuni yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita pia n-gili Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa luɣilikam.
en: and the nearest buildings ten meters away.

dag: Anabi Musa n-daa zaŋ gunibu zaligu tin ya, amaa pa Anabi Musa sani ka di daa yina, yi yaannim sani ka di daa yina, hal ka yi gundi yi bidibbihi Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Because Moses gave you the commandment about circumcision , you circumcise a man on the Sabbath.

dag: Amaa Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, di zaa yoli, a nini na kul bi tiɣi li, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, a lan yɛli man a dabili ŋɔ n yili ni ti yɛn be shɛm dahin shɛli ha yɛla, ka wuhi ma n zuliya ni ti yɛn be shɛm dahin shɛli ha.
en: But even this was too small in your eyes, LORD God! Now you have also spoken about your servants dynasty in the future and the generation to come, LORD God!.

dag: Ka a ti booi li bahi Aduna min o bidibisi zuɣu ni m-mali ba ka bɛ be kasi, ka leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi n tuma.
en: Then anoint Aaron and his sons and make them holy to serve me as priests.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe cheechi niriba zaa pam zaŋ tabili bɛnkam zaa daa wum di yɛla.
en: Trepidation and dread seized the whole church and all who heard what had happened.

dag: Bumbɔni nyɛla asiba bɛ zaa sani, dama bɛ nyɛla bumbɔni mini dabiɛm zɔnima.
en: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends.

dag: Bɛ daa tɔɣisiri Jɛrusalɛmnim Naawuni maa yɛla mi kaman dunianim buɣ shɛŋa niriba ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali la.
en: Then they insulted the God of Jerusalem just as they had insulted all the gods of the people from other nations—even though those gods are only things people made with their hands.

dag: ka yɛl o, N ni zaŋ nama ŋɔ sulinsi mini di jilima zaa ti a, dama mani n-su li ka ni tooi zaŋ li ti n ni bɔri so.
en: I will give you all this power and all this wealth, the Devil told him. It has all been handed over to me, and I can give it to anyone I choose.

dag: M mi daa bi chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti nya Masia tuun shɛb bɛn daa be n tooni la, amaa ka daa naɣ chaŋla Areebia. Di nyaaŋa ka n daa ti yi nimaani n-lan lab Damaskus.
en: nor did I go to Jerusalem to see those who were apostles before me. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and then I returned to Damascus.

dag: Mani ka Yawɛ daa daŋ nambu o tuma piligu ni, din daa nyɛ o tuuli tuma kurimbuni ha.
en: The Lord made me in the beginning, long before he did anything else.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl tuma kpamba maa daa baŋ ni yɛlli ka bɛ nya maa, bɛ ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ kul ŋmam bilichiisi maa kaman bɛ ni yi pun ŋmari li shɛm tariga dabisili kam la zuɣu.
en: The Hebrew foremen knew they were in trouble, because the Pharaoh had told them, You must still make as many bricks as you made before.

dag: ni nintuhi ni nyee nintuhi.
en: the signet rings, and the nose rings.

dag: N ni zaŋ a min a kɔsoya ni zahim maa labi tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka a ti lu palɔni, ka bɛ ti ku nya a sɔɣi. N ni ti zaŋ a ti mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini juri ka bɛ di.
en: I will throw you and all those fish into the desert. Your body will fall on the ground and be left unburied. I will give it to the birds and animals for food.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa pii ninvuɣ shɛb niriba maa ni ka bɛ nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni toondaannima ni Izraɛl zuliya kam ni zuɣulaannima.
en: These are the ones appointed from the community, chiefs of their ancestral tribes and leaders of the divisions of Israel.

dag: Doo maa zuɣu ka n ni nyu bara, amaa n ku nyu bara maŋmaŋ zuɣu dina; n naɣ ni nyula bara mmaŋmaŋ chɔɣinsi zuɣu.
en: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.

dag: Deem o wuhibu din yir o nol ni na, ka zaŋ o yɛligu niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Accept the teaching he gives; keep his words in your heart.

dag: Doo yi kpuɣi paɣ min o bia leeg o paɣiba di nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛtali, ka di simdi ka bɛ nyo doo maa min o paɣiba maa buɣim din ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛtali maa ku lan be bɛ sunsuuni.
en: It is a sexual sin if a man has sexual relations with a woman and her mother. The people must burn that man and the two women in fire! Dont let this sexual sin happen among your people.

dag: Ŋun be tibi n-lihiri nyari din be ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi; ŋuna n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri lura m-bahiri yoli.
en: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.

dag: Ka Bɛtuɛl mi daa dɔɣi Ribɛka. Bih anii ŋɔ ka Milika daa dɔɣi ti Nahɔr ŋun daa nyɛ Ibrahimma mabia maa.
en: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These are the eight Milcah bore for Nahor, Abrahams brother.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhiri bee n-chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. N daa pun bi yɛli ya kurimbuni ha, ka wuhi li? Naawuni so kani pahi n zuɣu. N ʒi Naawuni so ŋun mali yiko pam yɛla yaha. Yinima n-nyɛ n shɛhiranima.
en: Dont be afraid! Dont worry. I am the one who always told you what would happen. You are my proof. There is no other God; I am the only one. There is no other Rock; I know I am the only one.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu o suhu ni ka o bɔh omaŋa, Padiriba ala n-lee be m ba yiŋa m-mali bindira diri tiɣiri ka chɛra, ka man ti be kpe kpiri kum?.
en: When he came to his senses, he said, How many of my fathers hired hands have more than enough food, but Im starving to death!.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o nubila n-niŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim m-mihi bimpindigu maa tooni, ka lan zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa m-mihi bimpindigu maa tooni buyopɔin.
en: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ, piim ninvuɣ so leei niriba maa toondana.
en: You are the Lord God, and you know what is in everyone's heart. So I ask you to appoint a leader for Israel.

dag: amaa di simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun niŋdi saani ni ŋun yuri zaɣ suŋ ni ŋun su omaŋa ni ŋun bebu tuhi ni ŋun bebu be kasi ni ŋun gbib omaŋa.
en: He must be hospitable and love what is good. He must be self-controlled, upright, holy, and disciplined.

dag: A tɛhiya ni zuŋɔ ka m piligi bɔhiri Naawuni n-nyar o yɛla tir o? Naa, di zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mini n daŋ zaa so taali, dama mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ bi mi dimbɔŋɔ zaa yɛla hal baabiɛla gba.
en: Was that the first time I questioned God for him? Of course not! But please, the king shouldnt accuse me, his servant, or anyone in my fathers household of any wrongdoing, because your servant knew nothing whatsoever about this matter.

dag: Dama m mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni kum bee nyɛvili bee malaikanim bee alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi bee binyara din be pumpɔŋɔ bee binyara din ti yɛn kana bee yikombiɛri.
en: Im convinced that nothing can separate us from Gods love in Christ Jesus our Lord: not death or life, not angels or rulers, not present things or future things, not powers.

dag: Dama niriba maa ni daa laɣim maa, Jabɛshigiliad ninvuɣ so daa ka nimaani.
en: The Israelites counted everyone to see who was there and who was not. They found that no one from Jabesh Gilead was there.

dag: Ka o daa ti lihi nya kɔbiliga ka di do mɔɣu ni, ka piɛri tiɣisi do ʒii buta gil li, dama kɔbiliga maa ni kom ka bɛ daa ŋɔŋdi nyuhiri ba, ka kuɣ yɛlinli daa pa di noli zuɣu.
en: He saw a well in the field in front of him, near which three flocks of sheep were lying down. That well was their source for water because the flocks drank from that well. A huge stone covered the wells opening.

dag: Amaa so ni yɛli, A malila yɛda, ka m mi mali tuma. N gba ni yɛli, Wuhim ma a yɛda niŋbu din bi tumdi tuma maa, ka m mi wuh a n yɛda niŋbu n tuma tumbu puuni.
en: But someone might argue, Some people have faith, and others have good works. My answer would be that you cant show me your faith if you dont do anything. But I will show you my faith by the good I do.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan bia Ɛbɛd daa nyɛ Adin daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba pihinu daa pah o zuɣu.
en: of Adin, Ebed, Jonathans son and with him men.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, N ni duh a Izraɛlnim zaa ninni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ; ka bɛ baŋ ni n ni be a sani kaman n ni daa be Musa sani shɛm la.
en: The LORD said to Joshua, Today I will begin to make you great in the opinion of all Israel. Then they will know that I will be with you in the same way that I was with Moses.

dag: Ka kpamba maa mini niriba maa zaa daa yɛl o, Di garig o shɛli bee n-saɣ o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: The leaders and the people answered, Don't pay any attention to him; don't give in.

dag: dindina wula ka tinim ni tooi zo n-yi tibidarigibo maa ni, ti baɣa yi ka tiliginsim din galisi ŋɔ ni? Ti Duuma maŋmaŋ daa tuui yɛli tiliginsim maa yɛla, ka bɛn daa wum o yɛligu di o shɛhira ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: how will we escape if we ignore such a great salvation? It was first announced through the Lord, and then it was confirmed by those who heard him.

dag: Nyamiya, n zaŋla nyɛvili mini tɔŋsim ni kum mini ashaara n-zali yi tooni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Today I have given you a choice between life and death, success and disaster.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi yɛn dolila Ar polo ti gari Mɔabnim tintariga.
en: Today you must cross the border at Ar and go into Moab.

dag: Shɛm bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlam mini Ashur ni Aripakishad ni Lud ni Aram.
en: Shem's sons—Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram—were the ancestors of the peoples who bear their names.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yi bɛ tinsi ni n-laɣim Gibia na ni bɛ ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: From all the cities of Benjamin they came to Gibeah to fight the other people of Israel.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tusaayɔbu n-da Samaria daboli Shɛmɛr sani m-me tiŋ tam di zuɣu, ka boli di yuli Samaria ŋ-ŋmahindi Shɛmɛr ŋun daa su daboli maa yuli.
en: then he bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for , pieces of silver. He built a town there and named it Samaria, after Shemer who had owned the hill.

dag: ni Jɛhud ni Bɛnɛbɛrak ni Gatirimɔn.
en: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon.

dag: Amaa ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ omaŋmaŋ taali? Chɛli n daashilɔni taali.
en: But can anyone know what theyve accidentally done wrong? Clear me of any unknown sin.

dag: Teemi ni a daa me ma mi kaman yaɣiri la, ka lan yɛn chɛ ka n leei taŋkpaɣu?.
en: Remember that you molded me like a piece of clay. So don't turn me back into dust once again.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu bihi mini ninvuɣ shɛb daa kana ni bɛ ti da bindira maa, dama kum maa daa lula Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni gba.
en: The famine was very bad in Canaan, so there were many people from Canaan who went to Egypt to buy grain. Among them were the sons of Israel.

dag: O tizo Oholiba daa nya dimbɔŋɔ, amaa ka o pagɔrisigu tumbu min o kɔre daa bie n-gar o biɛli maa dini.
en: Even though her sister Oholibah saw this, she was wilder and more of a prostitute than Oholah had ever been.

dag: Ka Filip daa guui paag o sani nti wum ka o karindila Anabi Aizaia litaafi. Ka Filip bɔh o, A baŋ a ni karindi litaafi shɛli maa gbinni.
en: Philip ran up close and heard the man reading aloud from the book of Isaiah. Philip asked him, Do you understand what you are reading.

dag: Ka ti daa lan bɔhi ba bɛ yuya ni di chɛ ka ti sabi bɛ yuya, ka wuh a bɛn nyɛ tuma maa zuɣulaannima.
en: We also asked them their names so that we could inform you who the leaders of this work are.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi kpuɣi di ni wuhi ni yi saɣimmi binshɛɣukam maa ni binshɛli, dama yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni bo yɛla ti Izraɛlnima, ka di bahi ba yoli bɛ sansan ni.
en: But you, keep away from the things set aside for God so that you dont desire and take some of the things reserved. That would turn the camp of Israel into a thing doomed to be utterly wiped out and bring calamity on it.

dag: N niriba ni wuhi ni yi yuli leela noli n-din ya, ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni chɛ ka yi kpi, amaa n ni ti n niriba maa yuli din nyɛ zaɣ palli.
en: You will leave your name behind for my chosen ones to curse: May the LORD God kill you! May he call his servants by a different name.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba zaa bɛn be kpe ŋɔ puhiri ya, di bahi bamdi bɛn be Naa Siiza yiŋ la.
en: And greetings to you from all of Gods people here, especially those who work in the service of the emperor.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti yaba n-nyɛ Ibrahimma. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi yi di nyɛla Ibrahimma yaansi, yi naan tumdi kaman Ibrahimma ni daa tumdi shɛm.
en: They replied, Our father is Abraham. Jesus responded, If you were Abrahams children, you would do Abrahams works.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka kukol shɛli yɛli ma, Pita, yiɣisima n-kɔrigi ŋubi.
en: Then I heard a voice saying to me, Get up, Peter; kill and eat.

dag: Ka so ku tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo a hal ni a nyɛvili tariga. N ni be a sani kaman n ni daa be Musa sani shɛm la. N ku chɛ ka a ti bɔri ma ka bi nya ma, m mi ku chɛ a.
en: Joshua, no one will be able to defeat you as long as you live. I will be with you as I was with Moses. I will always be with you; I will never abandon you.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus bɔh o, Ninsal yi kurigi, wula ka o lan yɛn niŋ ka bɛ dɔɣ o yaha? O ni lan tooi kpe o ma puuni ka o dɔɣ o yaha.
en: Nicodemus said, How can a man who is already old be born again? Can he go back into his mothers womb and be born a second time.

dag: Nɛr daa nyɛla Kish ba, ka Kish nyɛ Sool ba, ka Sool nyɛ Jɔnatan mini Malikishua ni Abinadab ni Ɛshibaal ba.
en: Ner was the father of Kish, and Kish was the father of Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti zooi m-mali yaa, ka lan mali suhukpeeni pam, ka daa chaŋ ti be mɔɣu ni hal ka o saha ti paai, ka o naanyi yih omaŋ palo Izraɛlnim sani.
en: The child grew up, becoming strong in character. He was in the wilderness until he began his public ministry to Israel.

dag: Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahir awɛi biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti Anabi Hagai.
en: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month in the second year of Darius, the LORDs word came to Haggai the prophet.

dag: N yura nyɛla n ni su so, ka n gba nyɛ o ni su so. O zaŋd o biŋkɔbbaligu chani ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri Paɣiviɛligakushihikom puuni.
en: My lover is mine, and I am his. He feeds his flock among the lilies.

dag: Ka m mi ni ŋun piligi tuun suŋ ŋɔ yi ni maa ni tum li hal ti naai li ti Duuma Yisa Masia labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: Im sure about this: the one who started a good work in you will stay with you to complete the job by the day of Christ Jesus.

dag: N ni nya ka shɛli viɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Di simdi ni ninsalinim diri ka nyura, ka di bɛ tuma zaa nyaɣisim dunia ŋɔ ni dabisa biɛla shɛli Naawuni ni ti ti ŋɔ puuni, dama ti tarili m-bala.
en: This is the one good thing Ive seen: its appropriate for people to eat, drink, and find enjoyment in all their hard work under the sun during the brief lifetime that God gives them because thats their lot in life.

dag: Amaa o yiko pam maa puuni, o nam maa ni ti wurim m-pirigi ʒii bunahi. Ka nanim bɛn bi yi o zuliya ni na ni ti deeg o nam maa di n-zan o zaani, amaa ka bɛ lee ti ku mali yiko shɛli o ni daa mali maa tatabo.
en: But suddenly his kingdom will be crushed and scattered to the four corners of the earth, where four more kingdoms will rise. But these won't be ruled by his descendants or be as powerful as his kingdom.

dag: Ka Asirianim gba pahi bɛ zuɣu n-chɛ ka Lɔt zuliya nya yaa.
en: Assyria has also joined them as a strong ally of the Ammonites and Moabites, the descendants of Lot.

dag: Musa ni daa tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa naai, o daa zaŋla sariga pili lir o ninni.
en: The face of Moses kept shining, and after he had spoken with the people, he covered his face with a veil.

dag: ka naɣ kara ayopɔin bɛn niŋgbuna kul nyɛlisiri daa yi Nail Mɔɣili maa ni na ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: Seven cows came up out of the river and stood there eating the grass. They were healthy, good-looking cows.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhiri bee n-chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. N daa pun bi yɛli ya kurimbuni ha, ka wuhi li? Naawuni so kani pahi n zuɣu. N ʒi Naawuni so ŋun mali yiko pam yɛla yaha. Yinima n-nyɛ n shɛhiranima.
en: Dont tremble; have no fear! Didnt I proclaim it? Didnt I inform you long ago? You are my witnesses! Is there a God besides me? There is no other rock; I know of none.

dag: n-sɔɣi ŋuniya mal li tɔri ninvuɣ so ŋun ka taali; bɛ kul tɔrila niriba libigiri ba, ka bi zɔri dabiɛm.
en: from their hiding places so as to shoot an innocent person. They shoot without warning and without fear.

dag: Yɛhudia ninvuɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ Alikizandria tiŋbia ka o yuli booni Apolɔs daa ti ka Ɛfɛsus na. O daa nyɛla zilinvaliŋgalana, ka lan nyɛ ŋun mi Naawuni Kundi viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: A Jew named Apollos came to Ephesus. Born in the city of Alexandria, he was an educated man who knew the Scriptures well.

dag: Ka a yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, bɔ ka a yɛn ti o? Bee bɔ ka o yɛn nya di ni?.
en: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?.

dag: Ka di mi bi simdi ni ti Duuma tumtumda ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni. Di naɣ simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun mali nirilim zaŋ chaŋ sokam sani, ka nyɛ karimba suŋ ni ŋun mali suɣilo.
en: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.

dag: Amaa n ti ku darigi deei nam maa zaa o nuu ni, dama n ni ti zaŋ zuliya yini ti a bia maa n dabili Dauda mini Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni pii shɛli leegi n tiŋ la zuɣu.
en: And I will not take the whole kingdom away from him; instead, I will leave him one tribe for the sake of my servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city I have made my own.

dag: Noli deebu mini ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu ni chɛ ka nir daalahichi kpihim, ka Yawɛ jɛmbu ni chɛ ka nir yi zaɣ biɛɣu ni.
en: Love and faithfulness reconcile guilt; the fear of the LORD turns away evil.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Izraɛl kpamba daa yɛli niriba maa zaa. Doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa tin ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Then Moses, together with the leaders of Israel, said to the people, Obey all the instructions that I am giving you today.

dag: Ka Naftali bidibisi daa nyɛ: Jaziil mini Guni ni Jɛza ni Shilɛm.
en: Naphtali and his sons: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

dag: Di saha Bɛtishɛmɛshinim daa bela vinvamli ni n-chɛri alikama, bɛ ni daa ti kpuɣi bɛ zuɣuri lihi nya Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ka di niŋ ba suhupiɛlli.
en: The people of Beth-Shemesh were harvesting their wheat in the valley. When they looked up and saw the chest, they were so happy that they stopped working and started celebrating.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri lu a zuɣu n-ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be a ni.
en: So this is what the Lord GOD says: I will bring a sword against you. I will destroy all your people and animals.

dag: N daa to ba la kpani ka di pili yi, ka bɛ lu n naba ni ka kɔŋ yiɣisibu, ka n ku bɛ zaa.
en: I strike them down, and they cannot rise; they lie defeated before me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ zaa laɣim duhi bɛ yɛhi n-suhiri Naawuni yɛra, Zallakudura Naa ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni ŋɔ.
en: When the believers heard this, they all prayed to God with one purpose. They said, Master, you are the one who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in the world.

dag: Chɛl barinyubo yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka di lan chɛ ka karimbaan yɛtɔɣa yi a nol ni na yaha. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ mi binshɛɣukam, ka mi daadam ni niŋdi shɛlikam.
en: Dont go on and on, talking so proudly, spouting arrogance from your mouth, because the LORD is the God who knows, and he weighs every act.

dag: Di saha ka tumtumdi kpɛm maa daa yɛli o suhu ni, N dana yi yihi ma o tuma ŋɔ ni, wula ka n yɛn niŋ? N lan ka yaa din ni tooi tum tuun kpɛma, ka mi zɔri vi ni m mali bara.
en: The servant said to himself, My master is going to dismiss me from my job. What shall I do? I am not strong enough to dig ditches, and I am ashamed to beg.

dag: bɛn nyɛ yuun pihita zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinu, ka nyɛ bɛn zaa ni tooi tum tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni.
en: those from to years old who were eligible for work in the meeting tent.

dag: M bi bɔri ni di be kaman n sabirila gbana ni n kpɛhi ya dabiɛm.
en: I dont want you to think that I am trying to scare you with my letters.

dag: N yi be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, m malila a zaligunim maa yiini yila.
en: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi ka bɔh o, Paɣa, ka bɛ be ya? Bɛ ni so bi lan yɛli ni a simdi kubu.
en: Jesus stood up and said to her, Woman, where are they? Is there no one to condemn you.

dag: Bɛ daa tɔhi salima ka di gari tɔn kɔbiga ni pisopɔin, ka tɔhi anzinfa tɔn kɔbisita ni pihinahi, ka tɔhi daanya kaman tɔn kɔbisiyɔbu ni pisi ka tɔhi kuriti gari tɔn tusaata ni kɔbisinahi ni bɛ zaŋ li tum Naawuni duu maa mɛbu tuma.
en: to give five thousand kikkars and ten thousand darics of gold, ten thousand kikkars of silver, eighteen thousand kikkars of bronze, and one hundred thousand kikkars of iron for the work on Gods temple.

dag: Di piligimi kaman Anabi Aizaia ni daa sab shɛm la ni Naawuni yɛliya: N tumo m-bɔŋɔ; n ni tim o ka o daŋ a tooni nti mal a chandi maa soli ti a.
en: with what the prophet Isaiah said would happen. He wrote: Listen! I will send my messenger ahead of you. He will prepare the way for you. Malachi :.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti boli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn guli tiŋ maa dunɔdali n-yɛli ba, Ti chaŋla Sirianim sansan la ni nti bi nya so bee n-wum so damli, amaa ka bɛ tanti suɣa la beni; ka bɛ yuri mini bɛ bunsi gba loya pahi.
en: They went back to Samaria and shouted up to the guards at the gate, We've just come from the Syrian army camp, and all the soldiers are gone! The tents are empty, and the horses and donkeys are still tied up. We didn't see or hear anybody.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ mɛɛr din to kaman yabiga la gari wain ni ti o ni o nyu; amaa ka o daa zaɣisi li.
en: They tried to give him wine mixed with myrrh, but he didnt take it.

dag: Bɛ ŋma ʒiri pa Yawɛ, ka yɛli, O ku niŋ shɛli. Zaɣ biɛɣu ku paai ti, tɔbu bee kum ku lu ti zuɣu.
en: The Lord 's people have denied him and have said, He won't really do anything. We won't have hard times; we won't have war or famine.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla ŋun bi doli din tuhi? Bee Kpiɔŋlan Naa nyɛla ŋun bi doli din tuhi?.
en: God is always fair. God All-Powerful does what is right.

dag: Yawɛ, n dimnim galisiya pam, bɛn yiɣisi lu n zuɣu galisiya pam!.
en: I have so many enemies, Lord , so many who turn against me!.

dag: Di daa zaŋ kpala nudirigu polo maa hal ti paai Akirabim n-zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Zin n-kul zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo maa hal ni Kadɛshibarinia n-zaŋ ti gari Hɛzirɔn m-mali ti paai Adda ŋ-ŋmaligi chaŋ Karika.
en: The border went south to Scorpion Pass and continued on to Zin. Then the border continued south to Kadesh Barnea. It continued past Hezron to Addar. From Addar the border turned and continued to Karka.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋla nyin Yawɛ ni ti ma tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni atam din daŋ niŋbu na ti ti a. Ka a zaŋ li zali tiŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, ka kurim tiŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ tooni.
en: So now I am bringing the early produce of the fertile ground that you, LORD, have given me. Set the produce before the LORD your God, bowing down before the LORD your God.

dag: Ka nimdi maa mini bɔrɔbɔro maa shɛli yi guui, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim.
en: Burn up any meat or bread that is left over.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yiɣis o suhu bahi Reechɛl zuɣu pam, ka bɔh o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun ŋar a dɔɣim soli.
en: Jacob was angry at Rachel and said, Do you think Im God? God alone has kept you from giving birth.

dag: Dim liɣiri maa ka di doli soli. Zaŋm li da naɣilahi mini piɛlahi ni piɛbihi ni kawana ni wain n-zaŋ di mini biŋkɔbiri maa zaa mali sara yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu sara maligu bimbini zuɣu Jɛrusalɛm.
en: With this money you will be careful to buy bulls, rams, and lambs, as well as their grain offerings and their drink offerings. And you will offer them on the altar of Gods house in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka naa bɔh o, O be ya? Ka Ziba daa yɛli naa, O be Ammiɛl bia Makiri la yiŋa Lɔdɛba.
en: Where is he? the king asked. At the home of Machir son of Ammiel in Lodebar, Ziba answered.

dag: Anab shɛb bɛn daa be Jɛriko la ni daa nya Ilaisha ka o miri ba na ka bɛ yɛli, Ilaija shia la shiri be Ilaisha ni. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli n-damd o tiŋa.
en: The group of prophets from Jericho saw him from a distance. They said, Elijahs spirit has settled on Elisha! So they came out to meet him, bowing down before him.

dag: n-zaŋ a niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku a ka nyɛ a ni zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb dabiɛm la nuu ni. Hal n naan zaŋ a niŋ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza mini Kalidianim nuu ni.
en: I would hand you over to those who seek to kill you, those you dread, even Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar and his army.

dag: N daa lo nia ni n ka yi sanna nti kaai ya ka gari chaŋ Masidɔnia; ka ti lan yi Masidɔnia lab yi sanna ka yi ti sɔŋ ma ka n chaŋ Judia.
en: For I planned to visit you on my way to Macedonia and again on my way back, in order to get help from you for my trip to Judea.

dag: Ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi daa firi bayaɣiti ni n-kɔŋ chandi. Di saha ka Ijiptinim maa daa yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti zo ka chɛ Izraɛlnim maa, dama Yawɛ tuhirila Ijiptinim pahiri bɛ zuɣu.
en: The LORD jammed their chariot wheels so that they wouldnt turn easily. The Egyptians said, Lets get away from the Israelites, because the LORD is fighting for them against Egypt.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka yɛli ba, Nam yini puuni niriba yi ŋmaligi tuhiri taba, bɛ nam maa ni wurim; ka yil yin nim yi ŋmaligi zabira, bɛ yili maa mi wurindimi.
en: Because Jesus knew what they were thinking, he said to them, Every kingdom involved in civil war becomes a wasteland, and a house torn apart by divisions will collapse.

dag: Amaa n ku vuui n yurilim maŋli la ka chɛ o bee n-yi n ʒiɛyimtali nyaaŋa.
en: But I will never take my love from him. I will never stop being loyal to him.

dag: Chɛ ka Speen mini teeku ni tiŋgban bihi nanim kana ti jɛm o, ka chɛ ka Shiiba nanima mini Siiba nanim ʒi pina na ti ti o.
en: The kings of Spain and of the islands will offer him gifts; the kings of Sheba and Seba will bring him offerings.

dag: Na shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni ti yɛli bɛ mini bɛn sɔŋdi ba yɛla kpiimba biɛhigu shee maa. Bɛ ni ti siɣi tiŋgban ni nti fo n-doya, bɛn bi guni ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku shɛba.
en: Brave military leaders killed in battle will gladly welcome you and your allies into the world of the dead.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ teebul la zali pateesa maa nyaaŋa, ka zaŋ firilatamdigu la zali tuhi teebuli maa zaŋ labi nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ teebuli maa zali nuzaa polo.
en: Put the special table you made outside of the curtain. The table should be on the north side of the Holy Tent. Then put the lampstand on the south side, across from the table.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti puhi zani Zakaria sani n-ʒe tulaale zim maa tuɣilibu shee nudirigu polo.
en: Then, on the right side of the incense table, an angel of the Lord came and stood before Zechariah.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa, Saɣisimiya miri ma na. Ka bɛ daa saɣisi mir o. Ka o yɛli ba, Mani yi tizo Yisifu so yi ni daa zaŋ kɔhi Ijipti ŋɔ la m-bala.
en: Joseph told them to come closer to him, and when they did, he said: Yes, I am your brother Joseph, the one you sold into Egypt.

dag: N naan bo sɔɣibu shee yomyom, ka pɔhim mini sanʒiɛɣu ku tooi paai ma.
en: I would run away. I would escape from this storm of trouble.

dag: Ka yi mi yi bi gbibi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daalikauli shɛli o ni lɔn ya maa, ka damdi buɣa tooni jɛm li, dindina Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi pam bahi yi zuɣu, ka yi bahi yoli yomyom tiŋgbɔn sun shɛli o ni zaŋ tin ya ŋɔ ni.
en: If you violate the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you to keep, and go on to serve other gods and worship them, then the LORD will be furious with you. You will quickly vanish from the fertile land that he has given you.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ salima mali bans ayi n-zaŋ li goli sara maligu bimbini maa yaɣ yini naŋgbaŋkuɣila salima din kɔɣili li maa lɔŋni, ka lan mali bans ayi niŋ yaɣ din la gba, ka bɛ ti zaŋ dapuhi turi di ni kpuɣiri sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Make two gold carrying rings for it and attach them below the border on two sides to hold the poles with which it is to be carried.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma ni deei bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa maa. Naawuni ni zaŋ bɛ daazichi maa bahi teeku ni, ka nyo bɛ tiŋ maa buɣim ka di di n-lu n-dahim.
en: But the Lord will take away everything she has. He will throw her wealth into the sea, and the city will be burned to the ground.

dag: Yaa ti Naawuni, hal binshɛlikam din niŋ ti ti daalahichi mini ti taali zuɣu ŋɔ ti mi ni a bi darigi ti tibili kaman ti tuumbiɛri ni simdi shɛm, ka chɛ ka ti ni shɛb tiligi ŋɔ.
en: You punished us because of our terrible sins. But you did not punish us nearly as much as we deserve, and you have brought some of us back home.

dag: Shimɛi bidibisi daa nyɛla bɛba ata, Shɛlomɔt mini Haziɛl ni Haran. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Leedan daŋ niriba kpamba.
en: They were all family leaders among their father's descendants. Shimei was the father of Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Jɛrusalɛm polo n-yihi waazu jɛndi bɛ luɣ shɛŋa din be kasi. Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: Son of man, look toward Jerusalem and speak against their holy places. Speak against the land of Israel for me.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka bɛ nab pam, ka bi chɛ ka bɛ biŋkɔbiri filim.
en: God blessed them with many children and plenty of animals.

dag: ka Jɛsi mi nyɛ Naa Dauda ba. Naa Dauda daa nyɛla o paɣ ŋun daa nyɛ Yuria paɣa la bia Sulemaana ba;.
en: Jesse was the father of David the king. David was the father of Solomon, whose mother had been the wife of Uriah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa piligi tir o kpiɔŋ saha shɛl o ni daa be Mahanɛdan din be Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol sunsuuni la.
en: The LORDs spirit began to move him when he was in Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

dag: Ka Naa Uzia daa lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Filistianima, ka daai Gaat mini Jamnia ni Ashidɔd goondahi zaa luhi, ka me fɔntinsi miri Ashidɔd mini Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣ shɛŋa polo.
en: Uzziah fought a war against the Philistines. He tore down the walls around the towns of Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod. Uzziah built towns near the town of Ashdod and in other places among the Philistines.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino mali yi daalahichi sanyoo sara.
en: Offer one male goat to seek reconciliation for yourselves.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa mmaŋmaŋ ni laɣisi m piɛ shɛb bɛn kpalim maa n ni kari ba bahi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa na nti zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ biɛhigu shee, ka bɛ dɔɣi bihi ka nabi.
en: I myself will gather the few remaining sheep from all the countries where I have driven them. I will bring them back to their pasture, and they will be fruitful and multiply.

dag: Ka Mɛlatia ŋun daa yi Gibiɔn na la mini Jadɔn ŋun daa yi Mɛrɔnɔt na la ni Gibiɔnnim ni Mizipanim bɛn daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili polo gomna sulinsi ni la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: Melatiah from Gibeon, Jadon from Meronoth, and the men of Gibeon and Mizpah built the next section, as far as the residence of the governor of West-of-Euphrates.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgban ni tiwal shɛŋa din daŋ moobu zaa, ka bɛ zaŋ li na ti ti man Yawɛ, di nyɛla yi dini; ka ŋunkam be a yiŋa ka be nyam ni tooi di li.
en: It all belongs to you. Every member of your family who is ritually clean may eat it.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, A zuɣu n-lɛbigi! Amaa ka o nini kul mooi ka o yɛri ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Ka bɛ yɛl o, O malaika m-bala.
en: Youve lost your mind! they responded. She stuck by her story with such determination that they began to say, It must be his guardian angel.

dag: ka bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa chaŋ bɛn bi gundi sani, ka a mini ba ti laɣindi timdi dira.
en: They said, You went into the homes of people who are not Jews and are not circumcised, and you even ate with them.

dag: N ni suhi m Ba ka o tin ya Sɔŋda so na ka o ti be yi sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: I will ask the Father, and he will send another Companion, who will be with you forever.

dag: N ni zaŋ a kuli m ma yiŋa, n ni zaŋ a ti kpɛhi ŋun daa dɔɣi ma du gbɛrili ni. N ni ti a wain viɛlli mini m pumpɔrinchihi wala kom ka a nyu.
en: I would lead you into my mothers house, to the room of she who taught me. I would give you spiced wine squeezed from my pomegranate.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ lɛbihi mini matarikanima n-saɣim bɛ ni kpe dari mali binshɛŋa la zaa.
en: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.

dag: Ka chɛrubinim maa daa wuɣi du zuɣusaa. N ni daa nya binneen shɛba Kɛba Mɔɣili dul la m-bala.
en: The winged creatures rose up, the same creatures that I had seen at the Chebar River.

dag: Amaa a nyɛla ŋun chɛri niriba taali ni di chɛ ka bɛ zɔr a.
en: But you forgive people, so they fear and respect you.

dag: Ka Hitinim maa yɛl o.
en: The Hittites answered Abraham.

dag: Di saha maa, anab kam ti ku lan nyu bara ʒii nyabu zuɣu bee n-wuhi ni o nyɛla anabi bee n-ye binyɛr shɛli din mali biŋkɔbiri kɔbiri di ni n-yɔhim niriba.
en: When that time comes, no prophet will be proud of his visions or act like a prophet or wear a prophet's coarse garment in order to deceive people.

dag: Yɛligu maa daa pun bela Naawuni sani piligu ni ha.
en: The Word was with God in the beginning.

dag: ka zaŋ sida dari maa mini taaŋkɔro ni mi ʒee la m-pahi noombil nɛɔŋ la zuɣu tim bɛ ni kɔrigi noombil so maa ʒim mini ko viɛlli maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi yili maa buyopɔin.
en: Then he shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the red cord, and the live bird and shall dip them in the blood of the bird that was killed and in the fresh water. And he shall sprinkle the house seven times.

dag: Amaa a yi lɔri noli, nyin paɣim a ninni, ka niŋ kpam ʒe a zuɣu.
en: So when you fast, wash your face and make yourself look nice.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni ni tin ya din simdi ya zaa o bundaantali din be Yisa Masia ni la zaa puuni.
en: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!.

dag: amaa ŋun mali shili ni o kari nyɛvilinim mini bɛn kpi saria la ni ti bɔhi ba di zuɣu.
en: They will have to reckon with the one who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chani maa ka bɛ mali ti paai ko shɛli, ka namɔɣili maa yɛl o, Nyam kom ŋɔ! Bɔ n-lee ni chɛ ka n ku deei kom baptaizibu? .
en: As they were going along the road, they came to a place where there was some water. The official said, Look! Here is some water. Why can't I be baptized.

dag: Lahibal suŋ daa kala ti sanna kaman di ni daa chaŋ bɛ sani shɛm; ka bɛ ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa daa bi ku ba buchi, dama bɛn daa wum li maa daa bi niŋ li yɛda.
en: Yes, the good news about it was told to us just as it was to them. But the message they heard did not help them. They heard it but did not accept it with faith.

dag: ka mali binyila tam di tarisi bunahi zuɣu, ka di mini di binyila maa zaa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka yi ti niŋ daanya pa di zuɣu.
en: Make projections at the top of the four corners. They are to form one piece with the altar, and the whole is to be covered with bronze.

dag: Ka Naawuni daalibarika min o yiko daa pali Stiivin ka o tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ka wuhiri shihira pam niriba maa ni.
en: Stephen, who stood out among the believers for the way Gods grace was at work in his life and for his exceptional endowment with divine power, was doing great wonders and signs among the people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa piri Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunɔguliba tuma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kɔra daŋ ni, bɛ daa piila Kɔre ŋun daa nyɛ Asaf bidibiga la bia Mɛshɛlɛmia.
en: The temple guards were also divided into groups according to clans. Meshelemiah son of Kore was from the Korah clan and was a descendant of Asaph.

dag: Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba kalinli ni zooi gari Lɛvinim kalinli kaman ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pisopɔinnaata la zuɣu.
en: There are , Levites, but there are , firstborn sons from the other families. This leaves more firstborn sons than Levites.

dag: Ka naa daa kpuɣ o salima jaaŋgbee la tir o.
en: The king held out the gold scepter to Esther, and she got up and stood before him.

dag: Ninsalinim ni tooi mali bɛ wuna? Binyara lala pala Naawuni.
en: Can humans make their own gods? If so, they are not gods at all!.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, faashee kabiɛlli kpe tiŋgban ni pooi, di yi pa lala, di kul ni nyɛla kabiɛl yini maa ko; amaa di yi kpe tiŋgban ni pooi, di ni nabi.
en: I assure you that unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it can only be a single seed. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi zaŋ bɛ ni daa tahi laɣ shɛli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa na m-mali anzinfa taha mini firilakpihindi bina ni lahi ni kikahi bee salima bee anzinfa lahi n-zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: None of the money, however, was used to pay for making silver cups, bowls, trumpets, or tools for tending the lamps, or any other article of silver or of gold.

dag: Daadam, tin shɛli nim yi bi ʒe yim ni mani ka tum alahichi, ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu ka m mɔŋ ba bindirigu, ka chɛ ka kum lu bɛ zuɣu n-kuri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni.
en: Son of man, I will punish any nation that leaves me and sins against me. I will stop their food supply. I might cause a famine and remove the people and animals from that country.

dag: Di saha ka Zɛdɛkia Chɛnaana bia la daa chaŋ ti lab Mikaya tapaɣa, ka bɔh o, Wula ka Yawɛ shia niŋ yi n ni kana ti tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Then the prophet Zedekiah went to Micaiah and hit him on the face. Zedekiah said, How is it that the Spirit of the Lord left me to speak through you.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Bɔ ka n niŋ? Pa bɔhigu yini kɔŋko ka m bɔhi.
en: David said, What did I do now? I didnt do anything wrong! I was only talking.

dag: ka daa gari n salalaantab tooni Yɛhudianim adiini soli dolibu ni; ka di nyɛla n suhu ni daa kul ye n yaannim kaya dolibu zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: I advanced in Judaism beyond many of my peers, because I was much more militant about the traditions of my ancestors.

dag: Ka o daa garigi yɛl o, N ni gbaai m buzɔŋ ni bubil polli ti a. Ka paɣ maa bɔh o, Ka bimbɔ ka a yɛn zaŋ ti ma ka di nyɛ alikauli lɔbu shɛhira hal ka a ti zaŋ bua maa ti ma na.
en: One of my young goats, he answered. What will you give me to keep until you send the goat? she asked.

dag: M bi zaŋ mmaŋ dalimla ninsal shɛhira, amaa n yɛli ya la dimbɔŋɔ yi tiliginsim nyabu zuɣu.
en: It is not that I must have a human witness; I say this only in order that you may be saved.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Wula ka niriba lee ni tooi yɛli ni Masia nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa?.
en: Then Jesus said, Why do people say that the Messiah is the Son of David?.

dag: ka Ram dɔɣi Aminadab.
en: Hezron was the father of Ram. Ram was the father of Amminadab.

dag: Dinzuɣu timmi Jɔpa ti boli Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la na.
en: Send messengers to Joppa at once and summon a certain Simon, the one known as Peter.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti kpe tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni chaŋchaŋ gil li, ka sab di yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm niŋ litaafi ni, ka lan pirigi di fɔndi ʒii buyopɔin zuɣu n-zaŋ labi ti ti Jɔshua Shilo sansani maa ni.
en: So the men went all over the land and set down in writing how they divided it into seven parts, making a list of the towns. Then they went back to Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.

dag: n wahala ŋɔ zaa lan chɛmi ka dabiɛm mali ma; dama m mi ni a ku yɛli ni n ka taali.
en: But the suffering still frightens me. I know that God will not see me as innocent.

dag: Yawɛ dunoli m-bɔŋɔ; wuntizɔriba kɔŋko n-ni tooi dol li kpe.
en: Those are the Lord s gates, and only good people can go through them.

dag: Kalim Gɛrishɔn gba zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: to take a census of the Levite clan of Gershon by subclans and families.

dag: Bɛ daa mali karimbaani, ka tum din chihiri n sani ka n nya li, dinzuɣu ka n daa ku ba.
en: They thought they were better than everyone else, and they did things I hate. And so I destroyed them.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa chaŋ luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Gɛtsɛmani la ka o ti yɛli ba, Ʒinimiya kpe ka n chaŋ ti suhi Naawuni.
en: Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and he told them, Sit here while I pray.

dag: O daa wurim bɛ ni zaani luɣ shɛŋa tuhiri tɔbu ka wurim bɛ fɔntinsi. O daa yi ŋum, dabiɛm gbaarila sokam zaa bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: he ravaged their widows and laid waste to their cities. When the earth and everything in it became horrified by the sound of his raging.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa malila kpambaliba kɔbisiyi ni pihinu ka bɛ su niriba fukumsi.
en: Solomon appointed officers to be in charge of his workers.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa dii darigi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka yɛli, O mɔri Naawuni! Bɔ ka ti lan bɔri shɛhiranim ni ti niŋ yaha? Yi zaa wum o ni mɔri Naawuni shɛm.
en: When the high priest heard this, he tore his clothes in anger. He said, This man has said things that insult God! We dont need any more witnesses. You all heard his insulting words.

dag: Ka Abija min o tɔbbihi maa daa ku ba pam, ka bɛ ni daa ku Izraɛlnim maa ninvuɣ shɛb daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbisinu.
en: Abijah and his people struck them severely: five hundred thousand select warriors were killed.

dag: Saɣisim a bihi tahima ni na beni saha shɛl la, ka di yu ni bɛ bahi yoli.
en: Discipline your children while there is hope, but dont plan to kill them.

dag: N yiɣisirila yuntisuɣu m-paɣir a, a wuntia zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.

dag: Ka Hiram daa tim ti yɛli Sulemaana, N wum a ni tim na nti yɛli ma shɛm la, ka m mali shili ni n-niŋ a ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ sida dakuɣiri mini sipirɛs dakuɣuri ŋmabu polo la.
en: Hiram sent word back to Solomon: I have heard your message to me. I will do as you wish with the cedar and pinewood.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wum o wuhibu maa ŋahili, dama bɛ daa mirila Jɛrusalɛm ka niriba maa tɛhiri ni o dii yɛn chɛmi ka Naawuni nam piligi.
en: As they listened to this, Jesus told them another parable because he was near Jerusalem and they thought Gods kingdom would appear right away.

dag: Nuhu daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pihinu, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: and died at the age of .

dag: Ŋun yɛn da kul yɛrimi, Di mali shaara, di mali shaara, di nyaaŋa ka o chaŋ ha ti nyuri bara.
en: The buyer says, Bad, bad, but then goes away and brags.

dag: Ŋunkam zu o ba bee o ma binshɛli ka yɛli ni di pala zaɣ biɛɣu, dilan nyɛla ŋun pahi ninvuɣ kuriba ni.
en: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.

dag: Ka yi sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bɛ ni duɣi bindir shɛli tahilaa puuni, di simdi ka di nyɛla zim viɛlli, ka kpam be di ni.
en: If you bring a grain offering cooked in a frying pan, it must be made from fine flour mixed with oil.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛri din nyɛ: saŋkpana.
en: These are the rules for any infection of leprosy.

dag: Di saha ka Zɔfar ŋun daa nyɛ Naama nir la daa garigi yɛli.
en: Then Zophar from Naamah answered:.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa lihi Amalɛknima, ka tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Amalɛknima n-daa be zuliya kam tooni, Amaa bɛ bahigu ni ti nyɛla bahi yoli zaa.
en: Then Balaam saw the Amalekites and said this: Amalek is the strongest of all nations, but even Amalek will be destroyed.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ daanya mali bansi pihinu n-zaŋ gɔhigɔhi suɣili maa tabili taba, ka di niŋ zaɣ yini.
en: They made fifty copper clasps to join the tent together so that it would be one whole structure.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ sol zuɣu zibisi ka sarigira, ka Yawɛ malaika kariti doli ba.
en: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.

dag: Ka maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa yɛli tɔbbihi bɛn yi tɔb maa na, Yawɛ ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Musa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Eleazar the priest said to the men who had returned from battle, These are the regulations that the Lord has given to Moses.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ a yuri siɣi teeku ni, ka fuɣifuɣi pani di ko titali zuɣu.
en: You make your horses tread on the sea; turbulent waters foam.

dag: Ti ni daa zaŋ lahibal suŋ waazu yihi tin ya la zuɣu ka Naawuni boli ya ni yi mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia ti laɣim nya o jilima.
en: God called you to this through the Good News we preached to you; he called you to possess your share of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Tarimtali mini Yawɛ zɔbo laara nyɛla buni mini jilima ni nyɛvili.
en: Respect and serve the Lord ! Your reward will be wealth, a long life, and honor.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o zuli n-vooi saŋmarisi pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim zuɣu bahi dunia ni; ka daa chaŋ ti ʒe paɣ so ŋun yɛn dɔɣi maa tooni ni o ti dɔɣi ka o di bia maa nyɛvili.
en: His tail swept down a third of heavens stars and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman who was about to give birth so that when she gave birth, he might devour her child.

dag: Nazari nir zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: saha shɛl o ni zaŋ wolig omaŋ maa tariga yi ti paai, bɛn zaŋm o na ti zali Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni.
en: When you complete your nazirite vow, you shall perform this ritual. You shall go to the entrance of the Tent.

dag: Hal bɛ ni kul zaŋ anzinfa duhi kaman taŋkpaɣu la, ka zaŋ situra duhi kaman yaɣiri maa zaa yoli.
en: If they store up silver like dust, amass clothing like clay.

dag: Ka wain booriba kpɛm la daa yɛli Yisifu o zahindi ni nyɛ shɛm. O daa yɛl o mi, Zahindi maa ni n sa nyami ka wain tia ʒe n tooni.
en: The chief wine steward described his dream to Joseph: In my dream there was a vine right in front of me.

dag: Lihimiya daboya zuɣusaa nya, luɣ dini ka yi mini so lee bi dɔni? Yi daa ʒila soya naŋgban kpansi n-guhiri yi mamanima kaman Laribu m-be tiŋgban nɛli ni la. Yi zaŋ zina niŋbu mini yi ninvuɣ biɛtali n-ta tiŋgbani maa daɣiri.
en: Look up at the hilltops. Is there any place where you have not acted like a prostitute? You waited for lovers along the roadside, as an Arab waits for victims in the desert. You have defiled the land with your prostitution.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka bɛ ni ti kana ti zaŋ binshɛɣukam din be a yiŋ puuni min a yaannim ni daa bo binshɛɣukam zali hal ni zuŋɔ la n-kuli Babilɔn, ka di shɛli ku kpalim. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.

dag: Ka ŋun zaŋ li ti Yawɛ maa yi bɔr ni o yo di zuɣu ka dee li, dindina ŋun yom di daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi ka di leeg o dini.
en: If you want to buy the field back, you must add one-fifth to that price. Then you will get the field back.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Yuza zuɣu, ka o daa chɛ ka o lu n-kpi nimaani Naawuni tooni, o ni daa zaŋ o nuu gbaai Alikauli Adaka maa zuɣu.
en: At once the Lord became angry with Uzzah and killed him for touching the Box. He died there in God's presence.

dag: Bɛla ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛɔr bidibiga ka nyɛ Dinhaba nir la daa di nam Ɛdom.
en: Bela son of Beor was a king who ruled in Edom. He ruled over the city of Dinhabah.

dag: Yiɣisima, kuhimi pampam zaawuni, tiŋguliba ni deeri tab tuma saha shɛl la. Chɛ ka a suhu saɣim pam ti Duuma tooni. Suhim o a bihi nyɛviya zuɣu; kum ni tarigi bi shɛb sɔŋ solɔɣu kam zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: All through the night get up again and again to cry out to the Lord; Pour out your heart and beg him for mercy on your children— Children starving to death on every street corner!.

dag: ka bɛ biŋkɔbiri duri din palipali la kpalim zaɣ kuma, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili din galisi zuɣu.
en: Theres an eerie silence in the peaceful meadows, because of the LORDs fierce anger.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ bihi mini bɛ niɣi ni bɛn ʒiri bɛ nɛma be tooni, ka bɛ ŋmaligi doli.
en: They headed back on their way, but they put the children, the livestock, and the prized possessions in front of them.

dag: Dabisi shɛli din pahir anahi dali ka bɛ daa laɣim Bɛraka Vinvamli ni, dama nimaani ka bɛ daa paɣi Yawɛ. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani Bɛraka Vinvamli hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Then on the fourth day, everyone came together in Beracah Valley and sang praises to the Lord . That's why that place was called Praise Valley.

dag: Wuhim bihi so shɛli din tuhi, ka bɛ yi ti zooi niŋ ninkura, bɛ ku ŋmaligi ka chɛ li.
en: Teach children in a way that fits their needs, and even when they are old, they will not leave the right path.

dag: N zaŋ a leela ŋun ni be n niriba ni n-kpahindi ba ka yihiri ba daɣiri ni din ni chɛ ka a baŋ ka kpahim bɛ soya.
en: I have made you a tester of metals, to examine my people to know and prove their ways.

dag: Dɔdai ŋun daa nyɛ Aho nir la n-daa su bɛ ni daa lan pirigi ninvuɣ shɛb la fukumsi gol so ŋun pahi ayi ni. Mikilɔt n daa su o yaɣili fukumsi. Ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: Dodai, from the Ahoahites, was in charge of the army group for the second month. Mikloth was a leader in that group. There were , men in Dodais group.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba zaa kalinli pirigibu buta puuni ʒii buyi kpi.
en: and throughout the land two-thirds of the people will die.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli, Chimham ni doli ma kuli ka n ti niŋ o a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani, ka a suhu ni kul yu ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa, n ni niŋ li ti a.
en: The king answered, Kimham will go back with me. I will be kind to him for you. I will do anything for you.

dag: N yɛtɔɣa zaa nyɛla wuntizɔbo yɛtɔɣa, di shɛli pala ʒiri bee n-nyɛ din gɔŋ.
en: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.

dag: N wum a ni suhi ma suhigu shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Ishimail gba polo maa. N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni, ka chɛ ka o zuliya nab pam. O ni ti nyɛla nanim pinaayi yaba, ka n chɛ ka o zuliya ti galisi pam.
en: I have heard your request about Ishmael, so I will bless him and give him many children and many descendants. He will be the father of twelve princes, and I will make a great nation of his descendants.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, So ʒi n-nyo firila zaŋ lɔɣu pil li bee n-zaŋ li sɔɣi, amaa o naɣ ni zaŋ li mi tam binshɛl zuɣu ni bɛnkam kpɛri yili maa ni na nyari li.
en: People dont light a lamp and then put it in a closet or under a basket. Rather, they place the lamp on a lampstand so that those who enter the house can see the light.

dag: nti be nimaani hal ka a biɛli suhuyiɣisili maa ti chɛ.
en: and stay with him for a while. When Esau stops being angry.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni di daa kpala talahi ni o be kaman o mabihi ni be shɛm shɛlikam puuni, ka di chɛ ka o tooi leei maligumaani titali ŋun ʒe yim ni ŋun nyɛ nambɔzɔra o tuma ni zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, ka di chɛ ka niriba nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ.
en: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.

dag: Wummi alikauli yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka zaŋ li yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: Listen to the terms of this covenant and proclaim them to the people of Judah and the citizens of Jerusalem.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti kari ninvuɣ biɛri bahi, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ o naani ni ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: Those who trust in the Lord will possess the land, but the wicked will be driven out.

dag: So daa bi lo a nuhi, so mi daa bi ba a naba bandi. A lumi kaman nir ni lu putɔɣulan tooni shɛm la. Ka niriba maa zaa daa lan kum o zuɣu yaha.
en: No one tied your hands or chained your feet, yet you died as a victim of murderers. Everyone started crying again.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli nyariba, Di lan nyan ya, ka yɛli anabinima, Di yɛliya ti din tuhi; naɣ yɛlimiya ti la ti suhu ni yu shɛli ni binshɛŋa din bi tuhi yɛla.
en: They tell the prophets to keep quiet. They say, Don't talk to us about what's right. Tell us what we want to hear. Let us keep our illusions.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti nya li, di daa gari ba mi ka dabiɛm gbaai ba ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: But when they saw it, they were amazed; they were afraid and ran away.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Ŋunkam nyu kɔbiliga ŋɔ kom, kɔnyuri ni lan gbaag o yaha.
en: Jesus answered, Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔash ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihitanaayopɔin saha, ka Jɛhɔahaz bia Jɛhɔash daa di Izraɛl nam ʒi Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pinaayɔbu.
en: Jehoash became king of Israel in the thirty-seventh year of Joash's rule in Judah, and he ruled years from Samaria.

dag: A daa tɛhiya ni nyini n-kul yɛn su nam sahakam, ka bi tɛhi a suhu ni ni di nyɛla shɛli bee n-tɛhi di zaa ni ti yɛn bahindi shɛm.
en: You said, Im forever; Im the eternal mistress. You didnt stop and think; you didnt consider the outcome.

dag: ka chɛ ka Speen ŋariŋ titaŋa zaa mini ŋariŋ viɛla zaa shim.
en: He will sink even the largest and most beautiful ships.

dag: ka fɔntin shɛli din ti miri kpim maa ni do luɣ shɛli maa kpamba ni bo naɣisa so bɛ ni na ʒi n-zaŋ tum tuma bee n-zaŋ dapua pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu.
en: Once it is determined which city is closest to the dead body, its elders must take a young cow that hasnt been used or yet pulled a plow.

dag: Ziɔnnima, dumiya zoya zuɣu nti moli lahiba suŋ molo. Jɛrusalɛmnima, duhimiya yi yee moli lahiba suŋ molo. Duhimiya yi kukoya pam yɛli Juda fɔntinsi ni nima, Yi Naawuni kanna! Di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: Go up on a high mountain, messenger Zion! Raise your voice and shout, messenger Jerusalem! Raise it; dont be afraid; say to the cities of Judah, Here is your God.

dag: dama bɛn kpalim maa ni ti yi Jɛrusalɛm mini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu na n-galisi pam. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ loya ni o ni chɛ ka lala niŋ.
en: There will be people in Jerusalem and on Mount Zion who will survive, because the Lord is determined to make this happen.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa gbaai Jɔn Baptaizira kpɛhi duu saha shɛl la nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa ka Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na nti yihiri Naawuni lahibal suŋ waazu.
en: After John was arrested, Jesus came into Galilee announcing Gods good news.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ma chaŋ duno shɛli din kpɛri dundɔŋ maa puuni, ka n daa lihi nya ka voli be gooni ni.
en: So I went to the entrance to the courtyard, and I saw a hole in the wall.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-labi yi ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni, ka yi yaannim gba daa bi mi li, ka yi ti jɛmdi wun shɛŋa nimaani yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, dama n ku zɔn ya nambɔɣu. .
en: So then, I will throw you out of this land into a land that neither you nor your ancestors have ever known. And there you will serve other gods day and night, and I will show you no mercy.

dag: Ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa daa yɛl o, Chama. Di saha ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa zo n-kuli ti boli bia maa ma na.
en: Pharaohs daughter agreed, Yes, do that. So the girl went and called the childs mother.

dag: N ni dol a zaligunima; di chɛ ma bahi zaa.
en: I will keep your statutes. Please dont leave me all alone!.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun pah ata la ŋun daa zaŋ o yiŋlan maa ni ti o laɣ shɛli maa ti gaai bɔɣili zaŋ li pi.
en: But the servant who had received the one valuable coin dug a hole in the ground and buried his masters money.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb daa tɛhi ni yɛla maa ʒila Alikizanda zuɣu, Yɛhudianim ni daa daag o zali tooni la zuɣu; ka o daa kpuɣ o nuu gahi salo maa ni o wuhi ba din niŋ.
en: Several of the Jewish leaders pushed a man named Alexander to the front of the crowd and started telling him what to say. He motioned with his hand and tried to explain what was going on.

dag: Taali sanyoo sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ. Di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: This is the Instruction for the compensation offering: It is most holy.

dag: o ni daa wum Lazarɔs bariŋ maa yɛla o daa kpalim o ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa n-niŋla biɛr ayi pahi;.
en: But he stayed where he was for two more days.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ ti liri Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa n-chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi zani Gibia kaman bɛ ni daa pun niŋdi shɛm la.
en: Three days later, the Israelites marched out against the Benjaminites. They lined up for battle against Gibeah as before.

dag: Yisa daa ti be luɣ shɛli suhiri Naawuni. O ni daa ti suhi naai ka o nyaandoliba maa ni yino yɛl o, Ti Duuma, wuhim ti ti ni yɛn suhiri Naawuni shɛm kaman Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa wuh o nyaandoliba shɛm la.
en: Jesus was praying in a certain place. When he finished, one of his disciples said, Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples.

dag: A mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa cham gilimi Jɛriko goondaa maa napɔŋ yim dahin yini kam n-niŋ lala hal ti paai daba ayɔbu.
en: Circle the city with all the soldiers, going around the city one time. Do this for six days.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ bɛ kpiɔŋ jilima. A nirilim zuɣu ka ti di nasara.
en: You are their amazing strength. Their power comes from you.

dag: ka tiŋkpaŋ maa nim daa ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku deeg o, o ni daa pun lo nia ni o gari chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm zuɣu.
en: But he was on his way to Jerusalem, so the people there refused to welcome him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni o ni daa ku Galilinim shɛb maa daa nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim gari Galilinim zaa zuɣu ka bɛ daa kpi maa?.
en: Jesus answered, Do you think this happened to those people because they were more sinful than all other people from Galilee?.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ m ma, ka banim mi nyɛ n tizɔbihi.
en: Jesus asked, Who is my mother and who are my brothers.

dag: Ŋun Yawɛ n-daa lan kari Amɔrinim zaa bɛn daa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu tinim gba ni jɛmla Yawɛ, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni.
en: As we advanced into this land, the Lord drove out all the Amorites who lived here. So we also will serve the Lord ; he is our God.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul nyurila bara bɛ suhuri ni kɔr biɛri zuɣu; ka bɛn nyɛ diribarilimnim mi kul zaɣisiri Yawɛ ka tur o.
en: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord .

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ o paɣ Zara nti sɔɣi sil shɛli din daa be Makipɛla palo din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo la ni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Then Abraham buried his wife Sarah in that cave in the land of Canaan.

dag: Ka kɔnyuri daa gbaai Samsin pam, ka o suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Nyini n-chɛ ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ di nasara ŋɔ, ka kɔnyuri ti yɛn ku ma, ka n lu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi gundi ŋɔ nuu ni.
en: Then Samson became very thirsty, so he called to the Lord and said, You gave me this great victory; am I now going to die of thirst and be captured by these heathen Philistines.

dag: Ka Lidanim mini Sharɔnnim zaa daa nya doo maa, ka niŋ ti Duuma yɛda.
en: Many people in the towns of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and became followers of the Lord.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hɛburɔn ni Uziɛl.
en: Kohath had four sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
